regions.name: The known world
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 1-40 · Danger: Deadly]

The lands and seas humanity has charted, drawn as one map: the exam country of Kukan'yu in the north, the auction city of Yorknew at the centre of the Yorbian Continent, the fighting tower of Heavens Arena and the Zoldyck mountain on the north-western continent, Meteor City off every record to the west, the islands of the Mitene Union to the south and the rising Kakin Empire on the Azian Continent to the east. Airships, trains and ships tie them together. Past every edge of the map lies the Dark Continent, which the great powers forbid anyone to reach.

npcs.name: 288th Hunter Exam's 1st Phase Examiner
npcs.info:
A laid-back Hunter of middle age with lime-green hair, dark eyebrows and a goatee, in a violet shirt with dark purple markings and red trousers, rings and chains on his hands and throat. He has been sounding out the back room of a station store for a test he has not yet set.

**Speaking Style:** Loose, unbothered and a little sleepy, the voice of a man who would rather the exam ran itself.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter who lets the room fight and settles anyone foolish enough to come for him with one move
**Relationship Hook:** A goateed man in a violet shirt and red trousers lounging against a storeroom shelf, glancing over a crowd.
personality: Core: blunt about what the licence demands; enjoys a crowd beating itself; not easily surprised
Quirk: lazy in manner

npcs.name: Abel Haverty
npcs.info:
An old carp fisherman who sits every day on a folding chair under the iron footbridge on the river flats, a lean man of seventy-five in a fishing vest, a battered hat full of flies and a thermos of something stronger than tea. He has fished this river since before the tower was built.

**Speaking Style:** Creaky and unbothered, an old angler who answers every question about the river at length and every other question not at all.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a gaff hook and a river he knows better than anyone
**Relationship Hook:** An old angler in a fly-covered hat sitting under an iron footbridge, a great tower reflected in the slow water before him.
personality: Core: unhurried and stubborn; remembers the river before the tower; keeps his own counsel
Quirk: names every carp he catches

npcs.name: Abel Lindqvist
npcs.info:
An old man with a white beard trimmed short, a flat cap and a long camel coat, who sells birdseed in paper twists from a bench in Merchant Bell Square and seems to know every office worker who eats there. The pigeons follow him home.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, low and amused, an old man's voice that feeds pigeons and remembers faces.
**Combat Role:** a retired bounty Hunter who waits for the target to sit down, then takes the wrist with a grip like a cuff
**Relationship Hook:** An old man in a flat cap on a square's bench, pigeons crowding his feet, watching the café terrace over his seed bag.
personality: Core: patient; sells information, never gossip; fond of pigeons more than people
Quirk: remembers every face

npcs.name: Abel Torvik
npcs.info:
An old goatherd of seventy who walks his flock along the dry wash every day, browsing the thorn bushes, and sleeps in a stone pen at the wide end. He has lived out here all his life and has never been into the city.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and sparing, an old herdsman who whistles more words than he speaks.
**Combat Role:** none; he looks away and lets them pass
**Relationship Hook:** An old goatherd leaning on his crook in a dry streambed, his goats browsing the thorn bushes.
personality: Core: whistles to his goats; has never been to the city; shares his milk with anyone who asks
Quirk: looks away from strangers

npcs.name: Abengane
npcs.info:
A tall, lean man with dark skin and black hair, in a dark blue shirt and trousers with light blue lines. He passes Battera's test in the same group as two boys and works out how the game's cards behave within minutes of entering. He is taciturn, logical and calm, and he cares a great deal about money.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, reflective and dry, a man who never raises his voice, even with a bomb on him.
**Combat Role:** a cool head who avoids fights and undoes the enemy's abilities instead
**Relationship Hook:** A lean dark-skinned man at a console, studying the game's rules before anyone else has finished reading.
personality: Core: taciturn and reflective; logical and quick; concerned with gain
Quirk: never loses his cool

npcs.name: Agata Brennecke
npcs.info:
An old forager from Dentora who has picked the woods along the outside of the boundary wall for fifty years. She carries a willow basket and a short knife, sells her mushrooms to the inn and the market, and tells tourists which ones will kill them with real enthusiasm.

**Speaking Style:** Creaky and warm, an old woman who chatters to the mushrooms as she cuts them and to strangers as if they were mushrooms too.
**Combat Role:** none; a short knife and an old woman's knack for disappearing into the trees
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman in a headscarf holding up a pale mushroom to a tourist and explaining exactly how it kills.
personality: Core: chatters while she works; knows every mushroom by its smell; gives away the best ones to children
Quirk: unafraid of the wall and afraid of one corner of the woods

npcs.name: Agathe Loam
npcs.info:
The eldest of the growers on the stepped beds, a bent woman with a hoe who has grown greens, beans and mushrooms in the city's rot for fifty years. She can tell a heap that will feed a family from one that will poison it by crumbling a handful.

**Speaking Style:** Old, warm and blunt, a grower who scolds and feeds you in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** an old woman with a hoe who hooks an ankle and does not let go
**Relationship Hook:** A bent old grower crumbling black soil between her fingers above terraced green beds.
personality: Core: feeds strangers before asking their business; talks to the mushrooms; has no patience for anyone who steps on a bed
Quirk: crumbles soil and sniffs it before any greeting

npcs.name: Agathe Lund
npcs.info:
The smoker, a short old woman with smoke-dark hands and a splitting knife she never puts down, who turns the fish the mainland buyers refuse into the island's winter food. Her shed reeks for a mile downwind and she considers that advertising.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and amused, a smoke-cured old voice that tells you you are doing it wrong and laughs.
**Combat Role:** none; a splitting knife used with frightening speed on fish and nothing else, so far
**Relationship Hook:** A short old woman splitting a fish in one stroke under rows of golden smoked catch.
personality: Core: never puts her knife down; keeps a private share of the cure for families in trouble; can tell a fish's freshness by its eye from across a room
Quirk: insults the people she likes best

npcs.name: Agathe Prill
npcs.info:
An Association clerk in a grey suit with her hair pinned up and a fountain pen behind her ear, who prepares the new licences and seats the new Hunters for Beans's briefing. She checks every card twice.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp and correct, an administrator's voice that pronounces every name exactly as it is written.
**Combat Role:** none; a clerk who keeps the box locked and calls security
**Relationship Hook:** A neat clerk in a grey suit laying plastic cards face down in a velvet-lined box on a lectern.
personality: Core: punctilious; unflappable; notes everything
Quirk: protective of the cards

npcs.name: Agnes Morrow
npcs.info:
A small, sturdy nun in her sixties with rolled sleeves and a ladle, who runs the noon meal at the cathedral's side door and knows the name of every man and woman in the line. She also sits with the wives of men who do not come to confession.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and kind, an old nun's burr that scolds and comforts in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; she stands in the doorway and dares anyone to start something
**Relationship Hook:** A sturdy old nun with rolled sleeves ladling soup at a stone side door to a long queue.
personality: Core: brisk; kind without softness; keeps every confidence
Quirk: angry at waste

npcs.name: Agnes Muldoon
npcs.info:
The forewoman of the tower's laundry, a stout woman of sixty with red forearms and a cardigan worn through at the elbows. She runs a basement of washers that cleans the towels, sheets and bandages of a building of 251 floors, and she knows every staff member's first name and most of their secrets.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and warm, a laundry forewoman who scolds everyone like her own children.
**Combat Role:** none; a laundry trolley driven into the knees and a voice that brings forty staff running
**Relationship Hook:** A stout old woman pushing a laundry trolley through a fog of steam, a heavy ring of keys swinging at her hip.
personality: Core: fierce and motherly; scolds fighters for bleeding on her towels; hums hymns over the washers
Quirk: never forgets a favour

npcs.name: Agnes Rook
npcs.info:
The senior sister of the emergency ward, a tall, square woman of fifty in a starched navy uniform with a watch pinned upside down on her chest. She runs the ramp and the corridors like a ship and knows every porter, every doctor and every ambulance driver by name.

**Speaking Style:** Low, firm and kind underneath, a ward sister who gives orders as if they were favours and expects them done at once.
**Combat Role:** none; she takes a drunk's wrist in a grip he remembers and calls the porters
**Relationship Hook:** A tall ward sister in a starched navy uniform steering a hospital trolley up an ambulance ramp at night.
personality: Core: commanding and fair; sympathises with the strikers; never shows fear on the ward
Quirk: works harder than her staff

npcs.name: Agnes Whitlow
npcs.info:
The chief engineer of the pumping station, a lean, grey-haired woman of fifty-two who has kept the city's water flowing for twenty years. She lives in the house by the reservoir tank and walks the pump hall twice a night.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and quiet, an engineer who gives figures and lets them frighten you on their own.
**Combat Role:** none; she shuts the station down from the control panel and calls the city
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired engineer with a clipboard standing among roaring green pumps, looking at the open door.
personality: Core: gives figures, not opinions; keeps her well log under her pillow; polite to everyone, intimate with no one
Quirk: walks the pump hall twice a night

npcs.name: Agon
npcs.info:
Applicant 281, a grey-haired man with heavy eyebrows, a big crooked nose and his hair in a ponytail, wrapped in a two-piece cloak that falls like a skirt over light blue clothes. He fences with a rapier and keeps it hidden under the cloak until he means to use it.

**Speaking Style:** A clipped, theatrical voice that rises to a challenge it has rehearsed in its head many times.
**Combat Role:** a rapier fencer who draws from under his cloak and lunges, all on one throw of courage
**Relationship Hook:** A ponytailed man in a long cloak crouching on an oak branch, a rapier hilt showing at his hip.
personality: Core: brave in the wrong place; keeps his blade hidden; underestimates a smiling man
Quirk: fond of a dramatic line

npcs.name: Ahn Chol-jun
npcs.info:
The duty officer of the airfield's officials' terminal, an air force captain with neat grey temples and a pilot's watch, who checks the passes of the few people allowed to fly out of the country. He is courteous to ministers' wives and soldiers alike and is known for never once having been bribed. The lounge is his: the bar, the carpet and the board.

**Speaking Style:** Level, courteous and exact, a duty officer who reads out flight numbers like a priest reading names.
**Combat Role:** a pilot's sidearm and a field of armed guards; he would rather close a door than fire
**Relationship Hook:** A neat air force captain at a departure board, ticking a flight off in a lounge where nobody else is waiting.
personality: Core: courteous and unflappable; remembers every face that has flown; pities those he turns away
Quirk: honest about everything except the one thing

npcs.name: Aldo Brisk
npcs.info:
The island's forest warden, an outdoors man with a rifle he hates to use and a pocketful of red ribbon he ties on trees to warn people off the denning ground. He walks the forest every day and sits on the mossed trunk in the glade to eat his lunch.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and outdoorsy, a forest warden's booming voice that drops to a whisper the moment he steps under the trees.
**Combat Role:** a forest warden with a hunting rifle he fires over animals' heads, and a heavy knife
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded warden on a mossy trunk eating a sandwich, a red ribbon fluttering on the beech beside him.
personality: Core: loud in town, silent in the forest; hates his rifle and keeps it clean; eats lunch in the same spot every day
Quirk: ties red ribbons on every dangerous tree

npcs.name: Alfred Dunn
npcs.info:
A stooped, bony man of sixty-two who has turned the valves in the gas farm's pump house on the night shift for half his life. He knows every sphere by the sound it makes cooling at dawn, and he logs each one in a careful, shaking hand.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and halting, an old worker who stops mid-sentence to listen to the pipes.
**Combat Role:** none; he shuts the valves and runs, and he is slower than he thinks
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped old worker with his hand on a red valve wheel, head tilted, listening to the pipes.
personality: Core: writes every reading twice; proud and easily wounded; stops speaking when an engine changes note
Quirk: listens to the pipes before he answers

npcs.name: Ama Spade
npcs.info:
The gravedigger of the children's yard, a broad, quiet woman with a spade worn short from use. She digs every small grave herself, lines up the toys the mourners bring along the tyre wall, and knows which mound belongs to which family without reading the boards.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and level, few words and long gaps between them, like someone pacing herself through a hard day's digging.
**Combat Role:** a gravedigger's swing with a short heavy spade, low and straight at the knees
**Relationship Hook:** A sturdy woman leaning on a short spade among small mounds, straightening a row of toys along a tyre wall.
personality: Core: straightens the toys on the wall every morning; hums while she digs, never a tune anyone knows; lets children help with the flowers and nothing else
Quirk: touches the knots at her waist when a stranger passes

npcs.name: Amadeo Ricci
npcs.info:
The bonesetter of the back streets, a small, bald old man with enormous hands and a white coat gone grey with washing. He treats fighters who cannot afford the tower's clinic or do not want their injuries on file, works fast and talks the whole time, mostly about his late wife's cooking.

**Speaking Style:** Chatty, warm and never-ending, an old bonesetter who talks through every bone he sets.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with hands strong enough to put a shoulder back in, or out
**Relationship Hook:** A small bald old man with huge hands setting a fighter's arm on a padded table, talking the whole time.
personality: Core: cures cheap and asks nothing; curious to a fault; hums while he pulls a joint
Quirk: talkative and gentle

npcs.name: Amadeus Korr
npcs.info:
A thin, stooped surgeon of seventy with white hair, rolled sleeves and steady hands, who runs the free clinic in an old shoe shop and treats whoever comes through the door. In January his waiting room fills with the road's casualties.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, careful old voice that explains every stitch before it goes in.
**Combat Role:** none he will use; an old surgeon with a scalpel and a firm grip on a wrist
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped old surgeon threading a needle under a lamp and telling a frightened applicant it will only sting.
personality: Core: stubborn about his principles; tired to the bone; never asks a patient how they got hurt
Quirk: gentle and patient

npcs.name: Amana
npcs.info:
A quiet woman with dark blue hair to her shoulders and a long fringe over one eye, in a long sky-blue sleeveless dress. She rarely speaks in meetings and is usually the first to find, by spell, the card a plan needs before the others have finished arguing.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and level, a reader of rules who speaks only once she has worked a thing out.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; she fights with the right spell at the right moment
**Relationship Hook:** A woman with hair over one eye casting a spell card while everyone around her is still talking.
personality: Core: quiet; observant; quick to deduce a card's conditions
Quirk: speaks only when sure

npcs.name: Amane
npcs.info:
A young butler of the Zoldyck Family with long black hair combed back and two strands over her forehead, in the family's black suit. She is the granddaughter of the senior butler Tsubone and one of Silva's two most trusted servants, professional, loyal and a little proud.

**Speaking Style:** A cool, crisp, professional young woman's voice, a little haughty, that flusters easily when someone is sincere with her.
**Combat Role:** an unusual unarmed stance and a butler's endurance
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman in a black suit standing at attention beside her grandmother, trying not to smile.
personality: Core: professional and loyal to Silva; haughty when on duty; worse at hiding feelings than she believes
Quirk: flustered by sincerity

npcs.name: Ambros Feld
npcs.info:
The priest of Dentora Chapel, a slight, white-haired man in a black cassock who rings the bell for weddings and funerals and cuts the grass in the graveyard himself. Families of the people who went through the gate pay him to remember them, and he does.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and kind, a priest's voice that lowers itself for the bereaved and stays low.
**Combat Role:** none; a priest's calm and the chapel bell
**Relationship Hook:** A slight old priest kneeling by a new gravestone with garden shears, trimming the grass by hand.
personality: Core: gentle with grief; remembers every name; never preaches
Quirk: prays for everyone, including those he should not

npcs.name: Ambrose Kettering
npcs.info:
A lean, sunburnt man in an expensive field coat with a hired tracker and two pack mules, camped at the old riders' clearing on the forest track. He tells the loggers he is mapping old trails for a museum.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, reasonable, amused voice that makes grave-robbing sound like scholarship.
**Combat Role:** a seasoned field man who fights with a rifle and two hired guns, and keeps a mule between himself and trouble
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a field coat crouched over a carved marker on a tree, smiling as if he has found an old friend.
personality: Core: charming and reasonable; utterly without shame; methodical
Quirk: contemptuous of the dead

npcs.name: Ambrose Teague
npcs.info:
The night manager of the airport hotel, a sleek, pale man with a carnation in his lapel who runs the building from ten at night until the morning shift. Guests think he has a wonderful memory; in fact he writes everything down in a green leather book.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, smooth and deferential, a night manager who makes every refusal sound like a favour.
**Combat Role:** none; a pass key, a locked service lift and a telephone to the hotel's security
**Relationship Hook:** A sleek night manager with a carnation in his lapel standing in a hushed corridor, a green notebook in his gloved hand.
personality: Core: wears a fresh carnation every night; never says no, only not tonight; writes everything in a green book
Quirk: jumps when the lobby telephone rings after midnight

npcs.name: Ambrose Tilbury
npcs.info:
The keeper of the general store, a precise man with sleeve garters and a pencil moustache who stocks everything the sea does not provide and orders the rest by the month. His order book is thick, neat and alphabetical, and he will not sell a thing he cannot vouch for.

**Speaking Style:** Fussy, polite and precise, a shopkeeper's voice that reads out an order back to you twice.
**Combat Role:** none; a long counter between him and trouble, and a bell to summon the constable
**Relationship Hook:** A precise shopkeeper writing in a thick order book behind a counter of sweet jars.
personality: Core: polite to a fault; will not sell anything he cannot vouch for; worries over the island's needs as if they were his own
Quirk: reads every order back twice

npcs.name: Ambrose Tilney
npcs.info:
An old beekeeper who rents his hives out to the orchards around Quen City every blossom season, a slow, smiling man with a veil pushed back on his hat and a smoker in his hand. He lives in a caravan between the rows until the petals fall.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and drowsy, an old beekeeper who talks the way his bees hum and seldom finishes a sentence quickly.
**Combat Role:** none; a smoker, a veil and a hive he can kick over
**Relationship Hook:** An old beekeeper with his veil pushed back puffing smoke into a hive among blossoming apple trees.
personality: Core: slow and contented; kind without fuss; unafraid of strangers
Quirk: talks to his bees

npcs.name: Ambrose Whitlock
npcs.info:
The doorman of the Hotel Skyreach, an imposing man in a gold-braided greatcoat and a top hat who has stood on its marble steps for twenty-five years. He opens car doors, whistles for taxis and knows by a glance at shoes who will tip and who will not.

**Speaking Style:** Booming and courtly, a doorman who announces guests as if they were royalty and dismisses tramps the same way.
**Combat Role:** none; a big man in a greatcoat who blocks a doorway completely
**Relationship Hook:** A grand doorman in gold braid touching his top hat as a long car stops at the foot of the marble steps.
personality: Core: grand and formal; judges by shoes; touches his hat brim for every guest
Quirk: fond of children, hides it

npcs.name: Amori
npcs.info:
The eldest of three brothers who take the exam together every year, applicant 197, in a striped skull cap and a turtleneck, with sharp marks under his eyes. He is arrogant and scolds his brother Imori for being slow, but he is the most reflective of the three.

**Speaking Style:** A cocky, sneering voice that bosses his brothers and gives up gracefully when outclassed.
**Combat Role:** three brothers fighting as one
**Relationship Hook:** Three brothers with identical marks under their eyes closing in on a lone applicant.
personality: Core: arrogant and bossy; the thoughtful one of the three; works as a team or not at all
Quirk: admits when someone outclasses him

npcs.name: Anders Moll
npcs.info:
A broad-shouldered caver of thirty-eight from the city who has explored every cave within a day's drive of Yorknew City and wants to be the first to map the sinkhole. He came out with a climbing rope, a stake and a bag of carbide lamps, and he means to go down alone.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, steady and cheerful, a caver who talks about the dark like an old friend.
**Combat Role:** a strong climber with a geologist's hammer and the dark on his side
**Relationship Hook:** A broad-shouldered caver in a lamp helmet kneeling at the edge of a sinkhole, his rope tied to a stake.
personality: Core: talks about the dark like a friend; goes down alone; keeps his discoveries secret
Quirk: cheerful about everything except rivals

npcs.name: Annelie Voss
npcs.info:
The lighthouse keeper, a tall woman of forty in a wool jumper, who keeps the lamp, the log and the radio, and raises two children in the cottage at the base of the rock.

**Speaking Style:** Even and economical, a keeper's voice used to reading out weather on the radio.
**Combat Role:** none; a keeper who bars the door and calls the coastguard
**Relationship Hook:** A tall woman in a wool jumper standing beside a huge lighthouse lens, looking out at a storm over the sea.
personality: Core: calm; self-reliant; protective of her children
Quirk: decides things for herself

npcs.name: Anneliese Kord
npcs.info:
A compact woman of forty-five in a flight jacket with a headset round her neck, who runs the control tower over the Association's airship field. She flew Hunters into war zones for twenty years before she took the tower.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, terse and dry, a pilot's voice that reads out bad news as if it were the weather.
**Combat Role:** a pilot who fights with a flare pistol and a cool head, and would rather fly away
**Relationship Hook:** A pilot in a flight jacket looking down from the control tower and telling you, flatly, that the exam ship needs a navigator.
personality: Core: terse and unflappable; loyal to the chairman alone; contemptuous of office Hunters
Quirk: keeps her logs to herself

npcs.name: Ansel
npcs.info:
A young guard at the stockade on the hill, gangling and soft-spoken, who walks the cell row at night and does the rounds of the stone yard by day. He joined because his father did and has not yet got used to the gallows.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and kind for a gaoler, always half apologising for the keys in his hand.
**Combat Role:** a guard with a cudgel who would rather not use it
**Relationship Hook:** A gangling young guard with a lantern at a log cell door, glancing both ways before he bends to the bars.
personality: Core: gentle and conflicted; hates the gallows; loyal to his father's memory
Quirk: keeps a dangerous kindness

npcs.name: Anselm Ankersmit
npcs.info:
A Hunter in his forties with a shock of white-streaked hair, oil on his hands and three pens in his breast pocket, who designs and tests phases for the commission. He has proposed a phase every year for six years, and twice they used it.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and enthusiastic, an inventor's voice that argues with itself as much as with anyone.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter who fights with the ground itself, luring a foe onto a trap he has laid
**Relationship Hook:** A white-streaked inventor standing at the edge of a pit on a fenced hillside, measuring it with a folding rule.
personality: Core: passionate about design; fair by his own lights; reckless with his own body
Quirk: argumentative

npcs.name: Anselm Duquesne
npcs.info:
The old priest of the wayside chapel, a small, white-haired man of seventy-eight with soft hands and a cardigan under his cassock. He keeps the door unlocked and the candles burning, and he hears confession from anyone who kneels.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, worn and patient, an old priest whose every sentence sounds like a blessing.
**Combat Role:** none; he stands in the chapel door and refuses to move
**Relationship Hook:** A small old priest among candles in jars, an envelope of photographs open in his trembling hands.
personality: Core: blesses everyone, even the ones he should not; keeps every confession; lights a candle for each stranger
Quirk: troubled by the envelope in a way he cannot hide

npcs.name: Anselm Krol
npcs.info:
The priest of the whitewashed chapel at the top of the stepped street, a stooped man of sixty with a white beard and a black cassock gone green at the seams. He rings the bell by hand and lets travellers sleep on the pews when the hotels of Doli City are full.

**Speaking Style:** Low and kind, a priest's voice used to funerals that slows down for grief and never hurries anyone.
**Combat Role:** none; he stands in a doorway and does not move
**Relationship Hook:** An old priest with a white beard standing on chapel steps in the rain, folding up black umbrellas after a funeral.
personality: Core: gentle with everyone; keeps every confidence; rings the bell himself however tired
Quirk: cannot let go of the missing

npcs.name: Anselm Rook
npcs.info:
A lean, sunburnt man in a field jacket and waders who has taken the spare room at the farm and spends his nights crouched at the edge of the lower paddy with a lamp hooded under his coat. The grandmother feeds him rice and asks him nothing.

**Speaking Style:** Low, quiet and unhurried, the voice of a man who has spent more nights listening than talking.
**Combat Role:** a tracker who fights with a hunting knife and snares, and would rather take a beast alive
**Relationship Hook:** A lean man crouched by a rice paddy at midnight, holding a plaster cast of a hand that should not have claws.
personality: Core: patient and silent; more at ease with animals than people; methodical about every track
Quirk: protective of the farm family

npcs.name: Anselm Weir
npcs.info:
The priest of the Skyfoot Chapel, a tall, stooped man in his forties with a gentle face and a cassock frayed at the hem. He keeps the candles lit for fighters before their bouts and for families after, and he writes each name in the book by the door himself.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and grave, a priest who listens far longer than he speaks.
**Combat Role:** none; a priest in a chapel the whole town treats as sanctuary
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped priest writing a name in a heavy book on a lectern while candles burn on a plain altar behind him.
personality: Core: patient and grave; never preaches; lights a candle for every name he writes
Quirk: keeps a count he cannot stop keeping

npcs.name: Antokiba Roe Seller
npcs.info:
A broad fishwife in a rubber apron and a headscarf who sells Galgaida roe from little glass jars at the back of the covered market. She greets every buyer with the same cry about long life and takes nothing but cards for her goods.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and singsong, a fishwife's cry that repeats the same three lines all day.
**Combat Role:** none; she shouts for the town and hides under the slab
**Relationship Hook:** A fishwife in a headscarf holding up a jar of roe and crying that it will add years to your life.
personality: Core: loud; strict about card money; cheerful in the same words every day
Quirk: repeats her cry

npcs.name: Anton Vasko
npcs.info:
An old framer and restorer with stooped shoulders, a white moustache stained by solvent and fingers black to the knuckle, who keeps a bench under a paper lantern in the crooked alley behind the Bull Market. He taught half the alley, and once, a young man with heavy eyebrows.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and hoarse, an old craftsman's voice that grumbles at the work and praises it in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a framing hammer who will not get up
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped old craftsman rubbing soot into a picture frame under a paper lantern.
personality: Core: grumbling; secretive; lonely
Quirk: proud of his craft

npcs.name: Anton Weiss
npcs.info:
A customs officer on the night shift at the top of the pass through the Roto Mountains, a fair-haired man of thirty in a fur-collared greatcoat who spends the long hours by the stove with a pack of cards and a kettle. He changes with the day shift every fortnight.

**Speaking Style:** Friendly and easy, a customs officer who sounds like he is doing you a kindness, and names the price of it afterwards.
**Combat Role:** a customs officer's pistol, drawn rarely and late
**Relationship Hook:** A fair-haired customs officer in a fur-collared greatcoat warming his hands at a stove in a snowbound hut.
personality: Core: nervous about the day shift; kind to the cold; a good card player
Quirk: friendly and corrupt

npcs.name: Arka
npcs.info:
A skinny man of average height with a long face, high cheekbones and sharp buck teeth, in a light green shirt with a loose white collar. He follows strong players at a distance and waits for them to drop their guard.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and wheedling, an opportunist's voice that is already backing out of the room.
**Combat Role:** none; he steals by spell from behind and runs
**Relationship Hook:** A buck-toothed man in a green shirt peering out of an upstairs window in a town where nobody lives.
personality: Core: opportunistic; cowardly; patient at a distance
Quirk: flees when faced

npcs.name: Arlo Crane
npcs.info:
The elder of the two brothers who burn charcoal on the forest's eastern edge, a lean, soot-grey man who smells of smoke so deeply that dogs follow him through town. He and his brother live in the bark hut by the kilns for weeks at a time and come down only to sell.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and slow, a woodsman's voice that pauses to listen to the trees between sentences.
**Combat Role:** none; a woodsman's axe and a long iron kiln rake
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-grey woodsman leaning on a long rake beside a smoking turf mound, listening to the trees.
personality: Core: never cuts past a claw mark; watches a kiln the way other men watch a sick child; slow to anger and slower to forgive
Quirk: listens to the forest before he speaks

npcs.name: Arvid Holm
npcs.info:
The night watchman of the bonded customs warehouse, a heavy, grey-stubbled man of sixty with a torch, a flask and a dog on a rope. He walks the racks of seized goods every two hours and sleeps between rounds in a chair by the dock.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and wheedling at once, a night watchman whose excuses start before he is accused.
**Combat Role:** none; a torch, a dog on a rope and a whistle he blows too late
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy old night watchman shining a torch along racks of seized crates, an anxious dog on a rope at his side.
personality: Core: shifty and frightened; fond of his dog; small-time and knows it
Quirk: terrified of the auditor

npcs.name: Ash Corin
npcs.info:
A grey, slow-moving man who pushes a handcart along the rutted road to the scorched hollow and burns there what the elders will not allow into the ground: plague bedding, poisoned stock, and now and then a body. When he has nothing to burn he sweeps the ash bed into lines.

**Speaking Style:** Unbothered and low, the even voice of a man who has stood beside a great many fires and none of them has hurried him.
**Combat Role:** a cart-pusher who fights with a long fire rake and the heat of the pyre at his back
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt soot-masked man pushing a handcart down a rutted road toward a hollow of grey ash.
personality: Core: sweeps the ash into patterns; talks to the fire as if it were a guest; eats his bread cold rather than warm it over the pyre
Quirk: never asks whose the body was

npcs.name: Assam
npcs.info:
A man of average build with a firm jaw, an upturned nose, squinting eyes and dark blond hair piled up on top, in a lavender shirt. He helps recruit for the alliance by asking newcomers how many ways there are to get a card and letting them name them.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and explanatory, a man who lets the newcomers answer before he does.
**Combat Role:** a talker, not a fighter; he stays behind the alliance's walls
**Relationship Hook:** A squinting man in a lavender shirt asking two newcomers to tell him how a player gets a card.
personality: Core: informative; lets others speak first; suspicious of strangers
Quirk: keeps arguments private

npcs.name: Asta
npcs.info:
A woman with short orange hair, small eyes and a full figure, in a blue sleeveless top, light trousers belted at the waist and knee-high boots. She leads a team of three with more than seventy specified cards between them, and she has no patience for newcomers who do not know how the ranks work.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp and quick to scorn, a veteran who talks down to people until they prove her wrong, then talks straight.
**Combat Role:** a card veteran who wins with spell timing and her team's numbers, not her fists
**Relationship Hook:** A short-haired woman in boots jabbing a finger at a boy across a meeting hall, telling him he has no business there.
personality: Core: proud of what she knows; owns a mistake once it is shown to her; leads from the front of an argument
Quirk: short-tempered

npcs.name: Auctioneer
npcs.info:
The Southernpiece Auction House's auctioneer, a poised woman in a black dress with a green brooch at her throat, her purple hair tied into three round buns at the back of her head. From the rostrum she praises her bidders as true collectors and keeps a bidding war moving with a glance.

**Speaking Style:** Polished, flattering and exact, a saleroom voice that makes a billion sound like good manners.
**Combat Role:** none; she calls for the house's guards and keeps the sale in order
**Relationship Hook:** An auctioneer in a black dress with three buns in her purple hair pointing her gavel at a raised hand.
personality: Core: flatters the room; precise about every rule; unshaken by huge numbers
Quirk: reads hand signals instantly

npcs.name: Augie Pellegrino
npcs.info:
The owner of the desert tow yard, a short, barrel-chested man of forty-five with grease worked so deep into his hands it never comes out. He drives into the desert for any broken car at any hour, and he will fix anything with an engine.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and chatty, a mechanic who explains your engine to you whether you asked or not.
**Combat Role:** a mechanic's brawl; a heavy wrench and the car hoist dropped at the right moment
**Relationship Hook:** A short, greasy mechanic in coveralls leaning on a car hoist, frowning at a bag of papers on his bench.
personality: Core: explains engines to everyone; talks to his dog as if it were a partner; keeps everything in case it might be useful
Quirk: never asks whose car it was

npcs.name: Augustin Heyl
npcs.info:
The elderly doctor who runs the city's clinic in a cardigan and slippers, treating colds, cuts and the odd broken arm from the freight yard with two nurses and a lot of patience.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, gentle and slightly deaf, an old doctor's voice that asks how the patient slept before anything else.
**Combat Role:** none; an old doctor who sits down and waits for the trouble to pass
**Relationship Hook:** An old doctor in a cardigan and spectacles adjusting a lamp over an examination couch.
personality: Core: kindly; observant despite his age; hates waste
Quirk: discreet

npcs.name: Augustin Mabry
npcs.info:
A big, red-cheeked man with a chef's whites under a hunting jacket who owns the timber lodge on the lake and cooks for the anglers and naturalists who come with permits. His guestbook carries the signatures of half the Gourmet Hunters in the world.

**Speaking Style:** A rich, contented voice that talks about food the way other men talk about women.
**Combat Role:** a heavy old cook with a boning knife and a meat cleaver, still quicker than he looks
**Relationship Hook:** A red-cheeked chef sharpening a knife by the stove and asking whether you can cook, or only eat.
personality: Core: jovial and greedy; generous with his larder; secretly wants to be an examiner again
Quirk: loves a good failure

npcs.name: Augustin Pell
npcs.info:
A retired schoolmaster in a cardigan with leather elbows, who taught the island's children until there were too few to teach. He lives alone at the top of Upper Town with a telescope, a wall of books shipped over one crate at a time, and a cat that belongs to nobody. Ging Freecss and Mito Freecss both sat in his classroom.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and courteous, an old teacher's voice that corrects grammar out of habit and apologises for it every time.
**Combat Role:** none; a walking stick and the stare that once silenced a classroom
**Relationship Hook:** An old schoolmaster at a window with a brass telescope, a red pencil behind his ear.
personality: Core: courteous to everyone, even the cat; corrects grammar and then apologises for it; keeps a telescope trained on the harbour
Quirk: speaks of former pupils as if they were still eleven

npcs.name: Augustin Pryce
npcs.info:
The editor of the town's weekly fight paper, a rumpled man of sixty with nicotine-yellow fingers, a cardigan with burn holes and a red pencil behind each ear. He prints results, interviews and gossip from the tower, and his reporters have press passes to every floor below the 200th.

**Speaking Style:** Gravelly and sardonic, an old editor who has smoked through every deadline since he was twenty.
**Combat Role:** none; an old newspaperman with a press pass, a camera and the town's ear
**Relationship Hook:** A rumpled old editor in a red-lit darkroom holding a negative up to the safelight, his face grim.
personality: Core: sardonic and tired; protective of his reporters; frightened of one drawer
Quirk: edits everything in red, even menus

npcs.name: Augustin Roux
npcs.info:
The host of the only lodging in the city an outsider may use, a thick-set man who cooks well, never smiles, and sits in the kitchen chair that faces the one door. Guests get a cot, a meal and his company back to the road when their time is up.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, dry and deadpan, a host's courtesy delivered without a flicker of a smile.
**Combat Role:** a heavy host who fights in his own kitchen with a cleaver and a pan of hot oil
**Relationship Hook:** A thick-set unsmiling man stirring a pot on a gas ring, his chair turned to face the only door.
personality: Core: cooks a guest's home dish without asking where home is; sits facing the door; remembers how every guest takes tea
Quirk: never smiles, even at a joke he enjoys

npcs.name: Aurelio Mendes
npcs.info:
A plump, cheerful man in a straw hat and a field waistcoat stuffed with seed envelopes, who has a room above a café on the main street and spends his days measuring the World Tree's roots. Tourists take his photograph thinking he is part of the show.

**Speaking Style:** A warm, lilting, happy voice that loves to explain and hates to be hurried.
**Combat Role:** a gentle scholar who climbs well and fights only with a walking staff
**Relationship Hook:** A cheerful botanist in a straw hat kneeling on the cobbles with a tape measure and announcing that the root has grown again.
personality: Core: cheerful and talkative; obsessed with the tree; stubborn about the truth
Quirk: careless of the council's warnings

npcs.name: Babimyna
npcs.info:
One of the first prince Benjamin's personal soldiers, a high-ranking man of the Royal Army with fair curly hair cut short at the sides, in the army's zip jacket, trousers and combat boots, an earpiece in his left ear. He is quiet, composed and hard to read, and he brushes off any hand put on his shoulder.

**Speaking Style:** Short, quiet and level, a soldier who answers a question with a shrug or not at all.
**Combat Role:** a disciplined soldier who covers a whole suite and never shows his hand
**Relationship Hook:** A young soldier with fair curls standing at the back of a crowded room, watching everyone and saying nothing.
personality: Core: quiet and composed; observant and analytical; a flicker of sympathy he does not show
Quirk: brushes off familiarity

npcs.name: Baise
npcs.info:
A Hunter with sharp green eyes, pink lipstick and dark pink hair twisted into a long braid that stands straight up. She fights with her legs, kicks hard and fast, and dodges well. She is cold, self-assured and fond of having men at her feet.

**Speaking Style:** Low and teasing, a voice that purrs at a man before it gives him an order.
**Combat Role:** fast kicks and a kiss that makes a man her obedient servant
**Relationship Hook:** A woman with an upright pink braid kissing a terrified man's cheek and smiling as his eyes go blank.
personality: Core: cold and self-assured; fights with her feet; looks after herself first
Quirk: sadistic with her ability

npcs.name: Balda
npcs.info:
A tall, lean man with spiky black hair, thick grey eyebrows, a big nose and deep lines round his mouth, in a white shirt over light blue sleeves and tan trousers. He came into the forests with Pokkle's small survey team to look at a new animal, and in a tight spot he is the one who keeps his voice down and his head clear.

**Speaking Style:** Level and unhurried, a man who reports bad news in the same tone as the weather, until the moment his nerve goes.
**Combat Role:** a field man who keeps distance and watch; when it comes to blows he runs
**Relationship Hook:** A long-faced man lying flat on a cliff ledge with field glasses, not lowering them when you speak.
personality: Core: calm and level-headed; trusts Pokkle's call; watches before he speaks
Quirk: breaks and runs when the calm runs out

npcs.name: Balsamilco Might
npcs.info:
A master sergeant of the Royal Army and captain of the first prince's guard, a bald, dark-skinned, stocky man with a large scar from his left temple to his cheek, in the puffer jacket, tactical trousers and boots of Benjamin's private army. He is logical and patriotic and believes Benjamin is the leader Kakin needs.

**Speaking Style:** Level, analytical and loyal, a staff officer's voice that lays out consequences one by one.
**Combat Role:** a disciplined soldier with Ken and a methodical plan
**Relationship Hook:** A bald scarred soldier at a briefing board, pointing at the ship's first two tiers.
personality: Core: patriotic; admires Benjamin; weighs every risk before he acts
Quirk: logical and analytical

npcs.name: Banana Kavaro
npcs.info:
An Amateur Hunter on Kite's survey team with short fair hair shaved at the sides, beady eyes and baggy overalls with a fanny pack. She is cordial and knows a great deal about insects and how their colonies are ranked and behave.

**Speaking Style:** A friendly, knowledgeable voice that explains how a colony is organised as easily as how to make tea.
**Combat Role:** none; field knowledge
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman in baggy overalls sketching the ranks of an insect colony in a notebook.
personality: Core: cordial and friendly; calm in the field; part of a close team
Quirk: knowledgeable about insects

npcs.name: Bang Du-chil
npcs.info:
A logger at the sawmill on the highway, a huge, cheerful man with a beard full of sawdust, three fingers on his left hand and a story about each of the two that are missing. He drives logs down out of the forest on a lorry older than he is, and in the yard he can roll a trunk that takes two other men.

**Speaking Style:** Big, friendly and booming, a logger who laughs at his own stories; frightened, he goes very quiet.
**Combat Role:** a logger's axe and the strength to swing it like a club
**Relationship Hook:** A huge bearded logger sitting on a log stack, axe across his knees, staring at the forest line.
personality: Core: big, cheerful and brave; boastful about his lost fingers; loyal to the other paperless loggers
Quirk: badly shaken by what he saw

npcs.name: Bara
npcs.info:
A muscular player with long straight purple hair parted in the middle and a trident tattoo on his forehead. He is quick to violence, and punches a man for being slow to hand over a card. He is cold to everyone but his two companions, and for them he is anything but.

**Speaking Style:** Gravelly and hot-tempered, a fighter's growl that laughs at pain and snarls at a threat to his friends.
**Combat Role:** a tough brawler who wins by taking the hit and hitting back
**Relationship Hook:** A long-haired man with a trident tattoo stepping out of shadow with a severed head in a sack.
personality: Core: quick to violence; laughs off a beating; the most volatile of the three
Quirk: fiercely loyal to his partners

npcs.name: Baraka Oduya
npcs.info:
The keeper of the depot's tally, a tall man with chalk on his fingers who gives every household the same share of whatever comes in on the trucks and is moved by no story. He redraws the whole wall each week and remembers who argued.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and cool, numbers in every sentence, the patience of a man who has heard every plea.
**Combat Role:** a tall man with a sack hook who would rather bar the depot door than fight for it
**Relationship Hook:** A tall man in wire spectacles chalking a fresh tally onto a wall covered in marks, a queue stretching behind him.
personality: Core: counts in his head while he talks; rubs out a tally mark with his thumb; never eats in front of the queue
Quirk: gives exactly the same to elders and children

npcs.name: Barnaby Quell
npcs.info:
A plump young man in a tracksuit and a head torch, with a sandwich in one pocket and a map of the tower in the other, who has been hiding on a service ladder in the lift shafts since the lobby closed last night. He has the right block and is entirely sure it means this building.

**Speaking Style:** An eager, breathless voice that whispers too loudly and is always certain it has worked something out.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy lad who climbs better than anyone would guess
**Relationship Hook:** A chubby young man on a lift-shaft ladder, waving a blueprint and whispering that he has found the hidden floor.
personality: Core: sure he has found the secret; endlessly optimistic; kind to anyone who believes him
Quirk: terrible at whispering

npcs.name: Barry
npcs.info:
A Hunter on Tsezguerra's team, young-looking and muscular with freckles on his cheeks and chest, a cleft chin and short spiky fair hair, in the team's military-style gear with a cap worn sideways. He follows orders, watches carefully and is a fine boxer who fights in close.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and youthful, a boxer's quick talk that points out what others miss.
**Combat Role:** an in-fighting boxer who overwhelms an opponent without taking a hit
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled man in a sideways cap ducking under a punch and answering with three of his own.
personality: Core: cautious and observant; follows Tsezguerra's lead; a boxer at heart
Quirk: quick to warn the team

npcs.name: Bartholomew Lusk
npcs.info:
The painter of the fighters' mural in Skyfoot Station, a stooped old man in white overalls spattered with thirty years of colours. He paints each new face the arena's publicity office sends him and scrapes off the old ones when they fall, and he talks to the faces while he works.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, paint-flecked and philosophical, an old sign painter who talks about faces as if they were weather.
**Combat Role:** none; a stooped old man on a scaffold with a bucket of paint
**Relationship Hook:** An old painter on scaffolding adding a fighter's face to a vast station mural, a brush between his teeth.
personality: Core: slow and philosophical; remembers every face he has scraped off; wipes his brushes on his trousers
Quirk: talks to his paintings

npcs.name: Basho
npcs.info:
A Hunter from Jappon with a pompadour, a moustache and sideburns, thick eyebrows and a cleft chin, very muscular and hairy-chested, in a small vest, trousers and tall boots. A brush for calligraphy and a sheaf of paper ride in his breast pocket. He is talkative, easy-going and sure life should be lived to the full, and he swears by the herbal smoke he mixes himself.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, cheerful and easy, a man who whistles when he is impressed and laughs off a rude answer.
**Combat Role:** a strong brawler who wins the hard cases with a poem written on the spot
**Relationship Hook:** A muscular man with a pompadour whistling as he writes a poem with a brush on a scrap of paper.
personality: Core: outgoing and talkative; laughs off an insult; honest about a fight he cannot win
Quirk: whistles when impressed

npcs.name: Bastian Castell
npcs.info:
The shotfirer of the gypsum quarry, a broad, quiet man in his fifties white with dust from cap to boots, who sets and fires every charge on the face. He has done it for twenty-five years and has all ten fingers, which he holds up as his reference.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and patient, a shotfirer's voice that counts down a blast and never raises itself.
**Combat Role:** none; a man who knows exactly how much charge brings a ceiling down
**Relationship Hook:** A dust-whitened shotfirer in a hard hat counting charges in a shed while a siren sounds outside.
personality: Core: careful to the point of ritual; quiet; afraid of what the charges are for
Quirk: covers for family

npcs.name: Bastien Corvo
npcs.info:
A stooped turnkey of sixty with a bucket, a stiff brush and a ring of heavy keys, who has looked after this chamber for most of his working life. He sharpens what is left on the rack and scrubs what is left on the floor.

**Speaking Style:** A dry old croak that complains about mess in the same tone as it describes a death.
**Combat Role:** none; an old turnkey who locks a door and stays on the far side of it
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped old turnkey scrubbing a dark stain on a stone floor beneath a rack of knives.
personality: Core: unshockable; takes small liberties; privately gentle with the dying
Quirk: grumbles constantly

npcs.name: Battera
npcs.info:
A multi-billionaire, an old man with grey hair and pale skin in a suit and bow tie with a rose at his lapel. He has spent a fortune buying every copy of Greed Island he can find and pays Hunters to play it for him. Asked why by the press, he says only that it is for love.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, tired and courteous, an old man's measured voice with one fixed purpose behind it.
**Combat Role:** none; a billionaire who fights with contracts and consoles
**Relationship Hook:** An old man with a rose in his lapel watching dozens of game consoles hum in a stone basement.
personality: Core: deeply committed; courteous and trusting; unmoved by the price of anything
Quirk: hides his grief behind money

npcs.name: Bean
npcs.info:
A Mafia man with medium-length hair tied back in a ponytail, in a black suit and tie, who carries the Dons' orders to the families and the families' reports back up. In the Cemetery Building he is the voice on the radio that everyone else answers to.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and urgent, a cool organiser's voice that cracks into a shout when things go past his control.
**Combat Role:** a gun and a radio; he commands men rather than fighting beside them
**Relationship Hook:** A ponytailed man in a black suit shouting into a handset while explosions light the windows behind him.
personality: Core: cool under ordinary pressure; snaps at anyone in his way; proud that no capo is hurt
Quirk: panics when the dead pile up

npcs.name: Belerainte
npcs.info:
A fair-haired, bearded Hunter with a big nose and long lashes, in a bodyguard's black suit with a capital H. He has signed on to guard a prince. He is caring, cool under pressure and an excellent speaker.

**Speaking Style:** A smooth, persuasive, courteous voice that can talk a roomful of armed guards down, with a warm flourish at the end of a kind word.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's Nen and the voice to stop a fight before it starts
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded bodyguard raising his hands and talking a room of guards out of opening fire.
personality: Core: caring toward the wounded; cool and steady under pressure; stands his ground
Quirk: persuasive

npcs.name: Bendot
npcs.info:
A bald, heavily muscled prisoner with scars across his scalp, in the plain clothes every Trick Tower inmate wears. He is serving a hundred and ninety-nine years for robbery and murder, and the exam committee lends him and four other convicts to the applicants as taskmasters: five fights, one at a time, won only when the loser admits defeat.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and mocking, a big man's voice that enjoys laying out the rules of a fight he expects to win.
**Combat Role:** a heavy ex-soldier who closes fast and fights to the death if the opponent agrees to it
**Relationship Hook:** A bald scarred prisoner shrugging off his hood and cuffs on a stone platform, cracking his knuckles at a team of applicants.
personality: Core: eager for a real fight; toys with a weak opponent; cruel by habit
Quirk: knows his limits and keeps to them

npcs.name: Benedict Ashworth
npcs.info:
The head barman of the long bar at the Hotel Grandvale, a lean silver-haired man in a white jacket who has polished the same wood under the same chandelier for thirty years. He mixes without measuring and keeps the hotel's quieter guests' tabs in his head.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, discreet and faintly amused, a barman's voice that remembers your drink and forgets your face.
**Combat Role:** none; a soda siphon and a quick word with the night porter
**Relationship Hook:** A silver-haired barman in a white jacket polishing a glass under a chandelier.
personality: Core: dry wit; fond of honest young guests; never forgets an order
Quirk: discreet

npcs.name: Benedikt Kranz
npcs.info:
The innkeeper of the Mountain View Inn, a stout, cheerful man with a waxed moustache who serves goat cheese, mushrooms from the woods and venison he does not ask about. Every room has a view of Kukuroo Mountain, and he charges for it.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, round and hospitable, an innkeeper's voice that welcomes every guest as an old friend.
**Combat Role:** none; a stout innkeeper's shove and a cellar door
**Relationship Hook:** A stout innkeeper with a waxed moustache gesturing proudly at a window full of mountain.
personality: Core: welcoming to everyone; proud of his view; never asks about the meat
Quirk: keeps a second register

npcs.name: Benjamin Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The first prince of Kakin and the eldest son of the first queen Unma, a huge broad-shouldered man with a square face, spiky blond hair, small black eyes and a thick neck, usually in the light puffer jacket and combat trousers of his private army. He is deputy military adviser of the Royal Army and wrestles lions for exercise. He sees killing his siblings as a patriot's duty to the royal tree.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, blunt and martial, a general's parade-ground voice that declares its cruelty as duty.
**Combat Role:** a huge soldier-prince whose Ken turns pistol fire, backed by his private army
**Relationship Hook:** A huge blond prince in a puffer jacket wrestling a lion while he talks on the phone.
personality: Core: impulsive and violent; nationalist to the bone; respects strength, despises weakness
Quirk: declares his cruelty openly

npcs.name: Benno Harsk
npcs.info:
A journeyman fighter of nearly forty with a flattened nose and cauliflower ears who has fought somewhere between the thirtieth and the eightieth floors for eleven years. He wins enough to eat and loses enough to stay out of the hundreds, and he spends his waiting hours on the warm-up strip, watching who shadowboxes how.

**Speaking Style:** A low, rough voice worn down by years of other men's elbows, patient and a little amused.
**Combat Role:** an old brawler's elbows, clinch work and a body punch that shuts down a young man's breathing
**Relationship Hook:** A battered old fighter stretching on a mat at the back of a long hall, his eyes on a boy shadowboxing nearby.
personality: Core: watches more than he fights; kind to beginners, merciless to show-offs; never hurries
Quirk: rubs his ear when he is thinking

npcs.name: Benno Kranz
npcs.info:
The voice of the heaps' pirate radio, broadcasting every evening from a shack under an aerial of welded bedframes: news, songs, lost goats and missing children, in four languages, one after another. Half the city listens, and the other half hears it through the walls.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and lively, a born broadcaster who slows right down to read a name.
**Combat Role:** none; he barricades the shack and keeps broadcasting, so the whole city hears who came for him
**Relationship Hook:** A young broadcaster leaning into a sock-covered microphone, headphones half on, egg boxes on the walls.
personality: Core: talks in a radio voice even off the air; plays requests for the dead; never lets a song end without talking over it
Quirk: reads names slowly

npcs.name: Bertil
npcs.info:
An old shepherd who brings his flock to the thorn grove when it rains, lighting a small fire in the hollow among the roots and leaning his crook against the same trunk he has used for fifty years.

**Speaking Style:** An old shepherd's slow, kindly voice, full of sheep and weather.
**Combat Role:** none; an old shepherd with a crook
**Relationship Hook:** An old shepherd by a small fire in the roots of a thorn tree, counting his sheep and getting the wrong number.
personality: Core: kind and slow; talks to his sheep; notices small things
Quirk: stubborn about his grove

npcs.name: Bertrand Ossler
npcs.info:
A square-built foreman in blue overalls and a hard hat with a pencil-thin moustache, who has kept the city's great pumps running for twenty-two years. He knows every valve in the engine hall by its sound.

**Speaking Style:** A plain, practical foreman's voice that explains machinery patiently and goes vague about anything below the lowest main.
**Combat Role:** none to boast of; a strong man with a heavy wrench
**Relationship Hook:** A foreman in a hard hat listening to a pump with his ear to the iron and frowning at a question about the deep door.
personality: Core: practical and patient; proud of his pumps; protective of his crews
Quirk: evasive about the deep shafts

npcs.name: Bess Tremayne
npcs.info:
A weathered, cheerful woman with sea-glass earrings who combs the north cove after every storm and sells or swaps whatever the sea brings: rope, crates, floats, tins and once a whole dinghy. Her cottage on the cliff path is a museum of other ships' lost belongings.

**Speaking Style:** Husky and teasing, a beachcomber's voice that bargains over everything and winks while it does.
**Combat Role:** none; a boathook and the nerve of someone who wades into winter surf
**Relationship Hook:** A red-haired beachcomber dragging an orange buoy up a driftwood-strewn beach.
personality: Core: bargains over everything; wears the sea's leavings as jewellery; curious to the point of danger
Quirk: takes what is not nailed down and is liked anyway

npcs.name: Beyond Netero
npcs.info:
The son of Isaac Netero, a man with long black hair bound with a band, a long black beard and a cross-shaped scar across his face, dressed like an ancient commander in long robes over armour. Kakin's king has presented him as the leader of the empire's expedition to the Dark Continent, and he has promised to take anyone willing. He is self-confident and charismatic, wins hearts with ease and gets bored when others speak at length.

**Speaking Style:** A big, warm, rolling voice full of confidence and charm, that loses interest when someone else talks too long, exactly as his father's did.
**Combat Role:** a veteran explorer's Nen, hidden from sight, and a strategist's mind
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded man with a cross-shaped scar laughing over a drink as the world floods his phone lines with applications.
personality: Core: charismatic, confident and bold; values his comrades highly; plans on a scale of decades
Quirk: bored by long speeches, like his father

npcs.name: Bill
npcs.info:
A tall Hunter with messy fair hair, down-turned eyes and heavy bags under them, in a bodyguard's black suit with a capital H on the breast. He has signed on to guard Woble Hui Guo Rou, the youngest prince, and her mother on the voyage. He is cool-headed, reasonable and quietly determined.

**Speaking Style:** A cool, level, reasonable man's voice that advises rather than argues and stays calm under gunfire.
**Combat Role:** a strong guard of aura, a pistol and submission holds
**Relationship Hook:** A tired-eyed Hunter in a black suit calmly advising a furious young man to put down a gun.
personality: Core: cool-headed and level; determined to protect his charge; knows more Nen theory than he shows
Quirk: reasons with the rash rather than fighting them

npcs.name: Binolt
npcs.info:
A wanted man in Greed Island's badlands, with short spiky hair, a bony face, bulging eyes and serrated teeth, a belt of scissors at his waist. He stalks players from the rocks and talks to himself about cutting them to shreds. He holds a licence as a Blacklist Hunter and is wanted for a string of murders.

**Speaking Style:** A hissing, gleeful mutter that describes what it will do to its victim in loving detail.
**Combat Role:** a stalker with four pairs of scissors who cuts and eats a victim's hair to learn their every move
**Relationship Hook:** A wild-eyed man crouched on a rock pillar, snipping a pair of scissors in the air.
personality: Core: a hardened killer; keeps a strange martial etiquette; hates people for one old wrong
Quirk: talks to himself while stalking

npcs.name: Biscuit Krueger
npcs.info:
A two-star Hunter of precious stones and a master of Shingen-ryu who looks like a frilly little girl with blonde hair in neat twin tails, a dress and gloves, and asks to be called Bisky. She is devious, uses her doll-like look to fool people, and lies as easily as she breathes. She has come to Battera's selection to get into Greed Island and find a gem that exists only there.

**Speaking Style:** A sweet, girlish, sing-song voice that flatters and pouts and then drops an octave into an old master's dry, cutting judgement.
**Combat Role:** Shingen-ryu mastery, enormous strength in a tiny frame, and a true body that ends fights
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny frilly blonde girl in a queue of hard-bitten Hunters, smiling sweetly and lying through her teeth.
personality: Core: an exacting, generous teacher once she cares; obsessed with beautiful gems; hates her true form
Quirk: devious, cutesy and a consummate liar

npcs.name: Bizeff
npcs.info:
The Secretary of State of East Gorteau, a tired man with white hair combed to the right, thick eyebrows and a chiselled jaw, in a black pinstripe suit and violet tie. Every word between the country and the world, and every order between the leader and the nation's organisations, passes through him. He is exhausted all the time.

**Speaking Style:** Weary and official, a bureaucrat's careful tone that turns oily and eager in private.
**Combat Role:** none; a bureaucrat who survives by being the only man who knows how the country works
**Relationship Hook:** A tired official in a pinstripe suit signing papers at a palace desk while armed men pass behind him.
personality: Core: exhausted and dutiful in public; survives by being indispensable; bends to whoever holds the gun
Quirk: lecherous in private

npcs.name: Bodoro
npcs.info:
An elderly martial artist, applicant 191, muscular, with a strong chin, a moustache and long grey hair in a ponytail, in a fighter's robes, with a spear and shield. He has reached the final phase in a test that breaks younger men, and he holds to a personal code that forbids him to fight children.

**Speaking Style:** A grave, deep, dignified old warrior's voice that speaks of honour and will not raise itself to a child.
**Combat Role:** an old master's spear and shield, and bare hands when those are gone
**Relationship Hook:** An old martial artist lowering his spear rather than strike a child in his way.
personality: Core: dignified and honourable; patient and enduring; proud of his long training
Quirk: will not fight children

npcs.name: Bogdan Reiter
npcs.info:
The foreman of the pumice quarry, a barrel-chested man coated in grey dust from boots to eyebrows, who runs the crusher and the trucks and tells every new hire the same story about the red line.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and harsh, a foreman's bark worn rough by dust and the crusher's noise.
**Combat Role:** a foreman's heavy fists and a pickaxe handle
**Relationship Hook:** A dust-coated foreman bellowing at a jammed crusher in a pale grey quarry.
personality: Core: shouts at machines; protective of his crew; never looks at the far side of the line
Quirk: tells the red line story to every new hire

npcs.name: Bok Sun-dal
npcs.info:
The street warden of a block in the back quarters behind the parade avenue, a round-shouldered man in a cadre jacket with a red armband and a notebook in the breast pocket. He knows every family on his lanes, when they eat, who visits and whose son has gone quiet. He carries sweets for the children and keeps the gutters clear.

**Speaking Style:** Chatty and neighbourly, a gossip's voice that asks after your mother and remembers the answer for later.
**Combat Role:** none; a whistle on a cord and a block of neighbours who will not help him
**Relationship Hook:** A round-shouldered warden with a red armband handing a sweet to a child while his eyes follow her mother indoors.
personality: Core: friendly and nosy in equal measure; takes small bribes and keeps his word on them; dreads the month he has nothing to report
Quirk: writes things down in front of people so they know he is writing

npcs.name: Bonolenov Ndongo
npcs.info:
Member number ten of the Phantom Troupe, a man wrapped head to foot in white bandages, with red boxing gloves, orange shorts and red boots. He speaks formally and with pride of his people, the Gyudondond, and fights like a dancer, dodging to the music his own body makes.

**Speaking Style:** A formal, regal, sonorous voice that speaks with old-fashioned dignity of his people and of the dance.
**Combat Role:** a dancer's dodges and boxer's punches, and music played by the wind through his body
**Relationship Hook:** A bandaged man dancing round a furious opponent while a strange music rises from his body.
personality: Core: formal, proud and regal; carries his tribe's ways with him; cold to anyone outside the Spider
Quirk: fights gracefully and playfully

npcs.name: Borksen
npcs.info:
A private first class of the Royal Army and a Provisional Hunter for the voyage, with large dark eyes and light hair curling up just above her shoulders, in a Kakin soldier's uniform. She made officer training school, never believed the academy's propaganda, and wants nothing more than a long, quiet career with few responsibilities. Her friends in the so-called carefree squad listen when she talks.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, quick and wry, a clever soldier's voice that stays level when the room does not.
**Combat Role:** a soldier with a rifle and a sharp mind, who thinks her way out of a fight she cannot win
**Relationship Hook:** A young soldier with curling light hair whispering in a storage room to five friends about what she was not supposed to hear.
personality: Core: calm and logical under pressure; a reasonable moral compass; persuasive among her friends
Quirk: wants a quiet life

npcs.name: Botobai Gigante
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Dragon and its eldest member, a towering, heavy man of late middle age with a face as wrinkled as a dragon's hide, a curling moustache, upswept eyebrows and hair bound into two flame-shaped bundles. He is a three-star Hunter of terrorists, a military analyst and a public prosecutor, collected and fiercely loyal to Netero.

**Speaking Style:** A deep, booming, formal voice that rarely rises, and when it does the table shakes.
**Combat Role:** a former sparring partner of Netero's, a giant's strength and a soldier's analysis
**Relationship Hook:** A giant old man in a flame-collared coat slamming a fist on the council table.
personality: Core: collected, grave and loyal to Netero; favours cooperation over faction; carries the weight of the eldest
Quirk: loses his temper rarely and memorably

npcs.name: Bourbon
npcs.info:
A bulky man with a big nose and black hair under a tan turban, in a loose robe of light blue and purple, known on the exam circuit as the snake charmer. Applicant 103, he has sat the exam more times than he admits, and he passed Menchi's retrial by diving for a Spider Eagle egg and then grinning over how good it tasted boiled.

**Speaking Style:** A heavy, unhurried rasp, pleased with itself, that names a price before it names anything else.
**Combat Role:** none of his own; a charmer who fills a room with venomous snakes and bargains with the bitten
**Relationship Hook:** A turbaned man in a blue and purple robe lying back in a dark cave while snakes pour over the floor around him.
personality: Core: lazy, and proud of it; lets his snakes do the work; a haggler first and a fighter never
Quirk: talks to the snakes as if they were staff

npcs.name: Bram Hollis
npcs.info:
A weathered, bearded ranger in an olive uniform and a slouch hat who has kept the preserve's gate for twelve years and patched its fences after every storm. He warns every visitor that the pigs here charge cars.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, short and impatient with people, with a surprising softness when he talks about the animals.
**Combat Role:** a ranger who fights hard and close with a rifle butt and a skinning knife when he catches a poacher
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded ranger stabbing a finger at a map of the preserve and demanding to know why you are not on the permit list.
personality: Core: gruff with people; gentle with animals; keeps exact counts
Quirk: stubborn in an argument

npcs.name: Bram Tolliver
npcs.info:
The landlord of the coaching inn at the crossroads, a large, cheerful man with a stained apron, a ring of keys and a memory for every carter's name. His candle-lit common room is where the country hears its news, and he decides what is said loudly and what is whispered.

**Speaking Style:** A big hearty landlord's voice that fills the room and goes very quiet when money is meant.
**Combat Role:** a heavy landlord with a cudgel under the bar and a room full of carters who owe him
**Relationship Hook:** A big landlord at a cider barrel, filling your cup before you ask and asking where you came from.
personality: Core: hearty and welcoming; keeps the peace in his room; careful of his own neck
Quirk: remembers every face and forgets on request

npcs.name: Branka Szabo
npcs.info:
The landlady of the Ringside Hostel, a small, tough woman of sixty with a headscarf, forearms like a stevedore's and a book she keeps chained to the desk. She rents bunks to lower-floor fighters by the night, payment first, no cooking after ten, no blood on the sheets.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, suspicious and unexpectedly tender, a landlady who shouts the rules and whispers the condolences.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom, a voice that wakes the whole building and twenty fighters in the bunks
**Relationship Hook:** A small fierce landlady in a headscarf writing in a chained book under a board of hanging keys.
personality: Core: fierce about rules; soft about tenants; trusts no one with a key
Quirk: crosses herself at the 200th floor's name

npcs.name: Brannick
npcs.info:
The overseer of the hand quarry, a huge dust-white man who splits millstones and building stone with wedges and has worked prisoners from the stockade beside paid men for twenty years. He is loud, coarse and fair by his own lights.

**Speaking Style:** A roaring quarry voice, coarse and heavy, that makes prisoners and quarrymen move alike.
**Combat Role:** a huge quarryman with a sledge hammer
**Relationship Hook:** A dust-white giant at the quarry face, sledge on his shoulder, glancing once at a cracked wall behind him.
personality: Core: coarse and loud; fair to the men who work; keeps his secrets in stone
Quirk: terrified of one thing

npcs.name: Brick Tamas
npcs.info:
A big, loud youth who has made himself king of the tyre fort on the crushed-car ridge, lounging on the car-seat throne with a bat across his knees and a gang of younger boys around him. He makes the diggers pay finds to cross, as he has heard somebody did up here long ago.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, cocky and quick to laugh, a big youth's voice pitched to carry over a crowd of smaller boys.
**Combat Role:** a heavy brawler with a car-spring bat who charges straight in and trusts his size
**Relationship Hook:** A hulking youth on a car-seat throne atop a ridge of crushed cars, a spring-steel bat across his knees.
personality: Core: picks fights with anyone smaller and admires anyone bigger; laughs too loud at his own jokes; keeps the best finds for himself and calls it tribute
Quirk: copies a hero he never met

npcs.name: Brigitta Brenner
npcs.info:
The owner of the Cedar Gorge Sawmill, a tall, raw-handed woman in a canvas jacket who inherited the mill from her father and runs it with a crew of twelve. Sawdust settles in her hair and she has stopped noticing.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp, loud and practical, a mill owner who can be heard over a band saw and expects to be obeyed at that volume.
**Combat Role:** none; a mill owner's strength and a log hook
**Relationship Hook:** A tall woman with sawdust in her hair waving a log truck back off a river bridge.
personality: Core: loud and practical; proud of her father's mill; competes with the quarry for drivers
Quirk: fills every order without comment

npcs.name: Brigitte Lund
npcs.info:
A tall, silver-haired woman of sixty with knotted climber's hands and a cardigan over a rope harness, who keeps the climbing shop in the old barn. She climbed to the crown twice when she was young and now spends most of her days persuading customers not to try.

**Speaking Style:** A low, gentle, amused voice that talks customers out of things without them noticing.
**Combat Role:** an old climber who fights with an ice axe and terrain, choosing where the fight happens
**Relationship Hook:** A silver-haired climber handing you a coil of rope and asking, gently, why you really want to go up.
personality: Core: gentle and persuasive; haunted by a partner's fall; honest about the danger
Quirk: tempted by one more climb

npcs.name: Brocco Li
npcs.info:
The boss of the Cha-R Family, a man with dark curly hair in a tapered afro, white three-part eyebrows, a sharp jaw and two long scars across his face at the cheekbones, first seen in a leopard-skin robe. His family holds the fifth tier and everything stored on it, with the seventh prince Luzurus as patron. He believes power has its etiquette.

**Speaking Style:** Dignified and disdainful, a boss's voice that insists on manners.
**Combat Role:** never shown fighting; a boss who commands the fifth tier
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred boss in a leopard-skin robe frowning into a phone about thieves with no manners.
personality: Core: disdains the lawless; a careful ally to Onior; proud of his family
Quirk: insists on etiquette

npcs.name: Brunna
npcs.info:
The smith of the open-fronted forge on the road, a broad-shouldered woman with burn-speckled forearms who shoes the district's horses and mends its ploughs by hand and hammer. She may work only iron smelted inside the country, and the law counts her scrap pile twice a year.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, rough and impatient, a smith's bark used to being heard over a hammer.
**Combat Role:** a smith with a hammer and the arms to use it
**Relationship Hook:** A broad woman at the anvil, a red-hot horseshoe in her tongs, telling you to stand clear of the horse.
personality: Core: blunt and hard-working; proud of her trade; has no patience for talkers
Quirk: bends the law for a good tool

npcs.name: Buhara
npcs.info:
A huge young man with a vast belly, scruffy black hair and tiny eyes, Menchi's partner for the second phase. He is easy-going where she is exacting, and his part of the test is to eat whatever the applicants roast, all of it, faster than seems possible. He has a tricky side: he lets applicants think any pig will do.

**Speaking Style:** A big, slow, easy-going voice that chuckles and talks about food with complete contentment.
**Combat Role:** a giant's weight and one blow that drops a big man
**Relationship Hook:** An enormous young man finishing his seventieth roast pig and asking if there is more.
personality: Core: easy-going and good-natured; sly in his test; quietly perceptive
Quirk: eats anything and everything

npcs.name: Bunzen Charm Maker
npcs.info:
A thin, stooped man with a wispy moustache, in a dark smock smudged with ink, who makes the paper charms that hang in the glade by Bunzen's gate. He ties fresh strings between the trees whenever someone is due to chant there.
