**Speaking Style:** Hushed and superstitious, a charm-maker who whispers in case the curses are listening.
**Combat Role:** none; he runs for the town gate
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped old man stringing paper charms between two trees and glancing nervously at the fire pit in the middle.
personality: Core: whispers; fussy about fresh charms; keeps clear of the fire
Quirk: superstitious

npcs.name: Bunzen Foreman
npcs.info:
A big red-bearded man in flannel with an axe on his shoulder and sawdust in his beard, who runs the woodcutters' yard at Bunzen's edge. He talks about the weather before anything else and pays players to clear the beasts from the felling ground.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and weather-minded, a foreman who opens every conversation with the sky.
**Combat Role:** an axe swung like a woodcutter swings it, not a fighter
**Relationship Hook:** A red-bearded foreman squinting at the sky, then at a stranger, and asking if they can swing an axe.
personality: Core: gruff; pays fairly; never satisfied a job is done
Quirk: talks about the weather

npcs.name: Bushidora Ambitious
npcs.info:
A one-star Blacklist Hunter on the Association's disciplinary committee, of average build with spiky brown hair and a cleft chin, in a white trench coat with a red chest piece and flames, white gloves and a flame-trimmed police cap. He wants the rule that forbids Hunters to hunt other Hunters revised.

**Speaking Style:** A self-important, earnest, moralising voice that speaks of justice in capital letters.
**Combat Role:** a Blacklist Hunter's training and a righteous charge
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a flaming white trench coat declaring that Hunters who prey on Hunters must answer for it.
personality: Core: earnest and moralising; thinks himself a fine leader; distrusts amateurs
Quirk: critical of the rule on hunting Hunters

npcs.name: Caddock Breen
npcs.info:
A spry old seabird fowler with a long beard and a longer story, who walks the headland's spine every day with a net on a pole and will tell anyone how the island got its name, at length, whether they asked or not.

**Speaking Style:** Cackling and theatrical, an old storyteller's voice that leaps from whisper to roar to sell a tale.
**Combat Role:** none; a long fowling net on a pole and terrific nerve
**Relationship Hook:** A wild-bearded old man with a fowling net, arms flung wide, as a blowhole spouts behind him.
personality: Core: cannot resist an audience; invents history and then believes it; fearless on the cliff edge, reckless with others
Quirk: tells stories with his whole body

npcs.name: Calvin Ferro
npcs.info:
A well-dressed man from one of the Mafia's families who has parked a black car outside the old recruiting house and sits in the waiting room with the door open, smoking and reading a newspaper as though he were expected. He is polite to every resident who walks past and asks after nobody by name.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, courteous and unhurried, a salesman's warmth laid over a voice that never quite smiles.
**Combat Role:** a Mafia gunman who keeps the car between himself and trouble and shoots from behind its door
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a black suit and sunglasses reading a newspaper on a folding chair, a black car gleaming through the door behind him.
personality: Core: polite to everyone, friendly with no one; smokes only half of each cigarette; checks the road before stepping out of the car
Quirk: reads the same newspaper every day

npcs.name: Camilla Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The second prince of Kakin and eldest child of the second queen Duazul, a beautiful woman with long blonde hair worn in elaborate styles and large black eyes, always in fine gowns. She is charming and elegant in public. Most of her guards are Have-Nots, Kakin's lowest caste, and they would die for her.

**Speaking Style:** Sweet and gracious in public, cold and imperious in private, with a laugh that does not reach her eyes.
**Combat Role:** a prince who lets her guards fight, and who empties a pistol at a rival without hesitation
**Relationship Hook:** A blonde prince in a ball gown smiling sweetly while her guards check their pistols.
personality: Core: hates her siblings on principle; fearless of her elder brother; commands absolute loyalty from the Have-Nots
Quirk: charming in public, cruel in private

npcs.name: Canary
npcs.info:
An apprentice butler of the Zoldyck Family, a dark-skinned girl in the butler's suit who guards a line on the path to the mansion with a long rod and drives back anyone who crosses it. She is ruthless at her post and will beat a trespasser bloody, but for an instant her eyes betray concern. She is devoted to Killua, who once asked her to be his friend.

**Speaking Style:** A young girl's level, stern voice that orders trespassers back across a line and almost never cracks; when it does, she sounds her age.
**Combat Role:** a long rod swung with precision, footwork that blurs into afterimages, and a ruthless will
**Relationship Hook:** A girl in a butler's suit standing behind a line drawn in the dirt, a rod raised, her eyes wet for a moment.
personality: Core: stern, dutiful and unyielding at her post; devoted to Killua; learns any technique after seeing it once
Quirk: softer than she lets anyone see

npcs.name: Captain
npcs.info:
The captain of the ship that carries exam hopefuls from Whale Island, an elderly, stocky sailor with a bushy beard, a red nose and a bottle never far from his hand, in a captain's hat with a whale emblem. He calls his seasick passengers pathetic, reads a storm hours before it comes and puts ashore at the nearest port all but those he judges worth carrying on.

**Speaking Style:** A gruff, rum-soaked old sailor's voice that mocks the seasick and goes kindly gruff with a promising youngster.
**Combat Role:** none; a ship, a storm and a bottle
**Relationship Hook:** An old bearded captain at the wheel of a heaving ship, laughing at passengers sick over the rail.
personality: Core: kind to those who earn it; drinks steadily; reads the sea better than any instrument
Quirk: gruff and mocking

npcs.name: Carlo Benedetti
npcs.info:
The manager of the Lucky Ring Betting Parlour, a lean, sallow man in a black suit and a narrow tie who runs the parlour from a back office of phones and a safe. He takes bets the tower's windows will not, on rounds, on knockouts and on stretchers, and he has never been seen to smile.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, cold and precise, a bookmaker who never repeats a number and never smiles.
**Combat Role:** a pistol in the desk, a family behind him and men who do the rest
**Relationship Hook:** A lean unsmiling bookmaker at a desk of telephones, a steel safe behind him and a chalked odds board through the doorway.
personality: Core: never raises his voice; keeps every promise, especially threats; taps a pen on the safe when he is thinking
Quirk: cold and exact

npcs.name: Casimir Dorn
npcs.info:
A broad-faced young man in a cheap suit with a fading bruise on his jaw and a folder of forms on his knees, waiting in the queue outside admissions. He passed the Hunter Exam the year before and has come to claim the fee waiver the charter grants a licence holder.

**Speaking Style:** A polite, careful, slightly anxious voice that rehearses its answers.
**Combat Role:** a miner's son's fists and the stamina that got him through the exam
**Relationship Hook:** A broad-faced young man in a cheap suit clutching his forms and asking whether you know anything about anatomy.
personality: Core: proud of where he comes from; studies late into the night; embarrassed by his licence
Quirk: earnest and anxious

npcs.name: Casino King
npcs.info:
A gambler with an enormous pompadour in a plain dress shirt and trousers, who plays poker in a private room above the casino floor in Dorias. He looks down on anyone who sits at his table and says so before the first deal.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and showy, a high roller's purr that sneers at challengers until the last card turns.
**Combat Role:** none; he fights with a deck and the odds
**Relationship Hook:** A man with a towering pompadour fanning a poker hand and telling a boy he is too young to lose this much.
personality: Core: cool and confident; deflates when beaten; plays the showman
Quirk: contemptuous of challengers

npcs.name: Celeste Arcos
npcs.info:
A licensed Hunter in a long coat who has parked at the road end with a case of documents and asked, very politely, to speak to the Assembly. She has been told to wait, and she waits well.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp and courteous, every word in its place, the politeness of someone who expects to win.
**Combat Role:** a Blacklist Hunter who studies a target for days and then ends it fast with aura drawn into wire
**Relationship Hook:** A tall woman in a trench coat waiting by her car at the road end, a document case in her gloved hand.
personality: Core: files everything in labelled folders; assumes every silence is hiding something; never eats what she is offered
Quirk: polite to the point of menace

npcs.name: Celeste Varga
npcs.info:
The manager of the largest dress boutique on the galleria's upper floor, a tall woman in her forties who has dressed the wives and daughters of half the families that fly in for the autumn auctions. She remembers every client's size and every client's enemies, and seats them in different fitting rooms.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, polished and a little cold, a saleswoman who prices a stranger before she greets her.
**Combat Role:** none; a scream that brings the galleria's security and a locked stockroom door
**Relationship Hook:** A tall boutique manager with a tape round her neck smiling at a rich girl and not at the men behind her.
personality: Core: prices a customer by her shoes; keeps a list of who must never meet whom; lies smoothly and only about small things
Quirk: speaks warmly to the rich and briskly to their guards

npcs.name: Cha Sun-ok
npcs.info:
A bus driver out of the Luonton City depot, a sturdy young woman in a cap and a padded jacket who drives the long route to the northern villages in a bus held together with wire. She carries letters, parcels and live chickens for a fee and the news for free, and every village on her route knows her horn.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, chirpy and full of news, a bus driver who talks over the engine and never runs out of gossip.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy bus and the nerve to drive it through anything
**Relationship Hook:** A sturdy young bus driver in a cap leaning on a battered bus, refusing to look at the northern route on the chalkboard.
personality: Core: chatty and bright; brave about roads, frightened of silence; carries everyone's letters and reads none
Quirk: will not say what she saw

npcs.name: Chae Il-man
npcs.info:
A corporal of the monument's honour guard, nineteen and very proud of it, with a pressed uniform, white gloves and a ceremonial rifle he is not allowed to load. He stands his hour at the foot of the great bronze, eyes front, and afterward tells anyone who will listen how still he stood. He believes every word on the plinth.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, eager and loud, a young soldier who says everything as if reporting it to an officer.
**Combat Role:** a drilled soldier with a bayonet on an empty rifle and a whistle for the real guard
**Relationship Hook:** A young honour guard at rigid attention in front of a heap of wreaths, one heel pressed against a crack in the stone.
personality: Core: earnest and proud; fidgets once his relief arrives; wants an officer to notice him
Quirk: believes what he is told, and is starting not to

npcs.name: Cheadle Yorkshire
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Dog, a bespectacled woman with sea-green hair, a headdress with dog-like ears and a white dress and caplet marked with a cross. She is a three-star Hunter of disease, calm, intelligent and morally exact, the leading voice of those who back Netero, and a former sparring partner of the chairman. Pariston grates on her every day.

**Speaking Style:** A clear, precise, professional woman's voice that summarises and decides; it snaps when someone is being clever at the wrong moment.
**Combat Role:** a sparring partner's Nen she has not shown in public, and a mind that keeps the room in order
**Relationship Hook:** A bespectacled woman in a dog-eared headdress cutting off a smiling man mid-sentence.
personality: Core: calm, intellectual and principled; practical and decisive; admires Ging's mind and loses patience with his antics
Quirk: cannot stand Pariston

npcs.name: Cherry
npcs.info:
A martial artist of middling height in loose training clothes and soft shoes, applicant 76, with a flat-top cut finished in a short tail, a drooping nose and a stare that fixes on people. He fights with his hands alone and has sat the exam before, which is how the old hands in the hall know his face.

**Speaking Style:** Short, level and unhurried, a fighter's voice that wastes nothing and goes quiet when something in the room is stronger than he is.
**Combat Role:** an unarmed martial artist, hands and feet, who reads an opponent before he commits
**Relationship Hook:** A flat-topped martial artist nodding once to a running companion and telling him only one applicant has fallen out so far.
personality: Core: stoic under pressure; knows when he is outmatched; keeps his own counsel
Quirk: counts and measures as he goes

npcs.name: Chibaba
npcs.info:
A prizefighter on the lower floors of the Heavens Arena, slim and narrow-eyed, with fair spiky hair raked straight back and a plain black shirt he fights in. He has been bouncing between the forties and the sixties for a season, winning one, losing one, and he tells anyone in the waiting hall that this week the run starts.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and cocky, a young brawler who talks up his own footwork between every breath.
**Combat Role:** quick jabs and a lot of bouncing on his toes, with nothing behind the second punch
**Relationship Hook:** A narrow-eyed young fighter with his hair raked back, bouncing on his toes across the ring from a huge bald man.
personality: Core: talks a better fight than he throws; keeps his hair combed back between rounds; sulks for an hour after a loss, then forgets it
Quirk: sizes up children as easy wins

npcs.name: Choe Un-jong
npcs.info:
The director of Mandai's mass games, a stern woman with a megaphone and a stopwatch who conducts thousands of citizens in the stands as they flip coloured cards to make the leader's face. She rehearses them every afternoon, block by block, and remembers which block missed a turn last week. She was a gymnast once, and moves like one still.

**Speaking Style:** A megaphone voice even without the megaphone, all counts and corrections.
**Combat Role:** none; a megaphone, a stopwatch and ten thousand people who follow her signals
**Relationship Hook:** A stern woman with a megaphone in front of a stadium of coloured cards, staring at one wrong square.
personality: Core: exacting and loud; obsessed with perfect timing; afraid of her own silence
Quirk: secretly moved by the block's defiance

npcs.name: Chrollo Lucilfer
npcs.info:
The founder and head of the Phantom Troupe, a handsome man in his twenties with slicked-back dark hair, a cross tattooed on his forehead and a long fur-collared coat. He leads the world's most notorious band of thieves, who carry the highest bounty there is and kill as a matter of course, and they revere him. He is calm, charismatic and a lover of books and beautiful things, and he loses interest in a treasure once he has it.

**Speaking Style:** A calm, low, thoughtful voice that speaks gently and listens closely, as a reader speaks of a good book; it never threatens, and it never needs to.
**Combat Role:** a knife fighter's speed, a perfect Zetsu, and a book of other people's abilities
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a fur-collared coat reading by candlelight in a ruined building, a cross on his brow, his thieves waiting.
personality: Core: calm, charismatic and courteous; puts the Troupe before himself, and expects the same; kills without anger or regret
Quirk: loves books, music and beautiful things

npcs.name: Cinder Mack
npcs.info:
A soot-black youth who mines the cooled rim of the burning tyre fields for steel wire, quicker on the hot crust than anyone his age. He sells the wire to the smelter and spends what it gets him the same day.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, quick and cheeky, a youth who jokes fastest when he is frightened.
**Combat Role:** a nimble scrapper who fights on ground nobody else can stand on and lets the crust do the rest
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-black youth crouched on smoking ground, goggles up, a coil of steel wire across his shoulders.
personality: Core: walks the hot crust like a dance; spends whatever he earns the same day; never stands still on warm ground
Quirk: jokes when he is afraid

npcs.name: Clara Whitcombe
npcs.info:
A medical student in her early twenties with straight brown hair tied back, wire glasses and a bag of anatomy texts, who has had the same reading desk in the library tower since spring. She works nights at a shop to pay for the course.

**Speaking Style:** Earnest and quick, a student's voice that apologises and argues in one breath.
**Combat Role:** a determined student who has trained only her legs and her nerve; she runs, and she does not stop
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman in wire glasses reading an anatomy text under a green library lamp at midnight.
personality: Core: earnest; too proud to ask for help; brave in a quiet way
Quirk: stubborn

npcs.name: Cleapatro
npcs.info:
The supreme magistrate of the court that sits on Tier 1, a lean woman with delicate features and long, thin eyebrows, her hair dressed in a heavy style like an ancient queen's. She wears a pale high-collared uniform striped in black and keeps a telephone at her elbow on the bench. She speaks calmly and weighs everything before she rules.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, formal and exact, a judge's voice that weighs each clause, and goes ice-cold when her work is mocked.
**Combat Role:** none; a magistrate who fights with privilege rules, warrants and the court's officers
**Relationship Hook:** A lean magistrate in a striped high-collared uniform listening to a telephone at a raised bench.
personality: Core: weighs every factor before ruling; refuses to rule on rumour; keeps her rulings short and her reasons long
Quirk: loses her temper when her work is made light of

npcs.name: Clem Dorsey
npcs.info:
The airport police's dog handler, a lanky, sunburnt man of thirty-five who sleeps in the kennel block more nights than at home. His four shepherds patrol the fence with him, and he swears they can smell a lie on a man's breath.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and drawling, a dog man who talks to his animals more gently than to people.
**Combat Role:** a handler and his dogs; four shepherds loosed on a runner and a baton for what gets past them
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky handler kneeling in a dog run with his arm round a grey shepherd, both staring toward the cargo sheds.
personality: Core: trusts an animal's nose over a manifest; eats his lunch in the dog run; keeps a photograph of each dog he has lost
Quirk: talks softly to dogs and roughly to men

npcs.name: Clemence Ashby
npcs.info:
The chairwoman of the island council, a grey-haired woman in a tweed coat who keeps the schoolhouse keys, runs the polling station and shows films on the old projector when it works. The island elected her because she was the only one who did not want the job.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and patient, a council chairwoman's voice that lets everyone talk and then says the one thing that settles it.
**Combat Role:** none; a gavel, the schoolhouse keys and the island's vote
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired chairwoman at a schoolroom blackboard, chalk in hand, writing two columns of figures.
personality: Core: lets everyone speak before she does; decides slowly and never reverses; shows a film whenever the island needs cheering
Quirk: keeps the schoolhouse as if the children might come back

npcs.name: Clement Ashby
npcs.info:
The vicar of the stone church in the market town, a gangling, untidy man of forty with chalk on his sleeves and a bicycle he cannot ride well. He organises the dances, the blood drives and the jumble sales, and he cannot sing in tune.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and apologetic, a vicar who sounds unsure of everything except what he is doing.
**Combat Role:** none; he stands on the trapdoor and talks
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly vicar in a chalky tweed jacket setting out jumble on trestle tables in a parish hall, standing very still on one spot.
personality: Core: clumsy and kind; braver than he looks; devoted to his parish
Quirk: a poor liar who lies anyway

npcs.name: Clementine Ashby
npcs.info:
The head teacher of the Skyfoot Primary School, a trim woman of forty-five with a grey streak in her dark hair, a whistle on a ribbon and a cardigan over a pressed blouse. She fights a losing battle to keep a school full of would-be fighters interested in arithmetic.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp and precise, a head teacher who uses full sentences with children and expects them back.
**Combat Role:** none; a whistle, a voice that stops any child in their tracks and a school full of witnesses
**Relationship Hook:** A trim head teacher with a whistle holding a class register, looking at one empty desk among the tower drawings.
personality: Core: strict and devoted; never gives up on a child; furious at the tower
Quirk: blows her whistle twice for emergencies

npcs.name: Cleo
npcs.info:
The host of a weekly two-hour request show on the city's radio, twenty-four by her own account, who reads out fan letters between songs. She tells her listeners she is always compared to a famous model, then reminds them that her hobby is lying.

**Speaking Style:** Silky and teasing, a late-show radio voice that winks at the listener and never quite tells the truth.
**Combat Role:** none; she hangs up, locks the booth and calls security
**Relationship Hook:** A young radio host with headphones round her neck leaning into a microphone, a fan letter in her hand.
personality: Core: playful; loves her listeners; never takes herself seriously
Quirk: lies for fun

npcs.name: Cloth Hall Seamstress
npcs.info:
A round-faced young woman in a striped apron with a pincushion strapped to her wrist and a tape measure round her neck, who sews flags in the cloth hall of the capital's great market. She has sewn more parade banners than she can count.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and busy, a seamstress who chatters through a mouthful of pins.
**Combat Role:** none; she throws a bolt of cloth over trouble and runs
**Relationship Hook:** A seamstress with pins in her mouth holding up a half-finished parade banner and asking if the colours look right.
personality: Core: cheerful; never idle; certain the parade is coming
Quirk: talks through pins

npcs.name: Cluck
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Chicken, a slim woman with dark blue hair in a feathered outfit of blue and white, with little wings on her back. She hunts plants, and she is also a dancer and musician. She is short-tempered and blunt and has no patience for Pariston.

**Speaking Style:** A sharp, blunt woman's voice that loses patience fast and ends arguments by shouting at people to shut up.
**Combat Role:** birds under her command and abilities she keeps to the council
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in a blue feathered costume standing up to shout at the whole council table.
personality: Core: short-tempered and blunt; has no patience with schemers; a performer at heart
Quirk: says what she thinks loudly

npcs.name: Cocco
npcs.info:
The ring announcer for Heavens Arena's upper floors, with orange hair in two pom-pom bunches and long bangs, brown eyes, the arena's staff uniform and a headset. She introduces each fighter with their record, calls every move to the crowd and never loses her cheer, whatever happens in the ring.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, fast and breathless, an announcer's voice that never runs out of exclamation marks.
**Combat Role:** none; an announcer with a headset and a crowd
**Relationship Hook:** An orange-haired announcer leaning out over the ring rail, shouting a fighter's record into her headset.
personality: Core: passionate about every fight; calls the action as she sees it; knows every fighter's record
Quirk: cheerful and energetic

npcs.name: Coco Loo
npcs.info:
The guide on the tourist bus that runs up the Dentora road to the gate of Kukuroo Mountain, a curvy woman with curly, messy orange hair in a blue guide's uniform and a small hat. She tells the passengers about the family of assassins who live on the mountain, the ten of them, every one an assassin, and smiles the whole time.

**Speaking Style:** Chirpy and rehearsed, a tour guide's sing-song patter with a little thrill of fear in it.
**Combat Role:** none; a tour guide with a microphone
**Relationship Hook:** A cheerful guide in a blue uniform pointing out the window at a gate in the mountainside.
personality: Core: tells the same tales every trip; smiles through anything; never goes past the gate
Quirk: cheerful and energetic

npcs.name: Conditional Auction Announcer
npcs.info:
A showman with painted markings round both eyes and a trimmed goatee, who works the club's stage bare-bellied in a cropped top to show off a hard set of abs. He hosts the sales the families hold off the books, where the lot is a job and the bidders are the people willing to do it.

**Speaking Style:** A showman's bark, bright and pumped, that sells a manhunt like a game-show prize.
**Combat Role:** a stage host, not a killer; he calls security and steps behind the curtain
**Relationship Hook:** A bare-bellied announcer with painted eyes spreading his arms under a spotlight as flyers pass through a crowd.
personality: Core: exuberant on stage; indifferent to who dies; loves an audience
Quirk: explains the rules twice

npcs.name: Connelly
npcs.info:
A lieutenant of the Xi-Yu Family, a man with a rectangular head, thick eyebrows, narrow eyes, full lips and sleek dark hair, in a light shirt, a patterned tie and dark trousers. He runs errands between the family's boss upstairs and its men below, and he is loyal and thorough.

**Speaking Style:** Even, respectful and plain, a lieutenant who repeats his orders to be sure and then carries them out.
**Combat Role:** a Mafia lieutenant with a handgun and a team at his back
**Relationship Hook:** A square-headed mobster crossing a private bridge with a paper bag of cash under his arm.
personality: Core: loyal to the family; works with rivals for the sake of balance; asks one question too many, then obeys
Quirk: carries cash in paper bags

npcs.name: Contarch
npcs.info:
A man with a dark afro, a thin moustache and high cheekbones, in a light short-sleeved shirt over a dark long-sleeved one. He recruits newcomers to the alliance, hands them the list of spell cards and tests them on it within the hour.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and schoolmasterly, a man who quizzes recruits and shouts when they get it wrong.
**Combat Role:** none; he keeps members who cannot fight out of fights
**Relationship Hook:** A man with an afro holding up a list of spells and asking a recruit what a defensive card does.
personality: Core: schoolmasterly; a persuasive recruiter; cautious once blood is on the floor
Quirk: loud when crossed

npcs.name: Corbin Hale
npcs.info:
The range master of the gun club, a compact, grey-crewcut man of fifty who was a family's bodyguard for twenty years before a bullet in the hip slowed him. He tests the families' new hires on his range before they are trusted with a principal, and he can tell a man from his grip.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, quiet and exact, a range master who corrects your grip before he says your name.
**Combat Role:** a master marksman with a pistol in each hand, fast and calm, and no aura to answer one
**Relationship Hook:** A compact grey-haired range master in a shoulder holster correcting a young bodyguard's grip on a sandy range.
personality: Core: loyal to the families to the bone; despises talk of luck and aura alike; limps and hides it
Quirk: corrects a stranger's grip unasked

npcs.name: Cornelius Vandermeer
npcs.info:
One of the two big grain brokers of the Ininge exchange, a silver-haired man in a three-piece suit and a gold watch chain who watches the floor from the gallery and bids by a raised finger. His firm buys a third of the northern plain's wheat.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and genteel, a broker who sounds like he is doing the farmer a favour while robbing him.
**Combat Role:** none; he hires lawyers and, once, two large men
**Relationship Hook:** A silver-haired broker in a three-piece suit leaning on a gallery rail above a shouting trading floor, raising one finger.
personality: Core: courteous and cold; plays a long game; despises small farmers in private
Quirk: sure he is owed his fortune

npcs.name: Corrado Bellini
npcs.info:
The captain of the guard on the Dons' floors, a broad, bald man in his forties with a boxer's flattened nose and a suit cut to hide a shoulder holster. He has kept that landing every September for twelve years, and no one has passed the metal detector without his nod.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and level, a guard captain's voice that counts the exits while it says good evening.
**Combat Role:** a heavy professional bodyguard who shields the door with his body and shoots from behind it
**Relationship Hook:** A bald guard captain with a broken nose waving a metal detector wand over a visitor on a guarded landing.
personality: Core: trusts procedure over people; proud of his record; suspicious of the unseen guards
Quirk: methodical

npcs.name: Corrado Benedek
npcs.info:
A broker for the Mafia Community who keeps the curtained booth at the back of the Seventh Door Bar most weeks of the year. He is a neat, thin man in a grey suit with an earpiece he never seems to use, and he buys drinks for anyone who looks capable and broke.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and precise, a businessman's voice that sounds patient and is always counting.
**Combat Role:** a pistol in a shoulder holster and men waiting outside; he never fights in the bar
**Relationship Hook:** A thin man in a grey suit drawing a curtain back an inch to look at the bar.
personality: Core: patient and polite; never sits with his back to the door; tips the barman exactly
Quirk: measures people by what they would cost to replace

npcs.name: Corvin Ashe
npcs.info:
A tall, grey-suited man of forty with a long raincoat and a newspaper folded to the same page, who sits on the lower concourse by the left-luggage lockers in January and seems to be waiting for a train that never comes.

**Speaking Style:** Low, slow and exact, a voice that asks one question and waits, as long as it takes, for the answer.
**Combat Role:** a manhunter who strikes once from a prepared position with cuffs, a baton and a sidearm in reserve
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a raincoat lowering his newspaper as an applicant walks past the lockers, and then raising it again.
personality: Core: speaks only to the point; trusts no one he has not checked; polite to station staff, cold to everyone else
Quirk: patient beyond reason

npcs.name: Corwin Ashe
npcs.info:
A licensed Hunter in his thirties on a government contract, surveying the roads and bridges near the NGL border for the Union's transport ministry. He wears a field jacket over a shirt and tie, carries a clipboard and a camera, and waits at the tea stall for the next lorry out.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and amused, a man who has heard every joke about his kind of licence and tells them better himself.
**Combat Role:** a trained Enhancer who fights only when cornered, with a surveyor's steel staff and a quick head
**Relationship Hook:** A Hunter in a field jacket and loosened tie writing on a clipboard at a roadside tea stall, a surveyor's staff leaning by him.
personality: Core: methodical and thorough; curious beyond his contract; does the dull job well
Quirk: self-mocking about his licence

npcs.name: Corwin Strand
npcs.info:
The harbourmaster, a lean, neat man in a peaked cap with a pencil moustache, who logs every boat in and out, sells the passage to the mainland and talks the fleet home on the radio when the weather turns. He has rung the storm bell by the door more times than he cares to count, and he has never once rung it late.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and practical, a radio man's measured voice that repeats every number twice.
**Combat Role:** none; a flare pistol in the drawer and the storm bell
**Relationship Hook:** A harbourmaster in a peaked cap holding a radio handset, eyes on a falling barometer.
personality: Core: logs the weather even on his days off; keeps promises to the Captain he would rather not have made; talks boats home in a voice that never rises
Quirk: repeats every figure twice to be sure

npcs.name: Corwin Tesk
npcs.info:
One of the commission's observers for the badge hunt, a wiry Hunter in camouflage with a radio, binoculars and a week of beard. Applicants never see him; he sees all of them.

**Speaking Style:** Low and clipped, a radio voice: position, name, time, and nothing else.
**Combat Role:** a field Hunter who stays hidden and steps in only when the commission's rules require it
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded man in camouflage on a tree platform, binoculars raised, a radio headset over one ear.
personality: Core: silent and patient; professional to a fault; dry humour on the radio
Quirk: unsettled by anyone who sees through his Zetsu

npcs.name: Curly
npcs.info:
A university professor and Temp Hunter on Beyond's team, with long hair curling at the ends and swirl-tinted glasses that hide his eyes. He is polite, calm, sensitive and enormously learned in ancient languages and in modern and ancient geography, and he cannot stop explaining.

**Speaking Style:** A polite, eager, endlessly explaining scholar's voice that sulks when it is not allowed to finish.
**Combat Role:** none he shows; a specialist's ability kept for the Dark Continent
**Relationship Hook:** A man in swirling glasses raising his finger to explain, and being told to sit down.
personality: Core: polite, calm and sensitive; sulks when cut short; loves knowledge for itself
Quirk: loquacious and eager to teach

npcs.name: Cutie Beauty
npcs.info:
A one-star Hunter of cute things, of average height with a huge head, masses of hair in a ponytail with a big bow, a funnel nose, big ears, heavy makeup and a polka-dot dress. She tries to seem modest and humble and is plainly pretentious.

**Speaking Style:** A simpering, would-be modest voice that cannot hide how pleased it is with itself.
**Combat Role:** none she shows
**Relationship Hook:** A woman with an enormous bow pretending to be embarrassed by the votes she wanted.
personality: Core: pretentious; competent in her field; enjoys attention
Quirk: affects modesty

npcs.name: Cuzco
npcs.info:
A gaunt man with an almond-shaped head, long unkempt hair and a few days' stubble, in a plain long-sleeved shirt and trousers. He came into the game from the Southernpiece Auction, where he wore a suit and a clean shave, and he has a habit of noticing what other people miss.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and hoarse, a gaunt man who says little and notices odd things.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter with Nen enough to pass a hard test, who survives more often than he wins
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt, stubbled man staring at a games console whose power light glows with no plug in the wall.
personality: Core: quiet; notices oddities; a survivor
Quirk: keeps observations to himself

npcs.name: Dagny Rourke
npcs.info:
A rangy woman in a stained boiler suit who runs the diesel pump and keeps its book. She knows to the litre what every boat on the island burns in a week, and she will tell a skipper so, to his face, in front of his crew.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and hard, a woman's voice that gives figures, not opinions, and does not repeat herself.
**Combat Role:** a strong worker who swings a pump wrench and keeps her back to the water
**Relationship Hook:** A tall woman in a stained boiler suit locking a diesel pump while two angry skippers walk down the pontoon.
personality: Core: blunt to the point of rudeness; never takes a side between skippers; sleeps badly before a tanker is due
Quirk: carries the whole island's fuel sums in her head

npcs.name: Dalzollene
npcs.info:
The head of Neon Nostrade's bodyguards and Light's right hand, a well-built man with a short haircut and tattoos under both eyes reaching to the cheekbones, usually in a sweater and slacks, a slim engraved sabre at his side. He is calm, competent and fond of music, and he runs the guard detail like a business: the job is the girl, and the girl comes first.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, low and businesslike until a man fails him; then a hard Mafia bark that brooks no reply.
**Combat Role:** a strengthened body that shrugs off small-arms fire and a slim engraved sabre
**Relationship Hook:** A tattooed man on a mansion screen telling a room of applicants that the door is locked.
personality: Core: calm and collected; loyal to the family; harsh when a subordinate fails
Quirk: fond of music

npcs.name: Dario Fenck
npcs.info:
A lean man in his late twenties with a stubbled jaw and a headlamp, who has failed the Hunter Exam three times and digs the unprotected mounds of the valley at night. He tells anyone who finds him that he is a surveyor.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, wheedling and fast, a voice always explaining why it is not what it looks like.
**Combat Role:** a scrapper with a shovel who runs as soon as a torch swings his way
**Relationship Hook:** A stubbled man with a headlamp crouching behind a beech tree at night, eyeing a shovel left beside a grassy mound.
personality: Core: plausible liar; desperate; not cruel, only greedy
Quirk: blames the exam for everything

npcs.name: Dario Fenn
npcs.info:
A young Blacklist Hunter camped alone in the overgrown clearing where the great raid on the mountain set out three years ago. He is handsome, restless and well equipped, with his licence on a chain round his neck and a map of the wall pinned to a board by the old fire ring.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, quick and persuasive, a young Hunter who argues as if he has already won and grins when he loses.
**Combat Role:** a pro Hunter's Nen, a pair of short batons and a willingness to run when the odds turn
**Relationship Hook:** A young Hunter crouching by an old fire ring, studying a pinned map of a wall that runs off the edge of the paper.
personality: Core: charming and impatient; plans everything and trusts nothing he cannot see; refuses to hate the people who did it until he knows who they are
Quirk: talks about his brother in the present tense

npcs.name: Dario Pense
npcs.info:
A gangly seventeen-year-old in the school's blue uniform with oil on his hands and a bandaged ankle, bent over a lathe in the workshop after hours. He and two friends went to sit the exam on a dare; he came home on the second day.

**Speaking Style:** A flat, careful teenage voice that has decided to say as little as possible.
**Combat Role:** none; a workshop boy with a wrench and a good eye for where things break
**Relationship Hook:** A schoolboy with an oil-stained bandage turning a scrap lamp on a lathe and refusing to look anyone in the eye.
personality: Core: quiet and guilty; good with his hands; braver than he lets on
Quirk: lies to protect his friend

npcs.name: Darlene Voss
npcs.info:
The night waitress at the truck stop's diner, a tired, pretty woman of thirty-eight with a pencil in her bleached hair, who has poured coffee for lorry drivers since she ran away from a husband in the city. She bakes the pies herself at four in the morning, and she is the reason the place is famous.

**Speaking Style:** Husky and kind, a night waitress who calls every driver honey and means it about half the time.
**Combat Role:** none; a pot of scalding coffee and the cook's shotgun behind the counter
**Relationship Hook:** A tired blonde waitress pouring coffee at a chrome counter, her eyes on the payphone by the door.
personality: Core: calls every driver honey; bakes before dawn and never sleeps enough; flinches at a city accent she half recognises
Quirk: watches the payphone out of the corner of her eye

npcs.name: Degiro
npcs.info:
A fat man with short brown hair in a dark mustard sweater who hangs about the roads near the start looking for new players to rob. He boasts about the spells he has already cast before he casts the one that matters.

**Speaking Style:** Blustering and boastful, a bully who brags about his spells and shouts threats while backing away.
**Combat Role:** a card bully whose hands are slower than his mouth
**Relationship Hook:** A fat man in a mustard sweater holding up a spell card and announcing what it is about to do.
personality: Core: arrogant; preys on newcomers; all talk once beaten
Quirk: relies on spell cards

npcs.name: Desmond Farrowe
npcs.info:
A tanned man in a pale linen suit and loafers that are not meant for mud, who has been at the frog farm three days running with a briefcase and a cheque book. He wants to buy every breeding frog on the place and move the lot to a farm outside Yorknew City.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, sunny and persuasive, a salesman's voice with an offer ready before the question ends.
**Combat Role:** avoids a fight with talk, and when that fails, with a hired man and a fast car
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a muddy linen suit smiling across a frog pond and naming a sum that makes the farmer's son stop breathing.
personality: Core: charming and persistent; never raises his voice; lies only about numbers
Quirk: finds the weak point in a family

npcs.name: Desmond Kerrigan
npcs.info:
A promoter in his thirties with a tan, white teeth and a cream linen suit who works the lobby bar of the Hotel Skyreach. He buys drinks for any young fighter who looks good on a poster and talks of sponsors, television and a name on the station mural.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, quick and flattering, a promoter whose every compliment comes with a contract attached.
**Combat Role:** a promoter who never throws a punch himself and always has someone near who will
**Relationship Hook:** A tanned promoter in cream linen leaning on a hotel bar, sliding a business card toward a young fighter.
personality: Core: charming and generous; never lets a drink go unpaid for; loses interest the moment a fighter loses
Quirk: slides a business card across every table

npcs.name: Desmond Pryce
npcs.info:
A heavy-set guard of fifty who has sat in the brick hut at the private apron's gate for eleven years, lifting the barrier for black cars and writing their plates in a register nobody has ever asked to read. He chews liquorice instead of smoking because of the fuel lines, and he keeps a transistor radio tuned to the racing.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and dry, a man who answers a question with the fewest words that will close it.
**Combat Role:** none; he drops the barrier arm and radios the barracks, then stays inside the hut
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy guard in a brick gatehouse lifting a striped barrier arm for a black car without looking at the driver.
personality: Core: says yes or no and nothing in between; never looks into a car, only at its plate; keeps the racing results better than the gate log
Quirk: chews liquorice when he is nervous, and chews a lot

npcs.name: Desmond Whitlock
npcs.info:
A floor trader in a yellow jacket with slicked hair and a loosened tie, who shouts orders in the pit from opening bell to close and spends the evening in the bars round the exchange. He is good, lucky and very sure which one it is.

**Speaking Style:** Brash and fast, a floor trader's voice that sells before the sentence ends.
**Combat Role:** none; he shouts, then he runs
**Relationship Hook:** A young trader in a yellow jacket shouting with a fist of slips raised under glowing number boards.
personality: Core: brash; greedy; smarter than he lets on
Quirk: superstitious about his jacket

npcs.name: Dex Mallory
npcs.info:
A tout on the steps of the ticket hall, a wiry man in a flat cap and a too-big sports jacket who murmurs seat numbers at passers-by and sells the best upper-floor seats at prices the windows would never charge. He knows every regular spectator by name and every guard by shift.

**Speaking Style:** A fast, low murmur out of the side of the mouth, all winks and seat numbers.
**Combat Role:** none; a quick pair of feet and a crowd to vanish into
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry tout in a flat cap fanning a hand of tickets at a passing family on the steps of a great hall.
personality: Core: quick-talking and charming; generous to the broke; keeps one eye on the guards
Quirk: flips a coin while he talks

npcs.name: Dinah Shard
npcs.info:
A bottle picker of the glass ridge, rubber-booted to the knee, who stacks whole bottles by colour and sells them back to traders at the road. She knows the safe paths across the shards and charges favours to show them.

**Speaking Style:** Light and amused, a picker who sounds as if she knows a joke about you she is not going to tell.
**Combat Role:** a sure-footed picker who leads an attacker onto sliding shards and lets the ridge cut them
**Relationship Hook:** A rubber-booted woman holding a green bottle up to the sun on a ridge of glittering glass.
personality: Core: counts bottles under her breath; never walks the same path twice in a day; laughs at anyone who runs on glass
Quirk: charges in favours, never in goods

npcs.name: Dmitri Sallow
npcs.info:
The foreman of the weighbridge at the sidings, a broad, genial man in a donkey jacket who weighs every lorry in and out and is on first-name terms with every driver. He organises the yard's football team and buys the first round at the end of every week.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and friendly, a yard foreman who makes every threat sound like advice from a well-wisher.
**Combat Role:** a heavy man with a crowbar and four friends who arrive at once
**Relationship Hook:** A burly yard foreman in a donkey jacket leaning out of a weighbridge hut, waving a heavy lorry through with a smile.
personality: Core: genial and generous; thinks of everything as business; protects his men
Quirk: ruthless when crossed

npcs.name: Dorota Mallek
npcs.info:
The owner of the Halfway Diner on the highway to Parasta, a handsome woman in her forties with a pencil in her hair and coffee always on. Truckers stop for her pie and the jukebox, and tourists stop because hers is the only lit window for miles.

**Speaking Style:** Husky and amused, a diner owner who calls every trucker honey and remembers everything they say.
**Combat Role:** none; a coffee pot and a shotgun behind the pie case
**Relationship Hook:** A diner owner with a pencil in her hair pouring coffee for a trucker and listening to every word.
personality: Core: calls everyone honey; remembers everything; never writes anything down
Quirk: feeds the estate's drivers free

npcs.name: Dorran
npcs.info:
The other interpreter at the lodge, a heavy-browed, bearded man with a big nose, a broad hat and a fur cape over his shoulders. He rides behind his partner and lets her do the smiling. In the back room he writes the reports in a square careful hand and seals them for the rider.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and slow, a man who says less than his partner and hears twice as much.
**Combat Role:** a big man who stands in a doorway and does not move
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded man in a fur cape at a lamp-lit desk, pressing a seal into hot wax without looking up.
personality: Core: gruff and watchful; writes neatly and slowly; trusts paper more than people
Quirk: beginning to doubt his masters

npcs.name: Dorrie Malvane
npcs.info:
A big-hipped woman of fifty with dyed red curls, a pink uniform and a pencil behind her ear, who runs the diner at the truck stop and works the griddle herself. Lorry drivers swear by her eggs, and in January she fields a hundred questions a day about the road to Zaban City.

**Speaking Style:** A warm, husky diner voice that calls everyone love and can turn to ice between one word and the next.
**Combat Role:** none to speak of; a cast-iron pan and a shotgun under the counter she has never fired
**Relationship Hook:** A red-haired diner owner pouring a coffee, listening to an applicant's question and deciding how to answer it.
personality: Core: calls everyone love; generous to the courteous; nosy about her customers
Quirk: remembers every rude word

npcs.name: Doster
npcs.info:
A tall, muscular Hunter with dark green hair under a thick gold headband, two red stripes beneath his eyes and three red marks on his forehead, in a sleeveless dark red and yellow vest. He passed the billionaire's aura test in the same batch as the two boys.

**Speaking Style:** Firm and spare, a fighter's voice that keeps its reports short.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's trained Nen behind a big frame, straightforward and hard
**Relationship Hook:** A muscular man in a gold headband lowering a pair of binoculars and pointing down the road.
personality: Core: disciplined; respects strength; keeps his own counsel
Quirk: spare with words

npcs.name: Dov Kalinsky
npcs.info:
A visiting fisherman with a flattened nose, cauliflower ears and hands that do not match the rest of him, who sits under the green beacon at the end of the mole mending his gear. He crews on a mainland trawler now and talks about fish, but the way he stands gives him away to anyone who has been in a ring.

**Speaking Style:** Rasping and slow, a former fighter's broken-nosed voice with a laugh that ends in a cough.
**Combat Role:** a heavyweight boxer, slow on his feet now but with a punch that still drops men twice his size
**Relationship Hook:** A broken-nosed fisherman at the end of a breakwater, idly blocking a gull's dive with an open palm.
personality: Core: sits with his back to a wall out of habit; plays down every fight he ever won; coughs instead of laughing
Quirk: watches people's shoulders when they talk

npcs.name: Dov Sprocket
npcs.info:
The projectionist of the screening days, a lanky man with a tool roll who keeps the church's one projector clattering on parts begged from Dead Set Hill. He threads the reels, shoos children off the cable, and stands behind the bedsheet with the voice actors when one of them forgets a line.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and a little harried, a handyman's patter that drops into a mutter whenever a machine misbehaves.
**Combat Role:** none; he swings his tool roll and a heavy reel can and hopes the children scatter first
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky man threading a film reel by torchlight behind a bedsheet screen, a fuse tucked behind his ear.
personality: Core: talks to the projector as if it were a mule; carries spare fuses behind his ear; lets nobody else touch the reels
Quirk: mouths along to every line of the cartoon

npcs.name: Duazul Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The second queen of Kakin, a woman with fair wavy hair and a gentle expression, always in formal clothes like her children. She is mother to the second prince Camilla, the fifth prince Tubeppa and the seventh prince Luzurus, and raised the ninth prince Halkenburg as her own. Her guards describe her as demure in everything.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, soft and demure, a queen's quiet voice that refuses to choose.
**Combat Role:** none; a queen who keeps to her rooms and her guards
**Relationship Hook:** A gentle queen in a formal gown turning her face away from her daughter's order.
personality: Core: gentle and demure; quietly stubborn; dreads her eldest daughter
Quirk: refuses to choose between her children

npcs.name: Dutch Kessler
npcs.info:
The scrap dealer whose name is on the yard's licence, a heavy, bullet-headed man of fifty-five who sits in the scale house weighing loads and paying cash. He runs a straight business by day and a crooked one by night.

**Speaking Style:** Short, blunt and unbothered, a dealer who names a weight and expects no argument.
**Combat Role:** a heavy brawler; a lead pipe and the magnet crane dropping a car where he wants it
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy, bald dealer in a scale house counting cash from a box, a mountain of crushed cars behind him.
personality: Core: names a weight and expects no argument; never opens a boot; pays in cash and counts it twice
Quirk: superstitious about the crane since last week

npcs.name: Dwight Calloway
npcs.info:
A heavy, grey-moustached sergeant of the city police who has run the auction-season traffic plan for twenty years, from the map room on the chief's floor. He knows every one-way street in the auction quarter and every officer by their first name.

**Speaking Style:** Gravel and tobacco, a desk sergeant's growl that reads out orders he does not believe in.
**Combat Role:** a veteran street cop with a revolver and a radio who calls for cars before he calls for courage
**Relationship Hook:** A heavyset police sergeant drawing a red circle on a city map pinned across a wall.
personality: Core: gruff; resigned to the corruption; keeps his own counsel
Quirk: protective of his officers

npcs.name: Eamon Kovach
npcs.info:
The forestry ranger for the Miera ridge, a big bearded man in a green service jacket who walks up to the hut twice a week to check the stove, the bunks and the logbook. He has carried more walkers down off the mountain on his back than he can count.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and level, a ranger who measures out words like water on a long walk.
**Combat Role:** a ranger's hatchet and rifle, and the high ground he knows better than anyone
**Relationship Hook:** A big bearded ranger at a radio set in a log hut, logbook open beside him, snow on the window.
personality: Core: calm in any weather; protective of walkers; knows the range by heart
Quirk: quietly disobedient

npcs.name: East Gorteau Go Champion
npcs.info:
The national champion of go, a tall, bony man with short black hair and thin-rimmed glasses who climbs the stairs above the tea shop most afternoons in a plain shirt and pressed trousers. He takes on the regulars three boards at a time, wins without looking pleased, and spends the rest of the day bent over a board with schoolboys, making them replay their mistakes stone by stone.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and exact, a teacher's voice that counts stones aloud; under pressure it climbs, thins and starts making excuses.
**Combat Role:** none; a thin scholar who has never thrown a punch and would sooner resign
**Relationship Hook:** A thin man in glasses tapping a go stone on the board's edge while three boys argue over their next move.
personality: Core: patient with children, short with adults; replays every lost game in his head on the walk home; never raises his voice at the board
Quirk: excuses a defeat before he admits it

npcs.name: East Gorteau Nen-using Soldier
npcs.info:
A sergeant of the palace guard, bald under his beret and heavily muscled, who squints at everything as if it owes him money. On duty he wears a tight vest and plain trousers and carries no rifle when he can avoid it. He is short-tempered, loyal to the leader without a flicker of doubt, and the recruits fear him in a way they cannot quite explain.

**Speaking Style:** A parade-ground bark in short sentences that end in threats; he laughs once, at the wrong moment, when he means to fight.
**Combat Role:** a barehanded brawler who wraps himself in aura and charges, trusting his fists over any weapon
**Relationship Hook:** A huge bald sergeant in a beret standing alone in a drill yard at dawn, the air around him strangely heavy.
personality: Core: aggressive and quick with his fists; loyal to the leader past reason; scorns recruits who need rifles
Quirk: keeps his real training to the hours before dawn

npcs.name: East Gorteau Shogi Champion
npcs.area: Go and Shogi Club Champions' Wall
npcs.info:
The shogi champion of East Gorteau, a short, heavy man with cropped blond hair, thick lips, freckles across both cheeks and a mole on the left side of his face. He holds court at the club in shirtsleeves and socks, shoes kicked under the table, under the framed list that carries his name at the top. The regulars put up with his bragging because he pays for the tea.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and jolly over a winning board, all lip-smacking boasts; frightened, it shrinks to a stammering wheeze.
**Combat Role:** none; a soft man who runs, and not fast
**Relationship Hook:** A fat little man in his socks slapping a shogi piece down and shouting for more tea.
personality: Core: boastful and hungry for praise; buys tea to keep an audience; panics the moment the danger is real
Quirk: plays every lost position to the bitter end

npcs.name: Ebbert Kemp
npcs.info:
The reeve of the great market under the old barn, a square grey man on a stool beside a wooden weighing beam. He weighs goods, sets fair trades of eggs for nails and cloth for honey, and his ruling ends every quarrel. He watches every basket for anything made by machine.

**Speaking Style:** Short and certain, a market reeve's voice made for settling quarrels in one sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; a reeve who calls the stockade guards with a word
**Relationship Hook:** A grey man on a stool by a great wooden balance, weighing a basket of eggs against a stone.
personality: Core: strict and fair to small people; proud of his beam; afraid for his family
Quirk: blind on purpose to large ones

npcs.name: Ebina
npcs.info:
The butler assigned to Milluki's room, a thin young man with a feather duster in one hand and a clipboard of inventory numbers in the other. He dusts the figure cases daily, carries snacks up from the kitchens and stays out of reach of the whip that hangs on the hook by the door.

**Speaking Style:** A quick, breathy, nervous voice that apologises before it is accused and goes up half an octave when the second son is in the room.
**Combat Role:** a butler's training he never gets to use; quick hands and a fast exit
**Relationship Hook:** A nervous butler holding his breath as he dusts a glass case of figurines under the glow of a wall of screens.
personality: Core: apologises constantly; knows the inventory number of every figure; secretly likes some of the shows the figures come from
Quirk: flinches at the sound of a whip

npcs.name: Edda Faulk
npcs.info:
The airfield's radio operator, a young woman with headphones round her neck and a pencil in her hair, who keeps the flight log and answers every call that comes in to the headland.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and bright, a radio operator's voice that ends every sentence with a call sign.
**Combat Role:** none; an operator who calls for help and locks the office
**Relationship Hook:** A young radio operator with headphones round her neck writing in a book beside a crackling radio set.
personality: Core: cheerful; a memory for names; secretly star-struck by Hunters
Quirk: rule-abiding

npcs.name: Edda Stromberg
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Tower Shadow Park, a sturdy woman of fifty in a green council jacket and rubber boots who rakes the running track, feeds the ducks on the pond and knows every early runner by the sound of their feet.

**Speaking Style:** Unhurried and outdoorsy, a park keeper who talks about the ducks as if they were neighbours.
**Combat Role:** none; a rake, a whistle and a council radio
**Relationship Hook:** A sturdy park keeper leaning on her rake on a gravel track as a boy in white runs past in the long shadow of a tower.
personality: Core: calm and unhurried; minds her own business; notices who is new
Quirk: talks to the ducks

npcs.name: Eddo Valk
npcs.info:
A wiry seventeen-year-old with a rope burn across both palms and a woollen hat pulled over his ears, grandson of the eldest egg gatherer on the ridge. He climbs down into the gorge for Spider Eagle eggs and sells them to the finest kitchens anywhere.

**Speaking Style:** An easy, wind-roughened young voice that jokes on the ledge and goes silent on the rope.
**Combat Role:** none; a climber with a knife for the rope and a grip that does not let go
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry boy in a woollen hat clipping onto a rope at the lip of the gorge and grinning too widely.
personality: Core: cheerful above the drop, silent on it; proud of his family's trade; scornful of shortcuts
Quirk: afraid and doing it anyway

npcs.name: Edmund Haller
npcs.info:
The master thatcher of the district, a gnarled old man who has trained every roofer within three days' ride. He teaches apprentices on a half-finished roof on posts and says a good thatch should outlive the man who laid it.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and gravelly, a craftsman who explains his work with his hands as much as his words.
**Combat Role:** none; an old roofer with a leggett and a ladder
**Relationship Hook:** An old thatcher on a practice roof, beating reed into place and telling his apprentice not to ask.
personality: Core: patient teacher; proud of his craft; fond of his apprentice
Quirk: takes the money and the silence

npcs.name: Edmund Varrick
npcs.info:
A straight-backed man of fifty-five with a grey moustache and a regimental blazer who is the Association's liaison to the barracks, a post so old nobody can say what it is for. He watches the drill each morning from the reviewing stand.

**Speaking Style:** A clipped, carrying parade-ground voice with good manners and no patience.
**Combat Role:** an old soldier with a service pistol and a sword stick he carries for show
**Relationship Hook:** A moustached man on a reviewing stand tapping his sword stick and asking, very politely, who sent you.
personality: Core: correct and clipped; wants a quiet life; privately ashamed of the post
Quirk: good at being two men's friend

npcs.name: Edna Callahan
npcs.info:
The terminal's ticket clerk, a stout grey-haired woman in a uniform cardigan with a voice that carries across twenty bays; since half the departures board went dark she calls the coaches out herself. She knows every night driver.

**Speaking Style:** A brass-lunged announcer's bellow, flat and unarguable, that carries over twenty bays.
**Combat Role:** none; she shouts for the drivers and they come
**Relationship Hook:** A stout grey-haired clerk leaning out of a ticket window and calling across a waiting hall.
personality: Core: loud; fair; hates the families' men in her hall
Quirk: soft on runaways

npcs.name: Elena
npcs.info:
The keeper of the tower at Greed Island's port, a young girl whose helmet parts her white hair into two tails on top and two thick braids; she wears a thin black choker and a black sleeveless robe cut square at the neck. She sends home players who leave by card or by ticket and warns them that their cards stay behind.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and monotone on duty, with a small curious warmth that slips out when someone remembers her.
**Combat Role:** none shown; a keeper of the game's exits
**Relationship Hook:** A white-haired girl at the top of a port tower telling a boy his cards will stay behind.
personality: Core: monotone on duty; pleased to be remembered; irritated by an obvious lie
Quirk: curious by nature

npcs.name: Elias Hartmann
npcs.info:
The doctor who keeps the Mercy Street Free Clinic open, a gaunt man in his forties with untidy grey hair, a stained white coat and a stethoscope that has lost its earpieces' rubber. He treats anyone who comes, and the queue starts before the door opens.

**Speaking Style:** Tired and kind, a doctor's voice worn to a hoarse murmur by night shifts.
**Combat Role:** none; he keeps a scalpel in reach and his hands steady
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt doctor in a stained coat scrubbing a steel table behind a curtain late at night.
personality: Core: kind; exhausted; stubborn about free care
Quirk: ashamed of the envelopes

npcs.name: Eliza
npcs.info:
One of Neon Nostrade's personal attendants, with long wavy violet hair and purple eyes, always in a dark kimono, always a step behind Neon. She is calm and patient, cleans up after the girl's tantrums and plays cards with her at night. She is fond of her mistress in spite of everything.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, patient and composed, a lady's maid's voice that only sharpens with her mistress.
**Combat Role:** none; an attendant who keeps out of the way
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in a dark kimono gathering scattered cards from a hotel floor after a tantrum.
personality: Core: calm and patient; fond of Neon despite her temper; loves Squala
Quirk: keeps her feelings private

npcs.name: Elspeth Ruane
npcs.info:
A rosy, sturdy woman in her twenties who milks the island's goats at the stone shelter and fetches them off the ridge when they will not come. She knows every animal by name and temper and talks to them more than to people.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless and cheerful, a goatherd's quick voice usually calling to an animal halfway up a rock.
**Combat Role:** none; a crook, a bucket and sure feet on bad rock
**Relationship Hook:** A rosy goatherd with a crook calling up a rock slope to a goat that is ignoring her.
personality: Core: calls every goat by name; happier on a rock face than in a room; laughs off every fall
Quirk: follows a goat anywhere it goes

npcs.name: Emeric Varga
npcs.info:
A fruit grower on the terraced hills west of town, a lean, sun-browned man in his fifties who fills the market's stalls and delivers fruit to the estate's gate twice a week. He has done so for twenty years and has never once been allowed through.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and chatty, a fruit grower who talks about pears the way other people talk about grandchildren.
**Combat Role:** none; a farm truck and a ladder
**Relationship Hook:** A sun-browned grower stacking crates of pears into his truck for the run up to the gate.
personality: Core: asks no questions about the sealed boxes; chats to anyone at the stall; worries about the weather constantly
Quirk: proud of his fruit

npcs.name: Emil Saaresto
npcs.info:
The farmer of the date farm, a lean, sun-browned man of sixty-five whose grandfather planted the first palms before the airport existed. He sells dates at the city markets and lives alone in the farmhouse since his wife died.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and few-worded, a farmer who answers with a nod and finishes with a question.
**Combat Role:** a farmer with a rifle; a long gun from the porch and a dog that barks first
**Relationship Hook:** A lean old farmer in a straw hat rocking on his porch with a rifle across his knees, watching his far fence.
personality: Core: nods instead of speaking; talks to the palms; rises before dawn and sleeps at sundown
Quirk: takes his grandfather's rifle down only for strangers

npcs.name: Emmerich Pohl
npcs.info:
The night clerk of the freight yard, a heavy man in a cardigan with a mug that has not been washed in years, who keeps the manifests for every wagon that passes through.

**Speaking Style:** A low, gravelly mutter, friendly to anyone who brings coffee and deaf to anyone who doesn't.
**Combat Role:** none; a clerk who locks the office door and phones the station
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy clerk in a cardigan frowning at a typed manifest at a cluttered desk, a chipped mug in his hand.
personality: Core: genial to regulars; curious about the wrong things; slow to move
Quirk: for sale in small ways

npcs.name: Erbier Mano
npcs.info:
A player with a bowl haircut in a long dark overcoat and plain shoes. He goes everywhere with Linn and does the climbing while his partner does the waiting.

**Speaking Style:** Cool and polite, a long-coated player who talks business as if it were the weather.
**Combat Role:** a cautious veteran who climbs out of reach rather than fight
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a long dark overcoat perched high in a tree, peering down at the insects swarming the bark.
personality: Core: a careful keeper of cards; loyal to his partner; takes defeat well
Quirk: cool and polite

npcs.name: Esther Valmont
npcs.info:
The doctor who keeps the night clinic over the pharmacy, a spare woman in her late forties with reading glasses on a chain and sleeves rolled to the elbow. She stitches, sets and bandages after the hospitals have shut their doors, and asks how only when the answer might matter.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and precise, a doctor's voice that gives instructions before reassurance and means both.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel in a steady hand and a door she can lock
**Relationship Hook:** A thin doctor in a white coat stitching a man's arm under a bright lamp in a two-room night clinic.
personality: Core: unshockable; asks only the useful question; angry at officials who do not listen
Quirk: keeps careful notes

npcs.name: Esther Wick
npcs.info:
A soft-spoken woman whose turn on the lamp rota never seems to end, because she takes the turn of anyone who cannot come. She trims wicks, refills oil and changes dead bulbs at the shrine of every faith, and prays to none of them aloud.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and airy, half a whisper, the way people speak in a room full of candles.
**Combat Role:** none; she shields a flame with her body before she shields herself
**Relationship Hook:** A veiled woman trimming a wick before a wall of hundreds of flames, an oil can in her other hand.
personality: Core: trims a wick while listening to a confession; prays silently in no particular direction; holds her oil can the way others hold beads
Quirk: will not relight a lamp until she knows why it died

npcs.name: Eta
npcs.info:
The guide who greets every player at Greed Island's starting point, a young woman with big azure eyes and long silver hair in two tails under a helmet with eye motifs, in a black sleeveless robe marked with eyes. She explains the game's rules in detail and in the same words to everyone, conjures a sword and turns it into a card to show how cards work, and sends each player out onto the plain.

**Speaking Style:** Precise, even and almost mechanical, a guide's voice reciting rules it has said a thousand times.
**Combat Role:** none shown; a keeper of the game who calls on the others when someone breaks in
**Relationship Hook:** A silver-haired young woman in an eye-patterned robe reciting the rules to a new arrival.
personality: Core: explains everything once; watches every arrival; never strays from the script
Quirk: professional and machine-like

npcs.name: Ewart Merriweather
npcs.info:
The keeper of the walled orchard, a round, rosy man in a straw hat, whose grandfather was the sea captain who planted the trees. He prunes in winter, picks in autumn with the whole island, and runs the cider press for a week of the best weather of the year.

**Speaking Style:** Genial and rambling, an orchardist's mellow voice that drifts into the past and comes back when it remembers you.
**Combat Role:** none; a pruning hook and a heavy cider mallet
**Relationship Hook:** A round old orchardist in a straw hat patting the trunk of a gnarled apple tree.
personality: Core: rambles and comes back to the point; treats the trees like elderly relatives; generous with cider and sparing with everything else
Quirk: superstitious about his grandfather's chest

npcs.name: Ezra Hollis
npcs.info:
The sexton of the chapel on the hill, a tall stooping man who rings the bell, cuts the grass between the stones and unlocks the doors on the rare days a visiting minister steps off the mail boat. In between he carves the little boats on the headstones of those the sea never gave back.

**Speaking Style:** Low and careful, a sexton's hushed voice used to speaking in graveyards and to the grieving.
**Combat Role:** none; a spade and the patience of a man who digs graves by hand
**Relationship Hook:** A tall sexton in a dark porch, one hand resting on a bell rope, watching a grey sea.
personality: Core: speaks softly even outdoors; keeps a count of every time he has rung the bell; carves boats on the stones of the drowned
Quirk: stands near the rope in every storm

npcs.name: Ezra Pennick
npcs.info:
A wiry old prospector of sixty-eight with a metal detector, a dog and a tent, who has combed this stretch of open desert for meteorites for nine years. He sells what he finds to collectors who come to the autumn auctions, and he swears a great stone fell here in his grandfather's time.

**Speaking Style:** Cracked, excitable and wandering, an old prospector who interrupts himself to show you a stone.
**Combat Role:** none; a pickaxe swung wildly and a dog that bites
**Relationship Hook:** A wild-haired old prospector sweeping a metal detector over open sand, his scruffy dog trotting behind.
personality: Core: shows strangers stones from his pocket; talks to his dog as an equal; camps alone for months and likes it
Quirk: certain a great stone fell here

npcs.name: Ezra Thistlewood
npcs.info:
The caretaker of the Skyfoot Cemetery, a tall, gaunt man of fifty-five with a lantern jaw and a spade always at hand. He digs the graves, sweeps the paths and cuts the floor numbers under the fighters' names himself, and he keeps the burial register in his lodge.

**Speaking Style:** Low and even, a caretaker who speaks of the dead by their floors as other men speak of the weather.
**Combat Role:** none; a gravedigger's spade and arms that have dug a thousand graves
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt caretaker leaning on his spade among headstones carved with fists, the great tower rising beyond the cypresses.
personality: Core: calm and solemn; respectful of every grave; whittles while he waits
Quirk: curious about the flowers

npcs.name: Fabius Sorrel
npcs.info:
The owner of the back-street pawnshop, a thin, beak-nosed man behind a grille, who buys watches, cameras and anything else with a story attached.

**Speaking Style:** Oily and confiding, a dealer's whisper that makes every price sound like a favour.
**Combat Role:** none; a dealer behind a grille with an alarm button
**Relationship Hook:** A thin beak-nosed pawnbroker with a loupe on his forehead weighing a hunting knife behind a counter grille.
personality: Core: greedy; smooth; careless about where things come from
Quirk: collector's passion

npcs.name: Fan Lizhi
npcs.info:
A noodle cook at the Azian quarter night market, a broad-shouldered man in his forties with a shaved head, a white towel round his neck and forearms scarred by the stockpot. His broth is the best in the market and he knows it.

**Speaking Style:** Rich, quick and scolding, a noodle cook's voice that criticises a customer's chopsticks and then feeds him twice.
**Combat Role:** an aura-trained Gourmet Hunter with a cleaver in each hand and no patience
**Relationship Hook:** A broad shaven-headed cook with a towel round his neck tasting broth over a steaming pot under red lanterns.
personality: Core: proud cook; well informed; quick temper
Quirk: scolds customers he likes

npcs.name: Feitan Portor
npcs.info:
Member number two of the Phantom Troupe, a short, lean man in dark baggy clothes with a skull-marked mask over his mouth and an umbrella that hides a sword. He is the Troupe's interrogator and torturer, one of its fastest fighters, and he speaks little. He and Phinks are usually together.

**Speaking Style:** A clipped, rasping voice that speaks few words in bad grammar and snaps into a foreign tongue when angry; it sounds bored even while hurting someone.
**Combat Role:** a blade drawn from an umbrella, blinding speed and torture as a craft
**Relationship Hook:** A short man in black with a masked mouth leaning on an umbrella, a prisoner trembling at his feet.
personality: Core: enjoys interrogation; loyal to the Spider before any one member; terse with friends, worse with others
Quirk: taciturn, brutal and precise

npcs.name: Felix Abernathy
npcs.info:
A charming man of thirty-five in a safari jacket who sits at the motel bar with a portfolio of photographs and sells them to the journalists who come to look at the east. His pictures of East Gorteau are the only ones anyone can buy.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and confiding, a salesman whose every sentence sounds like an exclusive.
**Combat Role:** none; he talks his way out or runs to his car
**Relationship Hook:** A smooth man in a safari jacket spreading grainy photographs across a motel bar for a pair of reporters.
personality: Core: charming and plausible; generous with drinks; afraid of the real east
Quirk: a fraud who half believes himself

npcs.name: Femi Okafor
npcs.info:
The weigher at the wire burners' scales, a cheerful man with his face wrapped twice against the smoke, who weighs every bundle of stripped copper and marks the Assembly's share. The burners like him because he weighs honestly and jokes while he does it.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and good-humoured, laughing through the cloth, coughing through the laugh.
**Combat Role:** a strong-shouldered man who swings a scale weight on a chain
**Relationship Hook:** A broad man with his face wrapped twice, grinning above the cloth as he balances a bundle of copper on a beam scale.
personality: Core: jokes while he weighs; will not round a weight in anyone's favour; sings in a language from far away
Quirk: coughs through his own laughter

npcs.name: Fen Ruolan
npcs.info:
The head of reception at the RG Foundation's tower, a woman in her fifties in a neat grey suit who has signed in every visitor for twenty years. She knows the directors' wives by name, their drivers by face and their moods by the way they cross the marble.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, even and kind, a receptionist's voice that drops to a murmur when she means a warning.
**Combat Role:** none; she sees trouble coming across the lobby and has the security men there first
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-suited receptionist behind a marble desk, quietly telling a young clerk to go home early.
personality: Core: remembers every face; never gossips in the lobby; keeps barley sweets in her desk for the drivers
Quirk: sends the new girls home early on certain days

npcs.name: Fenn Abernethy
npcs.info:
A stooped old man with frost on his eyebrows half the day, who keeps the ice house compressor running as he has for forty years. He walks the building with his ear cocked like a doctor with a stethoscope and can tell from a knock which bearing is going.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and grumbling, an old engineer who talks to machines more gently than to people.
**Combat Role:** none; a long spanner and a lifetime of knowing where the heavy things fall
**Relationship Hook:** An old man with his ear pressed to a thumping compressor, a spanner in his raised hand.
personality: Core: listens to machines before he looks at them; refuses every offer of help and then needs it; keeps a thermos of tea in the cold room
Quirk: grumbles at people and murmurs to engines

npcs.name: Fenn Tarpaper
npcs.info:
The builder everyone on the shanty rows calls when a roof leaks or a wall leans, a long-armed man who can raise a shack on top of a shack in a day from doors, sheet tin and tarpaulin. He works for a meal and a story.

**Speaking Style:** Rich and easy, a builder who sings while he works and talks the same way.
**Combat Role:** a long-armed builder who fights with a claw hammer and drops a wall on a pursuer
**Relationship Hook:** A long-armed builder balancing a sheet of tin on a shack roof, a claw hammer at his belt.
personality: Core: sings as he works; will not build higher than three; takes his pay in stories
Quirk: knocks on every wall he passes to hear it

npcs.name: Feodor Lanz
npcs.info:
