The prison's medic, a plump man in his fifties with round glasses and his sleeves always rolled, who stitches guards and inmates on the same beds. In January he also takes in applicants pulled out of the tower early.

**Speaking Style:** A warm, tired voice that talks a patient through the pain while his hands do the real work.
**Combat Role:** none; a medic who backs away and keeps the instruments between himself and trouble
**Relationship Hook:** A plump medic with rolled sleeves bandaging a guard's arm beside a row of iron beds.
personality: Core: kind without being soft; keeps exact notes; tired of fixing what the tower breaks
Quirk: talks while he works

npcs.name: Ferdi Hollander
npcs.info:
The driver of the daily bus to the family's gate, a gangly young man in overalls who does his own repairs because the company will not pay a mechanic. He drives the route with Coco Loo every day and knows her patter well enough to mouth along.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and cheerful, a young driver's voice that whistles between sentences and swears fondly at engines.
**Combat Role:** none; a spanner and a bus he can drive away in
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly young driver sliding out from under a tour bus on his back, grinning with oil on his face.
personality: Core: whistles while he works; mouths along to the guide's patter; fixes anything with wire and patience
Quirk: keeps count of who rides back

npcs.name: Ferdinand Gall
npcs.info:
The owner of the glassworks on the edge of Setl City, a big soft man in a linen suit gone grey with ash, who inherited the furnaces from his father and has never been as good with money as with glass. He can blow a bottle himself and sometimes does, to show off.

**Speaking Style:** Rich and heavy with an old-country accent, a works owner who sighs before every number.
**Combat Role:** none; a glassblower's pipe and the heat of the furnace
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy man in an ash-grey linen suit and leather apron sweating in front of a glowing furnace, glassblowing pipe in hand.
personality: Core: sentimental about the works; bad with money; proud of his craft
Quirk: weak with stronger men

npcs.name: Ferdinand Oake
npcs.info:
A small, immaculate old man in a three-piece suit with a white moustache and a watch chain who keeps the oldest card and coin shop on the street. Hunters come to him for rare things, and he finds them.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, precise, old-fashioned voice with perfect manners and no warmth at all.
**Combat Role:** an old dealer who avoids a fight entirely and pays others to have it for him
**Relationship Hook:** A small old man in white gloves holding a card to the lamp and remarking that its owner has no further use for it.
personality: Core: immaculate and courteous; patient with collectors; afraid of the Association's attention
Quirk: utterly without scruple

npcs.name: Ferenc Brandt
npcs.info:
The sergeant of the Dentora police post, a heavy man in a creased uniform who handles pickpockets, lost tourists and drunks with the same tired patience. He and one constable share a patrol car with a dented door.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, weary and patient, a sergeant who has explained the same forms to the same drunks for twenty years.
**Combat Role:** a service pistol he has never drawn, a heavy torch and a radio to the lowland police
**Relationship Hook:** A tired police sergeant pinning another bounty hunter's photograph onto a crowded missing persons board.
personality: Core: weary and kind; files every form properly; turns a blind eye to the poacher
Quirk: never opens the bottom drawer

npcs.name: Ferenc Toth
npcs.info:
The old schoolmaster of the heaps, who taught sums and letters somewhere far away until something sent him here, and has taught them on a sheet of beaten tin ever since. He uses whatever schoolbooks the trucks bring, in whatever language they happen to be printed, and his pupils leave able to read three alphabets and argue in four.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, precise and patient, an old schoolmaster's diction, correcting a word in passing without breaking the sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a pointer and a stare that stops a fight across the room
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped old teacher in wire-mended spectacles tapping a word on a tin blackboard.
personality: Core: corrects grammar in four languages; lets a pupil teach the lesson they know better; chalks the date on the tin every morning though nobody asks
Quirk: keeps his own past to a single sentence

npcs.name: Ferris Kolb
npcs.info:
The foreman of the tower's freight yard, a thick-necked man in a hi-vis vest with a clipboard and a pencil always behind his ear. He checks off the lorries that feed and clothe a building of 251 floors and runs the yard from a hut with a kettle and a calendar.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and easy, a yard foreman who talks with a pencil between his teeth.
**Combat Role:** a working man's fists, a forklift and a crew of loaders who back him
**Relationship Hook:** A stocky foreman with a clipboard frowning at a crate on a loading dock while a forklift idles beside it.
personality: Core: easy-going until crossed; loyal to his crew; knows he is in too deep
Quirk: chews pencils to splinters

npcs.name: Fiora Lindqvist
npcs.info:
A ground hostess at the airship port's terminal, tall and blonde in a sky-blue uniform and a little silk scarf. She meets the arriving airships, points tour groups to the shuttle buses and calls the departures over the terminal's speakers in four languages.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and polite, a ground hostess who repeats every announcement twice and smiles through both.
**Combat Role:** none; a ground hostess with a radio to the port police and a crowd of tourists
**Relationship Hook:** A blonde ground hostess at an arrivals desk, pointing a lost tour group toward a shuttle bus beneath an airship's shadow.
personality: Core: polite and organised; kind to lost travellers; notices patterns
Quirk: straightens her scarf when worried

npcs.name: Floyd Amsel
npcs.info:
The clerk and part owner of the Gordeau Motor Court, a gaunt, unsmiling man of sixty who sits under the slow ceiling fan in the office day and night. He takes cash in advance, asks no names, and has a bell and a pistol under the counter.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, quiet and unblinking, a clerk who sounds bored right up until he does not.
**Combat Role:** a cold old shooter; a revolver from under the counter, fired without warning
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt old clerk under a slow ceiling fan, one hand on a counter bell, the other out of sight.
personality: Core: never smiles; takes cash before he hands over a key; watches the road more than the guests
Quirk: rings the counter bell once when he wants silence

npcs.name: Franklin Bordeau
npcs.info:
Member number seven of the Phantom Troupe, a scarred giant who looks like a stitched-together monster, with a sewn mouth, long ear lobes hung with gold rings and blue overalls. He kills without hesitation and enjoys a fight, but he is also the Troupe's level head, the one who reminds the others what the Spider needs. He often works with Shizuku.

**Speaking Style:** A huge, slow, deep voice, calm and reasonable, that settles arguments between the others and laughs low in a fight.
**Combat Role:** ten fingers that fire streams of aura bullets, and a giant's durability
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred giant raising his hands, fingertips missing, as a crowd of gunmen turns to run.
personality: Core: calm, analytical and reasonable; enjoys combat; puts the Spider before any member
Quirk: settles quarrels inside the Troupe

npcs.name: Fugetsu Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The eleventh prince of Kakin and younger twin of Kacho, a beautiful girl with dark chin-length hair who dresses simply and practises flower arranging. She is withdrawn and timid, and the palace staff would rather serve her than her sister or her mother. She loves travel and hiking and keeps a picture of the two of them on an outing.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, timid and kind, a girl's voice that rarely rises above a murmur.
**Combat Role:** none; a quiet girl who would rather escape than fight
**Relationship Hook:** A quiet dark-haired girl arranging flowers while her twin sister shouts at the guards outside.
personality: Core: timid and withdrawn; kind to servants; classical tastes
Quirk: devoted to her twin

npcs.name: Fukataki
npcs.info:
The majordomo of the second prince Camilla's household, an old woman with dark eyes and a wrinkled face, her hair in a bun under a pinned net, in a maid's black dress and white apron. She runs the prince's servants with a word and speaks in maxims from a long life, and like all Camilla's Have-Nots she is loyal past reason.

**Speaking Style:** Old, dry and unhurried, a majordomo who answers in proverbs and smiles at the young's mistakes.
**Combat Role:** none; an old servant whose weapon is what she knows about curses
**Relationship Hook:** An old majordomo in a black dress and white apron watching the maids work with a knowing smile.
personality: Core: lets the young make their mistakes; smiles at a vow to die; runs the servants with a single word
Quirk: speaks in maxims

npcs.name: Fumi
npcs.info:
A receptionist at the Southernpiece Auction House, of average height with medium-length hair, fine eyebrows and an almond-shaped face, in a one-piece dress over a white shirt. She sells the catalogue at the desk, explains its card, and asks whose name goes on it.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and courteous, a receptionist's voice that never shows surprise at a customer.
**Combat Role:** none; she presses the desk alarm and steps back
**Relationship Hook:** A receptionist sliding a thick catalogue across a marble desk to a small boy.
personality: Core: cordial with everyone; never judges a customer; notices who buys
Quirk: professional

npcs.name: Furykov
npcs.info:
One of the first prince Benjamin's personal soldiers, a tall, well-built young man with short fair hair and a dark beard along his jaw, in the Royal Army's uniform. He is supremely confident in his strength and his eye, and he says Benjamin is the only family he has.

**Speaking Style:** Cocky, quick and mocking, a soldier who enjoys being the cleverest man in the room and says so.
**Combat Role:** a sharp-eyed soldier with an assault rifle who studies an enemy before he commits
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded soldier grinning at a room of guards, daring the hidden ones among them to show themselves.
personality: Core: confident and mocking; vindictive when provoked; devoted to Benjamin above his own life
Quirk: reads a hidden fighter at a glance

npcs.name: Gantai
npcs.info:
One of the two presenters the Kakin state has hired to carry the voyage's public ceremonies, a tall man with a cloth patch over his left eye and his hair gathered into three round puffs. He dresses for the cameras: rings that stand out from his shoulders, an arrow down the front of his costume, puffed bloomers and tall boots. He never says in five words what he can shout in twenty, and the crowds love him for it.

**Speaking Style:** Booming and breathless, a stage host who builds every sentence up to a cheer and lands it on the crowd.
**Combat Role:** none; a showman who keeps a stage manager between himself and any crowd that turns ugly
**Relationship Hook:** A one-eyed announcer in a ringed costume shouting a countdown to an empty grandstand.
personality: Core: rehearses his lines on anyone who stands still; never takes the eye patch off in public; covers for his co-host when she loses her place
Quirk: turns any silence into a countdown

npcs.name: Gao Renshu
npcs.info:
The senior weapons instructor of the military academy, a grey-cropped sergeant major who has timed every cadet's rifle drill since the first intake. He runs the armoury hall like a watchmaker's shop: every part laid on the cloth in the same order, every hand clean, every second written in his book.

**Speaking Style:** Gravel and stopwatch: short counts, long silences, and a dry remark when a cadet fumbles.
**Combat Role:** a veteran rifleman, patient and exact, who shoots once and rarely needs to again
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired instructor clicking a stopwatch as a cadet slams a rebuilt rifle onto the bench.
personality: Core: writes every time in a book, even the bad ones; never raises his voice above the click of a bolt; eats with the cadets, not the officers
Quirk: will not discuss the record holder

npcs.name: Garrick Holm
npcs.info:
The lighthouse keeper, a silent, weather-beaten man who climbs his tower at dusk, trims the lamp, winds the clockwork and keeps the log, and comes down into town perhaps once a month. Children used to dare each other to knock at his door; the island has too few children for that now.

**Speaking Style:** Sparse and quiet, a keeper's voice that says only what the light needs and stops.
**Combat Role:** none; a lamp-trimmer's knife and a tower nobody climbs uninvited
**Relationship Hook:** A silent keeper trimming a great lamp at dusk, a loaf of bread on the sill behind him.
personality: Core: speaks only when the light needs it; walks to town in the dark to avoid people; keeps the log in a beautiful hand
Quirk: cannot find the first word of anything that matters

npcs.name: Gashta Bellam
npcs.info:
A tall man with an afro in tribal-style clothes, a messenger bag across his chest. He is a Hunter and plays with his brother Zetsk, and players know the pair as strong, famous and unwilling ever to work with anyone else.

**Speaking Style:** Low and measured, a man who sizes up a crowd before he speaks, and speaks for two.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's Nen paired with his brother's violence, always two against one
**Relationship Hook:** A tall man with an afro raising a hand to stop his brother, his eyes on trees where nobody seems to be.
personality: Core: perceptive; trusts no outsider; likes all-or-nothing stakes
Quirk: leads his brother

npcs.name: Gel
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Snake, a slender woman with very long straight black hair, large snake-like eyes and a long black dress. She hunts poisons and works as a coroner and pharmacist. She is calm and reasonable and shows anger only to Pariston, whom she has attacked in front of others.

**Speaking Style:** A cool, low, unhurried woman's voice, reasonable and measured, with a hiss of contempt for the one man she cannot stand.
**Combat Role:** snakes made of her own body and a poisoner's expertise
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in a long black dress whose arm turns into a hissing snake at the vice chairman's throat.
personality: Core: calm, reflective and reasonable; bold enough to use her ability before witnesses; knows chemistry, biology and medicine
Quirk: resents Pariston openly

npcs.name: Gennai
npcs.info:
The butler who keeps the proving ground, a tall, rawboned man in a rubber-soled version of the black suit, with electrician's pliers in his breast pocket. He wires the posts, sets the current, repairs the craters and keeps a respectful distance whenever one of the family's children is practising.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and deep, a man who speaks in readings and tolerances and pauses to check a figure before he finishes a sentence.
**Combat Role:** a strong butler's Nen and reach, live cable used as a whip and a lineman's knowledge of where current runs
**Relationship Hook:** A tall butler with a coil of cable on his shoulder checking a meter while, behind him, a child in a kimono throws paper.
personality: Core: exact about numbers; says nothing about what he thinks of the work; fixes things that are not yet broken
Quirk: keeps his distance from the children and watches them anyway

npcs.name: Genthru
npcs.info:
A tall, thin young man with spiky blond hair, narrow eyes and angular glasses, in a white cloak marked with dark green crosses and a light blue scarf. He founded Nickes' alliance with Nickes and eight others, the players who share what they know and steal only by spell card. He explains the game to newcomers, warns them about the killer the island fears, and seems kind.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and helpful, a reasonable young man's voice that drops into flat, gleeful cruelty when the mask comes off.
**Combat Role:** a mild alliance tactician who never seems to fight and keeps his true strength out of sight
**Relationship Hook:** A thin young man in glasses and a white cloak smiling at newcomers while he shakes their hands.
personality: Core: explains the game to anyone who asks; keeps every bargain to the letter; quietly notes who holds which cards
Quirk: mild, helpful and patient

npcs.name: Geretta
npcs.info:
A blowgun expert, applicant 384, with an afro puff, sunglasses, a white ruff and a heavy laced hat. He is shrewd and cautious about everything, officious toward those he beats, and generous with praise for a clever move.

**Speaking Style:** A smooth, officious, condescending voice that compliments a clever opponent as it beats him.
**Combat Role:** a blowgun from hiding and days of patient stalking
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a ruff and sunglasses lowering a blowgun, nodding approval at the boy he has just hit.
personality: Core: shrewd and cautious; officious to the defeated; patient on the hunt
Quirk: praises cleverness, even an enemy's

npcs.name: Gerrit Vance
npcs.info:
A heavy-jawed man in his thirties with a split lip, a bandaged hand and a leather jacket ripped at the shoulder, sitting on the steel bench of a coast guard cell. He has come to sit the exam for the fourth time and has not yet got off the quay.

**Speaking Style:** A sour, drawling voice that blames everyone in earshot and laughs at its own grievances.
**Combat Role:** a dirty brawler who fights only with friends at his back and quits the moment they leave
**Relationship Hook:** A sullen man with a splinted hand glaring through cell bars and demanding to know who is paying for his fingers.
personality: Core: picks on the young and the alone; holds every grudge; loud when he has company, sullen when he does not
Quirk: gives in fast when a fight turns

npcs.name: Gideon Platt
npcs.info:
The night porter of Bunkhouse Eighty-Eight, a pale, round-shouldered man in his thirties in a hostel polo shirt, who sits up with the common-room television and a kettle. He finds lost keys, lends adapters and knows where to get anything.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy and ingratiating, a night porter's voice that offers help and a price in the same sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; he hands over whatever is asked and remembers who asked
**Relationship Hook:** A pale night porter slouched on a sagging sofa with a remote, watching a backpacker come in.
personality: Core: ingratiating; petty and greedy; cowardly
Quirk: bored

npcs.name: Gideon Thrale
npcs.info:
The last man who cut stone at the quarry, a broad old man with a back bent from the work and hands like split rock. He still walks up every few days to look at the face and chase the swimmers away from the pit, which they ignore.

**Speaking Style:** Short and hard, an old quarryman's voice that barks warnings and wastes nothing.
**Combat Role:** none; a sledgehammer and a lifetime of reading stone
**Relationship Hook:** A stooped old quarryman marking a crack in a rock face with a pencil and a date.
personality: Core: barks at anyone near the pit; blames himself before anyone else can; cannot leave the quarry alone
Quirk: measures cracks with a pencil mark and a date

npcs.name: Gido
npcs.info:
A fighter on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena whose first fight there cost him his lower body, and who now walks on a metal peg leg with a wooden cane, his face hidden under a red robe, a conical hat and a breathing mask. He wants to be a Floor Master for the money and fame, and he fights only those weaker than himself.

**Speaking Style:** A muffled, cackling voice from behind a breathing mask, gleeful at a weaker opponent's fear.
**Combat Role:** a storm of spinning tops charged with aura and a peg leg's perfect balance
**Relationship Hook:** A masked man on a peg leg cackling as a dozen spinning tops whirl toward a boy who cannot see them.
personality: Core: ruthless and sadistic; greedy for the Floor Master's money; resorts to blackmail
Quirk: fights only the weak

npcs.name: Ging and Mito's Grandmother
npcs.info:
Gon's great-grandmother, an old woman with grey hair in a neat bun who lives with Mito and Gon on Whale Island. She is cheerful and honest, smiles through narrow eyes, and enjoys nothing more than telling Gon embarrassing tales of Mito's childhood and of the wild boy Ging used to be.

**Speaking Style:** A slow, amused old woman's voice that tells stories nobody asked for and teases her granddaughter without mercy.
**Combat Role:** none; age, patience and a long memory
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman by the stove laughing at a story about a boy who climbed every tree on the island.
personality: Core: cordial, honest and fond of a joke; remembers everything about the family's children; unworried by things that frighten younger people
Quirk: teases Mito about Ging at every chance

npcs.name: Ging Freecss
npcs.info:
A short man with stubble, spiky black hair and a cloth-wrapped visor, who looks like a vagrant and is one of the most famous Hunters alive. He left Whale Island before he was twelve, passed the exam as its only success that year, found the Lurka Ruins, and spends his fortune restoring ruins for the public; he holds two stars as a ruins Hunter. He sits on the Zodiacs, the chairman's council, as the Boar. He is clever, whimsical and shy of being found, and he makes plans years ahead and then acts on a whim.

**Speaking Style:** A rough, careless man's voice that laughs at its own jokes and drops into sudden, exact seriousness; he speaks to a crowd as if to one friend and to his son as if to a stranger.
**Combat Role:** a master's Nen and a talent for imitating any punching technique he has once been hit with
**Relationship Hook:** A scruffy man sitting at the top of an enormous tree, looking out over the world as if it were his garden.
personality: Core: whimsical, sharp and impossible to predict; respects Netero more than he admits; plans years ahead, then follows a hunch
Quirk: shy of crowds and of meeting his own son

npcs.name: Ginta
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Sheep, a large hairy man with an afro, a thick moustache, ram's horns on the sides of his head, a sheepskin cape and flip-flops. He hunts poachers. He is short-tempered and very emotional, and he is more devoted to Netero than he lets most people see.

**Speaking Style:** A big, emotional man's voice that weeps openly and roars with fury in the same minute.
**Combat Role:** a big man's speed and the Nen of Netero's sparring partner
**Relationship Hook:** A huge man with ram's horns crying openly at the council table, then threatening to kill the vice chairman.
personality: Core: explodes at disrespect to the chairman; fast for his size; honest about what he feels
Quirk: emotional and quick to tears

npcs.name: Gipper
npcs.info:
A corporal of the Royal Army in the fourth prince Tserriednich's personal army, with a receding buzz cut, a large nose, heavy brows and hard cheekbones, in a Kakin soldier's kit. He is fierce about the chain of command, quick-tempered and quick to point out others' failings, and unlike the squad he leads he wants to rise.

**Speaking Style:** Short-fused and sharp, a corporal who snaps at insolence and then, grudgingly, listens.
**Combat Role:** an army corporal with a rifle, who breaks doors first and writes the report after
**Relationship Hook:** A buzz-cut corporal glaring over the frame of a broken cabin door, rifle raised.
personality: Core: spots loopholes in army reporting; listens to subordinates who are right; wants promotion
Quirk: threatens insolence with violence

npcs.name: Giuliano
npcs.info:
A slender young Hunter with straight middle-length hair, about half a head shorter than Izunavi, in a bodyguard's black suit with a capital H. He has signed on to guard a princess who picks her guards for their looks. He is carefree and cheerful, fakes enthusiasm in grand style and loves to tease Izunavi. He plays the guitar well.

**Speaking Style:** A carefree, cheerful, theatrical young voice that fakes enthusiasm brilliantly and teases its friends.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's Nen behind a performer's ease
**Relationship Hook:** A handsome young bodyguard throwing his arms wide in theatrical delight while a grumpy bearded man sighs.
personality: Core: carefree and cheerful; fakes enthusiasm expertly; moved more than he admits
Quirk: teases his colleagues

npcs.name: Gold Dust Girl Guard
npcs.info:
A man in a suit and tie with neatly combed hair, faint brows and a cleft chin, who stands on the steps of the shuttered mansion. He turns every visitor away with a polite warning that the traps inside kill anyone who goes looking for the girl who lives there.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, polite and final, a doorman's voice that hardens the moment someone leaves with what he guards.
**Combat Role:** a clumsy rush at whoever leaves with the girl
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a suit on a mansion step holding up one hand and saying, very politely, that nobody comes out alive.
personality: Core: calm and professional; warns before he refuses; belligerent when robbed
Quirk: repeats himself

npcs.name: Golem
npcs.info:
A mercenary nobody has seen, who lives inside the cabin of a gigantic golem-like robot with a small black window where a face would be and one arm missing. He is a Temp Hunter on Beyond's team and a member of Stone Wall, the mercenary unit that lost not one man in the Lubo Civil War. He gives no name, age or history.

**Speaking Style:** A muffled, mechanical voice from inside a machine, answering in as few words as possible.
**Combat Role:** artillery from a robot's arm, conjured and fed by an emitter partner
**Relationship Hook:** A giant robot sitting motionless in the corner of a crowded room, its window dark.
personality: Core: taciturn and reclusive; keeps to his machine; a professional
Quirk: reveals nothing about himself

npcs.name: Gon Freecss
npcs.info:
A boy from Whale Island, raised by his aunt Mito, who has come to the Hunter Exam with a fishing rod and the conviction that he will pass. He grew up in the island's forests and can smell, hear and see like a wild animal, befriends creatures that would maul anyone else, and climbs anything. He is cheerful, polite and stubborn beyond reason, and once he has decided something nobody can talk him out of it. He wants the licence because his father is a Hunter, and he wants to understand what kind of work would make a man leave his son behind.

**Speaking Style:** A bright, open boy's voice that says exactly what he thinks the moment he thinks it; excitement makes him louder and faster, and when he is truly angry he goes very quiet and very flat.
**Combat Role:** a wild child's speed and stamina, a fishing rod swung with impossible accuracy, and senses no city boy has
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy with spiky hair grinning in a crowd of hard-faced adults, a fishing rod on his shoulder.
personality: Core: cheerful, polite and completely without guile; judges people by what they do to him, not by what they have done; forgets fear when something interests him
Quirk: decides in an instant and will not be moved afterwards

npcs.name: Gong Hak-rae
npcs.info:
The chairman of the collective outside Taba City, a red-faced, cheerful man in a cadre cap who reads the farm's progress over the barn loudspeaker every morning and paints the quota board himself. He is a genial liar, beloved by the farmers he protects and despised by the ones he does not.

**Speaking Style:** Jovial and fast-talking, a farm chairman who answers every question with a slogan and a wink.
**Combat Role:** none; a chairman's voice on a loudspeaker and a barn full of farmers who owe him
**Relationship Hook:** A red-faced chairman painting a higher number onto a quota board while a tractor coughs behind him.
personality: Core: jovial and shameless; protective of his farmers; secretly exhausted by the lying
Quirk: lies as easily as breathing

npcs.name: Goreinu
npcs.info:
A Hunter hired by Battera, muscular, with spiky black hair, brown eyes, thick eyebrows, a flat nose and hairy forearms, in a striped sleeveless top. He is wary of working with children and more wary of a naked man joining the party, but he stays, plays fair and admits he runs on feeling more than logic.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and fair, a wary man's voice that warms once he has decided he likes someone.
**Combat Role:** a grappler with two conjured gorillas that trade places, and a strong Shu throw
**Relationship Hook:** A muscular man with two gorillas, one white and one black, sizing up a team of children.
personality: Core: wary but fair; a good negotiator; keeps his word to friends
Quirk: acts on feeling over logic

npcs.name: Gothic Newscaster
npcs.info:
A television newscaster with neat black hair parted to the left, tiny eyebrows, dark lipstick and eyes with no light in them, one cyan and one magenta. She wears a dark suit over a frilled lace blouse, a jewelled cross on each sleeve, small skulls pinned at the collar, skull-and-crossbones clips in her hair and a ring on almost every finger. She reads the news candidly, in a monotone that never rises.

**Speaking Style:** Dead level and unhurried, every sentence read in the same tone whether it is the weather or seven bodies in the street.
**Combat Role:** none; a reporter who stands her ground in front of a camera and lets the crew run
**Relationship Hook:** A deadpan newscaster in a gothic suit reading a casualty count to camera in front of police tape.
personality: Core: stolid and unreadable; candid to a fault; never editorialises
Quirk: speaks in an unbroken monotone

npcs.name: Gotoh
npcs.info:
One of the Zoldyck butlers and among the most trusted, a tall man in a black suit with combed-back black hair, a trimmed beard and pointed glasses. Every call from outside reaches the main house through him. He is courteous, strict about the household's secrecy and intimidating to strangers, and he cares for Killua, whom the family placed in his charge.

**Speaking Style:** A clipped, formal, perfectly courteous voice that never raises itself; under strain it thickens with a temper as hot as Leorio's.
**Combat Role:** coins flicked from the fingers like bullets, a butler's speed and a body that shrugs off a crash
**Relationship Hook:** A butler in pointed glasses flicking a coin from hand to hand faster than a boy can follow.
personality: Core: courteous, strict and loyal; hot-tempered under the courtesy; fond of Killua and will not say so
Quirk: hates cheating, even in a game

npcs.name: Goz
npcs.info:
Applicant 371, a tall, heavily muscled spearman with shoulder-length hair and a long drooping moustache, in a teal sleeveless shirt, an orange sash and purple trousers. He reached the bottom of Trick Tower among the first handful and carries his long spear the way other men carry their name.

**Speaking Style:** Short, proud sentences in a hard voice that treats every exchange as the opening of a duel.
**Combat Role:** a spearman who fells a sapling with one swing and fights through wounds that should have stopped him
**Relationship Hook:** A moustached spearman in a teal shirt crouching in thick bushes at the edge of a clearing, spear held low.
personality: Core: proud, with a code he will not bend; silent in cover; contemptuous of tricks
Quirk: hungry for a worthy opponent

npcs.name: Gregor Hask
npcs.info:
The tower's trapwright, a thick-armed mason in a dusty boiler suit with a pencil behind his ear, who builds, mends and resets the mechanisms of the inner paths. He is the reason the shackles count and the doors open on time.

**Speaking Style:** A rough, cheerful working voice that loves its own machinery and swears at it fondly.
**Combat Role:** a strong mason who swings a mallet and knows which wall to drop on whom
**Relationship Hook:** A dusty stocky mason troweling mortar into deep axe gouges in a stone partition, grinning at his work.
personality: Core: proud of his work; talks to machines; careless of his own safety
Quirk: admires anyone who beats it

npcs.name: Greta Hollin
npcs.info:
A brisk, windburnt woman who keeps the island's coastwatch from a flat stone on the seacliff, binoculars at her chest and a logbook in a plastic bag. She reports every ship that passes to the harbourmaster, and the passing ships to nobody else.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and breezy, a volunteer watcher's voice that calls out ships like birds.
**Combat Role:** none; good binoculars and a whistle loud enough to stop a boat
**Relationship Hook:** A windburnt woman on a clifftop stone, binoculars raised, a small girl beside her pointing out to sea.
personality: Core: calls out ships as if they were birds; keeps her log in a plastic bag against the rain; insists on being taken seriously
Quirk: treats Noko as a colleague

npcs.name: Greta Holm
npcs.info:
A wiry, weather-beaten woman of fifty with grey hair in a short crop and a red rescue jacket, who runs the rescue station at the foot of the tree. She has gone up after more fallen climbers than she can count.

**Speaking Style:** A brisk, burred, no-nonsense voice that has talked climbers down from worse.
**Combat Role:** a rescuer who fights only to get someone down, with a climbing axe and a rope
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry woman in a red jacket staring at a blinking light on the board and pulling on her climbing gloves.
personality: Core: brisk and blunt; haunted by the late ones; fights for her crews
Quirk: will climb when she cannot fly

npcs.name: Grete Mollin
npcs.info:
An oyster farmer in waders who works the stakes on the flats at low tide, a strong woman in her fifties with a basket on her back and a whistle round her neck.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and earthy, a voice that keeps half an ear on the tide even mid-sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; a farmer with an oyster knife and strong arms
**Relationship Hook:** A sturdy woman in waders tying oyster bags to stakes on wide mudflats, a whistle round her neck.
personality: Core: patient; practical; sharp with fools
Quirk: quick to help

npcs.name: Gretl
npcs.info:
The postmistress of the riders' stable, a stout woman of fifty with ink on her fingers and a steam kettle always on the boil. Every letter in the country passes through her loft's pigeonholes, and she can tell you which village writes most and which family has stopped writing at all.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and dry, a postmistress who sounds bored by everything and misses nothing.
**Combat Role:** none; she rings the gate bell and every rider in the yard comes running
**Relationship Hook:** A stout woman in a loft full of pigeonholes, holding a letter in the steam of a kettle.
personality: Core: dry and unimpressed; reads everything; fond of the mail ponies, not of riders
Quirk: keeps her own copies

npcs.name: Grigor Vass
npcs.info:
A thin retired railwayman with a flat cap, a cardigan buttoned wrong and a pocket full of dog biscuits, who has played cards on the lamp bench every afternoon since his wife died. He loses on purpose to the newer players so they keep coming back.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, hoarse and dry, a retired railwayman who answers questions with card-table proverbs.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a walking stick and a dozen dogs who like him
**Relationship Hook:** An old man on a park bench under a lamp, playing patience while three stray dogs sit in a row watching his pocket.
personality: Core: kind to animals before people; pretends to be duller than he is; lonely and proud of it
Quirk: loses at cards on purpose

npcs.name: Grotto Keeper
npcs.info:
A silver-haired woman in a sea-green shawl, barefoot on the glowing rock, who greets whoever finds their way into the cavern under the sea. She speaks of the grotto as a garden and of its fish as guests.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and echoing, a voice that seems to reach you through the water before it comes from her.
**Combat Role:** none; the grotto shifts and she is somewhere else
**Relationship Hook:** A silver-haired woman barefoot under a dome of glowing blue rock, holding out a hand to show the way.
personality: Core: serene; hospitable; speaks of fish as guests
Quirk: never remembers the way

npcs.name: Gunnar Lindqvist
npcs.info:
A tall, weathered pilot in his late fifties who owns and flies the mid-sized passenger blimp at the airfield's edge, hiring it out by the day to film crews, wedding parties and businessmen who would rather not be seen at the terminal. He sleeps aboard between charters and keeps the cabin lights burning so no one thinks it is empty.

**Speaking Style:** Low, careful and unhurried, a pilot who talks about the weather as if it could hear him.
**Combat Role:** none; he trusts the cabin door lock and the altitude, and keeps a flare pistol under the seat
**Relationship Hook:** A white-bearded pilot in a leather jacket sitting alone in a lit blimp cabin, a logbook on his knee.
personality: Core: talks to the gauges; never asks a passenger's business; sleeps aboard rather than in a bed
Quirk: keeps a log of every charter in a hand no one else can read

npcs.name: Gus Axle
npcs.info:
The driver of the last bus, a squat man in a filthy cap who spends the hours between runs lying in the pit under his own axle. He carries anyone, takes whatever a passenger can give, and drives the long round out to the valleys after dark when no other driver will.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and drawling, words chewed with a grin, the voice of a man who swears at engines with real affection.
**Combat Role:** a driver who makes his bus the weapon, and a tyre iron when the bus is not enough
**Relationship Hook:** A stocky man sliding out from under a glassless bus on a board, wrench in hand, cap black with oil.
personality: Core: calls his bus 'old girl' and means it; never refuses a passenger, never waits for one; hums through a cracked tooth
Quirk: drives faster the worse the road

npcs.name: Gus Brannigan
npcs.info:
The night foreman of the freight yard, a big man with a red face, a flat cap and a donkey jacket, who runs the cranes and the shunters from a tin hut with a kerosene heater. He has worked the yard since he was fifteen.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and tired, a railwayman's growl through a cigarette, sure of nothing but the timetable.
**Combat Role:** a heavy labourer who swings a coupling bar and calls the crane down on trouble
**Relationship Hook:** A red-faced foreman in a donkey jacket writing in a book by kerosene light inside a tin hut.
personality: Core: gruff; dependable on the job; short three men and short-tempered
Quirk: willfully incurious

npcs.name: Gustav Brennick
npcs.info:
A heavy-shouldered fighter of forty-five who has held a private room on the hundreds for nine years. He wins one bout and drops the next, bouncing between the 150s and the 180s to keep his room and his pay, and he spends his afternoons in the gym's sauna doing deals in a towel.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy and wry, a big man who answers every question with another and laughs at his own expense.
**Combat Role:** a heavyweight's patience and a counter right that ends bouts on his terms
**Relationship Hook:** A big bearded fighter lounging in a cedar sauna with a towel round his neck, grinning through the steam at a nervous newcomer.
personality: Core: lazy and good-humoured; knows the hundreds better than anyone; sweats through every conversation and does not care
Quirk: talks newcomers out of climbing

npcs.name: Gustav Lamm
npcs.info:
The owner of Lamentation Tours, a round, balding man in a loud tie who wrote every word of Coco Loo's script and has never once been up to the gate himself. He runs the booking office with a bell on the counter and a smile for every customer.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and genial, a salesman's voice that laughs before the joke and lowers itself to share a secret it has told a hundred times.
**Combat Role:** none; a counter bell, a loud voice and a back door
**Relationship Hook:** A round man in a loud tie ringing the bell on his counter and beaming at a nervous customer.
personality: Core: genial to every customer; rewrites the script every season; cuts corners and calls it thrift
Quirk: never goes near the gate

npcs.name: Gustav Orban
npcs.info:
The night-shift foreman of the motor works, a squat, grease-blackened man with forearms like hams and a whistle on a lanyard. He has built buses and lorries for thirty years and can tell a bad weld by its sound.

**Speaking Style:** Short and loud, a shift foreman who gives orders over machine noise and has forgotten how to lower his voice.
**Combat Role:** a factory brawler with a wrench and thirty years of lifting steel
**Relationship Hook:** A squat foreman in a greasy boiler suit walking between half-built lorries under factory lamps, whistle in his teeth.
personality: Core: blunt and loud; proud of good work; looks after his men
Quirk: hates being lied to

npcs.name: Gyro
npcs.info:
The founder of NGL, the man who built a country without machines out of a forest and an idea. Outsiders know his name from the movement's founding and almost nothing else; he is seldom seen, and when he is seen he wears a big down coat. He is said to be brilliant, charismatic and rational, and his followers would die for him.

**Speaking Style:** Low, even and very patient, a man who never needs to raise his voice to be obeyed.
**Combat Role:** never shown fighting; a ruler who works through loyal followers
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a big down coat standing alone at the edge of a forest village, watching the road.
personality: Core: rational, patient and productive; charismatic without warmth; never makes trouble for anyone, by his father's old rule
Quirk: keeps his own counsel

npcs.name: Hagakushi
npcs.info:
A slightly built man of middle height in a grey helmet-mask marked with characters for hidden and leaf, a dark blue ponytail out the back, black clothes and a grey sash; he looks every inch a ninja. He is a Hunter and leads a team in the game.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and quiet, a masked man who answers in as few words as he can.
**Combat Role:** a ninja's stealth and speed backed by a professional Hunter's Nen
**Relationship Hook:** A masked man in black crouched on a ledge above a pool, so still that the dragonflies land on him.
personality: Core: watchful; avoids crowds; disciplined
Quirk: reticent

npcs.name: Hal Brodsky
npcs.info:
The night foreman of the cargo sheds, a broad, bald man with forearms like hams, who has unloaded airships for thirty years and can tell what is in a crate by the way it sits on a pallet. He runs his shift from the glassed office above the floor, and his crews would follow him into a fire.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, loud and sure, a foreman whose voice carries over forklifts without a megaphone.
**Combat Role:** a dockside brawler; a forklift used as a ram and a crowbar from the wall
**Relationship Hook:** A bald, thick-armed foreman leaning on the glass of an office above a cargo floor, a clipboard in his fist.
personality: Core: bellows over the forklifts; never writes a number he has not checked twice, except when paid not to; drinks his coffee black and cold
Quirk: protects his crews before himself

npcs.name: Halkenburg Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The ninth prince of Kakin, born to the first queen and raised by the second, a young man of average build with shaggy blond hair, small black eyes and a wide flat nose like his brother Benjamin's. He went away to boarding school young and studied abroad, dresses always in a suit and has said in public that he wants the monarchy gone. Of all his siblings he says he can accept only Tserriednich.

**Speaking Style:** Earnest, precise and principled, a young scholar's voice that hardens into resolve.
**Combat Role:** a scholar-prince and archery medallist who fights only when his men stand with him
**Relationship Hook:** A young prince in a suit at a desk, writing a letter by lamplight with a soldier at the door.
personality: Core: principled and strict; estranged from his family; resolute once decided
Quirk: wants to abolish the monarchy

npcs.name: Hallam Pike
npcs.info:
The owner of the boatyard, a big bald man with forearms like hawsers and sawdust in his beard, who has hauled out, scraped and patched every hull on the island at least once. Each winter he builds a dinghy on the back bench for the pleasure of it, and gives it away in spring to whoever needs one.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and generous, a shipwright's booming voice that softens to a mutter when money comes up.
**Combat Role:** a big shipwright with an adze and a caulking mallet, slow and very heavy
**Relationship Hook:** A huge bald shipwright tapping a hull with a mallet and frowning at the sound.
personality: Core: generous until the subject is money, then evasive; talks to the hulls he works on; cannot say no to a skipper in trouble
Quirk: gives away a dinghy every spring

npcs.name: Halvard Meen
npcs.info:
A Ruins Hunter in his sixties with a white beard and half-moon glasses, who sits at the head of the trust's table when the volunteers decide what may be done to the site. He passed the exam late in life after reading the restorer's method.

**Speaking Style:** A careful, scholarly voice that weighs a question for a long time and answers it in one sentence.
**Combat Role:** a strong old Ruins Hunter who lifts stone for a living and fights only to protect a site
**Relationship Hook:** An old bearded scholar in a tweed jacket at the head of a long table, listening with an unlit pipe in his hand.
personality: Core: cautious; principled; slow to decide
Quirk: privately doubting

npcs.name: Halvard Oake
npcs.info:
The keeper of the radio mast on the higher ridge, a gaunt, bespectacled man who changes the batteries, reads the weather recorder's paper drum and sends the island's weather to the mainland twice a day. He hikes up and down the ridge in all weathers and is said to own one shirt in six identical copies.

**Speaking Style:** Careful, nasal and exact, a radio man's voice that spells out call signs and distrusts rounding.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy battery and a lot of steel cable
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt man in thick glasses staring up a steel mast at a humming stay, clipboard trembling.
personality: Core: exact to the decimal; talks in call signs and figures; keeps his weather log better than anyone alive
Quirk: afraid of heights and ashamed of it

npcs.name: Ham Ok-nyo
npcs.info:
A rice farmer of the collective, a wiry woman in her forties with a straw hat on a cord, sleeves tied back and mud to the knee, who works the paddies by day and keeps the collective's accounts by lamplight. She is quiet, quick and fair, and the other families bring their quarrels to her rather than to the chairman.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, steady and practical, a farm woman who talks while her hands keep working.
**Combat Role:** none; a sickle and the strength of a woman who plants rice all day
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry farm woman in a straw hat standing in the doorway of a flooded barn, looking at the water and not the road.
personality: Core: quiet and steady; fair to everyone, generous to children; afraid of nothing except hunger
Quirk: keeps her secrets in her head

npcs.name: Hanne
npcs.info:
A hazel-gatherer of sixteen who comes to the thicket every autumn with a sack and a hooked stick, and swears she can cross the tangle without snapping a single twig. She has never managed it.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and teasing, a girl who laughs at her own clumsiness and every snapped twig.
**Combat Role:** none; a girl with a hooked stick who runs
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled girl in the hazel with a sack over her shoulder, freezing at the sound of her own footstep.
personality: Core: playful and curious; keeps little treasures; brave until something moves
Quirk: clumsy and cheerful

npcs.name: Hanne Bell
npcs.info:
The night volunteer at the foundlings' door, a young woman who sleeps sitting up on the bench with a blanket ready across her knees. When the bell rings she is outside before it stops, and the baby she carries in belongs to the city from that moment.

**Speaking Style:** Hushed and soothing, pitched for a sleeping baby, never louder than a lullaby.
**Combat Role:** none; she gathers up the child and runs for the shrine door
**Relationship Hook:** A sleepy young woman on a bench by a door, a blanket across her knees and one hand already on the latch.
personality: Core: wakes at a whisper; will not look down the road after whoever left a child; rocks on her heels when she stands
Quirk: names every baby after a star until the caretakers choose

npcs.name: Hannelore Duss
npcs.info:
The dispatcher of the coach terminal, a heavy-set woman in a brown uniform cardigan who has sent coaches out and taken them in for twenty years. Her office window looks onto the waiting room, where a broken television shows fights through a snowstorm of static.

**Speaking Style:** Weary and steady, a dispatcher who has explained every delay on the continent and believes none of them.
**Combat Role:** none; a dispatcher's office with a lock, a phone and the coach drivers' union
**Relationship Hook:** A tired dispatcher behind an office window, phone at her ear, while a crowd waits under a television full of static.
personality: Core: patient and tired; fair to everyone; thumps the television when it fails
Quirk: keeps lost things

npcs.name: Hanse
npcs.info:
A dark-skinned man of middle height with heavy brows and a big rounded nose, in a plain tank top, trousers and boots. He leads a team of three and keeps the inn's back room for counting the team's cards behind a bolted door.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and wary, a team leader who sounds calm until the bad news is about him.
**Combat Role:** a cautious player who keeps a spell between himself and any fight
**Relationship Hook:** A dark-skinned man in a tank top staring at his own palm as if it belonged to someone else.
personality: Core: careful; checks who holds what before a plan; hates fights with weapons in them
Quirk: frets when the danger is personal

npcs.name: Hanzo
npcs.info:
A bald young ninja from Jappon, applicant 294, in a black shirt with padded shoulders, a red neckerchief and bandaged wrists and ankles. He has trained in ninjutsu every day of his eighteen years and is fast, strong and very good, and he cannot stop talking about it. He wants to be a Hunter to find a legendary hermit's scroll hidden in a country closed to ordinary people.

**Speaking Style:** A loud, chatty young man's voice, boastful and cheerful, that keeps forgetting a ninja is supposed to keep quiet.
**Combat Role:** ninjutsu of the hidden-cloud school, speed, hidden blades and a torturer's knowledge
**Relationship Hook:** A bald young ninja crouched on a branch above the applicants, talking loudly about how silent he is.
personality: Core: talkative, boastful and cheerful; cold and focused when the work demands; honest in his own fashion
Quirk: overconfident and gives too much away

npcs.name: Harbormaster
npcs.info:
A stocky man in a button-up shirt with a long collar, a flat captain's hat and a wristwatch, with coral-like antlers growing from his head, pointed ears, slitted eyes and hairy arms. He decides who may leave the island from its only port, and a ticket comes from him by bribe or by beating him.

**Speaking Style:** Grasping and changeable, a harbourmaster's grumble that names a different fare every morning.
**Combat Role:** a burly brawler who expects to win and goes down to a real fighter
**Relationship Hook:** An antlered harbourmaster leaning back in his chair and telling a boy the fare has gone up today.
personality: Core: greedy; guards the way out; folds to force
Quirk: mercurial

npcs.name: Harlan Mosby
npcs.info:
A licensed Hunter in a rumpled brown suit and reading glasses who sits behind the permit counter of Yorknew City Hall every auction season, checking the papers of auction houses and street dealers for the city. The rest of the Hunters laugh at a Temp Hunter doing clerk's work; he laughs with them and keeps cashing the cheques.

**Speaking Style:** Patient and a little worn, a civil servant's voice that has explained the same form ten thousand times.
**Combat Role:** a trained Hunter gone soft behind a desk; he blocks, grapples and talks the room down
**Relationship Hook:** A tired man in reading glasses stamping a permit behind a glass window, a queue curling away behind the applicant.
personality: Core: patient; quietly keeps records; will not pick a fight he cannot win
Quirk: dry self-mockery

npcs.name: Harriet Coyle
npcs.info:
The schoolteacher of the settlement school, a plain, sturdy woman of fifty who came to teach for a year and stayed twenty. Most of the runway families' children learned their letters at her desks, and their mothers confide in her as in nobody else.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, patient and plain-spoken, a teacher who never raises her voice and never needs to.
**Combat Role:** none; she stands between a child and the danger and does not move
**Relationship Hook:** A sturdy teacher at a blackboard looking at an empty desk, chalk still in her hand.
personality: Core: never raises her voice; remembers every pupil she ever taught; brings bread for the children who come hungry
Quirk: stubborn as a mule when a child is in trouble

npcs.name: Haruna
npcs.info:
A single mother in one of NGL's villages, with long plum-coloured hair in a ponytail, a peach dress and a green shirt over it. She raises two children alone, a serious boy and a little girl who follows him everywhere. She lives the natural life the country asks for and wants nothing from the world outside.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and tired, a mother's voice that keeps steady for the children and breaks when they are out of hearing.
**Combat Role:** none; a villager who hides her children and runs
**Relationship Hook:** A woman at a village door calling two children in from the forest's edge.
personality: Core: warm and hard-working; devoted to her children; quiet in her grief
Quirk: accepts what she loves whatever shape it takes

npcs.name: Haruomi
npcs.info:
The captain of the family's private airship, a tall butler with a neat beard and a captain's cap worn with the black suit. His crew are butlers who learned to fly under him, and he can have the ship off the mast within minutes of an order from the mansion.

**Speaking Style:** Rich, steady and carrying, the voice of a ship's captain giving orders over the wind without ever shouting.
**Combat Role:** a butler's Nen and a captain's knowledge of a gondola's every handhold
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded butler in a captain's cap on a windy mooring mast, signalling to the crew of a sleek black airship.
personality: Core: calm in any weather; proud of his crew; never asks the family a question
Quirk: invents a new company name for each flight and keeps the list

npcs.name: Hatsuse
npcs.info:
The keeper of the Zoldyck kennels, a lean, weathered woman in a rubber apron over her butler's suit, with the sleeves rolled back from forearms crossed with old scars. She cuts the meat, hoses the pens and walks the rule sheet every morning, and she has kept her post for longer than any keeper before her.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, dry and low, a woman who talks to people the way she talks to dogs: short sentences and no tone to read.
**Combat Role:** none she trusts against her charges; a butler's reflexes, a cleaver and a fast retreat
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in a rubber apron hosing out a pen while Mike, the size of a truck, watches her from the back of it.
personality: Core: moves at exactly the same pace every day; dry about danger, careful about habit; has no patience for visitors who want to pet anything
Quirk: talks to the dogs under her breath

npcs.name: Heavens Arena 200th Floor Clerk
npcs.info:
The clerk at the registration desk on Heavens Arena's two hundredth floor, a young woman with lilac hair to the shoulder, sleepy violet eyes and painted nails, in the arena's referee uniform. She explains the rules of the floor to newcomers and warns them they must register by midnight or lose their place.

**Speaking Style:** Sleepy and flat, a clerk reciting the rules on autopilot.
**Combat Role:** none; a clerk with a deadline and a pen
**Relationship Hook:** A sleepy-eyed clerk at the far end of a corridor telling two boys they have until midnight.
personality: Core: calm and professional; explains the rules precisely; oblivious to aura
Quirk: sleepy-looking

npcs.name: Hector Abernathy
npcs.info:
The owner of Ringwear Outfitters, a big, limping man of fifty who held a room on the 160s until his left knee gave out. He sells everything a fighter wears, wraps, tape, shoes and school uniforms, and tells every customer how to tie their laces properly.

**Speaking Style:** Big-voiced and friendly, an ex-fighter who sells shoes like he is coaching a corner.
**Combat Role:** a retired hundreds fighter's heavy hands, slowed by a bad knee
**Relationship Hook:** A big ginger-bearded shopkeeper in a knee brace measuring a small boy for a white uniform at a counter of wraps.
personality: Core: hearty and helpful; gossips about injuries; ties customers' laces for them
Quirk: limps and jokes about it

npcs.name: Hector Lund
npcs.info:
A road maintenance man of forty-four who looks after thirty miles of the desert road from a hut by the culvert, clearing sand off the tarmac after storms and patching potholes. He is quiet, methodical and happy in his own company.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and measured, a road worker who explains everything in terms of drainage.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides in the culvert pipe, which nobody thinks to search
**Relationship Hook:** A road worker in an orange hard hat shovelling sand off a culvert road between two dunes.
personality: Core: explains everything through drainage; clears the road before he eats; likes his own company more than anyone's
Quirk: never reports a stain

npcs.name: Hedda
npcs.info:
The head weaver of the sheds, a lean old woman who has worked a hand loom since she was eight and can tell flax from nettle by the sound of the shuttle. Her sheds cut the rough tunics handed to every visitor at the border, by the hundred, in three sizes she admits fit nobody.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and loud over the clack of the looms, a head weaver who scolds and jokes in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a weaver with a shuttle and a sharp tongue
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman at a hand loom, not stopping the shuttle as she asks you your size.
personality: Core: brisk and bossy; proud of her craft; keeps count of everything
Quirk: laughs loudest at her own jokes

npcs.name: Hedda Achterberg
npcs.info:
The captain of the airport police, a tall, lean woman of forty-five with cropped iron hair, who came up through the city's traffic division and was sent out here, everyone says, to be forgotten. She runs her barracks honestly and is outnumbered in every way that matters.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, clipped and impatient, a captain who gives orders as if each one had already been disobeyed once.
**Combat Role:** a trained police officer; a service pistol drawn fast and a baton, and a radio that calls a dozen jeeps
**Relationship Hook:** A lean captain with cropped grey hair standing before a pinned map of the airport perimeter, a radio handset in hand.
personality: Core: gives orders twice; stays late every night; despises the families and fears for her officers
Quirk: honest to the point of rudeness

npcs.name: Hedda Brusk
npcs.info:
The cook who runs the warders' canteen, a round woman with flour on her forearms and a radio always on behind her counter. She feeds three shifts of guards a day and knows every one of their families.

**Speaking Style:** Bustling and motherly, full of questions about whether anyone has eaten.
**Combat Role:** none; a cook who would throw a ladle and run for the guards
**Relationship Hook:** A plump cook in a kerchief ladling soup behind a canteen counter, a radio playing on the shelf behind her.
personality: Core: warm; nosy; feeds anyone who looks hungry
Quirk: discreet where it counts

npcs.name: Hedda Lindqvist
npcs.info:
The owner of Dentora Hot Springs, a round, rosy woman in a blue cotton robe who runs the bathhouse, the tea counter and the outdoor pools with the help of two nieces. She swears the water cures backs, nerves and broken hearts.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and motherly, an innkeeper's voice that fusses over towels and gossip in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a wooden bucket and a loud voice for her nieces
**Relationship Hook:** A rosy woman in a cotton robe tasting a ladle of spring water, frowning.
personality: Core: fusses over guests; never asks the butlers anything; gossips about everyone else
Quirk: tastes the water every morning

npcs.name: Hedda Moss
npcs.info:
A small, brown, wrinkled woman in a waxed hat who fishes the forest river bend nearly every day and has done for fifty years. She sits so still on the gravel bar that foxbears come down to drink a stone's throw from her, and she talks to them as she would to neighbours.

**Speaking Style:** Low, slow and amused, an old angler's voice that never startles anything, fish or person.
**Combat Role:** none; total stillness and the patience to be overlooked by anything with teeth
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old angler on a gravel bar while a big foxbear drinks a few yards away.
personality: Core: talks to foxbears like neighbours; keeps children's secrets and animals' too; says more with a nod than a sentence
Quirk: sits still enough that animals forget her

npcs.name: Hedda Sieve
npcs.info:
A sorter of the scavenger lanes, sitting on an upturned bucket among piles of glass, cloth, metal and the unclassifiable, shaking the small finds through a mesh sieve. She can sort a cartload before noon and tell you what every piece used to be.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and musing, an unhurried sorter's murmur, naming things as her hands find them.
**Combat Role:** none; she flings a sieve of grit into a face and shouts the lane awake
**Relationship Hook:** A thin woman on an upturned bucket shaking a mesh sieve, sorted piles rising around her.
personality: Core: sorts while she talks and never looks down; hums the radio's evening song; names what a piece once was
Quirk: gives everything away

npcs.name: Hedwig Brandt
npcs.info:
A licensed Ruins Hunter of thirty-four, tall and sun-browned, with a surveyor's tripod over her shoulder and a notebook of mine plans older than the city. She is surveying the old silver camp for a museum in the city and sleeps in the ruined bank, which has the only roof left.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, amused and unhurried, a Hunter who talks about danger as if it were weather.
**Combat Role:** an Enhancer's blows and a surveyor's pick, with a Ten that turns a bullet into a bruise
**Relationship Hook:** A tall, sun-browned Hunter with a tripod over her shoulder nailing a survey tag to a fallen headframe.
personality: Core: talks about danger as if it were weather; sleeps in a ruined bank; maps everything she sees
Quirk: curious past the point of good sense

npcs.name: Henrik Dobrev
npcs.info:
A farmer whose fields line the back road to Parasta, a big, slow-moving man with a red face and a tractor that is older than he is. He spends half his days mending the fence where drivers dodging the roadworks clip his gate.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, slow and good-natured, a farmer's voice that always has a joke ready about the weather.
**Combat Role:** none; a farmer's strong hands and a fencing hammer
**Relationship Hook:** A big red-faced farmer at a farm gate waving a hammer at a black car racing past.
personality: Core: talks to anyone who stops; fixes the same fence without complaint; jokes about the weather
Quirk: waves at every car

npcs.name: Henrik Strand
npcs.info:
The captain of the watch that keeps the road, a hard, quiet man who has written in the book of arrivals longer than any watcher alive. He reads every name in it once to each new watcher, so that nobody who came down the road is ever forgotten.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, low and controlled, orders delivered as flat facts behind the mask.
**Combat Role:** a disciplined watch captain who holds the road with a shotgun and a line of masked neighbours, and fights to the last on it
**Relationship Hook:** A tall masked captain with a shotgun across his back, writing a name into a thick book by the glow of a radio.
personality: Core: never takes off his mask before an outsider; speaks only in orders on duty; keeps the radio on even while he sleeps
Quirk: reads the arrivals book aloud to new watchers

npcs.name: Hessa Moor
npcs.info:
An elder of the Assembly, a small woman wrapped in grey with a face so lined it seems carved, who speaks last in every debate and is listened to most. Residents who cannot get a hearing anywhere else bring their case to her seat in the circle.

**Speaking Style:** Very quiet and very old, each word set down like a stone, so that the room leans in to hear.
**Combat Role:** an elder who never fights herself; one word from her and a hundred masked residents stand up
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny elder wrapped in grey sitting very still in a circle of seats, the one the whole room is watching.
personality: Core: remembers every vote the circle has taken; never raises her voice; weighs a child's word as heavily as an elder's
Quirk: speaks last and briefly

npcs.name: Hilde Brunner
npcs.info:
A market gardener on the plain south of the town, a broad, sun-browned widow of fifty who grows the tomatoes and peppers the tower's restaurants serve. She sets her working day by the tower's lights going off in the morning and runs the greenhouses with her two sons.

**Speaking Style:** Plain and practical, a farmer who talks about tomatoes and sons in the same worried breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a farmer with a hoe, a farm lorry and a son who fights better than she would like
**Relationship Hook:** A sun-browned farmer in a headscarf carrying a crate of tomatoes through a greenhouse, the tower on the skyline behind.
personality: Core: practical and stubborn; worries without stopping work; proud of her sons
Quirk: talks to her plants

npcs.name: Hinrigh Biganduffno
npcs.info:
The underboss of the Xi-Yu Family, a lean man with long, wavy fair hair, upturned brows, pale eyes with tiny pupils and black makeup circling his eyes. He takes on fieldwork himself, carries the authority to pass into the ship's highest tiers, and bears a grudge against the Heil-Ly Family's boss for breaking the code that binds Kakin's Mafia.

**Speaking Style:** A smooth, confident, mocking voice with a sadist's relish, that turns cold and formal when it speaks of a family's code.
**Combat Role:** a conjurer's weapons reinforced against bullets and thrown knives
**Relationship Hook:** A lean man with black-ringed eyes smiling as two rival gangsters glance his way in a crowded passage.
personality: Core: confident and responsible; holds to the Mafia's code; observant of the smallest glance
Quirk: sadistic in elaborate ways

npcs.name: Hisashi
npcs.info:
The beacon watcher on the bald hill, a mild, round-faced man who sleeps by day in a turf hut and watches by night with a spyglass, ready to put a torch to the great stack of wood and tar the moment the next hill shows a flame. He was a boy when he last saw it burn.

**Speaking Style:** A watcher's mild, sleepy voice, slow to start and in no hurry to finish.
**Combat Role:** none; a watcher who lights the fire and runs
**Relationship Hook:** A round-faced watcher beside a huge stacked bonfire, a spyglass to one eye and a torch unlit at his feet.
personality: Core: mild and sleepy; conscientious about small rules; lonely on his hill
Quirk: waits for orders

npcs.name: Hishita
npcs.info:
A young butler of the Zoldyck Family with short light blond hair, in the black suit the whole staff wears. He is one of the estate's regular drivers and does what the senior butlers tell him promptly and without comment. When Gotoh plays one of his games with visitors, he stands at the back of the room and keeps his face empty.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and even, a junior butler's voice that answers in as few words as the order needs and never offers an opinion of its own.
**Combat Role:** a trained butler's speed and strength, and a car driven as a weapon when that is the order
**Relationship Hook:** A young butler polishing a black limousine until he can see his own blank face in the door.
personality: Core: obedient, quick to carry out an order; keeps his face still while he is being tested; defers to Gotoh in everything
Quirk: talks to engines more freely than to people

npcs.name: Hisoka Morow
npcs.info:
A tall, muscular man dressed like a jester, with a star painted on one cheek and a teardrop on the other, who throws playing cards that cut like razors. He fights for the pleasure of fighting strong people and kills those who bore him, and he spares the promising ones, especially children, to let them ripen into worthy opponents. Last year he was thrown out of the exam for nearly killing an examiner. He is the fourth member of the Phantom Troupe, and he enjoys everything.

**Speaking Style:** A silky, lilting, amused voice that purrs and sing-songs, savouring words like food; it never hurries and it always sounds pleased.
**Combat Role:** razor playing cards, impossible flexibility, and aura that sticks and stretches like gum
**Relationship Hook:** A painted jester smiling at a boy with a fishing rod, a playing card turning slowly between his fingers.
personality: Core: playful, theatrical and utterly self-serving; spares the promising and kills the dull; keeps his word only when it amuses him
Quirk: calls strong young fighters his unripe fruit

npcs.name: Ho Sang-bom
npcs.info:
The oldest judge of the national Gungi hall, a stooped, white-haired man with a magnifying glass on a ribbon who has refereed tournaments for forty years. He keeps the hall's record room and sits at its desk under a green-shaded lamp, copying every important game into bound books in a tiny, perfect hand. He is unimpressed by everyone but one player.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and dry, an old referee's voice that weighs a move before it speaks of it and never praises one twice.
**Combat Role:** none; an old judge with a cane and a long memory
**Relationship Hook:** An old judge under a green lamp, copying a Gungi game into a fat bound book with a brush.
personality: Core: unimpressed and exacting; contemptuous of officials who play; keeps his own counsel for days at a time
Quirk: reverent about one player alone

npcs.name: Hobb Marley
npcs.info:
The island's constable, a big, slow, kindly man with a helmet he rarely wears and a bicycle he rarely rides, who solves most trouble by talking to someone's mother. His cell is mostly a bed for visiting crewmen who drank too much, and he brings them tea in the morning.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and drawling, a country policeman's voice that never hurries and always gets there.
**Combat Role:** a big policeman with a truncheon and a grip he uses instead of it
**Relationship Hook:** A big kindly constable at a desk under a blue lamp, typing slowly with two fingers.
personality: Core: never hurries and never gives up; brings tea to his prisoners; keeps one case open for years
Quirk: talks to the mother before the son

npcs.name: Hollin
npcs.info:
In town she is a tall, sharp-faced woman with a long plait who sells mushrooms at the harbour gate; in the pinewood she is a Kiriko, tall, fox-faced and clawed, who walks upright and watches the paths from the dark. She is kin to the family at the lone pine and keeps the forest's lower paths for them.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, amused voice that seems to come from somewhere a little to the left of where she stands.
**Combat Role:** claws and deception in the dark, striking from the branches and gone before the answer comes
**Relationship Hook:** A tall fox-faced shape on a branch over the ravine, asking a lost applicant a riddle in a pleasant woman's voice.
personality: Core: clever and well read; enjoys testing people; patient as a hunting fox
Quirk: fond of anyone who surprises her

npcs.name: Hollis Draper
npcs.info:
The owner of the lone filling station on the coast road, a lean man in a cap and overalls who pumps fuel, sells cigarettes and keeps a shotgun under the counter for whoever comes through at night.

**Speaking Style:** A slow, wary drawl that stays polite as long as both of a customer's hands are visible.
**Combat Role:** a shotgun from behind the counter, and only when someone reaches first
**Relationship Hook:** A lean man in oil-stained overalls behind a filling-station counter, one hand resting out of sight beneath it.
personality: Core: polite; dangerous when pushed; a good neighbour
Quirk: wary

npcs.name: Hollis Grieve
npcs.info:
The chief of the tower's guards, a square-jawed former army sergeant with a grey crew cut and a radio on each hip. He runs forty men in grey uniforms, throws out drunks, confiscates the weapons people try to carry below the 200th floor and watches the whole building on a wall of small screens.

**Speaking Style:** Short sentences, no wasted words, a former soldier who gives orders in the same tone he orders coffee.
**Combat Role:** an ex-soldier's baton, cuffs and a takedown, with forty guards behind the radio
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired security chief with his arms folded before a wall of small screens, one of them showing a strange haze.
personality: Core: disciplined and blunt; protective of his men; obeys orders he dislikes
Quirk: taps the screen when something is wrong

npcs.name: Hollis Varga
npcs.info:
A lean, sunburnt lorry driver in his forties with a drooping moustache, a baseball cap and a cab that smells of diesel and oranges. He runs travellers out to the border stop of NGL and back, sleeps in his cab between runs, and asks only for a reason and the fare.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and rough, a long-haul driver's drawl that names a fare and a road and nothing else.
**Combat Role:** none; a tyre iron and a lorry that does not stop for anyone standing in the road
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt lorry driver in a red cap chalking a departure time on a board in a gravel yard full of lorries.
personality: Core: asks no questions; keeps his word on a pickup time; superstitious about the border road
Quirk: counts who comes back

npcs.name: Hollis Whistle
npcs.info:
The neighbour who has sat on the crate at the busiest crossing of the inner zones for longer than most of the children here have been alive. He wears his mask high, watches every face that turns the corner, and blows the whistle on his string twice for a stranger and three times for a stranger walking with a child.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and clipped behind the mask, every sentence an instruction, softening only when he talks to a child.
**Combat Role:** a heavy man who blocks a lane with his body, sounds the whistle and holds on until the street arrives
**Relationship Hook:** A heavyset masked man on a crate at a crossing, whistle halfway to his lips as a stranger turns the corner.
personality: Core: counts heads at the water queue without meaning to; eats on the crate rather than leave it; gentle with any child, curt with any adult
Quirk: whistles before he speaks

npcs.name: Hollowmouth
npcs.info:
A grey-pelted old ape with a long, thin body and a face that looks almost exactly like a starved, frightened man's, who sits in the dead tree on the rim of the hollow. The reed-cutters of the marsh have a name for him and will not say it aloud.

**Speaking Style:** A breathy, wheedling voice that can sound like a lost man, and under it a wet growl.
**Combat Role:** an ambusher who lures prey close with a man's face and voice and lets the troop drag it down
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt grey ape with a man's frightened face crouched in a dead tree, calling for help in a voice that is almost right.
personality: Core: cunning and patient; leads from behind; flees from anything that does not fall for the trick
Quirk: mimics human cries

npcs.name: Hotaka
npcs.info:
The summit lookout, a wiry, sun-browned butler who spends most of her days on the crater rim with binoculars and a radio. She reports the weather for the estate's airship and anything that moves on the slopes below, and she is happier in the cold than anyone else on the mountain.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and unhurried, warmed by long hours alone in the wind; she talks about the weather the way other people talk about friends.
**Combat Role:** a mountaineer's balance and a butler's Nen; she uses height and wind before she uses her hands
**Relationship Hook:** A butler in a padded jacket on a crater rim above the clouds, binoculars raised, a hawk on the rock beside her.
personality: Core: at ease alone; names the clouds; reports exactly what she sees and no more
Quirk: feeds a wild hawk against the rules

npcs.name: Hou Dacheng
npcs.info:
A sergeant of the railway police who works the night platform, where the slow trains from the interior come in before dawn. He is heavy, unhurried and fond of tea from the platform urn, and every Have-Not who steps down from a sleeper carriage has to pass his torch.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and patient, a night-shift policeman who chats while he reads your papers and never stops reading.
**Combat Role:** a heavy railway policeman with a truncheon, a whistle and a radio that brings ten more
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy railway policeman reading a labourer's papers by torchlight beside a steaming night train.
personality: Core: reads papers with a torch even under the lamps; takes his tea black and scalding; has never once refused a parcel
Quirk: calls everyone younger than him 'little brother'

npcs.name: Hsu Lianqiao
npcs.info:
A palace attendant assigned to the princes' private pool and screening lounge, a graceful young woman who folds towels, mixes drinks and switches the projector on for whichever prince arrives. She was chosen for the post because she belongs to none of the queens' households.

**Speaking Style:** Light, sweet and careful, an attendant's chatter that says nothing anyone could repeat.
**Combat Role:** none; she dives into the pool and stays under
**Relationship Hook:** A graceful attendant laying out towels beside a glowing indoor pool, smiling at two guards who will not look at each other.
personality: Core: chatters without saying anything; learns each prince's drink by heart; never stands between two guards
Quirk: takes every gift, gives nothing back

npcs.name: Hu Lianshan
npcs.info:
An upland herder's son who carries the zoological agency's tracking licence, lean and sun-dark, with a rifle he has never fired at anything bigger than a wolf. He knows the high grassland's storms better than the weather office and goes up the ridges when every other herder comes down.

**Speaking Style:** Few words, low and unhurried, a tracker who answers a question with a direction.
**Combat Role:** an upland tracker with a rifle and a knife, who wins by being where the beast is not looking
**Relationship Hook:** A lean upland tracker crouched by a ring of old fire pits, turning a cooked bone in his hand.
