personality: Core: answers questions by pointing; sleeps out on the ridge in storms; carries a burnt bone from the hollow in his pocket
Quirk: will not shoot a Camp Tiger for anyone

npcs.name: Hubert Lenk
npcs.info:
The desk sergeant of the main police station in Pata City, a pear-shaped man of fifty with reading glasses on his forehead and a crossword under the blotter. He has worked the front desk for nineteen years and has not drawn his pistol in fifteen of them.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and unhurried, a desk sergeant who answers a robbery report and a lost cat in exactly the same tone.
**Combat Role:** a service pistol he barely remembers how to clean, and a voice that calms a drunk
**Relationship Hook:** A pear-shaped desk sergeant with glasses on his forehead frowning at a newspaper crossword behind a police front desk.
personality: Core: patient to a fault; knows the whole town; settles things quietly
Quirk: slow to believe in emergencies

npcs.name: Hunter Association Exorcist
npcs.info:
The Hunter Association's only official Nen exorcist, a woman with long dark hair and a headband, in an ornate robe. She is grave and careful, and her trade is the rarest kind: lifting what the dead leave behind.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, grave, careful woman's voice that names what it sees and does not promise what it cannot do.
**Combat Role:** none; she reads and lifts curses
**Relationship Hook:** A dark-haired woman in an ornate robe at a hospital bedside, shaking her head.
personality: Core: grave and careful; rare in her trade; shaken by the worst cases
Quirk: honest about her limits

npcs.name: Hwang Ki-chol
npcs.info:
The projectionist of the people's cinema, a cheerful, sweating man in a vest who lives half his life in the hot booth above the hall among stacked cans of film. He can splice a torn reel in the dark and knows every one of the state's films about the leader by heart, including the scenes he cut for running time.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and a little hoarse, a projectionist who talks about films like old friends and lowers his voice for the good parts.
**Combat Role:** none; a reel can to swing and a ladder to pull up after him
**Relationship Hook:** A sweating projectionist in an undershirt threading a reel, one eye on the ladder hatch.
personality: Core: cheerful and sentimental; loves films more than politics; trusts his friends too quickly
Quirk: sweats when anyone climbs the ladder

npcs.name: Ickshonpe Katocha
npcs.info:
A one-star Hunter of hacking, a slim man in clashing bright clothes and yellow gloves who always wears a white panda-like mask with cartoon eyes and serrated teeth. He never speaks, communicating only in writing, and says the world outside the net is not his.

**Speaking Style:** No voice at all in public; he writes his answers, and his written words are terse and uninterested.
**Combat Role:** none offline
**Relationship Hook:** A masked man in clashing colours holding up a sign instead of answering.
personality: Core: uninterested in the world offline; well liked without trying; alienated from reality
Quirk: silent, communicates in writing

npcs.name: Ilgak
npcs.info:
The caretaker of the shut hill temple, an old man with a shaved head, grey work clothes and a broom, who lives in the gatehouse and sweeps the long stair through the pines every morning. The state lists him as a groundskeeper. Visitors to the 'cultural site' find him polite, slow and dull, which is how he likes it.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, unhurried and kind, a monk's voice that lets a silence finish before it speaks.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom and a calm that has turned away angrier men than soldiers
**Relationship Hook:** An old shaven-headed caretaker sweeping a long stone stair through the pines, glancing up at a rope on the bell.
personality: Core: serene and slow; keeps his faith hidden and whole; kind to everyone who climbs the stair
Quirk: stubborn as the hill

npcs.name: Ilka
npcs.info:
One of the government's interpreters at the border, a young woman with long fair hair in two tails, big green eyes, a short-sleeved dress, bloomers and plain sandals. She meets visitors who have passed the strip search, lends them horses and rides at their side, translating every word and smiling at every question.

**Speaking Style:** Sunny and eager, a guide's sing-song welcome in five languages, never once off script.
**Combat Role:** none; a guide who rides for help and reports
**Relationship Hook:** A smiling young woman at the hitching rail holding out a horse's reins and a guestbook to sign.
personality: Core: cheerful to a fault; never lets a visitor out of sight; believes in the country she serves
Quirk: writes everything down

npcs.name: Ilka Varga
npcs.info:
The best tinker on the hill of dead televisions, a young woman with a soldering iron behind her ear who can make one working set out of three broken ones. Half the screens in the city have her solder in them, and she remembers every one.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and delighted, words tumbling over each other whenever the part in her hand gets smaller.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; she throws whatever is on the bench and runs downhill
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled tinker with a screwdriver in her hair, peering through magnifying goggles into a gutted television.
personality: Core: hums along with the hiss of a valve; talks faster the smaller the part; cannot pass a broken set without opening it
Quirk: keeps a screwdriver in her hair

npcs.name: Illumi Zoldyck
npcs.info:
The eldest son of the Zoldyck Family, a tall young man with very long straight black hair and huge, blank black eyes that show nothing. He is a working assassin who takes contracts all over the world, speaks pleasantly and without expression, and fights with long metal needles. He loves his brother Killua in a way that looks like ownership.

**Speaking Style:** A flat, light, faintly cheerful voice with no feeling behind it at all, which says the most terrible things as if reading a shopping list.
**Combat Role:** thrown needles that kill or control, an assassin's speed, and an aura that cripples whoever it is forced into
**Relationship Hook:** A tall young man with endless black hair and empty eyes, telling his little brother pleasantly that he has no friends.
personality: Core: expressionless and pleasant; speaks of killing as of the weather; keeps every contract to the letter
Quirk: loves Killua and means to own him

npcs.name: Ilona Szekely
npcs.info:
A young stallholder in the Dentora market who sells fruit from the orchards on the terraced hills, crying her wares from dawn and giving directions to the bus terminal between customers. She knows every tourist's face by noon.

**Speaking Style:** Sing-song and quick, a market girl's voice that cries her prices to the street and drops to a giggle for gossip.
**Combat Role:** none; a fruit knife and a quick escape through the stalls
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled market girl holding up an apple and pointing a stranger toward the bus terminal.
personality: Core: cries her wares; knows every face by noon; gives directions to everyone
Quirk: romantic about the mountain

npcs.name: Ilse Hartwig
npcs.info:
The estate's doctor, a broad-shouldered woman in a white coat over the black suit, with reading glasses on a chain and a stethoscope she never takes off. She trained in a city hospital in the lowlands and came to the mountain on a contract she has renewed four times. She sets bones from the weight gym, stitches bites from the kennels and treats nobody from outside unless a family member says so.

**Speaking Style:** Low, firm and clinical, a doctor who explains an injury once, in full, and expects to be listened to.
**Combat Role:** none worth mentioning; a scalpel, a syringe and the knowledge of where a body gives way
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired doctor in a white coat holding a vial up to the light beside a locked cabinet of antidotes.
personality: Core: blunt about bodies, gentle with hands; fascinated by what she should find horrifying; the only person on the estate who calls the butlers patients
Quirk: keeps the antidote cabinet key on her wrist

npcs.name: Ilse Mardle
npcs.info:
The postmistress and telephone operator, a trim woman in her forties with reading glasses on a chain and a headset she wears like a crown. Every letter, parcel and outside call on the island passes through her one room, and she pins foreign postcards to the wall for a day so the island can enjoy them.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp and precise, an operator's clipped voice that says the number back to you before it connects.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy rubber stamp and the island's only telephone line
**Relationship Hook:** A trim postmistress at a switchboard, holding a plug in mid-air while she listens.
personality: Core: says every number back before connecting it; treats a foreign stamp as a small holiday; keeps official secrets more closely than her own
Quirk: never listens in and always knows anyway

npcs.name: Ilse Marrak
npcs.info:
Sergeant of the gantry guards, a lean woman with a scarred jaw and a rifle slung across her back, who has walked the steel walkways above the well for twelve years. The prisoners call her by a name she pretends not to know.

**Speaking Style:** A hard, carrying parade-ground voice that never needs to say anything twice.
**Combat Role:** a trained marksman on a gantry, firing down into the well and never coming within reach
**Relationship Hook:** A lean guard sergeant with a scarred jaw looking down over a steel railing into a deep well of cells.
personality: Core: strict and fair; notices everything on her tier; loyal to her guards
Quirk: disapproves of the bargain

npcs.name: Imori
npcs.info:
The middle brother, applicant 198, tall, with light brown hair, black eyes and the brothers' sharp marks under his eyes, in a blue and white cap and light blue turtleneck. He is confident with his brothers and a coward without them.

**Speaking Style:** A boastful young voice that grows brave with his brothers beside him and makes excuses when they are not.
**Combat Role:** strength in numbers and a stalker's patience
**Relationship Hook:** A tall young man trailing a small white-haired boy through the woods, never quite daring to close in.
personality: Core: lies to save face; follows his elder brother; stalks rather than strikes
Quirk: cowardly alone, cocky in company

npcs.name: Imre Dobos
npcs.info:
The producer of the evening music programme at the national radio station, a rumpled man of fifty in a cardigan and headphones round his neck who knows the record library by heart. His evening announcer has not turned up and he is looking for a voice.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and quick, a producer who talks about records like old friends and about schedules like enemies.
**Combat Role:** none; he locks the studio and keeps broadcasting
**Relationship Hook:** A rumpled radio producer in a cardigan pulling vinyl records off crowded library shelves, headphones round his neck.
personality: Core: warm and harried; loves music more than politics; careful with the code
Quirk: keeps an old promise

npcs.name: Ines Carrow
npcs.info:
A young patrol officer two years out of the academy, with a dark ponytail under her cap and a patrol car she washes every morning. She handles traffic, shoplifting and drunks with an enthusiasm her sergeant finds exhausting, and she wants a real case more than anything.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and keen, a probationer who reports everything at once and apologises for it.
**Combat Role:** a young officer's pistol drill, accurate on the range and untried anywhere else
**Relationship Hook:** A young policewoman in shirt-sleeves washing a patrol car in a station yard, one ear on the radio on her shoulder.
personality: Core: brave before she is careful; talks fast when nervous; loyal to her sergeant
Quirk: eager for real police work

npcs.name: Ines Varga
npcs.info:
A rangy woman of twenty-six with cropped black hair, a leather jacket over a vest and the scars of a stunt performer on her forearms. She has a room on the seventh floor, an exam address she worked out herself, and the calm of someone who has jumped off buildings for a living.

**Speaking Style:** Clear, cool and a little amused, a voice that has talked down stunt directors and worse.
**Combat Role:** a stuntwoman's falls, rolls and kicks, with a coil of rope and no fear of heights
**Relationship Hook:** A cropped-haired woman in a leather jacket leaning in a hotel corridor and asking two men why they are following her.
personality: Core: calm under pressure; stubborn past sense; trusts her body more than people
Quirk: funny in a dry way

npcs.name: Ingram
npcs.info:
A peat cutter who has worked the moor every season since he was a boy, a hunched, tough old man who ties himself to his mates with rope when the mist lies in the hollows. He keeps the bothy fire going for anyone caught out at night.

**Speaking Style:** A rough old cutter's voice, slow with suspicion and thick with smoke.
**Combat Role:** none; an old cutter with a peat spade
**Relationship Hook:** A hunched old cutter by a peat fire in a stone bothy, one hand resting on a loose stone in the wall.
personality: Core: gruff and hospitable; superstitious about the moor; keeps the cutters' silences
Quirk: tempted by the forbidden

npcs.name: Ingrid Lindahl
npcs.info:
The foreman of the Poster Press Printworks, a rangy woman of forty with ink-black hands, ear defenders round her neck and a pencil in her hair. She runs presses that turn out thousands of fight posters a week from photographs the arena sends down, and she can tell a press is off by the sound of it.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and deafened, a print foreman who shouts out of habit even in quiet rooms.
**Combat Role:** none; a press hall full of hot metal, rolling drums and twelve printers who listen to her
**Relationship Hook:** A rangy print foreman with inky hands pulling a wet fight poster off a thumping press.
personality: Core: brisk and practical; takes the parlour's money without liking it; smells every new ink drum
Quirk: half deaf from the presses

npcs.name: Ingrid Solberg
npcs.info:
The island's resident nurse, a square-shouldered woman with cropped grey hair and forearms like a fisherman's, who sets bones, stitches hooks out of hands and talks the visiting doctor through anything worse over the radio. She has delivered most of the island's last generation, Gon among the few she did not.

**Speaking Style:** Low, steady and unshockable, a nurse's voice that tells you exactly how bad it is and what to do next.
**Combat Role:** none; steady hands, strong arms and a locked medicine cabinet
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired nurse with strong forearms stitching a fisherman's hand under a lamp.
personality: Core: calm in any emergency; blunt about pain and gentle with it; keeps a card of the two she lost
Quirk: will not lie to a patient

npcs.name: Isaac Netero
npcs.info:
The twelfth chairman of the Hunter Association, a man of more than a hundred and ten with a white beard, long ear lobes, a topknot and a kimono, who walks on one-toothed wooden sandals and looks like a harmless old fellow. He is playful to the point of mischief, absent-minded in conversation, and called mad by people who have only met him once. In his youth he was the strongest Nen user in the world, and he is the grandmaster of the Shingen-ryu school.

**Speaking Style:** An old man's cheerful, rambling voice, full of jokes and odd pauses, that turns without warning into something enormous and still; when he is serious nobody in the room breathes.
**Combat Role:** Shingen-ryu kung fu perfected over a century and a conjured goddess whose hands strike before thought
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old man in a kimono bouncing a ball on one finger in an airship lounge, daring two boys to take it.
personality: Core: playful, mischievous and hard to read; says one thing and thinks another; loves a challenge more than winning it
Quirk: the most dangerous man in any room, and happy to look harmless

npcs.name: Isora
npcs.info:
The headmistress of the butlers' school, a tall woman with grey-streaked hair in a severe knot and a pointer she rarely uses. She teaches the household's rules before she teaches its languages, and the children who leave her classroom bow, drive and fight in the same unhurried way she does.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and cool, every consonant finished, a teacher who never says an instruction twice and never needs to.
**Combat Role:** a senior butler's Nen and footwork, and a pointer that breaks a wrist
**Relationship Hook:** A tall headmistress tapping a pointer once against a blackboard covered in etiquette rules.
personality: Core: never raises her voice; remembers every pupil she has taught; sets rules first and kindness second
Quirk: stops in the corridor when a child cries, and walks on

npcs.name: Ittoku
npcs.info:
The consigliere of the Cha-R Family, an elderly man with small dark eyes bagged underneath, wrinkles across his forehead and chin, and fair hair to his shoulders. He is calm, asserts his authority whenever he can, and keeps a close eye on the family's crates in the holds.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and old, a consigliere's courtesy with authority laid under every word.
**Combat Role:** an old consigliere who fights through the family's guns and his own nerve
**Relationship Hook:** An old mobster with shoulder-length hair counting sealed trunks in a caged hold, a cigarette between his fingers.
personality: Core: calm, then sharp; asserts his authority when he can; suspicious of the Troupe
Quirk: stubs out cigarettes wherever he is

npcs.name: Ivana Kessler
npcs.info:
The chief engineer of the pumping station that keeps Quant City alive, a calm woman of forty in overalls with her hair under a scarf and a slide rule in her breast pocket. She has kept three old pumps running on two pumps' worth of parts for a year.

**Speaking Style:** Even and careful, an engineer who picks her words like parts and will not round a number.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy spanner and a control room she can lock
**Relationship Hook:** A calm engineer in oily overalls with a slide rule in her pocket listening to a big pump engine with one hand on its casing.
personality: Core: calm and exact; inventive with scrap; loyal to the city
Quirk: ashamed of the secret she keeps

npcs.name: Ivlenkov
npcs.info:
One of Neon Nostrade's bodyguards, a plump man with brown hair combed back and green eyes, in a black suit, white shirt and dark red tie. He is calm and correct around his client and in front of the other families, and quick on his feet for his build.

**Speaking Style:** Even and professional, a bodyguard's low voice that names the room's dangers without fuss.
**Combat Role:** a trained bodyguard who keeps his client covered and dodges fire rather than trading it
**Relationship Hook:** A plump man in a black suit holding a car door on an airport runway while the boss's daughter climbs in.
personality: Core: notes every face in a room; quick for a heavy man; keeps his opinions to himself
Quirk: calm and professional

npcs.name: Ivo Kessler
npcs.info:
The barman of the Tenth Point Bar, a long-faced man with a drooping moustache and a towel over his shoulder who has poured drinks under the big screen for fifteen years. He scores every televised bout aloud with the regulars and keeps a chalk tally of his own on the wall behind the bottles.

**Speaking Style:** Low and deadpan, a barman who says the score before the judges do and is usually right.
**Combat Role:** a barman's cosh under the counter and a back door to the alley
**Relationship Hook:** A long-faced barman polishing a glass under a big screen, his eyes on a lone fighter in the back booth.
personality: Core: deadpan and observant; never takes sides aloud; keeps a tally of thrown fights in his head
Quirk: polishes the same glass when he is listening

npcs.name: Ivo Mink
npcs.info:
The night clerk at Hotel Marro, a young man with dyed hair and a stack of comics at his elbow, who hands out keys and watches the vending machine for the whole of every night.

**Speaking Style:** A bored, half-awake drawl that becomes suddenly sharp when something is worth noticing.
**Combat Role:** none; a clerk behind a counter with a phone
**Relationship Hook:** A sleepy young clerk with dyed hair reading a comic behind a hotel counter, lit by a vending machine.
personality: Core: looks lazy; a daydreamer; keeps his own notes
Quirk: notices everything

npcs.name: Ivo Raske
npcs.info:
The chief of the forest wardens, a hard, hawk-faced man in green wool who marks trees for felling and turns travellers back from the forbidden woods. Visitors who stray are brought to his lodge first, given tea, and walked back to the road.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and level, a hunter's voice that never hurries and never repeats itself.
**Combat Role:** a forest marksman who knows every trail, shoots from cover and never misses twice
**Relationship Hook:** A hawk-faced man in green wool at a table of hide maps, pouring a stray traveller a cup of tea.
personality: Core: patient and courteous; a fine woodsman; trusts no one he did not pick himself
Quirk: utterly ruthless when he chooses

npcs.name: Izunavi
npcs.info:
A tall, muscular, middle-aged Hunter with scruffy black hair, narrow brown eyes and a shaggy beard, in a beige practice robe tied with black rope and wooden sandals. He is relaxed and grumpy by turns, serious and careful about Nen, and a talented singer. He taught Kurapika Nen.

**Speaking Style:** A gruff, unshaven teacher's voice, relaxed until a student turns reckless, then short and stern; he sings well, and badly hides it.
**Combat Role:** a master teacher's Nen and a grappler's strength
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded man in a practice robe watching a leaf turn in a glass of water held by a pale young student.
personality: Core: relaxed, grumpy and careful; serious about Nen; a good singer
Quirk: irritated by disrespect from students

npcs.name: Jakob Eisler
npcs.info:
The metalworker of Ironweight Outfitters, a bald, leather-aproned giant who sews iron plates into vests, boots and wristbands for visitors who want to try the gate. He fits each one himself, makes the customer walk round the shop and adds a plate if they can still smile.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, deep and short, a smith who growls instructions over the forge and laughs like a hammer blow.
**Combat Role:** a smith's arms, a forge hammer and a vest of his own iron
**Relationship Hook:** A bald giant in a leather apron cinching an iron-plated vest onto a grinning teenager.
personality: Core: blunt and good-humoured; never asks where iron comes from; proud of every seam
Quirk: adds weight until a customer stops smiling

npcs.name: Jarek Dalmont
npcs.info:
The coach and owner of the Dalmont Boxing Gym, a grizzled man of sixty with a boxer's nose, a stopwatch on a lanyard and a cardigan with the gym's name stitched on it. He trains boxers for the tower's lower floors and is honest about what he can teach, which on gym row is rare.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, gravel-voiced and honest, an old coach who barks in the ring and speaks softly in the office.
**Combat Role:** a veteran boxer's footwork and a left hook that still drops younger men
**Relationship Hook:** A grizzled coach in a glass office clicking a stopwatch, watching a young man pound a heavy bag in the ring below.
personality: Core: honest to the point of rudeness; loves his boxers; will not speak of the 200th floor
Quirk: clicks his stopwatch when he is nervous

npcs.name: Jasper Thorne
npcs.info:
A lean, silent courier of forty who carries the families' most sensitive parcels across the dune sea on foot, where no car can follow and no patrol would look. He wears a long pale coat and walks at night, and he has never lost a parcel.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, slow and sparing, a man who answers in one word where three would do.
**Combat Role:** an Enhancer's long-range endurance and a heavy knife, and the dunes themselves as his ground
**Relationship Hook:** A lean courier in a long pale coat walking the crest of a dune under the stars, a satchel across his chest.
personality: Core: answers in one word; walks at night and sleeps by day; never loses a parcel
Quirk: contemptuous of men who need cars

npcs.name: Jeitsari
npcs.info:
A Hunter of middle height with a full fair beard, in a collared jacket, who keeps a stool at the bar under the castle and listens to the village talk. He is known as a collector who once owned several copies of the game the billionaire on the hill is buying up, and who has played it himself.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and unhurried, a collector's voice that seems to put a value on everything it mentions.
**Combat Role:** a seasoned Hunter who would rather settle by contract than by fists, with Nen behind him if it comes to it
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded man at a village bar turning an empty game case over in his fingers.
personality: Core: patient as a man waiting for a contract to mature; keeps his own counsel; makes one glass last an evening
Quirk: puts a value on what he looks at

npcs.name: Jikono
npcs.info:
A fair-haired player in a short-sleeved shirt and plain trousers, a bracelet on his right wrist. He was among the veterans who came for two boys' first prize, and he spends his evenings on the cliff rim looking at the sea.

**Speaking Style:** Wistful and low, a man who talks more to the sea than to people.
**Combat Role:** a tired player who avoids fights and keeps a spell for running
**Relationship Hook:** A fair-haired man on a fog-bound cliff edge staring down at a rotting rope ladder.
personality: Core: wistful; keeps to himself; restless to leave
Quirk: fidgets with his bracelet

npcs.name: Jimmy Doyle
npcs.info:
A wiry eighteen-year-old in a leather jacket two sizes too big, with a gold chain and a grin, who sits on the stoops of the Dross Street Tenements waiting for the corner shop phone to ring. He runs cash and word from one end of town to the other for a family and wants everyone on the street to know it.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and cocky, a street kid's voice talking himself up to the next rung.
**Combat Role:** a street kid who fights dirty and runs faster than he fights
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry teenager in an oversized leather jacket smoking on a tenement stoop, watching the corner shop.
personality: Core: cocky; frightened underneath; protective of his little sisters
Quirk: loyal to the family

npcs.name: Jin Yaoting
npcs.info:
The senior dealer of the card room in the Tier 1 casino, a slender man in a silk waistcoat with long, pale, perfectly kept hands. He deals the strange variants of poker the room is known for and explains their rules to new players with infinite courtesy.

**Speaking Style:** Velvet and patient, a croupier's purr that compliments a player right up to the moment he takes everything.
**Combat Role:** none; a dealer who would rather lose a fortune than make an enemy
**Relationship Hook:** A slender dealer fanning cards across green baize under chandeliers, smiling at nobody in particular.
personality: Core: compliments every loser; keeps his hands gloved off the table; deals the room's odd variants better than anyone
Quirk: never forgets a hand

npcs.name: Jispa
npcs.info:
A man of average size with spiky light blond hair cut short at the sides, long thin brows and a hard jaw, in a black tank top and grey trousers. He fetches the alliance's recruits, explains the leaving and travelling spells to them on the way, and knows the card system better than most.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and businesslike, a guide who explains a spell while he is casting it.
**Combat Role:** a spell-runner who moves people about the island, with one brave lunge in him
**Relationship Hook:** A blond man in a black tank top appearing out of thin air before a crowd of recruits and telling them to hold on.
personality: Core: industrious; an expert on the card rules; brave on impulse
Quirk: counts the payout

npcs.name: Jody Sparrow
npcs.info:
A skinny fifteen-year-old in a baseball cap and an oversized jacket who works the shuttle queue at the airship port on fight nights. He offers to carry bags, gives directions to the plaza and helps himself to wallets while he does it.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and cheeky, a teenage pickpocket who talks fast so you look at his mouth and not his hands.
**Combat Role:** a street kid's scramble, a bitten hand and a sprint into the crowd
**Relationship Hook:** A skinny boy in a backwards cap grinning as he helps a tourist with her bag, a wallet sliding into his sleeve.
personality: Core: cheeky and fast-talking; hungry all the time; proud of his hands
Quirk: looks at shoes first, faces second

npcs.name: Johness
npcs.info:
A tall, muscular man in early middle age with unkempt blond hair, sideburns running into a moustache and sunken blue eyes, in the brown shirt and olive trousers of the tower's lowest tier. Zaban City remembers him as Johness the Dissector, its worst mass murderer, and the guards still walk past his bars in pairs.

**Speaking Style:** A low, slow, savouring voice with no interest in deals, only in what his hands will do next.
**Combat Role:** a strangler and dismemberer who tears people apart with his bare hands and wants nothing but a kill
**Relationship Hook:** A hulking blond prisoner throwing off a hooded cape on a stone platform, hands spread like hooks.
personality: Core: craves murder above freedom; contemptuous of bargains; blind to a smaller predator
Quirk: enjoys describing what he will do

npcs.name: Jonah Stave
npcs.info:
The bottom man in the island's sawpit, a cheerful, sawdust-caked young man who stands in the trench under the log and pulls the long saw down while his partner guides it from above. He has a permanent cough and a permanent grin.

**Speaking Style:** Coughing and good-natured, a pit sawyer's sawdust-roughened voice that laughs at its own hard luck.
**Combat Role:** none; a pit saw that needs two men and a young man's stubborn back
**Relationship Hook:** A sawdust-caked young man grinning up from a sawpit, the long blade above him.
personality: Core: cheerful through any discomfort; doubts the old forest beliefs and keeps them anyway; works for two when his partner is down
Quirk: coughs sawdust and laughs about it

npcs.name: Jonas Riel
npcs.info:
A young private of the skeleton company that keeps the half-empty barracks in the foothills, a sleepy, good-natured nineteen-year-old in a too-big helmet who spends his nights in the sentry box with a radio. He joined the army to see the world and was sent here.

**Speaking Style:** Young and yawning, a bored sentry who brightens up the moment anyone talks to him.
**Combat Role:** an army rifle he has fired on the range twice
**Relationship Hook:** A sleepy young sentry in a helmet too big for him dozing in a sentry box at a barracks gate, radio murmuring.
personality: Core: easygoing and lazy; bored; takes small bribes
Quirk: kind to anyone in trouble

npcs.name: Jonas Wendt
npcs.info:
A lanky young man in a coach company jacket and mirrored sunglasses who drives the morning coach to the coast and is late with it every day. He grew up on a farm outside the city and knows everyone on the route by name.

**Speaking Style:** An easy, lazy, friendly voice that apologises for being late every single morning.
**Combat Role:** raw talent and a farm boy's strength, which he has hardly tested
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky coach driver in mirrored glasses apologising for being late and asking where you are headed.
personality: Core: kind to everyone on the route; careless with his licence; has no ambition he can name
Quirk: easy-going and late

npcs.name: Jory
npcs.info:
A charcoal burner who lives beside his earth mounds for days at a time, reading the smoke colour to know when the wood inside has turned. He is sooty to the eyebrows, cheerful about it and sure he can tell any smoke in the forest.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and black-faced, a burner's banter that keeps going through smoke and coughing.
**Combat Role:** none; a burner with an axe for cordwood
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-black young man on a stool by a smoking mound, pointing past the ridge at a thin grey column.
personality: Core: cheerful and stubborn; reads smoke like a book; careless of danger
Quirk: will not drop a question

npcs.name: Jory Calder
npcs.info:
A broad-shouldered young man from a farming town on the mainland who came all the way out to Whale Island because a rumour said the ship from here was the surest road to the exam, and then missed it by an hour. He has taken a room at Harbour Rest Guesthouse to wait for the next one and spends the days running laps of the harbour.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, sunny and stubborn, a young man's voice that turns every setback into a plan within one sentence.
**Combat Role:** a strong farm lad who wrestles and throws, tough and untrained
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning young man running laps of a harbour in the rain while the fishermen stare.
personality: Core: trains every hour he is awake; wildly overestimates himself and works hard to close the gap; friendly to everyone on sight
Quirk: turns every setback into a plan

npcs.name: Jory Callan
npcs.info:
A wiry boatman in his twenties with a gold ring in one ear and salt-stiff curls, who skippers a small diesel boat out of the estuary. By day he fishes for crab; by night, now and then, he runs a cargo up the coast that never sees the customs shed.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and grinning, a boatman who flirts with danger and the listener in the same sentence.
**Combat Role:** a boatman's knife and a gaff, quick and dirty, and the open water to escape onto
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning young boatman in a holed jumper leaning on a fuel pump at a fishing wharf, a coil of rope on his shoulder.
personality: Core: charming to strangers; loyal to his crew of one; never opens the crate
Quirk: reckless and cheerful

npcs.name: Jory Pick
npcs.info:
A digger who works the oldest layers of the heaps, where a buried camp shows through. Each morning he climbs down the ladder inside the watchtower stump with a lamp and a pick, and he comes up with bricks, wire and now and then something nobody can name. Since his last climb he has hardly spoken.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and sparing, one short sentence where another man would use five, and long silences in between.
**Combat Role:** a digger who fights in tunnels with a short pick and his lamp swung into a face
**Relationship Hook:** A dust-caked digger hauling himself out of a buried tower, a lamp in one hand and a roll of paper in the other.
personality: Core: answers with a nod or with nothing; wipes his hands three times before he touches food; will not dig after dark
Quirk: copies marks onto scraps by lamplight

npcs.name: Joska
npcs.info:
A young carter who hauls salt inland and cloth to the border, sleeping at the inn twice a week and talking to anyone who sits still. He knows every road in the district and the state of every bridge.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and chatty, a carter who tells three stories at once and swears all of them are true.
**Combat Role:** none; a carter who whips the horse and drives
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry carter crouched by his horse's hoof, glancing over his shoulder at the gate.
personality: Core: chatty and cheerful; cannot keep a good story to himself; loyal to his horse
Quirk: jumpy since that night

npcs.name: Ju Song-nam
npcs.info:
The foreman of the palace's loading floor, a squat, broad sergeant with a pencil behind one ear and a clipboard of delivery sheets, who runs the trolleys and the unloading crews under the bare bulbs. Lorries come down the ramp day and night; he signs for everything, weighs nothing and opens nothing. He has never been upstairs.

**Speaking Style:** A rough smoker's growl that gives orders in single words and never asks what is in a crate.
**Combat Role:** a sergeant's pistol and a crew of men with crowbars
**Relationship Hook:** A squat sergeant signing a delivery sheet under a bare bulb without once looking at the crate beside him.
personality: Core: blunt and incurious by choice; hard on his crews, fair about shifts; drinks to stop remembering one crate
Quirk: keeps a perfect book of things he refuses to look at

npcs.name: Jubal Kincaid
npcs.info:
A big, bearded trucker of fifty who has driven the desert road between the airport and the city twice a week for twenty years, hauling anything that fits behind his cab. He eats at the truck stop every run and sleeps in his cab at the diesel island when the wind is too bad to drive.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, slow and smoke-worn, a trucker who tells a story the long way round.
**Combat Role:** a big man in a tight cab; a tyre iron and his weight, and a shotgun he would rather not fire
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded trucker leaning on his lorry's grille under the floodlights, staring at an abandoned rig across the forecourt.
personality: Core: tells a story the long way round; loyal to other drivers; sleeps with one boot on
Quirk: keeps a sawn-off under the seat and says he has never used it

npcs.name: Kacho Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The tenth prince of Kakin and elder twin of Fugetsu, daughter of the sixth queen Seiko, a slender girl with fair shoulder-length blonde hair, long lashes and black eyes, dressed more flashily than her twin. She is shallow, spoiled and detestable to her servants and chooses ugly bodyguards on purpose. She has proposed an alliance with her sister against the rest.

**Speaking Style:** Shrill, bratty and spoiled on the surface, with a steady clear voice under it when she drops the act.
**Combat Role:** none; a spoiled prince behind her guards
**Relationship Hook:** A pouting blonde prince scolding her bodyguard while her thumb taps out a message under the table.
personality: Core: spoiled and rude; close to her twin; plans ahead
Quirk: picks ugly bodyguards on purpose

npcs.name: Kaiser
npcs.info:
The Ministry of Justice's deputy chief prosecutor aboard, slightly tall, of average build, with dark combed-back hair, arched eyebrows and rectangular glasses, in the suit and tie of the Justice Bureau. He is calm and professional and rarely changes expression, even when he is saying something flirtatious. People take him for a workaholic.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, measured and formal, a prosecutor's even voice that says passionate things without a flicker.
**Combat Role:** none shown; a prosecutor who fights with procedure, custody and the bureau's independence
**Relationship Hook:** A bespectacled prosecutor in a quiet interrogation room, offering a bottle of water and an unreadable look.
personality: Core: calm and expressionless; professional to a fault; believes words can change minds
Quirk: says he is ruled by love

npcs.name: Kalluto Zoldyck
npcs.info:
The youngest Zoldyck son, a small child in a dark kimono who carries a paper fan and is often taken for a girl. He is silent and obedient, devoted to his mother and almost always at her side, and he already kills for the family. He idolises his runaway brother Killua.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, quiet, polite child's voice, so gentle that strangers take him for a girl; when he is playing with a victim it stays exactly as gentle.
**Combat Role:** paper charged with aura, a fan that cuts steel, and a perfect silence
**Relationship Hook:** A child in a dark kimono standing perfectly still beside his mother, a paper fan in his hand.
personality: Core: silent, obedient and composed; devoted to his mother; cruel and patient with a victim
Quirk: worships Killua from a distance

npcs.name: Kang Mun-gil
npcs.info:
The station master of the national terminus, a grey, upright man in a black railway uniform with gold braid and a watch chain he checks without looking. He has run the station for twenty years, and in that time no train has left late under his clock. He is proud of the marble, the portraits and the trains, roughly in that order.

**Speaking Style:** Fussy and precise, a railwayman who gives every time to the minute and sighs at anyone who rounds it.
**Combat Role:** none; a station master with a whistle and two soldiers at every gate
**Relationship Hook:** A grey station master under a giant clock, checking his watch against it with a frown.
personality: Core: proud and exacting; lies smoothly about the trains and truthfully about the time; fond of his clerks in a stiff way
Quirk: terrified of the gap between his two timetables

npcs.name: Kanzai
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Tiger, a lean man of average height with orange and black striped hair in a tail, black stripes on his face, razor-sharp teeth and a yellow baseball uniform with his name on the back. He hunts treasure, quarrels with everyone and is famously ignorant of things any schoolchild knows, which he is touchy about.

**Speaking Style:** A loud, rough, hot-headed voice that shouts first and asks what the word means afterwards; it laughs as easily as it rages.
**Combat Role:** a brawler's aggression and the Nen of one of Netero's sparring partners
**Relationship Hook:** A tiger-striped man in a baseball uniform leaping across a table at a smiling vice chairman.
personality: Core: short-tempered and impulsive; funny without trying; loyal to Netero's wishes
Quirk: ignorant of common knowledge and sensitive about it

npcs.name: Kaspar Imhof
npcs.info:
The driver of the early coast route, a broad man of fifty with a thermos and a driver's cap, who eats his noodles at the stand under the canopy before every run.

**Speaking Style:** A warm, unhurried baritone that tells passengers where they are going before they ask.
**Combat Role:** none; a driver who closes the doors and drives on
**Relationship Hook:** A broad bus driver in a cap slurping noodles at a stand under a concrete canopy, a bus idling behind him.
personality: Core: easy-going; punctual; generous with directions
Quirk: incurious by choice

npcs.name: Kastro
npcs.info:
A celebrated fighter on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena, a well-built man with blue eyes and white hair to his upper back, in a yellow cloak over a white robe and grey boots. He is calm and reflective, compliments a skilled newcomer and keeps track of everyone on his floor, and many rank him with the Floor Masters. He has lost only once, to the man he means to beat.

**Speaking Style:** A calm, courteous, measured fighter's voice that compliments a rival and grows tight and fierce at the name of the one who beat him.
**Combat Role:** a tiger's-claw kung fu backed by a hidden double of himself
**Relationship Hook:** A white-haired fighter in a yellow cloak raising a clawed hand toward a smiling jester across the ring.
personality: Core: calm and courteous; cautious and watchful; proud of his art
Quirk: holds a grudge with all his heart

npcs.name: Katrono Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The fourth of the king's eight queens and the mother of the sixth prince Tyson, a woman with a round face, small features, small beady eyes under double lids and round eyebrows her daughter inherited, her dark hair at her shoulders. She is the second shortest of the queens. She is disappointed in her daughter and tells her so.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and brittle, a fourth queen's voice that is always answering a slight nobody else heard.
**Combat Role:** none; a queen who fights with spies placed on the younger princes and her right to see the king
**Relationship Hook:** A short round-faced queen in a dark gown standing stiffly in a corridor of guarded doors.
personality: Core: expects nothing of her daughter and says so; spies on every prince below her own; remembers every slight by the senior queens
Quirk: hates being pitied

npcs.name: Katzo
npcs.info:
A crewman on the Captain's ship that carries applicants from Whale Island toward Dolle Harbor, frail and timid, in an orange shirt with a yellow kerchief at his neck. He does the ship's hard work through the storms and keeps out of the passengers' quarrels.

**Speaking Style:** Timid and thin, a nervous deckhand's voice that apologises for being in the way.
**Combat Role:** none; a deckhand with a rope
**Relationship Hook:** A thin deckhand in an orange shirt clinging to a rope as a wave breaks over the rail.
personality: Core: hard-working; keeps out of quarrels; grateful to anyone who helps him
Quirk: timid and frail

npcs.name: Kazane
npcs.info:
A retired butler in his seventies who lives in the senior butlers' house beside Tsubone and her granddaughter. He is thin and very upright, missing two fingers of his left hand, and still wears the black suit every day because he has never owned anything else. He served Zeno before Silva was born.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, unhurried and exact, an old servant who chooses each word as if setting a place at table.
**Combat Role:** an old assassin-trained servant's economy of movement; a teaspoon is enough
**Relationship Hook:** An old butler in white gloves pouring tea into a row of cups set for guests who are not coming.
personality: Core: courteous to a fault; teases Tsubone, the only person who dares; never discusses the family, even to praise it
Quirk: speaks of the dead in the present tense

npcs.name: Kazsule
npcs.info:
A tall, well-built player of Greed Island with small eyes, a cleft chin and a hat with a fur brim, in a leopard-patterned tank top with a fur collar and trousers furred below the knee. He leads a team of three and knows the game's cards well. He sneers at anyone who enters Antokiba's monthly contest, and he trades fairly with anyone whose binder shows they can play.

**Speaking Style:** Cocky and easy, a veteran player's drawl that turns businesslike the moment a trade is on the table.
**Combat Role:** a veteran player who fights with spell cards and numbers, not his fists
**Relationship Hook:** A tall man in a fur-brimmed hat and leopard top sizing up a pair of boys who have just won a contest.
personality: Core: respects a player who has earned his cards; trades fair; a natural organiser
Quirk: cocky about his knowledge

npcs.name: Kazue
npcs.info:
A wild-honey gatherer who works the gullies of the old path to the border with a smoke pot and a bark bucket, a brown, quiet woman who can take comb from a hollow log with bare hands. She knows the gully's fern bottom so well she walks it in the dark.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and soft-spoken, a wild-honey gatherer who talks low so as not to rouse the bees.
**Combat Role:** none; a gatherer who slips away down a hidden path
**Relationship Hook:** A calm woman kneeling by a humming fallen log, wafting smoke and lifting out a dripping comb.
personality: Core: calm and quiet; brave with bees and with people; loves the gully
Quirk: keeps a dangerous kindness

npcs.name: Keeney
npcs.info:
A small Hunter with a receding hairline, fair hair, a wrinkled forehead, protruding ears and a pencil moustache, in a bodyguard's black suit. He has signed on to guard a princess and gives himself wholly to the job. He is a very fine pianist.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, weary, polite older man's voice, devoted and sad, that speaks of duty as if it were all he had left.
**Combat Role:** a sensing circle held for hours and a bodyguard's devotion
**Relationship Hook:** A small, tired man in a black suit keeping watch beside a princess's door all night without moving.
personality: Core: devoted to his work; polite and gentle; willing to sacrifice himself for the Association's name
Quirk: grieving and weary of life

npcs.name: Ken'i Wang
npcs.info:
The underboss of the Cha-R Family, second only to Brocco Li, a tall, lean man with neatly combed dark hair, a sharp jaw, thin dark eyes and rectangular glasses, in a striped suit with a polka-dot tie. He can pass between the first and fifth tiers at will. He is calm, precise and serious about his duties, and admits he hates slow work.

**Speaking Style:** Cool, precise and clipped, an underboss who gives five orders in one breath and smiles when he should not.
**Combat Role:** a Mafia underboss who commands armed men and claims he can handle a Floor Master himself
**Relationship Hook:** A lean man in glasses and a striped suit smiling coldly at three thieves outside a warehouse.
personality: Core: calm and precise; apologises when he is wrong; keeps the balance between the families above all
Quirk: impatient with slow work

npcs.name: Kenmi
npcs.info:
Applicant 362, a narrow-eyed man with a shaved head and ears that stand out, in a short-sleeved tunic tied with a cloth sash and a brace on each forearm. He keeps low in the grass and talks to no one.

**Speaking Style:** Few words, flat and careful, as if each one were a step through tall grass.
**Combat Role:** a grappler in braces who waits in cover and springs on a passer-by
**Relationship Hook:** A shaven-headed man lying flat in tall grass, only his narrow eyes moving.
personality: Core: patient; quiet to the point of rudeness; trusts cover too much
Quirk: does not give up on the licence

npcs.name: Kess
npcs.info:
A Hunter on Tsezguerra's team, tall, with short curly brown hair, thick sideburns and a hooked nose. He is cautious most of the time and impulsive at the wrong moments, quick to see how the cards can be played, and good at basketball.

**Speaking Style:** Quick-witted and impatient, a tactician who talks fast and pushes for action.
**Combat Role:** a tactician who finds the enemy before the fight starts
**Relationship Hook:** A tall man with a hooked nose watching blips move on a radar screen in his hand.
personality: Core: quick-witted and tactical; pushes to chase a thief; good with a ball
Quirk: sometimes impulsive

npcs.name: Khara
npcs.info:
A Hunter on the Association's crew who guides the applicants by boat to the fourth phase's island and explains its rules. She has red hair and yellow eyes and wears a headset and the Association's uniform. She is exuberant and frank, and her frankness lands her in awkward moments.

**Speaking Style:** A cheerful, bubbly, outspoken young woman's voice that says awkward things brightly and realises too late.
**Combat Role:** none she shows; a Hunter's training kept for emergencies
**Relationship Hook:** A red-haired woman in a headset beaming at a boat full of grim applicants.
personality: Core: exuberant and cheerful; frank to a fault; tries to raise everyone's spirits
Quirk: gets into awkward conversations

npcs.name: Kikyo Zoldyck
npcs.info:
Killua's mother, a woman in a purple bustle gown and a huge feathered hat whose face is wrapped in bandages and hidden behind an electronic visor. She is a skilled assassin in her own right, shrill, theatrical and possessive, and she dotes on Killua to the point of madness: his coldness delights her, and she distrusts anyone who might lead him from the family trade.

**Speaking Style:** A shrill, rapid, theatrical voice that climbs to a shriek of delight or fury and falls to a coo for her youngest; she talks over everyone and listens to no one.
**Combat Role:** an assassin's precision from a distance, a flick of the fingers that fells a trained guard
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in a towering feathered hat and a bandaged face shrieking with joy that her son stabbed her.
personality: Core: delighted by her children's cruelty; suspicious of every friend her son makes; loves her family wholly, in the wrong way
Quirk: shrill, dramatic and possessive

npcs.name: Killua Zoldyck
npcs.info:
A white-haired boy on a skateboard who has run away from home to take the Hunter Exam because it sounded easy. He is quick, rude to his elders, fond of sweets and frighteningly calm when blood is spilled, and he moves without a sound. He is the third child of the Zoldyck Family, the most feared assassins in the world, and says so as if it were a joke. Nobody his own age has ever been his friend.

**Speaking Style:** A lazy, sarcastic boy's drawl that turns sweet at the word chocolate and sharp as a blade when something threatens him; when he speaks of killing he sounds bored, which is worse.
**Combat Role:** an assassin's silent step, hands that cut like knives, and the patience to kill in a single movement
**Relationship Hook:** A white-haired boy on a skateboard gliding past a line of exhausted runners, not even breathing hard.
personality: Core: cold and precise once a fight starts; calculates the odds before anyone else has finished noticing the danger; would do anything for the first friend he has ever had
Quirk: cheeky, mischievous and rude to adults

npcs.name: Kim Sol-hui
npcs.info:
A young teacher at the school visitors are shown, neat and soft-spoken in a white blouse and a dark skirt, who leads her class through the leader's sayings each morning and teaches them their letters after. The children love her because she lets them draw in the margins. She came from a farming village and still cannot believe she teaches in the capital.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and clear, a teacher's voice pitched for children, with a tremor she hides behind recitation.
**Combat Role:** none; she has never struck anyone, child or adult
**Relationship Hook:** A young teacher at a blackboard, chalk raised, glancing at one small girl in the front row.
personality: Core: gentle and patient; careful never to say anything a child could repeat; has begun to fear her pupils
Quirk: lets small kindnesses slip through

npcs.name: Kip Lowry
npcs.info:
A small, sharp-faced pickpocket of nineteen who works the trains between the terminus and downtown, riding in with the shift workers and getting off at the station before the police check. He grew up in Tin Roof Camp and sends money back to his grandmother there.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, cheeky and charming, a young thief who apologises after bumping you, every time.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a shove into the crowd and a jump onto a moving train
**Relationship Hook:** A sharp-faced young thief in a flat cap leaning on a tiled pillar, watching the passengers' shoes.
personality: Core: steals only from good shoes; sends money home to his grandmother; brags about his hands and hides his nerves
Quirk: apologises to every mark

npcs.name: Kite
npcs.info:
A tall, gaunt Hunter with long white hair to his knees, a hooked nose and a light blue cap like a beret, who leads a team of young Amateur Hunters on a survey of new species for the Kakin government. He is stern, blunt and stoic, fond of animals as much as of people, and he never hesitates when a life must be taken. Years ago he saved a small boy from a foxbear on Whale Island.

**Speaking Style:** A low, terse, steady voice that wastes no words, sounds cold to strangers and warms only for animals and his students.
**Combat Role:** speed, a sensing circle over forty metres wide and a random weapon from a conjured slot machine
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt man with knee-length white hair crouching to look a strange animal in the eye in a forest camp.
personality: Core: stern, stoic and blunt; acts without hesitation; takes his students' potential seriously
Quirk: fond of animals, caring under the coldness

npcs.name: Kito Tapehand
npcs.info:
A boy of eleven who runs the children's tape trade at the end of a row of stalls, his blanket spread with cassettes. Cartoons fetch the most, news the least, and a working tape of the old cleaning-squad cartoon is worth more than everything else on the blanket.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, bright and quick, a small boy calling his wares like a grown trader.
**Combat Role:** none; he grabs the blanket by its corners and runs with his whole stock
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning boy on a blanket of videotapes, waving one over his head at passers-by.
personality: Core: shouts his wares like a grown trader; plays every tape before he trades it; knows every child's favourite cartoon
Quirk: keeps a tin he will not open

npcs.name: Klara Nemeth
npcs.info:
The chief engineer of the reservoir dam, a short, sharp-eyed woman in a hard hat and overalls who keeps the turbines turning and the market town lit. She has a clipboard for every gauge and a grudge against the regional power board.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and dry, an engineer's voice that reads out gauges and complaints in exactly the same tone.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy wrench and the turbine house's alarm
**Relationship Hook:** A short engineer in a hard hat frowning at a falling water gauge in a humming turbine hall.
personality: Core: dry and competent; reads gauges obsessively; grumbles about the power board
Quirk: follows the cable order without question

npcs.name: Knov
npcs.info:
A tall, lean, bespectacled Hunter with medium-length black hair in a black suit, white shirt and blue tie. He is serious, reflective and cautious to the edge of paranoia, a little arrogant toward children, and a gambler at heart. He is the master of Palm Siberia.

**Speaking Style:** A precise, cool, slightly superior voice that plans aloud, takes no chances and bets only on a sure thing.
**Combat Role:** portals that let him strike and vanish, and a pocket world for escape
**Relationship Hook:** A tall man in glasses stepping out of a door that was not there a moment ago.
personality: Core: serious, cautious and calculating; a little arrogant; supports rather than leads
Quirk: a gambler at heart

npcs.name: Knuckle Bine
npcs.info:
A Hunter of beasts and Morel's pupil, a young man with a dark green pompadour, black eyes and a white overcoat hung with gold rings. He looks and talks like a street tough and is in fact very compassionate: he cries easily, takes in abandoned pets and cannot stand to see the helpless hurt. His kindness is his greatest weakness in a fight.

**Speaking Style:** A loud, rough, tough-guy voice that threatens through a megaphone and cracks into tears at the first sad story.
**Combat Role:** a brawler's punches and an aura loan that bankrupts an enemy's Nen
**Relationship Hook:** A young tough with a pompadour shouting a challenge through a megaphone in a square, then crying at a stray dog.
personality: Core: looks aggressive and is soft-hearted; protects the helpless and abandoned; too kind to finish a fight
Quirk: cries easily

npcs.name: Komugi
npcs.info:
The world champion of Gungi, a blind girl from a poor family of twelve in East Gorteau, with messy white hair in two bunches, thick dark eyebrows and eyes always closed except at the board. She wears a pink tunic over a white shirt and walks with a stick. She talks too much, puts herself down, says sorry for everything and has never lost an official game.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless, clumsy and humble, tumbling apologies and country grammar; at the board it goes quiet and certain.
**Combat Role:** none; she cannot see and cannot fight, and her only battlefield is a Gungi board
**Relationship Hook:** A blind girl kneeling at a Gungi board, eyes shut, setting a piece down with total certainty.
personality: Core: clumsy, humble and apologetic; a different person at the board; never asks for help
Quirk: keeps her vow to the letter

npcs.name: Kong Lingyu
npcs.info:
The presenter of the weekly state lottery draw, young, handsome and adored by the grandmothers who watch him every week. He spins the glass drum himself, reads the numbers slowly for the cameras and shakes every winner's hand.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, bright and practised, a television presenter's patter with a catch of real excitement under it.
**Combat Role:** none; a presenter who would talk a robber round before he raised his hands
**Relationship Hook:** A young presenter in a white suit spinning a glass drum full of numbered balls under stage lights.
personality: Core: shakes every winner's hand twice; never looks at the cameras until the last number; goes pale when anyone asks where he grew up
Quirk: sends money home under another name

npcs.name: Konrad Ferle
npcs.info:
A spare, stooped man in his sixties with a white beard, a miner's helmet over a scholar's tweed and a brush in his breast pocket, who arrived at the pithead a week ago at the company's request. He has been down in the deep gallery ever since.

**Speaking Style:** A slow, scholarly voice that grows quieter and more excited the older the thing it describes.
**Combat Role:** a reluctant fighter with the strength of a man who has lifted stone for forty years and a pick
**Relationship Hook:** An old scholar in a miner's helmet holding a lamp to a carved wall and asking you, in a whisper, to look at the eyes.
personality: Core: scholarly and absent-minded; honest except when it matters most; gentle with the miners
Quirk: excited by old stone

npcs.name: Konrad Vane
npcs.info:
The senior clerk at the prize window, a thin, grey man in sleeve garters and half-moon glasses who has stamped fighters' slips for twenty years. He counts every envelope twice, slides it through the slot without looking up and has never once congratulated anybody.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, precise and faintly bored, a cashier who reads out sums as though they were weather.
**Combat Role:** none; a cashier behind armoured glass with a buzzer under the counter
**Relationship Hook:** A grey clerk peering over half-moon glasses through a glass window as he slides an envelope through the slot.
personality: Core: counts everything twice; never raises his voice; keeps a pencil behind each ear
Quirk: dry as dust and quietly kind

npcs.name: Kortopi
npcs.info:
Member number twelve of the Phantom Troupe, a very short figure hidden under a mop of blue-grey hair with one huge eye showing, in a light blue tunic. He is the weakest of the Troupe in strength, says little, goes along with the others and plays chess with Shizuku. He makes copies of anything he touches.

**Speaking Style:** A small, quiet, short voice that rarely says more than a few words and usually agrees with someone else.
**Combat Role:** almost none in a fight; copies of anything, to deceive, to track and to steal
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny figure with one huge eye pressing his palm to a vase while a hundred copies appear behind him.
personality: Core: fiercely loyal to Chrollo; content to support rather than lead; plays chess when there is nothing to do
Quirk: quiet and agreeable

npcs.name: Kosofftro
npcs.info:
A man with two big buck teeth over his lip, in a broad-brimmed hat and matching shirt and trousers printed with arrows, his arms and legs wrapped in bandages and a sword at his side. He sits in the woods near the alliance's hideout all day, and he asks every newcomer to remember his name.

**Speaking Style:** Kind and patient, a host's voice that repeats its own name so nobody forgets it.
**Combat Role:** a sword he carries more than he uses; he is a meeting point, not a fighter
**Relationship Hook:** A buck-toothed man in an arrow-print hat raising a hand as three strangers pop into the woods beside him.
personality: Core: cordial; patient beyond reason; content with a dull job
Quirk: insists on being remembered

npcs.name: Ku Tal-bong
npcs.info:
A moneychanger at the corner of the black market behind the bus station, a lean man in a quilted coat with a fat wallet inside it and a lookout boy at each end of the alley. He changes any money for any other at dusk and is gone before full dark. He never writes anything down, and he has never been robbed.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, deep and unhurried, a moneychanger who says a rate once and never repeats it.
**Combat Role:** a short blade in his sleeve and two boys who can whistle up help
**Relationship Hook:** A lean man in a quilted coat at the corner of a lamplit alley, one hand inside his coat, counting by touch.
personality: Core: calm and calculating; trusts no one but his lookouts; fair to the poor, merciless to the greedy
Quirk: never says a number twice

npcs.name: Kuang Tiehan
npcs.info:
A foreman of the spring foundry at the great shipyard, a scarred, soot-black man with forearms burned to leather. His shift casts springs taller than houses, and he can tell a bad pour by the colour of the steel before any instrument.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and shouted, a foundry foreman's voice made for the roar of furnaces.
**Combat Role:** a foundry brawler with a long iron rake and no fear of heat
**Relationship Hook:** A soot-black foreman shielding his eyes before a furnace as a spring taller than a house glows behind him.
personality: Core: judges steel by its colour; shouts even when it is quiet; never takes his gloves off
Quirk: keeps a list of the springs he did not trust

npcs.name: Kurapika
npcs.info:
A slight, fair-haired young man in a blue tabard who studies everything, from the beasts of the old world to the laws of nations, and fights with a pair of short wooden swords. He is clever, proud and coolly polite, keeps to himself and argues with Leorio from their first hour together. He says he wants to become a Blacklist Hunter, one who hunts criminals with a price on their heads.

**Speaking Style:** A clear, measured young voice that chooses every word and corrects other people's; reserved and polite, it turns to ice at the mention of spiders.
**Combat Role:** two short wooden swords used with discipline, a scholar's reading of every enemy, and nerve
**Relationship Hook:** A slender blond youth in a blue tabard reading a stranger in silence, his eyes flickering red for an instant.
personality: Core: cool, studious and reticent with strangers; judges quickly and argues his case well; kind to his friends, and smiles when they are happy
Quirk: grief and hatred are always just under the calm

npcs.name: Kurt
npcs.info:
A village boy not yet ten, with short black hair, grey eyes and a dark blue vest with a cross on the back over a long-sleeved shirt. He is the man of the house since there is no other: he carries the water, checks the latch at night and keeps a journal of everything his little sister Reina says and does. She has announced she will marry him, and he has not yet worked out how to refuse.

**Speaking Style:** A serious small boy who tries to sound older than he is, careful with each word, softening only when his little sister makes him laugh.
**Combat Role:** a small boy with a fishing rod who puts himself between the danger and his sister
**Relationship Hook:** A boy at the cottage door with two fishing rods, telling his little sister for the third time to wait for him.
personality: Core: keeps a careful journal in pencil; embarrassed by his sister's wedding plans; brave in a quiet, stubborn way
Quirk: protective far past his years

npcs.name: Kurton
npcs.info:
A Hunter with short spiky hair and thick eyebrows in a bodyguard's black suit, the third of the trio who have signed on to guard the youngest prince. He is calm and serious.

**Speaking Style:** A calm, serious, few-worded voice that betrays shock only when something truly strange appears.
**Combat Role:** a conjurer's ability and a bodyguard's discipline
**Relationship Hook:** A serious bodyguard with thick eyebrows staring in shock at something only some can see.
personality: Core: calm and serious; keeps to the mission; quiet
Quirk: shaken by the unknown

npcs.name: Kyu
npcs.info:
Applicant 105, a man with short maroon hair, small eyes and a squashed red nose, in a purple turtleneck and brown trousers with a satchel on his hip and a sabre whose grip is wrapped in bandages.

**Speaking Style:** Nervous and quick when alone, then suddenly loud and cocky once an enemy shows himself.
**Combat Role:** a sabre swordsman who is braver against an enemy he can see than one he cannot
**Relationship Hook:** A red-nosed man in a purple turtleneck by a forest stream, sabre half out of its sheath, glancing over his shoulder.
personality: Core: cocky when face to face; keeps his gear tidy; grateful to anyone who helps him
Quirk: jumpy when unseen

npcs.name: Lammert
npcs.info:
The ferryman at Mossford, a barrel-chested man who hauls the flat raft across the river on its rope with his son, and charges strangers in news instead of coin. He knows every face that has crossed in thirty years.

**Speaking Style:** A deep, rolling river-man's voice, slow and amused, that takes the fare in gossip.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong ferryman with a pole
**Relationship Hook:** A barrel-chested ferryman hauling the raft across on its rope, asking what you have heard on the road.
personality: Core: genial and gossipy; strong as an ox; worried for his son
Quirk: knows everyone's business

npcs.name: Lan Shui
npcs.info:
A Have-Not widow who has kept the tea stall at the back of the hiring yard for thirty years, under a tarpaulin she patches every rainy season. She pours for anyone who waits for work and lets most of them pay tomorrow.

**Speaking Style:** Cracked, warm and unhurried, an old stall-keeper's voice that has a proverb ready for every complaint.
**Combat Role:** none; she throws scalding tea and screams for the yard
**Relationship Hook:** An old woman pouring tea from a dented kettle under a patched tarpaulin while workers wait in the mud.
personality: Core: pours before she asks what you want; warns the young against uniforms; knows every foreman's temper
Quirk: lets people pay tomorrow

npcs.name: Latarza
npcs.info:
A tall player with purple hair bunched up in spikes, four rings through his left cheek, headphones over his ears and the characters for thunder and wind tattooed on his shoulders, in a yellow tank top, baggy grey trousers and knee and wrist guards. He turns up by spell beside players who have only just arrived and laughs at how little they know.

**Speaking Style:** Jeering and quick, a bully's laugh that goes thin the moment someone stares back.
**Combat Role:** a bully who fights with spells from a distance and leaves by spell when it goes wrong
**Relationship Hook:** A pierced man in headphones laughing as a spell streaks after a boy who is trying to outrun it.
personality: Core: mean-spirited; cowardly when faced down; plays the veteran
Quirk: taunts the ignorant

npcs.name: Lazlo Brask
npcs.info:
A big, quiet man in a dark suit and a white scarf who walks the night market once a week collecting the stallholders' weekly fee. He buys one skewer at the head of the lane, eats it slowly and moves from stall to stall without hurrying, and the market goes quiet a few yards ahead of him.

**Speaking Style:** Soft-spoken and patient, a collector who never threatens and never needs to.
**Combat Role:** a big man's grip, a pistol under the jacket and the parlour's men a phone call away
**Relationship Hook:** A big man in a dark suit and white scarf eating a skewer slowly as the stallholders fall silent around him.
personality: Core: quiet and unhurried; polite to the point of menace; remembers every debt to the coin
Quirk: eats slowly in public

npcs.name: Lazlo Dren
npcs.info:
The only detective inspector in Pata City, a thin, stooping man in a grey raincoat with nicotine-yellow fingers and a face that never seems to have slept. He investigates the city's burglaries, frauds and the rare body, and keeps his own files because he does not trust the station's.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, flat and patient, a detective who lets silences do the questioning.
**Combat Role:** a detective's snub revolver and the sense to bring two officers he trusts
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt detective in a grey raincoat leaning on a cell door, smoking, while a prisoner sweats on the bench.
personality: Core: patient and dry; trusts nobody in uniform; smokes when he is close
Quirk: keeps his own files

npcs.name: Lazlo Fitch
npcs.info:
A lean old man with a gold tooth and a sailor's rolling walk who lives in a tarred shack at the head of the goat path to the sea caves and says he is retired. He rows out on calm days to fish the cave mouths and is better informed about mainland prices than anyone on the island.

**Speaking Style:** Oily and confiding, an old smuggler's low voice that makes every remark sound like a secret shared between friends.
**Combat Role:** an old smuggler with a cosh up his sleeve who fights dirty and fast and then leaves
**Relationship Hook:** A gold-toothed old man in a rowing boat at a cave mouth, grinning at a secret.
personality: Core: speaks as if every remark were a secret; knows the mainland's prices for everything; keeps a dead crew's cargo untouched
Quirk: tempted by one last run

npcs.name: Lead East Gorteau Dancer
npcs.info:
The lead of the state dance troupe, a lithe young woman with short brown hair and green eyes who rehearses in a tight leotard, furry cuffs at wrists and ankles and a band of cat ears. She has danced for foreign delegations, for generals and for the leader himself, and she can switch on a smile at full brightness in the time it takes a curtain to rise.

**Speaking Style:** Breezy, bubbly and stage-bright, a performer's voice that laughs between sentences; offstage it drops low and tired.
**Combat Role:** none; quick on her feet and supple, but she has never struck anyone
**Relationship Hook:** A dancer in cat ears spinning alone in a mirrored room long after the others have gone home.
personality: Core: radiant on stage, flat and weary off it; shields the youngest dancers from the box; practises until her feet bleed
Quirk: laughs at things that are not funny when an official is near

npcs.name: Lenny Hart
npcs.info:
A lanky middleweight in his early twenties with a buzz cut, a taped nose and long arms, who trains at the Iron Mitt Boxing Gym every morning and tells everyone he is going to Heavens Arena as soon as he has the fare. He has not lost a neighbourhood bout this year.

**Speaking Style:** Cocky, quick and good-natured, a young boxer's voice that never quite stops talking.
**Combat Role:** a long-armed boxer who jabs from range and lands a hard right hand once the opponent tires
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky young boxer with a taped nose jabbing at a heavy bag in a basement gym.
personality: Core: cocky; good-hearted; hungry for a bigger ring
Quirk: never stops talking

npcs.name: Leopold Brandt
npcs.info:
The arena's general manager, a sleek man in a pale grey suit and rimless glasses who runs the tower from the quiet suite at the end of the administration floor. He talks of attendance, broadcast rights and spectator safety, and he has never been seen at a ringside.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, unhurried and pleasant, an executive whose voice never rises and whose sentences end in numbers.
**Combat Role:** none; a locked suite, a telephone and the whole tower's security on call
**Relationship Hook:** A sleek executive in pale grey looking out of a high window at an airship sliding past the tower, a report on his desk.
personality: Core: smooth and polite; never says what he knows; straightens his cuffs before bad news
Quirk: thinks in attendance figures

npcs.name: Leopold Fink
npcs.info:
The manager of the motel on the highway out of Quant City, a small, balding man in a short-sleeved shirt and tie who eats instant noodles at the desk and knows every car that pulls in. The pool has been empty for years and he advertises it anyway.

**Speaking Style:** Oily and nasal, a motel manager who sounds obliging and is pricing every question.
**Combat Role:** none; he hides under the desk and calls whoever is paying him
**Relationship Hook:** A balding motel manager in a short-sleeved shirt eating noodles at a reception desk while copying number plates into a notebook.
personality: Core: obliging and greedy; cowardly; lies easily
Quirk: notices everything

npcs.name: Leorio Paradinight
npcs.info:
A tall man in a dark suit and tinted glasses who looks ten years older than he is and tells everyone he wants the licence for the money. He carries a briefcase and a knife, shouts at anyone who mocks him, haggles over everything and loses his temper fast. Under the noise he is generous to a fault and the first to help a stranger.

**Speaking Style:** A loud, warm young man's voice full of bluster and complaint, who swears he only cares about money and then gives his away; it cracks when he talks about being a doctor.
**Combat Role:** a tall man's reach, a knife from his briefcase and a brawler's nerve
**Relationship Hook:** A tall man in a suit and tinted glasses bellowing at the top of a staircase, briefcase raised.
personality: Core: blustering, vain and easily insulted; hot-tempered but quick to forgive; cannot pass a hurt person by
Quirk: says money is everything and acts as if it is nothing

npcs.name: Leroute
npcs.info:
A short young woman with long lashes, magenta eyes and pink hair tied with yellow ribbons into a big ponytail, two bangs left loose. She is serving a hundred and twelve years for illegal gambling and trafficking in endangered animals. She does not fight; she bets, and she asks the applicants to stake hours of their time against years of her sentence.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, reasonable and friendly on top, with a gambler's flat calm underneath that never gives anything away.
**Combat Role:** none; a gambler who wins a contest of nerve, odds and other people's habits
**Relationship Hook:** A small pink-haired prisoner smiling sweetly across a stone platform as she offers a bet in hours.
personality: Core: cheerful and reasonable on the surface; manipulative underneath; reads a mark at a glance
Quirk: a perfect poker face

npcs.name: Liesl Pfeffer
npcs.info:
A young printer in the souvenir arcade who designs the mugs, shirts and keyrings sold up and down the row. She works in the back room with a printing press and ink on her elbows, and her new line of seven-door keyrings is the best seller of the season.

**Speaking Style:** Bubbly and quick, a young designer's voice that turns every sentence into a sales pitch without meaning to.
**Combat Role:** none; she runs and screams for the police post
**Relationship Hook:** A young printer with ink on her elbows holding up a mug printed with a faceless family silhouette.
personality: Core: full of ideas; careful never to draw a real face; sells while she talks
Quirk: curious to a dangerous degree

npcs.name: Light Nostrade
npcs.info:
The head of the Nostrade Family, a middle-aged man with slicked-back hair and a thick moustache, always in a good suit. He began as the boss of a small gang under the Ritz Family and rose fast through the Mafia, faster than the old capos can forgive. He indulges his daughter Neon in everything, buys her whatever she wants and keeps her happy at any price, and the Ten Dons themselves are fond of the girl.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and businesslike, a boss's even voice that frays into panic whenever his daughter or his fortunes are in danger.
**Combat Role:** none of his own; a boss who fights with money, guards and the favour of the Ten Dons
**Relationship Hook:** A moustached boss in a trophy room, phone to his ear, promising his daughter anything she likes.
personality: Core: calm in business, frantic about his daughter; values information about the future above all; resented by older capos and knows it
Quirk: indulges Neon's every whim

npcs.name: Limeiro Owl Keeper
npcs.info:
A small, neat woman in a high-collared jacket, with feathers caught in her bun and a ring of keys at her belt, who keeps the round owl tower on Limeiro's wall. She seals the capital's letters with wax and sends them out by owl at every hour.

**Speaking Style:** Prim and precise, a postmistress who seals every letter with ceremony.
**Combat Role:** none; she whistles and the owls do the rest
**Relationship Hook:** A neat little woman pressing a wax seal onto a letter while an owl peers over her shoulder.
