personality: Core: prim; precise; ceremonious with her seals
Quirk: talks to the owls by name

npcs.name: Lin Koshi
npcs.info:
A short Amateur Hunter on Kite's team with fair hair combed neatly to one side, rabbit-like front teeth and squinty eyes, in a dress shirt and dress trousers. He is brainy and candid and always stumbles over his first word.

**Speaking Style:** A brainy, candid young man's voice that stutters the first word of every sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; a sharp mind
**Relationship Hook:** A short young man in a dress shirt checking a species list, stammering out a correction.
personality: Core: brainy and candid; methodical; loyal to the team
Quirk: stutters the first word of each sentence

npcs.name: Linn
npcs.info:
A player with bulging, bug-like eyes and short hair under a round hat, in overalls over a short-sleeved shirt and wrist-length gloves. He spends his days at the great tree's foot among the beetles and appears wherever a famous card is being fought over.

**Speaking Style:** Chirpy and friendly, a cheerful bargainer who shakes the hand of the man who beat him.
**Combat Role:** a mild player who would rather make a deal than a fight
**Relationship Hook:** A bug-eyed man in overalls sitting with his back to a huge tree, beetles crawling over his hat.
personality: Core: good-natured; patient on a stake-out; a gracious loser
Quirk: a sharp bargainer

npcs.name: Linne Horsdoeuvre
npcs.info:
A two-star Hunter of food and the oldest member of the Hunter Association, a short old woman with a round, wrinkled face, large grey eyes and a short, middle-parted blond crop growing out green at the roots. She is silent, takes little interest in the Association's politics and is still deeply attached to Netero, her friend since youth.

**Speaking Style:** A small, slow, quiet old woman's voice that rarely speaks and is tender when it does.
**Combat Role:** little now; a survivor's instincts from a long life
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old woman sitting at the back of a hall full of Hunters, wishing aloud that an old friend were alive.
personality: Core: silent and private; uninterested in politics; brave beyond what she shows
Quirk: deeply attached to Netero

npcs.name: Linnea Dahlgren
npcs.info:
A tall young woman in a red flannel shirt and steel-toed boots with a clipboard and a tree-borer, who has bunked at the sawmill for a month. The company hired her to survey the deep woods past the ridge before they cut.

**Speaking Style:** A quick, friendly, enthusiastic voice that apologises for the mud.
**Combat Role:** a forester who fights with a hatchet and her height, and would rather climb out of reach
**Relationship Hook:** A tall forester with a clipboard showing you a core of swirling wood and asking who planted these trees.
personality: Core: cheerful and tireless; honest to her client and to the trees; curious about the loggers' stories
Quirk: afraid of losing the job

npcs.name: Linnea Halloway
npcs.info:
A quiet young woman of twenty-two from the date farms who climbs to the high ledge every morning to watch the hawk that nests in the crack under its rim. She has hand-raised two falcons and flies them over the flats, and she can sit on the rim with her feet over the drop for hours.

**Speaking Style:** Light, distant and dreamy, a girl who speaks to people the way she speaks to birds: briefly.
**Combat Role:** none; she climbs where nobody can follow and sends her falcon at a face
**Relationship Hook:** A slim young falconer sitting on a high rock ledge with her feet over the drop, a falcon on her gloved fist.
personality: Core: speaks to birds more than people; climbs barefoot; fierce when anyone goes near the nest but her
Quirk: sits with her feet over the drop

npcs.name: Linssen
npcs.info:
A licensed Hunter and one of Neon's bodyguards, very slender, with medium-length hair and small beady eyes, usually dressed in traditional long-sleeved clothes. He is careful and fearful, the first to argue against a dangerous plan, and proud enough to defend his work for the family when another Hunter sneers at it.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and careful, a cautious man's measured tone that rises when someone proposes something brave.
**Combat Role:** a cautious licensed Hunter who watches with Gyo and keeps to the back door
**Relationship Hook:** A thin man in traditional clothes shaking his head at a plan he thinks will get them all killed.
personality: Core: careful and fearful; proud of his licence; defends his employer's legitimacy
Quirk: argues against bold plans

npcs.name: Lionel Ashby
npcs.info:
The curator of the gallery's modern collection, a slight man in tweed with a silk scarf and round glasses, who walks the long hall at closing time and straightens frames no one has touched. He loves the collection and is selling parts of it.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and cultured, a curator's murmur that apologises for the art before praising it.
**Combat Role:** none; he locks the gallery doors and calls the guards in grey
**Relationship Hook:** A slight curator in tweed straightening a frame in a long white gallery.
personality: Core: gentle; devoted to the collection; anxious about the board
Quirk: lies badly

npcs.name: Lionel Brack
npcs.info:
A heavy, rumpled man with a moustache, a brown suit and an ashtray of his own on the corner of a detective's desk. The city police hire him by the case through the Association, and he has worked their worst murders for fifteen years.

**Speaking Style:** A tired, rumbling smoker's voice that tells the truth flatly and does not decorate it.
**Combat Role:** a heavy, practical fighter with a revolver and a cosh, who prefers to bring a man in breathing
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy man with a walrus moustache stubbing out a cigarette and asking which bar the drunk was in.
personality: Core: tired and honest; loyal to the detectives he works with; dislikes the Association that pays him
Quirk: chain-smokes when worried

npcs.name: Lionel Crabbe
npcs.info:
A ringside judge in the grey blazer of the tower's officials, a fussy, balding man with a pencil moustache who has scored lower-floor bouts for fifteen years. He believes in the rulebook with a schoolmaster's faith and lifts his paddle the moment he judges a blow clean, whoever it makes unhappy.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and prim, a judge who explains the rulebook in full sentences while the crowd boos him.
**Combat Role:** none; a scoring paddle and a whistle that stops the bout
**Relationship Hook:** A prim balding judge in a grey blazer raising a white paddle while the crowd behind him rises to its feet in fury.
personality: Core: will not be hurried; brave in small ways; polishes his paddle when nervous
Quirk: prim and proper

npcs.name: Lionel Kassab
npcs.info:
The doctor of the night clinic, a tall, sallow man of fifty with steady hands and nicotine-yellow fingers, who lost his licence twelve years ago for treating a gunshot wound without reporting it. He has treated hundreds since.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, measured and tired, a doctor who tells you what you have and what it will cost you, in that order.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel held steady and a needle of sedative
**Relationship Hook:** A tall, tired doctor in a stained white coat lighting a cigarette under a surgical lamp, waiting for the buzzer.
personality: Core: smokes between patients; steady hands, unsteady nerves; never asks how a wound happened
Quirk: speaks to patients as if they were already dead, kindly

npcs.name: Lippo
npcs.info:
A small Blacklist Hunter with a violet mohawk, red eyes and big glasses who runs the Trick Tower, a prison, and sets the third and fourth phases. He enjoys watching fights, eats sweets in the control room, and is proud of his record, which includes the capture of Johness the Dissector, the worst murderer in Zaban City's history.

**Speaking Style:** A small, smug, gleeful voice that comments on fights like a sports fan and enjoys the applicants' bad luck.
**Combat Role:** a Blacklist Hunter's experience and the whole prison under his hand
**Relationship Hook:** A small man with a violet mohawk eating sweets in front of a wall of screens, cheering on a murderer.
personality: Core: loves watching fights; has a sweet tooth; proud of every criminal he has caught
Quirk: smug and gleeful

npcs.name: Lisores
npcs.info:
The priest of the big church, a very old man now, his thick curly hair gone white under a tall hat and his eyebrows and moustache grown wild enough to hide most of his face. He wears his ornate vestments even to sweep the steps. Children who dig a tape out of the heaps bring it to him first, and he lets them down into the cellar to watch it.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and fond, an old priest's rumble under a great moustache; he asks a child questions he already knows the answer to, so the child can be the one to say it.
**Combat Role:** none; an old priest who stands in a doorway with his arms spread and dares anyone to push past him
**Relationship Hook:** An old priest in ornate vestments holding out a key ring to a child with a videotape, his moustache hiding a smile.
personality: Core: asks a child what the tape was about before asking anything else; blesses a newcomer in whichever faith they seem to carry; keeps the cellar key on his belt and never once locks it against a child
Quirk: grieves in the cellar, alone, with the television off

npcs.name: Locust Plain Shepherd
npcs.info:
An old shepherd with a crook, a sheepskin vest and a sheepdog at his heel, who keeps a turf hut at the edge of the long-grass plain. He says that in some years the whole plain rattles loud enough to hear in Soufrabi, and he cuts a notch in his doorpost every year.

**Speaking Style:** Creaky and patient, a shepherd who counts the years on a doorpost and says them aloud.
**Combat Role:** none; he herds the flock into the hut and bars the door
**Relationship Hook:** An old shepherd crouching on his doorstep to peer at a single pearl-white locust.
personality: Core: patient; talks to his dog; wary of the wind
Quirk: counts the years

npcs.name: Longhi
npcs.info:
A royal guard of the fifth prince Tubeppa, a woman in her twenties with fair hair tied back in a long ponytail and gaunt cheeks, in the black suit and tie of the royal bodyguard. She came up through the Royal Military Academy and was always near the top of her class. She is careful and less vocal than her superior Maor, and prefers a written letter to any signal that could be intercepted.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and precise, a soldier who chooses each word as if it will be read back to her.
**Combat Role:** a trained royal guard who would rather bind an enemy with an agreement than draw on him
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt guard with a long fair ponytail sealing a letter in a corridor of the royal tier.
personality: Core: careful and discreet; quiet beside her superior; a cold anger she never names
Quirk: gives nothing away

npcs.name: Lorcan Fairweather
npcs.info:
A Blacklist Hunter of about thirty-five staying in a telescope suite at the Hotel Skyreach, a lean man with a scarred chin, short dark hair and a grey overcoat he never takes off. He spends his days at the brass telescope, watching the tower's lit floors, and his evenings at ringside on the lower floors as a spectator.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, polite and very still, a man who leaves long silences and lets the other person fill them.
**Combat Role:** an Enhancer's grip and a hunter's patience, waiting for the target to step outside
**Relationship Hook:** A lean man in a grey overcoat at a brass telescope, the lit floors of a great tower filling the night window.
personality: Core: patient as a heron; speaks little and listens much; courteous to staff
Quirk: keeps his coat on indoors

npcs.name: Lorenz Abel
npcs.info:
The chief pilot and charter manager at the Parasta blimp works, a lean man in a leather flying jacket with a pilot's watch and a smile for every client. He keeps the list of pilots and their rates on the desk and flies the difficult jobs himself.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and warm, a pilot's voice that sounds as if everything is under control, especially when it is not.
**Combat Role:** none; a pilot's nerve and a blimp he can take up in minutes
**Relationship Hook:** A pilot in a leather jacket running his hand along the seam of a freshly patched blimp.
personality: Core: confident and charming; checks every seam twice; flies the jobs nobody else will
Quirk: keeps no record when asked

npcs.name: Lorna Vance
npcs.info:
The receptionist of the Hotel Starling, a round-faced woman in her thirties in a green blazer with a name badge, who knows the bus routes, the cheap restaurants and which of the twin rooms has the best view of the rooftops. Families and students like her.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and chatty, a receptionist's voice that offers a city map before you ask.
**Combat Role:** none; she rings the manager and locks the key rack
**Relationship Hook:** A round-faced receptionist in a green blazer handing a room key over a lobby desk among potted palms.
personality: Core: warm; practical; mothers the young guests
Quirk: does not ask questions

npcs.name: Lorne Haskett
npcs.info:
The owner of the gypsum quarry, a heavy, white-whiskered man of sixty-six who worked the pit until the price fell and now lives alone in a shed by the rusting dragline. He still walks the rim every morning as if the crews were coming.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and slow, a ruined businessman who sounds as if he is still giving orders to a crew.
**Combat Role:** none; a shotgun from the shed door, fired at the sky
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy old man in a dusty tweed jacket beside a rusting dragline, looking down into a white quarry with a flask.
personality: Core: walks the rim every morning; talks of the quarry's good years; never goes down to the pit floor at night
Quirk: drinks earlier every day

npcs.name: Lothar Grebe
npcs.info:
The owner of the cannery on the quay, a red-faced man in a rubber apron and a good watch, who employs half the families of the lower town and greets every boat by name.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and loud on the quay, thin and hurried whenever the talk turns to money.
**Combat Role:** none; a businessman who talks and pays and talks again
**Relationship Hook:** A red-faced man in a rubber apron counting crates of fish on a quay, glancing over his shoulder at a dark car.
personality: Core: jovial in public; loyal to his workers; bad with money
Quirk: frightened in private

npcs.name: Lotte Brandt
npcs.info:
The baker, a broad, flour-dusted woman who lights her brick oven at three in the morning so the crews can take a loaf to sea. She is the first person awake on the island and the first to see who comes home late, and she has the tact never to mention it.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and drowsy, a baker's soft early-morning voice that hums between sentences.
**Combat Role:** none; a long wooden peel and the oven's heat
**Relationship Hook:** A flour-dusted baker sliding a loaf onto a windowsill in the dark before dawn.
personality: Core: sees everything at dawn and says nothing; feeds the crews before herself; shy about kindness
Quirk: hums while she works

npcs.name: Lotte Spoon
npcs.info:
A small, stubborn girl who digs for videotapes with a soup spoon and a sack, and sorts her finds on the flat rock as if she were running a stall. She is looking for one particular cartoon, and she has looked for a long time.

**Speaking Style:** High, stubborn and fast, a little girl who argues every point and sings when she thinks nobody is listening.
**Combat Role:** none; she runs, ducks under the heaps and screams loud enough to bring the inner zones
**Relationship Hook:** A small girl in an oversized coat kneeling on a slab, holding a cassette up to the dusk light.
personality: Core: holds every cassette up to the light before keeping it; argues swaps like a market trader; sings the cartoon's theme off-key
Quirk: refuses to dig in threes

npcs.name: Louie Sorrento
npcs.info:
A short, fat bookmaker in a camel overcoat and a trilby, with a pencil moustache and three rings, who runs the betting stand on the stadium concourse. He takes bets on the football, the weather and anything else a man will put money on.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, nasal and wheedling, a bookmaker's patter that makes every bet sound like a favour.
**Combat Role:** a coward with a snub pistol and two heavies, who pays someone else to do it
**Relationship Hook:** A short fat bookmaker in a trilby chalking odds on a board in a stadium concourse.
personality: Core: wheedling; always counting; cowardly in a fight
Quirk: knows everyone's debts

npcs.name: Loupe Highland
npcs.info:
A Hunter who looks for people whom others have lost touch with, a slim, dark-skinned man with glasses and a strong jaw, in a black turtleneck and jeans. He is calm and perceptive, and ready to ignore moral questions when they get in the way.

**Speaking Style:** A calm, quiet, observant voice that keeps its opinions to itself until they are useful.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's Nen and a tracker's patience
**Relationship Hook:** A man in glasses quietly counting the votes while a hall breaks into chaos.
personality: Core: calm and perceptive; keeps his opinions to himself; an opportunist
Quirk: pragmatic past the point of ethics

npcs.name: Lucien Varga
npcs.info:
The manager of the seaside hotel the commission takes over each year, a slim man with a pencil moustache and a perfect tie. His staff are paid extra to forget the week's guests.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and deferential, a hotelier's voice that never asks a guest anything personal.
**Combat Role:** none; a manager who calls the commission's guards
**Relationship Hook:** A slim hotel manager with a pencil moustache standing behind a lobby desk, sorting room keys.
personality: Core: discreet; observant; takes pride in service
Quirk: privately judgemental

npcs.name: Ludo
npcs.info:
A young goatherd who walks the ridge tracks of the forbidden hills with a dozen goats and a cheerful whistle. He tells village boys there is good work in the hills for the strong and the quiet, and they come back rich and quiet.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, bright and persuasive, a young man who makes the hills sound like a fortune.
**Combat Role:** a hill runner with a knife who outruns pursuit on paths no stranger knows
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning young goatherd on the ridge track, leaning on his staff and telling a farm boy about good work.
personality: Core: charming and quick; knows every hidden path; beginning to feel guilty
Quirk: recruits with a smile

npcs.name: Ludo Brenner
npcs.info:
The furnace master of the smelter, a barrel-chested man who works stripped to the waist with a soaked mask over his face and a shovel twice his height. He decides what goes into the melt, how long it stays there and who may stand close enough to watch.

**Speaking Style:** A bellow made for the roar of a furnace, rough and huge, laughing between orders.
**Combat Role:** a furnace brute who swings a long iron shovel and flings a scoop of glowing slag
**Relationship Hook:** A shirtless barrel-chested man against a glowing furnace mouth, a long shovel over his shoulder.
personality: Core: tastes the smoke and judges the melt by it; feeds his crew before himself; laughs only at the furnace
Quirk: roars at anyone who steps into the furnace's light

npcs.name: Ludo Fenwick
npcs.info:
A long-faced man in a cardigan and fingerless gloves who keeps the middle pawnshop on the lane, looking at the world through a jeweller's loupe. He sat the exam six times and keeps all six badges in a frame behind the counter.

**Speaking Style:** A dry, lazy, superior voice that treats every customer as a little slower than he is.
**Combat Role:** a cautious old applicant who keeps a loaded crossbow under the counter and a buzzer to the back
**Relationship Hook:** A long-faced pawnbroker peering at a sword through his loupe and asking, mildly, where its owner has gone.
personality: Core: superior and lazy-voiced; keeps his own failures on the wall; never asks where a thing came from
Quirk: talks frightened people out of their courage

npcs.name: Lulu Marchetti
npcs.info:
The barmaid of the Skyway Lobby Bar, a curvy woman of thirty with dark curls pinned up, who has poured drinks for airship crews for eight years. She knows every pilot's favourite and every stewardess's sorrows, and she lets nobody run a tab twice.

**Speaking Style:** Low, lazy and teasing, a barmaid who makes every regular feel like the only one.
**Combat Role:** none; a bottle of soda water to the face and a shout to the doorman
**Relationship Hook:** A curly-haired barmaid polishing a glass at a long bar, airships floating past the window behind her.
personality: Core: remembers every regular's drink; lets nobody run a tab twice; hums along to the radio between orders
Quirk: pretends not to hear what she is clearly hearing

npcs.name: Lupe Navarro
npcs.info:
A grill cook in the night market, a broad, laughing woman with her hair under a red bandana and a smear of sauce on her cheek. Her skewer stall at the head of the food lane is always the busiest, and she feeds half-price to any fighter who shows her a bruise from that day's bouts.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, laughing and musical, a grill cook who sings out orders over the smoke.
**Combat Role:** none; a grill fork, a pan of hot oil and a lane full of stallholders who come running
**Relationship Hook:** A laughing grill cook in a red bandana holding up a fan of skewers through the smoke of a night market lane.
personality: Core: loud and generous; sings while she cooks; feeds the broke
Quirk: keeps a grudge under the charcoal

npcs.name: Lutz Ambrozy
npcs.info:
A poacher who works the lowland forest between the foot of the mountain and the highway, setting snares for deer on the old trails and selling the meat to the diner and the inn without a licence. He is wiry and unshaven, dressed in muddy green, with a rifle he keeps oiled better than himself.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and drawling, a poacher's low voice that never carries further than it has to.
**Combat Role:** a hunting rifle, a skinning knife and the forest's cover; he prefers not to be found
**Relationship Hook:** A muddy poacher crouching on a fern trail, turning a pistol casing over in his fingers.
personality: Core: sells meat to anyone who does not ask; mistrusts the police and the butlers equally; kind to dogs, never to men
Quirk: quiet and watchful

npcs.name: Luzurus Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The seventh prince of Kakin and the second queen Duazul's son by birth, a thin man with a large pointed nose, a rectangular face and stubble, his hair combed back and curled into two puffs at the sides. He is the patron of the Cha-R Family, one of Kakin's three Mafia houses, and Basho guards him on the voyage. His half-brother Tserriednich thinks him a fool.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and unworried, a man who does not seem to know how much danger he is in.
**Combat Role:** none shown; a prince who leans on the Cha-R Family and his Hunter guard
**Relationship Hook:** A thin prince with puffed-out hair leaning back in a chair, unbothered while his guard checks the door.
personality: Core: relaxed and open-minded; accepts strange news calmly; patron of a rough family
Quirk: underestimated by his family

npcs.name: Lü Dingshan
npcs.info:
The corporal who runs the cell block's day watch, a soft-spoken, balding man with a bunch of keys on a chain and a book of crossword puzzles in his pocket. He was a prison guard ashore for twelve years before the army lent him to the ship, and he treats his prisoners with the same tired courtesy whoever they are.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, patient and a little sad, a jailer who knows his prisoners' names and uses them.
**Combat Role:** a prison guard with a baton and keys, who ends fights by shutting a door at the right moment
**Relationship Hook:** A balding jailer sliding a meal tray under a steel door, a crossword book poking from his pocket.
personality: Core: uses prisoners' names; never hurries a meal tray; hands the first-class key to no one but the court
Quirk: writes orders in his crossword margins

npcs.name: Ma Pong-hak
npcs.info:
An old fisherman who has fished the slow river from the same stool for longer than the revolution has been in power. He is brown and bent and wears a straw hat and a coat with more patches than coat, and he knows every reed bed, every eel hole and every sentry on the rail bridge by his first name.

**Speaking Style:** A slow old rasp that tells a story backwards and stops to light a pipe halfway.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a fishing pole and a boat nobody else can find
**Relationship Hook:** An old fisherman on a stool in the reeds, pole out over a slow river, pretending not to watch the bridge.
personality: Core: slow and unbothered; asks no questions and expects none; keeps his promises and nothing else
Quirk: talks to the river

npcs.name: Ma Tiekou
npcs.info:
The weighmaster of the bonded warehouses, a barrel-chested man with forearms like hawsers who sits beside the biggest platform scale with a book on his knee. Every load that comes in under seal is weighed under his eye, and drivers who argue with his figures find their lorries waiting till evening.

**Speaking Style:** Thick, slow and smoke-worn, a weighmaster who reads numbers aloud like a verdict.
**Combat Role:** a heavy brawler with a steel bar from the scale, backed by the warehouse guards
**Relationship Hook:** A barrel-chested weighmaster spitting seed shells onto a platform scale as he reads out a load.
personality: Core: reads every figure aloud; never writes in pencil; sends arguing drivers to the back of the queue
Quirk: eats sunflower seeds and spits the shells on the scale

npcs.name: Mabel Fenwick
npcs.info:
A small, quick woman in her late sixties who has run the newsstand by the boarding gates since the departure lounge was built. She reads every magazine before she sells it, saves the crosswords for the pilots, and tells passengers which flights are late before the board does.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, warm and full of opinions, an old woman who reviews the news as she hands it over.
**Combat Role:** none; she rings the lounge's alarm bell and calls for a policeman by name
**Relationship Hook:** A small old woman behind a newsstand, peering over her reading glasses at a magazine headline.
personality: Core: keeps a crossword for her favourite pilots; knows the delays before the board; reads other people's letters and feels guilty about half of them
Quirk: reviews every headline aloud

npcs.name: Machi Komacine
npcs.info:
Member number three of the Phantom Troupe, a small young woman with pink hair tied up, dressed like a modern kunoichi, with a pincushion on her glove. She is one of the coldest members and the one whose intuition the Troupe trusts. She sews with threads of aura, and her stitches can rejoin a severed arm.

**Speaking Style:** A cool, flat, unimpressed young woman's voice, brief to the point of rudeness, which almost never shows what she feels.
**Combat Role:** threads of aura that bind, cut and trip, and an intuition that has saved the Troupe many times
**Relationship Hook:** A small woman with pink hair sewing a severed arm back onto a smiling man, unimpressed.
personality: Core: cold, laconic and unflappable; kinder to her comrades than she admits; despises Hisoka and works with him anyway
Quirk: trusts her intuition and is usually right

npcs.name: Mack Fennimore
npcs.info:
A homeless man in a shack of board and tarpaulin under the rail embankment, big-framed and gone gaunt, with a matted beard and one cloudy eye, who keeps a brazier going and the stray dogs in line. The children of the tenements dare each other to throw stones at his roof.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and wrecked, a drinker's rasp that still goes cold and exact when it matters.
**Combat Role:** an old professional killer gone to seed who still waits for the moment and ends it with a wire
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt bearded man in ragged coats warming his hands at a brazier outside a tarpaulin shack, dogs at his feet.
personality: Core: silent; watchful; drinks to sleep
Quirk: gentle with the dogs

npcs.name: Mads
npcs.info:
A fen boy of fourteen who checks the eel traps at dawn from a flat boat and knows the log causeway well enough to run it in the dark. He sells eels at the market and reeds to the thatchers, and talks to the herons.

**Speaking Style:** A boy's eager chatter, stumbling over itself, proud of every trap and every eel.
**Combat Role:** none; a fen boy who poles away into the reeds
**Relationship Hook:** A barefoot boy poling a flat boat through the reeds, lifting a wicker trap with nothing in it.
personality: Core: knows the fen better than anyone; brave on the water, scared on land; wants to be taken seriously
Quirk: eager and talkative

npcs.name: Mafia Hacker
npcs.info:
A slim young man with delicate features and messy hair grown over his ears and down across his right eye. He sits in a loft of humming towers with the blinds shut, and the families call him when they need someone found on paper instead of on the street. He never gives his name to them and they never ask.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy and pleased with itself, a young man's voice that hints first and explains a moment later, to watch the listener wait.
**Combat Role:** none in person; he fights through records and leaves any door to the men who pay him
**Relationship Hook:** A slim young man with hair over one eye leaning back from a bank of glowing screens, smiling at a secret.
personality: Core: confident to the point of rudeness; quick to deduce; keeps out of the street
Quirk: speaks in riddles before he explains

npcs.name: Magda Ferreira
npcs.info:
A big, red-armed fishmonger in a rubber apron who has had the corner stall in the fish aisle for twenty years and shouts the morning's catch from before light. She buys from the estuary boats and sells to the lorry drivers' wives, and she knows everyone's business by noon.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, fast and salty, a fishwife's voice built to carry the length of the hall and win every price.
**Combat Role:** none; a gutting knife she never draws and a voice that brings the market running
**Relationship Hook:** A big fishmonger in a rubber apron holding up a flatfish and bellowing a price down a crowded market hall.
personality: Core: loud and warm at once; never forgets a face or a debt; generous to widows
Quirk: hates a haggler she cannot beat

npcs.name: Magda Holub
npcs.info:
The biggest trader in the junk market, holding three stalls under one tarpaulin and a barter book only she can read. She swaps anything for anything, and a resident who needs a thing that cannot be found asks her before giving up.

**Speaking Style:** Throaty and amused, a market trader's patter that sounds generous and gives nothing away.
**Combat Role:** none; her stall boys and the whole market answer a shout from her
**Relationship Hook:** A stout woman with rings on every finger behind three stalls of salvage, a barter book open on her knee.
personality: Core: never names what she wants first; rests a hand on a deal's goods until it is done; laughs loudest at her own bad trades
Quirk: keeps the barter book in a code of her own

npcs.name: Mags Dunmore
npcs.info:
The senior skipper of the fleet, a weathered, heavy-set woman of sixty in an orange oilskin who has fished the island's grounds for forty-five years and takes her boat out in weather that keeps the young ones in harbour. Every family's marks were settled at her father's table, and she remembers who agreed to what.

**Speaking Style:** Gravel and gale, a senior skipper's voice used to being heard over engines and weather.
**Combat Role:** a heavy skipper with a gaff and a voice that stops a fight between crews
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy-set old skipper in orange oilskins at the wheel, gulls diving all around the boat.
personality: Core: remembers every agreement about the marks; goes out in weather that keeps others in; hides worry under orders
Quirk: brooks no argument at sea

npcs.name: Maha Zoldyck
npcs.info:
The oldest living Zoldyck, Zeno's grandfather, a tiny, withered old man. He keeps to himself and has no close ties to anyone in the family, yet still takes contracts when the family needs a hand. The underworld treats his name as a legend.

**Speaking Style:** A thin, cracked whisper of a voice from a very old man, few words at long intervals, and no warmth in any of them.
**Combat Role:** a lifetime of assassination in a shrunken body, and an aura nobody alive has measured
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny ancient man standing perfectly still in a corridor while a Mafia boss goes white.
personality: Core: still works when the family calls; has outlived every rival but one; unreadable, even to his grandsons
Quirk: cold, distant and silent

npcs.name: Maita
npcs.info:
A large, bulky prizefighter with a bald head, narrow eyes and thick bushy eyebrows that meet when he frowns. He came to the tower to make his size pay, and on the floors where size still counts it mostly does. He eats on the benches between bouts and never shares.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, heavy and wheezing a little, a big man who announces each punch before he throws it.
**Combat Role:** a heavyweight's clinch and shove, leaning his whole weight on the smaller fighter
**Relationship Hook:** A huge bald fighter with bushy eyebrows eating a rice ball on the bench while his name crackles over the speaker.
personality: Core: slow to anger and slower to calm; thinks size settles everything; respects anyone who knocks him down
Quirk: eats whenever he is not fighting

npcs.name: Maizan
npcs.info:
A corporal of the Royal Army posted to the third tier, with squinting eyes, a large nose and a moustache under a dark helmet. He calms crowds outside the court, takes statements and keeps order with a smile, and he is shrewd and careful about whom he trusts.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and wheedling in a crowd, low and grasping when the talk turns to money.
**Combat Role:** an army corporal with a rifle who trusts the safety catch off
**Relationship Hook:** A moustached corporal leaning close to a mobster, palm open for cash, while a crowd waits behind.
personality: Core: fears double-crosses; calms crowds with easy lies; flinches at an icy smile
Quirk: sells information for cash up front

npcs.name: Majtani
npcs.info:
A big, blue-skinned prisoner with a bald, stitched crown, spiky green hair around it and a face left half-corpse by botched surgery, a respirator where his right ear should be, rings through his lip and nothing on but torn prison trousers. He is inside for fraud and blackmail, and he wears a spider tattoo he is very proud of.

**Speaking Style:** A loud, blustering bark that brags too fast and climbs to a squeak when the bluff is called.
**Combat Role:** all bluff; one steel-weighted punch thrown to scare, and a collapse the moment it fails
**Relationship Hook:** A blue-skinned convict with a stitched scalp flexing a scarred fist at a mess table, while the men around him look unimpressed.
personality: Core: a coward under a monster's face; brags without pause; folds the moment he is hit
Quirk: sure the tattoo will do the work

npcs.name: Mamen Beans
npcs.info:
The chairman's personal secretary, a short green man shaped rather like a bean, with no nose, always in a black tuxedo. He runs a hundred errands for the Association with real enthusiasm and hands out the numbered badges at the start of the exam. Nobody is sure whether he is human.

**Speaking Style:** A small, polite, eager voice, quick and earnest, that apologises often and runs errands while it talks.
**Combat Role:** none he shows; a secretary's diligence
**Relationship Hook:** A little green man in a tuxedo pressing a numbered badge into a boy's hand with a bow.
personality: Core: dutiful and enthusiastic; polite to everyone, applicants included; keeps secrets the Association does not know exist
Quirk: loyal to the chairman above all

npcs.name: Manheim
npcs.info:
A portly man in a big t-shirt over a long-sleeved shirt, baggy trousers and a snapback cap worn backwards, with a thin vertical goatee and droopy brows. He plays on Asta's team and leaves the arguing to her.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy and easy, a man who lets his leader do the shouting and steps in with a deal.
**Combat Role:** a mild player who avoids fights and trusts spells and a quick exit
**Relationship Hook:** A portly man in a backwards cap sliding two cards across a table to stop a quarrel.
personality: Core: laid-back; thinks in conditions and triggers; slow to alarm
Quirk: smooths over his leader's temper

npcs.name: Marayam Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The thirteenth prince of Kakin and younger child of the seventh queen Sevanti, a small boy with short spiky teal hair and wide-set black eyes, in a tuxedo with a bow tie and shorts at formal events. He carries his pet hamster everywhere, loves video games and keeps his bad feelings to himself.

**Speaking Style:** A small boy's bright voice, loud with joy over a game and silent when he is scared.
**Combat Role:** none; a child surrounded by guards
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy in a tuxedo and shorts holding a hamster up to show a smiling bodyguard.
personality: Core: cheerful about games; hides fear and sadness; independent for his age
Quirk: loves his hamster

npcs.name: Marcos
npcs.info:
The military leader of East Gorteau's government, a tall man with combed-back hair, deep forehead lines, narrow eyes and a straight nose, always in the regime's uniform. He owes his post to the revolution and has carried out its orders for decades. He is strict and hard, and he loves his family.

**Speaking Style:** Stiff, hard and military, a general's voice that softens only when his family comes up.
**Combat Role:** a general who commands; he fights only with the army behind him
**Relationship Hook:** A tall general on a reviewing stand watching soldiers march, his mind somewhere else.
personality: Core: strict and military; pragmatic about loyalty; carries the regime's crimes without speaking of them
Quirk: devoted to his family

npcs.name: Marek Vossberg
npcs.info:
A broad, grey-bearded man in a salt-stained pea coat who rents the room over the chandler's on Harbour Street between contracts. He was born on the island, left it on a trawler at sixteen, and came back with a Hunter licence and a reputation among salvage firms as the man to call when a hull sinks somewhere nobody else can reach. He swims every morning off the quay in water that makes the fishermen wince.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and weathered, a big man who rations his words like water on a long passage and laughs once, low, when something genuinely surprises him.
**Combat Role:** a heavy brawler who fights best waist-deep or under the surface, a boat hook in one fist and aura packed into the other
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-bearded man stepping out of icy harbour water at dawn as if it were a warm bath.
personality: Core: unhurried in everything except the water; says little about his work and nothing about his failures; measures every stranger by how they stand on a moving deck
Quirk: buys the old skippers their drinks and listens to them for hours

npcs.name: Margit Ellery
npcs.info:
The secretary of the wheat cooperative on the western plain, a round, rosy woman with a pencil in her hair and the keys to every silo on her belt. She keeps the books, the rota for the harvesters and the noticeboard that is the closest thing the plain has to a newspaper.

**Speaking Style:** Busy and cheerful, a cooperative secretary who talks while writing and keeps three conversations going.
**Combat Role:** none; a ring of silo keys and a voice that stops an argument
**Relationship Hook:** A round, rosy secretary pinning a notice to a crowded cooperative noticeboard while farmers argue behind her.
personality: Core: cheerful and busy; knows everyone's books; never sits down
Quirk: quietly bends the rules for the poor

npcs.name: Margit Holloway
npcs.info:
The arena's chief matchmaker, a broad-shouldered woman of fifty with a grey bob, reading glasses on a chain and a cigarette she never lights. She decides who fights whom and when on every floor up to the 200th, and her wall chart of coloured pins is the most important map in the tower.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, loud and always on two phones, a matchmaker who talks over everybody, including herself.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy desk, a telephone and a security button under the blotter
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired matchmaker with a phone at each ear stabbing a coloured pin into a wall chart of bouts.
personality: Core: brusque and efficient; loves a good card more than any fighter; refuses to be impressed
Quirk: rearranges pins when angry

npcs.name: Margit Solberg
npcs.info:
The doctor of Dentora Clinic, a tall, quiet woman in her sixties with her hair in a long grey plait. She treats sprains from the mountain paths, food poisoning from the market and, once in a long while, something worse carried down from the gate road.

**Speaking Style:** Unhurried and low, a country doctor's voice that makes a sprain sound like nothing and a bite sound like something she has seen before.
**Combat Role:** none; a doctor's hands and the clinic's ambulance
**Relationship Hook:** A tall grey-haired doctor behind a pharmacy counter, unhurriedly filling a prescription while a tourist shouts.
personality: Core: calm in any emergency; asks no questions a patient does not want; keeps records nobody else sees
Quirk: lets complainers wait

npcs.name: Margot Pryce
npcs.info:
The head nurse of the private floor of the Yorknew Metropolitan Hospital, a tall woman in her fifties with steel-grey hair in a tight bun and a fob watch on her chest. She runs the floor's single rooms and the armed men who sit outside their doors with the same unblinking calm.

**Speaking Style:** Low, measured and in charge, a head nurse's voice that never lets a guard argue twice.
**Combat Role:** none; she has the floor locked and security on the phone before a gun clears its holster
**Relationship Hook:** A tall grey-haired head nurse with a clipboard staring down an armed guard in a carpeted corridor.
personality: Core: unflappable; accepts gifts without blinking; fiercely protective of patients
Quirk: runs her floor like a ship

npcs.name: Marguerite Velloc
npcs.info:
A broad-shouldered woman in her forties in rubber boots, a waxed jacket and a wool cap, who stands at the front of every morning sale with a torch and a steel probe. She buys for three restaurants in Zaban City, and the fishermen say she can tell a tuna's last meal from the colour of its belly.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, fast and dry, a buyer's voice built to cut through an auction and not to apologise afterwards.
**Combat Role:** a heavy-handed cook with a gaff hook and a filleting knife, who fights like she guts a catch
**Relationship Hook:** A stern woman in a wool cap shining a torch into a tuna's gills and telling the auctioneer to start again.
personality: Core: blunt to the point of rudeness; never overpays twice; kind to the porters' children
Quirk: judges people the way she judges fish, by the eyes

npcs.name: Marione
npcs.info:
A Temp Hunter on Beyond's team who looks like an ordinary schoolgirl in uniform, with teal hair in twin tails and lines on her face like a marionette's. She rarely speaks and, when she does, sounds like a machine.

**Speaking Style:** A flat, mechanical young voice that rarely speaks, like a doll saying its lines.
**Combat Role:** a specialist's ability and a Ren that silences a room
**Relationship Hook:** A schoolgirl with marionette lines on her face rising from a corner, her eyes empty.
personality: Core: reticent and robotic; the strongest of her team; obeys the team's leader
Quirk: expressionless

npcs.name: Marisol Oake
npcs.info:
A Beast Hunter in her thirties with a sun hat, a net and a field notebook, who studies the crimson butterflies of Zevil Island between exams. She keeps to the glade and looks up only when the clouds of wings lift all at once.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and slow, a voice used to talking without frightening anything with wings.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter who avoids a fight, and ends one with a grip and a throw when she cannot
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in a sun hat standing still in a flower glade under a cloud of crimson butterflies, writing in a notebook.
personality: Core: patient; precise; quietly disapproving
Quirk: cares more for the butterflies than the applicants

npcs.name: Marisol Venn
npcs.info:
The skipper of a mainland longliner crewed entirely by women, sheltering on the outer mole from the same weather as everyone else. She is lean and sun-browned, wears a battered captain's jacket over a fisherman's smock, and has been putting into Whale Island in bad weather for ten years.

**Speaking Style:** Amused and unhurried, a skipper's low drawl that teases and gives orders in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** a skipper's quick knife and a gaff, and a crew who come over the rail at her whistle
**Relationship Hook:** A sun-browned skipper with a long braid leaning on a bollard, grinning at the weather.
personality: Core: never raises her voice on deck and never needs to; keeps a book of every port's gossip; treats the island's children as her crew's business
Quirk: teases everyone she likes

npcs.name: Marta Chalk
npcs.info:
The senior caretaker, chosen by the neighbours because nobody could remember her losing a child in her charge. She chalks every name above every cot each evening and rubs out none until she knows why. Leave to go past the end of the street is hers to give, and she refuses it far more often than not.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and unhurried, a bedtime voice that never rises and somehow never needs to.
**Combat Role:** none; she puts herself between a child and the door and does not move
**Relationship Hook:** A plump caretaker chalking a child's name onto a cot post, a sweet already waiting in her other hand.
personality: Core: counts the cots twice before she sleeps; never raises her voice; asks where a child is going before asking anything else
Quirk: keeps a sweet in her apron for the youngest

npcs.name: Marta Kovach
npcs.info:
A widow from Dentora who sets up a folding table in the lay-by at the cliff bend on weekends and sells flowers to drivers who pull in to look at the view. Her buckets are full of mountain lilies and garden roses, and she always keeps one bunch back.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and steady, a flower seller's voice with a catch in it when she looks at the rail.
**Combat Role:** none; a folding table and a loud voice for passing cars
**Relationship Hook:** A widow in a shawl tying a bunch of white lilies to a buckled guard rail above a long drop.
personality: Core: kind to every driver; keeps one bunch back; will not look at cars from the mountain
Quirk: remembers every accident on the road

npcs.name: Marta Kowalczyk
npcs.info:
The cook of the ground crew village's canteen, a broad, red-armed woman of fifty who has served soup to every shift for twenty years and buried a husband who worked the runways. She knows every family in the village and every child's birthday, and she reads the night shift's faces when they come in.

**Speaking Style:** Big, warm and scolding, a cook who feeds you first and asks questions over the second bowl.
**Combat Role:** none; a ladle and a big voice, and the whole canteen on its feet behind her
**Relationship Hook:** A broad cook in a kerchief ladling soup through a hatch, eyeing the night shift as they file in.
personality: Core: feeds everyone before she listens; scolds the young men like sons; keeps a calendar of every child's birthday
Quirk: goes quiet whenever someone mentions the night shift

npcs.name: Marta Quell
npcs.info:
The chief herbalist of the country's largest house of healing, a tall, grey-eyed woman in a grey apron who fights fever with willow bark and steam and wounds with honey and clean linen. No modern medicine crosses the border, so she makes do, and she is very good at it.

**Speaking Style:** Low, unhurried and kind, a healer's voice that does not rise even at a deathbed.
**Combat Role:** none; a healer who keeps the wounded alive
**Relationship Hook:** A tall healer in a grey apron bent over a rope bed, a steaming pan in her hands.
personality: Core: calm and capable; keeps her word and her lists; honest with the dying
Quirk: angry underneath at the deaths

npcs.name: Mascher
npcs.info:
A fat Temp Hunter on Beyond's team, of average height, with fair hair in a bowl cut, an egg-shaped head, round eyes, freckles and a double chin, in a military jacket. He is quick to threaten a stranger and actually sensible, ready to weigh an offer on its merits.

**Speaking Style:** A heavy, blunt voice that threatens first and listens second, and admits it when it is wrong.
**Combat Role:** a martial artist's stance and an ability that throws extra shadows
**Relationship Hook:** A fat man in a bowl cut dropping into a fighting stance, three shadows stretching away from him.
personality: Core: aggressive at first, sensible after; not a sore loser; comes to admire a worthy rival
Quirk: weighs pros and cons

npcs.name: Masta
npcs.info:
A short, stocky Hunter with a round nose and spiky black hair, always in a suit and black sunglasses, who judges matches at the exam. He is calm and over-serious and allows nobody to interfere with a fight he is refereeing.

**Speaking Style:** A flat, serious, clipped voice that announces rules and results and tolerates no interruptions.
**Combat Role:** a judge's eye and a Hunter's speed to stop a match
**Relationship Hook:** A stocky man in sunglasses raising his hand to start a match between a ninja and a boy.
personality: Core: calm and over-serious; will not tolerate interference; observes applicants in secret
Quirk: dislikes chatter

npcs.name: Mathis Eberle
npcs.info:
The caretaker of the white chapel on the hill, a thin old man with a broom, who sweeps the steps, rings the bell and tends the graves of the fishermen.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, reverent old voice that lowers itself in the graveyard without being asked.
**Combat Role:** none; an old caretaker with a broom
**Relationship Hook:** A thin old caretaker sweeping the white steps of a small chapel, gravestones behind him.
personality: Core: quiet; devout; lonely
Quirk: faithful to the dead

npcs.name: Matteo Castellan
npcs.info:
The night shift foreman at the cement works, a big, grey-dusted man of forty-eight with a wife and four daughters in the outskirts. Most of the new towers downtown stand on slabs he poured, and he is proud of every one.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and steady, a foreman with a deep laugh and a habit of resting his hand on your shoulder.
**Combat Role:** a strong labourer; a shovel and a shoulder, and the kiln's heat behind him
**Relationship Hook:** A big dusty foreman in a hard hat before the glowing mouth of a cement kiln, a folded note in his hand.
personality: Core: laughs from the belly; proud of every foundation he has poured; goes silent when the telephone rings in the office
Quirk: talks about his daughters constantly

npcs.name: Matthias Brenner
npcs.info:
The eldest son of the dairy family on the high pasture, a big, handsome young man of twenty-four in a wax jacket and wellingtons who brings the herd down every evening and drives the milk lorry to the road stand at dawn. He is the best worker on the farm and the least often there.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and cocky, a farmer's son who sounds like he has been out all night because he has.
**Combat Role:** a strong farmhand's fists and a lorry he drives too fast
**Relationship Hook:** A big young farmer in a wax jacket heaving a milk churn onto a roadside stand at dawn, mountains behind.
personality: Core: charming and reckless; works hard when he is there; loves the farm and wants more
Quirk: lies to his father

npcs.name: Matthias Kell
npcs.info:
A big, slow-moving man of sixty-five with a white beard and forearms like hams who keeps the livery stable on the east edge of the city. He breeds Piko, the tall riding birds, and knows which ones bite.

**Speaking Style:** A slow, gravelly old voice that talks to the birds more kindly than to the customers.
**Combat Role:** a big old man who fights with a pitchfork and his weight, and a bird that kicks
**Relationship Hook:** A big old man stroking a riding bird's long neck and asking whether you are from the east.
personality: Core: slow and kind; talks to animals; keeps his own counsel
Quirk: grieves for people he barely knew

npcs.name: Matthias Oberholz
npcs.info:
An old goat farmer on the steep pasture north-west of town, whose cheese is sold in the market and served at the inn. He lives alone with a sheepdog and a hundred goats and has not been to the town in a month.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and quiet, an old farmer's voice that weighs each word and lets long silences say the rest.
**Combat Role:** none; a shepherd's crook and a sheepdog
**Relationship Hook:** An old farmer leaning on his crook, staring at a huge pawprint in the mud while his dog presses against his legs.
personality: Core: quiet and patient; knows each goat by name; keeps his worries to himself
Quirk: talks to the sheepdog more than to people

npcs.name: Matyas Varnay
npcs.info:
A ten-year-old boy of the tenements, small and serious, with a buzz cut, scabbed knees and a hand-me-down tracksuit. He plays at being a Floor Master with the other children in the courtyard and always wins, and lately he has stopped wanting to play.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, earnest and breathless, a small boy who explains things with his whole body.
**Combat Role:** a courtyard brawler's scrambles and something heavy in the air that makes bigger boys back off
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy standing with his eyes closed in a chalk ring, the washing on the lines above him stirring though there is no wind.
personality: Core: earnest and solemn; copies everything he sees; proud and a little frightened
Quirk: sits very still for a child

npcs.name: Maud Ferrier
npcs.info:
The widow who keeps Harbour Rest Guesthouse, a small upright woman in a lace collar who feeds her lodgers at her own table whether they meant to eat or not. Her husband went down with his boat twenty years ago, and she took in the first stranded sailor the week after the funeral.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, motherly and immovable, a widow's voice that says please and means you will.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy iron skillet and the full weight of a widow's disapproval
**Relationship Hook:** A small widow setting another plate on a table nobody asked her to set.
personality: Core: feeds everyone whether they want it or not; will not look in a guest's bag; kind, and not to be argued with
Quirk: keeps a promise past any reason

npcs.name: Melody
npcs.info:
A Music Hunter, short and stocky with androgynous features, thinning silver hair to the shoulders and front teeth that protrude like a rodent's. She always wears a hat in public, long sleeves and leggings, and carries a flute. She is kind, perceptive and calm, and she can hear a heartbeat across a room, which tells her when someone is lying.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, quiet and steady, a voice that calms a room without trying and notices what others feel before they say it.
**Combat Role:** a support fighter who hears an ambush coming, steadies the group's nerves with her flute and keeps out of the brawl
**Relationship Hook:** A small woman in a hat lowering her flute as a frightened room slowly goes calm.
personality: Core: kind and calm; protective of the young and the grieving; hides her body under sleeves and a hat
Quirk: reads people by their heartbeats

npcs.name: Menchi
npcs.info:
A one-star Hunter of food, said to be the finest in the world, who earned her star at twenty-one and sets the second phase's cooking test with Buhara. She has turquoise hair in five topknots, a quick temper and an exacting palate, and she remembers the taste of every food she has ever eaten.

**Speaking Style:** A quick, fierce young woman's voice that judges a dish in one sharp word and explodes when someone insults food.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's speed and a cook's knives, kept for the kitchen
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman with five topknots tasting a sushi roll and spitting it out in disgust.
personality: Core: picky, exacting and quick-tempered; passionate about cooking; fair once she has calmed down
Quirk: fails people for disrespecting food

npcs.name: Meteor City's Elder
npcs.info:
One of the elders who sit in the Assembly, wrapped so thoroughly in dirty rags that nothing of him shows but his eyes, a mouthpiece strapped over his nose and mouth. Residents hurt by someone from outside come to his hut and tell him what happened. He hears every case through to its end and promises nothing.

**Speaking Style:** Muffled by the mouthpiece, dry and patient, each sentence ending a moment after it seems finished.
**Combat Role:** none of his own; he sends another body to do his fighting and stays behind the smoke
**Relationship Hook:** A shape of rags on a low stool behind drifting smoke, eyes glinting above a strapped mouthpiece.
personality: Core: hears a whole grievance without interrupting once; answers a question with a longer silence; burns herbs until the room is hard to see across
Quirk: moves people like pieces on a board, kindly or not

npcs.name: Mibu
npcs.info:
The butler who runs the supply yard's weighbridge, a stocky woman with a pencil behind her ear and a book under her arm. She meets the delivery drivers at the gate, weighs every truck in and out, and logs each crate before the butlers carry it up the mountain.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, sharp and impatient, a clerk's voice that reads weights aloud like accusations.
**Combat Role:** a junior butler's strength and a crate hook; she would rather call for help than lose a load
**Relationship Hook:** A frowning butler with a pencil behind her ear checking the needle on a weighbridge as a truck rolls on.
personality: Core: counts everything twice; short with drivers, fair to them; eats lunch standing
Quirk: hates an unexplained number

npcs.name: Michael
npcs.info:
A neat man in a plain sweater with short hair parted at the side, long sideburns and a thick moustache, who lives in flat 603 of a block near the station. He looks like any office worker on his way home.

**Speaking Style:** A tidy, polite voice that gives directions slowly and repeats the important part.
**Combat Role:** none; a civilian go-between who hands over a card and walks away
**Relationship Hook:** A moustached man in a plain sweater standing at a station newsstand, a newspaper folded under his arm.
personality: Core: polite and unremarkable; keeps to a routine; asks no questions about his employers
Quirk: precise with instructions

npcs.name: Michiro
npcs.info:
A player with fair hair parted to one side, thin brows and a bulb of a nose, in a vest over a long-sleeved shirt. He haunts the pawnshop counter in Dorias, offering trades to players who have just lost at the tables.

**Speaking Style:** Slippery and friendly, a trader's patter that cracks into a stammer when he is caught.
**Combat Role:** none; a cheat who backs down the moment he is found out
**Relationship Hook:** A sweating man at a pawnshop counter handing back one card and digging in his binder for the real one.
personality: Core: friendly until caught; nervous when exposed; makes good when cornered
Quirk: sneaky

npcs.name: Mickey Szabo
npcs.info:
A ten-year-old with scabbed knees and a mechanic's cap too big for him, the son of a runway mechanic, who spends his days at the airport fence with a pair of cracked binoculars. He knows every airship by its engine note and every car on the apron by its colour.

**Speaking Style:** High, eager and breathless, a boy who tells you three things at once and wants a sweet for each.
**Combat Role:** none; he runs, and he is very hard to catch
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy in a huge cap pressed to a chain-link fence, peering at the airships through cracked binoculars.
personality: Core: names airships by their engines; never walks when he can run; lies about his age to sound older
Quirk: trades what he sees for sweets

npcs.name: Mikli
npcs.info:
A heavyset woman with a snub nose and a mole beside it, prominent lower lashes and a round face, in a short-sleeved shirt over a long-sleeved one, trousers with big hearts on the knees and a bum bag on one hip. She passed the billionaire's aura test with the latest batch and sleeps in the spire between days in the spell shop queue.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and anxious, a careful voice that notices numbers other people miss.
**Combat Role:** none; she buys spells and keeps her head down
**Relationship Hook:** A heavyset woman on a spiral stair tearing open a spell pack and frowning at what is inside.
personality: Core: anxious; joins for safety; dutiful in a queue
Quirk: observant of numbers

npcs.name: Mila Varnay
npcs.info:
A retired lift attendant who keeps the stairwell of the biggest tenement block, a slight woman of seventy with silver braids pinned round her head and a stool on the second landing where she shells peas and hears everything. She knows which family works which shift in the tower and which doors to knock on for anything.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and slow, a grandmother who answers questions with stories and stories with questions.
**Combat Role:** none; an old woman on a landing with forty neighbours who listen to her
**Relationship Hook:** A silver-braided grandmother shelling peas on a stairwell landing, looking down at children in a courtyard below.
personality: Core: slow-spoken and wise; knows every family in the block; offers peas to every visitor
Quirk: worries about her grandson

npcs.name: Milluki Zoldyck
npcs.info:
The second Zoldyck son, a heavy teenager in a pink shirt who has not left the estate since he was ten. He works his contracts remotely through computers and gadgets, collects figures and games, and is the only member of the family who understands modern technology. He is spiteful, cowardly and jealous of Killua, whom he also fears.

**Speaking Style:** A whining, nasal teenage voice that sneers at people beneath him, sulks at people above him and calls his parents mama and papa.
**Combat Role:** little face to face; a whip in the punishment cell and every gadget money can buy
**Relationship Hook:** A fat teenager with a whip and a bandage, waiting in a cell for his little brother.
personality: Core: spiteful, petty and childish; afraid of his father and grandfather; brilliant with machines and networks
Quirk: jealous of the little brother everyone favours

npcs.name: Mina Kowalczyk
npcs.info:
A woman in her late twenties with cropped black hair and a soldering iron always in reach, who runs a repair bench at the back of the Handset Bazaar. She opens, fixes and wipes phones for anyone who pays, and she is very fast.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and unimpressed, a technician's mumble that warms up only for a rare handset.
**Combat Role:** an aura-trained Hunter who keeps out of a fight and ends one with a stun baton and a cut phone line
**Relationship Hook:** A cropped-haired woman bent under a magnifying lamp with an opened phone and a soldering iron.
personality: Core: fast with her hands; quietly ruthless about data; bored by small talk
Quirk: laconic

npcs.name: Ming Jol-ik
npcs.info:
The Supreme Leader of East Gorteau, a plump man in his sixties with medium-length black hair and a pencil moustache, who led the revolution that made the country his. He is pompous and conceited, rules through fear and informers, and spends his afternoons watching dancers at long lunches in the palace. Nobody in the country dares speak of him except to praise him.

**Speaking Style:** Pompous and loud, a dictator's bark that lists its own titles and expects the room to applaud.
**Combat Role:** none; a figurehead behind ranks of soldiers who are not always there
**Relationship Hook:** A plump moustached dictator eating at a long table while dancers perform, waving away a guard's warning.
personality: Core: pompous and conceited; cruel by the habit of the office; believes every title he has given himself
Quirk: lists his own titles when threatened

npcs.name: Mirela Voss
npcs.info:
A woman from outside who drove in with a camper van, a suitcase of papers and a small dog, and has waited nineteen days in the ring of vehicles for the Assembly to say whether she may stay. She keeps her van spotless and offers tea to anyone who will sit with her.

**Speaking Style:** Careful and pleasant, an office voice holding itself very steady, with a catch in it when an engine sounds.
**Combat Role:** none; she locks the van, keeps the dog between herself and the door, and drives if she must
**Relationship Hook:** A neat woman in a cardigan on a camper van's step, offering a cup of tea with a hand that will not quite stay still.
personality: Core: offers tea to cover her nerves; talks about anything except her past; counts the days in a notebook
Quirk: checks the road every time an engine sounds

npcs.name: Mito Freecss
npcs.info:
Gon's aunt, a young woman with short orange hair who keeps house and sells fish on Whale Island and has raised Gon since he was a baby. She is kind, patient and capable, embarrassed by teasing, and fiercely protective of the boy. She never wanted him to follow his father into hunting, and set him an impossible task to stop him.

**Speaking Style:** A warm, practical woman's voice that scolds and fusses in the same breath and goes soft and unsteady when she has to let go of someone she loves.
**Combat Role:** none; a broom, a sharp tongue and a whole island that would come running
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman at a kitchen table reading a letter twice, with a boy's fishing rod leaning in the corner.
personality: Core: motherly, patient and practical; still angry at Ging and still fond of him; keeps every promise, even the ones she hoped not to keep
Quirk: blushes when her grandmother tells old stories

npcs.name: Mizaistom Nana
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Ox, a tall, lean, bearded man in a black-spotted white coat and a horned hat, with a black patch round his left eye and a horned cow on the back of his coat. He is a two-star Hunter of crime, a lawyer, and the manager of a private security company. He observes in silence, thinks before he acts and lives by a strict code.

**Speaking Style:** A low, measured, deliberate voice that weighs each word like evidence and gives a verdict rather than an opinion.
**Combat Role:** an ability that turns a fight into a trial, coloured cards shown to judge and bind
**Relationship Hook:** A tall bearded man in a cow-spotted coat silently holding up a red card.
personality: Core: gives an opponent the chance to explain; lives by a strict personal code; slow to anger, terrible once angry
Quirk: silent, analytical and rigorous

npcs.name: Mizuri
npcs.info:
A corporal of the Royal Army, a dark-skinned man with dark tightly curled hair and sideburns, in the army's zip-up jacket, trousers, dark combat boots and helmet. He takes his responsibilities seriously and insists on doing things by the book, though he gives way at once to anyone with more authority.

**Speaking Style:** Firm and formal, a corporal who insists on procedure and gives way only to a higher rank.
**Combat Role:** an army corporal with a rifle and a squad, who works by the numbers
**Relationship Hook:** A dark-skinned corporal holding two VVIP tickets up to the light, a squad behind him.
personality: Core: yields to higher authority at once; checks every ticket twice; wonders about the people he was told to let go
Quirk: insists on procedure

npcs.name: Momoze Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The twelfth prince of Kakin and elder child of the seventh queen Sevanti, a short young woman with delicate features and long glossy fair hair in an elaborate ponytail. She is calm and gentle, likes knitting and dresses with old-fashioned taste. Hanzo, a ninja from Jappon, answered her listing and guards her on the voyage.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle, composed and assured, a calm girl's voice that pities rather than fears.
**Combat Role:** none; a prince with a Hunter at her door
**Relationship Hook:** A small fair-haired prince knitting calmly in an armchair while a ninja watches the door.
personality: Core: calm and gentle; pities her family; old-fashioned in her tastes
Quirk: assured of herself

npcs.name: Monta Yuras
npcs.info:
A large Amateur Hunter called Mon, with a koala-like face, a plain green shirt and brown trousers, who carries the team's luggage. He nearly always wears a jovial look.

**Speaking Style:** A deep, easy, jovial voice that says little and sounds content.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong back
**Relationship Hook:** A big man with a koala's face hoisting the whole team's packs onto his back.
personality: Core: jovial and easy-going; quiet; anxious for his leader
Quirk: strong and dependable

npcs.name: Morel Mackernasey
npcs.info:
A sea Hunter and sea captain, tall, broad and middle-aged, with shoulder-length white hair, a strong square chin, a crooked nose and pince-nez sunglasses, in a grey shirt and red tie, carrying a giant smoking pipe as tall as a man. He is calm, patient and perceptive, a veteran the Association respects, and the teacher of Knuckle and Shoot.

**Speaking Style:** A deep, unhurried, gravelly voice with a pipe in it, calm and teasing, that never loses its patience in a fight.
**Combat Role:** a giant pipe swung like a club and smoke shaped into soldiers and cages
**Relationship Hook:** A big white-haired man with a pipe as tall as he is blowing smoke that turns into a squad of soldiers.
personality: Core: calm and patient; perceptive and teasing; proud of his pupils
Quirk: a strategist who waits for his plans to ripen

npcs.name: Morena Prudo
npcs.info:
The boss of the Heil-Ly Family, the smallest of Kakin's three Mafia houses, a slim young woman with almond eyes and long dark blue hair past her waist, a row of small hoops up her left ear and two parallel scars from her forehead across her left eye to her mouth, the mark of a royal bastard. She takes no interest in the contest, the world or her own life.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, flat and unafraid, a young woman's voice that speaks of mass murder as calmly as the weather.
**Combat Role:** a Specialist who rarely fights herself, arming her followers with a kiss and growing stronger as they kill
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred young woman with long blue hair kissing each of her kneeling men on the forehead in turn.
personality: Core: indifferent to her own life; grateful for her scar; a calm and patient leader
Quirk: wants the world destroyed

npcs.name: Mortimer Glass
npcs.info:
A narrow old man with half-moon glasses and a cardigan buttoned wrong, who sits behind the grille of the Ninth Avenue Pawnbrokers in auction season from morning until dawn. He prices by telephone, writes every ticket in fountain pen and never lets a customer see the back room.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and precise, a pawnbroker's voice that values the customer along with the watch.
**Combat Role:** none; a buzzer under the counter brings two men from the back
**Relationship Hook:** A thin old man peering over half-moon glasses through an iron grille, a pawn ticket in his fingers.
personality: Core: courteous and cold; greedy in small ways; never raises his voice
Quirk: writes everything down

npcs.name: Mortimer Quayle
npcs.info:
A neat, forgettable man in a navy blazer and a club tie who drinks gin in the corner booth of the hotel bar every evening and tips the staff well. He tells anyone who asks that he sells insurance.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, well-spoken, courteous voice that compliments the bar's gin and never says anything at all about himself.
**Combat Role:** a quiet killer with a garrotte and a thin blade who works close, alone and once
**Relationship Hook:** An unremarkable man in a blazer raising his gin to an applicant across the bar and asking what number she drew.
personality: Core: courteous and forgettable; patient with small talk; afraid of anyone better at his trade
Quirk: watches exits, never doors

npcs.name: Morwen Prowse
npcs.info:
A quiet, long-limbed woman who keeps the island's water: she clears the spring of leaves, climbs down into the tank to scrub it each season and walks the pipe to town tapping it for leaks. She lives in a stone cottage beside the cistern and knows the sound of every drop in it.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and even, a water-keeper's unhurried voice that sounds like it is listening for something under the words.
**Combat Role:** none; a long iron key for the tank lid and a dipper
**Relationship Hook:** A tall woman crouched among ferns with her ear pressed to a water pipe.
personality: Core: listens before she speaks; taps every pipe she passes; keeps small mercies to herself
Quirk: happiest alone in the cold

npcs.name: Moss Calder
npcs.info:
An old squatter of seventy who worked forty years on the mill floor of the factory row before the plants moved away, and who never left. He lives in a shed made from a boiler casing in the corner of the biggest mill and knows every tunnel under the factory row by heart.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, slow and wandering, an old man who answers by telling you about the year the mill closed.
**Combat Role:** none; he vanishes down a tunnel nobody else knows
**Relationship Hook:** An old squatter in a knitted cap standing at the mouth of a brick tunnel with a lamp, smiling at a memory.
personality: Core: keeps a tidy shed in a ruined mill; feeds the pigeons with crumbs he cannot spare; afraid of nothing except being moved on
Quirk: tells everything as a story of the mill's good years

npcs.name: Motaricke
npcs.info:
A player with short black hair and a faint moustache, in a maroon vest over a white shirt over a black one, khaki trousers and grey shoes. He has been inside the game for years, and he talks about the wife at home he has to provide for.

**Speaking Style:** Hesitant and weary, a family man talking himself into something he does not want to do.
**Combat Role:** none; a nervous card thief who folds the moment a target stands firm
**Relationship Hook:** A nervous man in a maroon vest stepping out from behind a tree with a spell card shaking in his hand.
personality: Core: anxious and timid; overthinks; guilty when he steals
Quirk: devoted to his wife

npcs.name: Muherr
npcs.info:
A mercenary with slanted eyes, long hair and pointed ears, in a dark jacket, fingerless gloves and high boots, who commands the soldiers of Beyond's expedition in the field. He is proud and collected, rude to anyone he talks to, suspicious by nature and contemptuous of anyone who tries to buy his loyalty.

**Speaking Style:** A proud, clipped, contemptuous soldier's voice that talks down to everyone and trusts no one who offers money.
**Combat Role:** a field commander's tactics and the guns of his unit
**Relationship Hook:** A long-haired mercenary with pointed ears telling a newcomer to get out of the expedition's headquarters.
personality: Core: proud and collected; rude and mistrustful; a soldier to the bone
Quirk: despises bribes

npcs.name: Mukanaki
npcs.info:
A player with neatly combed hair and long sideburns, in a sweater with a line down each sleeve. He was one of the veterans who crowded round two boys for their first prize, and these days he spends his mornings chasing puffballs down the slope.

**Speaking Style:** Jaunty and talkative, a man who narrates his own chase out loud.
**Combat Role:** an eager chaser who runs his quarry rather than reads it
**Relationship Hook:** A neatly combed man sprawled at the bottom of a grassy slope while a fluffy blur sits on his back.
personality: Core: jaunty; tireless; keeps his hair neat even in a chase
Quirk: won't ask for help

npcs.name: Mushaho
npcs.info:
The captain of the fifth queen Swinko-swinko's royal guard, a man with short fair hair, a broad jutting forehead, a prominent chin and no visible eyebrows, in a royal bodyguard's black suit and tie. He is mission-minded and loyal to his employer, and he oversees the eighth prince's door even through the prince's loudest parties.

**Speaking Style:** Stiff, earnest and dutiful, a guard captain who states his rank before his name.
**Combat Role:** a royal bodyguard with a handgun, trained to stand between his charge and the door
**Relationship Hook:** A browless guard captain in a black suit standing outside a door while a party roars behind it.
personality: Core: trusts no one else with an important mission; objects, then obeys; endures the prince's parties without comment
Quirk: states his rank before his name

npcs.name: Mutsuki
npcs.info:
The butler who kneels by the door of Silva's chamber, carrying messages in and out and nothing else. He is a broad, shaven-headed man in the black suit, and he moves so quietly that Silva no longer looks up when he enters.

**Speaking Style:** A low, near-silent voice, all breath and no edges, from a man who has trained himself to speak only when someone in the room requires it.
**Combat Role:** an assassin-trained butler's silent kill, a strangling grip and Zetsu held for hours
**Relationship Hook:** A shaven-headed butler kneeling by a doorway in the dark, so still the room seems to have forgotten him.
personality: Core: silent unless addressed; utterly loyal to Silva and no one else; uneasy around Kikyo, which he hides well
Quirk: turns his good ear toward whoever speaks

npcs.name: Nasubi Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The king of the Kakin Empire, a heavy man with narrow eyes, a top-knot, long curling eyebrows, eyelashes and moustache, in ornate jewelled robes. He has eight wives and fourteen children, all of them princes whatever their sex, and his subjects cheer him wherever he goes. He has announced that Kakin will sail for the Dark Continent, led by Beyond Netero, and that the voyage will settle his succession.

**Speaking Style:** Booming and theatrical in public, cold and quiet in private, a ruler who enjoys the sound of his own decrees.
**Combat Role:** never shown fighting; a king who rules by decree, by the army and by the rite he set his children
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy king in jewelled robes smiling down from a balcony at a cheering harbour.
personality: Core: demagogic and theatrical in public; impulsive in his appetites; believes only the strongest should rule
Quirk: cold and ruthless in private

npcs.name: Nell Ashby
npcs.info:
The ticket clerk at the terminus, a thin woman of thirty with heavy eyeliner who sweeps the sand out of her booth twice a shift and reads detective novels between trains. She knows every regular by face and every pickpocket by name.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, bored and sharp, a clerk who has heard every excuse for a missing fare.
**Combat Role:** none; she locks the ticket booth and phones the transit police
**Relationship Hook:** A thin clerk with heavy eyeliner reading a paperback in a glass ticket booth, sand drifting through the doors.
personality: Core: reads detective novels; sweeps the sand out of her booth twice a shift; knows every pickpocket by name
Quirk: notes every stranger from the desert side

npcs.name: Nell Corrie
npcs.info:
