A salt-boiler of the strand, a sunburnt young woman with a wooden rake who tends the wide pans over driftwood fires and combs the wrack after storms. The salt-boilers are the best fed people on the coast, and she means to keep it so.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and salty, a shore girl who laughs at gulls and haggles like a fishwife.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong shore girl with a long rake
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt young woman leaning on a rake beside a steaming salt pan, pointing at a blue drum on the shingle.
personality: Core: cheerful and bold; loves the shore; greedy for a find
Quirk: quick to argue

npcs.name: Nell Pryor
npcs.info:
A strong, sunburnt woman who keeps the rowing boats on the sand cove's rollers, mends them, lends them, and taught Noko to swim in the shallows last summer. She lights the summer fire on the beach and decides when it is too rough to row.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, firm and outdoorsy, a swimming teacher's voice that counts strokes and never panics.
**Combat Role:** none; an oar and the lungs of a long-distance swimmer
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt woman painting an upturned rowing boat on a cold empty beach.
personality: Core: counts strokes under her breath; never panics in water; lends boats freely and checks them twice
Quirk: forbids the eastern end with no explanation

npcs.name: Neon Nostrade
npcs.info:
The daughter of Light Nostrade, seventeen, with blue hair tied back in a yellow bow, a striped top, a white dress and huge purple shoes. She collects human body parts, from eyes to whole mummies, and throws tantrums when she cannot have the next one. She tells fortunes for the Mafia's great and good in neat poems, a month at a time, and has never once been wrong; she has no idea how she does it.

**Speaking Style:** High, spoiled and bouncy, a seventeen-year-old who whines, sulks and squeals with delight inside one sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; a pampered girl whose power is foresight, guarded by her father's hires
**Relationship Hook:** A girl with a yellow bow sprawled on a hotel bed, circling human relics in an auction catalogue.
personality: Core: spoiled and self-centred; childlike more than cruel; loves her collection of human parts
Quirk: throws tantrums

npcs.name: Nicholas
npcs.info:
A round-faced, pale young man with neat black hair, a white ruffled shirt, a red bow, braces and dark trousers, applicant 187, who carries a notebook computer everywhere. First in his class at his studies and his sports, by his own account, he walks the hall reading other applicants off his screen as though the exam were a quiz.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, clipped and pleased with itself, a top student's voice that reads out facts nobody asked for and cracks into a shriek when the facts stop going his way.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a fit schoolboy who outruns trouble until his legs give out
**Relationship Hook:** A neat boy with a bow tie glancing up from his laptop to tell a newcomer exactly which applicant to avoid.
personality: Core: sure he is the cleverest person in any room; a fragile ego under the polish; treats other people as tools to use and drop
Quirk: shows off what he knows

npcs.name: Nickes
npcs.info:
A player of Greed Island, tall with scruffy hair, stubble and a strong jaw, in a jacket over a zip-up sweater. He knows the game's rules better than almost anyone and runs an alliance of players who steal by spell card, never by force. He recruits newcomers by warning them that someone on the island kills for cards.

**Speaking Style:** Earnest and informative, a leader's patient explaining voice that turns pleading when lives are at stake.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a strategist who plays by spell card and numbers
**Relationship Hook:** A stubbled man in a war room laying spell cards on a table and explaining them to newcomers.
personality: Core: intelligent and knowledgeable; a pacifist by method; trusts the wrong man
Quirk: selfless when a friend is threatened

npcs.name: Nico Crook
npcs.info:
A boy of twelve who drives the city's goats up the heap slopes each morning with a stick and a sling, and milks them at dawn with his sisters. He reads the heaps by what the goats refuse to eat, and he is usually right.

**Speaking Style:** A serious boy's voice, slow and sure, talking about goats as if they were grown-ups.
**Combat Role:** a herder boy with a sling, firing from behind a goat
**Relationship Hook:** A thin boy with a herding stick on a slope of rubbish, goats scattering around him.
personality: Core: counts the herd by its bells; never eats meat at a feast; practises the sling on cans
Quirk: talks to the lead nanny goat like an aunt

npcs.name: Nils Brander
npcs.info:
A thirteen-year-old pupil at the middle school, all elbows and scraped knees, who knows every shortcut in the city and is the fastest runner in his year.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, breathless and certain, a schoolboy's voice telling a story nobody believes.
**Combat Role:** none; a quick boy who runs and knows where to hide
**Relationship Hook:** A skinny schoolboy sprinting around a dirt running track, grinning over his shoulder.
personality: Core: excitable; stubborn; fast
Quirk: lonely in his certainty

npcs.name: Nils Overby
npcs.info:
One of the two crewmen from the outer mole who have taken rooms at Harbour Rest Guesthouse while their boat waits out the weather: a smiling young man with slicked hair and very clean boots for a fisherman. He compliments Maud Ferrier's cooking at every meal and has not yet paid for one.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and over-friendly, a stranded crewman's voice that agrees with everyone and owes everybody.
**Combat Role:** a cornered man with a folding knife who runs first and fights only when he cannot
**Relationship Hook:** A smiling young man on a dark landing, one hand reaching for a key on a nail.
personality: Core: flatters everyone at the table; owes money in every port; boots too clean for his trade
Quirk: goes very still when asked his name twice

npcs.name: Ninette Faber
npcs.info:
A shop girl in the souvenir arcade, nineteen and freckled, with ink on her fingers and a pen behind her ear. She sells model towers, headbands and signed photographs, and she can tell any visitor which fighter is winning this month before the board can.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, giggly and conspiratorial, a shop girl who winks at her own jokes.
**Combat Role:** none; a shop girl with a till, a shriek and a stockroom door that locks
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled shop girl signing a fighter's photograph behind a glass case of model towers, tongue between her teeth.
personality: Core: chatty and quick; proud of her handwriting; lies easily and badly
Quirk: doodles on every receipt

npcs.name: Ning Baozhu
npcs.info:
A private of the Royal Army posted to the lifeboat station's emergency door, a young woman from an inland village who had never seen the sea before she was sent to guard a door that opens onto it. She knows the keypad code, the order in which the channel floods and nothing else about the ship at all.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, careful and obedient, a young soldier who repeats her orders back before she answers anything.
**Combat Role:** an army private with a rifle and a radio, who calls for help before she fires
**Relationship Hook:** A young soldier standing stiffly beside a lifeboat control panel, her hand never far from the alarm.
personality: Core: counts the lifeboats at the start of each watch; writes letters home she cannot post; flinches at running footsteps
Quirk: repeats every order back

npcs.name: Nobunaga Hazama
npcs.info:
Member number one of the Phantom Troupe, a swordsman in a Jappon-style robe with his hair tied up in a topknot and his sword never out of reach. He is calm until crossed and quick to quarrel with the others, and his blade is fast enough that a word from Killua compares him to Hisoka. Uvogin is his closest friend.

**Speaking Style:** A gruff, sardonic swordsman's voice, short and cutting, that loses its temper with comrades and goes hushed and sincere for a fallen friend.
**Combat Role:** a sword drawn and swung inside a short sensing circle, faster than an eye
**Relationship Hook:** A swordsman in a loose robe crouched with his hand on his hilt, perfectly still, waiting for someone to step closer.
personality: Core: sullen and calm until provoked; quarrels with his comrades and fights for them; respects courage even in an enemy
Quirk: grieves his friends openly

npcs.name: Noko
npcs.info:
The only other child on Whale Island besides Gon, a little girl with green eyes and orange hair in two braids, in a pink long-sleeved shirt. She is at the front of the crowd when Gon brings in the great fish from the swamp and at the dock to wave him off.

**Speaking Style:** A small girl's shy, happy voice.
**Combat Role:** none; a village child
**Relationship Hook:** A little girl with orange braids waving from the end of a pier as a ship leaves.
personality: Core: shy and smiling; Gon's friend; always at the front of the crowd
Quirk: waves until the ship is gone

npcs.name: Nostrade Butler
npcs.info:
An elderly butler with short fair hair parted on the right, a long face lined across the forehead and under the eyes, sharp cheeks and a thick moustache. He wears a dark suit and a cravat and moves through the mansion without a sound.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, formal and sparing, an old servant's voice that says only what the house needs said.
**Combat Role:** none; he serves, and stands where he is put
**Relationship Hook:** An old butler with a heavy moustache handing out cards in a grand trophy room.
personality: Core: cordial; sees everything and says nothing; loyal to the house
Quirk: taciturn

npcs.name: Nugui
npcs.info:
The king's personal butler, a very small elderly man with well-combed hair, a square jaw, a bulbous nose and long earlobes, in a black suit and laced tie. He is calm, smiling and professional at all times, and he carries the king's word to the princes.

**Speaking Style:** Small, polite and unhurried, a butler's soft voice that delivers terrible news as if it were the weather.
**Combat Role:** none; a butler who carries the king's word
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old butler setting a lacquered box before a prince and explaining the rules with a smile.
personality: Core: calm and professional; loyal to the king; privately sorrowful for the children
Quirk: always politely smiling

npcs.name: Odile Brandt
npcs.info:
A sunburnt woman in her thirties with a blonde braid, a headlamp and a canvas jacket full of pencils, who has spent the summer mapping the dead branch of the Castor Line for the city archive. She treats the brick vaults as ruins, and is right to.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and enthusiastic, a field archaeologist's voice that warms to every brick.
**Combat Role:** an aura-trained Hunter with a digger's strength who fights reluctantly with a short pick
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt woman with a headlamp and braid photographing a fallen station sign on a dusty tiled platform.
personality: Core: bookish; cheerful underground; honest to a fault
Quirk: dislikes strangers in her site

npcs.name: Odile Fontaine
npcs.info:
The owner of the Skyfoot Patisserie, a plump, rosy woman in her fifties with a lace cap and flour to the elbows. Her window of cakes and chocolate draws every child on the plaza road, and she gives the smallest ones a broken biscuit for pressing their noses to the glass.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and motherly, a confectioner who calls every child 'my little one' and every adult 'dear'.
**Combat Role:** none; a rolling pin, a bell over the door and a whole street of shopkeepers who adore her
**Relationship Hook:** A plump confectioner in a lace cap handing a ribbon-tied box across a counter of cakes, a framed photo of a white-haired boy behind her.
personality: Core: kind and fussy; remembers every child's favourite; worries aloud
Quirk: dusts the framed photo every morning

npcs.name: Odile Marchand
npcs.info:
The eldest of the old women who sit on crates in the council shack and settle the camp's quarrels, a tiny, upright widow of seventy-five with a cane she rarely needs. She came to the camp when the city took her house for a road and has run it, in practice, for twenty years.

**Speaking Style:** Low, slow and certain, an elder who lets silence do half her talking.
**Combat Role:** none; she raises her cane and the whole camp comes out of its shacks
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old woman in a black shawl sitting on a crate in a tin shack, her cane across her knees, listening.
personality: Core: settles a quarrel before the police arrive; knows every child's name; never moves faster than she needs to
Quirk: lets silence do the talking

npcs.name: Odile Moreau
npcs.info:
The night waitress at the truck stop on the desert road, a tired, pretty woman of thirty-five with bottle-blonde hair, a pencil in it and a pink uniform. She pours thin coffee for the drivers crossing to Hass and knows each of them by his order.

**Speaking Style:** Low, warm and teasing, a night waitress who calls every driver honey and remembers every order.
**Combat Role:** none; a coffee pot and forty drivers who would stand up for her
**Relationship Hook:** A tired blonde waitress in a pink uniform pouring coffee along a diner counter crowded with lorry drivers.
personality: Core: warm to every driver; saving to leave; never forgets an order
Quirk: reads every message she carries

npcs.name: Odile Varenne
npcs.info:
A rangy woman of fifty in a fleece and a thermal hat with a magnifying lens on a cord round her neck, who runs the research hut on stilts at the dry edge of the wetlands. She has studied the marsh's mimics for twenty years and lost three assistants to them.

**Speaking Style:** A crisp, educated, faintly impatient voice that lectures as it walks.
**Combat Role:** a field scientist who moves unseen in the fog and fights with a tranquilliser rifle and a long knife
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired scientist peering through a lens at a specimen jar and telling you, without looking up, to close the door against the fog.
personality: Core: brisk and impatient; trusts evidence and nothing else; argues with the Association on principle
Quirk: fiercely protective of her students

npcs.name: Odo
npcs.info:
An old fur trapper who winters in the long bark hut deep in the northern woods, a wiry man in skins with a pack of dogs at his heels. He knows every animal track for days around and tells the longest tales at the hearth.

**Speaking Style:** A trapper's easy, rambling voice that turns every question into a story of the woods.
**Combat Role:** a trapper with a skinning knife and a snare line
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry old trapper by the long fire, scratching a dog's ears and starting a story.
personality: Core: knows the woods' moods; kind to dogs; first to smell trouble
Quirk: a storyteller

npcs.name: Odo Kessler
npcs.info:
The weighmaster, a barrel-chested man with a book and a stub of chalk, who hangs every big catch on the gantry hook and calls its weight to the crowd. He settles every bet on the island that turns on a fish, and he takes the job of witness as seriously as a judge.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and official, a weighmaster's voice built for calling numbers across a windy square, softening only when he talks about fish.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy iron counterweight and a voice that carries over a gale
**Relationship Hook:** A big weighmaster shouting a number while a huge fish swings from the hook of a rusty gantry.
personality: Core: will not let a bet stand without witnesses; grows quiet and gentle beside a really big fish; cannot stand being doubted
Quirk: calls every weight as if it were news

npcs.name: Oito Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The eighth queen of Kakin, tall and slim, her wavy black hair drawn back behind the ears, with black oval eyes and a light blue kimono. She was born poor, the middle of five children, and the king married her for her looks. She admits she was a shallow woman who wanted only luxury, until her daughter Woble was born.

**Speaking Style:** Soft-spoken and quick, a young mother's voice that is gentle with her child and steel with anyone who threatens her.
**Combat Role:** none of her own; a mother who fights with wits and the guards she hired
**Relationship Hook:** A young queen in a blue kimono holding a sleeping baby close as armed guards check the corridor.
personality: Core: quick-thinking and clever; ruthless when the baby is threatened; honest about who she used to be
Quirk: devoted to her child above all

npcs.name: Ok Chun-hwa
npcs.info:
A filing clerk in the grey folders of the informant bureau, a thin woman with her hair pinned flat and sleeve-guards over her cuffs. She has worked the same shelves for eleven years and can find any household in the capital by touch. She eats lunch at her desk and speaks to the folders more than to her colleagues.

**Speaking Style:** A dry, level clerk's voice that reads names as if they were grocery items.
**Combat Role:** none; a clerk who knows which folder can end a man
**Relationship Hook:** A thin clerk on a rolling ladder pulling one grey folder from among thousands and holding it a moment too long.
personality: Core: dry and unreadable; precise to the point of obsession; trusts paper more than people
Quirk: guilty in a way she will not name

npcs.name: Om Pun-i
npcs.info:
The keeper of the road inn between Taba City and Luonton City, a handsome, sharp-eyed widow in an apron who ladles noodles for lorry drivers, rents bunks by the night and keeps the registration book on the counter. She knows every driver on the highway by his lorry, his load and his wife's name.

**Speaking Style:** Husky, teasing and quick, an innkeeper who flatters drivers and remembers everything they say over noodles.
**Combat Role:** none; a ladle, a cleaver and a room full of drivers who like her
**Relationship Hook:** A sharp-eyed innkeeper ladling noodles while reading the registration book upside down on the counter.
personality: Core: sharp, teasing and observant; sells information to anyone who pays; curious to a fault
Quirk: kind to drivers down on their luck

npcs.name: Onior Longbao
npcs.info:
The boss of the Xi-Yu Family, the largest and richest of Kakin's three Mafia houses, a corpulent man with deep-lined cheeks, small eyebrows, a tuft of fair hair on top and two long scars across his forehead. He looks very like the king, his half-brother. He lives in the VIP area of the first tier and crosses to the lower decks by a drawbridge only soldiers and family heads may use.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and philosophical, a rich man's slow voice that talks of balance and order between mouthfuls.
**Combat Role:** never shown fighting; a boss who commands the largest family on the ship
**Relationship Hook:** A corpulent scarred man at a laden table, chopsticks in hand, talking calmly about balance.
personality: Core: philosophical about power; patient and calculating; lives in luxury and secrecy
Quirk: values balance above all

npcs.name: Oribe
npcs.info:
The range master of the butlers' firing range, a square-jawed man with a grey crew cut and the sleeves of his suit jacket pinned back. He keeps every butler's scores in a book going back twenty years, runs the pistol and rifle tests, and is the best shot on the mountain with anything that uses a cartridge.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, loud and flat, a range master's voice made for being heard through ear protection.
**Combat Role:** pistol and rifle at any range, a butler's speed between cover, and a book of everyone's weak hand
**Relationship Hook:** A crew-cut range master with ear protectors round his neck reading a target, then looking sourly at a coin-dented steel plate.
personality: Core: barks scores aloud; fair in his marking, harsh in his comments; cleans every weapon twice
Quirk: competitive with Gotoh and pretends otherwise

npcs.name: Orla Vesey
npcs.info:
A painter from the mainland who rented a stone hut below the falls for one summer and has stayed three winters, painting the same waterfall in every weather. She is thin, paint-spattered and polite, and the islanders consider her harmless and slightly mad.

**Speaking Style:** Dreamy and distracted, a painter's soft voice that drifts mid-sentence to look at the light.
**Combat Role:** none; a palette knife and the habit of disappearing behind the water
**Relationship Hook:** A paint-spattered young woman on a mossy boulder sketching a waterfall through drifting spray.
personality: Core: forgets to eat when she is painting; polite, distracted and quietly stubborn; keeps the ledge to herself
Quirk: looks at light rather than people

npcs.name: Orvald Brisk
npcs.info:
A stocky skipper of sixty with a grey beard, a peaked cap and a pipe he never lights, whose ferry carries applicants across the strait every January. His boat sits on blocks in the dry dock with a hole in her hull, and he stands under it telling the welders a different story each hour about what made it.

**Speaking Style:** A rasping old sea voice that rolls its words, makes a joke of everything and means very little of the joke.
**Combat Role:** a deckhand's brawling, with a boathook and a lifetime's balance on a rolling floor
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded old skipper rapping his boat's holed hull with a pipe and claiming it was a whale that owed him money.
personality: Core: a sharp eye for who will crack; proud of his boat; lies cheerfully about small things
Quirk: jokes about everything, especially danger

npcs.name: Otis Bramwell
npcs.info:
A sunburnt, cheerful guide of thirty who drives tourists out from the city in an old open jeep to see the desert at sunset. He parks in the hollow behind the low ridge because it has shade and a view, and he tells every party the same ghost story about the silver camp.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, practised and theatrical, a guide whose every sentence sounds like the start of a tour.
**Combat Role:** none; he guns the jeep and drives off across the sand, passengers or not
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburnt guide leaning on an open jeep in a sandy hollow, binoculars raised toward the flats.
personality: Core: never asks a passenger's business; drives too fast on sand; proud of his sunset like he made it
Quirk: tells the same ghost story to every party

npcs.name: Ottilie Brandauer
npcs.info:
A small, broad old woman with a scarf over grey curls and a housecoat over her dress, who comes up the hill to the big house once a week to air it for the letting agent. She has cleaned the place for forty years and four owners and calls it a cold old barn to its face.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and grumbling, an old charwoman who narrates her own dusting and expects to be agreed with.
**Combat Role:** none; she swings a broom handle and screams for the neighbours
**Relationship Hook:** An old charwoman in a headscarf throwing open the shutters of a gloomy dining hall and muttering at the cold.
personality: Core: houseproud about a house that is not hers; gossips about every tenant; keeps what is left behind
Quirk: superstitious about the dolls

npcs.name: Ottilie Brandt
npcs.info:
The teacher of the one-room school, a thin woman in her fifties with her hair pinned up and chalk on her sleeves. She teaches letters on slates, sums with pebbles and the creed of living without machines, and writes to every child's parents by hand each month.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and precise, a teacher's voice that still carries an accent from somewhere far away.
**Combat Role:** none; a teacher who gathers the children and bars the door
**Relationship Hook:** A thin teacher by a stove in a one-room school, quickly wiping a drawing off a slate as you come in.
personality: Core: patient and exact; loves her pupils; keeps her past to herself
Quirk: homesick for a world she gave up

npcs.name: Ottilie Gorse
npcs.info:
A wiry old woman who works the topmost plot of the terraces, in her dead husband's oilskin, which she put on the scarecrow until she needed it back. She grows the best onions on the island and makes sure everybody knows it.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, sour and patient, an old gardener's voice that says something cutting about every neighbour without changing tone.
**Combat Role:** none; a garden fork and three generations of grudge
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry old woman with a garden fork measuring a dry-stone wall with a knotted string.
personality: Core: sour about everyone and loyal to a few; grows the best onions and says so; has never lost an argument she meant to win
Quirk: measures the boundary wall every month

npcs.name: Ottilie Gutter
npcs.info:
The tank warden of the rain terraces, a sharp-elbowed woman who climbs the stilts every morning to lift the lids and sniff the water. She says which tank is drunk from and which is rested, and a resident who argues with her waits at the end of the queue.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp and hard-edged, a warden's bark that brooks no argument about water.
**Combat Role:** a wiry climber who fights from the scaffolding with a hooked lid-pole and drops things on heads
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry woman perched on scaffolding beside a great plastic tank, its lid lifted, her nose wrinkling.
personality: Core: sniffs every cup she is handed; climbs faster than any child; rations her own water tighter than anyone's
Quirk: treats a fouled tank like a murder

npcs.name: Ottla Wenzel
npcs.info:
A broad-shouldered prison guard in her forties with cropped hair, a baton and a clipboard, whose duty during the exam is to wind the clock in the forfeit cell and lock in whoever has lost time on the platform.

**Speaking Style:** A flat clerk's voice that reads out hours remaining as if they were a bus timetable.
**Combat Role:** a guard with a baton and a door she can lock faster than anyone can reach it
**Relationship Hook:** A broad prison guard in a peaked cap winding a caged wall clock, a clipboard tucked under one arm.
personality: Core: dry and unhurried; impossible to provoke; keeps meticulous records
Quirk: would help if anyone asked politely

npcs.name: Otto Kessel
npcs.info:
The owner of Kessel Firearms, a square old man with a grey crew cut and a cardigan, who was the police armourer for twenty-five years before he opened the shop. He sells pistols, shotguns and hunting rifles to anyone with a permit and teaches the basement range at weekends.

**Speaking Style:** Low and gravelled, a retired armourer's voice that talks about guns as if they were tools and people as if they were problems.
**Combat Role:** a retired police armourer who shoots well, from cover, and never first
**Relationship Hook:** A square old man in a cardigan oiling a pistol at a glass counter, rifles racked behind him.
personality: Core: matter-of-fact; trusts old faces only; takes pride in clean work
Quirk: careless about who dies

npcs.name: Ottokar
npcs.info:
A heavy, grey-stubbled labourer from Dentora who works under Zebro at the bone midden, raking the gully and sorting metal from what the hound leaves behind. He came to the estate as a scrap dealer's driver and stayed when the groundskeeper offered him steady work and asked no questions. He wears thick rubber gloves and a cap pulled low.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and unhurried, a scrapman who names each piece of metal as he picks it up, as if ticking it off a list.
**Combat Role:** a labourer's strength behind a long iron rake, and a shout for Zebro
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy man in rubber gloves lifting a rusted knife out of a pile of bones and reading its steel by the sound.
personality: Core: unbothered by bones, upset by waste; keeps his cap on even indoors; sends money home and tells nobody where it comes from
Quirk: names every piece of metal aloud

npcs.name: Ou Jianguo
npcs.info:
The chief of the ground crew on the whale's back, a wiry, sunburned man in ear defenders and an orange vest who brings airships down onto the painted circle with two batons and no visible fear. His crew unload everything the ship needs from the sky.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and shouted, a ground-crew chief who talks with his hands over wind and engines.
**Combat Role:** a deck hand with a signal baton and a crew of twenty who can swing a cargo net at a man
**Relationship Hook:** A sunburned ground-crew chief waving two batons as an airship settles onto a painted circle.
personality: Core: waves in anything that pays; naps on cargo nets between landings; knows every pilot by voice
Quirk: talks with his batons

npcs.name: Owen Pryce
npcs.info:
The overman of the night shift at the coal mine, a short, deep-chested man in his fifties with blue scars of coal dust in the skin of his hands and a lamp on his helmet. He hands out the lamps, counts the men down and counts them back up.

**Speaking Style:** Lilting and grave, a mine overman's voice that sings a little even when it is giving bad news.
**Combat Role:** none; a pick handle and a body that has worked in the dark for forty years
**Relationship Hook:** A barrel-chested mine overman under a lamp-room light, handing out lamps to a queue of miners at shift change.
personality: Core: responsible for every man; torn between the pit and the truth; sings under his breath
Quirk: counts twice

npcs.name: Pae Tok-su
npcs.info:
The night watchman of the department store's loading yard, a heavy, unhurried man in a padded coat who sits on a crate under a single lamp with a flask and a torch. He counts the deliveries in and out, signs the sheets and nods to the drivers by name. The store's staff call him uncle and bring him the broken biscuits.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, deadpan and slow, a watchman who delivers every joke as if it were a report.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy torch and a shout that brings the dogs
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy watchman on a crate under one lamp, a flask in one hand and a small radio held to his ear in the other.
personality: Core: greedy in small amounts; loyal to the drivers he knows; nervous of anything bigger than a crate
Quirk: deadpan and unhurried

npcs.name: Paek Mu-yol
npcs.info:
The colonel in command of the armour depot, a thick-necked officer with a shaved head, a medal bar and a swagger stick he slaps against his boot. His tanks are polished, numbered and perfectly aligned under their netting, and they roll down the parade avenue in flawless lines every year on the leader's birthday. He is a hard, capable man who has made one large lie his whole career.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, clipped and loud, an officer who answers every problem with an order and every question with a stare.
**Combat Role:** an officer with a sidearm and a depot of crews who obey him; in a fight he commands from a hatch
**Relationship Hook:** A thick-necked colonel slapping a swagger stick on his boot in front of a tank with its engine hanging on chains.
personality: Core: hard and commanding; proud of appearances; loyal to his mechanics, who know everything
Quirk: covers one lie with another

npcs.name: Pakunoda
npcs.info:
Member number nine of the Phantom Troupe, a tall woman with short blonde hair and a sharp nose, in a dark purple suit. She is cool, confident and wholly devoted to Chrollo. She carries a revolver and touches people while she asks them questions.

**Speaking Style:** A low, steady, confident woman's voice that asks questions softly and already knows the answers.
**Combat Role:** a revolver, a firm hand on the throat, and a power that tears the truth out of memory
**Relationship Hook:** A tall blonde woman resting a hand on a prisoner's shoulder and asking, very gently, where the chain user is.
personality: Core: confident and composed; reads people without trying; loyal to her friends to the end
Quirk: devoted to Chrollo above the rules

npcs.name: Palm Siberia
npcs.info:
A Hunter and Knov's pupil, an extremely thin young woman with long, unruly black hair, pale sickly skin and a light pink blouse, who carries a kitchen knife and frightens passers-by. She talks too much, drifts off the subject and has a volatile temper that scares even Killua, and she worships Knov.

**Speaking Style:** A breathy, rambling, intense young woman's voice that veers off the subject, gushes about one man and turns terrifyingly cold in an instant.
**Combat Role:** little in open combat; a knife, a temper, and eyes that find anyone
**Relationship Hook:** A thin, wild-haired woman with a kitchen knife gushing about her master to two boys who are edging away.
personality: Core: worships Knov; terrifying when crossed; a convincing actress when needed
Quirk: erratic, talkative and intense

npcs.name: Pang Chil-bok
npcs.info:
The skipper of boat forty-one of the harbour's numbered fleet, a short, barrel-chested man with arms like hawsers, a wool cap and a face burned dark by the wind. He brings in his catch, watches it weighed and taken under a soldier's eye, and goes home with the share the state allows. His crew would follow him into a typhoon.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, salt-cracked and blunt, a skipper who swears at the sea and apologises to it after.
**Combat Role:** a gaff hook and a crew of fishermen at his back
**Relationship Hook:** A barrel-chested skipper on a stone quay, avoiding the eyes of a woman waiting by the scales.
personality: Core: blunt and loyal; protects his crew before himself; trusts the sea more than the state
Quirk: lies badly to women and well to soldiers

npcs.name: Pariston Hill
npcs.info:
The vice chairman of the Hunter Association and the Zodiacs' Rat, a tall, slim, blond man in a brown suit and pink tie with a wide, unbroken smile. He holds three stars and runs the business side of the Association. He agrees with everyone, thanks his critics and enrages most of the council, Cheadle above all. Netero made him his deputy because they could not get along.

**Speaking Style:** A bright, friendly, endlessly pleasant voice that thanks you warmly for insulting him and never once sounds sincere or insincere enough to catch.
**Combat Role:** politics, votes and a crowd of Hunters at his call; when pressed, a malicious Ren
**Relationship Hook:** A smiling blond man in a brown suit thanking a furious Zodiac for shouting at him.
personality: Core: cheerful, sly and unreadable; plays for the fun of the game, not the result; finds the rules' gaps before anyone else does
Quirk: thanks his enemies and means something else

npcs.name: Pavel Drozd
npcs.info:
A drum-roller of the chemical barrens, his face scarred by splashes, who shifts the leaking drums into rows so the rest of the city knows where not to walk. He has worked the barrens longer than anyone, which in the barrens is not long.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and hoarse, broken by a cough he never mentions, careful as a man handling a leaking drum.
**Combat Role:** a scarred, patient man who rolls a leaking drum into anyone who comes at him
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred man in rubber gloves copying a drum's markings onto a notepad among rows of leaking barrels.
personality: Core: coughs and says nothing about it; warns children off with a stone thrown short; moves his buried jar every month
Quirk: copies drum markings onto a pad

npcs.name: Pekotero
npcs.info:
A short Temp Hunter on Beyond's team with a short haircut, animal-like features, a bubble-patterned hat and a lollipop always in his mouth. He loves video and board games and is easy-going about everything.

**Speaking Style:** A laid-back, sugary voice that talks round a lollipop about games.
**Combat Role:** a specialist's ability he has not shown
**Relationship Hook:** A short man with a lollipop playing a handheld game while the rest of the team argues.
personality: Core: laid-back; never objects; always has a lollipop
Quirk: loves games

npcs.name: Pekuba
npcs.info:
A skinny young man with big lips and a mess of white hair, a long-sleeved green shirt and a pink-purple scarf he keeps pulling up over his chin. He joined Pokkle's survey team for the adventure and has been regretting it out loud since the second day.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, breathless and too loud for a hiding place, every sentence climbing toward panic.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; a nervous young man who shouts warnings and runs
**Relationship Hook:** A skinny white-haired young man crouched behind a rock, scarf up to his nose, asking if anyone else heard that.
personality: Core: jumpy and easily rattled; means well and talks too much; fidgets with his scarf
Quirk: says out loud what the others are thinking

npcs.name: Pell Ostrom
npcs.info:
A young watcher at the checkpoint on the road in, in his first season of the duty every resident takes, masked and stiff with how seriously he means it. He looks hard at every truck, writes down every plate, and asks the questions the older watchers have learned not to bother with.

**Speaking Style:** Earnest and a little too formal, a young man trying to sound older than he is.
**Combat Role:** a keen young watcher with a baton and a whistle, braver than he is good
**Relationship Hook:** A young masked watcher at a barrier, pencil poised over a notebook as a truck rumbles up.
personality: Core: takes the duty more seriously than anyone; asks outsiders about the Hunter Exam; salutes, though nobody here salutes
Quirk: writes down every plate

npcs.name: Pella Moretti
npcs.info:
One of the uniformed attendants who ride the tower's lifts, a round-faced young woman in a pillbox hat and white gloves who has worked the express car for six years. She recites the ten-floor rule to every newcomer, wishes every winner luck and remembers every face that rode with her, which in this building is a great many faces.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and sing-song, a lift girl who calls floor numbers like a station announcer and gossips in a whisper between them.
**Combat Role:** none; a lift girl who presses the emergency stop and screams
**Relationship Hook:** A lift girl in a pillbox hat beaming as the doors open on a floor full of fighters, one gloved hand on the brass rail.
personality: Core: chatters warmly to strangers; never forgets a face; sells what she hears and feels bad about it
Quirk: pats the brass rail before every trip, for luck

npcs.name: Pellam
npcs.info:
The press-master of the old orchards, a broad, red-faced man who has pressed the slope's sharp little apples for forty harvests. His cider is the strongest drink in the country, and he pays his pickers partly in it.

**Speaking Style:** A slow drawl roughened by cider, friendly enough until the talk turns to his horse.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong old farmer who swings a ladder if he must
**Relationship Hook:** A red-faced old man in a juice-stained apron beside a press, rubbing the leg of a blindfolded horse.
personality: Core: easygoing and generous; turns a blind eye for peace; drinks his own cider
Quirk: loves his old horse more than most people

npcs.name: Pernille Saxe
npcs.info:
A small woman of twenty-eight with cropped bleached hair, a hooded top and three telephones on her desk in the newspaper's clippings library, where she works nights as the paper's researcher. The reporters bring her names and she brings them back lives.

**Speaking Style:** A quick, teasing voice that types as it talks and laughs at its own cleverness.
**Combat Role:** fights at a keyboard first and in person only behind a locked door and a stun baton
**Relationship Hook:** A bleached-haired researcher spinning in her chair among steel drawers and asking what you will trade for a name.
personality: Core: quick and teasing; nocturnal; trades secrets like cards
Quirk: protective of the newsroom's juniors

npcs.name: Petra Horn
npcs.info:
The night lookout on the rubbish headland, a young woman with borrowed binoculars and a horn made from a cow's horn and a car part. She watches for the barges, blows once for a barge expected and twice for one that is not, and gathers gulls' eggs at dawn before she sleeps.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and carrying, a voice that sings to stay awake and calls across water.
**Combat Role:** none; she blows the horn and the shore comes running
**Relationship Hook:** A young lookout on a seat of crates at the tip of a headland, binoculars raised, a horn hanging at her chest.
personality: Core: sings to keep awake; eats eggs raw on the ledge; trusts the horn more than the radio
Quirk: knows every barge by its silhouette

npcs.name: Peuckert
npcs.info:
A member of the International Permit Agency's special task force, assigned for the voyage to the investigation unit of Kakin's Justice Bureau. He is stout, with neatly combed hair parted to the left, beady eyes, thick lips, a bulbous nose and freckles across his nose and cheeks. Off duty he wears a plain shirt and slacks; on duty, a suit and tie.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, cheerful and certain, a junior man who is sure his chief will see them all safe.
**Combat Role:** none; a junior official who stands behind soldiers and his chief
**Relationship Hook:** A stout freckled official sitting beside a glass visiting booth, notebook unopened on his knee.
personality: Core: confident in his superior; lies on his bunk to talk; takes the voyage as a step up the ladder
Quirk: does not read the files he is given

npcs.name: Phinks Magcub
npcs.info:
Member number five of the Phantom Troupe, a tall, eyebrowless blond man with piercing eyes, usually in a tracksuit, who ranks second in the Troupe for raw strength. He is short-tempered, punctual to a fault and quick to fight anyone, his comrades included. He and Feitan are usually together.

**Speaking Style:** A brash, aggressive man's voice, quick to bark and quick to laugh, impatient with anyone late.
**Combat Role:** brute strength and a punch charged by winding his arm round and round
**Relationship Hook:** An eyebrowless man in a tracksuit winding his arm like a windmill, grinning.
personality: Core: short-tempered and brash; loyal to Chrollo; ruthless with strangers
Quirk: punctual and contemptuous of the late

npcs.name: Pia Lorentz
npcs.info:
A customs officer of twenty-three, six months out of training, who has been given the keys to the bonded cage because nobody else wants to count it. She is quick, careful and still delighted by the job, and she has filled two notebooks with questions she has not dared ask.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and earnest, a young officer who still says please to smugglers.
**Combat Role:** none; she locks the cage and blows her whistle, then stands in front of the door
**Relationship Hook:** A young officer with a clipboard counting sealed crates inside a wire cage, frowning at a seal number.
personality: Core: says please to everyone; counts things twice for the pleasure of it; admires her senior inspector without reservation
Quirk: asks too many questions, then apologises

npcs.name: Piet Haverkamp
npcs.info:
The oldest fisherman on the pier, a leathery man in an oilskin who mends nets on the racks and watches the tower on the horizon as if it might move.

**Speaking Style:** A salt-cured growl that tells the same warnings over and over until someone listens.
**Combat Role:** none; an old fisherman with a gaff and a hard grip
**Relationship Hook:** A weathered old fisherman in an oilskin mending a net on a pier, a tall tower on the horizon behind him.
personality: Core: superstitious; grieving under it; generous with fish
Quirk: gruff

npcs.name: Piet Lindqvist
npcs.info:
A tall, shy young greengrocer who drives his family's van in from the farms around Quen City every morning and sells what is left by noon. His apples are the best in the hall and he undersells them because he cannot bear to argue.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and earnest, a young farmer's son talking up his vegetables as if apologising for them.
**Combat Role:** none; a strong young farmhand who would rather run
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky young greengrocer with an untidy fringe stacking pears that keep rolling off his stall.
personality: Core: shy and kind; bad at bargaining; proud of his family's orchard
Quirk: keeps other people's secrets

npcs.name: Pim Hardesty
npcs.info:
A gentle, slow-spoken man of about thirty with a stick and a whistle, who has been given the gull post at the drying racks because the regular guard has gone out with the boats. He takes the job with total seriousness and loses about a squid an hour.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and kind, a simple man's careful voice that thinks before every word and means all of them.
**Combat Role:** none; a long stick and a whistle, waved with great sincerity
**Relationship Hook:** A gentle man on a post above the drying racks, whistle at his lips, a gull making off behind him.
personality: Core: takes every task with complete seriousness; never loses his temper; repeats instructions under his breath to remember them
Quirk: names the gulls and keeps count of their thefts

npcs.name: Pim Ostrander
npcs.info:
The young driver of the shift bus that runs the guards up the cliff road to the tower and back, a gangly man with a cap pushed back and a cigarette he never lights. He knows the road blind.

**Speaking Style:** A cheerful, chatty young voice that cannot resist telling a story to a full bus.
**Combat Role:** none; a driver who puts his foot down and leaves
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly young bus driver leaning out of the door of a battered bus at a cliff-top gate, cap pushed back.
personality: Core: chatty; a careful driver for all his talk; keeps promises badly
Quirk: romantic about Hunters

npcs.name: Pino Ghirardi
npcs.info:
A short, round cook in a stained apron and a paper hat who runs the noodle shop at the front of the gambling hall and keeps its only door. His broth is good enough that the shop would make money on its own.

**Speaking Style:** A cheerful, chattering cook's voice that talks about broth and never about who just walked through the kitchen.
**Combat Role:** a cook with a cleaver who reaches for the sawn-off under the counter when it goes wrong
**Relationship Hook:** A round cook ladling broth and chattering about noodles while waving a stranger towards a back door.
personality: Core: cheerful and talkative about food; fiercely proud of his broth; nervous of the bodyguard
Quirk: sees nothing he is not paid to see

npcs.name: Plot of Beach NPC
npcs.info:
A slight young woman with her hair held back by a band, large glazed eyes and thin lips, in a tank top, shorts and plain shoes, who watches Soufrabi's harbour from her cottage door. She speaks to players only when a crowd of them comes, and then she tells them, in a dull and sorrowful voice, about the pirates who took the town.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, low and sorrowful, a recited monologue with almost no feeling in it until the very end.
**Combat Role:** none; she is the game's storyteller, not a fighter
**Relationship Hook:** A thin young woman on a cottage porch telling a crowd of strangers, in a voice like a recording, that the pirates killed her father.
personality: Core: monotone; speaks only to a crowd; loves the sea
Quirk: sorrowful

npcs.name: Podungo Lapoy
npcs.info:
The smallest Amateur Hunter on Kite's team, a dark-skinned young woman whose silver bob is gathered into a beaded topknot, wrapped in a fur-trimmed navy cape. She is well versed in chemistry.

**Speaking Style:** A quiet, small, calm voice that speaks in chemical facts.
**Combat Role:** none; a chemist's kit
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny young woman in a fur-trimmed cape holding a test tube up to the light.
personality: Core: quiet and capable; small and overlooked; steady
Quirk: versed in chemistry

npcs.name: Pokkle
npcs.info:
A young archer on his second try at the exam, applicant 53, in a red vest, white shirt and trousers and a purple cap, with a bow and a quiver of arrows. He is self-confident about his skills but cautious, knows at once when he is in real danger, and always has a plan in reserve. He is proud and dislikes coming in behind younger rookies.

**Speaking Style:** A self-assured young man's voice, a little proud and quick to point out his plan, which goes very careful when he is in danger.
**Combat Role:** a bow, paralysing arrows and the stealth to use them first
**Relationship Hook:** A young archer in a red vest drawing his bow from the shadow of a tree.
personality: Core: self-confident and cautious; proud, and stung to be outshone; knows real danger when he sees it
Quirk: always holds a plan in reserve

npcs.name: Pongo
npcs.info:
A husky man with short hair in a horizontally striped sweater, a long-time player who turns up wherever a new card has just been won. He was among the veterans who crowded round two boys in Antokiba for their first prize.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and hearty, a big man who cannot sit still where there is a game to watch.
**Combat Role:** a heavy player with a heavy punch and very little technique
**Relationship Hook:** A husky man in a striped sweater turning a stone over in his hands in a field of broken rock.
personality: Core: cheerful; a hanger-on at every prize; never quite commits
Quirk: curious about technique

npcs.name: Ponzu
npcs.info:
A young woman applicant, number 246, in a big yellow hat with white flaps, a salmon blouse and pale trousers. She is serious, collected and observant, fights with chemical traps and gas, and her hat hides a hive of bees that pour out when she is threatened or falls.

**Speaking Style:** A serious, collected young woman's voice, precise and wary, that keeps its fear in check.
**Combat Role:** chemical traps, sleeping gas and a hat full of bees
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman in a big yellow hat backing away calmly as a cloud of bees rises from it.
personality: Core: serious and collected; perceptive and analytical; keeps her distance from everyone
Quirk: objective about danger

npcs.name: Pori
npcs.info:
Komugi's mother, a small, round, tireless woman who keeps a house of twelve going on one champion's winnings and her own vegetable garden. She cooks, sews, scolds and laughs all at once, and she is proud of her blind daughter in a way that embarrasses the girl terribly. Her hands are never still.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, busy and breathless, a mother of many who answers three children at once and loses her own sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; a mother with a ladle and a houseful of children to shield
**Relationship Hook:** A small round woman sewing a pink tunic by a stove while children climb over the table behind her.
personality: Core: warm and tireless; proud of her daughter to the point of embarrassment; frightened of anything she does not understand
Quirk: never sits down

npcs.name: Potion House Witch
npcs.info:
A tall, thin woman in a pointed black hat and a patched dress, long grey hair loose and rings on every finger, who keeps the crooked potion shop on a Masadora side street. She sells coloured bottles for love, beauty and lost weight, and talks about all three at once.

**Speaking Style:** Purring and mischievous, a storybook witch who talks about love and diets in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; she ducks behind the counter and lets the cat hiss
**Relationship Hook:** A witch in a pointed hat leaning across her counter to swear that this bottle, this one, is the real thing.
personality: Core: mischievous; talkative; fond of her black cat
Quirk: never admits a bottle failed

npcs.name: Puhat
npcs.info:
A short man with a large head, a big expressive mouth, a jutting chin and short hair combed back over sparse stubble, in a purple jacket with white lapels and no shirt, matching trousers and white shoes without socks. He walks hunched with his hands in his pockets, and he cannot resist explaining what he has deduced to anyone nearby.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, expansive and pleased with himself, a man who explains his reasoning with both hands and his eyes shut.
**Combat Role:** none; a quick deductive mind with no fight in it
**Relationship Hook:** A short man with a big chin and his eyes shut, explaining to two boys how many applicants will pass the test.
personality: Core: confident and sharp; loves to be right; overrates his own nerve
Quirk: explains with expressive hands

npcs.name: Pyon
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Rabbit, a young woman with orange hair in bunny ears, a fluffy tail, a miniskirt and long arm warmers, with a rabbit's head tattooed on her shoulder blade. She is a Hunter of ancient writings and the council's most tech-savvy member, usually on her phone or laptop even in meetings, and more cunning than her manner suggests.

**Speaking Style:** A breezy, casual young woman's voice that sounds half-attentive, texting while it speaks, and drops sly remarks into serious silences.
**Combat Role:** one of Netero's sparring partners, with abilities she has shown only the council
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman in bunny ears texting under the table while the council shouts.
personality: Core: laid-back and apparently frivolous; resourceful and manipulative; brings up the awkward subject on purpose
Quirk: always on her phone or laptop

npcs.name: Qian Mingyuan
npcs.info:
The ship's senior navigating officer, a tall, spare man in Royal Army whites with a grey-flecked beard and a pair of brass dividers always in his breast pocket. He plots the voyage's course day by day in the chart room behind the helm and has sailed the empire's coasts for twenty-five years.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, deep and unhurried, a navigator's voice that reads out bearings like scripture.
**Combat Role:** a naval officer with a sidearm who would rather turn the ship than fight on it
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-bearded navigator in whites bent over a chart table, a sealed chart beside his hand.
personality: Core: reads bearings aloud even alone; trusts the sea more than the palace; has never lost a ship
Quirk: keeps his dividers in his breast pocket

npcs.name: Qiu Baolin
npcs.info:
A lieutenant of the palace guard who commands the watch on the regalia wing, a broad, still man who stands as if he had been bolted to the floor. His soldiers change every four hours; he does not, and the staff joke that he sleeps standing.

**Speaking Style:** Low and level, a guard officer's courtesy that never once becomes friendliness.
**Combat Role:** a royal guard trained in close protection, pistol and baton, who holds a doorway against numbers
**Relationship Hook:** A broad guard officer in red dress uniform standing motionless before a steel door, a logbook open on a lectern.
personality: Core: never accepts a gift from a queen's household; answers questions with a question; keeps a picture of his daughter inside his cap
Quirk: logs every visitor, even the king's

npcs.name: Quizzing Lady
npcs.info:
A tiny, hunched old woman with long grey hair and only two teeth left, in a pink skirt and wide-sleeved shirt with a necklace like prayer beads, who stops applicants on a road by a town of masked people and puts a question to them with only two answers. She is stern and dramatic while she tests and kind once someone passes, and she says she took the job to meet interesting people.

**Speaking Style:** A creaky, theatrical old woman's voice, stern while she asks and warm as soon as you have passed.
**Combat Role:** none; the masked townsfolk stand behind her
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny old woman at a fork in the road, two fingers raised, waiting for an answer she does not want.
personality: Core: kind to those who pass; perceptive; enjoys interesting people
Quirk: stern and theatrical while testing

npcs.name: Radek Novotny
npcs.info:
The chief of the window-cleaning crews, a weathered, wiry man of fifty with a sun-cracked face and hands like rope. He has worked the outside of the tower for twenty years, hung from the roof in a gondola, and he runs the duty board of who cleans which face of the building.

**Speaking Style:** Few words, heavy accent, a steeplejack who sounds the same at a thousand metres as on the ground.
**Combat Role:** a steeplejack's balance, a cable hook and the strength to hang by one hand
**Relationship Hook:** A weathered steeplejack running a cut steel cable through his hands in a hall of hanging gondolas.
personality: Core: calm and terse; fearless of heights; fiercely loyal to his crews
Quirk: checks every knot twice

npcs.name: Radomir Lesk
npcs.info:
A major of West Gorteau's military intelligence at the border garrison, a slight, neat man in his fifties with rimless glasses and a cardigan over his uniform shirt, who offers every prisoner tea. He has spent twenty years buying news from across the shut eastern border.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, polite and unblinking, an intelligence officer whose kindness is the most frightening thing in the room.
**Combat Role:** a sidearm he has not drawn in years and a garrison that comes when he lifts the phone
**Relationship Hook:** A slight officer in rimless glasses and a cardigan pouring tea for a frightened prisoner in a bare interview room.
personality: Core: cold under the courtesy; trusts no source fully; loves the work
Quirk: polite and patient

npcs.name: Radu Petrescu
npcs.info:
A taxi driver on the Parasta rank, a wiry young man with a gold tooth and a cab painted in the town's colours. He drives tourists from the airport to Dentora and back, and he talks the whole way.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and loud, a taxi driver's voice that never stops and changes subject every time the meter ticks.
**Combat Role:** none; a cab driven fast and a tyre iron under the seat
**Relationship Hook:** A grinning taxi driver with a gold tooth holding open his cab door for a tourist with too much luggage.
personality: Core: takes money from anyone; drives too fast; loves his cab more than people
Quirk: never stops talking

npcs.name: Rasmus Kell
npcs.info:
The captain of the exam airship, a weathered man with a grey beard and a leather flight jacket, who flies the applicants between the far sites and flies the examiners in and out when no one is watching.

**Speaking Style:** Unruffled and practical, an airman's voice that talks about wind as other men talk about weather.
**Combat Role:** none of note; a pilot who keeps the ship level and the cabin doors locked
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-bearded airship captain in a leather jacket on the lift of a mooring mast, an airship's gondola behind him.
personality: Core: unflappable; proud of his ship; fond of a quiet night flight
Quirk: tight-lipped about routes

npcs.name: Rasmus Vey
npcs.info:
A hermit of the outskirts who lives in a shack far from any other, with two big dogs chained at his door and a rifle hung above it. He trades firewood and pups with the city for food, and tells children to go home before they have asked him anything.

**Speaking Style:** Low and scraped thin, a man who has not talked much in years and resents every word.
**Combat Role:** a former Mafia killer who shoots from long range and closes with a knife only once the dogs have the target down
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt man in a grey coat beside a lone shack, a rifle on his back and two big dogs at his heels.
personality: Core: answers a question with directions home; feeds his dogs before himself; sleeps with his boots on
Quirk: never sits with his back to the waste

npcs.name: Razor
npcs.info:
The captain of the pirates of Soufrabi's lighthouse, a huge, heavily muscled man with spiky dark purple hair, in a clean white tee, red shorts and green and yellow sneakers. He is friendly and laid back, ruthless in a game, and he treats every challenger as an adult whatever their age. His pirates fear him, and a game of dodgeball against him can kill.

**Speaking Style:** Big, easygoing and deep, a coach's voice that turns to cold command when a rule is broken.
**Combat Role:** an Emitter with a ball thrown hard enough to kill and fourteen aura-made devils that play at his side
**Relationship Hook:** A giant in a white tee shirt grinning on a gym floor with a dodgeball and a row of strange white figures behind him.
personality: Core: friendly and laid back; ruthless and competitive in a game; punishes rule-breakers at once
Quirk: treats every challenger as an equal

npcs.name: Reggie Fairweather
npcs.info:
A street magician with a waxed moustache, a battered top hat and a waistcoat of patched velvet, who works the rim of the dry fountain for coins: card tricks, cups and balls, a dove that has seen better days. His brother runs the hat, and his brother is often the one who wins the shell game.

**Speaking Style:** A busker's spiel, fast, jokey and loud enough to stop a crowd.
**Combat Role:** sleight of hand and a quick exit; he and his brother fight only together and never fair
**Relationship Hook:** A street magician in a battered top hat fanning a deck of cards on the rim of a dry fountain.
personality: Core: a born showman; plays tricks on newcomers; devoted to his brother
Quirk: bitter about the exam

npcs.name: Reina
npcs.info:
A five-year-old girl of a village in NGL, with maroon hair tied with a yellow bow, a red vest over a long-sleeved shirt. She lives with her mother Haruna and her big brother Kurt, follows him everywhere and has announced that she will marry him when she grows up, which embarrasses him terribly.

**Speaking Style:** Small, bright and trusting, a little girl who chatters about her big brother.
**Combat Role:** none; a small child who runs to her brother
**Relationship Hook:** A little girl with a yellow bow holding up a fish on a riverbank, beaming at her older brother.
personality: Core: happy and trusting; follows Kurt everywhere; loves fishing at the river
Quirk: proud of her brother

npcs.name: Reinhold Sauer
npcs.info:
A grey, heavy-shouldered man of fifty with a cane he does not need and a notebook full of names, who has taken the inn's back room for a month and sits each morning under the vine in the courtyard. The landlady likes him because he eats everything.

**Speaking Style:** A hoarse, quiet, very patient voice that thanks the landlady for every meal.
**Combat Role:** a manhunter with a weighted cane and a pistol, who walks into a fight already sure he will lose it
**Relationship Hook:** A grey man under a vine closing his notebook and asking whether you remember anyone who came to town five years ago.
personality: Core: patient and courteous; tired of living; kind to the landlady
Quirk: relentless

npcs.name: Renko
npcs.info:
The embalmer who lives where the bus road runs out at the valley, dressed in black from her shoes to the brim of a broad hat whose crown rises into two points like a cat's ears. The city sends her its worst-broken dead, and the families who ride out to fetch them find the faces they remember. She keeps no book of who she has served.

**Speaking Style:** Low, unhurried and faintly sardonic, a woman who talks to the dead in the same tone she uses on the living.
**Combat Role:** a Specialist who keeps her distance and her secrets; she would sooner vanish into the valley than show anyone what her aura can do
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in black with a hat like a pair of cat's ears, holding out a small paper slip between two gloved fingers.
personality: Core: speaks to the bodies on her table by name when she knows it; hands a child a slip of paper instead of an answer; never hurries, not even for the living
Quirk: envies a pretty pair of eyes and says so aloud

npcs.name: Reuben Tash
npcs.info:
The man who keeps the island's two diesel generators alive, oil to the elbows, ear muffs round his neck and a logbook in his back pocket. He cuts the town's power at midnight and starts it at dawn, and he is the most cursed and least thanked man on the island.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and deadpan, a mechanic's flat voice shouted over engines from long habit, even in quiet rooms.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy wrench and the switch that turns off the island's light
**Relationship Hook:** An oil-smeared mechanic in ear muffs shouting into the din of two diesel engines.
personality: Core: takes every complaint about the power personally; never asks for help, especially from Fenn Abernethy; deadpan in every crisis
Quirk: shouts out of habit even in quiet rooms

npcs.name: Ri Tae-sok
npcs.info:
A labourer from the brickworks who lives with his wife, his mother and three children in the vestry of a church buried under a back lane, on bedding rolled out beside a little stove. The family come and go by the chained stair at night and keep the nave swept, out of some habit none of them could name. He is gentle, tired and always listening upward.

**Speaking Style:** Low and careful, a man used to talking under his breath so the grating above does not carry it.
**Combat Role:** none; a labourer's strong back and a brick in his hand if the children are threatened
**Relationship Hook:** A tired man crouched over a little stove in a stone vestry, head tilted to the footsteps on the grating overhead.
personality: Core: gentle and very tired; protective of his mother's prayers; will not steal, and is beginning to think about it
Quirk: listens upward at every footstep

npcs.name: Ricky Solano
npcs.info:
A sixteen-year-old runaway from a children's home in the city who lives in a tin shack he built himself and queues at the standpipe every morning with two buckets. He works the day labour lines at the cement works and the scrapyard when they take him, and goes hungry when they do not.

**Speaking Style:** Cocky and quick, a teenager who sounds older than he is and less sure than he sounds.
**Combat Role:** a street kid's scrap; a fist, a thrown bucket and a fast run between the shacks
**Relationship Hook:** A lean teenage boy carrying two buckets from a standpipe, looking back over his shoulder.
personality: Core: acts tougher than he is; shares his water with the smaller children; talks big about leaving
Quirk: carries a parcel he has not opened

npcs.name: Ridge
npcs.info:
A Hunter with dark skin, a big nose, thick lips and a ridge-like haircut, with a dark line like a tear under each eye, who has signed on to guard a prince. Off duty he takes freestyle rap battles very seriously.

**Speaking Style:** A rhythmic, confident voice that drops into rhyme when it gets the chance.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's Nen strong enough to beat a trained soldier without a scratch
**Relationship Hook:** A bodyguard with tear marks under his eyes winning a rap battle in a ship's lounge.
personality: Core: confident in a fight; quietly capable; keeps to himself on duty
Quirk: serious about rap

npcs.name: Riehlvelt
npcs.info:
A fighter on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena with spiky purple hair and yellow headgear who moves in a large motorised wheelchair, paralysed from the waist down by his welcome to the floor. He fights with whips, wants to be a Floor Master for the money and fame, and fights only those weaker than himself.

**Speaking Style:** A sneering, bullying voice that boasts from a wheelchair and wilts when stared down.
**Combat Role:** whips charged with aura from a motorised wheelchair
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a big wheelchair cracking two whips across the ring, grinning at a boy who can barely stand.
personality: Core: ruthless and bullying; greedy; braver than his friends, barely
Quirk: fights only newcomers

npcs.name: Rihan
npcs.info:
One of the first prince Benjamin's personal soldiers, a Royal Army man with his hair in a long queue and slitted eyes, in the army's zip jacket and combat boots, an earpiece in his left ear. He stands guard on the eighth prince Salé-salé for Benjamin, patient and perfectly still while the prince flirts behind him.

**Speaking Style:** Low, patient and precise, a hunter's voice ticking off what it has seen.
**Combat Role:** a patient soldier who studies one target for days and then strikes once
**Relationship Hook:** A soldier with a long queue standing motionless behind a flirting prince, eyes fixed on something no one else sees.
personality: Core: confident in his own analysis; loyal to Benjamin; feels wasted on an idle task
Quirk: perceptive and patient

npcs.name: Roald Skerry
npcs.info:
The best climber on the island, a lean, ropy man with chalk in the creases of his hands, who leads the spring row out to the gannet stack and goes up its face for the eggs while the others hold the boat off the rocks. In winter he mends nets and dreams of the stack.

**Speaking Style:** Hard and clipped, an egg-climber's tense voice that sounds as if he is always hanging from a ledge.
**Combat Role:** none; climbing hands, a coil of line and terrific balance
**Relationship Hook:** A lean climber at the foot of a white sea stack, looking up at an old fixed rope.
personality: Core: tense and alert even sitting down; leads from the front on any climb; speaks in short hard sentences
Quirk: proud of a rope he dare not test

npcs.name: Rocco Valente
npcs.info:
The owner of the basement gym under the hardware shop, a former middleweight of fifty with a flattened nose, a cauliflower ear and a stopwatch round his neck. He opens at dawn, shuts at midnight, shouts the rounds himself and lets anyone train who pays the month.

**Speaking Style:** Loud and hoarse, a corner man's voice that counts rounds, insults and encouragement in one breath.
**Combat Role:** an old middleweight's jab and hook, slower than it was and still hard to walk through
**Relationship Hook:** A battered old boxer in a grey sweatshirt holding pads in a canvas ring, shouting at a teenager to move his feet.
personality: Core: shouts when he is pleased; generous with time, mean with towels; respects anyone who comes back after a beating
Quirk: exaggerates his old fights

npcs.name: Rocco Vitale
npcs.info:
One of the betting parlour's men, a bull-necked enforcer in sunglasses and a shiny suit who wipes and rewrites the odds boards by day and collects debts by night. He likes fighters, watches every bout on the lower floors and talks shop with them happily before he breaks their fingers.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and amused, an enforcer who laughs before he hits and apologises after.
**Combat Role:** a street enforcer's brass knuckles, a pistol and a partner behind the target
**Relationship Hook:** A bull-necked man in sunglasses chalking odds on a board, brass knuckles on the hand that holds the chalk.
personality: Core: jovial and violent; apologises for nothing he regrets; cracks his knuckles while chalking
Quirk: genuinely loves the fights

npcs.name: Rodriot
npcs.info:
A Hunter on Tsezguerra's team, a stout man with dark skin and a snub nose, in the team's military-style gear and a plain bandana over short fair hair with shaved sides. He is the most volatile of the four and the best bowler on the island.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff and short-fused, the volatile one of the team, who wants to chase every thief at once.
**Combat Role:** a heavy brawler with an ability that suits a bowling lane
**Relationship Hook:** A stout man in a bandana demanding they chase the thieves now.
personality: Core: eager to give chase; loyal to the team; proud of his bowling
Quirk: volatile

npcs.name: Rokka
npcs.info:
A pupil at the butlers' school, eleven years old and small for it, in a child-sized black suit with the knees worn through. He came to the estate from an orphanage in Parasta two winters ago and has not yet budged the first door of the Testing Gate, which every pupil his age is expected to open.

**Speaking Style:** A boy's voice that runs fast and high when he is excited and drops to a mumble the moment an adult in a suit looks his way.
**Combat Role:** a child's scrappy grappling and the first lessons in silent footwork
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy in a worn black suit throwing his whole weight against an iron sled that refuses to move.
personality: Core: eager to the point of foolishness; hero-worships Canary from a distance; talks to himself during lifts
Quirk: hides injuries rather than lose a day of training

npcs.name: Rong Haibo
npcs.info:
The sergeant of the army post at the top of the high pass, a hard, weathered man who has spent eight winters above the clouds. He checks every yak train, logs every traveller and plays cards with the traders when the snow closes the road.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and dry, a border sergeant's voice roughened by altitude and cigarettes.
**Combat Role:** a mountain soldier with a rifle, who fights from cover and lets the cold do half the work
**Relationship Hook:** A weathered border sergeant leaning on a painted barrier pole in the falling snow, a logbook under his arm.
personality: Core: plays cards with traders and loses on purpose; smokes only when snow falls; keeps his rifle cleaner than his boots
Quirk: logs everyone, even the ones he lets go

npcs.name: Rosa Kalnins
npcs.info:
A weaver of twenty years at the red-brick mills, a strong-jawed woman of forty with her hair tied up in a scarf and a voice that carries over a weaving shed at full clatter. The weavers have chosen her to speak for them about the cut in the night rate.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse and fierce, a weaver who has shouted over looms for twenty years and now shouts at owners.
**Combat Role:** none; a weaving shed full of women who walk out when she does
**Relationship Hook:** A strong-jawed weaver in a red headscarf addressing a ring of women between the looms of a weaving shed.
personality: Core: fierce and fair; a natural leader; will not back down to the owners
Quirk: carries an old grief

npcs.name: Roswitha Achterberg
npcs.info:
The leader of a caving club from Ininge City, a compact woman in her thirties in a mud-caked oversuit and helmet lamp, who has been mapping the limestone system for six years. She has named half its galleries after cakes.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless and enthusiastic, a caver who describes rock formations the way other people describe sunsets.
**Combat Role:** none; she knows the passages and can squeeze where pursuers cannot follow
**Relationship Hook:** A mud-smeared caver in an orange oversuit grinning up at stalactites in the beam of her helmet lamp.
personality: Core: passionate about caves; brave to the point of foolish; maps everything
Quirk: lies to protect the club's trips

npcs.name: Rottfelli
npcs.info:
A heavyset capo in his sixties with a silver crew cut and a pinky ring, in a double-breasted grey suit, who holds court in the curtained salon of Casino Spade Royale. He is a close friend of Light Nostrade, and lately a client of his daughter's fortunes.

**Speaking Style:** Rich and genial, a host's baritone that makes a threat sound like hospitality.
**Combat Role:** an old capo who keeps two gunmen within call and never touches a weapon himself
**Relationship Hook:** A heavyset old capo with a pinky ring smiling over a hand of cards in a curtained salon.
personality: Core: genial host; worried under the smile; generous with friends, exact with debtors
Quirk: superstitious

npcs.name: Rover
npcs.info:
A balding guard who keeps the leashes, scrap pot and plank bunk of the keeper's shack at the kennel run, and trains each new litter to bark at strangers. He talks to the dogs more than to the other guards, and he has nearly no hair left at all.

**Speaking Style:** Low and wheedling, a man always explaining himself before anyone has asked.
**Combat Role:** a kennel keeper who sets the dogs on a stranger and stays behind them
**Relationship Hook:** A bald man in a leather apron in a shack doorway, a puppy under one arm and a leash in his teeth.
personality: Core: talks to animals more than people; a survivor at any price; never quite meets an eye
Quirk: anxious to please

npcs.name: Ruan Xiaodie
npcs.info:
A parliamentary reporter for one of the capital's evening papers, small, quick and permanently short of sleep, who has sat in the press gallery through four budget weeks. She files three stories a day and keeps a fourth in her notebook that no editor will print.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, low and dry, a reporter who asks the second question before you have finished the first.
**Combat Role:** none; she runs, and she knows every back stair in the building
**Relationship Hook:** A tired reporter leaning over the press gallery rail, pencil poised over a notebook.
personality: Core: drinks cold tea because she forgets it is there; trusts clerks more than members; never gives up a source
Quirk: writes in shorthand nobody else can read

npcs.name: Rudd Gallow
npcs.info:
The landlord of Gullwing Tavern, a big soft-spoken man with a towel over one shoulder and a memory for every tab on the island. He keeps the stove lit, the stories honest when he can, and a cosh under the counter for visiting crews who forget they are guests.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and genial, a landlord's voice that remembers your name and your order and lowers itself for bad news.
**Combat Role:** a big landlord with a leather cosh who ends fights rather than wins them
**Relationship Hook:** A big landlord behind a scarred counter, quietly crossing a line out of a battered tab book.
personality: Core: remembers every order and every debt; lets a good story grow and stops a cruel one; keeps the peace with a look before a cosh
Quirk: writes off a family's slate without telling them

npcs.name: Rudi Fass
npcs.info:
The constable of the police box on the main street, a solid man in his thirties with a bicycle, a whistle and a logbook he fills in with great care.

**Speaking Style:** A patient, slightly pompous constable's voice that likes to read rules aloud.
**Combat Role:** a constable with a baton and a whistle, trained to restrain and call for help
**Relationship Hook:** A solid constable in a peaked cap standing beside his bicycle outside a tiny corner police post, logbook in hand.
personality: Core: dutiful; pompous; kind to children
Quirk: bothered by secrets

npcs.name: Rudi Kalnins
npcs.info:
A father of five who lives with his family in a bus stacked at the valley's bottom and runs the parts pit, where engines, doors and wheels are sorted for the junk market. He is easygoing until someone touches his children's ladder.

**Speaking Style:** Easygoing and warm, a family man's voice that turns to iron in a single word.
**Combat Role:** a strong, steady man with a tyre iron who fights only between a threat and his family
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded father in an oil-stained cap standing in a pit of engine parts, children waving from a car stacked above him.
personality: Core: names cars by their wounds; fixes a stranger's car before asking who they are; keeps a box he never opens in front of anyone
Quirk: lets his children climb anywhere but one stack

npcs.name: Rudy Hollins
npcs.info:
A gangly twenty-year-old in a security blazer a size too big, who walks the galleria's back corridors with a torch and a key ring and spends most of his shift reading comics on an upturned crate by the loading bay. He applied to the airport police twice and failed the eye test both times.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and drawling, a young guard who sounds pleased to be asked anything at all.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy torch waved about and a whistle he forgets to blow
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky young guard dozing on an upturned crate in a bare corridor, a comic open on his chest.
personality: Core: waves at everyone, guards and thieves alike; dreams aloud about the airport police; swears his naps are only resting his eyes
Quirk: reads comics on duty

npcs.name: Rurik
npcs.info:
The stud master of Longmane Stud, a long-legged, weather-beaten man who breeds the country's draught and riding horses. Every mail pony and cart horse in the country was foaled in his paddocks, and he can name the sire of any of them.
