**Speaking Style:** Few words and all of them slow, a horseman who would rather nod than speak.
**Combat Role:** none; a horseman who rides away from trouble faster than it follows
**Relationship Hook:** A tall horseman with a lantern in a straw-filled barn, watching a mare and not you.
personality: Core: quiet and patient; reads horses better than people; keeps a false stud book because he was told to
Quirk: uneasy since the tracks

npcs.name: Ruta
npcs.info:
A widow from a hill village who has camped on the waiting mound for nine days with a blanket and a bundle, waiting to be heard by the council. She shares her fire with newcomers and tells each of them her petition.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and steady, a widow's voice that has said the same request so often it no longer shakes.
**Combat Role:** none; a widow who will not leave
**Relationship Hook:** A white-haired widow by a small fire on the mound, offering you half her bread.
personality: Core: patient and stubborn; will not be moved; knows what she saw
Quirk: generous to strangers

npcs.name: Ruta Benes
npcs.info:
The head stitcher of the row, a round, quick woman who works the first treadle machine and can turn a bolt of salvaged cloth into a wrap and a mask before the kettle boils. Every family on her lane orders from her, and she remembers each order down to the thread.

**Speaking Style:** Chatty and quick, a stitcher's running gossip that never once slows her needle.
**Combat Role:** none; a pair of shears and a voice that brings the whole row out
**Relationship Hook:** A plump stitcher at a treadle machine, measuring tape round her neck, glancing up at a stranger's collar.
personality: Core: talks without looking up from the needle; measures people with her eyes; bites thread instead of cutting it
Quirk: gossips freely about everything but the watch

npcs.name: Ruth Calloway
npcs.info:
The phone company's relay technician, a compact, wry woman of thirty-six who drives up the switchbacks twice a week to keep the mast and its humming equipment running. She has worked the mesa for eight years and likes it better than any office.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, technical and wry, a technician who describes a broken circuit as a personal insult.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy torch and a fast drive down the switchbacks
**Relationship Hook:** A compact technician in coveralls frowning at a new lock on a concrete hut beneath a radio mast.
personality: Core: drives the switchbacks too fast; prefers machines to people; keeps a spare key to everything, except now
Quirk: takes broken equipment personally

npcs.name: Ryang Ok-gi
npcs.info:
The fire lookout of the northern ridges, a solitary woman in a forestry uniform who lives in the wooden tower on the highest ridge with a pair of binoculars, a radio and a map pinned to every wall. She calls in smoke, logs the weather and sees no one for weeks at a time, which suits her. She can name every ridge and valley in the province by its shape.

**Speaking Style:** Cool and clear, a radio voice trained to read out bearings and nothing else.
**Combat Role:** none; an old hunting rifle she has only used on boar
**Relationship Hook:** A lone lookout in a wooden tower holding binoculars on a thread of smoke in a far valley.
personality: Core: solitary and self-sufficient; precise about what she sees; not easily frightened, and frightened now
Quirk: keeps a private log of what she cannot report

npcs.name: Ryu
npcs.info:
Applicant 34, a swordsman of average build with spiky green hair, blue eyes and a turned-up nose, in a tunic over a long-sleeved shirt, plain trousers and boots, a sheathed broadsword on his belt. He got down the tower inside the time and now sits on the boat with the others, saying little.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and offhand, a swordsman's voice that sounds more relaxed than he is.
**Combat Role:** a broadsword fighter who trusts reach and weight
**Relationship Hook:** A green-haired swordsman sitting at a boat's rail with his hand on his sword, watching the island grow closer.
personality: Core: outwardly relaxed; keeps a hand near his sword; watches others instead of talking
Quirk: has done less homework than he should

npcs.name: Ryu Tong-sik
npcs.info:
A goatherd who drives a small flock across the stony plain beyond the palace, sleeping in a hollow of the ridge in a felt coat and moving on before anyone thinks to ask him for papers. He is lean and leathery, carries a crook and a skin of water, and knows where every trickle in the rock can be found.

**Speaking Style:** Spare and windblown, the voice of a man who talks to goats more than people.
**Combat Role:** none; a crook and a sling for wolves
**Relationship Hook:** A leathery goatherd on a ridge of broken stone, crook in hand, watching an airship drone low over the empty plain.
personality: Core: distrusts anyone with a uniform; kind to animals, wary of men; superstitious about the empty plain
Quirk: silent and self-reliant

npcs.name: Sabazushi
npcs.info:
A rotund man in his fifties with short fair hair, a darker moustache, a square face and a flat nose, in a camouflage uniform and a beret. He commands the armed guard at the castle where a billionaire keeps his game consoles running, and he runs it like a payroll: shifts posted, wages paid on the day, no questions about the rooms upstairs.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and plain-spoken, a sergeant's voice that delivers bad news straight and then offers coffee.
**Combat Role:** a professional soldier with a rifle, a radio and a squad behind him, and no Nen to speak of
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy man in a beret and camouflage stopping at a castle gate to tell three Hunters something they will not like.
personality: Core: runs his men by the clock; pays and expects to be paid; keeps out of his employer's business
Quirk: kinder than his uniform

npcs.name: Sabine Arkwright
npcs.info:
A Beast Hunter in a mud-coloured field jacket who has camped at the edge of the denning hollows since late autumn, logging the foxbear dens with a camera, a notebook and a patience the islanders find unsettling. She is polite, keeps to the forest and buys her bread at the bakehouse once a week.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and quiet, a field scientist's voice that notes everything aloud as if dictating to a recorder.
**Combat Role:** a Nen user who wraps herself in a silent, scentless aura and pins a charging beast with a weighted net and a stun spear
**Relationship Hook:** A Beast Hunter crouched motionless among scored trunks, camera raised, while a foxbear passes ten feet away.
personality: Core: never hurries an animal or a person; polite and quite impossible to move; trusts animals' behaviour over people's stories
Quirk: dictates her observations aloud

npcs.name: Sabine Roux
npcs.info:
The winemaker of the terraced vineyards, a sun-browned woman of fifty in a straw hat and a stained apron who runs the stone winery at the foot of the hill with her two daughters. She tastes from the barrel every morning and spits with great accuracy.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, low and warm, a vintner who describes wine as if it were weather and family.
**Combat Role:** none; a pruning knife and two grown daughters
**Relationship Hook:** A sun-browned vintner in a stained apron holding a glass of red up to a lamp in a stone cellar of barrels.
personality: Core: patient and loyal; proud of her wine; sharp with fools
Quirk: keeps faith with absent friends

npcs.name: Saccho Kobayakawa
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Horse, a horse-faced man with protruding front teeth and long black hair in a ponytail, in a purple yukata painted with flowers, with two bandage-wrapped katanas. He is a two-star Hunter of problems, a swordsman and a careful thinker who weighs every rule and its downside.

**Speaking Style:** A quiet, careful voice that considers every consequence aloud and speaks only when it has something to add.
**Combat Role:** two katanas and the careful mind of a problem Hunter
**Relationship Hook:** A horse-faced swordsman reading the Association's rules in silence while the others argue.
personality: Core: calm, careful and collected; weighs every consequence before acting; scrupulous about rules
Quirk: volunteers quietly for the dangerous watch

npcs.name: Sachi
npcs.info:
An egg and honey seller with a trestle at the market every week, a round-faced young woman who walks in from her family's farm before dawn with two baskets on a yoke. She gives the hungry children a cracked egg and the reeve a hard time.

**Speaking Style:** Warm and quick, a market seller's patter that turns into real kindness halfway through.
**Combat Role:** none; she throws eggs and shouts for the reeve
**Relationship Hook:** A round-faced young woman behind a trestle of eggs and honey jars, asking if you have come from the north.
personality: Core: kind and quick-witted; talks to everyone; never gives short weight
Quirk: worried for her husband

npcs.name: Sadaso
npcs.info:
A tall, pale fighter on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena with white hair, slanted eyes, thin lips and a face like a mask, who lost his left arm in his welcome to the floor. He wants to be a Floor Master for the money and fame and fights only those weaker than himself, speaking in taunts and threats.

**Speaking Style:** A taunting, oily, threatening voice that goes thin and frightened when a child stares back at him.
**Combat Role:** an invisible hand of aura where his left arm used to be
**Relationship Hook:** A one-armed fighter smiling as an invisible hand closes around a boy's throat.
personality: Core: taunting and threatening; fights only the weak; greedy
Quirk: a coward when stared down

npcs.name: Saeki
npcs.info:
The butler who keeps the watch room's tapes, a plump, quiet woman who labels every cassette in the same careful hand as the screens. She changes the recorders on a fixed rota, files the old tapes by date and camera, and fetches whatever Kikyo asks to see.

**Speaking Style:** Low, slow and soothing, almost a whisper, the voice of someone who spends her nights beside humming machines.
**Combat Role:** a butler's training and a recorder-room's darkness; she avoids fights she cannot see coming
**Relationship Hook:** A plump butler in reading glasses holding a cassette up to the screen light to read its label.
personality: Core: meticulous with labels; patient with machines and impatient with people; takes Kikyo's moods as weather
Quirk: hums along with the recorders

npcs.name: Saiyu
npcs.info:
The Zodiacs' Monkey, a lanky man with a monkey-like face, protruding ears, two small hearts shaved into his hair, a headband, long wristbands, a short sleeveless jacket marked with the sign for monkey and a fake tail. He is a Blacklist Hunter and a martial artist, direct to the point of rudeness, and he has challenged Ging to a fight.

**Speaking Style:** A brash, direct, rude voice that says the unkind thing first and loudly, and challenges anyone who might be stronger.
**Combat Role:** martial arts and a conjured staff
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky man in a monkey costume jabbing a finger at Ging across the table.
personality: Core: direct and rude; a martial artist first; says unkind things about the council's stars
Quirk: challenges stronger fighters openly

npcs.name: Sakisuke Njiji
npcs.info:
A man with a mullet, a snub nose and beady eyes, in a fur-trimmed vest and a collar-like necklace. He was hired the same day as the two boys everyone talks about, and he hunts the flats for monster cards that sell well.

**Speaking Style:** Greasy and grasping, a man who asks what is in it for him before he asks anything else.
**Combat Role:** a capable Nen brawler who picks fights he expects to profit from
**Relationship Hook:** A beady-eyed man in a fur vest pressed flat on a rock above a giant spotted lizard.
personality: Core: a capable fighter; weighs every deal by his share; patient on a hunt
Quirk: greedy

npcs.name: Sal Duquesne
npcs.info:
A heavy-lidded man in a grey waistcoat and shirt sleeves who keeps the book in the gambling hall's cage, a fat book at his elbow and a pistol in a drawer. He takes bets on anything, and in January he takes them on the Hunter Exam.

**Speaking Style:** A dry, unbothered voice that quotes odds the way other men talk about the weather.
**Combat Role:** a mobster with a pistol in the drawer and two men within shouting distance
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy-lidded bookmaker behind bars looking up from his book as someone asks the odds on a boy with a fishing rod.
personality: Core: dry and unhurried; loyal to the family; kind to regular losers
Quirk: hates a bet he does not understand

npcs.name: Sal Duranti
npcs.info:
The owner of a chrome lunch counter near the Bull Market, a thick-armed man in a stained apron with a towel over one shoulder and a pencil behind his ear. He shouts orders at the griddle, keeps the coffee bad on principle, and calls every regular by the name of what they eat.

**Speaking Style:** A short-order cook's patter, rough, loud and friendly, that drops to a mutter when the talk turns useful.
**Combat Role:** an old runner who still keeps a sawn-off under the till and a meat cleaver in reach
**Relationship Hook:** A burly cook in a stained apron leaning on a chrome counter with a towel over his shoulder, listening.
personality: Core: loud and friendly; loyal to the old family; worried about money
Quirk: listens harder than he talks

npcs.name: Salkov
npcs.info:
One of the fourth prince Tserriednich's bodyguards, tall and square-jawed, his fair hair cut short, in a black suit and tie. He passed the 289th exam with Theta and the others as a Provisional Hunter. He is relaxed, passes small jobs to Theta and follows her lead.

**Speaking Style:** Laid back and plain, a man who says he is not the clever one and means it.
**Combat Role:** a guard who hides in Zetsu and follows a smarter partner's plan
**Relationship Hook:** A tall square-jawed guard standing very still beside a door while something unseen moves behind it.
personality: Core: laid back; follows Theta's lead; calm in front of horrors
Quirk: devoted to Theta

npcs.name: Salvo Prentice
npcs.info:
A rumpled, balding man in a cardigan and half-moon glasses who rents the hostel's attic every winter and receives visitors at a desk buried under notebooks. He sat the exam eleven times and now sells what he learnt: names, faces and who to stay away from.

**Speaking Style:** A friendly, confiding voice that drops to a near whisper for anything it wants you to pay for.
**Combat Role:** a soft-bodied talker who keeps a table between himself and anyone angry
**Relationship Hook:** A balding man in a cardigan sliding a folded page across his desk and whispering a name like a secret.
personality: Core: warm and confiding with strangers; sells to both sides; never sits the exam himself any more
Quirk: invents details to fill a gap

npcs.name: Salé-salé Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The eighth prince of Kakin and only son of the fifth queen Swinko-swinko, a tall, slightly heavy man in light robes and boots, with short blond hair at the sides of his head, narrow eyes and rings in his right ear. He is always surrounded by beautiful women, food and drink, and he says the contest does not interest him. He can be good company.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy, boastful and merry, a party host's voice slurred with wine.
**Combat Role:** none; a prince who throws parties instead of punches
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy prince lounging in robes among women and platters, raising a goblet to the door.
personality: Core: boastful; indifferent to the contest, or so he says; sociable at a party
Quirk: a womaniser and a glutton

npcs.name: Sanbica Norton
npcs.info:
A one-star Hunter of viruses and the Association's lead doctor, always in a concealing medical gown, gloves and surgical mask, short, with big dark eyes. She is timid and insecure and stammers, hates the spotlight, and is excellent at her work.

**Speaking Style:** A small, timid, stammering voice from behind a surgical mask, sure only when it speaks of medicine.
**Combat Role:** none; a doctor's hands and knowledge
**Relationship Hook:** A small masked doctor shrinking from a round of applause.
personality: Core: timid and insecure; stammers; excellent at her work
Quirk: hates being in the spotlight

npcs.name: Sander Wiik
npcs.info:
The leader of the volunteer mountain rescue crew, a tall, weathered man in a red jacket who has brought down hikers from every trail in the region. He trains the volunteers, keeps the radio room and walks the rescue dog every evening.

**Speaking Style:** Level and steady, a rescue leader's voice made for calming people over a radio from far away.
**Combat Role:** none; a climber's strength, ropes and a rescue dog
**Relationship Hook:** A rescue leader in a red jacket pressing a headset to his ear, waiting for a radio that has gone silent.
personality: Core: calm under pressure; keeps every call in the logbook; talks to lost hikers for hours over the radio
Quirk: will not cross the wall and will not let his crew

npcs.name: Sarahell
npcs.info:
The captain of the second prince Camilla's guard, an imposing woman with short fair hair spiked to the left, eyeliner at the corners of her eyes and deep lines round her mouth. Like all Camilla's guards she is one of the Have-Nots, raised to a soldier's standing by the prince. She is devoted to Camilla and eager to die for her, but she reminds the others that their deaths must count.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, clipped and fervent, a captain's voice that preaches Camilla's cause and keeps her comrades in line.
**Combat Role:** not much stronger than an ordinary soldier, she works by disguise and a curse cast at a distance
**Relationship Hook:** An imposing spiky-haired woman in a guard's suit outside a prince's door, her face set like a mask.
personality: Core: devoted to Camilla; fervent but strategic; keeps the others in line
Quirk: a master of disguise

npcs.name: Saskia Rook
npcs.info:
The broadcast camera operator who works the gantry above the big ring, a lanky woman in a work vest with gaffer tape round both wrists and a headset jammed over cropped hair. She has filmed every televised bout on the upper floors for three seasons, hanging over the ring on a rail most people would not walk.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and clipped over a headset, a camera operator who says 'copy' to everything and means about half of it.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy camera, a safety line and a long drop for anyone who follows her out onto the rail
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky camerawoman crouched on a narrow gantry high over a ring, her camera trained on two fighters far below.
personality: Core: dry and unimpressed; no fear of heights at all; chews gum through every broadcast
Quirk: keeps copies of everything

npcs.name: Satotz
npcs.info:
The first examiner of the 287th exam, a Hunter of ruins with pale lavender hair curling at the ends, a thin curled moustache and no visible mouth, in a dark coat and red tie. He leads the applicants on an endless walk through the tunnel under Zaban City at a pace that forces them to run, then out across the Milsy Wetlands. He is calm, courteous and silent most of the way.

**Speaking Style:** A polite, quiet, precise gentleman's voice that gives short instructions and never sounds out of breath.
**Combat Role:** speed, keen senses and a calm that catches thrown cards out of the air
**Relationship Hook:** A tall, mouthless gentleman walking calmly ahead of four hundred panting runners in a dark tunnel.
personality: Core: calm, quiet and courteous; takes his duty as examiner seriously; quietly encourages the ones he likes
Quirk: strongly admires Ging

npcs.name: Sayird
npcs.info:
A Hunter with medium-length fair hair and a thin moustache reaching to his chin, in a bodyguard's black suit with a capital H. He has signed on with Bill and Kurton to guard the youngest prince. He keeps to the mission, avoids the court's quarrels and tries to keep Nen secret from outsiders.

**Speaking Style:** A careful, businesslike man's voice that keeps to the job and changes the subject when Nen comes up.
**Combat Role:** an emitter's aura at range and a bodyguard's training
**Relationship Hook:** A moustached bodyguard standing between a queen and the door.
personality: Core: focused on the mission; guards the secret of Nen; prioritises his charge
Quirk: keeps out of court politics

npcs.name: Scairt
npcs.info:
A narrow-eyed Hunter with a long head, jutting cheeks and ears, in a bodyguard's black suit, who has signed on to guard a prince.

**Speaking Style:** A plain, quiet, dutiful voice that says only what the job needs.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's Nen and a bodyguard's discipline
**Relationship Hook:** A plain-faced bodyguard standing silently at a prince's door.
personality: Core: dutiful; watchful; keeps out of quarrels
Quirk: quiet

npcs.name: Schoolgate Runner
npcs.info:
A young woman with a short bob, a satchel and a slice of toast in her mouth, a trainee teacher late for her first class at the school down the lane. Every morning she comes running round the corner, collides with whoever is standing there, apologises, blushes and runs on.

**Speaking Style:** Breathless and flustered, a young teacher who apologises and blushes in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; she knocks people over by accident
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman with toast in her mouth rounding a blind corner at full tilt, her satchel flying.
personality: Core: flustered; apologetic; repeats her scene every morning
Quirk: always late

npcs.name: Seaquant
npcs.info:
A Blacklist Hunter working as a groundskeeper on the Zoldyck estate, a man of average build with spiky brown hair, a white headband and a fur-collared jacket. He is cordial to visitors and blunt about his employers: the family and its staff, he says, are too strange for words.

**Speaking Style:** A plain, easy-going man's voice with a wry edge when he talks about the people he works for.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's training and Nen, though he has never been a match for the estate's people
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a fur-collared jacket shrugging at visitors: the people up the mountain are beyond words.
personality: Core: cordial and blunt; humbled by one defeat and never forgets it; good company at the end of a shift
Quirk: afraid of the family and honest about it

npcs.name: Sebastien Laroque
npcs.info:
The head waiter of the Cloudline Restaurant, a tall, silver-haired man in a white jacket who has served dinner above the clouds for eighteen years. He seats every guest himself, remembers what they drank last time and moves through the room so quietly that diners forget he is there.

**Speaking Style:** Silky and discreet, a head waiter who murmurs and never once interrupts.
**Combat Role:** none; a waiter with a silver tray, a carving knife on the trolley and a lift to the kitchens
**Relationship Hook:** A silver-haired head waiter folding a napkin by a window table where the clouds drift past below.
personality: Core: impeccably polite; notices everything; disapproves of shouting
Quirk: folds a napkin while he listens

npcs.name: Sedokan
npcs.info:
A small, slight prisoner with long brown hair over his left eye and a calm, almost sleepy face, in Trick Tower's grey. He is serving a hundred and forty-nine years for a string of bombings. He admits he is no fighter, and offers games instead: two candles, one long and one short, and the first flame out loses.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, pleased and patient, a small man savouring a trap he has already sprung.
**Combat Role:** none; a game-player who wins with a rigged contest and loses the moment it turns physical
**Relationship Hook:** A small long-haired prisoner sitting cross-legged on a stone platform, smiling as an applicant agonises over two candles.
personality: Core: calm and relaxed; no good at physical contests; pleased with his own tricks
Quirk: careful, with a plan behind the plan

npcs.name: Seiko Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The sixth queen, mother of the twin princes Kacho and Fugetsu, a woman with short fair hair curling sideways, clear eyes and bags under them that make her look older than she is, usually in a pale long-sleeved dress. She is distrustful and close-mouthed with outsiders and insists on her own way when no one important is watching.

**Speaking Style:** Cool and close-mouthed, a queen who says nothing to strangers and everything to her own.
**Combat Role:** none; a queen who fights with royal privilege, closed doors and her own guards
**Relationship Hook:** A fair-haired queen with tired eyes facing an investigator across a suite, her lips pressed shut.
personality: Core: favours her younger twin; insists on her way when unobserved; weeps once, when no one expects it
Quirk: answers nothing to strangers

npcs.name: Sekine
npcs.info:
A junior butler who sits in the booth by the Testing Gate on the days Zebro is at his cabin, answering the wall telephone and the questions at the window. She is small and neat in the black suit, with a notebook always open, and the tourists who expect a monster at the gate get a polite young woman instead.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, practised and patient on the telephone; she sounds exactly the same to a lost tourist and to a man asking which way the hound runs.
**Combat Role:** a butler's training kept in reserve; a short baton and the telephone to the mountain
**Relationship Hook:** A young butler in the gate booth with the receiver at her ear, writing down a stranger's every word.
personality: Core: polite to everyone through the window; laughs at the tourists' questions only after the bus has gone; afraid of the gate's silence at night
Quirk: writes down every word a caller says

npcs.name: Sekiya
npcs.info:
A butler of the Zoldyck Family on leave in the market town, who comes to the hot springs on his free days and sits in the outdoor pool for hours without moving. He is broad and heavily scarred, and the other bathers give him the far end of the pool without being asked.

**Speaking Style:** Sleepy and slow, a man who speaks from the bottom of a deep breath and rarely bothers.
**Combat Role:** a butler's strength and an aura he can shut off completely
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred man sitting perfectly still in a steaming pool while tourists edge away from him.
personality: Core: silent about his work; polite to the bathhouse owner; dislikes being stared at
Quirk: still for hours

npcs.name: Selma Quist
npcs.info:
A guide who takes small groups down to the painted chamber, a lively woman in her twenties with a lantern and a practised speech about the people who were buried there.

**Speaking Style:** Clear and lilting, a guide's voice that drops to a hush at the bottom of the stairs.
**Combat Role:** none; a guide who keeps her group together and herds them out
**Relationship Hook:** A young guide holding a lantern at the top of a narrow stone passage, smiling at a waiting tour group.
personality: Core: enthusiastic; fond of a good story; protective of the paintings
Quirk: a little star-struck

npcs.name: Sengi Guild Agent
npcs.info:
The agent of a hidden hiring office in a slum, tall and gaunt with purple hair gelled to the left, piercings through nose, lips, ears and brows, tattoos, rings and metal wristbands. She places Hunters with clients who pay well and ask for discretion. Finding her office is the first test.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, professional and unimpressed, a broker's voice that says no before you finish asking.
**Combat Role:** none shown; an agent whose aura forms a skull to test who can see it
**Relationship Hook:** A pierced, gaunt woman behind a desk with a skull of aura floating over her shoulder.
personality: Core: calm and professional; takes her job seriously; rewards those who come back ready
Quirk: unimpressed by a licence alone

npcs.name: Senna Okoro
npcs.info:
The keeper of the shoe post at the end of the old track, a tall veiled woman who walks the whole track once a week and ties every small shoe she finds onto the post, one string each. When a family brings a shoe of its own she ties it on for them and stands with them without speaking.

**Speaking Style:** Grave and slow, every word chosen, a voice that has said a great many names over a great many years.
**Combat Role:** a tall, patient woman with a hooked pole who trips, pins and holds until the watch comes
**Relationship Hook:** A tall veiled woman tying a small shoe to a post already heavy with them, a burned van behind her.
personality: Core: walks the track every seventh day whatever the weather; ties knots slowly and properly; says nothing at all to outsiders on the track
Quirk: keeps her list sewn inside her wraps

npcs.name: Seok Jae-hwan
npcs.info:
The chief mining engineer of the coal pits, a grave, hollow-cheeked man with a cap lamp and a slide rule in his jacket pocket. He knows the seams better than his own family and goes down with the shifts more often than any engineer needs to. The miners trust him; the prisoners do not know what to make of him.

**Speaking Style:** Measured and grave, an engineer's voice that states facts and lets the listener feel them.
**Combat Role:** none; a cap lamp, a pick and knowledge of every tunnel in the hill
**Relationship Hook:** A hollow-cheeked engineer with his cap lamp on a damp new brick wall, listening.
personality: Core: grave and responsible; keeps his own counsel; protective of the miners and, quietly, the prisoners
Quirk: haunted by the cave

npcs.name: Sevanti Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The seventh queen of Kakin, a young woman with an elaborate hairstyle, two locks crossing on her forehead, in long robes. She is mother to the twelfth prince Momoze and the thirteenth prince Marayam, and she keeps her small son close at every event, smiling at the onlookers.

**Speaking Style:** Young and anxious, a mother's soft fretting voice.
**Combat Role:** none; a mother surrounded by guards
**Relationship Hook:** A young queen in long robes holding her small son's hand as guards close around them.
personality: Core: devoted to her son; anxious and watchful; regrets her choices too late
Quirk: neglects her daughter

npcs.name: Severin
npcs.info:
The council's clerk at the longhouse, a neat man in a dark wool coat who keeps the petition roll, calls each petitioner forward and writes the council's rulings into the great book. He knows the law better than the councillors who make it.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, courteous and endlessly patient, a clerk who can say no for an hour without using the word.
**Combat Role:** none; a clerk who calls the guards
**Relationship Hook:** A neat clerk at a lectern in the long hall, reading out a ruling in a name nobody has seen in weeks.
personality: Core: courteous and precise; knows every law by heart; kind to petitioners in small ways
Quirk: never asks where the orders come from

npcs.name: Severin Kade
npcs.info:
A fighter of the 200th floor with five wins and two losses, a tall, rawboned man of thirty with a shaved head, a broad scar across his collarbone and a plain grey training robe. He fights rarely and only opponents who can see him, and he trains alone in the old quarry where no camera reaches.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, level and spare, a fighter who speaks as though every word costs him aura.
**Combat Role:** an Enhancer's open-hand strikes that split stone, with Ken held through a whole bout
**Relationship Hook:** A shaved-headed fighter in a grey robe standing in a quarry pit beside a boulder split clean in two.
personality: Core: solitary and serious; fights only those who can see him; despises the newcomer-hunters
Quirk: bows to a boulder before he strikes it

npcs.name: Shachmono Tocino
npcs.info:
A licensed Hunter and senior Nostrade bodyguard, slender, with orange hair and sideburns that curl at the end, in a green pinstriped shirt under a pinstriped vest. He knows the Underground Auction's ways better than most of the family and enjoys testing newcomers.

**Speaking Style:** Easy and amused, a man enjoying a trick he has played, then sheepish when it is seen through.
**Combat Role:** a puppeteer who fights through a squad of hooded aura-made gunmen and swordsmen
**Relationship Hook:** A slender man with curled sideburns sitting among applicants, smiling as hooded gunmen burst in.
personality: Core: confident in his own trick; knows the auction's customs; brave when it counts
Quirk: enjoys testing newcomers

npcs.name: Shalnark
npcs.info:
Member number six of the Phantom Troupe, a friendly-looking young blond man in a lavender suit with a phone always in his hand. He is the Troupe's planner, hacker and voice of reason, polite, clever and level-headed, and he holds a Hunter licence, which opens doors the others cannot.

**Speaking Style:** A light, cheerful, friendly young man's voice that explains plans clearly and sounds just as cheerful saying people will have to die.
**Combat Role:** antennas thrown or stabbed into a target, then a phone, and the target is his
**Relationship Hook:** A cheerful young man in a lavender suit tapping at a bat-shaped phone while a stranger walks like a puppet.
personality: Core: thinks fast and plans for the group; treats people as tools without malice; closest to Uvogin
Quirk: cheerful, polite and level-headed

npcs.name: Sheila
npcs.info:
A woman of the heaps who left to see the world and comes back to the paper hill between journeys, a dark backpack of books on her shoulders and a heart-patterned band in her hair. She means to earn a Hunter licence and says so to anyone who asks where she has been. Children follow her up the mound for the stories.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and eager, a storyteller who leans in when the tale gets good and goes quiet when it comes too near home.
**Combat Role:** a traveller who runs first and fights only when cornered, with a knife she has used more on rope than on people
**Relationship Hook:** A fair-haired woman with a heart-patterned headband in a burrow of old paper, an adventure novel open on her knees and children crowding to hear.
personality: Core: reads aloud whether or not anyone is listening; turns every road she has walked into a story; wraps every book she carries in oilcloth against the damp
Quirk: changes the subject when the Spider is mentioned

npcs.name: Shen Yuxi
npcs.info:
The manifest clerk of the shipping office, a sallow young woman in sleeve guards who types passenger lists all day on a machine older than she is. She books passages, fills crew lists and sells berths to anyone who comes up the stairs with cash and no questions.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, fast and bored, a clerk who has heard every story and believes none of them.
**Combat Role:** none; she pulls the alarm cord under the counter and the men from the yard come up
**Relationship Hook:** A bored clerk typing a passenger list in an office stacked with stamped manifests.
personality: Core: types without looking at the keys; never asks a passenger's reason; takes her lunch at her desk
Quirk: keeps a list of names she typed and never saw again

npcs.name: Shi Huiming
npcs.info:
The keeper of the temple's manuscript library, a monk in grey with ink-stained fingers who has spent his whole life copying brittle scrolls from the age of the warlords. He lets pilgrims look through the lattice at the locked cases and tells them stories of the First King that the guidebooks leave out.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful and kind, a librarian monk who speaks as if the scrolls could hear.
**Combat Role:** none; a scholar monk who has never lifted anything heavier than a scroll case
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-robed monk unrolling a brittle scroll by an oil lamp among locked cases.
personality: Core: speaks softly to the scrolls; tells pilgrims the stories the guidebooks leave out; does not sleep the night before a courier comes
Quirk: copies everything twice

npcs.name: Shishito
npcs.info:
Applicant 89, a tall man with a long face, a cleft chin and dark shoulder-length hair, in a green long-sleeved shirt under a brown vest, his badge pinned to the vest. On the boat he spent the whole crossing wondering who had drawn him.

**Speaking Style:** A worried, reasonable voice that talks itself through every possibility out loud.
**Combat Role:** a cautious brawler who keeps his back to rock and loses to numbers
**Relationship Hook:** A long-faced man in a brown vest edging along the bottom of a rocky ravine, glancing up at the rim.
personality: Core: anxious; careful of the obvious danger and blind to the rest; decent to strangers
Quirk: thinks out loud

npcs.name: Shizuku Murasaki
npcs.info:
Member number eight of the Phantom Troupe, a petite young woman in a black turtleneck and glasses who forgets names, faces and whole conversations, and says cold things without noticing. Opponents take her for an airhead; she is a practised killer and pickpocket. She conjures a vacuum cleaner that swallows the Troupe's traces.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, flat, absent young woman's voice that says blunt and cruel things with no feeling and often forgets what it was saying.
**Combat Role:** a conjured vacuum cleaner, a quick hand and cold aim
**Relationship Hook:** A woman in glasses vacuuming the blood off a floor with a cleaner that has eyes.
personality: Core: calm, aloof and blunt; underestimated and dangerous; follows the rules the Troupe sets
Quirk: forgets names and faces

npcs.name: Shoot McMahon
npcs.info:
A Hunter of unidentified beasts and Morel's other pupil, Knuckle's partner, a tall, thin, pale man with no eyebrows, tired black eyes and pink hair slicked back with a bandaged ponytail on one side. He wears bandages under a purple kimono with one great sleeve. He is timid, distrusts his own strength and hates to hurt anyone, and his caution balances Knuckle's recklessness.

**Speaking Style:** A soft, hesitant, tired voice that doubts itself aloud and goes steady once the fight has begun.
**Combat Role:** three floating hands that strike from every side, and a birdcage that takes what they hit
**Relationship Hook:** A pale, tired-looking man with one great sleeve watching three disembodied hands circle his opponent.
personality: Core: dislikes hurting anyone; cautious where Knuckle is rash; steadier than he believes
Quirk: timid and self-doubting

npcs.name: Sibylle Marrin
npcs.info:
A small, freckled woman in a fisherman's smock and rubber boots who lodges with a reed-cutting family on the boardwalk and goes out each morning in a tarred reed boat with sample cases. The village children call her the flower lady.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, earnest and precise, with a botanist's pleasure in a long scientific name.
**Combat Role:** a fieldworker who fights with what grows around her: a machete, a paralysing sap, a quick retreat by boat
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled botanist on a foggy boardwalk holding up a pressed flower and warning you not to smell it.
personality: Core: earnest and precise; gentle with children; keeps the village's rules
Quirk: careless of her own safety for a sample

npcs.name: Sid Faraday
npcs.info:
The projectionist of the drive-in, a soft, round man of forty-two in thick glasses who has run the projectors since he was a boy and lives in a caravan behind the screen. He knows every film the drive-in owns by heart, frame by frame.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and dreamy, a film lover who speaks of old movies as if they were people he knew.
**Combat Role:** none; he locks the hut and turns the projector's lamp into an intruder's eyes
**Relationship Hook:** A plump projectionist in thick glasses threading a film reel by the light of the projector lamp.
personality: Core: speaks of films as people; never leaves the hut during a reel; lives on popcorn and cold tea
Quirk: frightened of the back row and fascinated by it

npcs.name: Silas Grebe
npcs.info:
The gravedigger of the potter's field, a tall, stooped, long-armed man of sixty who has buried the city's unclaimed dead under numbered stakes for thirty years. He keeps a book of every number and the date, and he digs with care.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, low and mournful, a gravedigger who sounds as if he is reading the burial rites.
**Combat Role:** none; a long-handled spade and a strength his stoop hides
**Relationship Hook:** A tall stooped gravedigger in a black hat leaning on his spade, staring at a stake with no number.
personality: Core: digs with care for strangers; keeps two books; never asks a black car its business
Quirk: talks to the dead while he works

npcs.name: Silas Grimes
npcs.info:
The old yardman of Grimes Auto Salvage, a stringy man in greasy overalls with a long grey ponytail and his dog on a long chain, who strips wrecks for parts and crushes the rest into blocks. He never asks where a car came from.

**Speaking Style:** A slow, oil-soaked drawl that sounds half asleep and misses nothing.
**Combat Role:** an old man with a tyre iron, a chained dog and a crusher he can start from the booth
**Relationship Hook:** A stringy old man in greasy overalls eating a sandwich in a lever booth above a car crusher, a big dog at the door.
personality: Core: laconic; never asks questions; loves the dog
Quirk: keeps souvenirs

npcs.name: Silas Grubb
npcs.info:
The owner of Tower Pawn and Loan, a soft, pale man with a jeweller's loupe on a cord round his neck and a cardigan buttoned wrong. His shop on the poster street is full of fighters' belts, gloves and trophies, and he sympathises with every fighter who brings one in.

**Speaking Style:** Wheedling and nasal, a pawnbroker who sympathises in the same breath as he names his rate.
**Combat Role:** none; a pawnbroker behind a steel grille with a shotgun under the counter
**Relationship Hook:** A soft pale pawnbroker squinting through a loupe at a championship belt behind a steel grille.
personality: Core: oily and sympathetic; never refuses a loan; afraid of the parlour's men
Quirk: squints through his loupe at everything

npcs.name: Silas Nought
npcs.info:
A broker of the heaps with no fixed shack, drifting between the road end, the market and the lanes in a good coat with nothing under it but wraps. Outsiders who want something from the city find him before they find anyone else, and residents use him to talk to outsiders without being seen.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth and civil, the cultured voice of a man who sounds like he came from somewhere better and never says where.
**Combat Role:** a broker who never fights where he can be seen, and pays someone else to fight where he can
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a good overcoat over rag wraps, leaning against a heap with his hands in his pockets, smiling as you come.
personality: Core: names his terms last; never stays two nights in the same shack; speaks to outsiders in their own language
Quirk: will not deal in children

npcs.name: Silas Ormond
npcs.info:
A retired skipper with a clay pipe and one milky eye, who holds the card table in the stove corner every evening and has done since his last boat went to his son. He has an opinion on every fish ever caught and keeps the book on every wager the tavern makes.

**Speaking Style:** Croaking and wry, an old skipper's voice that takes forever to reach the point and is always right when it gets there.
**Combat Role:** none; a heavy walking stick and decades of knowing when to leave a room
**Relationship Hook:** An old one-eyed skipper by a stove, pipe in his teeth, laying down a winning hand.
personality: Core: takes the long way round every story; runs a betting book on anything; keeps one old secret about the record board
Quirk: trusts the sea more than any man

npcs.name: Silva Zoldyck
npcs.info:
The head of the Zoldyck Family, a huge man with long silver hair and cold blue eyes who sits cross-legged in a dim room and gives the orders that move the world's best assassins. He is calm, thoughtful and fair after his fashion: he holds his son Killua as heir, and he lets the boy go out into the world because he believes it will make him stronger.

**Speaking Style:** A deep, slow, unhurried voice that rarely rises and never needs to; when he speaks to his son it is the voice of a father, and when he speaks of a target it is the voice of a craftsman.
**Combat Role:** an assassin's crushing strength and two orbs of aura that blast a room apart
**Relationship Hook:** A huge silver-haired man sitting cross-legged in a dark room, considering his son in silence.
personality: Core: proud of his son in a way that frightens the boy; ignores half of what his father says; keeps his word to a son as strictly as to a client
Quirk: stoic, calm and pensive

npcs.name: Silvio Marek
npcs.info:
A freelance assassin waiting in the departures hall at Parasta Airport, a tall, well-dressed man with a newspaper he is not reading. He came to Padokea on business and has stayed longer than he meant to.

**Speaking Style:** Low, slow and pleasant, a killer's voice that is courteous to the point of mockery.
**Combat Role:** an aura user's garrotte and a knife, struck from a crowd and gone before the body falls
**Relationship Hook:** A well-dressed man in black gloves lowering a newspaper to watch a black airship through an airport window.
personality: Core: courteous and cold; proud of his work; unwilling to admit fear
Quirk: watches everything over a newspaper

npcs.name: Sim Hye-ryon
npcs.info:
A ward doctor at the state hospital in Mandai, a tired, capable woman in a white coat gone grey with washing, who works double shifts in a ward of patients two to a bed. She takes the gifts relatives bring, because her salary will not feed her son, and gives the best of them to the patients who brought nothing.

**Speaking Style:** Low, tired and kind, a doctor's voice that delivers bad news gently and good news cautiously.
**Combat Role:** none; a doctor with a scalpel she would only use to heal
**Relationship Hook:** A tired doctor in a greying coat stitching a wound by lamplight in a ward where every bed holds two.
personality: Core: tired, kind and practical; silent about the leaks for her patients' sake; angry in a way she cannot afford
Quirk: takes gifts and redistributes them

npcs.name: Simon Pettigrew
npcs.info:
The clerk of the lost-property room at the junction, a thin young man with a long neck, round spectacles and an immaculate railway waistcoat, who catalogues every umbrella and suitcase that comes in. He loves his book and very little else.

**Speaking Style:** High and fussy, a clerk who reads out the regulations to himself and is frightened of every exception.
**Combat Role:** none; he rings the station bell and hides behind the counter
**Relationship Hook:** A thin clerk in round spectacles writing in a large book behind a counter piled with umbrellas and suitcases.
personality: Core: fussy and exact; frightened of rule-breaking; kind to children who lose things
Quirk: frightened of the suitcase

npcs.name: Sindri Ahl
npcs.info:
A free-diver and handline fisherman who rows out to the wreck on the reef and fishes from its rusted bow, or goes down into the flooded hold on one breath for the big fish that live in the dark. He is silent, broad-chested and unhurried in everything.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and economical, a free-diver's calm voice that seems to be holding its breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a diver's knife and a breath held longer than any fight
**Relationship Hook:** A broad-chested diver standing on a rusted bow, filling his lungs before going under.
personality: Core: silent for long stretches; does everything slowly and well; loyal to his family's old secret
Quirk: knows more about the wreck than he will say

npcs.name: Siper
npcs.info:
Applicant 80 and one of the few women to reach the fourth phase, a sniper with long crimson hair tied back in a bushy tail and square sunglasses, in an orange sleeveless vest over a navy turtleneck, blue trousers, brown boots and grey gloves. Her rifle is never far from her shoulder.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and level, a marksman's voice that sounds bored until the moment she fires.
**Combat Role:** a sniper who picks one shot from far away and stakes everything on it
**Relationship Hook:** A crimson-haired woman in sunglasses lying in tree roots behind a sniper rifle, aiming at an empty patch of earth.
personality: Core: patient behind a scope; cold about killing; sure of her aim
Quirk: underestimates a target who does not move

npcs.name: Soffman
npcs.info:
A player with fair slicked-back hair in a t-shirt over a striped long-sleeved shirt, baggy trousers and black shoes. He keeps jugs at the spring in the dell, and he was among the veterans who turned up for two boys' first prize in Antokiba.

**Speaking Style:** Easygoing on the surface and evasive underneath, a man who says 'something like that' when cornered.
**Combat Role:** a modest player who stays out of fights and lets bigger men use him as a signpost
**Relationship Hook:** A slick-haired man by a mossy pool sniffing a jug and trying to guess what it has turned into.
personality: Core: easygoing; goes where he is paid to go; likes his drink
Quirk: evasive when questioned

npcs.name: Sommy
npcs.info:
Applicant 118, a tall, thin man with messy brown hair and thick eyebrows, in a black long-sleeved shirt and tan trousers, with a trained monkey forever clinging to his shoulder. The monkey fetches, steals and runs on command.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and sneering, quick to call others stupid and quicker to climb out of reach.
**Combat Role:** none face to face; a trickster whose monkey snatches a badge while he talks
**Relationship Hook:** A thin man in a black shirt grinning from a tree branch while a small monkey scampers up beside him with a stolen badge.
personality: Core: sly; condescending to anyone he cheats; runs up a tree at the first danger
Quirk: relies on his monkey for everything

npcs.name: Son Hyon-u
npcs.info:
The senior engineer of the state broadcaster, a lean, bespectacled man in an oil-stained white coat who keeps the transmitter alive with valves he solders himself. He has worked under the mast for fifteen years and has never once let the leader's voice drop off the street loudspeakers. He is calm, clever and very careful.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and practical, a technician's voice that explains the machine before it complains about it.
**Combat Role:** none; a soldering iron and a knowledge of which cable kills every loudspeaker in the capital
**Relationship Hook:** A lean engineer in an oil-stained coat bent over a humming transmitter, headphones round his neck.
personality: Core: calm and methodical; careful to the point of silence; loves the machine more than the message
Quirk: curious about the world beyond the border

npcs.name: Soufrabi Net Mender
npcs.info:
The oldest of Soufrabi's fishermen, a gnarled man in an oilskin smock with a mending needle never out of his hand, who works the tarred lofts above the beach. Since the pirates came, he and the others mend their nets in silence and keep the boats hauled up.

**Speaking Style:** Low and sparing, an old fisherman who speaks only once he has decided a stranger is worth it.
**Combat Role:** none; he pulls the ladder up into the loft
**Relationship Hook:** An old fisherman threading a needle through a net without looking up while a crowd of strangers asks about pirates.
personality: Core: silent; watchful; judges a party by its size
Quirk: never stops mending

npcs.name: Spinner Clow
npcs.info:
A young Amateur Hunter called Spin, with long magenta hair, teal eyes and a big ochre beret, always carrying a camera. She wants to become a Hunter of beasts so that she can repay Kite, who once bought a whole mountain to save the swans of her home town from a mine.

**Speaking Style:** A serious, direct young woman's voice, quick to criticise and loyal to the bone where Kite is concerned.
**Combat Role:** none to speak of; a camera, sharp eyes and quick feet
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman in a beret photographing a strange bird, glaring at two boys who have just arrived.
personality: Core: serious and direct; resents anyone who leaves him behind; an observant naturalist
Quirk: fiercely loyal to Kite

npcs.name: Spot
npcs.info:
A forest guard of no particular look, white-haired before his time, who walks the chain line at a kennel run deep in the woods and feeds the big dogs that bark at anyone on the track. He is polite to strangers in the way of a man who has been told to send them back the way they came.

**Speaking Style:** A tired, ordinary voice that agrees with whoever spoke last, quick to say sorry.
**Combat Role:** a guard with a club and a dog's chain who has never had to fight anyone who fought back
**Relationship Hook:** A white-haired man at a stake-and-rope fence, holding back a chained dog and telling you this track goes nowhere.
personality: Core: meek and obedient; does as he is told; would do anything to live
Quirk: hopes to be overlooked

npcs.name: Squala
npcs.info:
The longest-serving of Neon's bodyguards, brown-skinned with long curly black hair tied tightly back and a dot in the middle of his forehead, in a fuchsia shirt with a purple zigzag. He keeps many dogs and loves them, and he loves Eliza, one of Neon's attendants. He is not a leader and knows it, and he is less keen on the job than the others.

**Speaking Style:** Nervous and rapid, a man who talks a little too much and laughs to cover it.
**Combat Role:** a quick dodger who sends his trained dogs ahead and fights through them
**Relationship Hook:** A curly-haired man in a fuchsia shirt kneeling to calm a pack of guard dogs.
personality: Core: nervous and talkative; loves his dogs; lies to protect his friends
Quirk: loves Eliza

npcs.name: Stanislav Brede
npcs.info:
The harbourmaster of the estuary wharf, a heavy man near retirement with a peaked cap, a cardigan under a Union-issue jacket and a cold pipe in his teeth. He logs the fishing boats in and out, collects the berth dues and spends most of the night in the customs shed with the radio on.

**Speaking Style:** Heavy and wheezing, a harbourmaster's voice that agrees with everything and promises nothing.
**Combat Role:** none; he calls the police and then remembers why he should not
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy old harbourmaster in a peaked cap writing in a logbook by lamplight in a customs shed, radio murmuring.
personality: Core: comfortable and lazy; friendly to everyone with money; frightened of his pension going
Quirk: avoids knowing things

npcs.name: Stanislav Brod
npcs.info:
The blasting foreman of the basalt quarry, a huge man in a hard hat and a dust-grey shirt, who sets the charges, sounds the siren and counts his men back in after every blast.

**Speaking Style:** A huge, booming foreman's voice that carries over a crusher and does not wait for answers.
**Combat Role:** a strong labourer with a crowbar, who would rather blow the hill than fight on it
**Relationship Hook:** A huge bearded foreman in a hard hat standing in a black stone quarry, raising an arm to clear the pit.
personality: Core: loud; careful with explosives; proud of his quarry
Quirk: never loses a man

npcs.name: Steiner
npcs.info:
One of the highest-ranked officers of the International Permit Agency, tall and bespectacled, with light brown hair and hazel eyes, in a suit and tie on official business. He has been made Beyond's guide for the expedition, and for the voyage he and several colleagues are on loan to the investigators of Kakin's Justice Bureau.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and assured on duty, a senior official's voice with a strain under it he will not let show.
**Combat Role:** none; an official who fights with permits, agency authority and the protection of his status
**Relationship Hook:** A tall bespectacled official holding a small button in his palm and staring at it.
personality: Core: self-assured until he learned too much; pragmatic, tactical and a good speaker; keeps his juniors reading the files
Quirk: does not voice his worst thoughts

npcs.name: Stick Dinner
npcs.info:
An Amateur Hunter on Kite's survey team with a big afro, a blue and white shirt and starred red trousers, who is in charge of the team's meals. He comes from the same mining town as Spinner and is always smiling and making puns.

**Speaking Style:** A jolly, laughing young man's voice that drops puns into every sentence.
**Combat Role:** none; a cook's knife and a cheerful head
**Relationship Hook:** A young man with a big afro stirring a pot over a campfire, laughing at his own pun.
personality: Core: jolly and always smiling; in charge of dinner; loyal to Kite and his friends
Quirk: loves a pun

npcs.name: Su Kwang-chol
npcs.info:
A senior radar operator at the hilltop station, a heavy-lidded lieutenant in headphones who has watched the sky over the Balsa Islands on green screens for twelve years. He logs every aircraft that crosses the coast, and is said to be able to tell a fighter from a cargo plane by the way its blip moves.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and deep, an operator who makes jokes in a monotone so nobody can prove they were jokes.
**Combat Role:** a sidearm and a station of soldiers; he would sooner phone for a fighter
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy-lidded operator in headphones tapping a pencil against a green radar screen.
personality: Core: dry and watchful; exact on the screen, careless in the canteen; bored enough to be dangerous
Quirk: keeps copies of what he is told to wipe

npcs.name: Sub
npcs.info:
A player with spiky red hair, narrow eyes and a small tattoo on his forehead like a bat or a devil's head, in grey trousers and a pink long-sleeved shirt printed with the same mark. He is a sound hand-to-hand fighter and an accurate thrower, cold to everyone but his two companions.

**Speaking Style:** Cool and level, a quiet man who measures an enemy aloud before he moves.
**Combat Role:** a sturdy hand-to-hand fighter with a big pool of aura and an accurate throwing arm
**Relationship Hook:** A red-haired man flicking a stone from his hand to knock a spinning yo-yo out of the air.
personality: Core: cold and methodical; looks for weak spots; not as careful an observer as he thinks
Quirk: loyal to his partners

npcs.name: Sun-bin
npcs.info:
A Cha-R Family man with thin fair hair, slanted eyes and a rose tattooed on the left side of his neck, in a zip-up jacket and dark trousers. He speaks casually and wears a deadpan, even bored face whatever he is saying, and he claims to hate the sight of blood.

**Speaking Style:** Bored, informal and flat, a deadpan drawl that sounds concerned only on paper.
**Combat Role:** a Mafia gunman who reads aura and keeps his distance from what he sees
**Relationship Hook:** A bored mobster with a rose tattoo leaning by a turnstile, watching three strangers pass without paying.
personality: Core: deadpan whatever he says; informal with everyone; reads a stranger's strength at a glance
Quirk: claims to hate blood

npcs.name: Swinko-swinko Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The fifth queen, mother of the eighth prince Salé-salé, a slim woman with wide hips, short fair hair stopping above her ears and parted over her left eye, a rectangular face, beady eyes and a thin nose. Unlike the other queens she wears trousers: a sharp-shouldered vest over a turtleneck with a sash at the waist, with simple earrings, blush and lipstick.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp and scolding one moment, indulgent and cooing the next, a mother who cannot stay angry with her son.
**Combat Role:** none; a queen who fights through her guard captain and her own spies
**Relationship Hook:** A slim queen in a sharp vest and trousers scolding her son across a bed littered with party rubbish.
personality: Core: handles every problem for her son; wears trousers when the others wear gowns; calls the contest a golden opportunity
Quirk: scolds and spoils in one breath

npcs.name: Tae Kap-sun
npcs.info:
A ration clerk at the wire windows of the hall, a sturdy middle-aged woman with forearms like a baker's and a rubber stamp she handles like a weapon. She tears coupons and weighs out grain from before dawn to noon, knows every face in the queue, and has a word for each, though not always a kind one. The queue is careful to be polite to her.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk and even, a clerk's voice that says no exactly as pleasantly as it says yes.
**Combat Role:** none; a stamp, a wire window and a queue that would not help anyone who crossed her
**Relationship Hook:** A sturdy clerk behind a wire window bringing a rubber stamp down on a coupon while she looks the next person over.
personality: Core: brisk and sharp-tongued; steals with a clear conscience; fond of the children in the queue
Quirk: plays favourites without hiding it

npcs.name: Tajao
npcs.info:
The vice boss of the Cha-R Family and military adviser to the seventh prince Luzurus's private army, a middle-aged man of medium build with a curtained, dyed haircut whose dark roots show at the nape and in his moustache, round eyes, dark circles and gaunt cheeks. He stays calm and smokes through the worst of news.

**Speaking Style:** Even and unhurried, a vice boss who discusses a war between families in the tone of a weather report.
**Combat Role:** a Mafia vice boss and military adviser who wins wars with routes, men and timing
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt vice boss leading the way down an oily catwalk with a flashlight and a cigarette.
personality: Core: calm through bad news; proud the families kept the country from the shadows; never threatens customers
Quirk: smokes steadily

npcs.name: Tak Pyong-gu
npcs.info:
The foreman of the uniform-cloth mill, a sleek, pot-bellied man with a gold tooth and a party badge who walks the loom floor with his hands behind his back. He is generous with praise, quick with the fines, and always the last to leave. The women on the looms call him the weasel when he cannot hear.

**Speaking Style:** Oily and cheerful, a foreman's voice that calls every worker 'sister' and every bribe 'a little present'.
**Combat Role:** none; a fat man with friends in the district office
**Relationship Hook:** A pot-bellied foreman strolling a loom floor in a cloud of cotton dust, hands behind his back, gold tooth flashing.
personality: Core: greedy and careful about it; quick to blame the workers; sweats when the gate guard looks at him
Quirk: sleek and flattering

npcs.name: Taloon
npcs.info:
The organiser of the Preview Market in Yorknew, an older man with a large nose, a bushy moustache and hair over the back of his neck, in a patterned shirt and a cap. Goods that came too late for the official catalogues pass through his hands, and he appraises them before they go under the hammer.

**Speaking Style:** Cordial and practised, an appraiser's purr that warms the moment he sees something worth having.
**Combat Role:** none; a dealer who fights with an offer
**Relationship Hook:** An old dealer in a cap holding a necklace up to the light and naming a price before anyone asks.
personality: Core: cordial and professional; an eye for quality; never shows how much he wants something
Quirk: makes quiet offers before the sale

npcs.name: Tamazo
npcs.info:
Gantai's co-presenter for the voyage ceremonies, a short woman with big round eyes and her hair plaited into five sections that hang like strings of beads. Her sleeveless dress is scattered with round baubles of every size, her shoes match it, and she wears puffed bloomers like her partner. On stage she is all excitement; between takes she checks the cue cards twice.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, bright and bouncing, a co-host who answers her partner's shouts with a squeal and a fact.
**Combat Role:** none; she ducks, shrieks into the microphone and lets security do its job
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny presenter in a bauble dress counting dancers onto a stage with her binder held to her chest.
personality: Core: remembers every performer's name and hometown; laughs at Gantai's jokes even off air; quietly redoes the work of anyone who cuts corners
Quirk: bounces on her heels when she talks

npcs.name: Tan Sanbao
npcs.info:
An old Have-Not who keeps the pump house at the foot of the terraces and works the top three steps of the hill himself. He knows where every channel runs and how long each terrace takes to fill, and he sleeps beside the diesel pump in the dry months.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, cracked and plain, an old farmer who measures his words like water.
**Combat Role:** none; a hoe and a lifetime of carrying sacks up a hill
**Relationship Hook:** An old farmer in a straw hat standing barefoot by a humming pump house below green terraces.
personality: Core: sleeps beside the pump in the dry season; will not set foot in the capital; keeps old names nobody else remembers
Quirk: talks to the water channels

npcs.name: Tang Zhao Li Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The third queen, mother of the third prince Zhang Lei, a dark-skinned woman with short curly blonde hair, large eyes and a thin nose. She is seldom seen outside her suite and is better known by the reach of her household than by her face, which most of the ship has seen only in a portrait.

**Speaking Style:** Low, languid and assured, a senior queen who never needs to finish a sentence to be obeyed.
**Combat Role:** none; a senior queen who moves the army and the Xi-Yu with a word
**Relationship Hook:** A dark-skinned queen with short blonde curls taking tea in a formal drawing room, a guard bent to her ear.
personality: Core: is obeyed before she finishes speaking; lends her influence for a favour returned; keeps count of her placed guards
Quirk: rarely leaves her suite

npcs.name: Tarek Aswad
npcs.info:
The head of the family that runs the whitewashed rest house halfway across the Bilgai Desert, a lean, grave man in a long cotton robe and a headcloth. His family has kept the water tank on this road for four generations, and he radios the city when a vehicle breaks down.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and dry, a desert host who says very little and makes the silence sound like hospitality.
**Combat Role:** an old hunting rifle and a desert he can lose any pursuer in
**Relationship Hook:** A grave desert host in a white headcloth on a shaded porch, watching a broken-down car in the glare.
personality: Core: grave and hospitable; proud of his family's road; patient as the desert
Quirk: judges people before he helps them

npcs.name: Tembeko Ndari
npcs.info:
The oldest of the Gyudondond quarter's Bap, a dancing warrior bound in strips of cloth over the holes pierced into him as a child, through which his body plays. On festival nights he leads the songs of battle from the court, and the sound carries across the heaps as far as the church; his people rank him above their own elders.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and rhythmic, the city's tongue spoken with his own people's music under it, pausing on the beat.
**Combat Role:** an old Bap who plays a song of battle on his own body before he fights, then dances out of reach and strikes with bare hands
**Relationship Hook:** A bandaged old man mid-dance in an open court, arms raised, the court falling silent to hear his body play.
personality: Core: hums through his wrappings while he thinks; speaks his tribe's tongue first and the city's second; sings the names of the dead at dusk
Quirk: knows a stranger by the rhythm of their walk

npcs.name: Teo Bramwell
npcs.info:
A young skipper whose trawler has been on blocks in the yard since autumn. He inherited the boat and its debts from his father, and he comes to the slipway every morning to scrape a little more of her hull, as if that might pay for something.

**Speaking Style:** Ashamed and quiet, a young skipper who keeps clearing his throat before he says anything that matters.
**Combat Role:** none; a young fisherman's strength and a scraper
**Relationship Hook:** A young skipper scraping the hull of a trawler that is going nowhere.
personality: Core: proud and too ashamed to ask for help; keeps his father's habits on board; laughs off every question about money
Quirk: works on the boat every day though it goes nowhere

npcs.name: Teradein Neutral
npcs.info:
A two-star Hunter of heads and a specialist in human resources, an older man with well-kept grey hair and hazel eyes in a teal suit and yellow tie. He has charisma and a gift for leadership, and he is honest to a fault.

**Speaking Style:** A dignified, charismatic, older man's voice, honest and earnest, that rallies a crowd.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's Nen and the people he leads
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired man in a teal suit rallying a group of Hunters to his cause.
personality: Core: a natural leader; naive about rivals; earnest
Quirk: charismatic and honest

npcs.name: Tess Orlov
npcs.info:
A night clerk at an internet café near the central station, short and bright-eyed, her hair in two short bunches, in a denim jacket covered in pin badges. She passed the Hunter Exam the year before last and still works the desk, because the licence turned out to need a plan she has not made yet.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and chirpy, a night-shift voice running on vending-machine coffee and good news.
**Combat Role:** an exam survivor with good reflexes and no art; she runs, climbs and throws whatever is close
**Relationship Hook:** A young woman in a badge-covered denim jacket swiping a card at a café desk, monitors glowing behind her.
personality: Core: cheerful; curious about everyone's searches; unsure what to do next
Quirk: careless with her licence

npcs.name: Theta
npcs.info:
One of the fourth prince Tserriednich's bodyguards, a tall slim young woman with light hair held back by a band, clear eyes and long lashes, in a black suit, tie and earpiece, with a handgun at the small of her back. She is one of five of his guards who passed the 289th Hunter Exam as Provisional Hunters, which let him bring more staff aboard. She is clever and prudent and teases her colleague Salkov.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp, cool and dryly funny, a clever woman's voice that keeps its fear under perfect control.
**Combat Role:** a trained guard and Nen user with a handgun, who plans her way past a stronger enemy
**Relationship Hook:** A slim woman in a black suit at a prince's door, her face calm and her hand near the gun at her back.
personality: Core: sagacious and prudent; disapproves of her prince; keeps her fear in check
Quirk: dry humour with colleagues

npcs.name: Thorvald
npcs.info:
The foreman of the felling camp at the river's oxbow, a huge man with an axe on his shoulder who sets the crews to fell, the sawyers to their pits and the ox teams to drag the trunks to the water. His camp floats more timber than any other in the country.

**Speaking Style:** A big shouting voice for across a felling camp, short-tempered, never unkind.
**Combat Role:** a giant woodsman with a felling axe
**Relationship Hook:** A huge red-bearded foreman leading an ox team past the sawpits, axe on his shoulder.
personality: Core: works harder than his crews; obeys the wardens without liking it; protective of his men
Quirk: loud and fair

npcs.name: Tibor Halloran
npcs.info:
The landlord of the night bar by the station, a broad man in his fifties with a shaved head, rolled sleeves and forearms tattooed in faded naval ink. He keeps a shogi board for the regulars and a bat under the counter for everyone else, and he has used the bat more often than the board.

**Speaking Style:** Low and sardonic, a landlord who uses three words where a customer uses twenty and makes each one land.
**Combat Role:** a heavy ex-sailor who ends a bar fight with one swing of a bat and the door
**Relationship Hook:** A shaven-headed landlord drying a glass behind a brass-railed counter, one eye on a shogi board and one on the door.
personality: Core: says little and means it; protective of his regulars; fair to anyone who pays
Quirk: reads trouble before it starts

npcs.name: Tibor Lusk
npcs.info:
A gangly young man in an Association blazer a size too big, with a crooked tie and a clipboard, who mans the shuttle desk on the concourse. He passed last year's exam and was given a desk while he decides what kind of Hunter he means to be.

**Speaking Style:** A bright, eager voice that sounds as if it is still surprised to have a job.
**Combat Role:** raw talent and the training that got him through the exam, with a collapsible baton
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly clerk with a crooked tie holding up his licence to show you, and then realising he should not have.
personality: Core: eager and careless; honest to a fault; bored by the work that matters
Quirk: talks too much about his licence

npcs.name: Tilda Ronn
npcs.info:
A student volunteer of nineteen with a sunburnt nose and a bandana, who came for one summer and has stayed two years sifting soil for nothing. She sleeps in the loft and keeps the tools clean.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, eager and breathless, a student's voice that never stops asking.
**Combat Role:** none; a volunteer who swings a shovel if she must and runs if she can
**Relationship Hook:** A young volunteer in a bandana hanging dusty sieves on a timber wall in a bunkhouse.
personality: Core: eager; hardworking; full of questions
Quirk: hides her ambition

npcs.name: Tito Barrales
npcs.info:
The senior porter on the arrivals kerb, a wiry man of forty with a moustache he combs between flights, who decides which of the younger porters gets the rich luggage. He knows every chauffeur in the limousine bay by his first name and his employer by the second.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful and fast-talking, a porter who greets you by your luggage tag before your name.
**Combat Role:** a street fighter's knee and a luggage trolley swung sideways, then he runs into the crowd
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry porter in a red cap steering a trolley of luggage toward a black limousine, already talking to its driver.
personality: Core: combs his moustache between flights; calls every chauffeur by his first name; carries a heavy bag as if it weighed nothing
Quirk: sells the same secret twice

npcs.name: Tobias Ferrel
npcs.info:
The night signalman at the sidings, a gangling nineteen-year-old in a railway jacket two sizes too big, who works the levers alone from ten to six with a flask of tea and a radio turned low. He took the job because nobody else wanted the night shift.

**Speaking Style:** Thin and nervous, a young signalman who whispers as if the levers could hear him.
**Combat Role:** none; he locks the box door and pulls the signal to danger
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly young signalman in an oversized railway jacket peering out of a lit signal box window at lamps on the far line.
personality: Core: timid and observant; good at his job; too frightened to speak up
Quirk: talks to the levers

npcs.name: Tobin Ackerley
npcs.info:
The dairy farmer's son, a broad fifteen-year-old with straw in his hair who milks the cows at dawn and runs the hills every night. He has read everything he can find about the Hunter Exam.

**Speaking Style:** A quiet, earnest teenager's voice, polite to adults and fierce about the one thing he wants.
**Combat Role:** a strong farm boy who wrestles and runs and has never fought anyone
**Relationship Hook:** A broad farm boy in dungarees milking a cow in a shed at dawn, staring out of the door at the hills.
personality: Core: earnest; stubborn; fit beyond his age
Quirk: shy about his dream

npcs.name: Tobin Ashe
npcs.info:
A creed reader who comes round the meeting houses of the district to read the founding words on rest days: that people went wrong when they let machines think and work for them. He marries the young, buries the old and stays for supper with whichever family he chooses.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, pious and patient, a reader's voice that makes a question sound like a confession.
**Combat Role:** none; a reader whose word sends men to the stockade
**Relationship Hook:** A thin man in a green robe at the foot of the hall's tree, closing his book and smiling at you.
personality: Core: pious and patient; remembers every confession; never raises his voice
Quirk: dines where he means to look

npcs.name: Tobin Haskell
npcs.info:
A skinny fifteen-year-old from the outer islands with a sunburnt nose, a borrowed duffel coat and a rucksack he uses as a pillow. He has been sleeping in the chapel's back pew for three nights, and he tells anyone who asks that he is only resting before he sets off.

**Speaking Style:** A cracking teenage voice that tries to sound tough, fails, and gets quieter every time it fails.
**Combat Role:** none; a fisherman's boy with quick feet and a pocket knife
**Relationship Hook:** A skinny island boy in a coat too big for him looking up from the back pew and pretending he was just leaving.
personality: Core: too proud to go home; polite to the old sexton; jumps at loud voices
Quirk: frightened and hiding it badly

npcs.name: Toby Wexler
npcs.info:
A gangly student of twenty from a college in the city, who has pitched a tent among the cottonwoods for seven nights, photographing the cottonwoods and the red walls for a portfolio. He has a borrowed camera, a tent too thin for the night cold and a stack of film.

**Speaking Style:** Eager, earnest and talkative, a student who explains his project to anyone who stands still.
**Combat Role:** none; he runs, badly, and takes a photograph while running
**Relationship Hook:** A gangly student in round glasses crouching among cottonwoods in a red canyon, a camera at his eye.
personality: Core: takes photographs of everything; sleeps in a tent too thin for the cold; trusts people too easily
Quirk: explains his project to anyone

npcs.name: Todo
npcs.info:
A large, round wrestler with slicked-back hair in a ponytail and the sides of his head shaved, applicant 255, who wants to become a Blacklist Hunter. He is smarter than he looks, irascible and dogmatic, and he protests loudly when he thinks an examiner is unfair.

**Speaking Style:** A loud, aggrieved, heavy voice that protests every injustice at full volume.
**Combat Role:** a wrestler's weight and grip
**Relationship Hook:** A huge wrestler roaring at a cooking examiner that a Hunter does not need to make sushi.
personality: Core: irascible and dogmatic; smarter than he looks; judgemental of other people's skills
Quirk: hates injustice, loudly

npcs.name: Togari
npcs.info:
A Hunter and former examiner with blue hair and a face slashed with big scars, dressed in furs with bandaged wrists and legs. He sits in on the third phase with Lippo. He is proud and self-confident, and he has trained for a year for one purpose.

**Speaking Style:** A proud, tight, bitter voice that keeps trying to sound calm and keeps failing whenever a certain name comes up.
**Combat Role:** a Hunter's training sharpened by a year of hate, and not enough
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred man in furs stepping out of a hidden room to face a smiling jester.
personality: Core: proud and self-confident; trains hard and believes it is enough; underestimates his enemy
Quirk: consumed by a grudge

npcs.name: Tokarine
npcs.info:
A Hunter picked by the Zodiacs for the expedition, a plump, round-faced woman with small eyes and dark bobbed hair dyed lighter on top, with an earring. She knows her limits and is not afraid to say so.

**Speaking Style:** A plain, honest, slightly anxious woman's voice that says what it cannot do before anyone asks.
**Combat Role:** little; an ability for carrying and moving things
**Relationship Hook:** A round-faced woman in a meeting raising her hand to say she will need more people.
personality: Core: practical; a little anxious; admires others more than herself
