Quirk: honest about her limits

npcs.name: Tokharone
npcs.info:
A man with an undercut, thick brows, a bulbous nose and a hard, chiselled face who leads a team of his own. Other players say his is one of the strongest teams in the game, and they give it a wide berth.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and decided, a team leader who talks like a man who has already chosen.
**Combat Role:** a strong Nen user who leads from the front with his team at his back
**Relationship Hook:** A hard-faced man with an undercut kneeling to study footprints that walk into a cliff and never come out.
personality: Core: ruthless with rivals; keeps his team close; plays the long game
Quirk: decisive

npcs.name: Tokiwa
npcs.info:
A young butler on the boundary wall rota, walking the patrol path along the top with a radio and a torch. He is loose-limbed and talkative, and he treats the long walks as a chance to be away from the senior staff.

**Speaking Style:** Cocky and easy, a young man's chatty voice that drops into a careful whisper the moment he is near the wall's edge.
**Combat Role:** a junior butler's speed and a heavy torch; he reports first and fights second
**Relationship Hook:** A lanky young butler on top of a giant stone wall, shining his torch down at a grappling hook on the outer side.
personality: Core: talks to himself on long patrols; pretends to be braver than he is; obeys the hound's rule to the letter
Quirk: keeps a tally of climbers on the inside of his cap

npcs.name: Tolly Brannock
npcs.info:
The chandler on Harbour Street, a wiry man in his thirties with a pencil behind each ear, who sells hooks, line, shackles, paint, oilskins and anything else a boat eats. His shop is narrow and dark and smells of tar and new rope, and he will talk to anyone who stands still in it.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and chatty, a shopman's patter that never quite finishes one sentence before the next begins.
**Combat Role:** none; a marlinspike he has never used on anything but rope
**Relationship Hook:** A wiry chandler leaning over a counter of fishhooks, pointing proudly at a hand-painted sign in his window.
personality: Core: talks while he works and works while he talks; gives credit to anyone with a boat; loses his nerve in front of Mito Freecss
Quirk: boasts about the boy's catch as if it were his own

npcs.name: Tommy Rourke
npcs.info:
The boss of the porters' union at the Hollis Wholesale Market, a barrel of a man in a rubber apron and boots who stands at the end of the fish hall at four in the morning and picks who works. He carries a pistol in his apron and a list in his head.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, flat and final, a union boss's voice that ends an argument by finishing his sentence.
**Combat Role:** a market bruiser with a pistol in his apron and a dozen porters at his whistle
**Relationship Hook:** A barrel-chested man in a rubber apron pointing at porters in a fish hall under hanging lamps.
personality: Core: blunt; brutal to strikers; obeys the family without love
Quirk: fair to his own men

npcs.name: Tomoe
npcs.info:
The chandler of the bee yard, a slight young woman with honey-coloured hands who dips the beeswax candles the longhouse buys. With no electric light in the country her candles light half the district, and she has never once been stung.

**Speaking Style:** Light and drifting, a chandler who talks to her bees and to people in the same murmur.
**Combat Role:** none; a beekeeper who can turn a hive out on anyone
**Relationship Hook:** A slight young woman in a dark room of hanging candles, lifting a fresh one from the wax pot.
personality: Core: dreamy and gentle; notices smells nobody else does; shy with strangers
Quirk: talks to her bees

npcs.name: Tong Chang-su
npcs.info:
A guide who takes people across the border river at the ford by the blown bridge, a rangy, scarred man in a deserter's camouflage jacket with the badges torn off, who waits in the reeds for dark. He is the guide the patrols know by sight and take money from, and the one families ask for by name because he has never left a party in the water.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and dry and amused, a smuggler who quotes the river's depth like a price.
**Combat Role:** a trained commando with a knife and a stolen rifle, deadly in reeds and water at night
**Relationship Hook:** A scarred man in a stripped camouflage jacket crouched in the reeds, watching the patrol pass the broken bridge.
personality: Core: hard, dry and honest in his trade; kind to children; will fight a patrol rather than give up a party
Quirk: despises guides who abandon their parties

npcs.name: Tonpa
npcs.info:
A short, fat man in a blue V-neck with a satchel, wearing badge number sixteen, who greets newcomers like an old friend, explains the exam to them and offers them a drink. He has taken the exam thirty-four times and calls himself an expert.

**Speaking Style:** A chummy, wheedling, helpful-sounding voice that offers advice and juice to newcomers and giggles when they fall.
**Combat Role:** none worth the name; tricks, poisoned drinks and false friendship
**Relationship Hook:** A short, friendly man holding out a can of juice to a boy who sniffs it and frowns.
personality: Core: friendly, helpful and false; a coward who survives everything; brags about his experience
Quirk: enjoys newcomers' failure more than anything

npcs.name: Trick Tower's 3rd examiner
npcs.info:
A big bald Hunter with a large nose and thick lips, in a pale suit, who works the third phase beside the warden. He never gave the applicants a name and none of them asked; he is the large man who stands at the lottery box and holds it out.

**Speaking Style:** A heavy, patient bass that sounds faintly amused by everything an applicant does.
**Combat Role:** a heavy Hunter who ends trouble with one grip and rarely has to move his feet
**Relationship Hook:** A big bald man in a pale suit kneeling on a flat stone roof, pressing on one flagstone to test the hinge beneath.
personality: Core: calm and slow-moving; amused rather than impressed; meticulous with machinery
Quirk: says nothing he does not have to

npcs.name: Trink
npcs.info:
A lean capo in his fifties with slicked-back black hair going grey at the temples, a thin moustache and tinted glasses, who keeps the same red booth at Club Velours every August. He is an old friend of Light Nostrade and one of the new names in his daughter's appointment book.

**Speaking Style:** A low, dry rasp that drops to a whisper whenever a waiter comes near.
**Combat Role:** a capo who fights through other men, a word in an ear and a car at the kerb
**Relationship Hook:** A lean capo in tinted glasses watching the door from a red velvet booth, a whisky untouched at his hand.
personality: Core: dry and careful; trusts fortunes more than men; keeps old friends close
Quirk: never sits with his back to a door

npcs.name: Tserriednich Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The fourth prince of Kakin and second son of the first queen Unma, a tall, muscular man with shoulder-length blond hair combed back, a thin moustache and stubble, dressed with expensive care. He is erudite and courteous, an art lover and a football fan, and the patron of the Heil-Ly Family. At the military academy he broke the field-stripping record and shot a fellow cadet in the leg after an argument.

**Speaking Style:** Placid, polished and amused, a scholar's soft voice discussing philosophy and football in the same breath, never raised.
**Combat Role:** none at first; within days a Nen genius whose aura frightens his own teacher, and a handgun he is happy to use
**Relationship Hook:** A tall blond prince smiling courteously over a glass of wine in a room full of glass cases.
personality: Core: placid, polished and erudite; collects human beauty; learns anything at frightening speed
Quirk: sociopathic behind the courtesy

npcs.name: Tsezguerra
npcs.info:
A single-star Jackpot Hunter, tall and lean with broad shoulders, a long thin face, slicked-back black hair, a black beard along the jaw and a thin moustache that bends down at the corners, in an air-force-style combat suit. He runs Battera's hiring test and plays the game himself with three men who have worked with him for twenty years. He is prudent and straightforward and takes only challenges he can win.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, dry and authoritative, a veteran's voice that never wastes a word or admits a mistake.
**Combat Role:** a veteran tactician who leads a four-man team, strikes from ambush and reads abilities fast
**Relationship Hook:** A lean bearded man in a flight suit watching applicants fail his test one after another.
personality: Core: prudent and straightforward; looks down on the weak; honest about his own limits, eventually
Quirk: takes only winnable fights

npcs.name: Tsubone
npcs.info:
A senior butler of the Zoldyck Family, a tall and heavy old woman in the black suit with her hair in two pigtails and a monocle in her right eye. She is one of Silva's two most trusted servants, and the other butlers sweat in her presence. She alone calls the boy Killua-chan.

**Speaking Style:** A heavy, imperious old woman's voice that commands the room, softening only for the two children she calls by pet names.
**Combat Role:** an old master's speed and perception, and her own body turned into a vehicle
**Relationship Hook:** A huge old woman in a butler's suit adjusting her monocle while two younger butlers break into a sweat.
personality: Core: imperious, experienced and unshakeable; fond of Killua and says so; sees through a lie at once
Quirk: obeys Silva without hesitation

npcs.name: Tsudonke
npcs.info:
A supervisor of the Cha-R Family on the fifth tier, a young man with fair hair shaved at both sides and freckles on his cheeks. He shows newcomers the ropes, explains the rotations and the stockpile, and decides which sick passengers get a pass up the central passages to a real doctor.

**Speaking Style:** Cool on the outside, bursting underneath, a young supervisor who sounds composed and thinks in exclamation marks.
**Combat Role:** a Mafia supervisor with a handgun and juniors at his back
**Relationship Hook:** A freckled young mobster at a sick bay desk, signing a pass while staring at nothing with shining eyes.
personality: Core: plays it cool, fan underneath; sets a good example for the juniors; decides who gets a pass upstairs
Quirk: wants a proper autograph board, not a scrap

npcs.name: Tsui Wenjie
npcs.info:
An immigration officer at the international airport, assigned to the separate desk for visitors whose permits allow restricted travel. He is thin, correct and courteous in four languages, and he has learned to stamp a passport without looking at the man who holds it out.

**Speaking Style:** Polite, careful and flat, a passport officer's voice that gives away nothing and expects the same.
**Combat Role:** none; a civil servant who presses a button and lets the airport police come
**Relationship Hook:** A thin immigration officer stamping a passport while two men in suits read over his shoulder.
personality: Core: courteous in four languages; stamps without looking up; straightens his desk before every flight
Quirk: keeps a private list of faces he was told to forget

npcs.name: Tsukuma
npcs.info:
A former police officer of twenty-nine with a gaunt, hard-jawed face and a muscular frame wasting under a hospital gown. Bandages cover the top of his head, his right eye and ear, and a pad is taped over one cheekbone. He has no legs below the blanket. He talks to the television crews calmly and without self-pity.

**Speaking Style:** Flat and steady, a policeman giving a statement from a hospital bed in short sentences, as if describing a road accident he only happened to see.
**Combat Role:** none now; once a patrolman's sidearm and baton, and a policeman's eye for the detail that matters
**Relationship Hook:** A bandaged ex-policeman sitting up in a hospital bed, telling a camera crew about a giant shrimp in a level voice.
personality: Core: precise about what he saw and what he did not; refuses pity; still thinks like a policeman
Quirk: calm under any question

npcs.name: Tubeppa Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The fifth prince of Kakin and second daughter of the second queen Duazul, a woman with a sharp blond bowl cut, a long nose, a long thin mouth and glasses, who dresses in suits rather than gowns. She is a scientist, patient and straightforward, and likes things plain and simple. She has her own idea of the kingdom.

**Speaking Style:** Plain, clipped and dry, a scientist who says what she means and no more.
**Combat Role:** none of her own; a scientist who plans and lets her guard act
**Relationship Hook:** A prince in a suit and glasses studying a vial under a lamp, ignoring the party outside.
personality: Core: patient and tolerant; a scientist; despises the eldest princes
Quirk: plain-spoken and straightforward

npcs.name: Tyson Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The sixth prince of Kakin and only daughter of the fourth queen Katrono, a short, stout woman with a large round face, long straight black hair and dark upturned eyes, in fuzzy, flowery clothes with hearts on them. She picked her bodyguards for their looks, refuses to let the Hunter Association vet them and loves to be pampered and called cute. She has written a book of her teachings on love.

**Speaking Style:** Giggly, sweet and dreamy, a voice that preaches love and blushes at a compliment.
**Combat Role:** none; a prince who trusts love and her guards
**Relationship Hook:** A round-faced prince in a flowery dress pressing her book into a bodyguard's hands with a giggle.
personality: Core: sweet and dreamy; possessive of her guards; opposes violence
Quirk: loves to be pampered

npcs.name: Umori
npcs.info:
The third brother, applicant 199, in a brimmed skull cap and a pinstriped shirt over a plain one, with a large nose and the brothers' sharp eye marks. He is as cocky as Amori but will admit what he does not know and give in at once if a brother's life is threatened.

**Speaking Style:** A gruff, practical voice that admits what it does not know and bargains when a brother is in danger.
**Combat Role:** the brothers' teamwork and a willingness to deal
**Relationship Hook:** A young man in a skull cap handing over his badge to save his brother's life.
personality: Core: confident and arrogant; admits ignorance; practical in a pinch
Quirk: puts his brothers' lives before the exam

npcs.name: Underground Clinic Nurse
npcs.info:
The head nurse of a clinic the state does not admit exists, a short, stout woman with black hair, narrow eyes and a stethoscope over her starched uniform. She runs the bed, the drugs, the telephone and the books, and charges for all four. She speaks to a patient the way a bank speaks to a debtor, and her walls are corroded and filthy.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, nasal and relentless, a cashier's voice that reads out the bill before it asks how the patient feels.
**Combat Role:** none; she has orderlies, a locked door and a scalpel she knows exactly where to put
**Relationship Hook:** A short stout nurse at the foot of a bed, clipboard raised, reading a bill to a patient who has only just opened his eyes.
personality: Core: greedy without a scrap of shame; polite only to a patient whose account has cleared; never raises her voice; she does not need to
Quirk: enjoys telling debtors what their organs are worth

npcs.name: Unma Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The first queen of Kakin, with short blonde hair, a rectangular face and a wide flat nose, in formal royal dress. She is mother to the first prince Benjamin, the fourth prince Tserriednich and the ninth prince Halkenburg, whom she gave to the second queen to raise.

**Speaking Style:** Cool, sharp and proud, the first queen's voice, used to being heard first.
**Combat Role:** none; a queen whose weapons are secrets
**Relationship Hook:** A tall blonde queen watching her three sons across a banquet hall with unreadable eyes.
personality: Core: proud and ambitious; supportive of her youngest; knows more than she says
Quirk: favours Halkenburg over her eldest

npcs.name: Usamen
npcs.info:
A Temp Hunter on Beyond's team with a big underbite, uneven eyes and a sushi chef's headband, with an apron hung from his hip marked with the sign for fresh. He calls himself a master of the aura game pip-play.

**Speaking Style:** A brash, boastful voice that brags about its skill at a party trick.
**Combat Role:** a specialist's ability he has not shown
**Relationship Hook:** A man in a sushi chef's headband shaping a bubble of aura, then staring as someone else makes a dozen.
personality: Core: boastful; outclassed and gracious about it; easy company
Quirk: proud of a party trick

npcs.name: Uvogin
npcs.info:
A giant of a man in bearskins, with a wild grey mane, sideburns and a body that bullets bounce from, who is the strongest Troupe member in raw power. He loves a fight, despises planning, and laughs through pain. He is one of the Troupe's founders, and his closest friend in it is the swordsman Nobunaga.

**Speaking Style:** A huge, booming, laughing voice that roars for joy in a fight and bellows insults; it has no volume but loud.
**Combat Role:** an enhancer's body made almost invulnerable and a punch like a bomb
**Relationship Hook:** A giant in bearskins laughing as a bazooka shell bursts harmlessly against his chest.
personality: Core: wild, headstrong and simple; remorseless toward strangers; loyal to his friends to the death
Quirk: loves fighting more than anything

npcs.name: Valerian Ostend
npcs.info:
The master of the Hall of the Burning Will, a handsome man of fifty in embroidered silk with a long grey ponytail and rings on every finger. He teaches that the fighters above the 200th floor have learnt to burn their will as fuel, sells grades in coloured belts and makes his students hold their breath until they faint.

**Speaking Style:** Rich, slow and theatrical, a self-made master who speaks of inner fire in a voice like warm syrup.
**Combat Role:** a once-real kung fu of open palms and sweeps, gone soft under the silk
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-ponytailed master in embroidered silk raising a ringed hand over rows of students holding their breath.
personality: Core: grand and theatrical; believes half of what he teaches; greedy for fees
Quirk: strokes his ponytail when he lies

npcs.name: Vance Rourke
npcs.info:
A rangy, handsome bounty hunter of thirty-two with a scar across his chin, who has failed the Hunter Exam twice and makes his living in the meantime catching bail jumpers and wanted men for the police. He comes to the motor court every autumn when the auction city fills with men worth money.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, sure of himself and quick to laugh, a bounty man who talks about his next catch as if it were already in the boot.
**Combat Role:** a bounty man's rifle and handcuffs; good with a gun, bad at knowing when to run
**Relationship Hook:** A rangy bounty hunter sitting on the edge of an empty pool, cleaning a rifle with a wanted list beside him.
personality: Core: generous with his whisky; practises his draw in the motel mirror; takes a defeat as a personal insult
Quirk: boasts about catches he has not made yet

npcs.name: Vantine
npcs.info:
The captain of the fourth prince Tserriednich's guard, an older man with slicked-back hair past his ears, a moustache and a soul patch, in the black suit and tie of a royal bodyguard. He is formal and professional, reports to his prince often and is trusted with errands to the Justice Bureau.

**Speaking Style:** Formal and correct, an old guard captain's quiet reports, never a wasted word.
**Combat Role:** a disciplined guard captain who follows orders to the letter
**Relationship Hook:** An older guard captain bowing in a doorway to report to a smiling prince.
personality: Core: formal and professional; reports everything; never questions an order
Quirk: fiercely loyal

npcs.name: Vesna Kral
npcs.info:
The nurse of the container clinic, who trained somewhere outside and has never said where. She works in rubber gloves she washes and wears again, reads the scratched-off dates on her medicine by its smell and colour, and sews up whoever comes in and asks nothing about how.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, tired and exact, a night-shift nurse who has heard every excuse and believes none of them.
**Combat Role:** none; a scalpel and a quick needle of sedative for whoever turns violent on her cot
**Relationship Hook:** A gloved nurse in a white-painted container, holding a medicine bottle up to the lamp to read its colour.
personality: Core: washes her gloves more often than her hands; answers questions about her past with medical advice; smokes on the container roof at night
Quirk: is gentlest with whoever is most dangerous

npcs.name: Viktor Halasz
npcs.info:
The barman of the Seventh Door Bar, a broad, bearded man with forearms like hams and a rag permanently over one shoulder. He paints a drinker's name on the back wall when they swear to open one of the seven doors, and paints it over when they do not come back.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and slow, thick with the vowels of the hill villages, a barman who leans in to talk and never needs to be asked twice.
**Combat Role:** a broad man's grip, a shotgun under the bar and a room full of regulars who like him
**Relationship Hook:** A bearded barman painting a new name onto the first of seven doors on his back wall.
personality: Core: listens more than he talks; never lies, never volunteers; keeps a shotgun under the bar and has never used it
Quirk: paints names and paints them over

npcs.name: Viktor Szabo
npcs.info:
The captain of the Rokario border guard post west of Quen City, a lean officer in his forties with a pencil moustache, pressed fatigues and mirrored glasses he takes off only to frighten someone. His patrols ride the NGL line in jeeps, since the other side will not let an engine past.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and cold, an officer who gives a reprimand and a compliment in the same hard tone.
**Combat Role:** an army officer's rifle at long range and a pistol close, with a squad at his back
**Relationship Hook:** A lean border captain in mirrored glasses inspecting a line of guards on a dusty parade square, flag at half-mast behind him.
personality: Core: hard on his men and loyal to them; proud of his marksmanship; never puts anything in writing
Quirk: disciplined and corrupt

npcs.name: Vittoria Sarto
npcs.info:
A tall woman in a black trouser suit with a severe bob and a scar through one eyebrow who stands behind the chair of whoever runs the hall that night. She never sits, never drinks and never plays.

**Speaking Style:** Low, even and unhurried, a voice that sounds as if it is reading a verdict.
**Combat Role:** a bodyguard who reads a threat before it moves and ends it with a short blade or her hands
**Relationship Hook:** A tall woman in black behind a gambler's chair turning her head slowly to look straight at you.
personality: Core: unsentimental about her clients; ambitious for a better post; respects only strength
Quirk: silent and watchful

npcs.name: Vivienne Castellane
npcs.info:
A gem dealer in her forties with a sharp black bob and a grey trouser suit, who keeps a showroom of velvet trays behind a buzzer door on Diamond Row. Her stones come from mines most dealers have only read about, because she went and found them.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and elegant, a gem dealer's voice that prices a stone and its owner together.
**Combat Role:** an aura-trained Hunter who fights from cover with a small pistol and a cool head
**Relationship Hook:** A woman with a black bob studying a diamond through a loupe over a tray of velvet.
personality: Core: elegant and exacting; proud of her finds; dislikes being told to stay out
Quirk: will not deal in fakes

npcs.name: Wade Holcomb
npcs.info:
A young sergeant of twenty-six, top of his class at the academy, who asked for the highway post because his father patrolled it before him. He is tall, clean-shaven and very careful with his paperwork.

**Speaking Style:** Polite and earnest, a young policeman who still says sir to the men he pulls over.
**Combat Role:** a police academy graduate; a service revolver, a baton and a patrol car's radio
**Relationship Hook:** A young sergeant in a tan uniform writing in a notebook at a counter, glancing at the door.
personality: Core: says sir and ma'am to everyone; polishes his boots every morning; speaks of his father with pride
Quirk: writes everything down

npcs.name: Waldemar Kosik
npcs.info:
The station master of Dentora Station, a thin, grey man in a railway uniform with a watch chain across his waistcoat. He has met the morning train for thirty years, and he reads the passengers who step down by the way they carry their bags along the platform.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, clipped and courteous, a station master's voice that sounds like a timetable being read aloud.
**Combat Role:** none; a railway whistle and the station police on the end of a telephone
**Relationship Hook:** A grey station master checking his pocket watch while he studies the bags of a man stepping off the train.
personality: Core: punctual to the second; polite to everyone, warm to no one; judges people by their luggage
Quirk: keeps a private list

npcs.name: Waldo Kettle
npcs.info:
The unloading boss of the road end, a big-bellied man whose voice carries over truck engines, who tells each driver where to tip and each scavenger crew which load is theirs. Nothing coming off a truck is touched until he says it belongs to the city.

**Speaking Style:** Big and booming, a voice built to beat a truck engine, gone soft and gravelly in a quiet room.
**Combat Role:** a big-bellied brawler who stops a man by walking into him and letting the crews close in
**Relationship Hook:** A big-bellied man in work gloves waving a dump truck back toward the heaps, his beard full of dust.
personality: Core: bellows over engines and whispers in quiet; slaps a truck's side to send it off; gives the first find of every load to a child
Quirk: never lets anyone take anything back

npcs.name: Walter Pimm
npcs.info:
A shift engineer at the Eastbank Power Station, a thin man in his fifties with ear protectors round his neck and a clipboard of meter readings, who has walked the switching yard behind the turbine hall every night for nineteen years.

**Speaking Style:** Mild and careful, a shift engineer's voice that explains a breaker as if it were a pet.
**Combat Role:** none; he knows which switch to throw and where to hide when it sparks
**Relationship Hook:** A thin engineer with ear protectors round his neck reading a meter in a fenced yard of transformers at night.
personality: Core: careful; proud of his station; conflict-averse
Quirk: notices small changes

npcs.name: Waystation Keeper
npcs.info:
An old man with a white beard and a squint, in a dusty coat and a wide straw hat, who keeps the stone hut where the road meets the badlands. He sells water from the trough and advice to anyone heading out among the stone pillars.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and dusty, an old man's voice that gives the same good advice every time.
**Combat Role:** none; he bars the door and waits for morning
**Relationship Hook:** An old man by a stone trough pointing a ladle at the pillars and saying: find the weak spot first.
personality: Core: unhurried; kind to the young; counts heads
Quirk: repeats his one lesson

npcs.name: Wei Qinglan
npcs.info:
The senior clerk of the brokerage house, an old man in a scholar's grey gown who works an abacus faster than the young men can work their calculators. He keeps the house's real accounts in a room upstairs and greets every client by the name his father knew them by.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, courteous and old-fashioned, a clerk who addresses everyone as if they were his grandfather's guests.
**Combat Role:** none; an old clerk whose defence is that nobody else can read his books
**Relationship Hook:** An old clerk in a grey gown clicking an abacus beside a safe, his spectacles on the end of his nose.
personality: Core: works an abacus faster than any machine; never writes a request he dislikes; drinks the same tea at the same hour
Quirk: greets clients by their fathers' names

npcs.name: Wendell Hask
npcs.info:
The desk sergeant at the Skyfoot Police Station, a heavy, slow man with a grey moustache and a newspaper always open on the desk. He takes complaints about pickpockets, drunks and fights that start outside the tower without a referee, and files most of them in a drawer.

**Speaking Style:** Weary and patient, a desk sergeant who says 'mm-hm' while he reads the paper.
**Combat Role:** an old policeman's truncheon and a revolver he has not fired in a decade
**Relationship Hook:** A heavy desk sergeant behind a high counter with a newspaper open, looking up at a young woman holding a photograph.
personality: Core: slow and tired; kind underneath; afraid of trouble
Quirk: reads the fight results before the news

npcs.name: Wendell Pruitt
npcs.info:
The chief of the volunteer fire station, who runs the hardware shop across the road and drops his till when the siren goes. He is a big, ruddy man of forty-five who has pulled more lost walkers out of the border woods than fires out of houses.

**Speaking Style:** Hearty and steady, a volunteer chief whose voice fills a fire bay and stays friendly.
**Combat Role:** a fireman's axe and the strength to carry a grown man out of a burning room
**Relationship Hook:** A big ruddy fire chief in an open turnout coat hosing down a red fire engine on a sunny forecourt.
personality: Core: cheerful in a crisis; trusts his crew absolutely; keeps the arrangement quiet
Quirk: cannot say no to a rescue

npcs.name: Wenna Carrick
npcs.info:
A plump, laughing woman in her fifties who leads the afternoon bench at the net shed, her needle going faster than her tongue and her tongue going very fast. Nothing happens on the island that she has not heard about before supper.

**Speaking Style:** Bright and conspiratorial, a gossip's voice that drops to a delighted whisper for the good parts.
**Combat Role:** none; a net needle, a heavy float on a cord and twelve women who back her
**Relationship Hook:** A plump woman on a bench knotting a net and leaning over to whisper to her neighbour.
personality: Core: chooses which secrets to tell with great care; laughs at her own stories before the end; knows everyone's birthday and everyone's debts
Quirk: talks without dropping a stitch

npcs.name: Werner Haupt
npcs.info:
The senior inspector of the customs hall, a precise man of fifty-five with half-moon glasses and a pale uniform he presses himself. He has cleared the lots for the autumn auctions for twenty years, and he can date a painting by the nails in its frame.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, exact and faintly amused, an official who quotes regulations as if they were jokes.
**Combat Role:** none; a whistle that brings the hall's officers and the bonded cage's steel door
**Relationship Hook:** A grey-haired inspector in white gloves bending over an open crate with a loupe at his eye.
personality: Core: quotes the customs code by section number; kind to his staff and cold to importers; keeps two books and believes in one of them
Quirk: polishes his glasses when he is lying

npcs.name: Wi Song-jae
npcs.info:
A prisoner of the labour camp, gaunt in a padded grey uniform with a number stencilled on the back, who works the coal lorries by day and sleeps in the third hut from the wire. He was a schoolteacher in Peijin until a pupil repeated something he said. He is calm, courteous and almost impossible to provoke.

**Speaking Style:** Hoarse, slow and very quiet, a prisoner who has learned to say only what can't be used against him.
**Combat Role:** none; a starved man who has learned to take a beating and get up
**Relationship Hook:** A gaunt prisoner with a stencilled number on his back rolling a scrap of paper between his fingers by the wire.
personality: Core: calm and courteous; patient beyond reason; never raises his voice or his hand
Quirk: cannot stop teaching, even here

npcs.name: Wilf Croy
npcs.info:
A wiry old shoeshine man with a folding chair and a box of brushes under the departures board, who has polished commuters' shoes on the same square of floor for thirty years. He talks to everybody and remembers everyone's feet.

**Speaking Style:** A thin, chirpy old voice that offers a shine, a tip about the weather and an opinion on your shoes.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man who shouts for the station police
**Relationship Hook:** An old shoeshine man looking up from a pair of boots and asking, very casually, whether this is your first January in Zaban City.
personality: Core: chatty and cheerful; judges people by their shoes; sentimental about the young ones
Quirk: never forgets a face

npcs.name: Wilhelmina Strand
npcs.info:
A wiry old eel-trapper in rubber waders and an oilskin, who has worked the creeks of the marsh since she was a girl and lives in a tin-roofed hut at its landward edge. She sells her catch at the covered market and takes nobody out on the water who cannot keep quiet.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and unhurried, with a countrywoman's habit of pausing to listen to the water before she answers.
**Combat Role:** none; she knows where the mud gives way and leads trouble into it
**Relationship Hook:** A weathered old trapper in waders lifting an eel trap out of a reed creek at dusk.
personality: Core: patient as the tide; distrusts the city; knows the marsh better than any map
Quirk: romantic about the fireflies in spite of herself

npcs.name: Wim Jansen
npcs.info:
A teenage climber from the lowlands in an iron-plated vest from Ironweight Outfitters, who has come to the Testing Gate every day this week to push at the first door. He wants to take the Hunter Exam next year and has decided the gate is the best training in the world.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, breathless and eager, a teenager's voice that talks itself up between pushes.
**Combat Role:** a teenager's raw strength and a lot of enthusiasm
**Relationship Hook:** A red-faced teenager in an iron-plated vest throwing his whole weight against a gate the size of a building.
personality: Core: eager and stubborn; ignores warnings; loves an audience
Quirk: talks himself up

npcs.name: Wing
npcs.info:
An assistant master of Shingen-ryu kung fu living near the Heavens Arena, a man of average height with messy black hair and glasses, his pink shirt only half tucked in. He is modest, quiet and absent-minded, a patient but strict teacher who slaps a reckless student, and his only pupil is the boy Zushi.

**Speaking Style:** A mild, absent-minded, gentle voice that explains carefully and becomes very firm when a student is about to do something reckless.
**Combat Role:** Shingen-ryu kung fu and aura flowed through anything he touches, a paper page that cuts a can
**Relationship Hook:** A bespectacled young man with his shirt half untucked raising a playing card that has just sliced through a can.
personality: Core: modest, quiet and absent-minded; patient but strict; tells a harmless lie to protect the unready
Quirk: cares deeply for his students' safety

npcs.name: Woble Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The fourteenth and youngest prince of Kakin, an infant girl with short dark hair, the only child of the eighth queen, Oito. She sleeps through almost everything and is carried everywhere in her mother's arms.

**Speaking Style:** A baby's soft sounds; she does not talk.
**Combat Role:** none; an infant
**Relationship Hook:** A sleeping baby in a blanket in her mother's arms, in a room full of armed guards.
personality: Core: calm in her mother's arms; cries at gunfire; smiles at a familiar voice
Quirk: sleeps through almost anything

npcs.name: Wong
npcs.info:
A zoologist of the Kakin government's zoological agency, a man in his middle forties, slightly heavy, neatly dressed and groomed, with brown hair and thick brown eyebrows. He commissions the agency's field work and signs off on its contracts, and he is known for praising the people he hires rather more than his budget lets him reward them.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, polite and a little effusive, an official who thanks people properly and means it.
**Combat Role:** none; a civil servant who has never held anything more dangerous than a specimen jar
**Relationship Hook:** A plump, tidy official reading field notes between rows of specimen jars.
personality: Core: generous with praise, tight with money; proud of the agency's collections; keeps his promises, even the small ones
Quirk: passes on gossip from the auction world

npcs.name: Worio Bay
npcs.info:
A staff member of Kakin's Justice Bureau, with a large square jaw, heavy eyebrows, a big nose and a thick head of hair parted on the right, in a suit and tie. He is quiet and reserved, and lately he has been kept in his quarters on the pretext of medical observation.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and reserved, a clerk who says little until he decides to say everything.
**Combat Role:** none; a bureau clerk carrying a power he cannot use on purpose
**Relationship Hook:** A square-jawed clerk raising his left hand to show a strange mark to a bespectacled prosecutor.
personality: Core: quiet until he trusts you; believes in the ninth prince; answers honestly once promised safety
Quirk: keeps his left hand in his pocket

npcs.name: Yabibi
npcs.info:
An elderly man with high cheekbones and very little hair left, in a hooded top and matching trousers. He leads a two-man team with the younger Montreux, and between them they hold more than fifty specified cards.

**Speaking Style:** Dry and careful, an old man who answers a bold plan with a question about what nobody knows yet.
**Combat Role:** an old hand who avoids fights and shields his cards with the right defensive spells
**Relationship Hook:** An old man in a hooded top raising one hand at a meeting to stop a young woman's plan to use force.
personality: Core: calm and reserved; rational; takes precautions before risks
Quirk: surprised by little

npcs.name: Yan Tuo
npcs.info:
A Have-Not elder from the district beyond the city wall, white-bearded and leaning on a stick of bamboo. Every spring he leads a quiet vigil at the fence of the barrows, and the families who walk with him leave paper flowers on the kerbstones.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, slow and patient, an elder who speaks of the dead as though they were in the next room.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man whose only defence is the crowd that follows him
**Relationship Hook:** A white-bearded elder reading names aloud at a fence before rows of grass mounds.
personality: Core: never raises his voice; distrusts anyone who promises the caste rank; brings the youngest child to the front of the vigil
Quirk: reads the names in the same order every year

npcs.name: Yao Lifen
npcs.info:
A switchboard operator of the Royal Army's signals company, a neat young woman with her headset pushed back over a short bob, who can patch a call across five tiers in the time it takes to say a room number. She logs every call she connects, as her orders demand.

**Speaking Style:** Crisp and pleasant, an operator's 'connecting you now' that hides how much she heard.
**Combat Role:** none; a signals private who cuts a line instead of throwing a punch
**Relationship Hook:** A young operator plugging a patch cable into a switchboard where one line wears a red tag.
personality: Core: connects before the caller finishes; logs every call and nothing more; keeps a sweet in her cheek on night shifts
Quirk: listens one second too long

npcs.name: Yi Myong-suk
npcs.info:
A minder at the foreigners' hotel, a poised woman in a neat grey suit and a portrait pin who speaks three foreign languages and smiles in all of them. She meets guests at the door, takes their passports for safekeeping and accompanies them everywhere, from the model school to the revolving restaurant. Visitors find her charming and cannot remember a single thing she has told them.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, fluent and practised, a hostess's voice that steers every question back to the tour.
**Combat Role:** none; a smile, a whistle and a lobby full of colleagues
**Relationship Hook:** A poised woman in a grey suit rising from a lobby armchair with a smile, a stack of passports under her arm.
personality: Core: charming and unreadable; kind to guests in small ways that cost nothing; frightened of her own reports
Quirk: steers every conversation

npcs.name: Yo Man-sik
npcs.info:
The headman of a farming village near the border, a skinny old man with a wispy beard, a cloth cap and a medal from a war he will describe for an hour. He organises the anniversary festivals, hangs the bunting himself from a ladder too tall for him, and makes the speeches nobody listens to. The village loves him for the festivals.

**Speaking Style:** A cheerful, wheezing old voice that turns everything into an announcement for the square.
**Combat Role:** none; an old man with a ladder and a loud voice
**Relationship Hook:** A skinny old headman on a ladder too tall for him, stringing bunting across a village square.
personality: Core: loves a celebration; fiddles the village's numbers for its own good; proud of a medal nobody else remembers
Quirk: cheerful and long-winded

npcs.name: Yokotani
npcs.info:
The legal adviser of the Heil-Ly Family, a man with narrow eyes, a long thin nose and a smile that never leaves his face, his dark hair slicked back to the neck, in a grey suit and black tie with a large law book under his arm. He stands with his back straight, feet square and hands clasped behind him, speaks only when spoken to, and is unfailingly cordial.

**Speaking Style:** Polite, smiling and endlessly correct, a lawyer who recites your crimes to you as if serving tea.
**Combat Role:** a defensive Conjurer who turns the law into guards inside his boss's hideout
**Relationship Hook:** A smiling lawyer with a law book under his arm standing very straight beside a cabin door.
personality: Core: speaks only when spoken to; blind to his own hypocrisy; apologises profusely to comrades
Quirk: unfailingly cordial

npcs.name: Yom Bok-hui
npcs.info:
An old reed cutter who has worked the marsh for fifty years, a tiny, bent woman in a broad hat and wading trousers with a sickle on her belt and a back that cannot straighten. She knows which duckboards are rotten and which are only pretending, and she leads strangers across for the price of a meal.

**Speaking Style:** A creaky, merry old voice that tells you where to put your feet and laughs when you don't.
**Combat Role:** none; a sickle, and the ability to leave a pursuer up to his neck in black water
**Relationship Hook:** A tiny bent old woman with a bundle of reeds on her back hopping nimbly across rotten duckboards.
personality: Core: merry and tough; keeps everyone's secrets but enjoys knowing them; contemptuous of uniforms
Quirk: fond of anyone who falls in and laughs about it

npcs.name: Ysolde Karsk
npcs.info:
The widow who keeps the oldest guesthouse in the gate village, a small woman in an apron who has fed visitors since before the walkways were built. She remembers the boy who restored the ruins as a scruffy fifteen-year-old who paid for his room in advance.

**Speaking Style:** A warm, gravelly old voice with a sharp edge for anyone who says a word against the ruins.
**Combat Role:** none; an old woman with a broom and the whole village behind her
**Relationship Hook:** A small old woman in an apron lighting a paper lantern at the door of a guesthouse.
personality: Core: warm with guests; remembers everyone; suspicious of money
Quirk: fierce about the ruins

npcs.name: Ysolde Marchetti
npcs.info:
A licensed Hunter in her thirties changing trains at the junction, a tall woman in a sun-faded field coat with a steel seed case chained to her wrist and soil under her nails. She collects rare plants for herbaria and growers all over the Union, and she has missed her connection.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and amused, a Hunter who speaks of rare seeds with feeling and of people with polite disinterest.
**Combat Role:** a trained Manipulator who fights with what grows around her, vines and spores turned to snares
**Relationship Hook:** A tall Hunter in a sun-faded field coat sitting in a crowded station buffet with a steel case chained to her wrist.
personality: Core: indifferent to people; travels light and alone; keeps her permits vague
Quirk: passionate about plants

npcs.name: Yun Pyong-do
npcs.info:
The minister's driver, a broad, quiet man in a dark suit and white gloves who waits beside a black car on the ministry's steps with the engine running. Every evening at the same hour he drives the minister up the palace road, and every night he brings him back. He polishes the car while he waits and never reads the papers left on the seat.

**Speaking Style:** Few words, all of them polite and none of them useful; a driver who answers questions with the weather.
**Combat Role:** none; a good driver and a pistol in the glovebox he has never fired
**Relationship Hook:** A broad driver in white gloves polishing a black car at the foot of a columned ministry as the lamps come on.
personality: Core: polite, punctual and blank; keeps the car spotless; drinks alone on his nights off
Quirk: never looks in the mirror at his passengers

npcs.name: Yusuf Barak
npcs.info:
The mechanic of the generator yard, usually asleep on a fuel drum between breakdowns and awake the instant an engine misfires. Every generator in the row carries his patches, and he can tell them apart by their coughs.

**Speaking Style:** Relaxed and cheerful, yawning half his words, suddenly sharp the moment an engine coughs.
**Combat Role:** a mechanic who fights with a big wrench and a live cable, and knows which one hurts more
**Relationship Hook:** A mechanic snoring on a fuel drum among rumbling generators, one hand still on a wrench.
personality: Core: sleeps anywhere and wakes at a wrong note; eats with oily hands; promises a fix by dark and means it
Quirk: names the generators after singers

npcs.name: Yuzuriha
npcs.info:
The butler who works the fumarole gully, gathering crusts and water from the mineral pools in sealed jars for the estate's lower levels. He wears a gas mask pushed up on his forehead between vents and gloves that reach his elbows, and his suit smells faintly of sulphur however often it is cleaned.

**Speaking Style:** Deep and muffled, a man who usually speaks through a gas mask and makes jokes too dry for anyone to be sure they were jokes.
**Combat Role:** a butler's training in bad air; he fights where others choke and leaves them to it
**Relationship Hook:** A masked butler crouched by a steaming orange pool, lowering a glass jar on a wire.
personality: Core: careful with jars, careless with himself; keeps a notebook of every vent's moods; gets along with no one and minds no one
Quirk: jokes in a deadpan nobody can read

npcs.name: Zakuro Custard
npcs.info:
A Xi-Yu Family man high in Hinrigh's trust, a fair-haired youth with large oval eyes that droop at the corners and hair gathered in six curling bunches. He wears pale baggy trousers and a high-collared jacket with enormous sleeves that narrow at the wrist, and he always carries a drip stand with two bags of blood. He is very mild and likes music.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, mild and slightly vague, a gentle youth's voice that thanks people for things they should not be thanked for.
**Combat Role:** a Manipulator who fights with his own blood from an open wound
**Relationship Hook:** A gentle fair-haired youth wheeling a drip stand with two bags of blood down a clinic ward.
personality: Core: very mild-mannered; listens to music in his free time; slow to suspect a trick
Quirk: thanks people who wound him

npcs.name: Zebro
npcs.info:
A balding, middle-aged groundskeeper at the foot of Kukuroo Mountain who looks like a gate guard and is really the estate's cleaner. He opens the first door of the Testing Gate himself with real effort, lets visitors through the small side door if they insist, and clears up after the family's hound has eaten the intruders.

**Speaking Style:** A friendly, tired, middle-aged man's voice, slow and good-humoured, with a groan when he lifts something.
**Combat Role:** none he uses; real strength, and the estate's hound does the rest
**Relationship Hook:** A balding guard straining to push open a vast door while three visitors watch in disbelief.
personality: Core: accommodating and kind; unshockable after years of cleaning up; good friends with Seaquant
Quirk: proud of opening the gate and afraid of failing it

npcs.name: Zeho
npcs.info:
A big bald man with small eyes and thick lips, in a white tank top, dark trousers and flat shoes. He is the muscle on Hanse's team and says so, and he is first on his feet whenever a challenge is about strength.

**Speaking Style:** Big, slow and sure of himself, a strongman who volunteers before the question is finished.
**Combat Role:** an untrained Enhancer who grapples and pushes on muscle and a slow Ren
**Relationship Hook:** A bald strongman cracking his knuckles at the edge of a sumo ring circled by fire.
personality: Core: proud of his strength; no schemer; takes a beating without complaint
Quirk: volunteers first

npcs.name: Zenji
npcs.info:
A capo of the Mafia Community, stocky and bald with a moustache and a soul patch, small sunglasses, a black suit, a red shirt and a yellow tie. He despises Light Nostrade for rising fast on a girl's fortunes, punches him in front of witnesses and holds a grudge until it costs him something.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, sneering and quick to anger, a capo's growl that spits at upstarts.
**Combat Role:** none of his own; a capo who orders others to shoot
**Relationship Hook:** A bald capo in small sunglasses jabbing a finger at a rival across an auction hall.
personality: Core: pretentious and jealous; quick to anger; a coward when bloodlust is turned on him
Quirk: vindictive

npcs.name: Zenju
npcs.info:
A bald man with thick brows in a monk's robes, large prayer beads round his neck. He is a Hunter hired into the game with the latest batch, and he spends long hours sitting under the old oak where the forest's animals gather.

**Speaking Style:** Low and serene, a monk's voice that answers a question with a slower one.
**Combat Role:** a monk's Nen, calm and patient, waiting for an opening rather than making one
**Relationship Hook:** A bald monk sitting under a vast oak with deer and foxes curled about his feet.
personality: Core: watchful; unhurried; keeps to himself
Quirk: serene

npcs.name: Zeno Zoldyck
npcs.info:
Killua's grandfather, a short old man with a long drooping moustache, his hands clasped behind his hunched back, whose clothes carry the slogans one kill a day and never retire. He was head of the family before Silva and is still one of the finest Nen users alive. He is witty, pragmatic and talkative, and he says he has never killed anyone he was not paid to kill.

**Speaking Style:** A dry, chatty old man's voice that grumbles about money and work and drops to a level, deadly calm the instant he decides to fight.
**Combat Role:** an old master's aura shaped into dragons, swift strikes and perfect timing
**Relationship Hook:** A small old man with a long moustache walking calmly away from a room full of dead gangsters, complaining about his fee.
personality: Core: witty, chatty and pragmatic; calm in any crisis, and analytical; boasts, and is usually right
Quirk: kills only for pay and only what he is paid for

npcs.name: Zepile
npcs.info:
An antiques trader with short light-brown hair, long sideburns and a pair of thick, wavy eyebrows that do half his talking. He dresses loud, a red blazer trimmed in black over a white shirt with its big collar thrown open, and he haunts the Bull Market and the Preview Market with a loupe in his breast pocket. He will tell a stranger what a thing is worth for the pleasure of being right.

**Speaking Style:** A dealer's patter, warm and quick, that slows to a lecturer's care the moment a glaze or a grain of wood comes up.
**Combat Role:** no fighter at all; he talks, bargains and ducks, and wins a room by knowing more than it does
**Relationship Hook:** A man with enormous eyebrows holding a vase up to the light at a market stall, a loupe screwed into one eye.
personality: Core: takes a cut and calls it fair; ashamed of his old forgeries; panics when money runs short
Quirk: shows off what he knows

npcs.name: Zetsk Bellam
npcs.info:
A huge man with a heavy brow and a jaw like a figure from the stone age, in a sleeveless shirt with a ruffled collar. He plays alongside his brother Gashta and snickers at anyone else who speaks.

**Speaking Style:** Rough and snickering, a violent man who laughs at others and listens only to his brother.
**Combat Role:** a brute with keen senses who fights at his brother's side
**Relationship Hook:** A brow-heavy giant of a man snickering behind his brother as a cyclops lumbers into a narrow gully.
personality: Core: violent; trusts only his brother; keen-sensed
Quirk: snickers at others

npcs.name: Zhang Lei Hui Guo Rou
npcs.info:
The third prince of Kakin and only son of the third queen Tang Zhao Li, a short, bald, dark-skinned man who looks like a monk, with squarish eyes, bags beneath them, dark dots over the eyes, a pencil moustache and long earlobes. He is the patron of the Xi-Yu Family, the largest of Kakin's three Mafia houses. He is cautious and diplomatic and likes to be thought an intellectual.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, careful and measured, a diplomat's voice that asks more than it tells.
**Combat Role:** none shown; a prince who works through the Xi-Yu Family and his guard
**Relationship Hook:** A short bald prince with monk-like features steepling his fingers as he listens to a guard's report.
personality: Core: cautious and diplomatic; prides himself on his intellect; feels superior behind equal manners
Quirk: prefers information to action

npcs.name: Zhou Meihua
npcs.info:
The cook of the busiest broth counter on the row, a round, red-armed woman who ladles soup for soldiers on leave, office girls and dock hands with the same sharp tongue. Her broth has simmered in the same vat, topped up daily, since her mother ran the counter.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, laughing and motherly, a cook who scolds and feeds you in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** none; a ladle of boiling broth and a street that takes her side
**Relationship Hook:** A round-faced cook ladling broth under paper lanterns while soldiers eat on plastic stools.
personality: Core: scolds customers for eating too fast; never lets a dock hand pay full price; swears her broth has never gone cold
Quirk: repeats gossip, but chooses which

npcs.name: Zushi
npcs.info:
A small, brown-haired, heavy-browed boy in a karate gi over a black turtleneck who climbs the Heavens Arena under his master Wing. He is earnest, hardworking and formal, loyal to Wing and honest even when it means disagreeing with him, and he fights well above his weight.

**Speaking Style:** An earnest, formal, eager boy's voice that answers with crisp respect and gets very serious about training.
**Combat Role:** Shingen-ryu kung fu with a stance that leaves few openings, guarded by an aura he can hold in a fight
**Relationship Hook:** A small boy in a gi bowing deeply to his opponent before flooring a man four times his size.
personality: Core: earnest and hardworking; loyal and honest with his master; respectful and formal
Quirk: determined to catch up with those ahead

locations.name: 251st Floor Penthouse
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 22-26 · Danger: High]

The tower's top floor, where the Floor Masters fight the Battle Olympia every two years; the winner lives in the penthouse until the next one.

areas.name: Olympia Floor
areas.text: The tournament floor at the top of the tower.

areas.name: Penthouse Suite
areas.text: The winner's apartment above the clouds.

locations.name: 287th Hunter Exam Site Restaurant
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 1-10 · Danger: Low]

A small cheap restaurant, Meshidokoro Gohan, on Tsubashi Street, with a cook at the grill and a waitress who shows certain customers to the back room. The food is ordinary; the back room is not.

areas.name: Descending Room
areas.text: The back room with its table and steak, which slowly sinks.

areas.name: Restaurant Counter
areas.text: The counter and grill where the password is given as an order.

locations.name: Afterlife Companions' Barrows
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 22-30 · Danger: Severe]

A field of old grass mounds outside the city walls, the burial ground of princes who never became king. A fenced processional way runs between the mounds to a sealed tomb at the far end.

areas.name: Barrows Processional Way
areas.text: A paved way between the mounds, its kerbstones carved with faded names.

areas.name: Barrows Sealed Tomb
areas.text: A stone tomb at the end of the way, its door sealed with the dynasty's mark.

locations.name: Aguilor
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 14-22 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

A busy cafe in Doli City whose waitresses wear pink maid dresses. It serves meals, sweets and drinks, and the booths are good for talking quietly.

areas.name: Window Booth
areas.text: The booth by the window looking onto the street.

locations.name: Aiai
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 14-24 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The city of love, whose streets play out the scenes of a dating game, with a pink heart floating in the sky. Every corner has a girl who trips, a stranger who needs saving or a chance meeting.

areas.name: Heart Plaza
areas.text: The plaza under the floating heart.

locations.name: Aiai Schoolgate Lane
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 14-20 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

A lane in Aiai that runs down to a school gate under cherry trees. Every morning a girl comes running round the corner with toast in her mouth and crashes into whoever stands there.

areas.name: Schoolgate Cherry Row
areas.text: The cherry trees along the lane, petals on the pavement.

areas.name: Schoolgate Corner
areas.text: The blind corner where the collisions happen.

locations.name: Alliance Base
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 14-26 · Danger: High]

A fortified house near Masadora used as a base by a large alliance of players.

areas.name: Alliance War Room
areas.text: The room with the map and the card books.

locations.name: Alliance Gathering Cave
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 14-22 · Danger: High]

A cave in the hills that a large alliance of players uses as its hideout and strongroom. Members come and go by spell rather than on foot, so few outsiders have ever found the mouth.

areas.name: Gathering Cave Entrance
areas.text: A narrow mouth behind a curtain of brush, with a guard sitting on a crate.

areas.name: Gathering Cave Tally Wall
areas.text: The rock wall where the alliance chalks up its specified cards by number.

locations.name: Amori Ravine
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 6-12 · Danger: Moderate]

A rocky ravine on Zevil Island where the forest opens out, the sort of place three people can trap a fourth.

areas.name: Ravine Floor
areas.text: The bottom of the ravine, narrow and hard to leave quickly.

areas.name: Ravine Rim
areas.text: The rim above it, from where a thrown badge can fly a long way.

locations.name: Antokiba
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 12-22 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The town of prizes, the nearest town to the Greed Island Starting Point and the first most new players find. Reward posters cover its walls, and on the fifteenth of every month a contest gives its winner a rare card.

areas.name: Contest Stage
areas.text: The stage in the square where the monthly contest is held.

areas.name: Poster Wall
areas.text: The wall of reward posters for lost dogs, odd jobs and rare items.

locations.name: Antokiba Fish Market
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 12-16 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

A covered market at the edge of Antokiba where townsfolk sell the island's catch. Its prize is the Galgaida, a fish said to be good boiled or grilled, whose roe is believed to give long life.

areas.name: Fish Market Roe Stall
areas.text: A stall at the back selling roe in little glass jars.

areas.name: Fish Market Slabs
areas.text: Long marble slabs heaped with ice and the morning's catch.

locations.name: Antokiba Meeting Hall
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 12-20 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

A rented hall off Antokiba's main street where an alliance of players holds its meetings, recruits newcomers and argues about who holds which card.

areas.name: Meeting Hall Floor
areas.text: Rows of folding chairs facing a raised floor and a board covered in numbers.

areas.name: Meeting Hall Side Office
areas.text: A cramped office where trades are written up and signed.

locations.name: Antokiba Prize Inn
locations.info:
[Safe Haven · Recommended Level: 12-16 · No hostile spawns · Downtime protected]

An inn by Antokiba's square where players who have just come off the plain take their first bed. The landlady greets every guest in exactly the same words and takes payment only in cards.

areas.name: Prize Inn Back Room
areas.text: A small room with one table and a door that locks from the inside.

areas.name: Prize Inn Common Room
areas.text: A low room of trestle tables, with the month's contest poster above the hearth.

locations.name: Ape Hollow
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 3-10 · Danger: Low]

A sunken hollow deep in the Milsy Wetlands where the ground is drier and the trees grow close. The fog sits in it like water in a bowl, and anyone lost in the marsh seems to end up here.

areas.name: Ape Hollow Bone Bed
areas.text: The floor of the hollow, matted with bones and old clothes.

areas.name: Ape Hollow Lookout Tree
areas.text: A dead tree on the rim of the hollow, scratched by long nails.

locations.name: Arena 200th Floor
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-24 · Danger: High]

The 200th floor and those above it, where there is no prize money, only fame, and every weapon is allowed. A fighter has ninety days to prepare for each bout, is out after four losses and may challenge a Floor Master after ten wins. The fighters here are different, and those below call it a fighter's trick.

areas.name: 200th Floor Corridor
areas.text: The long corridor from the lift, where something pushes against a newcomer like a wind.

areas.name: 200th Floor Registration
areas.text: The desk where fighters register within a deadline or lose the floor.

areas.name: Big Ring
areas.text: The great arena of the upper floors, filled for every bout.

locations.name: Arena Administration Floor
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 6-20 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The floor where the arena's administration runs the building: who fights whom, which bouts are televised, which fighter's room is cleaned and which fighter's registration lapses at midnight. Nothing in the tower happens without a form from here.

areas.name: Administration Executive Suite
areas.text: A quiet suite at the end of the floor with a view of the airship lanes.

areas.name: Administration Matchmaking Office
areas.text: Desks, phones and a wall chart of the week's bouts in coloured pins.

areas.name: Administration Records Room
areas.text: Ceiling-high cabinets of every fighter who ever registered.

locations.name: Arena Airship Port
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 4-10 · Danger: Low]

The field outside the town where passenger airships moor, close enough to the tower that arriving visitors crowd the windows to look up. A shuttle bus runs to the plaza every few minutes.

areas.name: Airship Port Mooring Field
areas.text: Tall masts and the long shadows of the airships at rest.

areas.name: Airship Port Shuttle Stop
areas.text: A covered stop where buses leave for the arena plaza.

areas.name: Airship Port Terminal
areas.text: The glass terminal with arrivals boards and a tower-shaped clock.

locations.name: Arena Clinic
locations.info:
[Safe Haven · Recommended Level: 4-20 · No hostile spawns · Downtime protected]

The clinic in the tower where injured fighters are patched up. The doctors have stopped asking how injuries from the upper floors were caused.

areas.name: Clinic Ward
areas.text: The ward of white beds.

locations.name: Arena Coach Terminal
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-8 · Danger: Low · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The bus terminal on the edge of town where the long-distance coaches from the far side of the continent come in. It is the cheapest way to reach the tower and it shows.

areas.name: Arena Coach Bays
areas.text: Numbered bays of diesel fumes and slamming luggage doors.

areas.name: Coach Terminal Waiting Room
areas.text: A waiting room with a broken television showing fights.

locations.name: Arena Commentary Booth
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 8-22 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The glass booth above the upper floors' big ring, where the arena's announcer calls each bout for the crowd and the cameras. From here every punch sounds twice as hard as it was.

areas.name: Commentary Booth Desk
areas.text: The desk of microphones, monitors and a cooling cup of coffee.

areas.name: Commentary Booth Gantry
areas.text: A narrow camera gantry running from the booth out over the ring.

locations.name: Arena Concourse
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-14 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The floors of restaurants, shops and betting windows that serve the arena's spectators, open as long as the fights go on.

areas.name: Betting Windows
areas.text: The windows where the spectators place their bets.

areas.name: Tower Food Court
areas.text: The food court on the concourse.

locations.name: Arena Hundredth Floors
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 6-18 · Danger: Moderate]

The floors from the hundredth to the hundred and ninety-ninth, where a fighter earns a private room and the prize money grows with every floor. No weapons are allowed below the 200th floor.

areas.name: Hundred Floor Ring
areas.text: A large ring with television cameras.

areas.name: Private Rooms
areas.text: The rows of private rooms where fighters live while they climb.

locations.name: Arena Judges' Gallery
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-18 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

Raised seats at the corner of each big ring, where men in grey blazers lift paddles and the crowd boos whichever way they go. Ten points end a fight as surely as a knockout, so the paddles matter as much as the fists.

areas.name: Judges' Gallery Review Room
areas.text: A small room with a tape deck where disputed fights are watched again.

areas.name: Judges' Gallery Scoring Bench
areas.text: The bench of paddles and score sheets right above the ring.

locations.name: Arena Lift Bank
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-14 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The bank of lifts behind the ground floor rings that carries fighters up the tower the moment they win. A uniformed attendant rides every car, calls the floors and recites the ten-floor rule to newcomers whether they listen or not.

areas.name: Lift Bank Express Car
areas.text: The one car that runs straight past the hundreds, wood-panelled and silent.

areas.name: Lift Bank Lobby
areas.text: A marble lobby of numbered doors where fighters queue in their sweat.

locations.name: Arena Lower Floors
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 4-12 · Danger: Moderate]

The floors from the first to the ninety-ninth, where a fighter climbs ten floors for a win and drops ten for a loss, fights with bare hands only, and is paid a little for every floor gained. A fight ends at a knockout or at ten points from the judges.

areas.name: Fifty Floor Ring
areas.text: A ring halfway up the lower floors, ringed by cheap seats.

areas.name: Fighters' Benches
areas.text: The benches where fighters wait to be called.

locations.name: Arena Prize Office
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-18 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

Where fighters below the 200th floor collect what each win pays. A winner shows the slip the referee signed, the clerk stamps it and slides an envelope through the slot; the envelopes get fatter the higher the floor printed on the slip.

areas.name: Prize Office Bench
areas.text: A bench in the corridor outside, where nobody sits for long unless they are waiting for someone.

areas.name: Prize Office Counter
areas.text: The glassed counter with its slot, its stamp and its queue of bruised winners.

locations.name: Arena Security Office
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 6-16 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The control room of the tower's guards, with screens for the lifts, the rings and the plaza. They throw out drunks, confiscate the weapons people try to carry below the 200th floor and file every fight that spills out of a ring.

areas.name: Security Office Confiscation Cage
areas.text: A wire cage of knives, knuckledusters and a sword with a tag on it.

areas.name: Security Office Holding Room
areas.text: A bare room with a bench, a table and a locked door.

areas.name: Security Office Monitor Wall
areas.text: A wall of small grey screens and a desk of switches.

locations.name: Arena Service Levels
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-12 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The basement and half-floors where the tower's staff wash the towels, cook for the restaurants, fix the lifts and keep the rings mopped. The stairs here are for staff only, which is why fighters avoiding someone use them.

areas.name: Service Levels Back Stairs
areas.text: A concrete stairwell that runs the height of the tower, floor numbers stencilled in red.

areas.name: Service Levels Kitchens
areas.text: Steel kitchens sending food up a dumb waiter to the restaurants.

areas.name: Service Levels Laundry
areas.text: Rows of industrial washers and a fog of hot soap.

locations.name: Arena Souvenir Arcade
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-8 · Danger: Low · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

A ring of shops on a lower floor selling the tower back to its visitors: models of the building, headbands printed with a fighter's name, signed photographs of whoever won big that month.

areas.name: Souvenir Arcade Model Shop
areas.text: Glass cases of tower models, from key-ring size to taller than a child.

areas.name: Souvenir Arcade Photo Booth
areas.text: A booth where a visitor poses in front of a painted tower.

locations.name: Arena Ticket Hall
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-10 · Danger: Low · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The hall beside the fighters' entrance where spectators buy their seats. Cheap tickets cover a day on the lower floors with dozens of rings at once; a seat at the big ring for an upper-floor bout sells out within an hour of the posting.

areas.name: Ticket Hall Tout Steps
areas.text: The steps outside where men in caps murmur seat numbers at passers-by.

areas.name: Ticket Hall Windows
areas.text: Forty glass windows under a board of the day's bouts.

locations.name: Arena Town
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-14 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The town at the tower's feet, full of hotels for spectators, gyms for fighters and street food for both. Every wall carries a fight poster.

areas.name: Gym Row
areas.text: The street of gyms and training halls.

areas.name: Poster Street
areas.text: The street of hotels and fight posters.

locations.name: Arena Waiting Hall
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 4-12 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

A long hall on the lower floors where fighters sit until their names are called for another bout that same day. The speaker garbles every name, so everyone listens hard and pretends not to.

areas.name: Waiting Hall Seats
areas.text: Bolted rows of seats facing a board of match numbers.

areas.name: Waiting Hall Warm-up Strip
areas.text: A strip of rubber matting at the back where fighters shadowbox.

locations.name: Arena Weekly Offices
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 4-10 · Danger: Low]

The offices of the town's fight paper, a weekly that prints results, interviews and gossip from the tower. Its reporters have press passes to every floor below the 200th and theories about every floor above it.

areas.name: Arena Weekly Darkroom
areas.text: A red-lit darkroom with negatives hanging to dry.

areas.name: Arena Weekly Newsroom
areas.text: Desks jammed together, typewriters and a fax that never stops.

locations.name: Assembly Hall
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-30 · Danger: Severe]

The hall where the elders of Meteor City sit as the Assembly that governs it. Their decisions often make no sense to outsiders and are obeyed anyway.

areas.name: Elders' Circle
areas.text: The circle of seats where the elders deliberate.

locations.name: Association Airship Field
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 2-10 · Danger: Low]

An airfield on the edge of Swardani City where the Association's airships are moored, fuelled and repaired. Hunters on urgent work fly from here, and the exam's own airship takes on supplies here each winter.

areas.name: Airfield Control Tower
areas.text: The glass tower over the field, with radar and radio.

areas.name: Airship Hangar
areas.text: A huge hangar where a ship is being refitted.

areas.name: Airship Mooring Masts
areas.text: The tall masts where the airships ride at anchor.

locations.name: Azian Frontier Highlands
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 26-36 · Danger: Deadly]

The high country where Kakin's interior meets the rest of the Azian Continent: passes, plateaus and a few roads that close for half the year. Army posts guard the passes, and the traders who cross them carry their goods on animals.

areas.name: Highlands Border Post
areas.text: A concrete army post at the top of the pass, its barrier pole painted in royal colours.

areas.name: Highlands Caravan Camp
areas.text: A plateau where yak trains rest, with stone pens and a trader's tea tent.

locations.name: Azian Quarter Night Market
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 10-18 · Danger: Moderate · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

When the shops of the Azian quarter close, their owners roll out stalls into the street, and the night market runs until dawn: noodles, dumplings, herbs, silk, secondhand radios. Immigrants from across the eastern sea keep its stalls and its customs.

areas.name: Night Market Herb Alley
areas.text: A narrow alley of herb sellers and jars of dried roots.

areas.name: Night Market Noodle Row
areas.text: A row of noodle stalls and folding tables under strings of lanterns.

locations.name: Badlands Deserted Camps
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-18 · Danger: Moderate]

Empty camps among the badlands' pillars, collapsed tents and cold fire pits left by players who moved on or never came back. Names are carved into a post at the centre.

areas.name: Deserted Camps Name Post
areas.text: A post carved with names and dates.

areas.name: Deserted Camps Tent Row
areas.text: A row of collapsed tents in long grass.

locations.name: Badlands Edge Waystation
locations.info:
[Safe Haven · Recommended Level: 14-20 · No hostile spawns · Downtime protected]

A single stone hut where the road from Antokiba reaches the badlands, with a trough, a bench and a signpost scored by claws. The old man who keeps it sells water and advice in equal measure.

areas.name: Waystation Signpost
areas.text: The signpost at the fork, its arms scored by claw marks.

areas.name: Waystation Trough
areas.text: A stone trough in front of the hut, fed by a spring.

locations.name: Badlands Vacant Town
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-20 · Danger: High]

A small town in the badlands with streets, shops and houses and nobody in them. Doors stand open and signs swing in the wind; no one answers a knock.

areas.name: Vacant Town Main Street
areas.text: The empty main street with its shops.

areas.name: Vacant Town Upper Window
areas.text: A house where a light sometimes burns upstairs.

locations.name: Balloon Crash Site
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 16-30 · Danger: Severe]

A stretch of desert where the wreck of a hot-air balloon lies among burnt-out cars and rocks pocked with bullets.

areas.name: Balloon Wreck
areas.text: The torn envelope and basket of the balloon.

areas.name: Burnt Cars
areas.text: A line of burnt-out cars.

locations.name: Bandits' Forest
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-24 · Danger: High]

The forest between Antokiba and the badlands, on the way to Masadora, where ragged bandits stop travellers and beg for money and clothes.

areas.name: Forest Road
areas.text: The road through the trees where the bandits come out.

locations.name: Banquet Hall
locations.info:
[Recommended Level: 28-40 · Danger: Deadly]

The banquet hall on Tier 1 between the king's quarters and the princes', with a throne platform, a stage and a restaurant.

areas.name: Banquet Stage
areas.text: The stage for the performers.

areas.name: Throne Platform
areas.text: The king's raised throne in the hall.

locations.name: Barrowgate Market
locations.info:
[Town Core · Recommended Level: 20-26 · Danger: High · No major hostile encounters within the settlement itself; surrounding ground remains dangerous]

The biggest market in the country, held under the walls of an old stone barn. Coin changes hands, but so do eggs for nails and cloth for honey, and the market reeve with his weighing beam settles every quarrel.

areas.name: Barrowgate Barn Loft
areas.text: The loft of the old barn, where sellers who come from far sleep among the sacks.

areas.name: Barrowgate Trestle Rows
areas.text: Rows of trestle tables in the mud, each with its seller and its basket.

areas.name: Barrowgate Weighing Beam
