items.info: Free card No. 585, rank C, limit 50 copies. A slippery horse that throws out bubbles when chased: white ones burst on aura, red ones on everything else. Found, never sold: Greed Island Hills.

items.name: Bullet
items.info: Spell card No. 1029, rank E, limit 120 copies. Smashes one random card in the target's specified slots. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Bulletproof Vest
items.info: A vest of layered fibre plates under a dark cover, worn under a jacket by Mafia guards and royal guardsmen. It stops a pistol round and does little against a fighter's aura. 200000 Jenny, sold at Yorknew City.

items.name: Bundle of Pail
items.info: A wad of the paper money used inside an illegal underground clinic in East Gorteau; five hundred of its notes make one Jenny. Nowhere else takes it. 2000 Jenny, sold at Underground Clinic.

items.name: Camp Hand's Ladle
items.info: A dented ladle from the crew's cooking pot.

items.name: Camping Tent
items.info: A light two-person tent that pitches in minutes, with a waterproof floor. It is made for the hikers of the mountain forests. 18000 Jenny, sold at Dentora Region.

items.name: Candidate Badge Tray
items.info: A tray of numbered tracking badges for a phase's candidates.

items.name: Canned Soda
items.info: A cold can of fizzy drink from the machines in Heavens Arena's halls. A can costs about what a boy's pocket money stretches to. 150 Jenny, sold at Arena Concourse.

items.name: Capo's Family Pin
items.info: A lapel pin that tells other made men which family you serve.

items.name: Capricious Remote
items.info: Specified card No. 028, rank B, limit 27 copies. A remote control with ten dials, one for each feeling one person has for another, from one to ten. It cannot touch how anyone feels about the owner. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Captain's Basement Key
items.info: A key to the castle basement where the consoles wait in rows.

items.name: Captain's Boxing Glove
items.info: A heavy boxing glove, split at the seam.

items.name: Captain's Campaign Badge
items.info: A badge from an election campaign, heavy enamel on brass.

items.name: Captain's Factory Key
items.info: A key taken from a factory in NGL.

items.name: Captain's Target List
items.info: A short list of names, one per prince, in the captain's hand.

items.name: Cartel Lord's Down Coat
items.info: A long down coat with a hood that hides the face.

items.name: Celadon Porcelain Vase
items.info: A stout pale-green porcelain vase of the Lai Dynasty, the last of its kind still whole. The Mafia's auction put it up for sale, and bidding climbed fast. Found, never sold: Cemetery Building.

items.name: Chair's Gavel
items.info: A gavel of island hardwood used to open the Union council.

items.name: Chairman's Hand Prayer Beads
items.info: A string of worn prayer beads from an old man's hand.

items.name: Challenger's Notice
items.info: A formal notice of challenge stamped by the arena office.

items.name: Chameleon Cat
items.info: Specified card No. 035, rank S, limit 6 copies. A rare cat that, once tamed, takes the shape of any animal while keeping its own weight, which makes for a very small elephant or a very large hamster. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Chief Examiner's Gavel
items.info: A worn wooden gavel used to close the final phase.

items.name: Chief of Wolf Pack
items.info: Free card No. 598, rank C, limit 45 copies. The leader of a wolf pack that preys on travellers, the strongest monster of its rank. Its wolves keep coming back until it falls. Found, never sold: Greed Island Hills.

items.name: Chosen's Name Card
items.info: A card with a name the Royal Guards gave, written in careful letters.

items.name: Church Keeper's Candle
items.info: A tallow candle from a church for the city's dead.

items.name: Claimant's Armband
items.info: A white armband stitched with a crude shield.

items.name: Clairvoyance
items.info: Spell card No. 1015, rank D, limit 70 copies. Shows every card a target player holds, specified and free alike. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Clairvoyant Snake
items.info: Specified card No. 096, rank A, limit 12 copies. Feed this snake any card of rank C or better and it coughs up a Clairvoyance. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Clean Leaf
items.info: A smoking herb Basho swears by. It is gentler than most drugs and has helped heavy smokers give up; using or growing it needs a licence, which Basho holds, and the recipe is on his home page. Found, never sold: Princes' Residential District.

items.name: Clerk's Rubber Stamp
items.info: A rubber stamp with the Union's five-pointed seal.

items.name: Climbing Rope and Harness
items.info: A coil of rope, a harness and a rack of clips. Visitors to the great tree hire guides and buy gear like this before the climb, and a rescue helicopter waits for the ones who overreach. 12000 Jenny, sold at World Tree.

items.name: Cling
items.info: Spell card No. 1033, rank C, limit 50 copies. Keeps one player's specified slots open to the caster's eyes for as long as that player stays in the game. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Clone
items.info: Spell card No. 1011, rank D, limit 70 copies. Becomes a copy of one card picked at random from the target's specified slots, and fails if the target has none or that card's limit is reached. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Club "You Rule"
items.info: Specified card No. 062, rank B, limit 20 copies. A club where everyone does as the owner says for as long as the owner stays. Time runs strangely there: each hour inside is a day outside. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Collision
items.info: Spell card No. 1017, rank F, limit 200 copies. Flies the caster to some player not yet met, chosen at random; with everyone already met, the card is wasted. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Combat Knife
items.info: A plain soldier's knife with a heavy spine and a rubber grip, the kind a professional killer draws when he wants a fight to be close and quiet. 7000 Jenny, sold at Dentora Region.

items.name: Commander's Field Glasses
items.info: Heavy binoculars scratched by sand.
items.where: Field Commander, Dark Continent Expedition Team

items.name: Companion's Burial Cord
items.info: A cord of the kind once tied around a companion's wrist at a burial.

items.name: Compromise
items.info: Spell card No. 1023, rank B, limit 25 copies. Destroys one of the target's cards of rank A or better and lets the target pick a card three ranks lower in its place. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Concealed Arm Blade
items.info: A short blade in a sheath strapped along the forearm, hidden under the sleeve until it is drawn.

items.name: Connection Severing Scissors
items.info: Specified card No. 014, rank B, limit 22 copies. Cut a photograph of someone with these scissors and you never cross paths with them again. Everyone in the photograph is cut away with them, so choose it with care. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Contact
items.info: Spell card No. 1040, rank F, limit 200 copies. Opens a three-minute talk through the binders with a player met before; only the caller can end it early. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Contender's Win Book
items.info: A small booklet of matches won and lost on the upper floors.

items.name: Contract Killer's Garotte
items.info: A thin wire with two wooden handles.

items.name: Convener's Whistle
items.info: A whistle used to call the alliance together.

items.name: Corporal's Helmet
items.info: A black round combat helmet, the corporal's headgear.

items.name: Corruption
items.info: Spell card No. 1022, rank C, limit 40 copies. Degrades one of the target's cards of rank B or better into a card of rank D or worse, of a number the caster picks. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Council Roll
items.info: A typed list of the twelve seats and the names that sit in them.

items.name: Councillor's Treaty Copy
items.info: A bound copy of the Union's founding treaty.

items.name: Courier's Leather Satchel
items.info: A satchel with a false bottom, made to pass a strip search.

items.name: Courier's Sealed Envelope
items.info: A thick envelope with no name on it, never opened by the one who carries it.

items.name: Curved Fighting Knife
items.info: A short knife with a hooked blade that catches flesh on the pull. Togari fought with four of them at once in the Trick Tower, which did him no good against Hisoka. 9000 Jenny, sold at Junk Market.

items.name: Dark Business Suit
items.info: A black two-piece suit with a white shirt and a thin tie, the uniform of every Mafia family's men and every rich man's guards. Sunglasses usually come with it. 80000 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Deck Boss's Price List
items.info: A list of what everything costs on the bottom tier this week.

items.name: Deck of Playing Cards
items.info: An ordinary deck of fifty-two cards and two jokers. Thrown well they sting; thrown with aura laid over them, as Hisoka throws them, they cut like steel and stick in walls. 500 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Deck of Throwing Cards
items.info: A deck of stiff playing cards, the edges filed smooth, and a second deck for when the first is spent.

items.name: Defensive Wall
items.info: Spell card No. 1003, rank G, limit 400 copies. Stops one attack spell cast at its holder, then is spent. The cheapest shield a player can keep in the binder. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Delivery Drone Order
items.info: A paid order to the long-range drones that fly luxury goods out to the ship from anywhere in the known world. Only the first tier's shops and residents may use them. 50000 Jenny, sold at Tier 1.

items.name: Deputy Chief's Bookend
items.info: A heavy bookend from an office lined with law books.
items.where: Deputy Chief Prosecutor, Ministry of Justice

items.name: Deputy Secretary's Coordination Order
items.info: An order placing every voyage agency under one office.

items.name: Director's Security Badge
items.info: A badge for the agencies' restricted floors.

items.name: Disciple's Breathing Scroll
items.info: A short scroll of breathing counts, copied in a student's hand.

items.name: Disciple's Practice Gi
items.info: A plain white practice uniform with the school's knot at the waist, washed thin.

items.name: Dispel
items.info: Spell card No. 1024, rank D, limit 80 copies. Strips every disguise made by Fake, Clone or Mimic from a target's binder, and any card left in the wrong slot is destroyed. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Division Officer's Rifle Strap
items.info: A strap from a soldier's rifle, taken as a trophy.

items.name: Doctor's Bag
items.info: A black leather bag holding a stethoscope, a suture kit, scalpels and a small pharmacy. A medical student carries one long before he is allowed to use it. 80000 Jenny, sold at Swardani City.

items.name: Don's Auction Paddle
items.info: A numbered paddle reserved for the Dons at the Underground Auction.

items.name: Double Postcard to the Dead
items.info: Specified card No. 031, rank S, limit 13 copies. A book of a thousand prepaid reply cards. Address one to someone who has died, post it, and an answer arrives the next day. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Double-Star Pin
items.info: A pin with two stars, given to a Hunter who holds a post and has raised a starred junior.

items.name: Doyen's Growth Pills
items.info: Specified card No. 067, rank B, limit 30 copies. A hundred pills, each adding a centimetre of height. Not meant for anyone under twenty. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Doyen's Hair Restorer
items.info: Specified card No. 069, rank B, limit 30 copies. A tonic that grows thick hair wherever it touches, enough in one bottle for ten heads. Wear gloves, or the palms grow it too. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Doyen's Virility Pills
items.info: Specified card No. 068, rank A, limit 20 copies. A vial of five hundred pills for a man's vigour in bed, both its staying power and how often. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Dracoderma Skin
items.info: A preserved hide from someone who had the disease that turns skin to a lizard's scales. Melody fetched it and was hired. Found, never sold: Nostrade's Mansion.

items.name: Drawbridge
items.info: Spell card No. 1019, rank F, limit 200 copies. Blocks one short-range spell from another player. Drawn at random from a shop pack. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Drift
items.info: Spell card No. 1016, rank F, limit 200 copies. Carries the caster off to a town not yet visited, chosen at random; with every town seen, nothing happens and the card is lost. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Drugged Arrows
items.info: A bundle of arrows whose heads are smeared with a sleeping drug, made to drop a target without killing it. 4000 Jenny, sold at Nancha City.

items.name: Dump Walker's Hook
items.info: A long iron hook for turning over rubbish heaps.

items.name: D²
items.info: A narcotic with an evil name in every nation, the newest drug on the market. Where it comes from, its buyers do not ask. Found, never sold: a dealer's pocket.

items.name: Elder's Gas Mask
items.info: A sealed protective mask passed down among the city's elders.

items.name: Elder's Hand-Bound Book
items.info: A book of the movement's teachings, bound with thread.

items.name: Elder's Pirate Tally
items.info: A tally of the pirates' contests won and lost.

items.name: Eliminate
items.info: A black-bordered card no player can hold. It throws out of the game any intruder who got in without playing by the game's rules. Found, never sold: the game's own masters.

items.name: Elite Killer's Knife
items.info: A plain fighting knife, kept very sharp.

items.name: Enforcer's Brass Knuckles
items.info: Knuckles of brass worn smooth by use.

items.name: Envoy's Passport Wallet
items.info: A leather wallet holding five countries' visas.

items.name: Envoy's Treaty Pin
items.info: A pin shaped like a closed gate, worn by treaty envoys.

items.name: Estate Slippers
items.info: Slippers of the estate, each heavy enough to train the legs on every step.

items.name: Eternal Hammer
items.info: Specified card No. 088, rank A, limit 15 copies. A hammer that lands a random attack spell on whoever it hits, with no defensive spell able to stop it. Fortress and the Paladin's Necklace still hold against it. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Examiner's Score Sheet
items.info: A folded sheet of marks no candidate is ever shown.

items.name: Eye of God
items.info: Spell card No. 1036, rank S, limit 10 copies. The caster gains the effects of List and Analysis on every card from No. 001 to No. 099 until the caster leaves the game. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Fairy King's Advice
items.info: Specified card No. 016, rank S, limit 6 copies. The fairy king tells the owner, kindly and to the point, what they lack and what they ought to mend. He turns up only when it suits him. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Fake
items.info: Spell card No. 1020, rank C, limit 40 copies. Turns itself into any specified card from No. 001 to No. 099. The copy sits in a slot and fools a glance, but it counts for nothing toward the set and can never become a real object; a swindler's card. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Faker's Abacus
items.info: An old wooden abacus used by the family's boss.

items.name: Faker's Lipstick Case
items.info: A gold lipstick case with a mirror inside.

items.name: Faker's Tea Bowl
items.info: A fine porcelain tea bowl used for the boss's meetings.

items.name: Family Assassin's Transmitter
items.info: A small transmitter the family uses on its jobs.

items.name: Favor Cushion
items.info: Specified card No. 030, rank B, limit 21 copies. Whoever sits on this cushion does the owner one favour, so long as it is within their power. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Favourite's Scale
items.info: A shining scale from the queen's own body.

items.name: Fickle Genie
items.info: Specified card No. 015, rank S, limit 10 copies. A genie who grants three wishes, picked by him from a list of a thousand truly different ones that the owner must write first. Asking for money a thousand ways does not count. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Field Hunter's Smoke Pipe
items.info: A long pipe, its bowl still warm.

items.name: Fighter's Hand Wraps
items.info: Long cloth wraps wound around the knuckles and wrists, stiff with old sweat.

items.name: Fighting Staff of Oak
items.info: A long oak staff, iron-shod at both ends.

items.name: First Beast's Feather
items.info: A grey owl feather, carried as a mark of rank.

items.name: First Guard's Cat Bell
items.info: A small bell, the kind hung on a cat's collar.

items.name: First-Aid Kit
items.info: A tin box of gauze, tape, antiseptic, scissors and a few pain tablets. It holds a bad wound together until a doctor takes over. 3000 Jenny, sold at Swardani City.

items.name: Flashlight
items.info: A heavy metal flashlight on batteries. In a tunnel, a ruin or the lower decks of a ship it is the difference between walking and groping. 1500 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Fledgling Actor
items.info: Specified card No. 044, rank B, limit 30 copies. A magic egg that makes a star of the stage and screen of the one whose hands warm it to hatching. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Fledgling Artist
items.info: Specified card No. 038, rank B, limit 30 copies. A magic egg that makes a great artist of whoever keeps it warm in their palms for long enough, from one year to ten. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Fledgling Athlete
items.info: Specified card No. 037, rank B, limit 30 copies. A magic egg to be warmed in the hands three hours a day for one to ten years. When it hatches its keeper becomes a champion athlete, and the hotter the wish, the sooner it hatches. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Fledgling CEO
items.info: Specified card No. 045, rank B, limit 30 copies. A magic egg that hatches into a head for business; its keeper ends up running a great company. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Fledgling Gambler
items.info: Specified card No. 043, rank B, limit 30 copies. A magic egg that hatches into a gambler's genius. The casino city's king of the tables gives it to anyone who beats him. Found, never sold: Dorias.

items.name: Fledgling Musician
items.info: Specified card No. 040, rank B, limit 30 copies. A magic egg that, warmed by hand every day until it hatches, leaves its keeper a master musician. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Fledgling Novelist
items.info: Specified card No. 042, rank B, limit 30 copies. A magic egg that turns its patient keeper into a fine writer when it finally cracks open. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Fledgling Pilot
items.info: Specified card No. 041, rank B, limit 30 copies. A magic egg that makes a first-rate pilot of whoever hatches it with their own warmth. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Fledgling Politician
items.info: Specified card No. 039, rank B, limit 30 copies. A magic egg that hatches, after years of patient warming, into a renowned political career for the one who held it. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Flip Phone
items.info: A cheap folding mobile phone with a stubby aerial. It calls and texts and does little else, and nobody minds losing it. 20000 Jenny, sold at Yorknew City.

items.name: Floor Master's Key
items.info: A key card that opens one whole floor of the tower.

items.name: Fluoroscopy
items.info: Spell card No. 1002, rank F, limit 150 copies. Lays open the specified slots of a player the caster has met, card by card. Drawn at random from a shop pack. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Folding Paper Fan
items.info: A painted paper fan with bamboo ribs, pretty and harmless in most hands. Kalluto's fan is the medium of his Nen, and paper becomes a blade when aura runs through it. 2000 Jenny, sold at Kakin Empire.

items.name: Foreman's Factory Pass
items.info: A plastic pass for a factory that NGL says does not exist.

items.name: Fortress
items.info: Spell card No. 1035, rank S, limit 10 copies. Seals one page of specified slots against every stealing and destroying spell for good, so long as the cards stay in their slots. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Fossilized Deodorosaurus Dropping
items.info: A lump of fossil dung from a long-dead dinosaur, polished and mounted. It was the first lot of the Southernpiece Auction, and someone paid for it. Found, never sold: Southernpiece Auction House.

items.name: Founder's Share Contract
items.info: A private contract setting out the founders' cut.

items.name: Fresh Whale Island Fish
items.info: A fish landed that morning off the island, still bright in the eye. The market's stalls clean and wrap it for the pot. 600 Jenny, sold at Whale Island Fish Market.

items.name: Galgaida
items.info: Free card No. 1217, rank F, limit 185 copies. A fish that tastes wonderful boiled or grilled. The restaurant hands one over to anyone who clears a whole plate of its spaghetti. Found, never sold: Caveau de Riquewihr.

items.name: Game Master's Badge
items.info: A small badge with one letter of the game's title stamped on it.

items.name: Gamer's Rule Notebook
items.info: A notebook full of rules, odds and the loopholes found in them, in a small tidy hand.

items.name: Gasoline
items.info: Free card No. 14170, rank H, no limit. A vial of fuel that catches fire at the least spark. 300 Jenny, sold at Trade Shops.

items.name: Giant Cyclops
items.info: Free card No. 572, rank G, limit 333 copies. The biggest of the island's one-eyed giants, which roam in small bands and attack anything on their ground. Beat one and it becomes this card. Found, never sold: Pillar Field.

items.name: Gold Dust Girl
items.info: Specified card No. 046, rank A, limit 13 copies. A shy girl whose skin sheds gold dust, half a kilo of it in each day's bath. She hardly ever leaves home, and her room lies behind trap after trap. Found, never sold: a trapped secret room.

items.name: Golden Dictionary
items.info: Specified card No. 012, rank S, limit 10 copies. Each day one word in this dictionary shines gold. The owner who learns it finds that the word comes in handy the very next day. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Golden Guidebook
items.info: Specified card No. 010, rank A, limit 20 copies. A travel guide that shows its reader where and when to meet the kind of person they would fall for. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Golden Scales
items.info: Specified card No. 011, rank B, limit 30 copies. A pair of scales that settles any choice between two paths by tipping toward the one that serves the owner's future better. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Gorteauan Ration Rice
items.info: A cloth sack of rice stamped with the state seal, the measure every household of East Gorteau is allotted. Selling it on is a crime; people do it anyway. 800 Jenny, sold at Peijin.

items.name: Greed Island Cartridge
items.info: A copy of the legendary game for the JoyStation Console, out of print and made only for Hunters. Only a Nen user can play it, the catalogue warns that it can kill, and copies go at auction for billions. Battera bought every one at the last sale. 8900000000 Jenny, sold at Southernpiece Auction House.

items.name: Greed Island Memory Card
items.info: The save card that goes into the console with the game. Without one no player's progress is kept, and one copy of the game takes the saves of eight players at most. Found, never sold: Battera's Castle.

items.name: Grilled Frog Skewer
items.info: A charred frog on a stick, crisp and salty, sold from the stalls of the port town where the exam's applicants gather. 300 Jenny, sold at Zaban City.

items.name: Grunt's Bandana
items.info: A faded pirate bandana from the town of Soufrabi.

items.name: Guidepost
items.info: Spell card No. 1030, rank E, limit 120 copies. Points the way to where the card of a chosen number can be found, any number except the last card of all. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Gungi Set
items.info: A board and its stacking pieces for Gungi, the strategy game of East Gorteau, where almost everyone plays and the country has won every world championship. 15000 Jenny, sold at Peijin.

items.name: Hand-Baked Country Bread
items.info: A round loaf baked in a wood oven from flour ground at the mill, sold in paper. Everything in NGL is made by hand, and the bread is the better for it. 300 Jenny, sold at NGL.

items.name: Handler's Animal Card
items.info: A card with only an animal drawn on it, the beasts' calling sign.

items.name: Hardwood Club
items.info: A heavy club of dense wood, as long as a man's arm. Uvogin once fought with a pair of big wooden clubs; it needs strength more than skill, and in the hands of an Enhancement user it breaks a car. 1500 Jenny, sold at Junk Market.

items.name: Head Bodyguard's Hotel Key
items.info: A key card to a suite in a grand Yorknew hotel.

items.name: Head Butler's Pointed Glasses
items.info: Glasses with pointed frames, worn by the estate's head butler.

items.name: Head of State's Signing Pen
items.info: A heavy fountain pen used to sign treaties.

items.name: Head of the Family's Contract Card
items.info: A plain card with an address and a telephone number, offered to a client.
items.where: Head of the Family, Zoldyck Family

items.name: Head of the Spider's Inverted Cross Coat
items.info: A long black coat with an inverted cross on the back.
items.where: Head of the Spider, Phantom Troupe

items.name: Healthy Villagers
items.info: Free card No. 263, rank C, limit 50 copies. The same mountain villagers in perfect health, won only after earning their trust by giving them everything they ask. Found, never sold: Sick Huts.

items.name: Heavens Arena Entry Ticket
items.info: The numbered ticket of a first-time fighter at Heavens Arena, good for one bout on the ground floor.

items.name: Heavy Alloy Yo-Yo
items.info: A yo-yo of a dense alloy weighing fifty kilos, with a star stamped on its face. The metal carries electricity very well. Killua got a pair through Milluki, and few arms could throw one. Found, never sold: Zoldyck Mansion.

items.name: Heavy Pistol
items.info: A large-calibre pistol with a hard kick. Aboard the royal ship Kurapika worried more about meeting one of these than any lighter gun, aura or no aura. 150000 Jenny, sold at Kakin Empire.

items.name: Helper's Welcome Script
items.info: A neatly copied script of the game's basic rules.

items.name: Herder's Hemp Rope
items.info: A rope of hand-twisted hemp.

items.name: Hermit's Scroll
items.info: A scroll of secret teachings said to lie in a country closed to ordinary people. Hanzo sat the Hunter Exam chiefly so the licence would let him in to look for it. Found, never sold: a closed country.

items.name: Hideout Address
items.info: A scrap of paper with an abandoned building's address, burned once read.

items.name: Hideout Realtor
items.info: Specified card No. 057, rank A, limit 11 copies. An agent who builds the owner a secret room wherever they like, on the one condition that they never speak of it or take anyone there. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Hiking Boots
items.info: Stiff leather boots with a deep tread and a padded collar, made for mountain trails. They take a week to break in. 12000 Jenny, sold at Dentora Region.

items.name: Hired Guard's Item List
items.info: A list of rare items to bring back to the mansion within a month.

items.name: Hired Gun's Hotel Pass
items.info: A hotel pass for a meeting room booked under a false name.

items.name: Holder's Card Count
items.info: A scrap listing a player's specified cards by number.

items.name: Holstered Revolver
items.info: A six-shot revolver in a worn leather holster.

items.name: Holy Water
items.info: Spell card No. 1026, rank A, limit 20 copies. Guards its holder against ten attack spells, and cannot itself be stolen or destroyed. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Hooded Wrap
items.info: A thick cloth wrap that hides the face and the body.

items.name: Hopeful's Pamphlet
items.info: A cheap election pamphlet calling for the squad's return.

items.name: Hormone Cookies
items.info: Specified card No. 033, rank S, limit 13 copies. Ten boxes of twenty cookies each. One cookie turns the eater into the other sex for a full day. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: House Butler's Black Suit
items.info: The standard black suit of the estate's staff, cut to fight in.

items.name: Hunter Licence Card
items.info: A thick card with a chip and a magnetic strip, the only proof the Association accepts.

items.name: Hunters' Tavern Login
items.info: Access to the Hunters' Tavern site, open only to licence holders. Information of every kind is bought there, from a family's staff list to a fresh photograph of a guard, and the Association posts its own notices on it. Found, never sold: Hunter Association Headquarters.

items.name: Hunting Bow
items.info: A recurved bow with a quiver of arrows. Pokkle carried one through the exam before his Nen made it unnecessary, and Hunters still take bows into the field. 15000 Jenny, sold at Nancha City.

items.name: Hunting Rifle
items.info: A bolt-action rifle with a scope, sold to hunters of the forests around Kukuroo Mountain. It reaches farther than any pistol and is slow to reload. 120000 Jenny, sold at Dentora Region.

items.name: Hunting Spear
items.info: A spear with a broad steel head and an ash shaft, sold in the market town where the exam's applicants gather. At least one applicant brought one down the tunnel. 8000 Jenny, sold at Zaban City.

items.name: Hybrid's Mask of Skin
items.info: A ragged mask from a hybrid's changing face.

items.name: Hyper Puffball
items.info: Free card No. 673, rank D, limit 80 copies. A small round creature so quick that most players never lay a hand on one. Found, never sold: Greed Island Hills.

items.name: Hypothetical T.V.
items.info: Specified card No. 024, rank A, limit 20 copies. Type a what-if into its remote and this television plays a thirty-hour documentary of how things might have gone. It can record what it shows. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Imp's Wink
items.info: Specified card No. 018, rank A, limit 18 copies. A little imp whose wink gives a bliss beyond anything the owner has felt. She comes back as often as she is called, and the card warns that the habit is hard to break. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Imported Delicacy Hamper
items.info: A wicker basket of foreign cheeses, cured hams, fine wines and fruit out of season, flown to the ship by drone for the first tier's tables. 120000 Jenny, sold at Tier 1.

items.name: Infiltrator's Palace Map
items.info: A map of East Gorteau's palace drawn from a defector's memory.

items.name: Informant's Point Card
items.info: A card stamped with points for each report made.

items.name: Instant Foreign Language School
items.info: Specified card No. 059, rank A, limit 20 copies. Study a language here and the hours go onto a timer that comes with it. While the timer runs down, the owner speaks that language like a native. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Investigator's Case File
items.info: A case file with a passenger's photograph clipped to it.

items.name: Invitation Message
items.info: A short message from Kazsule naming a place and a time.

items.name: J10,000
items.info: Free card No. 607, rank H, no limit. Ten thousand Jenny in card form, the largest note the island's money comes in. Out of its card it is an ordinary banknote, useless on the island. 10000 Jenny, sold at Card Bank.

items.name: Jelly Syndrome Child's Head
items.info: A body part on a flesh collector's wanted list, offered through the job agency's books. Nobody asks where it would come from. Found, never sold: Sengi Guild.

items.name: Jenny
items.info: The world's common money, good from Whale Island to the Kakin Empire. It changes hands as coins for small sums and as notes for the rest, and the amounts run high: a canned drink costs a couple of coins, while a Hunter's licence, a pair of Scarlet Eyes or a lot at the auctions of Yorknew City is spoken of in hundreds of millions or in billions. Hardly anywhere keeps a money of its own, and where one does, the Jenny must be changed before it buys anything.

items.name: JoyStation Console
items.info: An old third-generation games console, long out of date. Collectors still want one, because a certain game runs on it and on nothing else. 30000 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Kakin Court Robe
items.info: A long silk robe in the imperial style, with high collars and wide sleeves, the dress the court and the guests of the royal banquet are expected to wear. 150000 Jenny, sold at Kakin Empire.

items.name: Kakin Steamed Buns
items.info: Soft white buns stuffed with pork and spring onion, sold in bamboo steamers at the port before the great ship sails. 500 Jenny, sold at Kakin Empire.

items.name: Katana
items.info: A long curved sword in a lacquered scabbard, worn through the sash on the left hip. Nobunaga and Saccho both wear it so, and in a practised hand it is an iaido blade that ends a fight in one draw. An Enhancement user who lays aura along its edge makes it cut stone. 180000 Jenny, sold at Bull Market.

items.name: Keeper's Card Book
items.info: A book counting every spell card the alliance holds.

items.name: Keeper's Photograph
items.info: A faded group photograph of young Hunters, one of them unmistakably the chairman.
items.where: Keeper of the Name, Pure Paladin Squad

items.name: Kimono with Obi Sash
items.info: A plain kimono and a wide sash that a sword can be thrust through on the left hip, the dress of Jappon. Nobunaga wears his everywhere. 60000 Jenny, sold at Bull Market.

items.name: King White Stag Beetle
items.info: Specified card No. 053, rank A, limit 30 copies. A white beetle whose scent draws other insects into a vast colony around it; it leaves the colony once a day for an evening walk. Players climb its tree for it, or punch the trunk until one falls. Found, never sold: a great tree.

items.name: Kurta Tabard
items.info: A long blue tabard with a red hem, worn over a white full-body suit in the Kurta way. Kurapika wore his through the Hunter Exam. Found, never sold: Kurta Village.

items.name: Laptop Computer
items.info: A folding computer with a battery that lasts an afternoon. Milluki's rooms are full of bigger machines, but this one travels. 150000 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Large Rock
items.info: Free card No. 25008, rank H, no limit. A big boulder in a card, nothing more and nothing less. Found, never sold: Pillar Field.

items.name: Lead Designer's Cartridge
items.info: An early copy of the game, signed on its label.

items.name: Leader's Expedition Charter
items.info: A charter bearing Kakin's royal seal and Beyond's signature.
items.where: Expedition Leader, Dark Continent Expedition Team

items.name: Leader's Horse Brand
items.info: An iron brand with the movement's leaf mark.

items.name: Leather Boxing Gloves
items.info: Padded leather gloves laced at the wrist, sold to the arena's hopefuls. Bonolenov wears a pair for another reason: to cover the holes in his hands. 6000 Jenny, sold at Arena Town.

items.name: Leave
items.info: Spell card No. 1014, rank B, limit 30 copies. Throws a player out of the game altogether; cast on oneself, it is the way home. Drawn at random from a shop pack. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Levitation Stone
items.info: Specified card No. 080, rank S, limit 7 copies. A stone the size of a small gem that floats and can lift one person with it. It draws its strength from sunlight. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Levy
items.info: Spell card No. 1018, rank B, limit 25 copies. Takes one random card from every player within twenty metres at once. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Lieutenant's Folding Knife
items.info: A slim folding knife with a pearl handle.

items.name: Lieutenant's Reporter Badge
items.info: A press badge torn from a dead reporter's jacket.

items.name: Lighthouse Rope
items.info: A coil of tarred rope from the pirates' lighthouse.

items.name: Linked Bokken
items.info: Two wooden swords with bandaged grips joined by a cord, which swing as a pair or whirl like a flail. Kurapika fought with a set like this until his chains replaced them. 6000 Jenny, sold at Arena Town.

items.name: Lion's Mane Clasp
items.info: A heavy clasp made to hold back a lion's mane.

items.name: Liquor Spring
items.info: Specified card No. 006, rank A, limit 15 copies. Water drawn from this spring turns, an hour later, into some fine drink or other, never the same twice and always of the best quality. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: List
items.info: Spell card No. 1038, rank G, limit 350 copies. Tells how many players hold a chosen card and how many copies of it exist. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Lonely Sapphire
items.info: Specified card No. 078, rank B, limit 30 copies. A sapphire that brings its owner a fortune and takes away everyone they love; friends, family and partners all drift off for good. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Long Lost Delivery
items.info: Specified card No. 060, rank B, limit 30 copies. Phone the number, describe something lost for more than a month, and it turns up at the door the next day. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Long Smoking Pipe
items.info: A pipe as long as an arm with a bowl like a small pot, made for a big man's tobacco. Morel swings his like a club when he is not filling a room with its smoke. 20000 Jenny, sold at Swardani City.

items.name: Long Sword
items.info: A straight double-edged sword with a cross guard, heavy and old-fashioned. Mafia soldiers still carry a few into the desert when guns alone have not been enough. 90000 Jenny, sold at Bull Market.

items.name: Lottery
items.info: Spell card No. 1032, rank G, limit 350 copies. Turns into an item card picked by pure chance. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Lotus Anchorite
items.info: A seated figure among the three sacred treasures of the Kakin royal house, called the divine mummy and named as overseer of the succession contest. Found, never sold: Black Whale 1.

items.name: Lower-Tier Mess Tray
items.info: A metal tray of rice, stew and a boiled egg from the crowded dining hall on the lowest tier, where the Mafia keep the queue in order. 300 Jenny, sold at Tier 5.

items.name: Luck Bankbook
items.info: Specified card No. 013, rank A, limit 20 copies. A savings book for small luck. Let the little strokes of good fortune pass by unused and they pile up in it, ready to be drawn out as money. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Machine Gun
items.info: A belt-fed machine gun too heavy to fire from the hip for long. East Gorteau's soldiers have them; in Peijin Morel dodged one's stream of bullets and struck the gunner down with his pipe. Found, never sold: Peijin.

items.name: Mad Scientist's Pheromones
items.info: Specified card No. 071, rank A, limit 20 copies. A spray that draws the other sex to the wearer. Its strength cannot be turned down, so stalkers are a known hazard. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Mad Scientist's Plastic Surgery
items.info: Specified card No. 072, rank A, limit 15 copies. A machine that rebuilds the face to match any photograph fed into it. One operation in twenty goes wrong, and now and then the machine breaks. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Mad Scientist's Steroids
items.info: Specified card No. 070, rank A, limit 16 copies. Muscle without training: drink a litre a day for a week. It tastes vile, and it comes by the crate. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Magistrate's Gavel
items.info: The gavel of the Supreme Court on the first tier.

items.name: Magnetic Force
items.info: Spell card No. 1005, rank C, limit 50 copies. Flies the caster alone through the sky to wherever a player met before is standing. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Main Guy's Detonator Ring
items.info: A plain ring the killers wear like a promise to each other.

items.name: Map of the Island 'detailed'
items.info: Free card No. 101, rank D, limit 70 copies. The whole island already drawn, every town and landmark marked. 650000 Jenny, sold at Masadora.

items.name: Map of the Island 'empty'
items.info: Free card No. 100, rank G, limit 400 copies. A blank map of the island that draws itself in as its holder walks. Most players buy one first. 3000 Jenny, sold at Trade Shops.

items.name: Mark's Crumpled Card
items.info: A low-rank card taken from a dead player.

items.name: Master Sergeant's Baton
items.info: A short baton carried by a senior sergeant.

items.name: Master's Dojo Key
items.info: A brass key to a dojo, handed from master to master.

items.name: Medical Kit in a Briefcase
items.info: A battered briefcase packed with bandages, a suture kit, antiseptic and a few instruments.

items.name: Melanin Lizard
items.info: Free card No. 697, rank E, limit 100 copies. A lizard big enough to swallow a cow whole. It becomes a card only once beaten. Found, never sold: Pillar Field.

items.name: Member's Kill Counter
items.info: A small clicker counter kept in a pocket.

items.name: Memory Helmet
items.info: Specified card No. 090, rank A, limit 20 copies. Nothing seen or heard under this helmet is ever forgotten. It is huge and very heavy. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Mercenary's Contract Folder
items.info: A worn folder of signed contracts, payment terms and the names of past clients.

items.name: Messenger's Black Car Key
items.info: A key to a black car with darkened windows.

items.name: Mighty Sweepin' Power Cleaners Tape
items.info: A videotape of the cartoon that children everywhere love, recorded off the air. Long ago, in a church in Meteor City, Chrollo and Pakunoda put on a show of it for the other children. 2500 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Millennium Butterfly
items.info: Specified card No. 054, rank A, limit 25 copies. A butterfly of legend. The family of whoever catches it is said to prosper for a thousand years. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Mimic
items.info: Spell card No. 1010, rank A, limit 20 copies. Turns one of the caster's cards into a copy of another card already held; it fails and vanishes if that card's limit is full. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Miniature Dino
items.info: Specified card No. 050, rank A, limit 11 copies. A dinosaur no bigger than a hand, whose young are a different tiny species in every generation. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Miniature Dragon
items.info: Specified card No. 051, rank S, limit 10 copies. A hand-sized dragon that obeys its owner and, raised with love, learns to talk in time. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Miniature Mermaid
items.info: Specified card No. 049, rank A, limit 23 copies. A mermaid small enough to sit in a palm. Kept in comfort, she is cheerful and sings in a lovely voice. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Minister's Briefcase
items.info: A locked briefcase of reports nobody outside the palace reads.

items.name: Minister's Briefing Folder
items.info: A red folder stamped with the highest secrecy grade.

items.name: Misette Limited Edition Bull Snake
items.info: A collector's handgun, the first of a limited run, which a gun lover is hiring someone to find. Found, never sold: Sengi Guild.

items.name: Mood Clock
items.info: Specified card No. 020, rank B, limit 30 copies. A clock whose hands set the owner's mood. Turn them to noon and a perfect calm settles in; other hours give other tempers for other moments. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Mosquitone
items.info: An egg-shaped gadget with a speaker on top that gives off a tone too high for most adult ears. The young use it to talk in a room without the grown-ups hearing. 8000 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Mug
items.info: Spell card No. 1021, rank B, limit 30 copies. Takes from the target the one card the caster chooses. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Mukatolini's Lithograph
items.info: A print of bright abstract shapes, number three of fifty, with the artist's signature nearly as big as the picture. Mukatolini signed only the prints he truly liked, and his aura still clings to this one; a pawnbroker pays far more than the stall asks. 11000 Jenny, sold at Bull Market.

items.name: Mummified Right Arm
items.info: The dried right arm of a mummy, taken from a stone tomb in Egypersia. Basho fetched it for Neon's collection and got his job for it. Found, never sold: Nostrade's Mansion.

items.name: Mystery Pond
items.info: Specified card No. 008, rank S, limit 10 copies. Put a fish in this pond and the next morning there are two of its kind. Sea fish and river fish live in it side by side without harm. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Natural-Fibre Travel Clothes
items.info: Cotton, wool and leather, with no zip, no plastic button and no synthetic thread. Visitors to NGL change into these at the border, since nothing modern may cross it. 6000 Jenny, sold at NGL Border Stop.

items.name: Navigator's Lantern
items.info: A lantern from the forest cabins where the navigators wait.

items.name: Night Jade
items.info: Specified card No. 073, rank A, limit 15 copies. A jewel with a devil's blessing. When harm is about to fall on its owner, the jade turns it aside onto somebody else. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Night Shift Dwarves
items.info: Specified card No. 026, rank A, limit 20 copies. Seven little workers who do the owner's work while the owner sleeps. They can do anything the owner can and nothing more. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Nigiri Sushi
items.info: Small blocks of vinegared rice pressed by hand and topped with raw fish from the river. Hardly an applicant had heard of it when Menchi asked for it, and she passed nobody. Found, never sold: Cooking Ground.

items.name: Nine-Millimetre Pistol
items.info: The common service pistol of guards and police, with a long magazine in the grip. One prince's guards on the voyage carry them, and Kurapika reckoned that aura in the eyes alone would not keep him unhurt against one. 90000 Jenny, sold at Yorknew City.

items.name: Numbered Spider Tattoo
items.info: A twelve-legged spider inked on the skin, with a number on its abdomen.

items.name: Officer's Bureau Badge
items.info: A badge of the ministry's own police.

items.name: Officer's Cocoon Thread
items.info: A thread from the cocoons hung in the palace grounds.

items.name: Officer's Quota Tally
items.info: A strip of bark scratched with marks for each human brought in.

items.name: Olympia Champion's Belt
items.info: A gaudy belt from Battle Olympia, held for two years.

items.name: Origin
items.info: Spell card No. 1013, rank D, limit 65 copies. Sends the target flying all the way back to where every player first arrives. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Painkiller Tablets
items.info: A strip of strong pain tablets. They dull a broken rib enough to walk on it and do nothing at all for the bone. 1200 Jenny, sold at Doli City.

items.name: Paladin's Necklace
items.info: Specified card No. 084, rank D, limit 60 copies. A necklace that throws back curses aimed at its wearer and lifts the curse from any card its wearer touches. Antokiba gives it to the winner of a monthly tug of war. Found, never sold: Antokiba.

items.name: Paladin's Oath Card
items.info: A card with a short oath printed under an embossed shield.

items.name: Panda Maid
items.info: Specified card No. 099, rank S, limit 6 copies. A rare and tidy panda that loves to cook, keeps a hobby of its own such as sewing or gardening, and looks after children beautifully. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Paralysis Darts
items.info: A cloth wrap of blowgun darts dipped in a muscle relaxant. The drug normally wears off in about ten days; Gon, struck in the back of the neck, was moving again within minutes. 6000 Jenny, sold at Junk Market.

items.name: Park Hot Dog
items.info: A sausage in a soft bun with mustard, from the food stands in the park. During the auction weeks the queues run around the fountain. 400 Jenny, sold at Dayroad Park.

items.name: Parrot Candy
items.info: Specified card No. 032, rank B, limit 30 copies. Suck one and the voice can copy any voice the eater remembers, perfectly, until the next mouthful of food. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Party Member's Lapel Badge
items.info: A red enamel badge with the Supreme Leader's profile.

items.name: Patch of Forest
items.info: Specified card No. 001, rank SS, limit 3 copies. The way into a vast forest full of rare creatures found nowhere else, all of them gentle with visitors. Players who hold one guard it closely, since only three may ever exist. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Pearl Locusts
items.info: Specified card No. 052, rank B, limit 30 copies. Locusts that each carry a pearl in the belly. They swarm only about once every twelve years. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Peek
items.info: Spell card No. 1001, rank G, limit 200 copies. Shows the caster every card in the free slots of a player met before. Drawn at random from a shop pack. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Peerless Killer's Calling Card
items.info: A blank card left behind on a finished job.

items.name: Peon's Carapace Shard
items.info: A shard of chitin shed by a young soldier.

items.name: Peon's Lot Stick
items.info: A short stick used for drawing lots.

items.name: Perfect Memory Studio
items.info: Specified card No. 056, rank B, limit 25 copies. A photographer's studio that prints a picture of the owner at any past moment named, or a whole run of them. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Phone Line Registration
items.info: A paid phone line and registration number, the price of a connection to Cyberspace for anyone without a Hunter's licence, which gets it free. Tickets, sales and rumours are all a search away. 30000 Jenny, sold at Yorknew City.

items.name: Pickpocket
items.info: Spell card No. 1006, rank F, limit 170 copies. Lifts one card at random from another player's free slots. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Pitcher of Eternal Water
items.info: Specified card No. 003, rank A, limit 17 copies. A jug that never runs dry, pouring clean drinking water day and night, more than a thousand litres between one dawn and the next. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Plain Gold Ring
items.info: A smooth band of yellow gold with nothing on it. Couples buy them in pairs. 45000 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Plant Worker's Gloves
items.info: Thick gloves stained by a plant nobody names.

items.name: Planted Ally's Alliance Roster
items.info: A list of an alliance's members with ticks beside some names.

items.name: Plastic King
items.info: Specified card No. 091, rank A, limit 20 copies. A full-size model kit whose parts snap together into any vehicle that really runs. Fuel is not included. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Player's Contract Copy
items.info: A thick contract with a signature on every page.

items.name: Plot of Beach
items.info: Specified card No. 002, rank SS, limit 3 copies. The mouth of a sea cave whose tunnels shift each time someone goes in, so no map of it holds. The card belongs to whoever beats Razor and his fourteen pirates at their own games. Found, never sold: Soufrabi.

items.name: Pocket Compass
items.info: A brass compass with a lid and a ring for a cord. It keeps a traveller pointed straight in fog, swamp and forest, where the exam likes to lose people. 2000 Jenny, sold at Zaban City.

items.name: Police Nightstick
items.info: A short stick with a side handle, the kind every city's police carry. Tonpa says Geretta favoured one at some time before the blowgun. 3000 Jenny, sold at Pata City.

items.name: Polio Company Card
items.info: A business card for a dummy company with an address that does not exist.

items.name: Poltergeist Pillow
items.info: Specified card No. 019, rank A, limit 13 copies. Sleep on it and the soul slips out to roam as it likes. A soul that is not back in its body within a day stays a ghost for good. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Pre-Order Vouchers
items.info: Specified card No. 029, rank A, limit 20 copies. A book of a thousand vouchers. Write any product sold anywhere on one and it is yours however scarce, though it must still be paid for. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Pregnancy Stones
items.info: Specified card No. 007, rank S, limit 10 copies. A pair of heavy stones, one male and one female. Whoever carries one about for a month will conceive, man or woman, and the stone chosen settles the child's sex. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Private Second Class's Beret
items.info: A beret, the headgear of a private second class.

items.name: Prosecutor's Robe
items.info: A black robe for appearing before the court.

items.name: Provisional Licence Card
items.info: A Provisional Hunter's card from the 289th exam's screening, good for the length of the voyage and not a day after.

items.name: Pupil's Practice Shirt
items.info: A plain white shirt, never quite tucked in, worn by every pupil.

items.name: Purify
items.info: Spell card No. 1034, rank D, limit 55 copies. Undoes a transformation spell and returns the card to what it was. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Q Encryption Code
items.info: A nine-digit code a Hunter sends to a phone company the Association owns, opening a channel that keeps no logs and slips past ordinary wiretaps. Hunters bound by a client's silence use it to talk among themselves. Found, never sold: Hunter Association Headquarters.

items.name: Queen of Meteor City's Crown
items.info: A crown of scrap metal from the dumps.

items.name: Quiver of Frustration
items.info: Specified card No. 086, rank A, limit 11 copies. A quiver of ten arrows, each one spent to cast Leave without the spell card. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Radio Rat
items.info: Free card No. 711, rank H, limit 800 copies. A tiny rat that works an empty suit of armour with its aura and lets the armour take the blows while it runs off. Found, never sold: Greed Island Hills.

items.name: Rain Poncho
items.info: A hooded poncho of oiled cloth that keeps off rain and swamp mist. Applicants who know the exam's habits carry one. 2000 Jenny, sold at Zaban City.

items.name: Rainbow Diamond
items.info: Specified card No. 079, rank A, limit 20 copies. A diamond that glitters in every colour. A proposal made with it is always answered yes. It drops from the casino's slot machines, which is how Killua won one. Found, never sold: Dorias.

items.name: Razor's Dodgeball
items.info: A hard ball from the lighthouse gym, scuffed by a game master's throws.

items.name: Records Clerk's Index Card
items.info: A typed index card from a travel-risk file.

items.name: Recruiter's Flyer
items.info: A handwritten offer of a share in the reward, slipped to new players.

items.name: Recycle
items.info: Spell card No. 1037, rank F, limit 170 copies. Turns an item that came out of a card back into a card, if its rank is below C and its limit is not full. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Recycling Room
items.info: Specified card No. 036, rank S, limit 10 copies. Leave something broken in this room and a day later it is as good as new, so long as nobody opens the door before the time is up. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Reflect
items.info: Spell card No. 1004, rank E, limit 120 copies. Sends one attack spell from a known player back the way it came. Drawn at random from a shop pack. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Regional Officer's Travel Permit
items.info: A paper permit to move between cities, stamped twice.

items.name: Relegate
items.info: Spell card No. 1012, rank F, limit 140 copies. Hurls the target to some random spot on the island. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Retainer's Queen's Fan
items.info: A painted fan carried by a queen's retainer.
items.where: Queen's Retainer, Hui Guo Rou royal house

items.name: Return
items.info: Spell card No. 1009, rank G, limit 380 copies. Flies the caster back to any town already visited, most often to Masadora for more spells. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Revenge Shop
items.info: Specified card No. 055, rank A, limit 20 copies. A shop whose manager hears out a grudge and pays the offender back in fair measure. A heavier revenge costs extra. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Revolver
items.info: A six-shot revolver with a long barrel. Pakunoda carried one to load with bullets of her own making; for anyone else it shoots ordinary rounds. 70000 Jenny, sold at Republic of Hass.

items.name: Right Hand's Map Case
items.info: A map case of the survey routes, marked in Kite's own pencil.

items.name: Right Hand's Signet Ring
items.info: A heavy ring stamped with a Don's emblem.

items.name: Rising Dragon Tattoo Hide
items.info: A whole tattooed human skin with a rising dragon on it, sought by a flesh collector through the guild. Found, never sold: Sengi Guild.

items.name: Risky Dice
items.info: Specified card No. 025, rank B, limit 30 copies. A twenty-sided die with nineteen stars and one skull. A star brings wonderful luck; the skull brings a disaster big enough to wipe out every good roll before it, and players have died of it. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Roaming Ruby
items.info: Specified card No. 076, rank B, limit 30 copies. A ruby that makes its owner rich and restless both: great wealth comes, and the owner can never stay a week in one place. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Roast Great Stamp
items.info: A whole Great Stamp, the fiercest pig in the world, hunted in the preserve and roasted on a spit until the skin crackles. Buhara ate every one the applicants brought him. Found, never sold: Visca Forest Preserve.

items.name: Rock
items.info: Free card No. 21449, rank H, no limit. A plain, very hard stone of whatever size was picked up. Found, never sold: Pillar Field.

items.name: Rock Toss
items.info: Spell card No. 1028, rank E, limit 100 copies. Smashes one random card in the target's free slots. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Rodo Memorial Plates
items.info: A series of collectible plates. An antique collector at the guild wants the ones for two particular years. Found, never sold: Sengi Guild.

items.name: Rookie's Exam Badge
items.info: A numbered plate from the exam you passed, kept in a drawer as a reminder.

items.name: Round Steel Shield
items.info: A dented round shield with a leather arm strap. Hired toughs bring them to fights they expect to lose, as Seaquant's hundred did at the Zoldyck gate. 15000 Jenny, sold at Junk Market.

items.name: Royal Attendant's Honey Cup
items.info: A cup the attendants carry to the queen's chamber.

items.name: Royal Family's Jade Token
items.info: A jade token carved with the dynasty's name.
items.where: Royal Family, Hui Guo Rou royal house

items.name: Royal Guard's Gungi Stone
items.info: A playing piece from a board game the master grew fond of.

items.name: Ruler's Blessing
items.info: Specified card No. 000, rank SS, limit 1 copies. A castle and a walled town of ten thousand people who live by whatever laws their new ruler lays down. It is the last card of all and is handed over only in the capital, to the player who has already filled every other slot and won the closing quiz. Found, never sold: Limeiro.

items.name: Ruler's Invitation
items.info: Free card No. 110, rank SS, limit 1 copies. A warm letter of invitation to the island's capital and a tour of its castle, given to the winner of the game's closing quiz. Found, never sold: Limeiro.

items.name: Runner's Bone Whistle
items.info: A whistle carved from a bone, used to call a squad together.

items.name: Runner's Deck Pass
items.info: A pass for the fourth tier's service corridors.

items.name: Runner's Errand List
items.info: A crumpled list of shops and cards to fetch.

items.name: Sacrifice Armor
items.info: Specified card No. 085, rank S, limit 8 copies. Armour no weapon drawn from a card can harm. It breaks at some unknown blow within its first hundred. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Sage's Aquamarine
items.info: Specified card No. 074, rank A, limit 11 copies. Its owner gathers many clever friends and keeps every one of them for life. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Sara's Hair
items.info: A lock of a famous actress's hair in a box with a DNA certificate. It was one of the things on Neon's list for her guards to fetch, and Kurapika brought it. Found, never sold: Nostrade's Mansion.

items.name: Scarlet Eyes
items.info: A pair of eyes from the Kurta Clan, kept in fluid in a glass jar. The clan's eyes, brown in life, burn scarlet with strong feeling and stay that colour if their owner dies in it; collectors of human remains count them among the world's great treasures. Since the clan's massacre only a few dozen pairs exist, and they change hands at the Mafia's auction. 2900000000 Jenny, sold at Cemetery Building.

items.name: Scout's Ticket Stub
items.info: A torn ship ticket marked with a pencil tick, a scout's note on a candidate.

items.name: Scrap Metal Bundle
items.info: A wired bundle of salvaged steel, copper and aluminium from the heaps. Meteor City's people build their houses and their tools from it. 500 Jenny, sold at Junk Market.

items.name: Second's Black Gloves
items.info: Thin black gloves for night work.

items.name: Secret Cape
items.info: Specified card No. 095, rank A, limit 20 copies. A cape that wraps its wearer in Blackout Curtain for as long as it is worn. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Secretary's Palace Key
items.info: A heavy key to the palace's lower floors.
items.where: Secretary of State, East Gorteau regime

items.name: Secrets Video Rental
items.info: Specified card No. 058, rank A, limit 13 copies. A rental shop whose tapes hold other people's secrets. A renter must never show a tape or talk about what was on it. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Section Chief's Application Stamp
items.info: A stamp reading REFUSED in neat capitals.

items.name: Seed Urn
items.info: One of the three sacred treasures of the Kakin royal house: a ritual vessel made in the age of warring lords, when Kakin was small and in danger. Every prince of the contest took part in its rite before the voyage. Found, never sold: Black Whale 1.

items.name: Senior Advisor's Ballot Slip
items.info: A sealed slip from an Association vote, signed by a senior advisor.

items.name: Senior Assassin's Yo-Yo
items.info: A heavy steel yo-yo made for a child who kills.

items.name: Senior Beast's Collar Tag
items.info: A metal tag stamped with an animal and a number.

items.name: Senior Butler's Weighted Cup
items.info: A cup far heavier than it looks, used every day for training.

items.name: Senior Disciple's Sash
items.info: A sash dyed dark from years of practice.

items.name: Senior Leader's Queen Chit
items.info: A chit of chitin pressed with the queen's mark.

items.name: Senior Spider's Stolen Bauble
items.info: A trinket from a raid that the leader tired of and gave away.

items.name: Senior's Hideout Key
items.info: A wooden key to the alliance's hidden base.

items.name: Senior's Specimen Jar
items.info: A sealed jar for a specimen the crew could not name.

items.name: Servant's Grey Smock
items.info: A grey smock, the clothing the caste is allowed.

items.name: Servant's Livery Ribbon
items.info: A ribbon in the royal colours worn by palace servants.

items.name: Servant's Palace Pass
items.info: A palace pass stamped by the regime, now honoured by stranger masters.

items.name: Shadow Beast's Mask
items.info: A plain mask painted with the outline of an animal.

items.name: Shadow Soldier's Rifle Sling
items.info: A modern rifle sling, contraband in NGL.

items.name: Shield of Faith
items.info: Specified card No. 087, rank S, limit 15 copies. Within twenty metres of the one holding this shield, the spells Relegate, Return, Drift and Collision fail. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Shock Whip
items.info: A black whip whose tip looks like a snake's head. A switch in the grip sends a million volts down the lash. Riehlvelt fought with a pair from his wheelchair. 400000 Jenny, sold at Arena Town.

items.name: Sick Villagers
items.info: Free card No. 163, rank F, limit 150 copies. The people of a hidden mountain village, every one of them gravely ill. Found, never sold: Sick Huts.

items.name: Signed Exam Application
items.info: An application for the year's Hunter Exam, signed and stamped; for a minor, a guardian's signature sits under the applicant's.

items.name: Silk Guard's Spindle
items.info: A spindle wound with a spider ant's thread.

items.name: Silver Chain Pendant
items.info: A fine silver chain with a small plain pendant, a gift or a keepsake. It holds a photograph behind its lid. 30000 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Silver Dog
items.info: Specified card No. 098, rank S, limit 8 copies. A rare silver-coated dog. Mix a little gold into its daily food and it leaves a kilo of solid silver behind. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Single-Star Pin
items.info: A small pin with one star, given for remarkable work in one field.

items.name: Skin Care Hot Springs
items.info: Specified card No. 004, rank A, limit 15 copies. A steaming spring that clears up any trouble of the skin. Half an hour's soak a day leaves the bather's skin as soft as an infant's. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Sleeping Girl
items.info: Specified card No. 047, rank A, limit 11 copies. A girl who sleeps for the owner, who can then stay awake and fresh through a whole day and night. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Sleeve Blade
items.info: A short blade on a sprung rail that straps along the forearm under a sleeve and slides out at a flick. The ninjas of Hanzo's school hide them so, and nobody sees the weapon until it is at the throat. 25000 Jenny, sold at Junk Market.

items.name: Slow-Grilled Steak Combo
items.info: A thick steak with rice, soup and pickles from a small diner on Tsubashi Street, grilled over a low flame rather than boiled. Most of its customers never wonder why so many strangers order exactly this. 1500 Jenny, sold at 287th Hunter Exam Site Restaurant.

items.name: Small-Calibre Pocket Pistol
items.info: A small handgun that fits in a jacket pocket. Kurapika told Bill that a gun this size will not stop a Hunter, and he was right. 60000 Jenny, sold at Yorknew City.

items.name: Soldier's Arm Patch
items.info: A patch from Camilla's private army.

items.name: Soldier's Cha-R Pin
items.info: A small pin with the family's character.

items.name: Soldier's Hunting Net
items.info: A coarse net woven from vines, used to carry captives.

items.name: Soldier's Pistol Permit
items.info: A forged permit for a handgun, good enough for the local police.

items.name: Soldier's Xi-Yu Tattoo
items.info: A small family mark tattooed inside the wrist.

items.name: Solid-Gold Execution Sword
items.info: A curved ceremonial blade of solid gold, etched all over, once an executioner's and later kept in the Yul National Treasury. It opened the Mafia's sale as the first lot. Found, never sold: Cemetery Building.

items.name: Sonata of Darkness
items.info: A piece for piano, violin, harp and flute that the devil himself is said to have written. Whoever plays or hears it is cursed; Melody heard its flute part, and it changed her body and her hearing for good. Found, never sold: a lost score.

items.name: Sonne Limarch's Used Tissue
items.info: A used tissue from the actor Sonne Limarch, sealed in a case with a certificate of his DNA. Neon Nostrade sent her men to buy it. Found, never sold: Cemetery Building.

items.name: Southernpiece Catalog
items.info: A thick dark catalogue of every lot in Yorknew's leading auction house, with a card inside that admits up to five people to the sales. Without it there is no way to know which day a lot comes up, or into which hall. 12000000 Jenny, sold at Southernpiece Auction House.

items.name: Spaghetti Mountain
items.info: A plate of pasta piled higher than a head, the restaurant's challenge dish. Whoever finishes it within half an hour wins a prize card. 2000 Jenny, sold at Caveau de Riquewihr.

items.name: Specialist's Floor Plan
items.info: A building plan marked with exits in red.

items.name: Spell Card Pack
items.info: A sealed pack of three spell cards, drawn at random from the forty kinds the game holds. Masadora's shop is the only place in the game that sells spells, and nobody knows what a pack holds until it is opened. 10000 Jenny, sold at Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Spider Eagle Egg
items.info: A big egg taken from a nest of webs strung deep in the canyon. Boiled, it is richer than any hen's egg; the only way to it is a jump into the gorge with nothing but the webs to catch at. Found, never sold: Split Mountain.

items.name: Spirited Away Hollow
items.info: Specified card No. 005, rank S, limit 8 copies. A hollow that drops whoever walks through it somewhere lonely and far away in the same country. Fortune always brings the traveller home again without a coin spent. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Splint and Sling
items.info: A padded splint and a cloth sling for a broken arm, such as Gon wore for weeks after his fight with Gido. 1500 Jenny, sold at Arena Town.

items.name: Sports Pirate's Football
items.info: A battered football used in the pirates' contests.

items.name: Spotter's Field Glasses
items.info: Small binoculars with a cracked strap.

items.name: Squad Master's Radio
items.info: A field radio tuned to the team's channel.

items.name: Squad Officer's Map Scrap
items.info: A scrap of a village map stained with mud.

items.name: Squadron Captain's Banner
items.info: A strip of cloth taken from a village and worn as a sign of rank.

items.name: Squadron Leader's Name Tag
items.info: A tag with a chosen name written in clumsy letters.

items.name: Staff of Judgment
items.info: Specified card No. 082, rank A, limit 15 copies. Raise the staff and call out someone's name, and misfortune strikes whichever of the two has done more wrong, the one named or the one holding the staff. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Station Keeper's Tower Key
items.info: A key to one of the game's stations, the starting tower or the port.

items.name: Steel Spinning Tops
items.info: A box of ten metal tops with pull cords. Gido sends ten at once around the ring, guided by his aura, and owns as many as fifty, so that an opponent dodges into one while avoiding another. 12000 Jenny, sold at Arena Town.

items.name: Stone Wall Patch
items.info: A cloth patch of a grey wall, the unit's sign.
items.where: Stone Wall Mercenary, Dark Continent Expedition Team

items.name: Strategist's Map
items.info: A hand-drawn map of the island's towns with notes on every shop.

items.name: Student's Training Weight
items.info: A heavy band worn on the wrist in the weeks of training before the raid.

items.name: Stung Servant's Collar
items.info: A collar of silk thread worn by the stung.

items.name: Submachine Gun
items.info: A short automatic gun that sprays a magazine in seconds. Mafia soldiers carry them, and on the lowest tier of the ship Ken'i Wang's men pointed theirs at members of the Troupe. Found, never sold: Tier 5.

items.name: Survey Notebook
items.info: A notebook of sketches and species notes in several hands.

items.name: Swap Ticket
items.info: Specified card No. 092, rank S, limit 7 copies. A book of a thousand tickets. Tear one and hand half to another person, and the two of you live each other's lives for a day. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Switchblade
items.info: A folding knife whose blade springs out at the press of a catch. Leorio drew one when Hisoka found him in the exam, and Kurapika held one to a Mafia man's throat in Yorknew. 4000 Jenny, sold at Yorknew City.

items.name: Sword of Good Omens
items.info: The third sacred treasure of the Kakin royal house, the sword handed to a new king as the sign that the throne is his. Found, never sold: Black Whale 1.

items.name: Sword of Truth
items.info: Specified card No. 083, rank B, limit 22 copies. A sword that cleaves anything false, a liar included, and shatters if it is swung at something true; a day in its scabbard mends it. Antokiba's monthly rock-paper-scissors contest gives it as the prize; it was Killua's first card in the game, and other players soon stole it. Found, never sold: Antokiba.

items.name: Swordsman's Short Blade
items.info: A short, single-edged blade in a plain wooden sheath, quick to draw.

items.name: System Keeper's Circuit Sketch
items.info: A sketch of how a spell is supposed to work, covered in notes.

items.name: Tax Collector's Gauntlet
items.info: Specified card No. 089, rank A, limit 20 copies. A gauntlet that casts Levy at will, at the cost of one random card from its owner's own specified slots each time. With those slots empty it does nothing. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Temp Hunter's Card
items.info: A Hunter licence of the kind issued to temporary hires.
items.where: Temp Hunter, Dark Continent Expedition Team

items.name: The Swashbuckling Adventures of Dino Hunter
items.info: A battered adventure book about a Hunter who journeys to unknown places. Children of the dumps read it until it falls apart and dream of the licence. 800 Jenny, sold at Junk Market.

items.name: Thief
items.info: Spell card No. 1007, rank C, limit 50 copies. Steals one card at random from another player's specified slots, the slots that count toward winning. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Tier Boss's Book
items.info: A book of debts owed on the fourth tier.

items.name: Tinned Scavenged Food
items.info: A dented tin with no label, picked out of the rubbish of the outside world. It might be beans or peaches, and in Meteor City nobody complains. 200 Jenny, sold at Junk Market.

items.name: Tome of a Thousand Tales
items.info: Specified card No. 023, rank B, limit 30 copies. A book that tells a new story every time it is opened. A bookmark comes with it, for a reader who wants to find the same tale again. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Tonpa's Canned Juice
items.info: An ordinary can of orange juice from a vending machine, the same brand Tonpa carries in his satchel. Bought sealed, it is perfectly safe. 150 Jenny, sold at Zaban City.

items.name: Tonpa's Laxative Juice
items.info: A can of fruit juice that Tonpa hands to rookies as a friendly welcome, laced with enough laxative to end an exam. Killua drank one and felt nothing. Found, never sold: Exam Tunnel.

items.name: Toraemon
items.info: Specified card No. 022, rank A, limit 22 copies. A rare beast near extinction that tucks whatever it finds into a pocket deeper than its body. Nobody knows what treasures it has picked up until it empties out. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Touchscreen Smartphone
items.info: A flat phone that is all glass in front, the model most people carry by the time of the election. It browses, films and pays as well as it calls. 50000 Jenny, sold at Saloma Mall.

items.name: Tour Bus Ticket
items.info: A seat on Lamentation Tours' sightseeing bus up to the Zoldyck gate, with the guide's patter about the assassins included. 1500 Jenny, sold at Dentora Region.

items.name: Trace
items.info: Spell card No. 1027, rank E, limit 90 copies. Keeps a target player's whereabouts known to the caster until the target leaves the game. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Trade
items.info: Spell card No. 1008, rank E, limit 100 copies. Swaps a random card of the caster's for a random card of the target's. Drawn at random from a shop pack. Found, never sold: Spell Card Shop.

items.name: Trail Ration Bar
items.info: A dense bar of oats, nuts and honey wrapped in foil. One keeps a runner going through a long day; applicants buy them at the port before the exam. 400 Jenny, sold at Dolle Harbor.

items.name: Trained Killer's Pin Case
items.info: A slim case of steel pins, the tool of a family that kills at close range.

items.name: Transport Ticket
items.info: Free card No. 266, rank B, limit 150 copies. A ticket for a safe way off the island and out of the game. The harbourmaster at the port is the one who has them, for a bribe or a beating. Found, never sold: Greed Island Port.

items.name: Tree of Plenty
items.info: Specified card No. 009, rank S, limit 10 copies. A tree hung with every kind of fruit at once. Strip it bare and it is full again by morning, though what grows, and how much, is left to chance. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Triple-Star Pin
items.info: A pin with three stars; about ten living Hunters wear one.

items.name: Tryout Number Card
items.info: A paper number pinned on for the tryout in Battera's castle.

items.name: TSK-17 Vial
items.info: A sealed vial of a germ Kakin's military bred for war and shelved as a failure. Those it infects die of organ failure about half a day later, which makes it a quiet weapon in the right hands. Found, never sold: Tier 4.

items.name: Umbrella Sword
items.info: A black umbrella whose handle draws out as a blade and whose tip can fire a shot. Folded, it hides under a slim robe without a bulge. Feitan carries one; this is a copy from Meteor City's stalls, every bit as nasty. 300000 Jenny, sold at Junk Market.

items.name: Underboss's Bounty Notice
items.info: A notice offering money for a man's whereabouts.

items.name: Underboss's Fortune Sheet
items.info: A sheet of handwritten verse in a girl's looping hand.

items.name: Underboss's Knuckle Rings
items.info: Heavy rings worn on every finger of a big fist.

items.name: Underboss's Payroll Book
items.info: A small book of bribes paid and owed.

items.name: Underground Auction Invitation
items.info: A plain card naming its holder a guest of the Mafia's own sale, where goods that cannot be sold in daylight change hands. Only the families and their clients are given one. Found, never sold: Cemetery Building.

items.name: Unicorn Tribesman Skull
items.info: The skull of a man of the Unicorn Tribe, a rare find for a flesh collector. Baise brought it for Neon's collection. Found, never sold: Nostrade's Mansion.

items.name: Universal Survey
items.info: Specified card No. 034, rank B, limit 30 copies. Write questions about yourself on this form and hand it to someone; they answer every one truthfully. The form can be used again. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Vending Check-Up
items.info: Specified card No. 061, rank A, limit 20 copies. A coin-in-the-slot booth that scans the whole body and gives one of two answers, all clear or see a doctor. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Veteran's Card Notes
items.info: A pocket notebook listing cards, prices and shops inside the game.

items.name: Vice Chairman's Seal
items.info: A seal of office that carries deputy power while the chair is empty.

items.name: Villager's Wooden Spoon
items.info: A spoon whittled by hand, the kind every NGL household uses.

items.name: Virtual Restaurant
