items.info: Specified card No. 063, rank B, limit 30 copies. Order anything at all and eat until full, though the meal is only an illusion. Diners get a vitamin pill on the way out. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Voucher
items.info: Free card No. 102, rank SS, limit 150 copies. A claim ticket that becomes an Angel's Breath as soon as one of those cards can exist again. Found, never sold: Masadora.

items.name: Ward Resident's Pass
items.info: A pass to the ward Camilla built on her land.

items.name: Warehouse Man's Card Deck
items.info: A greasy deck of cards from a warehouse guard post.

items.name: Watch Rotation Slip
items.info: A scrawled rota of who watches the hideout each night.

items.name: Water Canteen
items.info: A metal canteen in a felt cover that keeps water cool a little longer. Out in the Gordeau Desert it is never filled too often. 800 Jenny, sold at Desert Roadhouse.

items.name: Water Divination Glass
items.info: A plain drinking glass and a dried leaf kept between two pages, the kit for repeating the test that named your category.

items.name: Whale Island Fishing Rod
items.info: A long flexible rod with a heavy line and a weighted hook, sold to the island's anglers. Gon used his to land the swamp's great fish, and in the exam as a whip and a grapnel. 5000 Jenny, sold at Whale Island Fish Market.

items.name: Wild Luck Alexandrite
items.info: Specified card No. 075, rank A, limit 20 copies. A ring set with a great stone. Its wearer lives through things that happen once in a lifetime, and has no say in whether they are good or terrible. Found, never sold: Sick Huts.

items.name: Wingman's Risky Dice
items.info: A die that grants great luck or great misfortune.

items.name: Witch's Diet Pills
items.info: Specified card No. 066, rank B, limit 28 copies. Each pill melts away a kilo. A vial holds two hundred, and swallowing more than one's own weight in kilos is fatal. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Witch's Love Potion
items.info: Specified card No. 064, rank B, limit 30 copies. A vial of five hundred pills. Kiss one and get the one you want to drink it, and they fall in love with you for a week. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Witch's Rejuvenation Potion
items.info: Specified card No. 065, rank S, limit 10 copies. Each pill takes a year off the body and none off the mind. Taking more pills than one's age kills. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Wooden Vault
items.info: An old kind of disguised safe, this one carved as a robed woman. Opened, it holds valuables; one that went for 7,000 at a stall sold, with its treasure, for 355 million at the Preview Market. 7000 Jenny, sold at Bull Market.

items.name: X-Ray Goggles
items.info: Specified card No. 021, rank B, limit 27 copies. Goggles that see through walls, boxes and clothes to a depth set on a dial. The one thing they cannot see into is a sealed pack from the spell card shop. Found, never sold: in-game.

items.name: Yorknew Street Map
items.info: A folding map of the city, its stations, hotels, markets and auction houses, sold by the thousand during the auction weeks. 1000 Jenny, sold at Yorknew City.

abilities.name: A Hatsu of Your Own
abilities.info:
You have found the idea for an ability yourself, the way the teachers wait for, and built it to fit who you are. Greatly improves the next hatsu action with the ability you designed. Spends 6 Aura.
[Skill: nen 18]

abilities.name: A Property Given
abilities.info:
Your aura takes on the property you chose for it, and holds it while you work. Greatly improves the next transmutation action to give your aura its property. Spends 4 Aura.
[Skill: transmutation 12]

abilities.name: Academy Drill
abilities.info:
Weapons drill timed against a record. Greatly improves the next action with a firearm or a field weapon.
[Trait: Kakin Military: Private Second Class]

abilities.name: Admissible Evidence
abilities.info:
You know what a court will accept. Greatly improves the next action to build a legal case.
[Trait: Ministry of Justice: Deputy Chief Prosecutor]

needs.variable: Ministry of Justice: Deputy Chief Prosecutor

abilities.name: Afterimage Step
abilities.info:
You vary your rhythm so the eye sees several of you, and the real one is already behind them. Greatly improves the next assassination action to confuse and close on a target.
[Skill: assassination 24]

abilities.name: Aid Book
abilities.info:
Foreign money moved where it was never meant to go. Greatly improves the next action to embezzle, launder or hide money.
[Trait: East Gorteau regime: Regional Officer]

abilities.name: All In
abilities.info:
All the strength you would ever have grown into and every scrap of Nen you would ever have, poured into this one fight. Greatly improves the next action of the one fight you gave everything for. Once, ever.
[Trait: Vow: Everything for One Fight]

abilities.name: All or Nothing
abilities.info:
The Specialist's ability you hold does its one strange thing completely, or not at all. Greatly improves the next specialization action with your ability. Spends 4 Aura.
[Skill: specialization 12]

abilities.name: All-Round Training
abilities.info:
A paladin trains for every kind of hunt. Greatly improves the next action outside your own field of work.
[Trait: Pure Paladin Squad: Claimant]

abilities.name: Always Hunting
abilities.info:
A Hunter is always hunting something, and you always have a quarry in mind. Greatly improves the next action to pursue a long-term goal of your field.
[Trait: Licensed Hunter]

abilities.name: Ambush in the Woods
abilities.info:
You strike from cover and are gone. Greatly improves the next stealth action to ambush.
[Skill: stealth 18]

abilities.name: Ancient Rite
abilities.info:
You know the old burial customs. Greatly improves the next action to perform or recognise a rite.
[Trait: Have-Nots: Afterlife Companion]

abilities.name: Animal Keeper Habit
abilities.info:
A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to calm, feed or read an animal.
[Trait: Animal Keeper]

abilities.name: Antidote From the Leaf
abilities.info:
You find the cure in the plant beside the poison. Greatly improves the next botany action to make a remedy.
[Skill: botany 12]

abilities.name: Antidote Ready
abilities.info:
You carry the cure as well. Greatly improves the next poisons action to cure a poisoning.
[Skill: poisons 24]

abilities.name: Antiques Dealer Habit
abilities.info:
A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to price an object or find who would pay most for it.
[Trait: Antiques Dealer]

abilities.name: Any Other Change
abilities.info:
The glass at Water Divination shows a change no other category makes, and the aura behind it answers you. It is held only by a Specialist. Greatly improves the next specialization action to use your strange aura. Spends 2 Aura.
[Skill: specialization 6]

abilities.name: Applicant's Nerve
abilities.info:

Pairs well with: Animal Keeper, Forest Child. The animals that answer.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Beast Hunter
traits.info:
Your field is animals: magical beasts, the rare and the undocumented, found, studied and protected.

Gives: Wit +1; Beast Lore +1; unlocks as you train: Field Notes (Beast Lore 6), Weak Spot (Beast Lore 12), Undocumented Find (Beast Lore 18), Protected Ground (Beast Lore 24).
Pairs well with: Animal Keeper, Survey Crew Hand. The animals of the field.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Begerossé Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the Begerossé Union, the great power between the Yorbian Continent and the Azian Continent, where trade passes both ways and so does everyone's business.

Gives: Wit +1; Negotiation +1, Appraisal +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Between Two Markets (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to broker a trade between people who do not trust each other).
Pairs well with: Antiques Dealer, Polyglot. The trade between continents.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Big Appetite
traits.info:
You eat enough for three and turn all of it into energy.

Gives: Endurance +1.
Pairs well with: Gourmet Hunter, Restaurant Cook. The appetite that fuels the body.

traits.name: Blacklist Hunter
traits.info:
Your field is people: the wanted, the dangerous and the bounties on their heads.

Gives: Wit +1; Bounty Hunting +1; unlocks as you train: Wanted List (Bounty Hunting 6), Fugitive's Habits (Bounty Hunting 12), Cornered (Bounty Hunting 18), Bounty Collected (Bounty Hunting 24).
Pairs well with: Firearms, Vengeful. The hunt for the wanted.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Blacklisted
traits.info: There is a bounty on your head. Police and soldiers attack on sight, and Blacklist Hunters follow you.

traits.name: Bladework
traits.info:
You fight with a blade: a sword from a sheath, a knife from a sleeve, a quick draw that ends things before they start.

Gives: Blades +2; technique Bladework Opening (The blade leaves the sheath and the first cut is already made. Greatly improves the next blades action to open a fight on your own terms); unlocks as you train: Quick Draw (Blades 6), Blade From Nothing (Blades 12, with Conjurer), Shadow Cut (Ninja 12, with Cloud-Hidden Ninja), Sleeve Knife (Blades 12), Parry and Cut (Blades 18), One Draw (Blades 24); starts with Swordsman's Short Blade (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Jappon Born, Conjured Weapon. The edge and its draw.

Primary Attribute: Speed

traits.name: Board Strategist
traits.info:
Gungi, chess and every board game where a hundred moves ahead is not far enough. You see the board whole.

Gives: Wit +1; Games +1; unlocks as you train: Opening Book (Games 6), Deep Read (Games 12), Endgame (Games 18), Board Seen Whole (Games 24).
Pairs well with: Gungi Parlour Regular, Quick Study. The board seen whole.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Born Strong
traits.info:
You were strong before anyone trained you. As a child you could lift what grown men could not, and a heavy door is only a door.

Gives: Body +1; Might +1.
Pairs well with: Rock-Breaker, Strong Back. The strength from the start.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Botanical Hunter
traits.info:
Your field is plants: the useful, the poisonous and the rare, found, named and kept alive.

Gives: Wit +1; Botany +1; unlocks as you train: Plant Named (Botany 6), Antidote From the Leaf (Botany 12), Rare Bloom (Botany 18), Living Collection (Botany 24).
Pairs well with: Herb Gatherer, NGL Born. The green field.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Card Strategist
traits.info:
You play the long game with cards: collecting, trading, holding the one card that wins the round, and counting what everyone else holds.

Gives: Wit +1; Games +1; unlocks as you train: Card Count (Games 6), Hand Built (Games 12), Trade Up (Games 18), Deciding Card (Games 24).
Pairs well with: Head for Numbers, Poker Face. The card in hand.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Cha-R Family: Deck Boss
traits.info: Rank 3 of 5 in Cha-R Family: Deck Boss.

traits.name: Cha-R Family: Second-Track Faker
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in Cha-R Family: Second-Track Faker.

traits.name: Cha-R Family: Soldier
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in Cha-R Family: Soldier.

traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in Cha-R Family: Underboss.

traits.name: Cha-R Family: Warehouse Man
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in Cha-R Family: Warehouse Man.

traits.name: Charged Aura
traits.info:
You give your aura the property of a current: a touch that jolts, a strike that locks muscles.

Gives: Speed +1; Transmutation +1; unlocks as you train: Static Touch (Transmutation 6), Locking Current (Transmutation 12), Current Through the Shell (Transmutation 18), Charged Reflexes (Transmutation 24).
Pairs well with: Unarmed Fighting, Fast Reflexes. The current in the hand.

Primary Attribute: Speed

traits.name: Clean Name
traits.info:
No record holds your name in any bad light, and officials see an honest traveller.

Gives: Negotiation +1.
Pairs well with: Temp Hunter, Ochima Born. The papers in order.

traits.name: Close Protection
traits.info:
You keep one person alive: you choose the seats, check the exits, and stand between your charge and the window.

Gives: Spirit +1; Awareness +1; unlocks as you train: Sightlines (Awareness 6), Body Between (Awareness 12), Safe Route (Awareness 18), Threat in the Crowd (Awareness 24).
Pairs well with: Light Sleeper, Kakin Royal Guard. The one who must live.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Cloud-Hidden Ninja
traits.info:
You trained in Jappon's Cloud-Hidden Style: the shadowing, the hidden blade and the long patience of a spy who is also a fighter.

Gives: Speed +1; Ninja +2; Health +10 (maximum and starting); unlocks as you train: Shadowing (Ninja 6), Blade From the Sleeve (Ninja 12), Shadow Cut (Ninja 12, with Bladework), Neck Strike (Ninja 18), Ninja's Patience (Ninja 24); starts with Concealed Arm Blade (damage +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Jappon Born, Shadow Tail. The island's hidden school.

Primary Attribute: Speed

traits.name: Coma
traits.info: You gave everything for one fight. Your body did not survive what your aura became.

traits.name: Condition: A Medium Kept for Years
traits.info:
Your ability works through one object you have carried for years. Without it, nothing happens. With it, the control is strong.

Gives: technique Old Medium (The medium in your hand is part of you after all these years, and the ability holds hard through it. Greatly improves the next manipulation action through your long-owned medium).
Pairs well with: Manipulator, Puppet Medium. The object and the years.

traits.name: Condition: Named and Explained
traits.info:
Your ability works only once the target has heard its name and how it works. You have to say it out loud, and then it holds.

Gives: technique Explained Hold (You finish explaining, and the ability takes hold with the strength the explanation bought. Greatly improves the next Hatsu action against a target who has heard how it works).
Pairs well with: Conjurer, Card Strategist. The ability spoken aloud.

traits.name: Condition: Touch First
traits.info:
Your ability needs a touch: a hand on the shoulder, a tap on the back, a finger on the skin. After that, the target is marked.

Gives: technique Marked by Touch (The hand has already touched them, and the mark answers. Greatly improves the next Hatsu action against a target you have touched).
Pairs well with: Pickpocket, Pressure Point Striker. The touch that marks.

traits.name: Conjured Beast
traits.info:
You conjure a creature of aura, a Nen beast with a shape and a temper of its own, bound by rules you gave it.

Gives: Spirit +1; Conjuration +1; unlocks as you train: Beast Called (Conjuration 6), Beast's Nature (Conjuration 12), Beast Sent Out (Conjuration 18), Beast Grown (Conjuration 24).
Pairs well with: Animal Keeper, Vow: A Rule on My Hatsu. The creature and its rules.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Conjured Tool
traits.info:
You conjure a tool, not a weapon: something that finds, stores, carries or cleans, and one strange thing besides.

Gives: Wit +1; Conjuration +1; unlocks as you train: Tool to Hand (Conjuration 6), Tool's Use (Conjuration 12), Tool's Rule (Conjuration 18), Tool Held Long (Conjuration 24).
Pairs well with: Steady Hands, Archive Copyist. The useful object.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Conjured Weapon
traits.info:
You made a weapon from aura through months of imagery training. It appears in your hand when you call it and does what its conditions say.

Gives: Body +1; Conjuration +1; unlocks as you train: Weapon in Hand (Conjuration 6), Weapon's Rule (Conjuration 12), Unbreakable Make (Conjuration 18), Weapon Remade (Conjuration 24).
Pairs well with: Bladework, Condition: Named and Explained. The weapon from nothing.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Conjurer
traits.info:
When you did Water Divination, specks appeared in the water. Your aura can become a real object, one that even people without Nen can see and touch, bound by the conditions you set it.

Gives: Wit +1; Conjuration +2, Nen +1; Aura +10 (maximum and starting); unlocks as you train: Imagery Training (Conjuration 6), Blade From Nothing (Blades 12, with Bladework), Object Made Real (Conjuration 12), Condition Kept (Conjuration 18), Called and Dismissed (Conjuration 24); starts with Water Divination Glass.
Pairs well with: Conjured Weapon, Condition: Named and Explained. The object and its rules.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Counterpuncher
traits.info:
You let them come. You read the first blow, slip it and answer before they recover.

Gives: Speed +1; Agility +1; unlocks as you train: Slip (Agility 6), Counter (Agility 12), Bait (Agility 18), Perfect Counter (Agility 24).
Pairs well with: Fast Reflexes, Unarmed Fighting. The answer to the first blow.

Primary Attribute: Speed

traits.name: Crippled
traits.info: The initiation that opened your nodes broke something too. Your body is weaker and slower to recover until a healer who uses Nen mends it.

traits.name: Dark Continent Expedition Team: Alternate
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in Dark Continent Expedition Team: Alternate.

traits.name: Dark Continent Expedition Team: Expedition Leader
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in Dark Continent Expedition Team: Expedition Leader.

traits.name: Dark Continent Expedition Team: Field Commander
traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in Dark Continent Expedition Team: Field Commander.

traits.name: Dark Continent Expedition Team: Stone Wall Mercenary
traits.info: Rank 3 of 5 in Dark Continent Expedition Team: Stone Wall Mercenary.

traits.name: Dark Continent Expedition Team: Temp Hunter
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in Dark Continent Expedition Team: Temp Hunter.

traits.name: Deckhand
traits.info:
You worked the decks of ships on long voyages, hauling lines and keeping your feet in a storm.

Gives: Seafaring +1, Might +1; technique Deckhand Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to work a ship, keep footing on a heaving deck or haul something heavy).
Pairs well with: Seaport Born, Mimbo Born. The decks.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Diagnostician
traits.info:
You find the cause: the poison behind the fever, the wound behind the limp, the lie behind the symptom.

Gives: Wit +1; Deduction +1; unlocks as you train: Symptom Read (Deduction 6), Hidden Poison (Deduction 12), Lie in the Symptom (Deduction 18), Rare Disease (Deduction 24).
Pairs well with: Quick Study, Medical Student. The cause behind the sign.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Dockside Labourer
traits.info:
You loaded and unloaded cargo for a wage, sun or rain, and you know what a full day's work costs a body.

Gives: Might +1, Endurance +1; technique Dockside Labourer Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to lift, carry or keep working when the body says stop).
Pairs well with: Have-Not of Kakin, Seaport Born. The hard day's work.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Dual Affinity
traits.info:
Your aura sits between two categories. You learn the neighbouring one as fast as your own, though it still runs a little weaker.

Gives: Spirit +1; Nen +1.
Pairs well with: Charged Aura, Rock-Breaker. The second category close at hand.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: East Gorteau Born
traits.info:
You grew up in East Gorteau, the closed country, where the neighbours were paid to point at each other and a careless word could take a family away.

Gives: Wit +1; Deception +1, Resolve +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Guarded Tongue (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to keep a secret under questioning or to spot the person in the room who reports to someone).
Pairs well with: Poker Face, Grudge Against the Powerful. The closed country's habits.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: East Gorteau regime: Informant
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in East Gorteau regime: Informant.

traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in East Gorteau regime: Minister.

traits.name: East Gorteau regime: Secretary of State
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in East Gorteau regime: Secretary of State.

traits.name: Eidetic Memory
traits.info:
You remember what you have seen once: a page, a face, a map, a sequence of moves.

Gives: Wit +1; Lore +1.
Pairs well with: Archive Copyist, Card Strategist. The memory that keeps everything.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Emitted Familiar
traits.info:
You cast a piece of your aura away from you in a shape of its own, a creature or a figure that acts on your orders while you stand elsewhere.

Gives: Spirit +1; Command +1; unlocks as you train: Aura Figure (Command 6), Figure on Watch (Command 12), Figure in the Fight (Command 18), Several Figures (Command 24).
Pairs well with: Animal Keeper, Professional Gamer. The figure sent out to work.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Emitter
traits.info:
When you did Water Divination, the water changed colour. Your aura keeps working after it leaves your body, across a room or farther.

Gives: Spirit +1; Emission +2, Nen +1; Aura +10 (maximum and starting); unlocks as you train: Handstand Launch (Emission 6), Aura Shell (Emission 12), Aura in the Barrel (Firearms 12, with Firearms), Lingering Emission (Emission 18), Long Reach (Emission 24); starts with Water Divination Glass.
Pairs well with: Aura Shot Specialist, Firearms. The reach of the shot.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: En Sphere
traits.info:
You spread your aura around you in a sphere and feel everything inside it, the shape and movement of every body, as long as your strength holds.

Gives: Spirit +1; Nen +1; unlocks as you train: Two-Metre Sphere (Nen 6), Room-Wide (Nen 12), Shaped En (Nen 18), Fifty Metres (Nen 24).
Pairs well with: Mafia Bodyguard, Light Sleeper. The sense that fills a room.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Enhancer
traits.info:
When you did Water Divination, the water in the glass rose and spilled over the rim. Your aura makes things stronger: your body, your blows and whatever you hold.

Gives: Body +1; Enhancement +2, Nen +1; Aura +10 (maximum and starting); unlocks as you train: Rock-Breaking Drill (Enhancement 6), Enhanced Knockout (Unarmed 12, with Unarmed Fighting), Reinforced Flesh (Enhancement 12), Quickened Healing (Enhancement 18), The Enhancer's Fist (Enhancement 24); starts with Water Divination Glass.
Pairs well with: Unarmed Fighting, Ko Striker. The straightest road to power.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Era: Greed Island
traits.info:
September 1999 to March 2000. A billionaire is buying every copy of the game Greed Island and hiring players to clear it, and some of the players are killing the others.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Professional Gamer, Card Strategist. The game and its players.
unlockedBy: The Woman on the Floating Seat

traits.name: Era: Heavens Arena
traits.info:
Spring and summer of 1999, when fighters climb the tower of Heavens Arena for prize money, and those who reach the 200th floor learn what the floors above it are really about.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Heavens Arena Fighter, Shingen-ryu Disciple. The tower and its teachers.

traits.name: Era: The 287th Hunter Exam
traits.info:
January 1999, and the year's Hunter Exam opens in the first week of the month, with hundreds of applicants, a set of examiners nobody can predict and a Chairman older than anyone can remember.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Hunter Exam Applicant, Repeat Applicant. The year's exam.

traits.name: Era: The Black Whale
traits.info:
August 2001. The great ship Black Whale sails from Kakin for the Dark Continent with two hundred thousand passengers, the Hunters, the royal family and its fourteen princes aboard. The voyage will settle who rules Kakin, one way or another.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Kakin Royal Guard, Provisional Hunter. The voyage and its passengers.

traits.name: Era: The Chimera Ant Crisis
traits.info:
Spring and summer of 2000, and something has gone into the NGL and is eating people. Hunters are going in after it, and few are coming out.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Beast Hunter, NGL Born. The nest and the hunt.

traits.name: Era: The Election and After
traits.info:
From August 2000, the Association has no Chairman and must elect one. The twelve Zodiacs run the vote, and every Hunter has a ballot.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Licensed Hunter, Temp Hunter. The Association's vote.
unlockedBy: The Boy in the Private Ward

traits.name: Era: Yorknew City
traits.info:
The end of August and the first days of September 1999. The Mafia's auctions bring the world's collectors to Yorknew City, and the Phantom Troupe comes to the city as well.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Mafia Bodyguard, Auction House Hand. The auction city.

traits.name: Estate Butler-in-Training
traits.info:
You trained as a butler for a family that does not have ordinary butlers: fitness drills, coin games, long hours guarding a gate and a rulebook stricter than any army's.

Gives: Might +1, Awareness +1; technique Estate Butler-in-Training Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to stand a long guard, obey a hard order or move fast when the house needs it).
Pairs well with: Padokea Born, Steady Nerves. The estate's service.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Expedition Guard
traits.info:
You guard surveys and expeditions into wild country: you keep the camp, scout the trail and shoot what comes for the scientists.

Gives: Body +1; Wildcraft +1; unlocks as you train: Camp Made (Wildcraft 6), Trail Scouted (Wildcraft 12), Beast Driven Off (Wildcraft 18), Party Brought Home (Wildcraft 24).
Pairs well with: Forest Child, Animal Keeper. The camp in the wild.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Family Enforcer
traits.info:
You are the family's heavy hand: the debt collected, the warning delivered, the door broken in.

Gives: Body +1; Streetwise +1; unlocks as you train: Warning Delivered (Streetwise 6), Debt Collected (Streetwise 12), Door Broken (Streetwise 18), Turf Held (Streetwise 24).
Pairs well with: Mafia Soldier, Short Temper. The family's hand.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Fast Reflexes
traits.info:
Your body moves before your head has finished deciding.

Gives: Agility +1.
Pairs well with: Counterpuncher, Charged Aura. The quick body.

traits.name: Field Surgeon
traits.info:
You can operate where there is no hospital: on a table, on a floor, in the back of a moving car.

Gives: Wit +1; Medicine +1; unlocks as you train: Kitchen-Table Surgery (Medicine 6), Bullet Out (Medicine 12), Bleeding Stopped (Medicine 18), Limb Saved (Medicine 24).
Pairs well with: Steady Hands, Medical Student. The knife in a crisis.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Firearms
traits.info:
You shoot: a pistol in a hand, a rifle on a shoulder, a submachine gun from a moving car. Most of the world's armies and all of its Mafia carry guns.

Gives: Firearms +2; technique Firearms Opening (The gun is out and aimed before anyone else has decided to draw. Greatly improves the next firearms action to open a fight on your own terms); unlocks as you train: Guard's Draw (Firearms 6, with Mafia Bodyguard), Steady Aim (Firearms 6), Aura in the Barrel (Firearms 12, with Emitter), Double Tap (Firearms 12), Suppressing Fire (Firearms 18), Trick Shot (Firearms 24); starts with Holstered Revolver (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Mafia Soldier, Kakin Royal Guard. The gun as the world's weapon.

Primary Attribute: Speed

traits.name: Fisher's Child
traits.info:
You grew up hauling nets and gutting fish, and you know the weather by the colour of the sea.

Gives: Seafaring +1, Wildcraft +1; technique Fisher's Child Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to read the sea and the weather, or to wait without moving until the moment comes).
Pairs well with: Whale Island Born, Rod and Line. The boats and the nets.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Forest Child
traits.info:
You were raised half wild, among trees and animals, and the woods treat you as one of their own.

Gives: Body +1; Wildcraft +1, Agility +1.
Pairs well with: Natural Climber, Animal Keeper. The woods as home.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Freelance Assassins: Contract Killer
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in Freelance Assassins: Contract Killer.

traits.name: Gambling Habit
traits.info:
You cannot walk past a game for stakes, and you raise when you should fold.

Gives: Wit -1.
Pairs well with: Lucky Streak, Card Strategist. The table that keeps calling.

traits.name: Gifted Talent
traits.info:
You have a gift for Nen that teachers notice at once: one in a hundred thousand, the sort that grasps in months what takes others years.

Gives: Spirit +1; Nen +1.
Pairs well with: Shingen-ryu Disciple, Unawakened. The talent and its teacher.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Gourmet Hunter
traits.info:
Your field is food: rare ingredients from impossible places, and the cooking that does them justice.

Gives: Wit +1; Gourmet +1; unlocks as you train: Single Taste (Gourmet 6), Remote Ingredient (Gourmet 12), Examiner's Dish (Gourmet 18), Poacher Chase (Gourmet 24).
Pairs well with: Restaurant Cook, Big Appetite. The kitchen and the hunt for it.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Greedy
traits.info:
Money matters to you more than it should, and a big enough sum can make you forget whose side you are on.

Gives: Spirit -1.
Pairs well with: Antiques Dealer, Hired Blade. The price of everything.

traits.name: Grudge Against the Powerful
traits.info:
You hate the rich, the royal and the bosses who never pay for what they do, and you cannot hide it.

Gives: Spirit -1.
Pairs well with: Have-Not of Kakin, Meteor City Born. The bottom looking up.

traits.name: Gungi Parlour Regular
traits.info:
You spent your evenings at the board-game parlours playing Gungi and every other game for small stakes and big reputations.

Gives: Games +1, Negotiation +1; technique Gungi Parlour Regular Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to win a board game or read an opponent across a table).
Pairs well with: Board Strategist, Professional Gamer. The parlour.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Gyo Watcher
traits.info:
You put aura into your eyes before you do anything else. Hidden aura, a hidden construct, a trap in a doorway: you see them first.

Gives: Wit +1; Awareness +1; unlocks as you train: Number in the Air (Awareness 6), Reading the Gather (Awareness 12), Hidden Construct Found (Awareness 18), Gyo Always (Awareness 24).
Pairs well with: Wild Senses, Keen Ears. The senses that miss nothing.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Gyudondond Born
traits.info:
You are of the Gyudondond, a small wild tribe driven off its land by development. Its men make music through their own bodies, and before a fight its dancing warriors play songs of battle on them.

Gives: Spirit +1; Music +1, Unarmed +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Tribal Rhythm (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to fight, march or work to a rhythm only your people know).
Pairs well with: Grudge Against the Powerful, Unarmed Fighting. The tribe's songs.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Hacker Hunter
traits.info:
Your field is the network: computers, Cyberspace, and the crimes and secrets that live in them.

Gives: Wit +1; Hacking +1; unlocks as you train: Back Door (Hacking 6), Deleted Files (Hacking 12), Trail in the Network (Hacking 18), Cyber Crime Case (Hacking 24).
Pairs well with: Network Hacker, Saherta Born. The network field.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Hard to Kill
traits.info:
You have survived things that should have killed you, and your body has learned the habit.

Gives: Health +10 (maximum and starting).
Pairs well with: Iron Body, Meteor City Born. The body that will not stop.

traits.name: Have-Not of Kakin
traits.info:
You were born at the bottom of Kakin's ladder, in the caste barred from office, and you learned early that nobody upstairs would help.

Gives: Body +1; Endurance +1, Streetwise +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Bottom of the Ladder (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to go unnoticed by the powerful or to get by on almost nothing).
Pairs well with: Dockside Labourer, Grudge Against the Powerful. The ones at the bottom.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Head for Numbers
traits.info:
You count cards, odds and money without trying.

Gives: Games +1.
Pairs well with: Card Strategist, Antiques Dealer. The numbers that win.

traits.name: Heavens Arena Fighter

You control people through something planted on them: a pin, a needle, a mark. The harder it is to plant, the harder it holds.

Gives: Wit +1; Manipulation +1; unlocks as you train: Planting (Manipulation 6), Small Push (Manipulation 12), Puppet's Walk (Manipulation 18), Full Control (Manipulation 24).
Pairs well with: Thrown Weapons, Assassin's Upbringing. The person on the string.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Poison Specialist
traits.info:
Poison was in your food as a child. Now you know them all by taste, and you know which ones would kill someone who was not raised on them.

Gives: Wit +1; Poisons +1; unlocks as you train: Known by Taste (Poisons 6), Poison Shrugged Off (Poisons 12), Poison Prepared (Poisons 18), Antidote Ready (Poisons 24).
Pairs well with: Herb Gatherer, Iron Constitution. The poisoned cup.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Poker Face
traits.info:
Nothing shows on your face that you do not mean to show.

Gives: Deception +1.
Pairs well with: Card Strategist, Master of Disguise. The face that hides the hand.

traits.name: Pole Weapons
traits.info:
You fight with something long: a staff, a pole, a club, a spear. A tool nobody fears becomes the reason they lose.

Gives: Weapons +2; technique Pole Weapons Opening (The staff comes up between you and them, and they have to come through it. Greatly improves the next weapons action to open a fight on your own terms); unlocks as you train: Reach (Weapons 6), Sweep (Weapons 12), Vault (Weapons 18), Spinning Guard (Weapons 24); starts with Fighting Staff of Oak (damage +2 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Reinforced Weapon, Mountain Village Born. The reach of the weapon.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Polyglot
traits.info:
You pick up languages the way others pick up stones, and can get by in most countries.

Gives: Lore +1.
Pairs well with: Paleograph Hunter, Begerossé Born. The tongues of the world.

traits.name: Prayer of Thanks
traits.info:
Every day you give thanks with a fist: a bow, a prayer and a strike, over and over, until the strike is faster than the thought.

Gives: Spirit +1; Resolve +1; unlocks as you train: Daily Gratitude (Resolve 6), Faster Than Thought (Resolve 12), Calm Before the Blow (Resolve 18), Strike of Thanks (Resolve 24).
Pairs well with: Steady Nerves, Unarmed Fighting. The prayer before the strike.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Pressure Point Striker
traits.info:
You know where to press and where to hit to put a body down: a blow to the neck, a thumb under the ribs.

Gives: Speed +1; Unarmed +1; unlocks as you train: Nerve Strike (Unarmed 6), Choke Point (Unarmed 12), Sleep Point (Unarmed 18), Paralysing Touch (Unarmed 24).
Pairs well with: Unarmed Fighting, Medical Student. The body's weak places.

Primary Attribute: Speed

traits.name: Price in Flesh
traits.info:
You paid for your ability with your own body: fingers cut off, a scar carved, something you will never have back. Paid once, it powers the ability for good.

Gives: Speed -1; technique Paid-For Power (What you cut away is still paying for the ability, every time you use it. Greatly improves the next Hatsu action of the ability your flesh paid for).
Pairs well with: Aura Shot Specialist, Hard to Kill. The sacrifice already made.

traits.name: Prodigy
traits.info:
One in ten million: what takes others a year takes you a week, and the reckless way you live is how you learn it.

Gives: Nen +2.
Pairs well with: Reckless, Charged Aura. The talent that never stops to look.

traits.name: Professional Gamer
traits.info:
You play games for money and take them seriously: board games, cards, odds, and the strange Nen game Greed Island, which a billionaire pays fortunes to have cleared.

Gives: Wit +1; Games +2; Health +10 (maximum and starting); unlocks as you train: Rules First (Games 6), Trap in the Rules (Games 12), Table Read (Games 18), Game Clear (Games 24); starts with Gamer's Rule Notebook.
Pairs well with: Card Strategist, Gungi Parlour Regular. The games worth winning.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Provisional Hunter
traits.info:
You passed the Association's screening for the Kakin voyage and carry a Provisional Hunter's card, which needs no Nen and ends when the voyage does.

Gives: Awareness +1, Resolve +1; technique Provisional Hunter Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to call on the Hunters aboard or to pass a check with the provisional card); starts with Provisional Licence Card.
Pairs well with: Era: The Black Whale, Unawakened. The voyage's temporary Hunters.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Puppet Medium
traits.info:
You move objects through a medium you have kept for years: paper, a pipe's smoke, a set of needles, a doll.

Gives: Wit +1; Manipulation +1; unlocks as you train: Moving Medium (Manipulation 6), Medium as Weapon (Manipulation 12), Swarm of Medium (Manipulation 18), Medium Shield (Manipulation 24).
Pairs well with: Thrown Weapons, Condition: A Medium Kept for Years. The medium in motion.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Pure Paladin Squad: Claimant
traits.info: Rank 2 of 5 in Pure Paladin Squad: Claimant.

traits.name: Pure Paladin Squad: Hopeful
traits.info: Rank 1 of 5 in Pure Paladin Squad: Hopeful.

traits.name: Pure Paladin Squad: Keeper of the Name
traits.info: Rank 5 of 5 in Pure Paladin Squad: Keeper of the Name.

traits.info: Rank 4 of 5 in Pure Paladin Squad: Paladin Captain.

traits.name: Pure Paladin Squad: Sworn Paladin
traits.info: Rank 3 of 5 in Pure Paladin Squad: Sworn Paladin.

traits.name: Quick Study
traits.info:
You learn a new trick in a day and remember it for good.

Gives: Wit +1.
Pairs well with: Diagnostician, Board Strategist. The mind that learns.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.info:
You jump first and look while falling. It works more often than it should, and it will not always.

Gives: Wit -1.
Pairs well with: Hard to Kill, Risk: The Long Wind-Up. The leap before the look.

traits.name: Reinforced Weapon
traits.info:
You pour your aura into whatever you hold: a rod, a pipe, a club. In your hands an ordinary tool hits like a hammer and does not break.

Gives: Body +1; Weapons +1; unlocks as you train: Unbreakable Grip (Weapons 6), Heavy Swing (Weapons 12), Edge of Aura (Weapons 18), Weapon Through Steel (Weapons 24).
Pairs well with: Pole Weapons, Born Strong. The tool made strong.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Repeat Applicant
traits.info:
You have sat the exam before, more than once. You know how the phases feel, which rookies will break and which tricks still work.

Gives: Wit +1; Deception +1; unlocks as you train: Old Hand's Tips (Deception 6), Spiked Drink (Deception 12), Known Tricks (Deception 18), Rookie Crusher (Deception 24).
Pairs well with: Poker Face, Hired Exam Scout. The exam's old hands.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Restaurant Cook
traits.info:
You worked a hot kitchen through the dinner rush and learned what to do with any ingredient that came through the door.

Gives: Gourmet +1, Negotiation +1; technique Restaurant Cook Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to cook something good out of whatever is to hand).
Pairs well with: Gourmet Hunter, Big Appetite. The kitchen.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Ring-Out Specialist
traits.info:
You win by knocking people off the stage. Below the 200th floor a clean push is a win and nobody has to get hurt.

Gives: Body +1; Might +1; unlocks as you train: Clean Push (Might 6), Low Stance (Might 12), Throw Out (Might 18), Knockdown (Might 24).
Pairs well with: Unarmed Fighting, Strong Back. The clean win.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Risk: The Long Wind-Up
traits.info:
Your strongest blow needs a wind-up: a chant, a stance, a breath held. While you wind up you are wide open. The risk is what makes it hit so hard.

Gives: technique Wound-Up Blow (You chant, you set your stance, you take the risk of standing there open, and the blow comes out with everything. Greatly improves the next Nen strike made after an uninterrupted wind-up).
Pairs well with: Ko Striker, Reckless. The blow that costs the open moment.

traits.name: Rock-Breaker
traits.info:
You put your aura into the blow. Your training started with a stone in your fist and a thousand more stones to break with it.

Gives: Body +1; Might +1; unlocks as you train: Thousand Stones (Might 6), Grip of Iron (Might 12), Wall-Breaker (Might 18), Crater Blow (Might 24).
Pairs well with: Born Strong, Unarmed Fighting. The strength behind the blow.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Rod and Line
traits.info:
You fight with a fishing rod: the line that snags a wrist, the weighted float that hits like a stone, the pole that vaults you clear.

Gives: Weapons +2; technique Rod and Line Opening (The line flies out and catches something before the fight has properly begun. Greatly improves the next weapons action to open a fight on your own terms); unlocks as you train: Cast (Weapons 6), Hunter's Catch (Wildcraft 6, with Licensed Hunter), Snag (Weapons 12), Float Strike (Weapons 18), Reeled In (Weapons 24); starts with Angler's Fishing Rod (damage +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Whale Island Born, Fisher's Child. The rod as a weapon.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Rokario Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the Republic of Rokario, one of the small nations of the Mitene Union, with the NGL on one border and Hass on the other.

Gives: Body +1; Wildcraft +1, Tracking +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Border Country Roads (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to find a way along back roads and forest tracks near a closed border).
Pairs well with: Expedition Guard, Animal Keeper. The border country and its woods.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Rubbish-Shore Child
traits.info:
You grew up where the world's rubbish comes ashore, picking metal from the tide line and selling it to whoever paid.

Gives: Body +1; Appraisal +1, Endurance +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Tide-Line Salvage (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to judge, strip or sell salvage).
Pairs well with: Meteor City Scavenger, Big Appetite. The shore's scrap.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Ruins Hunter
traits.info:
Your field is the past: ruins found, opened, restored and protected so that a dead society lives again.

Gives: Wit +1; Ruins +1; unlocks as you train: Dated Stone (Ruins 6), Hidden Door (Ruins 12), Restoration (Ruins 18), Dead City Revived (Ruins 24).
Pairs well with: Archive Copyist, Mountain Village Born. The ruins and their peoples.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Run: The Canon Road
traits.info:
The story as the series tells it: the cast joins at its canon points, and nobody and nothing is changed before the start.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Era: The 287th Hunter Exam, Era: Heavens Arena. The story as written.

traits.name: Run: What If: Another Kurta Lives
traits.info:
What if the massacre missed one more? Another child of the Kurta Clan survived it and grew up with the scarlet eyes and the grief.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Scarlet-Eyed Kurta, Lukso Born. The clan's second survivor.

traits.name: Run: What If: Reborn Among the Ants
traits.info:
What if you were eaten in the NGL, and came back? A human taken by the Chimera Ants is born again in an Ant's body, still remembering.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Ant-Reborn, Era: The Chimera Ant Crisis. The life after the nest.

traits.name: Run: What If: The Specialist's Road
traits.info:
What if your category turned? A Conjurer or a Manipulator who takes this road has already become a Specialist when the story begins.

Gives: no bonus at creation; what it does comes in the story.
Pairs well with: Specialist's Turn, Conjured Tool. The category that turns.

traits.name: Ryu Flow
traits.info:
You move your aura around your body in the middle of an exchange, more here to strike, more there to block, faster than an opponent can read.

Gives: Speed +1; Ren +1; unlocks as you train: Seventy-Thirty (Ren 6), Flowing Dance (Ren 12), Read and Shift (Ren 18), Seamless Ryu (Ren 24).
Pairs well with: Shingen-ryu Disciple, Fast Reflexes. The aura in motion.

Primary Attribute: Speed

traits.name: Saherta Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the United States of Saherta, the great power in the middle of the Yorbian Continent, with Yorknew City among its cities.

Gives: Wit +1; Hacking +1, Negotiation +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Big Country Confidence (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to talk, pay or file your way through an office of a rich state).
Pairs well with: Network Hacker, Clean Name. The great power's screens and offices.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Scarlet-Eyed Kurta
traits.info:
You are of the Kurta Clan, and you lived. Your eyes turn scarlet when you feel strongly, and somewhere collectors would pay billions for them. It is offered only on the road where another Kurta lives.

Gives: Spirit +1; Resolve +1; unlocks as you train: Scarlet Surge (Resolve 6), Coloured Lenses (Resolve 12).
Pairs well with: Vengeful, Lukso Born. The clan and its grief.

Primary Attribute: Spirit
unlockedBy: Run: What If: Another Kurta Lives

traits.name: Seaport Born
traits.info:
You grew up in a busy seaport, among cranes, customs men and the ships that leave for every continent.

Gives: Wit +1; Seafaring +1, Streetwise +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Dockside Contacts (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to find passage, a crew or a cargo hold that nobody checks).
Pairs well with: Deckhand, Dockside Labourer. The harbour's trade.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Sent Blow
traits.info:
You send a blow through space: your fist goes in here and comes out where you want it, across the room or behind a door.

Gives: Spirit +1; Emission +1; unlocks as you train: Short Portal (Emission 6), Behind the Door (Emission 12), Sent Object (Emission 18), Long Portal (Emission 24).
Pairs well with: Unarmed Fighting, Would-Be Doctor. The blow from nowhere.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Shadow Tail
traits.info:
You follow people without being seen, for days if you must, and report where they went and whom they met.

Gives: Speed +1; Tracking +1; unlocks as you train: Tail in a Crowd (Tracking 6), Rooftop Tail (Tracking 12), Report (Tracking 18), Days on the Tail (Tracking 24).
Pairs well with: Wild Senses, Keen Ears. The patient watcher.

Primary Attribute: Speed

traits.name: Shaped Aura
traits.info:
You shape your aura into patterns, surfaces and false faces. A wall can look like stone, and so can a wound.

Gives: Wit +1; Deception +1; unlocks as you train: False Surface (Deception 6), Covered Wound (Deception 12), Borrowed Face (Deception 18), Painted Trap (Deception 24).
Pairs well with: Wanted, Poker Face. The false surface.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Shingen-ryu Disciple
traits.info:
You train in the Shingen-ryu school of kung fu, which teaches the body and the aura together, and you bow to your master before every lesson.

Gives: Spirit +1; Shingen Ryu +2; Aura +10 (maximum and starting); unlocks as you train: Flame of Focus (Shingen Ryu 6), School Strike (Shingen Ryu 12, with Unarmed Fighting), Will Into Act (Shingen Ryu 12), School Etiquette (Shingen Ryu 18), Master's Stance (Shingen Ryu 24); starts with Disciple's Practice Gi.
Pairs well with: Unawakened, Kumite Partner. The school's slow road.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Short Temper
traits.info:
You rise to a slight fast and say or do the thing you should not have.

Gives: Wit -1.
Pairs well with: Steady Nerves, Family Enforcer. The temper and its counter.

traits.name: Shu Wielder
traits.info:
You lay your aura over a tool so it fights as part of your body. A playing card cuts like a blade; a shovel digs through rock.

Gives: Body +1; Nen +1; unlocks as you train: Shovel Through Rock (Nen 6), Card Like a Blade (Nen 12), Weapon as Body (Nen 18), Shu Mastered (Nen 24).
Pairs well with: Thrown Weapons, Steady Hands. The tool that is part of you.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Specialist's Turn
traits.info:
Your category changed. You were a Conjurer or a Manipulator, and somewhere along the way your aura became something no category describes. It is offered only on the what-if road where a category turns.

Gives: Spirit +1; Specialization +2; unlocks as you train: Any Other Change (Specialization 6), All or Nothing (Specialization 12), Old Category Kept (Specialization 18), Beyond the Rules (Specialization 24).
Pairs well with: Conjurer, Manipulator. The categories that turn.

Primary Attribute: Spirit
unlockedBy: Run: What If: The Specialist's Road

traits.name: State: In
traits.info: You are hiding your aura with In: your technique cannot be seen without Gyo.

traits.name: State: Ken
traits.info: You are holding Ken: Ren spread evenly over your whole body as a guard. It is strong and it is tiring.

traits.name: State: Ko
traits.info: Everything is in one point: your Ko. That point hits like nothing else; every other part of you is bare.

traits.name: State: Ten
traits.info: You are holding Ten: aura wrapped close around your body, a steady guard against bloodlust and weak Nen.

traits.name: State: Zetsu
traits.info: You are in Zetsu: every node shut, presence gone, body resting, and no guard at all against Nen.

traits.name: Steady Hands
traits.info:
Your hands do not shake over a wound, a lock, a wire or a throw.

Gives: Speed +1.
Pairs well with: Field Surgeon, Thrown Weapons. The steady touch.

traits.name: Steady Nerves
traits.info:
In a crisis you go quiet and your hands stay steady.

Gives: Spirit +1.
Pairs well with: Prayer of Thanks, Estate Butler-in-Training. The nerve that holds.

traits.name: Strong Back
traits.info:
You can carry a load that would bend a stronger-looking person double.

Gives: Might +1.
Pairs well with: Dockside Labourer, Ring-Out Specialist. The labour's back.

traits.name: Survey Crew Hand
traits.info:
You worked with an amateur survey crew, cataloguing animals and plants in wild country for a Hunter who paid in experience as much as in money.

Gives: Tracking +1, Beast Lore +1; technique Survey Crew Hand Habit (A habit from the life before. Greatly improves the next action to observe, record or follow a creature in the wild).
Pairs well with: Beast Hunter, Expedition Guard. The survey camp.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Swardani City Born
traits.info:
You grew up in the sprawling city that holds the Hunter Association's headquarters, where licensed Hunters walk in and out of the tower every day.

Gives: Wit +1; Lore +1, Negotiation +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Headquarters Gossip (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to learn what the Hunter Association is doing, or who in it to ask).
Pairs well with: Licensed Hunter, Hunter Exam Applicant. The Association's own city.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Temp Hunter
traits.info:
Your field is whatever the government pays for. The Association hands down state work at a guaranteed fee, and other Hunters sneer at anyone who lives on it.

Gives: Spirit +1; Negotiation +1; unlocks as you train: Government Job (Negotiation 6), Fee Guaranteed (Negotiation 12), Official Channels (Negotiation 18), Career Temp (Negotiation 24).
Pairs well with: Clean Name, Swardani City Born. The steady government fee.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Thread Aura
traits.info:
You turn your aura into fine, strong thread: to bind, to snare, or to stitch a wound shut.

Gives: Wit +1; Medicine +1; unlocks as you train: Fine Thread (Transmutation 6), Aura Stitch (Transmutation 12), Snare Line (Transmutation 18), Tracking Thread (Transmutation 24).
Pairs well with: Would-Be Doctor, Steady Hands. The needle and the thread.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Thrown Weapons
traits.info:
You throw: cards, needles, darts, knives. You hit what you aim at from across a room, and some of what you throw comes back.

Gives: Thrown Weapons +2; technique Thrown Weapons Opening (A flick of the wrist, and the first card is in the air before they have moved. Greatly improves the next thrown weapons action to open a fight on your own terms); unlocks as you train: True Throw (Thrown Weapons 6), Pin From the Dark (Assassination 12, with Assassin's Upbringing), Pinned Sleeve (Thrown Weapons 12), Property on the Throw (Thrown Weapons 12, with Transmuter), Fan of Blades (Thrown Weapons 18), Steered Throw (Thrown Weapons 18, with Manipulator), Curving Throw (Thrown Weapons 24); starts with Deck of Throwing Cards (damage +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Shu Wielder, Puppet Medium. The throw that lands.

Primary Attribute: Speed

traits.name: Toll: Paid in Lifespan
traits.info:
The ability you hold as a Specialist runs on your own lifespan. Every moment it is active is paid for out of the years you have left, and the narrator keeps the count. It is open only on the what-if road where a category turns. The vow: every moment the ability runs costs you lifespan, counted by the narrator and never returned; while it runs, the ability works far beyond your level.

Gives: technique Lifespan Spent (You let the ability run and feel the years go, and it works far beyond anything your level should allow. Greatly improves the next specialization action while the ability runs).
Pairs well with: Specialist's Turn, Conjurer. The price of the turn.

traits.name: Transmuter
traits.info:
When you did Water Divination, the water changed its taste. Your aura can take on the properties of something else, and nobody without Nen can see what you have done.

Gives: Wit +1; Transmutation +2, Nen +1; Aura +10 (maximum and starting); unlocks as you train: Numbers on a Fingertip (Transmutation 6), A Property Given (Transmutation 12), Property on the Throw (Thrown Weapons 12, with Thrown Weapons), Unseen Snare (Transmutation 18), Property Mastered (Transmutation 24); starts with Water Divination Glass.
Pairs well with: Thrown Weapons, Charged Aura. The trick no one sees coming.

Primary Attribute: Spirit

traits.name: Unarmed Fighting
traits.info:
You fight with fists, feet, elbows and throws. It is how most people start at Heavens Arena, and how some never stop.

Gives: Unarmed +2; technique Unarmed Fighting Opening (You take your stance and the first exchange goes your way. Greatly improves the next unarmed action to open a fight on your own terms); unlocks as you train: Clean Hit (Unarmed 6), Crowd's Favourite (Unarmed 6, with Heavens Arena Fighter), Enhanced Knockout (Unarmed 12, with Enhancer), Guts Without Nen (Endurance 12, with Unawakened), School Strike (Shingen Ryu 12, with Shingen-ryu Disciple), Throw (Unarmed 12), Hold (Unarmed 18), Knockout (Unarmed 24); starts with Fighter's Hand Wraps (Unarmed +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Heavens Arena Fighter, Rock-Breaker. The fist as the first weapon.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Unawakened
traits.info:
Your aura nodes are still shut. You cannot see aura or use Nen yet, and a user's bloodlust hits you like a wall. You can learn it in play: slowly, under a teacher, or at once by Initiation, if you survive it.

Gives: Body +1; Endurance +1, Resolve +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); unlocks as you train: Nodes Opened (Nen 6), Guts Without Nen (Endurance 12, with Unarmed Fighting), The Leaf on the Glass (Nen 12), A Hatsu of Your Own (Nen 18), Late Bloom (Nen 24).
Pairs well with: Shingen-ryu Disciple, Hunter Exam Applicant. The roads that teach it.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Vengeful
traits.info:
Someone took something from you that cannot be given back. You will find them, and everything else comes second.

Gives: Spirit -1.
Pairs well with: Blacklist Hunter, Vow: On My Life. The score to settle.

traits.name: Vow Broken
traits.info: You broke a rule you swore on your Nen. The power it bought is gone, and you know it.

traits.name: Vow: A Rule on My Hatsu
traits.info:
You swore a rule onto your ability: only at night, only against one kind of foe, only after you have spoken first. Kept, the rule pays you in power. Broken, it takes the ability with it. The vow: name the rule when you take this pick; keep it and the ability is half again as strong, break it once and the ability is lost, perhaps with all your Nen.

Gives: technique Sworn Limitation (The rule you swore holds, and the ability answers with half again its strength. Greatly improves the next Hatsu action made inside the rule you swore).
Pairs well with: Conjured Weapon, Conjurer. The rule that pays.

traits.name: Vow: A Rule With a Penalty
traits.info:
You swore a rule onto your ability and named what you lose if you break it: a hand's use, your sight, your whole Nen. The stake doubles the ability's force. The vow: name the rule and its penalty when you take this pick; keep it and the ability strikes with double force, break it and the ability is lost and the penalty paid in full.

Gives: technique Penalty-Bound Strike (The rule holds with its penalty hanging over it, and the ability strikes with double force. Greatly improves the next Hatsu action made inside the rule you swore).
Pairs well with: Vengeful, Ko Striker. The stake behind the rule.

traits.name: Vow: Everything for One Fight
traits.info:
Once, in the worst moment of your life, you can give up all your potential and every bit of Nen you will ever have for the strength to win one fight. You will win it. Then the body pays. There is no cure. It is open only to one who has already staked their life. The vow: once in your life, at a moment of your choosing, you may call it; you win that fight far above your level, and then your Nen is gone for good and your body fails, with no cure to be had.

Gives: technique All In (All the strength you would ever have grown into and every scrap of Nen you would ever have, poured into this one fight. Greatly improves the next action of the one fight you gave everything for. Once, ever).
Pairs well with: Enhancer, Vengeful. The last vow.
excludedBy: Vow: A Rule on My Hatsu

traits.name: Vow: On My Life
traits.info:
You swore your rule on your own life. Kept, it makes the ability three times what it was. Broken, it kills you. The vow: name the rule when you take this pick and stake your life on it; keep it and the ability is three times as strong, break it and you die.

Gives: technique Life-Staked Power (All that you are is behind the rule, and the ability carries three times its weight. Greatly improves the next Hatsu action made inside the rule you staked your life on).
Pairs well with: Vengeful, Scarlet-Eyed Kurta. The stake that cannot be taken back.

traits.name: Wanted
traits.info:
There is a price on your head from a Mafia family, a state or someone with long memory. You did not always deserve it.

Gives: Spirit -1.
Pairs well with: Poker Face, Master of Disguise. The face on the notice.

traits.name: Wealthy Family
traits.info:
You grew up in a rich house with tutors, servants and a family name that opens doors, and with the boredom that sends the rich looking for danger.

Gives: Wit +1; Lore +1, Appraisal +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Old Money Manners (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to impress, buy or bluff your way into a rich person's room).
Pairs well with: Clean Name, Professional Gamer. The rich and their games.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Whale Island Born
traits.info:
You grew up on a small island at the edge of the map, where a child learns the forest, the swamp and the sea before the alphabet.

Gives: Body +1; Wildcraft +1, Seafaring +1; Health +10 (maximum and starting); technique Island Angler (A habit of home. Greatly improves the next action to fish, read the water or catch something wild without hurting it).
Pairs well with: Fisher's Child, Rod and Line. The island and its waters.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Whipwork
traits.info:
You fight with a whip: a crack at the edge of hearing, a lash that wraps a wrist, a reach longer than any sword.

Gives: Weapons +2; technique Whipwork Opening (The whip cracks, and their weapon is somewhere else. Greatly improves the next weapons action to open a fight on your own terms); unlocks as you train: Crack (Weapons 6), Disarm (Weapons 12), Wrap (Weapons 18), Lash at Range (Weapons 24); starts with Braided Leather Whip (damage +1 while equipped).
Pairs well with: Charged Aura, Heavens Arena Fighter. The long lash.

Primary Attribute: Body

traits.name: Wild Senses
traits.info:
Your nose and ears are an animal's. You can smell a trail a day old and hear a heartbeat change in the next room.

Gives: Wit +1; Tracking +1, Awareness +1.
Pairs well with: Whale Island Born, Keen Ears. The senses of the wild.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Would-Be Doctor
traits.info:
You want to be a doctor and need the money and the licence to get through medical school. A Hunter licence is worth a fortune and opens doors that money alone does not, and that is reason enough to risk your life.

Gives: Wit +1; Medicine +2; Health +10 (maximum and starting); unlocks as you train: First Aid Hands (Medicine 6), Bedside Care (Medicine 12), Clean Suture (Medicine 18), Doctor's Eye (Medicine 24); starts with Medical Kit in a Briefcase.
Pairs well with: Field Surgeon, Medical Student. The road to medicine.

Primary Attribute: Wit

traits.name: Yorknew City Born

You grew up in the sprawling auction city, where the September crowds bring every collector, fence and gunman on the continent to the same streets.

traits.name: Zetsu Shadow

You can close your nodes and disappear. You can also hide a technique with In so that only Gyo will find it.

Gives: Speed +1; Zetsu +1; unlocks as you train: Presence Gone (Zetsu 6), Zetsu Rest (Zetsu 12), Hidden With In (Zetsu 18), Zetsu Under Eyes (Zetsu 24).
Pairs well with: Cloud-Hidden Ninja, Wanted. The art of not being there.

categories.name: Origin and People
categories.info: Where you come from: the country, the city or the people you know best. Each origin gives a habit of its own ground.

categories.name: Nen
categories.info: Whether your aura nodes are open, and if so, what Water Divination showed. Unawakened characters can learn Nen in play under a teacher, or by Initiation at a risk. Each pick opens a ladder.

categories.name: Flaw
categories.info: The weakness you carry. The narrator holds you to it.

categories.name: Calling
categories.info: The trade or art you live by: a Hunter's licence or the exam to win one, a fighting school, a family trade or a job for hire. Each opens a ladder.

categories.name: Discipline
categories.info: Your focus within your Nen or your calling: a principle you have made your own, a Hunter's field, a specialty of your trade. Each opens its own ladder.

categories.name: Weapon Art
categories.info: The weapon or the fight you trained in. It comes with a weapon and an opening move, and opens its own ladder.

categories.name: Era
categories.info: When your story starts: the arc of the story it opens in. Each start opens in one era; Write Your Own lets you choose.

categories.name: Run
categories.info: How the story bends: the canon road, or one of the what-if roads that open the rarest gifts.
traits: Run: What If: The Specialist's Road
Run: What If: Another Kurta Lives
Run: What If: Reborn Among the Ants

categories.name: Birth
categories.info: A gift or a talent from before your story starts. The rarest are open only on a what-if road.

categories.name: Background
categories.info: What you did before your story starts. It gives a habit of that life.

categories.name: Perk
categories.info: A small advantage you were born with or earned.

categories.name: Vow and Condition
categories.info: The rules you have bound your Nen with. A condition shapes an ability and cannot be broken; a vow can be, and breaking it costs what you swore. Up to two.
