The Association has set up a clinic in the middle of the ship's hull, and a medical student who is now a Zodiac is running it under the chairwoman. There are two hundred thousand passengers, very few doctors, and the first day has already brought bodies.
🎭 Borksen, Female, a private first class of the Royal Army and a Provisional Hunter for the voyage. Large dark eyes, white high-collared puffer jacket. A young soldier with curling light hair whispering in a storage room to five friends about what she was not supposed to hear.

starts.name: (Party) The First Ballot
starts.info:
PARTY · the election and after · 2-5 players · Leorio · guided
📍 Hunter Association Headquarters, The known world. The headquarters of the Hunter Association in Swardani City, where the chairman and the twelve Zodiacs meet, the exams are planned and the licences are issued.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 2-10)

The chairman is dead, and his will says the next one will be chosen by every Hunter alive. Hundreds of them have come to the Association's headquarters to vote, and a medical student with a licence has come to shout at someone.
🎭 Hisoka Morow, Male, a tall, muscular man dressed like a jester. Narrow amber eyes, pink sash. A painted jester smiling at a boy with a fishing rod, a playing card turning slowly between his fingers.
🎭 Illumi Zoldyck, Male, the eldest son of the Zoldyck Family. Very long straight jet-black hair, large black pupil-less eyes, green tunic with short puffed sleeves and round yellow studs. A tall young man with endless black hair and empty eyes, telling his little brother pleasantly that he has no friends.
🎭 Morel Mackernasey, Male, a sea Hunter and sea captain. Shoulder-length straight white hair, grey shirt. A big white-haired man with a pipe as tall as he is blowing smoke that turns into a squad of soldiers.
🎭 Leorio Paradinight, Male, a tall man in a dark suit and tinted glasses who looks ten years older than he is. White shirt. A tall man in a suit and tinted glasses bellowing at the top of a staircase, briefcase raised.
🎭 Tsezguerra, Male, a single-star Jackpot Hunter. Olive drab military flight suit with ribbed collar and chest pockets. A lean bearded man in a flight suit watching applicants fail his test one after another.
🎭 Barry, Male, a Hunter on Tsezguerra's team. Heavy-lidded eyes, olive drab military flight suit with ribbed turtleneck collar. A freckled man in a sideways cap ducking under a punch and answering with three of his own.

starts.name: (Party) The Hoihoi Hotel Meeting
starts.info:
PARTY · the Black Whale · 2-5 players · Hanzo and Basho · guided
📍 Hoihoi Hotel, The known world. A hotel in the Kakin Empire, one of the royal family's many, whose staff are discreet about who comes and goes and why.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 20-32)

Kakin's royal family is hiring Hunters to guard its princes on the voyage, and the applicants have been told to meet at seven in a hotel the family owns. A loud ninja and a Mafia poet have come for the same job.
🎭 Biscuit Krueger, Female, a two-star Hunter of precious stones and a master of Shingen-ryu who looks like a frilly. Large pink eyes, crimson and pink frilly dress with lace-up bodice and short capelet. A tiny frilly blonde girl in a queue of hard-bitten Hunters, smiling sweetly and lying through her teeth.
🎭 Izunavi, Male, a tall, muscular, middle-aged Hunter with scruffy black hair, narrow brown eyes. Narrow grey-brown eyes. A bearded man in a practice robe watching a leaf turn in a glass of water held by a pale young student.
🎭 Basho, Male, a Hunter from Jappon with a pompadour. A muscular man with a pompadour whistling as he writes a poem with a brush on a scrap of paper.
🎭 Bill, Male, a tall Hunter with messy fair hair. Messy upswept fair hair, down-turned heavy-lidded eyes. A tired-eyed Hunter in a black suit calmly advising a furious young man to put down a gun.
🎭 Hanzo, Male, a bald young ninja from Jappon. Sharp dark eyes, tight black short-sleeved shirt with round shoulder pads. A bald young ninja crouched on a branch above the applicants, talking loudly about how silent he is.
🎭 Melody, Female, a Music Hunter. Large round bulging eyes, long dark blue tunic. A small woman in a hat lowering her flute as a frightened room slowly goes calm.

starts.name: (Party) The Majority Path
starts.info:
PARTY · the 287th Hunter Exam · 2-5 players · Gon, Killua, Kurapika and Leorio · guided
📍 Trick Tower, The known world. A huge cylindrical stone tower with no windows and no stairs on its outside, used as a prison, its inside a maze of traps and puzzle rooms.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 6-14)

The exam airship set the applicants down on the roof of a prison tower and told them to reach the bottom in seventy-two hours. Five trapdoors dropped five people into one room, and every door from here opens only on a vote.

starts.name: (Party) The Queen's Door
starts.info:
PARTY · the Black Whale · 2-5 players · Kurapika and Bill · guided
📍 Princes' Residential District, The known world. The walled district on Tier 1 where each of the fourteen princes lives in one of fourteen identical rooms, numbered by birth order, set back to back in two rows with walkways between and walls round them all.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Endgame ground; nothing here is scaled to a beginner. (Recommended Level 30-40)

The youngest of Kakin's fourteen princes is a baby in his mother's arms, and the Association has sent its new Rat to guard them. Their room is one of fourteen identical rooms behind one wall on the top of the ship, and the ship has just sailed.
🎭 Tserriednich Hui Guo Rou, Male, the fourth prince of Kakin and second son of the first queen Unma. Half-lidded black eyes, elegant dark sports jacket over an open-collar shirt. A tall blond prince smiling courteously over a glass of wine in a room full of glass cases.
🎭 Benjamin Hui Guo Rou, Male, the first prince of Kakin and the eldest son of the first queen Unma. Short upright spiky blond hair, small black eyes, light military puffer jacket. A huge blond prince in a puffer jacket wrestling a lion while he talks on the phone.
🎭 Camilla Hui Guo Rou, Female, the second prince of Kakin and eldest child of the second queen Duazul. Large clear black eyes, elegant frilled gown. A blonde prince in a ball gown smiling sweetly while her guards check their pistols.
🎭 Furykov, Male, one of the first prince Benjamin's personal soldiers. Wide eyes, white high-collared puffer jacket. A bearded soldier grinning at a room of guards, daring the hidden ones among them to show themselves.
🎭 Kurapika, Male, a slight. Grey-brown eyes. A slender blond youth in a blue tabard reading a stranger in silence, his eyes flickering red for an instant.
🎭 Babimyna, Male, one of the first prince Benjamin's personal soldiers. Stern dark eyes, white high-collared puffer jacket. A young soldier with fair curls standing at the back of a crowded room, watching everyone and saying nothing.

starts.name: (Party) The Room in Mandai
starts.info:
PARTY · the Chimera Ant crisis · 2-5 players · Gon, Killua, Knuckle and Shoot · guided
📍 Mandai City, The known world. A city of East Gorteau where travellers can meet without attracting much notice.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 26-36)

The Hunters the chairman sent against the colony have split up to cross East Gorteau unseen. Four of them meet in a cheap hotel room in Mandai to plan the hardest thing any of them has ever tried.

starts.name: (Party) The Storm Crossing
starts.info:
PARTY · the 287th Hunter Exam · 2-5 players · Gon, Kurapika and Leorio · guided
📍 Captain's Ship, The known world. A small passenger ship that carries hopefuls from the islands to the exam's landing port at Dolle Harbor.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-4)

A small ship is carrying hopefuls toward the exam's landing port, and a storm is coming that only the captain saw. Three strangers aboard are about to become friends: a boy from a fishing island, a quiet blond youth and a loud man in a suit.
🎭 Captain, Male, the captain of the ship that carries exam hopefuls from Whale Island. An old bearded captain at the wheel of a heaving ship, laughing at passengers sick over the rail.
🎭 Katzo, Male, a crewman on the Captain's ship that carries applicants from Whale Island toward Dolle. Timid eyes, orange shirt. A thin deckhand in an orange shirt clinging to a rope as a wave breaks over the rail.

starts.name: (Party) The Survey Camp
starts.info:
PARTY · the Chimera Ant crisis · 2-5 players · Kite, Gon and Killua · guided
📍 Kakin Survey Forest, The known world. Wild forest in the Kakin Empire where new species still turn up, and a survey camp of tents.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 20-30)

Two boys used a card from a game to find a boy's father and landed instead in a forest camp with the man who once saved that boy's life. The man is a Hunter cataloguing new species, and a piece of something very strange has just come in from the coast.
🎭 Gon Freecss, Male, a boy from Whale Island. Large hazel-brown eyes, green high-collared jacket with orange-red trim. A small boy with spiky hair grinning in a crowd of hard-faced adults, a fishing rod on his shoulder.
🎭 Killua Zoldyck, Male, a white-haired boy on a skateboard who has run away from home to take the Hunter Exam. Messy spiky white hair, sharp blue cat-like eyes. A white-haired boy on a skateboard gliding past a line of exhausted runners, not even breathing hard.
🎭 Kite, Male, a tall, gaunt Hunter with long white hair to his knees, a hooked nose and a light blue. Small hazel eyes, light blue sash wound at waist. A gaunt man with knee-length white hair crouching to look a strange animal in the eye in a forest camp.
🎭 Spinner Clow, Female, a young Amateur Hunter called Spin. Long wavy magenta-pink hair, teal-blue eyes, dark purple long-sleeved shirt over white shirt. A young woman in a beret photographing a strange bird, glaring at two boys who have just arrived.
🎭 Banana Kavaro, Female, an Amateur Hunter on Kite's survey team with short fair hair shaved at the sides. Small green eyes. A young woman in baggy overalls sketching the ranks of an insect colony in a notebook.
🎭 Lin Koshi, Male, a short Amateur Hunter on Kite's team with fair hair combed neatly to one side. Squinty eyes, lavender short-sleeved polo shirt tucked into dark trousers. A short young man in a dress shirt checking a species list, stammering out a correction.

starts.name: A Deathmatch Booked
starts.info:
HOOK · the election and after · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Floor Master Floors, The known world. The floors from the 230th to the 250th, each the home of one of the twenty-one Floor Masters, the arena's highest ranked fighters.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 20-26)

Summer, a year after the election. Heavens Arena has announced a deathmatch between two Floor Masters, and the tickets sold out in an hour. Nobody will say much about the second fighter, only that the first has wanted this fight for years.

starts.name: Banners on Auction Avenue
starts.info:
ERA · Yorknew City · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Yorknew City, The known world. A sprawling metropolis in the United States of Saherta, famous for its auctions.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 10-28)

For ten days every September the world's collectors come to Yorknew to buy what cannot be bought anywhere else. The auction houses have hung their banners, the hotels are full, and the Mafia is in town in force.

starts.name: Bring Someone Faster
starts.info:
ERA · the Chimera Ant crisis · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Pata City, The known world. A small city in the Republic of Rokario, one of the modern cities nearest the NGL border.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 14-26)

Something fast and strange came out of the NGL and tore through Pata, then ran for the mountains. Before it went it told the police to bring someone faster tomorrow. The news has been showing the footage all night.
🎭 Gothic Newscaster, Female, a television newscaster with neat black hair parted to the left. Dead expressionless eyes, dark gothic dress suit. A deadpan newscaster in a gothic suit reading a casualty count to camera in front of police tape.

starts.name: Children of the Dump
starts.info:
ERA · the election and after · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Meteor City, The known world. A junkyard city of eight to ten million people, about the size of the Lapet Republic, whose residents appear in no record anywhere.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 12-34)

Meteor City appears on no map and in no record, and the world throws its rubbish there. The city's elders do not let outsiders in without a reason, and today they have a reason: a child of the city has been taken by a stranger.
🎭 Silas Nought, Male, a broker of the heaps with no fixed shack. Neat dark hair, good charcoal overcoat over layered cloth wraps. A man in a good overcoat over rag wraps, leaning against a heap with his hands in his pockets, smiling as you come.
🎭 Hedda Sieve, Female, a sorter of the scavenger lanes. Cloth mask pulled down. A thin woman on an upturned bucket shaking a mesh sieve, sorted piles rising around her.

starts.name: Interest Every Ten Seconds
starts.info:
ERA · the Chimera Ant crisis · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Doli City, The known world. A small, densely packed city in the Republic of Rokario and one of the nearest modern towns to the NGL border.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 14-26)

Doli City is the last modern town before the NGL border, and two Hunters are training there to stop two boys from going back in. One of them is loud, kind and never stops talking about debts.
🎭 Knuckle Bine, Male, a Hunter of beasts and Morel's pupil. Dark green hair, black eyes, high-collared long white coat with gold rings at the chest. A young tough with a pompadour shouting a challenge through a megaphone in a square, then crying at a stray dog.

starts.name: Natural Cloth Only
starts.info:
ERA · the Chimera Ant crisis · 1-5 players · guided
📍 NGL Border Stop, The known world. The checkpoint and embassy of the NGL Autonomous Region, built inside two huge hollowed trees.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 20-30)

The NGL lets nobody in carrying anything a machine has made. At the border stop inside two hollowed trees, every traveller is searched to the skin and given plain clothes. Lately the trucks have been bringing more Hunters than tourists.

starts.name: Noon at the Seaport
starts.info:
ERA · the Black Whale · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Kakin Empire, The known world. A country in the middle of the Azian Continent with more than a billion people, an economy that has grown fast for years and a king, Nasubi Hui Guo Rou, at the head of a parliamentary state.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 20-34)

The largest ship ever built is too big to dock. Ferries and airships are carrying two hundred thousand passengers out to it from Kakin's seaport, and at noon it sails for the New Continent.

starts.name: Pork for the Big Man
starts.info:
ERA · the 287th Hunter Exam · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Visca Forest Preserve, The known world. A forest preserve beyond the wetlands, its streams and lakes thick with fish and its clearings ruled by the Great Stamp, a pig with no equal for temper.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

The second phase is cooking. A huge examiner wants a roast pig, his partner wants something else entirely, and the pigs of this forest have noses made for flattening people.
🎭 Buhara, Male, a huge young man with a vast belly. Scruffy black hair, tiny narrow eyes, yellow long-sleeved shirt riding up over a (huge bare belly:1.3). An enormous young man finishing his seventieth roast pig and asking if there is more.

starts.name: Sign Here, Fight There
starts.info:
ERA · Kukuroo Mountain and Heavens Arena · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Heavens Arena, The known world. The world's most popular fighting site: a tower 991 metres tall with 251 floors, the fourth tallest building in the world, where about four thousand fighters a day climb by winning.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 4-26)

Heavens Arena takes anyone who signs the form. Four thousand fighters a day walk in; most leave with a bruise and a little money. The ones who keep climbing find out that the higher floors are a different world.

starts.name: Something on the Beach
starts.info:
HOOK · the Chimera Ant crisis · 1-5 players · guided
📍 NGL Shore, The known world. A lonely stretch of the NGL's coast with a fishing hamlet and a beach of driftwood.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 20-32)

A fishing hamlet on the NGL coast woke to find a trench in its beach, as if something taller than a man had dragged itself out of the sea and inland. The children who went to look at it have not come home.

starts.name: Spires in the Desert
starts.info:
ERA · Yorknew City · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Gordeau Rock Field, The known world. A field of tall rock spires in the desert where the wind moans through the stones and shadows fall long.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 18-30)

The thieves who robbed the Mafia's auction have fled into the desert outside the city, and the families are sending everyone they have after them. You are in a car full of armed men racing toward a field of rock spires.

starts.name: Steak, Low Flame
starts.info:
ERA · the 287th Hunter Exam · 1-5 players · guided
📍 287th Hunter Exam Site Restaurant, The known world. A small cheap restaurant, Meshidokoro Gohan, on Tsubashi Street, with a cook at the grill and a waitress who shows certain customers to the back room.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-10)

The navigators have told you the secret: in Zaban City there is a cheap restaurant, and if you order the right meal in the right words, the cook will send you somewhere no menu mentions.

starts.name: Tea and the Truth
starts.info:
ERA · Kukuroo Mountain and Heavens Arena · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Wing's Lodging, The known world. A small rented room in the arena's town where Wing, a teacher of the Shingen-ryu school, lives while his pupil Zushi fights.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 4-20)

A teacher of the Shingen-ryu school is living in a small rented room near the Arena while his pupil fights. Rumour says he can teach the thing that makes the 200th-floor fighters different. He has made a pot of tea and is waiting to hear why you came.
🎭 Wing, Male, an assistant master of Shingen-ryu kung fu living near the Heavens Arena. Dark brown eyes, white long-sleeved collared shirt half untucked with breast pocket. A bespectacled young man with his shirt half untucked raising a playing card that has just sliced through a can.

starts.name: The 288th Back Room
starts.info:
ERA · Greed Island · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Diksakura, The known world. A store beside the station in Beeskafmarro that sells the usual things.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 4-14)

It is January again and the 288th exam has begun in a shop by the station in Beeskafmarro, where a customer who pays with the right card is shown into the back. A white-haired boy has just walked in and gone straight to the door.
🎭 288th Hunter Exam's 1st Phase Examiner, Male, a laid-back Hunter of middle age with lime-green hair. Lime green hair, brown eyes, violet shirt with dark purple markings. A goateed man in a violet shirt and red trousers lounging against a storeroom shelf, glancing over a crowd.

starts.name: The Agent Who Sees
starts.info:
HOOK · Kukuroo Mountain and Heavens Arena · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Sengi Guild, The known world. A hidden hiring agency in a poor slum, where one agent offers shady jobs to people she judges capable.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 12-28)

A hidden agency in a slum hands out the kind of work Hunters take and nobody advertises. The agent at the desk has already turned one clever young man away this week, because he could not see what she showed him.
🎭 Sengi Guild Agent, Female, the agent of a hidden hiring office in a slum. A pierced, gaunt woman behind a desk with a skull of aura floating over her shoulder.

starts.name: The Appraiser's Table
starts.info:
HOOK · Yorknew City · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Preview Market, The known world. A market where goods that missed the catalogues are shown before auction and merchants appraise them, run by a man named Taloon.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-24)

Goods that missed the catalogues come to a market where merchants appraise them before the auctions. A boy with a bag of jewels is arguing with the appraiser, and the appraiser is losing.
🎭 Taloon, Male, the organiser of the Preview Market in Yorknew. Patterned shirt. An old dealer in a cap holding a necklace up to the light and naming a price before anyone asks.

starts.name: The Badge Man's Juice
starts.info:
ERA · the 287th Hunter Exam · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Exam Tunnel, The known world. A tunnel more than eighty kilometres long a hundred storeys under Zaban City, where hundreds of applicants with numbered badges wait for the exam to start.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-10)

Hundreds of applicants wait in a hall at the bottom of the lift for the exam to begin. A stout, friendly man sitting his thirty-fifth exam is going round the newcomers with cans of juice and good advice.
🎭 Gon Freecss, Male, a boy from Whale Island. Large hazel-brown eyes, green high-collared jacket with orange-red trim. A small boy with spiky hair grinning in a crowd of hard-faced adults, a fishing rod on his shoulder.
🎭 Kurapika, Male, a slight. Grey-brown eyes. A slender blond youth in a blue tabard reading a stranger in silence, his eyes flickering red for an instant.
🎭 Amori, Male, the eldest of three brothers who take the exam together every year. Short blond hair, almond-shaped grey eyes. Three brothers with identical marks under their eyes closing in on a lone applicant.
🎭 Cherry, Male, a martial artist of middling height in loose training clothes and soft shoes. Black hair, piercing black eyes, cloth sash. A flat-topped martial artist nodding once to a running companion and telling him only one applicant has fallen out so far.
🎭 Mamen Beans, Male, the chairman's personal secretary. White shirt. A little green man in a tuxedo pressing a numbered badge into a boy's hand with a bow.
🎭 Nicholas, Male, a round-faced. Neat short black hair, black eyes, white ruffled shirt. A neat boy with a bow tie glancing up from his laptop to tell a newcomer exactly which applicant to avoid.

starts.name: The Body in the Clearing
starts.info:
ANT RUN · the Chimera Ant crisis · reborn among the Ants · guided
📍 Nest Woods, The known world. Dense forest in the NGL interior, old, unmapped and far from any village.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 24-34)

You remember a life: a name, a face, a village. You woke in a clearing in a body with an insect's shell and a soldier's orders in your head, and the others around you are waking too.
🎭 Meleoron, Male, a chameleon-like ant with two big toes on each foot. Bulging round green eyes, grey hooded sweatshirt with hood up. A chameleon-man in a grey hoodie half-faded into the trees, sighing at his own soldiers.
🎭 Zazan, Female, a scorpion-like ant with long tangled fuchsia hair. Long wavy unkempt fuchsia hair, golden eyes. A purple-skinned woman with a scorpion tail lowering her sting into a fallen Hunter's neck.
🎭 Koala, Male, a small pink koala-like ant with fluffy round ears. Small brown eyes, black tuxedo with a white shirt and dark tie. A small pink koala in a tuxedo standing over a fallen man, tipping water from a gourd.
🎭 Rammot, Male, a thick-thighed rabbit-like ant with feathered arms. Long straight green hair, laced shin wraps. A rabbit-like ant grinning beside three animals impaled on branches, watching two boys approach.

starts.name: The Bow Lounge
starts.info:
HOOK · the Black Whale · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Observation Deck, The known world. A sightseeing platform at the front of the Black Whale, full of outdoor lounge chairs, shops and bars.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 20-32)

The observation deck at the front of the Black Whale is the one place on the ship where every tier that can afford it comes to look at the sea. Tonight a group of strangers has been showing a photograph round the bars.

starts.name: The Box in the Attic
starts.info:
HOOK · Kukuroo Mountain and Heavens Arena · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Whale Island, The known world. A small island port that fishing boats use more than anyone lives in it.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 1-4)

Summer on Whale Island, and two boys from Heavens Arena have come home for a while. One of them has a box his aunt kept for him, sealed by his father years ago, that opens only for someone who can use aura.
🎭 Marek Vossberg, Male, a broad, grey-bearded man in a salt-stained pea coat who rents the room over. Cropped grey hair, navy pea coat over a cable-knit wool sweater. A grey-bearded man stepping out of icy harbour water at dawn as if it were a warm bath.
🎭 Tolly Brannock, Male, the chandler on Harbour Street. Untidy sandy hair, rolled-sleeve checked flannel shirt. A wiry chandler leaning over a counter of fishhooks, pointing proudly at a hand-painted sign in his window.

starts.name: The Boy in the Private Ward
starts.info:
ERA · the election and after · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Swardani Hospital, The known world. A large hospital in Swardani City that treats Hunters as well as citizens, with private rooms on its upper floors where a licence buys privacy and a guard at the door.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

The boy who went into the palace in East Gorteau came out of it alive, barely, and nobody can say what is keeping him alive. He lies in a private ward in Swardani City under guard, and the doctors have stopped making promises.
🎭 Meleoron, Male, a chameleon-like ant with two big toes on each foot. Bulging round green eyes, grey hooded sweatshirt with hood up. A chameleon-man in a grey hoodie half-faded into the trees, sighing at his own soldiers.
🎭 Ikalgo, Male, a red octopus-like ant with round eyes. Round eyes. A small red octopus-ant peering out from a dead man's coat collar, gripping an air rifle in two tentacles.
🎭 Knuckle Bine, Male, a Hunter of beasts and Morel's pupil. Dark green hair, black eyes, high-collared long white coat with gold rings at the chest. A young tough with a pompadour shouting a challenge through a megaphone in a square, then crying at a stray dog.
🎭 Palm Siberia, Female, a Hunter and Knov's pupil. A thin, wild-haired woman with a kitchen knife gushing about her master to two boys who are edging away.
🎭 Shoot McMahon, Male, a Hunter of unidentified beasts and Morel's other pupil. Tired heavy-lidded eyes, bandages wrapped as a shirt. A pale, tired-looking man with one great sleeve watching three disembodied hands circle his opponent.

starts.name: The Bus to the Gate
starts.info:
ERA · Kukuroo Mountain and Heavens Arena · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Lamentation Road, The known world. The road the daily Lamentation Tours bus takes up through Dentora's mountains to the foot of Kukuroo Mountain.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 6-14)

Tourists pay to ride up into Dentora's mountains and look at the gate of the most famous assassins in the world. The guide tells the same jokes every trip. This morning two big men in the back seat are not laughing.
🎭 Coco Loo, Female, the guide on the tourist bus that runs up the Dentora road to the gate of Kukuroo Mountain. Big curly messy orange-pink hair, green eyes, navy bus guide uniform jacket with light blue trim and pencil skirt. A cheerful guide in a blue uniform pointing out the window at a gate in the mountainside.

starts.name: The Castle on the Cliffs
starts.info:
ERA · Greed Island · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Battera's Castle, The known world. An old castle on high ground above walls and cliffs, the property of the billionaire Battera, who has spent fortunes buying every copy of the game Greed Island.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 12-24)

Battera's castle stands on cliffs above high walls, and its basement holds thirty-two consoles running one game. The new recruits have been warned that the castle's security system kills anyone who wanders off.
🎭 Biscuit Krueger, Female, a two-star Hunter of precious stones and a master of Shingen-ryu who looks like a frilly. Large pink eyes, crimson and pink frilly dress with lace-up bodice and short capelet. A tiny frilly blonde girl in a queue of hard-bitten Hunters, smiling sweetly and lying through her teeth.
🎭 Gon Freecss, Male, a boy from Whale Island. Large hazel-brown eyes, green high-collared jacket with orange-red trim. A small boy with spiky hair grinning in a crowd of hard-faced adults, a fishing rod on his shoulder.
🎭 Killua Zoldyck, Male, a white-haired boy on a skateboard who has run away from home to take the Hunter Exam. Messy spiky white hair, sharp blue cat-like eyes. A white-haired boy on a skateboard gliding past a line of exhausted runners, not even breathing hard.
🎭 Bara, Male, a muscular player with long straight purple hair parted in the middle and a trident. Pale wide eyes, black long-sleeved shirt with a large white trident print. A long-haired man with a trident tattoo stepping out of shadow with a severed head in a sack.
🎭 Sub, Male, a player with spiky red hair. Short round puffy spiky red hair, magenta long-sleeved shirt with a large black bat-winged heart print. A red-haired man flicking a stone from his hand to knock a spinning yo-yo out of the air.
🎭 Tsezguerra, Male, a single-star Jackpot Hunter. Olive drab military flight suit with ribbed collar and chest pockets. A lean bearded man in a flight suit watching applicants fail his test one after another.

starts.name: The Catalogue Is the Ticket
starts.info:
ERA · Yorknew City · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Southernpiece Auction House, The known world. Yorknew's leading auction house and one of the most prestigious in the world, organiser of the Southernpiece Auction from the sixth to the tenth of September, the largest anywhere.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 12-28)

The most prestigious auction in the world opens on the sixth of September, and you get in only by buying its catalogue. The catalogue costs twelve million Jenny, and the desk takes only bank transfers.
🎭 Fumi, Female, a receptionist at the Southernpiece Auction House. Medium hair, one-piece dress over white collared shirt. A receptionist sliding a thick catalogue across a marble desk to a small boy.

starts.name: The Cell on Tier 1
starts.info:
ERA · the Black Whale · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Beyond's Detention Room, The known world. A small holding cell on Tier 1 where the expedition's leader, Beyond Netero, is kept under watch for the whole voyage.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Endgame ground; nothing here is scaled to a beginner. (Recommended Level 30-40)

The leader of the expedition to the New Continent surrendered to the Association a year ago, and he sails in a small cell on the top of the ship with Zodiacs at his door. He seems to be enjoying himself.
🎭 Beyond Netero, Male, the son of Isaac Netero. Ancient Chinese commander robes over lamellar armor. A bearded man with a cross-shaped scar laughing over a drink as the world floods his phone lines with applications.
🎭 Kanzai, Male, the Zodiacs' Tiger. Green eyes, yellow pinstriped baseball jersey with black collar. A tiger-striped man in a baseball uniform leaping across a table at a smiling vice chairman.
🎭 Saccho Kobayakawa, Male, the Zodiacs' Horse. Small dark eyes, purple kimono with three flower designs. A horse-faced swordsman reading the Association's rules in silence while the others argue.
🎭 Saiyu, Male, the Zodiacs' Monkey. Black mandarin-collar jacket with gold trim and gold knot buttons. A lanky man in a monkey costume jabbing a finger at Ging across the table.

starts.name: The Clone Fighter
starts.info:
ERA · Kukuroo Mountain and Heavens Arena · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Arena 200th Floor, The known world. The 200th floor and those above it, where there is no prize money, only fame, and every weapon is allowed.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-24)

A fighter in white has waited two years for a rematch with the magician who once beat him and let him live. The match is tonight, the Big Ring is sold out, and everyone on the 200th floor is betting on how it ends.
🎭 Hisoka Morow, Male, a tall, muscular man dressed like a jester. Narrow amber eyes, pink sash. A painted jester smiling at a boy with a fishing rod, a playing card turning slowly between his fingers.
🎭 Kastro, Male, a celebrated fighter on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena. Blue eyes, yellow hoodless cloak with high collar. A white-haired fighter in a yellow cloak raising a clawed hand toward a smiling jester across the ring.
🎭 Cocco, Female, the ring announcer for Heavens Arena's upper floors. Brown eyes, pink and navy Heavens Arena staff uniform with a fist emblem. An orange-haired announcer leaning out over the ring rail, shouting a fighter's record into her headset.

starts.name: The Cordon at Midnight
starts.info:
ERA · Yorknew City · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Cemetery Building, The known world. A huge building in Yorknew City that hosts the Mafia's own Underground Auction every September.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 14-28)

On the first night of September the Mafia holds its own auction in a building in the city, for the families only. A ring of cars and armed men stands a kilometre out. You are on that line tonight, and the night is very quiet.
🎭 Bean, Male, a Mafia man with medium-length hair tied back in a ponytail. Medium length hair, white shirt. A ponytailed man in a black suit shouting into a handset while explosions light the windows behind him.

starts.name: The Empty Mill
starts.info:
ERA · the Chimera Ant crisis · 1-5 players · guided
📍 NGL Village, The known world. A small village in the NGL, its houses thatched, its water from a well, its bread from a water mill.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 20-30)

A village in the NGL lives by a well and a water mill, and in one night half of it went silent. The mill is still turning. A mother is standing at its door waiting for her children.
🎭 Haruna, Female, a single mother in one of NGL's villages. Olive eyes, sleeveless green shirt over a peach-coloured dress. A woman at a village door calling two children in from the forest's edge.

starts.name: The Fortune Teller Lands
starts.info:
HOOK · Yorknew City · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Lingon Airport, The known world. A major airport in Yorknew City's suburbs, about ninety minutes by car from the city centre along a road across the desert.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 14-26)

A Mafia boss's daughter tells fortunes that come true, and the Ten Dons themselves are fans of her readings. She has flown in for the auctions with her maids and her guards, and she is already bored.

starts.name: The Graves in the Forest
starts.info:
KURTA RUN · the 287th Hunter Exam · a second survivor · guided
📍 Kurta Village, The known world. The village of the Kurta Clan in the forests of the Lukso Province, a people whose eyes turned scarlet with strong feeling.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-10)

Five years ago the Phantom Troupe killed your whole clan for their eyes. You were not in the village that day. You have come back for the first time, and someone else has been here before you to dig the graves.

starts.name: The Harbour of Hopefuls
starts.info:
ERA · the 287th Hunter Exam · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Dolle Harbor, The known world. A large port town where hopefuls for the Hunter Exam land every winter and set out to find the exam site.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 1-10)

Every January the port of Dolle fills with people who want to be Hunters. Nobody tells them where the exam is held, and half the town makes a living selling them the wrong answer.

starts.name: The Inn Below the Mountain
starts.info:
ERA · the election and after · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Dentora Region, The known world. A region of the Republic of Padokea, a country anyone may enter without papers.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 6-12)

The tour buses are still running up to the Zoldyck gate, but the town below the mountain has gone quiet. Butlers in black suits have been seen asking questions in the market, and last night nobody slept at the inn.
🎭 Benedikt Kranz, Male, the innkeeper of the Mountain View Inn. Waistcoat over white shirt. A stout innkeeper with a waxed moustache gesturing proudly at a window full of mountain.

starts.name: The Leader's Summons
starts.info:
ERA · the Chimera Ant crisis · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Peijin, The known world. The capital of the Republic of East Gorteau, in the south-east of the country: wide avenues built for parades, the Supreme Leader's portrait on every wall, soldiers at the crossings and poor streets behind the grand ones.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 26-36)

The Supreme Leader of East Gorteau has ordered every citizen to the capital on one day for a great national gathering. Nobody refuses an order in East Gorteau. Nobody has seen the Supreme Leader in public for weeks.
🎭 Marcos, Male, the military leader of East Gorteau's government. Neatly combed-back olive-blond hair, squinting eyes, light grey East Gorteau military uniform with high collar. A tall general on a reviewing stand watching soldiers march, his mind somewhere else.

starts.name: The Lottery Winners
starts.info:
HOOK · the Black Whale · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Kakin Empire, The known world. A country in the middle of the Azian Continent with more than a billion people, an economy that has grown fast for years and a king, Nasubi Hui Guo Rou, at the head of a parliamentary state.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 20-34)

In Kakin the Have-Nots can hold no office and no rank, and most of them never leave the quarter where they were born. This week some of them have won places on the great voyage, and the quarter does not know whether to celebrate or mourn.

starts.name: The Navigators' Cabin
starts.info:
HOOK · the 287th Hunter Exam · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Lone Pine Tree, The known world. A huge pine standing alone on a hill in the forest outside Dolle Harbor, with a log cabin at its foot.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-10)

The way to the exam site runs past a huge pine on a hill, and the family who live under it guide only those they trust. Tonight their cabin door has been smashed in.

starts.name: The Old Woman's Question
starts.info:
HOOK · the 287th Hunter Exam · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Quiz Road, The known world. A road through a small town on the way from the port to the pine, where a hunched old woman stops every applicant and asks a question that has no good answer.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 1-10)

Halfway between the port and the pine, a little town has put masks on and gathered in its square. A hunched old woman stands at the fork in the road and will not let anyone pass without answering her.
🎭 Quizzing Lady, Female, a tiny, hunched old woman with long grey hair and only two teeth left. Heavy-lidded eyes. A tiny old woman at a fork in the road, two fingers raised, waiting for an answer she does not want.

starts.name: The Prize Posters
starts.info:
HOOK · Greed Island · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Antokiba, The known world. The town of prizes, the nearest town to the Greed Island Starting Point and the first most new players find.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 12-22)

The town nearest the starting tower holds a contest on the fifteenth of every month, and the winner takes a rare card. This month the contest is announced on a poster nobody quite understands.
🎭 Kazsule, Male, a tall, well-built player of Greed Island with small eyes, a cleft chin and a hat. Small grey eyes, leopard-print tank top with fur collar. A tall man in a fur-brimmed hat and leopard top sizing up a pair of boys who have just won a contest.

starts.name: The Queue at Masadora
starts.info:
ERA · Greed Island · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Masadora, The known world. The magic city, a town of towers and spires that looks out of a storybook.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 12-26)

Spell cards are sold in packs in the magic city, and only there. Players wait hours in line for a pack, and the rarest cards change the shape of the whole game.
🎭 Kess, Male, a Hunter on Tsezguerra's team. Short curly brown hair, olive drab military flight suit with ribbed collar. A tall man with a hooked nose watching blips move on a radar screen in his hand.

starts.name: The Reserve's First Rangers
starts.info:
ERA · the election and after · 1-5 players · guided
📍 NGL Reserve Post, The known world. A small post on the edge of the forests where travellers are logged.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Endgame ground; nothing here is scaled to a beginner. (Recommended Level 24-36)

The NGL has become a nature reserve under the Hunter Association. Its border is closed to almost everyone, and the rangers who log the few travellers who pass have strict orders about what to report and to whom.

starts.name: The Rich Man's Theatre
starts.info:
ERA · the Black Whale · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Tier 2, The known world. The highest tier inside the hull, for celebrities and the rich, with six hundred guards and soldiers.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: ☠️ Deadly. Endgame ground; nothing here is scaled to a beginner. (Recommended Level 24-36)

Tier 2 is for celebrities and the very rich, with its own theatre, its own guards and a bulkhead that opens only from their side. Tonight's performance has been cancelled at the last minute, and nobody has said why.

starts.name: The Shut Border
starts.info:
HOOK · the election and after · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Republic of West Gorteau, The known world. A republic of the Mitene Union between Hass to the west and East Gorteau to the east, whose eastern border is shut.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 16-28)

East Gorteau is gone: its regime fallen, its land divided among its neighbours. On the West Gorteau side of the old border fence, a queue of refugees has been waiting for days for a gate that will not open.

starts.name: The Sick Village
starts.info:
HOOK · Greed Island · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Village of the Bandits from the Mountains, The known world. A poor village in the mountains where the bandits live, all of them ill with something no medicine cures.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-24)

A village of bandits in the mountains lies under a sickness no medicine cures. They have stopped robbing travellers and started begging them for help, and they will give everything they own to anyone who brings a cure.

starts.name: The Side Door
starts.info:
ERA · Kukuroo Mountain and Heavens Arena · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Testing Gate, The known world. The main gate of the Zoldyck estate: seven doors, each pair of panels twice as heavy as the last, the first panels weighing two tons each.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 6-20)

Beside the great gate of Kukuroo Mountain there is a little door with a lock, and the tourists are told it is the guards' door. An old man in a guard's cap holds its key. Tonight the key has been stolen.

starts.name: The Swindlers' Swamp
starts.info:
ERA · the 287th Hunter Exam · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Milsy Wetlands, The known world. A marsh under constant fog, also called the swindlers' swamp, where the animals and even the plants live by deceiving prey.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 2-10)

After eighty kilometres of tunnel the first phase climbs into a marsh where the animals lie for a living. The examiner has not slowed down, and now someone at the tunnel mouth says the examiner is a fake.

starts.name: The Ticket-Punchers
starts.info:
ERA · the Black Whale · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Tier 5, The known world. The smallest and lowest tier, at the bottom of the hull beside the propeller and wholly below the sea, with one clinic and no doctor.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🔴 Severe. Deadly to the unready; the top of this band eats mid-level parties. (Recommended Level 20-34)

Tier 5 is the bottom of the ship, with too few clinics and no doctor of its own. The Mafia families punch the passengers' tickets and decide who eats when, and on the first night the dining hall is very quiet.
🎭 Ken'i Wang, Male, the underboss of the Cha-R Family. Neatly slicked-back dark hair, thin dark eyes, white shirt. A lean man in glasses and a striped suit smiling coldly at three thieves outside a warehouse.

starts.name: The Train to the Castle
starts.info:
ERA · Greed Island · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Tarsetol Station, The known world. A train station in Yorknew City.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-22)

A billionaire has bought every copy of a game he can find and is paying fortunes to anyone who can clear it. Those he hired are boarding a train at a station in Yorknew. Some of them have played before, and none of them will say how it ended.

starts.name: The Tree Above the Clouds
starts.info:
ERA · the election and after · 1-5 players · guided
📍 World Tree, The known world. The only sapling of its kind in the known world, a tree 1,784 metres tall whose top stands above the clouds.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Quiet ground; trouble here is social before it is lethal. (Recommended Level 4-10)

Climbers come from every continent to the only World Tree in the known world, nearly two kilometres high. Past the 500-metre platform there are no lifts, only bark and wind. Word at the gate is that a famous Hunter has climbed to the top today.

starts.name: The Wanted Posters
starts.info:
HOOK · Yorknew City · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Dayroad Park, The known world. A large municipal park in Yorknew City, with lawns, paths and food stands, where people come to rest away from the auctions.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 10-20)

The Mafia has put a bounty on every member of the Phantom Troupe, and the pictures are on the internet for anyone with a Hunter's licence to see. In a park in the middle of the city, everybody is suddenly a bounty hunter.

starts.name: The Week of Badges
starts.info:
ERA · the 287th Hunter Exam · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Zevil Island, The known world. A remote island two hours by boat from Trick Tower, narrow at its middle where an isthmus joins two halves, with dense forest, fields of tall grass and crimson butterflies drawn to blood.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Real fights at the edges; walk in with your eyes open. (Recommended Level 6-14)

Every applicant who reached this island drew a number from a box. The number is somebody else's badge, and for one week every person on the island is both a hunter and a target.

starts.name: The Wind in the Corridor
starts.info:
ERA · Kukuroo Mountain and Heavens Arena · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Arena 200th Floor, The known world. The 200th floor and those above it, where there is no prize money, only fame, and every weapon is allowed.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟠 High. Dangerous ground; a party that picks its fights survives it. (Recommended Level 12-24)

You have climbed to the 200th floor of Heavens Arena. From here there is no prize money, only fame, and when the lift doors opened something in the corridor pushed against you like a wind that nobody else seemed to feel.
🎭 Hisoka Morow, Male, a tall, muscular man dressed like a jester. Narrow amber eyes, pink sash. A painted jester smiling at a boy with a fishing rod, a playing card turning slowly between his fingers.
🎭 Machi Komacine, Female, Member number three of the Phantom Troupe. Blue eyes, white short-sleeved uwagi with purple collar. A small woman with pink hair sewing a severed arm back onto a smiling man, unimpressed.
🎭 Gido, Male, a fighter on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena whose first fight there cost him. Red robe with a tall pointed hood covering the head. A masked man on a peg leg cackling as a dozen spinning tops whirl toward a boy who cannot see them.
🎭 Riehlvelt, Male, a fighter on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena with spiky purple hair and yellow. Spiky purple hair, black-grey eyes. A man in a big wheelchair cracking two whips across the ring, grinning at a boy who can barely stand.
🎭 Sadaso, Male, a tall, pale fighter on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena with white hair, slanted. White hair, slanted narrow eyes, mask-like expressionless face. A one-armed fighter smiling as an invisible hand closes around a boy's throat.

starts.name: The Woman on the Floating Seat
starts.info:
ERA · Greed Island · 1-5 players · guided
📍 Greed Island Starting Point, The known world. The tower where every player arrives on entering the game, its floor and walls covered in designs.
Pace: Guided. An authored opening plays out, then the world is yours.
Danger: 🟢 Low. Safe inside; the ground around it is not. (Recommended Level 12-20)

You have just been pulled through a console into a world that feels as real as your own skin. A woman in a uniform on a floating seat is smiling at you, and the rules she is about to recite are the only ones she will ever give.
🎭 Eta, Female, the guide who greets every player at Greed Island's starting point. Big azure eyes, black sleeveless high-neck robe with three blue eye symbols down the front. A silver-haired young woman in an eye-patterned robe reciting the rules to a new arrival.

starts.name: Write Your Own
starts.info:
MAKE IT YOURS · open-ended
Write your own beginning anywhere in the known world. Say who you are, which trade or field you follow, whether you hold a Hunter's licence, whether your aura nodes are open, which year it is, and where your road starts.

modes.name: Another Kurta Lives
modes.info:
RUN · Hard
A second survivor of the Kurta Clan, with the scarlet eyes and the grief, in a world that still buys and sells their people's eyes.
Expect · grief, revenge, the eyes' black market, a second survivor's choice
Lighter on · light-hearted scenes

modes.name: Beyond the Lake
modes.info:
WHAT IF · Very hard
The voyage does not stop at the New Continent: the party cross the lake's edge into the Dark Continent, where everything the world's governments feared is real.
Expect · exploration, impossible creatures, survival, the price of hope
Lighter on · the known world's safety

modes.name: Chaos
modes.info:
CHAOS · Very hard
One cursed lot from the auction is opened in front of the whole party, and every one of them is bound by a different Nen curse at once.
Expect · curses, conditions, desperate cures, strange gifts
Lighter on · the canon's order

modes.name: Family Business
modes.info:
ROLE · Hard
The party serve a Mafia family: guards, collectors, fixers and soldiers, under bosses who reward loyalty and bury failure.
Expect · loyalty, money, rival families, the code
Lighter on · law and order

modes.name: Guards of the Princes
modes.info:
ROLE · Very hard
The party guard a prince of Kakin aboard the Black Whale, where the throne goes to whoever is left and every corridor holds a rival's soldiers.
Expect · intrigue, close protection, martial law, the long voyage
Lighter on · open travel

modes.name: House of Assassins
modes.info:
ROLE · Hard
The party are assassins and their household: killers raised from childhood, butlers who guard a mountain, and the family that rules them.
Expect · contracts, family pressure, poison, the price of leaving
Lighter on · innocence

modes.name: Hunters for Hire
modes.info:
ROLE · Medium
The party are licensed Hunters taking jobs: bounties, ruins, rare beasts and lost people, for whoever pays and whatever their licence opens.
Expect · contracts, travel, a different job every arc
Lighter on · home life

modes.name: Multiplayer
modes.info:
TABLE · Medium
A party of applicants, Hunters, fighters and drifters from every corner of the map, on one road.
Expect · shared scenes, a spotlight for everyone, mixed callings
Lighter on · solo arcs

modes.name: Players of the Game
modes.info:
ROLE · Medium
The party are Greed Island players inside a game that is real, hunting the hundred cards that clear it, among players who kill for them.
Expect · cards, spells, puzzles, rival players
Lighter on · the outside world

modes.name: Prodigies of Nen
modes.info:
POWER · Easy
The party are prodigies whose auras grow faster than anyone's, strong enough to change a city's fate, and the world's strongest have noticed.
Expect · fast growth, big Hatsu, heroic wins
Lighter on · slow training

modes.name: Reborn Among the Ants
modes.info:
RUN · Very hard
Humans taken by the Chimera Ants and reborn in their bodies, remembering the lives they had, in a colony that eats people.
Expect · memory, hiding, a monstrous body, choosing a side
Lighter on · a human world that welcomes them

modes.name: Summer on Whale Island
modes.info:
GENTLE · Very easy
A slower, kinder road: island harbours, forest paths, fishing, good food and small troubles, with the world's dangers far away.
Expect · warm scenes, kind neighbours, small stakes
Lighter on · battles and loss

modes.name: The Canon Road
modes.info:
RUN · Medium
Gon's story as the series tells it, with the party living alongside it, meeting the cast where the cast is.
Expect · the canon's great moments, the cast at their canon points
Lighter on · what-ifs

modes.name: The Hunter Exam
modes.info:
SPECIALIST · Hard
Applicants on the road to a Hunter's licence, through the hidden tests, the phases and the final bout, and the one secret exam after it.
Expect · the exam's phases, rival applicants, examiners who cannot be predicted
Lighter on · long arcs

modes.name: The Junkyard's Children
modes.info:
ROLE · Hard
The party are people of Meteor City, a junkyard city of millions with no records, whose people take whatever the world throws away and look after their own.
Expect · survival, loyalty, the world's contempt, revenge
Lighter on · comfort

modes.name: The Specialist's Road
modes.info:
RUN · Hard
A Conjurer or Manipulator whose aura has already turned Specialist, with an ability nobody else can learn and a world that wants to know how it works.
Expect · a unique Hatsu, attention, the price of rarity
Lighter on · ordinary training

modes.name: The Tower of Fighters
modes.info:
ROLE · Medium
The party climb Heavens Arena floor by floor, for prize money, then fame, then the secret of the fighters above the 200th floor.
Expect · bouts, rivals, training, the climb
Lighter on · travel

modes.name: Under a Teacher
modes.info:
SPECIALIST · Medium
Students of Nen and their teacher: opening the aura, the four basics, the water test, and the first Hatsu built by its own rules.
Expect · training, the basics, a teacher's wisdom, a first ability
Lighter on · constant fights

music.title: Kukan Yu and the Exam Road, Tense 1
Kukan Yu and the Exam Road, Tense 2
Kukan Yu and the Exam Road, Explore 1
Kukan Yu and the Exam Road, Explore 2
Kukan Yu and the Exam Road, Explore 3

quests.name: A Bag That Rattles
quests.info: A bag came in off the border road heavier than its letters, and when Gretl lifted it onto the sorting table something inside clinked like glass on glass.
quests.goal: Learn which rider brought it in
steps: Open the bag with Gretl as witness.
Learn which rider brought it in.

quests.name: A Board for a Collector
quests.info: A foreign collector staying at the hotel has offered the hall a fortune for its oldest board, a cracked wooden thing older than the republic, and someone on the staff has said yes.
quests.goal: Keep the board in the hall
steps: Learn who promised the collector the board.
Keep the board in the hall.
quests.next: The Girl at the Barn Table

quests.name: A Buyer at the Guesthouse
quests.info: A smooth man in a camel coat has taken the best room in the village's oldest guesthouse and spends every evening asking which families own the fields that run up to the ruins.
quests.goal: See him leave without a single deed
steps: Learn who sent the buyer.
See him leave without a single deed.

quests.name: A Card in Her Pocket
quests.info: A foreign woman with a Hunter's licence card has been showing a photograph to lorry drivers in Taba City; the face in it is a forger wanted across the sea, and she says he is somewhere on this road.
quests.goal: Hear whom she hunts and why
steps: Find the Hunter before the police do.
Hear whom she hunts and why.

quests.name: A Card Through the Slot
quests.info: Ilka has been paid in batteries to fix a card reader for strangers. She thinks she knows now what it is for, and she would rather the party tested it than the strangers.
quests.goal: Run a blank card through it
steps: Help Ilka finish the reader from dead machines.
Run a blank card through it.

quests.name: A Climb of His Own
quests.info: His grandmother wants Eddo Valk to sell the ropes and go to school in the city; he wants to keep climbing and one day sit the Hunter Exam so he can study the eagles properly. They have not spoken in two days, and the hut is very small.
quests.goal: Help them find an answer both can live with
steps: Hear each of them out alone.
Help them find an answer both can live with.

quests.name: A Copy Kept Upstairs
quests.info: The younger clerk who shares the book office has seen the old man copying the oldest names into a small book of his own, and he is deciding which of the family's men to tell. He has asked to see the old man after closing.
quests.goal: Settle it with no blood on the book office floor
steps: Learn what the young clerk wants for his silence.
Settle it with no blood on the book office floor.

quests.name: A Dish of One's Own
quests.info: Menchi wants a dish that is the party's own: an ingredient they found and a way of cooking it nobody taught them.
quests.goal: Put the dish before Menchi
steps: Find an ingredient worth hunting.
Put the dish before Menchi.

quests.name: A Face on Pell Street
quests.info: A carved stone face no bigger than a hand is for sale in a card and coin shop on Pell Street, and Konrad Ferle is certain it was chiselled out of his gallery by someone with a cold chisel and no idea what he was holding.
quests.goal: Get the carving back before a collector buys it
steps: Learn which miner sold the stone.
Get the carving back before a collector buys it.

quests.name: A Face on the Listing
quests.info: The man in the gully will not give his name and begs them to keep the warden away. Arlo wants to know what his brother is hiding before another loaf goes north, and the island's only line to the mainland and its bounty listings runs through the post office switchboard.
quests.goal: Learn what the man in the gully is wanted for, and by whom
steps: Persuade Ilse Mardle to put a call through to someone who can read the listings.
Learn what the man in the gully is wanted for, and by whom.

quests.name: A Fair Return
quests.info: The two men have found the strand. They are polite, empty-handed after the border's search and very sure of themselves, and the salt-boilers have stopped working to stare.
quests.goal: See the men out of the country without blood on the strand
steps: Decide whether the cases go back or stay hidden.
See the men out of the country without blood on the strand.

quests.name: A Fawn That Follows
quests.info: The seamstress wants the deep green of the plateau's ferns for the parade's banners, and the player she sent up for them a week ago has not come back. Word from the plateau is that a fawn will not leave his side and he dares not move.
quests.goal: Bring him down, with an armful of fronds
steps: Find the player under the ferns.
Bring him down, with an armful of fronds.

quests.name: A Firm With No Office
quests.info: The firm on the waybill holds a season licence from the city, but the address on its papers is a locked door over a laundry.
quests.goal: Learn who signed for it
steps: Find the firm's licence at the permit counter.
Learn who signed for it.

quests.name: A Friend at the Desk
quests.info: Every search the detective plans at the sidings finds the far line swept clean, so somebody in the station is picking up a telephone.
quests.goal: Find out who carries it to the yard
steps: Let a false date for the next search loose in the station.
Find out who carries it to the yard.

quests.name: A Game That Was Never Played
quests.info: One of the judge's bound books holds a final copied in a hand that is almost his, crediting a title to a player who was knocked out a round before.
quests.goal: See the record put right
steps: Find who wrote the false game into the book.
See the record put right.

quests.name: A Guardsman Learns From Tape
quests.info: A young guardsman who watched the tapes has been trying the fighters' moves on his comrades, and tonight he has wagered a month's pay that he can put the barracks champion down.
quests.goal: Finish it before an officer asks where he learned to fight like that
steps: Reach the barracks before the bout.
Finish it before an officer asks where he learned to fight like that.

quests.name: A Hand Too Lucky
quests.info: A quiet man in spectacles has won at the card tables five nights running, always at the same dealer's table, and the family would like to know how before it asks him in its own way.
quests.goal: Show the house how the cards are reaching him
steps: Watch the lucky player's table through a night of play.
Show the house how the cards are reaching him.

quests.name: A Home for the Cargo
quests.info: The animals cannot stay in a freight yard, and the dealer will want them back. The university keeps an animal house for its zoologists, with a professor who asks fewer questions than the police would.
quests.goal: Put the dealer's name where it will cost him
steps: Get the animals to the university's animal house.
Put the dealer's name where it will cost him.

quests.name: A Horn for a Foreign Buyer
quests.info: A lorry has been parked below the lightning ridge for three days, and its men have been asking the herders about the cat with the burning horn. Hu Lianshan found an order slip in their rubbish written in a language from overseas.
quests.goal: Send them down the hill without a horn
steps: Find the poachers' camp on the ridge.
Send them down the hill without a horn.
quests.line: A Horn for a Foreign Buyer
quests.next: A Pelt in the Quarantine Yard

quests.name: A Leaf on the Water
quests.info: A glass full to the brim with a single leaf floating on it: Wing asks the party to hold their hands round it and pour their aura in, and the water will say what kind of user each one is.
quests.goal: Read what the water does
steps: Pour your aura round the glass.
Read what the water does.

quests.name: A Lift on the Salt Cart
quests.info: Joska admits he gave a lift to a lad with a sack of dried eels and no papers, and set him down on the horse trail two days short of the border.
quests.goal: Hear why he wants to go
steps: Catch up with the boy on the trail.
Hear why he wants to go.

quests.name: A Man Who Knew My Name
quests.info: A man in a good suit came into the police box this morning, called the constable by his first name and asked, very politely, to borrow the logbook he keeps at home. Rudi Fass has told no one that logbook exists.
quests.goal: Keep the logbook out of his hands
steps: Learn who told the stranger about the logbook.
Keep the logbook out of his hands.

quests.name: A Map in a Grey Folder
quests.info: The original of the digger's map was taken from a monk the year he was denounced, and it has lain in a folder in the bureau's filing hall ever since, under the name of the monk's neighbour.
quests.goal: Take the map out of the bureau
steps: Find the folder in the filing hall.
Take the map out of the bureau.

quests.name: A Marker in the Window
quests.info: A signed slip from the cage, promising a long-shot payout to whoever holds it, is sitting in a pawnbroker's window across town; the gambler who placed the bet was buried a month ago, and the bookmaker paid for the flowers.
quests.goal: Get it back to the cage before anyone tries to cash it
steps: Find out how the slip came to the pawnshop.
Get it back to the cage before anyone tries to cash it.
quests.next: Someone Is Thinking of the Cage

quests.name: A Member of the Party
quests.info: A party member informs on neighbours. A teacher in Peijin has been heard saying the wrong thing about the leader, and the party is told to find out whether it is true.
quests.goal: Report or protect the teacher
steps: Listen to the teacher's classes.
Report or protect the teacher.
Tell Bizeff the job is done.

quests.name: A Name Cut in Stone
quests.info: The fighter was buried under the name he fought as, and the chapel's book of names has nothing for him at all.
quests.goal: Have his stone recut with it
steps: Have his true name written in the chapel's book.
Have his stone recut with it.

quests.name: A Name on the Card
quests.info: The wanted man registered for the tower under a name nobody has heard, with a photograph that shows only half his face.
quests.goal: Learn which private room the tower has given him
steps: Find his registration in the records room.
Learn which private room the tower has given him.

quests.name: A Name on the Site
quests.info: The Hunters' Tavern has posted a bounty on a man wanted in three countries. Lippo wants the party to learn everything about him before they take a step.
quests.goal: Find where he was last seen
steps: Buy what the Tavern knows about the man.
Find where he was last seen.

quests.name: A Pelt in the Quarantine Yard
quests.info: A licensed hunter has brought in a scorched hide and claims the agency's reward for a wolf that took sheep. The zoologist thinks the hide is no wolf's, and he would much rather know than pay.
quests.goal: Learn where the hunter really shot it
steps: Compare the hide with the agency's specimens.
Learn where the hunter really shot it.
quests.line: A Horn for a Foreign Buyer

quests.name: A Prisoner's Odds
quests.info: Ansel says, red to the ears, that the prisoner who keeps the quarry book buys blankets and silence on the cell row with what he wins, and that one of the guards has started losing to him on purpose.
quests.goal: Break the debt without bringing anyone to the gallows
steps: Learn which guard is in the prisoner's debt.
Break the debt without bringing anyone to the gallows.
quests.line: The Lift at the Quarry Face

quests.name: A Pupil of Your Own
quests.info: A master of the school is measured by the pupils who come after. The party must take a beginner from the first exercise to the first real use of aura, and do it the slow way.
quests.goal: Bring the pupil to a first real use of aura
steps: Choose a pupil and begin the slow training.
Bring the pupil to a first real use of aura.
Tell Wing the job is done.

quests.name: A Reporter at the Fence
quests.info: The journalist who once tried to buy the flight log is back. This time he is not asking the radio operator: he is buying drinks for the hangar crew, and one of them has started asking her which examiners flew in last week.
quests.goal: See the reporter off the headland empty-handed
steps: Find the crewman the reporter has bought.
See the reporter off the headland empty-handed.

quests.name: A Room of One's Own
quests.info: A fighter on the hundredth floor is given a private room, and the fighters there will do anything to take it from a newcomer.
quests.goal: Keep it through a week of challenges
steps: Win the right to the room.
Keep it through a week of challenges.

quests.name: A Royal Bodyguard
quests.info: A royal bodyguard is chosen in front of the prince's people. The guards for the voyage are being picked at the hotel, and every prince wants the best.
quests.goal: Be chosen by a prince
steps: Show what you can do before the household.
Be chosen by a prince.
Tell Nugui the job is done.

quests.name: A Scroll on Velvet
quests.info: A seller laid a warlord-age scroll on the velvet in the viewing salon this afternoon and named a sum. The old clerk has seen the binding before, in a locked case on a hill, and the seller's hands are far too clean for a man who claims to have dug it up.
quests.goal: Get it back onto its shelf without the palace hearing
steps: Learn how the scroll left the temple.
Get it back onto its shelf without the palace hearing.

quests.name: A Seat at the Council
quests.info: A card holder brings something the alliance does not have. The convener wants to see one card from the party's binder that none of the fifteen holds.
quests.goal: Show it at the council
steps: Find a card none of the fifteen holds.
Show it at the council.
Tell Goreinu the job is done.

quests.name: A Second Bowl
quests.info: The bottle buyer is lodging at the bunkhouse under another name and has asked for a third night. The host says nobody leaves his kitchen without a second bowl, and the Hunter would rather take her man after it than in the street.
quests.goal: Take the wanted chemist alive without a fight in the kitchen
steps: Sit at the host's table until the guest talks.
Take the wanted chemist alive without a fight in the kitchen.

quests.name: A Song for Peace
quests.info: Melody believes music can calm the angriest room. She has been asked to play at a banquet where three families hate each other, and wants the party to keep the room from blood.
quests.goal: Let the music finish
steps: Keep the families in their seats.
Let the music finish.

quests.name: A Star of One's Own
quests.info: One star goes to a Hunter whose work in a single field the Association cannot ignore. The Lurka Ruins still hide a chamber the surveys missed, and the board will hear of whoever finds it.
quests.goal: Record it so the board must take notice
steps: Find the chamber the surveys missed.
Record it so the board must take notice.
Tell Mamen Beans the job is done.

quests.name: A Stone with No Body
quests.info: He has his answer and nothing to bury. The priest keeps a book of every name the mountain has taken, and the young Hunter is torn between adding one more line to it and following the pencilled route along the wall himself.
quests.goal: See the brother's name written in Ambros Feld's book
steps: Talk the young Hunter out of the wall, or decide to walk it with him.
See the brother's name written in Ambros Feld's book.

quests.name: A Tunic Too Big
quests.info: The boy's mother works a loom in the sheds, and Hedda says she has woven straight through three nights and will not say her son's name.
quests.goal: Learn which road he took
steps: Speak with his mother.
Learn which road he took.
quests.next: A Lift on the Salt Cart

quests.name: A Wheel and a Loupe
quests.info: The night he vanished, the apprentice pawned his own cutting wheel at the grille of the Ninth Avenue Pawnbrokers. No cutter parts with his wheel unless he means never to cut again.
quests.goal: Learn the address he gave on the ticket
steps: Get the old pawnbroker to open his book.
Learn the address he gave on the ticket.
quests.line: The Book That Does Not Match

quests.name: A Whole Plate
quests.info: The restaurant on the square gives a card to whoever eats its spaghetti to the last strand. A player has sat at the table for six hours trying, and his friends wait across the street to rob whoever manages it after him.
quests.goal: Leave with the card still in a binder of their own
steps: Finish the plate.
Leave with the card still in a binder of their own.

quests.name: A Year to the Exam
quests.info: Wim Jansen is lifting the cabin's weighted cups now without spilling tea, and he has started counting the days to the Hunter Exam. One more honest try at the first door, the smith says, and then the boy should go home and live long enough to apply.
quests.goal: Stand with him for his last try at the door
steps: Train beside the boy for a week in the cabin's yard.
Stand with him for his last try at the door.
quests.line: The Boy at the First Door

quests.name: An Estate Lot
quests.info: Silver bars stamped with the old camp's mark are listed for the Yorknew sales as a dead collector's estate, and the man who will sell them waits on the hotel's sixth floor for his buyer.
quests.goal: Decide whether the silver goes to the sale or to the museum
steps: Reach the seller before his buyer does.
Decide whether the silver goes to the sale or to the museum.

quests.name: An Order for the Lodge
quests.info: The chef who owns the lakeside lodge has ordered a full basket for a dinner of visiting Gourmet Hunters, and he says plainly that a day late is the same to him as never.
quests.goal: Win the chef's order for the rest of the season
steps: Bring the eggs to the lodge before the dinner.
Win the chef's order for the rest of the season.

quests.name: Answers for the Column
quests.info: A mother has come up from the lowlands asking after a son whose name sits in the long column, and the crew leader has no answer to give her. The gatekeepers might, if they are asked politely and by someone who is not wearing a red jacket.
quests.goal: Bring an answer, or an honest silence, back to the mother
steps: Ask the gatekeepers what became of the son.
Bring an answer, or an honest silence, back to the mother.

quests.name: Bad Soup in the Mess
quests.info: A rumour has gone round the mess hall that the warden is choosing which prisoners will fight for years off their sentences, and the lifers are ready to tear the benches up over who is on the list.
quests.goal: Quiet the mess before the guards go in with batons
steps: Trace the rumour to whoever started it.
Quiet the mess before the guards go in with batons.

quests.name: Battle Olympia
