quests.info: Every second year the masters fight for the penthouse on the 251st floor, and the whole world watches on the screens.
quests.goal: Take the penthouse
steps: Fight through the Olympia rounds.
Take the penthouse.
Tell Heavens Arena 200th Floor Clerk the job is done.

quests.name: Beetles at the Stall
quests.info: The stall that sells beetle-shaped foreign phones has a new regular, a polite man from the capital who buys one at a time, pays too much and asks each night when the next crate lands.
quests.goal: Send him home with nothing worth reporting
steps: Learn who the polite buyer reports to.
Send him home with nothing worth reporting.

quests.name: Behind the Coach's Back
quests.info: The boy left his gloves on the hook and his registration stub on the coach's desk, as if he wanted it found and did not want to be there when it was.
quests.goal: Learn who talked him into registering
steps: Find the boxer.
Learn who talked him into registering.
quests.next: The Clause on the Last Page

quests.name: Behind the Sidings
quests.info: This weekend's fight is in the ring of crates behind the sidings, and the boxer's usual cornerman has gone sick. The man the bookmaker sent to replace him carries a sponge that smells of something sharper than water.
quests.goal: Find out what was in the sponge
steps: Take the corner from the bookmaker's man.
Find out what was in the sponge.

quests.name: Bets at the Broth Counter
quests.info: Two men have been taking money at her stools all week on a bare-knuckle fight in the hiring yard, and the fighter everyone is backing to lose is her sister's boy. He told her he is going to win.
quests.goal: Learn whether the boy has been told to lose
steps: Learn who set the fight up.
Learn whether the boy has been told to lose.

quests.name: Birdseed and Faces
quests.info: The old man who sells birdseed on the square remembers every face that passes the exchange, and he sells what he remembers only to people who ask properly.
quests.goal: Learn where the forger has been seen
steps: Win the old man's attention without wasting it.
Learn where the forger has been seen.

quests.name: Blue Lips at the Clinic
quests.info: The old surgeon at the free clinic has had three patients in four days with the same blue lips and the same story about a friendly man on the road, and he has kept samples in jars.
quests.goal: Trace where the poisoner buys it
steps: Get the surgeon to name the poison.
Trace where the poisoner buys it.

quests.name: Blurs in the Stacks
quests.info: Black blurs have taken to nesting in the yard's log stacks and knocking the caps off any woodcutter who reaches for a log. The men swear the things come from the thicket in the hills, and the foreman wants one caught there to prove it can be done.
quests.goal: Carry its card back down to the yard
steps: Read the pattern in a Hyper Puffball's bounces and catch it.
Carry its card back down to the yard.

quests.name: Boss of the House
quests.info: A boss is chosen by the families who will follow. The house's old boss has lost his nerve, and the men want someone who will not.
quests.goal: Take the house without spilling family blood
steps: Win the men's loyalty.
Take the house without spilling family blood.
Tell Light Nostrade the job is done.

quests.name: Bouts in the Barn Loft
quests.info: Sachi's elder brother wrestles in the barn loft after market to clear a debt to the same book, and she has noticed he wins on the nights the wagers run against him.
quests.goal: Learn whether the bouts are fixed
steps: Watch a night of bouts in the loft.
Learn whether the bouts are fixed.
quests.line: The Lift at the Quarry Face
quests.next: The Last Lift of the Season

quests.name: Bread Carried North
quests.info: For two weeks Arlo Crane's younger brother has been walking north from the kilns with a loaf inside his coat and coming back without it. He cannot leave a kiln that has smouldered far longer than it should, and his brother answers every question by rolling over in his bunk.
quests.goal: Find out who is eating the bread
steps: Follow the brother north through the beeches without being seen.
Find out who is eating the bread.

quests.name: Bringing Him In
quests.info: Taking the man was half the work. Getting him alive to the tower's cells, with his friends on the road, is the other half.
quests.goal: Hand him to the warden alive
steps: Bring the prisoner to the tower.
Hand him to the warden alive.

quests.name: Burning Focus
quests.info: Wing begins with four words, focus, words, will and act, and says they are the whole art. He watches to see who is patient enough to believe him.
quests.goal: Hold them through a week of hard training
steps: Learn the four vows by heart.
Hold them through a week of hard training.

quests.name: Cadets with Their Pay in Their Boots
quests.info: One of the three cadets closest to the rifle record has been slipping out after lights-out to bet in the yard. He owes more than he will ever earn as an officer, and a bolt is missing from the armoury rack.
quests.goal: Get the bolt back on the rack before inspection
steps: Find the cadet's debt and who holds it.
Get the bolt back on the rack before inspection.

quests.name: Camilla's Soldier
quests.info: A soldier of Camilla's army fights for her without asking why. A rival's men have been provoking her guards on the third tier, hoping for a fight.
quests.goal: Turn the provocation back on its makers
steps: Keep the guards from the bait.
Turn the provocation back on its makers.
Tell Sarahell the job is done.

quests.name: Captain of the Companions
quests.info: The captain of the companions commands those who would die for Camilla. Her plans are bold and her enemies many, and the companions need someone to keep her alive in spite of herself.
quests.goal: Keep her alive through it
steps: Learn Camilla's next move.
Keep her alive through it.
Tell Sarahell the job is done.

quests.name: Cards That Come Apart
quests.info: A player with a stall under the awnings has been swapping newcomers rare cards for their spell cards, and a day later what he gave them is not what it looked like. Three newcomers are sitting in the cloth hall among the bolts, too ashamed to go back out.
quests.goal: Make him hand the newcomers back what they gave up
steps: Prove what the trader's cards really are, with an Analysis or a sharp eye.
Make him hand the newcomers back what they gave up.

quests.name: Casings in the Moss
quests.info: Lutz Ambrozy has found pistol casings on his best deer trail and wants them gone before they bring the police into his woods. The sergeant has decided, for once, to go in anyway, and to take the poacher as his guide.
quests.goal: Find the camp where someone has been testing guns
steps: Get the poacher to lead the way along the fern trail.
Find the camp where someone has been testing guns.
quests.line: Heavy Bags on the Morning Train

quests.name: Clubs on the Ridge
quests.info: The one-eyed giants have come down off their crest and now hold the gully the Masadora road runs through. Three teams turned back yesterday nursing broken arms, and one of them left a player's boots in the gully.
quests.goal: Take one of the pack and get through the gully before the others turn
steps: Learn what drops a giant before trying to drop one.
Take one of the pack and get through the gully before the others turn.

quests.name: Companion to the Last
quests.info: An afterlife companion has sworn to follow Camilla, the second prince, even into death. She has asked the party to stand at her door through a night when she expects to be attacked.
quests.goal: Meet the attack if it comes
steps: Stand at the door through the night.
Meet the attack if it comes.
Tell Sarahell the job is done.

quests.name: Crates Nobody Ordered
quests.info: Six crates came aboard the airship under a commission label, and the captain has asked every examiner on the roster: none of them ordered anything. The airship lifts at dawn.
quests.goal: Learn who signed them aboard
steps: Open the crates and see what is in them.
Learn who signed them aboard.

quests.name: Design a Phase
quests.info: Examiners are unpaid elite Hunters who set their own phase. The commission asks the party to build a test that measures body, mind and spirit, and then to run it on real applicants.
quests.goal: Run it fairly on real applicants
steps: Design the phase.
Run it fairly on real applicants.
Tell Satotz the job is done.

quests.name: Double Shifts at the Foundry
quests.info: The foundry foreman has a burned boy in his crew who will not go home because he owes the shift boss for his boots, his gloves and his bunk. The foreman will not order him out, and will not watch him fall into a pour.
quests.goal: Get him a night's leave across the bay
steps: Find what the boy owes, and to whom.
Get him a night's leave across the bay.

quests.name: Down With the Night Shift
quests.info: The forger bought a miner's papers and went down the pit with the night shift, where nobody asks a man his name and the roof talks before it falls.
quests.goal: Bring the forger up alive
steps: Go below with the shift.
Bring the forger up alive.
quests.next: Every Seat on the Morning Bus

quests.name: Dry Taps
quests.info: The water towers of Quant City have run dry, and the city blames the farms upstream.
quests.goal: Get the water running
steps: Climb the towers and find the fault.
Get the water running.

quests.name: Eight Is Not Enough
quests.info: A team of eight players has spent three days on the beach asking the fishermen where the pirates sleep. Last night the pirates came down to the lofts with torches to learn who had been talking.
quests.goal: Get the eight out of town before the lofts burn
steps: Learn from the fishermen what the pirates ask of anyone who challenges them.
Get the eight out of town before the lofts burn.

quests.name: Eleven Strings
quests.info: Senna Okoro walks the old track every seventh day, and today she lets the party walk it with her. Inside her wraps is a list of vans, their colours and their dents, kept since the night eleven small shoes went up on the post.
quests.goal: Match a van on her list to the colours in the code
steps: Walk the whole track beside Senna.
Match a van on her list to the colours in the code.

quests.name: Entering the Game
quests.info: The game begins at a tower where a guide explains the rules and hands every player a ring and a book. Goreinu says the first rule worth knowing is the one nobody tells you.
quests.goal: Learn the rule nobody tells
steps: Hear the guide's rules.
Learn the rule nobody tells.

quests.name: Evening Walk
quests.info: The parade's centre banner is to carry a white beetle, and the seamstress wants to know what one truly looks like before she cuts the silk. At the great tree, two teams who strike the trunk by turns each evening have started waiting for each other with knives.
quests.goal: Keep the two teams from killing each other over it
steps: Be at the trunk when the white beetle comes down for its evening walk.
Keep the two teams from killing each other over it.

quests.name: Every Seat on the Morning Bus
quests.info: The forger's partner has bought every seat on the first bus north, meaning to carry him off before the Hunter can claim him, and the driver wants no part of it.
quests.goal: Decide who leaves with the forger
steps: Hold the bus in the depot yard.
Decide who leaves with the forger.

quests.name: Fair Test or Grave
quests.info: The phase designer swears his pit trap can be survived by any careful applicant, and his colleague swears it is murder. Neither will try it again, and both want an honest verdict from someone who has never seen the plans.
quests.goal: Give both designers a verdict
steps: Run the trap line the way an applicant would.
Give both designers a verdict.

quests.name: Field Command
quests.info: A field commander leads when the leader is in a cell. The team's people are scattered across the ship, and the commander needs them ready.
quests.goal: Have them ready on the commander's word
steps: Find every member aboard.
Have them ready on the commander's word.
Tell Muherr the job is done.

quests.name: Fifteen Together
quests.info: An alliance elder holds the fifteen together. Only fifteen players arriving at once can learn where the pirates keep their card, and the alliance must arrive whole.
quests.goal: Learn where the card is kept
steps: Bring all fifteen to Soufrabi at once.
Learn where the card is kept.
Tell Goreinu the job is done.

quests.name: Fifty Floors Up
quests.info: The fiftieth floors are where most fighters stall. The party must win its way through them against men who have been stuck for years.
quests.goal: Reach the hundredth
steps: Win on the fiftieth floors.
Reach the hundredth.

quests.name: Fight Night in the Yard
quests.info: The fight goes ahead tonight in a ring chalked over the hiring line. Her nephew means to win it straight, and the men who bet the other way have brought friends who stand very close to the chalk.
quests.goal: See the fight to an honest finish
steps: Keep the collector's friends out of the ring.
See the fight to an honest finish.

quests.name: Fire at the Mounds
quests.info: The stranger walked to the clearing alone before dawn. Jory comes running with his eyebrows singed: one mound is kicked open and blazing, and two men are fighting beside it.
quests.goal: Settle whether the fugitive leaves with the Hunter or answers to the council
steps: Reach them before one of them dies.
Settle whether the fugitive leaves with the Hunter or answers to the council.

quests.name: Flowers After Dark
quests.info: Fresh flowers turn up on the same grave every week, always overnight, though nobody ever came to the burial.
quests.goal: Follow the visitor home
steps: Sit up with the caretaker through the night.
Follow the visitor home.

quests.name: Follow the Examiner
quests.info: Satotz walks into the tunnel at an even pace and does not stop, and the party must follow him without falling behind, however long the walk is.
quests.goal: Climb the stairs at the end without slowing
steps: Follow Satotz down the tunnel.
Climb the stairs at the end without slowing.

quests.name: For the Yorknew Sale
quests.info: A collector in the capital wants the house to bid for him at the Southernpiece Auction in Yorknew City, on a jade seal in the catalogue. The old clerk remembers a seal very like it being sold through this house forty years ago, to a family who say they never parted with it.
quests.goal: Ask the family who bought it how it left them
steps: Find the old sale in the house's oldest books.
Ask the family who bought it how it left them.

quests.name: Four Days of Folding Chairs
quests.info: Nobody has sat in the folding chairs. Residents walk past the open door and nod to him, and he has started to find the nodding worse than the empty room.
quests.goal: Find the broker who used to fill the chairs
steps: Ask along the lanes why nobody will come in.
Find the broker who used to fill the chairs.

quests.name: Freight for Yorknew
quests.info: A crate is going down the line tonight on the first leg to Yorknew City, ahead of the great auction season. The manifest calls it mountain cheese. A porter has been seen with a knife near the seals.
quests.goal: Catch whoever is cutting the seals
steps: Watch the crate from the goods shed to the guard's van.
Catch whoever is cutting the seals.

quests.name: Fresh Strings
quests.info: A player has come to the glade with somebody else's aura clinging to him like wet cloth; he has not slept in four nights. The exorcist who works the glade will see him at nightfall, and the charm maker insists the strings be new and the ring kept clear of gawkers.
quests.goal: Stay beside the man until the beast the fire raises has eaten what clings to him
steps: Keep the curious out of the ring until the rite begins.
Stay beside the man until the beast the fire raises has eaten what clings to him.

quests.name: Fresh Tapes, Seventh Floor
quests.info: The new tapes come in with a foreign businessman who records the bouts at home, and he will only hand them over in his room on the seventh floor, where the minders listen.
quests.goal: Carry the tapes out of the hotel
steps: Reach the businessman's room under a minder's eye.
Carry the tapes out of the hotel.

quests.name: Furniture in the Mill
quests.info: The family is in the biggest mill of the factory row, behind a fresh padlock, with their furniture and the boy; they were told it was that or the potter's field.
quests.goal: Bring them home to the camp
steps: Reach them through the service tunnels unseen.
Bring them home to the camp.

quests.name: Given and Not Taken Back
quests.info: Calvin's boss has telephoned the car for an answer. Waldo Kettle stands at the road end with his arms folded and says that what is left in the city belongs to the city, and that a woman who came down the road on her own counts.
quests.goal: Explain to Calvin Ferro what the city's rule means for her
steps: Get the beacon out of the caravan lot without a shot fired.
Explain to Calvin Ferro what the city's rule means for her.

quests.name: Glass or Diamond
quests.info: A seller swears his stone is a rare jewel worth a fortune, and Taloon thinks it is glass with a story.
quests.goal: Prove what it really is
steps: Learn where the stone came from.
Prove what it really is.

quests.name: Green Glass
quests.info: The buyer wants one green bottle only, a squat one with a ridged neck, and he wants every one on the ridge. The Hunter has a sheet in her folder describing a chemist who poured something into a reservoir and fled with his stock in exactly that kind of glass.
quests.goal: Learn what the bottles once held
steps: Follow Dinah's paths to where the green bottles lie.
Learn what the bottles once held.

quests.name: Grilled Over a Low Flame
quests.info: A frightened young applicant has been told the way into the exam starts at a restaurant on a back street, but nobody will tell him what to order.
quests.goal: Get him to the room behind the kitchen
steps: Bring the applicant to the restaurant.
Get him to the room behind the kitchen.

quests.name: Half a Stamp
quests.info: Travel papers stamped at the airport's restricted desk are turning up on the night platform, in the hands of Have-Not families who have never been near an aeroplane. The railway sergeant waved two of them through for a parcel of dumplings, and now he is frightened.
quests.goal: Recover the stamp, or the plate it was copied from
steps: Learn who sold the families their papers.
Recover the stamp, or the plate it was copied from.
quests.line: The Face He Did Not Forget

quests.name: Head of the Guard
quests.info: The head bodyguard decides where every guard stands. The family has come to the city for the auctions, and the hotel has too many doors.
quests.goal: Keep the family safe through the week
steps: Post the guards.
Keep the family safe through the week.
Tell Linssen the job is done.

quests.name: Head of the Household
quests.info: The head butler answers for every servant on the mountain. A butler has been bribed to carry the family's movements to an enemy, and the master wants the matter closed inside the house.
quests.goal: Close the matter inside the house
steps: Find the bribed butler.
Close the matter inside the house.
Tell Canary the job is done.

quests.name: Heads or Tails
quests.info: A hideout watch settles quarrels the Troupe's way: a coin is tossed and the loser gives in. Two members have drawn on each other over who goes first, and the party is told to settle it before blood is spilled.
quests.goal: Toss it and make the loser keep to it
steps: Get both members to agree to the coin.
Toss it and make the loser keep to it.
Tell Machi Komacine the job is done.

quests.name: Heavier Than the Label
quests.info: Four crates off a night cargo flight sit in the end shed under a seal the Cha-R never put on, and the weighmaster's scale says they are twice what their labels claim. He does not like a seal on his floor that is not his family's.
quests.goal: Wait for whoever comes to collect them
steps: Look inside one crate without breaking the strange seal.
Wait for whoever comes to collect them.
quests.line: The Face He Did Not Forget

quests.name: Heavy Bags on the Morning Train
quests.info: Rifles have been coming up on the morning train in golf bags and cello cases, and the bounty hunters who meet them leave town armed better than the police post. The porters see everything and say nothing.
quests.goal: Follow one bag to whoever collects it
steps: Watch the platform for the bags that ride heavy.
Follow one bag to whoever collects it.
quests.line: Heavy Bags on the Morning Train

quests.name: Her Name on the Capture
quests.info: The desk sergeant is happy to take the forger into a cell and happier still to write the arrest down under one of his own officers.
quests.goal: Have the capture recorded under her own licence
steps: Bring the forger and the plates to the desk.
Have the capture recorded under her own licence.

quests.name: Hidden and Shown
quests.info: Wing takes the party into the crowds of the hundredth floors and asks them to close every node until nobody can feel them, then to throw it all open in one burst.
quests.goal: Show the full burst on Wing's word
steps: Walk the floors with the aura shut away.
Show the full burst on Wing's word.

quests.name: His Corner Man
quests.info: The wanted man never drinks, but the trainer who works his corner drinks every night in a back booth and talks more than he should.
quests.goal: Learn where the man goes when he is not in the tower
steps: Get the trainer talking.
Learn where the man goes when he is not in the tower.

quests.name: Hiss Under the Taxiway
quests.info: The night valve man has heard a hiss under the north taxiway for a week; the day shift laughs at him, and the gauges in the sphere yard read a little lower every dawn.
quests.goal: Shut the tap someone cut into it before a spark finds it
steps: Follow the old pipe from the valve house to the hiss.
Shut the tap someone cut into it before a spark finds it.

quests.name: Holding the Book Honest
quests.info: Fight night comes round again. Teo can see a punch begin now, which may keep him conscious, but it will not beat whatever the champion carries. The champion's crew have bet heavily on a quick finish, and Silas Ormond, who holds the book, has sworn he will pay out on nothing he cannot call fair.
quests.goal: Get Teo Bramwell out of the ring on his own feet
steps: Show the shed, before or during the bout, that the champion's wins are crooked.
Get Teo Bramwell out of the ring on his own feet.

quests.name: Holding the Floor
quests.info: A floor master loses the floor by losing one challenge. A fighter who has watched every one of the party's matches has filed to take it.
quests.goal: Keep the floor
steps: Learn what the challenger has learned about you.
Keep the floor.
Tell Heavens Arena 200th Floor Clerk the job is done.

quests.name: Holding the Rope
quests.info: Eddo Valk has a client waiting and nobody at the top of the rope, and the gatherers say a climber is only as safe as the hands that know when to hold and when to pay out.
quests.goal: Hold the boy's rope through one full climb into the gorge
steps: Learn the rope signals from his grandmother at the hearth.
Hold the boy's rope through one full climb into the gorge.

quests.name: Inside the Game
quests.info: A veteran player knows the game from the inside. The millionaire wants a full report on how the game works from a player who has come back from it.
quests.goal: Leave the game and report
steps: Enter the game and learn its rules.
Leave the game and report.
Tell Battera the job is done.

quests.name: Into the Melt
quests.info: The barge crew is coming back for the crate. Magda has decided it was never hers to sell, and the furnace master says he has never been asked what goes in.
quests.goal: See every card into the furnace
steps: Get the crate out of the market before the crew returns.
See every card into the furnace.

quests.name: Keeper of the Binder
quests.info: A card keeper holds the cards the alliance shares. A member's binder has been emptied in the night, and the others accuse each other.
quests.goal: Get the cards back
steps: Learn how the binder was emptied.
Get the cards back.
Tell Nickes the job is done.

quests.name: Keeper of the Name
quests.info: The keeper of the name decides who may still use it. A powerful Hunter has called the revived squad too weak to deserve the name, in front of the whole Association.
quests.goal: Decide whether the name stays worn or is laid down
steps: Answer the challenge.
Decide whether the name stays worn or is laid down.
Tell Loupe Highland the job is done.

quests.name: Keys from the Laundry
quests.info: The private rooms above the hundredth floor lock from inside, and the only people who can open them without a fuss are the cleaners.
quests.goal: Borrow a key to the wanted man's floor
steps: Win over the laundry staff.
Borrow a key to the wanted man's floor.

quests.name: Lamps on the Far Line
quests.info: The night signalman has seen something on the far line that he will not put into words, and a detective climbing into the box would be noticed by the wrong people.
quests.goal: Mark down every wagon that is opened and sealed again
steps: Sit the night shift in the signal box with the boy.
Mark down every wagon that is opened and sealed again.

quests.name: Last Bout Before the Airship
quests.info: The bookmaker has one more fight for the boxer, in the crusher yard among the wrecked cars: a heavyweight twice his size, and a crowd of the bookmaker's friends standing close to the ropes.
quests.goal: See the fight finished fair
steps: Keep the bookmaker's friends out of the ring.
See the fight finished fair.

quests.name: Lead the Squad
quests.info: A captain chooses who stands with them. Hunters are lining up to join the revived squad, and most of them would only be a danger to the rest.
quests.goal: Choose a squad that can stand together
steps: Test the volunteers.
Choose a squad that can stand together.
Tell Loupe Highland the job is done.

quests.name: Learning to Take a Punch
quests.info: Clara Whitcombe can run for hours, but she has never been hit, and every applicant she has read about was hit early and often.
quests.goal: See her through her first round in the ring
steps: Get her a place in the gym's morning session.
See her through her first round in the ring.

quests.name: Left Luggage
quests.info: The forger keeps his plates in a left-luggage locker at the coach terminal and has a seat on the night coach south. The debt collector's crew is already on the benches of the waiting hall.
quests.goal: Reach the forger before the crew does
steps: Find the forger's locker.
Reach the forger before the crew does.

quests.name: Lessons by the Hour
quests.info: The teacher who took the bounty hunter's savings to show him what real Hunters see in the air round a man is back, renting room nine and selling the same lessons to two younger hopefuls.
quests.goal: Get the hopefuls' money back, and the bounty hunter's own if any is left
steps: Sit in on a lesson and see the trick for what it is.
Get the hopefuls' money back, and the bounty hunter's own if any is left.

quests.name: Letters in the Ruins
quests.info: Carvings on the ruin walkways have never been read, and the visitors' centre sells a guess as if it were a translation.
quests.goal: Find the key to the script
steps: Copy every carving on the walkways.
Find the key to the script.

quests.name: Lift the Seal
quests.info: The exorcist lays two fingers on the sealed character's wrist and says the vow left a knot in their aura. She can draw it out, but the thing she draws out has to go somewhere.
quests.goal: Pay what the exorcism costs
steps: Show the exorcist the seal.
Pay what the exorcism costs.

quests.name: Light on the Headland
quests.info: The lighthouse lamp has failed on the night the boats are out, and a storm is coming in from the open sea.
quests.goal: Keep it lit until the last boat is in
steps: Climb to the lamp room and get the light burning.
Keep it lit until the last boat is in.

quests.name: Light Tickets
quests.info: A lorry that crossed the weighbridge as empty rode low on its springs all the way down the desert road, and its driver stops for supper at the same diner on the same night every week.
quests.goal: Learn where the load goes after the diner
steps: Get under the lorry's tarpaulin while the driver eats.
Learn where the load goes after the diner.

quests.name: Lorries on the Salt
quests.info: The man holding the debt runs races on the salt pan for the families' entertainment, rig against rig, and he will cancel the driver's marker for one win against his own lorry.
quests.goal: Beat the bookmaker's lorry across the flat
steps: Get a rig ready and onto the starting line.
Beat the bookmaker's lorry across the flat.

quests.name: Luonton Square
quests.info: A crowd gathers in Luonton's square every evening and stands silent for an hour, and the police do not know whether to arrest them.
quests.goal: Keep the police from a massacre
steps: Learn why the crowd gathers.
Keep the police from a massacre.

quests.name: Made in the Family
quests.info: An enforcer handles what a soldier cannot. A man has been skimming from the family's takings for a year and lives as if nobody would notice.
quests.goal: Make him pay it back
steps: Prove the skimming.
Make him pay it back.
Tell Light Nostrade the job is done.

quests.name: Master Sergeant's Count
quests.info: A master sergeant knows where every soldier is. Three soldiers have gone missing between the second and the third tier.
quests.goal: Learn what happened to them
steps: Find the missing soldiers.
Learn what happened to them.
Tell Balsamilco Might the job is done.

quests.name: Men on the Bench
quests.info: Two men in cheap jackets sit on the bench outside the prize office from opening to close, and they never queue and never fight.
quests.goal: Follow them when they get up
steps: Watch the bench through a full afternoon of payouts.
Follow them when they get up.

quests.name: Missed by a Morning
quests.info: A girl who missed the applicants' ship has made up her mind to chase it. She has been asking Dagny Rourke how much diesel a borrowed fishing boat would need to reach Dolle Harbor, and Dagny Rourke, who has no fuel to spare and a sharp nose for weather, has rung the harbourmaster instead of answering.
quests.goal: Talk her out of the crossing, or see her across it some way that will not drown her
steps: Find the girl before she casts off.
Talk her out of the crossing, or see her across it some way that will not drown her.

quests.name: Money on the Counter
quests.info: The regulars at the station bar are betting on the boy's first real bout, and someone has laid so much against him that the landlord thinks the loss is being arranged.
quests.goal: See the bout fought straight
steps: Find out who laid the heavy money.
See the bout fought straight.

quests.name: Money on the Wrong Man
quests.info: Someone laid a heavy bet on the boxer losing the weekend's fight, too heavy for the bookmaker's own pocket, so he passed it on through a back table at the casino.
quests.goal: Learn whose money it was
steps: Find the back table where the bet was laid off.
Learn whose money it was.

quests.name: Names on the Back Wall
quests.info: Every drinker who swore to open a door has their name painted on the bar's back wall. He has read all seven doors twice by lamplight and is sure his brother's name should be there, but the newest coat of paint on the first door is thick, and the barman changes the subject.
quests.goal: Find someone who drank beside the brother on his last night
steps: Get Viktor Halasz to say what lies under the fresh paint.
Find someone who drank beside the brother on his last night.

quests.name: Nest Robbers
quests.info: Someone has been dropping into the gorge on ropes of their own and taking whole nests at once, which the gatherers never do, and the ranger at the preserve's gate thinks he knows the jeep they drive.
quests.goal: Hand the robbers to the ranger with what they took
steps: Find the nest robbers' camp.
Hand the robbers to the ranger with what they took.

quests.name: New Blood
quests.info: A recruiter brings in players the alliance can trust. The alliance needs three more, and every player in Masadora is a possible thief.
quests.goal: Bring them into the alliance
steps: Find three players worth trusting.
Bring them into the alliance.
Tell Nickes the job is done.

quests.name: Ninety Days
quests.info: A fighter who registers on the 200th floor has ninety days to fight his first bout, and the boy has handed in a date this week that one of the floor's regulars has already asked to take.
quests.goal: Get the boy to agree to wait
steps: Talk the matchmakers into holding the date open.
Get the boy to agree to wait.

quests.name: No Map to the Exam
quests.info: A busker in a top hat at the dry fountain is selling applicants the way to the Hunter Exam, written on a card, and the student has saved for weeks to buy one.
quests.goal: Show her why no bought route is worth having
steps: Learn what is really written on the busker's cards.
Show her why no bought route is worth having.

quests.name: No Names in the Circle
quests.info: Hessa Moor will put the Hunter's question to the circle, but only if somebody she trusts asks it for her. Questions about where children came from are the kind the circle hates most.
quests.goal: Bring the circle's answer back to the road end
steps: Put the Hunter's question to the Elders' Circle.
Bring the circle's answer back to the road end.

quests.name: Nobody Inside the Armour
quests.info: A suit of plate marches up and down the hill road and knocks travellers flat. Blows pass through it without so much as a dent, and the players it chased off swear by every card they own that it is a ghost.
quests.goal: Find what sits at the far end of it and look it in the face
steps: Use Gyo and follow the thin thread of aura that moves the armour.
Find what sits at the far end of it and look it in the face.

quests.name: Not the Family's Business
quests.info: The stolen prize money is turning up at the betting parlour's windows as wagers, and the family that owns the parlour has not been asked whether it minds.
quests.goal: Set the family against the freelancers using its windows
steps: Get a hearing in the parlour's back office.
Set the family against the freelancers using its windows.

quests.name: Numbers in a Notebook
quests.info: The seller slept a night at the motel on the highway out of Quant City, and the manager writes down every plate that pulls in but does not give his notebook away for nothing.
quests.goal: Search the room the seller slept in
steps: Get the seller's plate out of the manager.
Search the room the seller slept in.

quests.name: Numbers in the Air
quests.info: Biscuit writes a number in the air with her aura, hidden so only eyes full of aura can read it, and changes it every few seconds.
quests.goal: Read ten numbers in a row
steps: Train the eyes until you can see it.
Read ten numbers in a row.

quests.name: Odds on a Finished Fight
quests.info: A man in the back quarters has started taking bets on the taped fights from people who have never seen them, and he already knows every result from a foreign paper he keeps in his shoe.
quests.goal: Make him give back what he won
steps: Find the bookmaker in the back quarters.
Make him give back what he won.

quests.name: Of the Blood
quests.info: Only the king can raise a retainer to the royal family's own circle. He has asked to see the party alone, and the princes are watching the door.
quests.goal: Leave his rooms with his trust
steps: Answer the king's summons.
Leave his rooms with his trust.
Tell Nugui the job is done.

quests.name: One Name, Two Cots
quests.info: The girl on the floor will not say anything but the name. The child in the cot under that same name has been there a year and does not know her.
quests.goal: Find out who gave her the name
steps: Get the girl to say where she slept before she came.
Find out who gave her the name.
quests.next: Three Nights in a Neighbour's Shack

quests.name: One Signature, Two Faces
quests.info: The man asleep upstairs signed the registration book with a name another man wrote there last month, and the two did not look like brothers.
quests.goal: Learn which of the two men owns the name
steps: Set the two pages side by side and find the difference.
Learn which of the two men owns the name.

quests.name: Opening the Nodes
quests.info: Wing explains the two ways a body's aura is woken: slowly, over months of meditation, or all at once by another's push, which kills the unready. He offers the gentle push and asks who will take it.
quests.goal: Hold it in with Ten before the body runs dry
steps: Take the push and feel the aura pour out.
Hold it in with Ten before the body runs dry.

quests.name: Ottla's Book
quests.info: Someone has lifted the little betting book that the guards keep on the exam teams out of Ottla Wenzel's locker. Half the gantry owes the other half, and a guard who owes the most has been seen near the lockers.
quests.goal: Settle the debts before the guards come to blows
steps: Find the book.
Settle the debts before the guards come to blows.

quests.name: Out Before Dawn
quests.info: The fishermen mean to launch one boat before first light, while the lighthouse crew sleeps off its rum: the first boat out in years. They want strong backs on the chocks and sharp eyes on the headland.
quests.goal: Keep watch over the harbour until it comes home
steps: Run the boat down the shingle without waking the lighthouse.
Keep watch over the harbour until it comes home.

quests.name: Out of Bond
quests.info: The goods meant for the cases sit in the bonded warehouse at the West Gorteau border, and the glassworks has been told to send his lorry for them on papers already forged.
quests.goal: See what the forged papers were written to carry out
steps: Get into the bonded racks before the lorry is due.
See what the forged papers were written to carry out.

quests.name: Over Her Shoulder
quests.info: Last week a regular stood behind her at booth nine while she read the Hunters' Tavern, and he has not been back. The notice on the screen that night was a bounty on a forger of bearer bonds hiding somewhere in the city.
quests.goal: Find out who the regular is
steps: Learn which notice the regular read.
Find out who the regular is.

quests.name: Over the Rail
quests.info: A tourist's hire car missed the bend in the fog and is hanging in the trees below the guard rail with two people inside. The crew's truck is stuck behind a log lorry on the highway, and the party is closer.
quests.goal: Bring both passengers up to the road
steps: Rope down to the car before the branches give.
Bring both passengers up to the road.

quests.name: Paid by the Week
quests.info: The apprentice is hiding in a top bunk in a room of backpackers, with a week paid in advance and a bag he will not let go of. Two men in good shoes have already asked the porter for him by name.
quests.goal: Hear why he swapped the stones
steps: Reach the apprentice before the two men do.
Hear why he swapped the stones.
quests.line: The Book That Does Not Match

quests.name: Paper Tickets
quests.info: Forged betting slips are turning up at the windows, good enough to fool the clerks.
quests.goal: Shut the press
steps: Find where the slips are printed.
Shut the press.

quests.name: Papers at the Border
quests.info: A villager's son came home from the outside world and is being kept at the border because he carries a watch he will not give up.
quests.goal: Bring him home
steps: Hear the son and the guards.
Bring him home.

quests.name: Pawned Silver
quests.info: A trophy stolen from a fighter's private room has come to rest on the pawnbroker's shelves, and it came up the goods lift before it went down again.
quests.goal: Learn who pawned it
steps: Identify the trophy and its owner.
Learn who pawned it.

quests.name: Pay Night at the Pit
quests.info: The miners of the Roto Mountains hold a bare-knuckle smoker on the company row after pay night, and they have sent for the boy because one of the hewers has flattened everybody else in the valley.
quests.goal: Work his corner against the miners' champion
steps: Get the boy up the mountain road and through the evening in one piece.
Work his corner against the miners' champion.

quests.name: Posted for Hunters
quests.info: A bounty has been posted for Hunters on a poacher wanted in three countries, and word in the caravan camp says he means to cross the pass with a yak train before the snow shuts it. The sergeant has a barrier pole and four men.
quests.goal: Hold him at the border post until the claim is made
steps: Pick the poacher out of the caravan camp.
Hold him at the border post until the claim is made.
quests.line: A Horn for a Foreign Buyer

quests.name: Proctor of the Fog
quests.info: A phase proctor keeps the applicants honest and alive enough to fail. The wetlands are full of creatures that mimic people, and one of them has learned to mimic an examiner.
quests.goal: Keep the applicants on the right path
steps: Find the creature wearing an examiner's shape.
Keep the applicants on the right path.
Tell Satotz the job is done.

quests.name: Proof of the Name
quests.info: A claimant must show the name is more than a boast. Three Hunters in the city say the party has no right to it, and they will settle the matter in a test of their own choosing.
quests.goal: Pass it in front of witnesses
steps: Accept the three Hunters' test.
Pass it in front of witnesses.
Tell Loupe Highland the job is done.

quests.name: Quarantine Orders
quests.info: A senior advisor acts while the rest are still arguing. A disease no one can name has reached a ward in Swardani Hospital, and the council wants it contained before the press hears of it.
quests.goal: Find where the sickness came from
steps: Close the ward and keep the staff calm.
Find where the sickness came from.
Tell Cheadle Yorkshire the job is done.

quests.name: Queue in Zaban City
quests.info: The streets of Zaban City are full of applicants every winter, and a gang of pickpockets is working the queues at the frog stalls.
quests.goal: Return what they took
steps: Catch the pickpockets.
Return what they took.

quests.name: Rice and Raw Fish
quests.info: Menchi asks for a dish from a far country that nobody in the party has eaten: rice shaped by hand and topped with fresh fish from the stream.
quests.goal: Make the dish the way it is meant to be made
steps: Catch the fish.
Make the dish the way it is meant to be made.

quests.name: Rice Before Rent
quests.info: The terraces the widow's family came down from are ripe, the landlord's agent comes at the end of the week to count the harvest, and the old pump keeper has nobody to cut it. Her grandson knows every step of that hill.
quests.goal: Have the rice in the granary before the agent comes
steps: Bring hands from the hiring yard to the terraces.
Have the rice in the granary before the agent comes.

quests.name: Right Hand of the Crew
quests.info: The crew's right hand keeps everyone alive when the work turns dangerous. Something large has been moving round the camp at night, and the crew wants to keep working.
quests.goal: Get the crew through the season alive
steps: Find what circles the camp.
Get the crew through the season alive.
Tell Spinner Clow the job is done.

quests.name: Same Dent, New Plate
quests.info: The youngest watcher at the checkpoint has been told by the new shift to stop writing down plates. He has not stopped, and his private notebook shows one truck coming every week under a different plate with the same dent in its tailgate.
quests.goal: Search the dented truck on its next run
steps: Read Pell's notebook against Senna's list.
Search the dented truck on its next run.

quests.name: Sap in the Thicket
quests.info: The old eel-trapper says her mother once carried a pale flower out of the sap thicket that glowed on the kitchen table for one night and was water by morning.
quests.goal: Search the thicket after dark
steps: Win the trapper's leave to go into the thicket.
Search the thicket after dark.
quests.next: The Ledge in the Drip Gallery

quests.name: Scrapings from the Wall
quests.info: Someone in the guide's last small group carried a blade and a paper envelope past the glass, and there is a fresh scratch beside one of the paintings. The tour bus leaves in an hour.
quests.goal: Recover the scrapings before the bus leaves
steps: Find which visitor took the pigment.
Recover the scrapings before the bus leaves.

quests.name: Sealed at the Border
quests.info: The guards at the hollow trees have caught the rider with his next bag and want the names of everyone who ever touched it, and Gretl means to keep her riders' good name if she can.
quests.goal: Find a way to keep the post's name clean
steps: Speak for the rider before the guards.
Find a way to keep the post's name clean.

quests.name: Second Class
quests.info: A private second class has been seen by an officer and not forgotten. The party must win the drill competition held for the first prince's guard.
quests.goal: Win the competition
steps: Train for the drill.
Win the competition.
Tell Balsamilco Might the job is done.

quests.name: Shed Four
quests.info: A case with no stencil and no waybill has stood in shed four for nine days, the night crews will not go near it, and the foreman swears it is nobody's business.
quests.goal: See it opened in front of witnesses, or carried off under the captain's eye
steps: Learn who the case was flown in for.
See it opened in front of witnesses, or carried off under the captain's eye.

quests.name: Shovels
quests.info: Biscuit hands out shovels and points at the hardest ground in the badlands. The digging is to be done with aura wrapped round the blade.
quests.goal: Reach the depth she marked
steps: Dig with an aura-wrapped shovel.
Reach the depth she marked.

quests.name: Siding Six
quests.info: A sealed wagon has stood on siding six for a week. Its manifest was typed on paper the night clerk has never seen, nobody has come to claim it, and last night something inside it moved.
quests.goal: Learn who sent it
steps: Learn what is in the sealed wagon.
Learn who sent it.

quests.name: Six in a Room
quests.info: An elite killer is the one the others listen to. Six killers hired for the same target meet in a hotel room and argue whether to work together.
quests.goal: Decide how the six will work
steps: Hear the other five out.
Decide how the six will work.
Tell Sengi Guild Agent the job is done.

quests.name: Slates Under the Floor
quests.info: A boy of fifteen has missed four days of school. Under the loose board by his bench Ottilie Brandt found a stack of slates covered in words copied from an outside newspaper, over and over: Hunter, licence, exam.
quests.goal: Learn where the newspaper came from
steps: Read the slates.
Learn where the newspaper came from.

quests.name: Slips with a Borrowed Stamp
quests.info: The tout has moved on from maps to boarding slips for the applicants' ship, with the harbourmaster's stamp copied crookedly at the foot. Anyone who shows one at the gangway will be turned away, and some of the hopefuls have handed over everything they brought to get one.
quests.goal: See the cheated applicants paid back
steps: Catch the tout with forged slips in his pockets.
See the cheated applicants paid back.

quests.name: Smoke on the North Slope
quests.info: The bounty hunters have found the gully and set the bracken above it alight to drive the wanted man into the open. The wind is out of the south, Arlo Crane's smouldering kiln stands upslope, and the foxbear dens lie straight in the path of the fire.
quests.goal: Get the wanted man off the slope alive and settle what becomes of him
steps: Beat out or cut off the fire before it reaches the dens or the kilns.
Get the wanted man off the slope alive and settle what becomes of him.

quests.name: Smoke Read Wrong
quests.info: Jory mentions, between mounds, that a newcomer joined the burners last autumn: soft hands that hardened fast, a jump at every hoofbeat, and a flat refusal to sit for the children who draw faces in the ash.
quests.goal: Learn what he ran from
steps: Find the newcomer among the mounds.
Learn what he ran from.

quests.name: Snow at the Barrier
quests.info: The seller means to be over the Roto Mountains before the pass closes for the winter, with a new name in a passport he printed himself.
quests.goal: Take him and his printing kit without a shot fired
steps: Reach the barrier before he does.
Take him and his printing kit without a shot fired.

quests.name: Soldiers' Pay
quests.info: Men from a royal household have been sitting at the end of her bench, talking to the young ones about uniforms and soldiers' pay, and her grandson has started listening. They carry papers for the boys to sign, and none of the boys can read them.
quests.goal: Tell the young men at the bench what they would be signing
steps: Read one of the recruiters' papers.
Tell the young men at the bench what they would be signing.

quests.name: Someone Is Thinking of the Cage
quests.info: The woman who guards the chair at the tables says that for three nights someone in the hall has been thinking hard about the money behind the bars, and tonight the week's takings are counted.
quests.goal: Stop the robbery before anyone draws a gun
steps: Pick out who means to rob the cage.
Stop the robbery before anyone draws a gun.

quests.name: Something Breathing
quests.info: The dealer's men are bringing a truck to take the container to the salvage yard tonight and crush it with whatever is inside. Gus has put his kettle on and turned his back to the window.
quests.goal: Keep the animals inside it alive
steps: Open the container before the truck arrives.
Keep the animals inside it alive.

quests.name: Something on the Beach
quests.info: The tide has left something on the driftwood beach that nobody can name: a shell bigger than a boat, cracked open and empty.
quests.goal: Tell the elders what it is, if anyone can
steps: Look at the shell.
Tell the elders what it is, if anyone can.

quests.name: Something Taking Goats
quests.info: The old goat farmer has finally rung the rescue hut instead of the police, because the print in his mud is bigger than his hand and he will not go out after dark. The crew leader would rather know what is walking the high pastures before his volunteers do.
quests.goal: Track whatever comes for the goats
steps: Sit up a night with the farmer and his dog.
Track whatever comes for the goats.

quests.name: Souvenirs of a Killer
quests.info: A shop in the market sells the family's portraits on mugs and shirts, and the shopkeeper's windows were broken last night.
quests.goal: Keep the shop from worse
steps: Find who broke the windows.
Keep the shop from worse.

quests.name: Sparring With Bisky
quests.info: The last drill is a fight with Biscuit herself, moving aura from fist to foot to guard as fast as the blows come.
quests.goal: Land a blow she did not let you land
steps: Spar with Biscuit.
Land a blow she did not let you land.

quests.name: Spell Cards
quests.info: Spell cards are sold in packs at Masadora, and the queue is full of players who will rob anyone who comes out with a good one.
quests.goal: Leave the town with the cards
steps: Buy packs at the shop.
Leave the town with the cards.

quests.name: Splints and Shackles
quests.info: The medic has a notebook of every injury the tower's traps have caused for a decade, and he wants the trapwright to read it before the next exam. The trapwright has refused to open it twice.
quests.goal: Persuade the trapwright to blunt one trap
steps: Carry the notebook to the fork room.
Persuade the trapwright to blunt one trap.

quests.name: Spots on the Mud Pan
quests.info: A Melanin Lizard has lain down across the only dry path over the flats. Two new players who tried to shift it with their fists are still crouched behind the bone heap, waiting for it to fall asleep, and it has not.
quests.goal: Strike that one spot and take the lizard's card
steps: Watch the lizard until it shows which of its spots it keeps turned away.
Strike that one spot and take the lizard's card.

quests.name: Stacked Three High
quests.info: A player at the open tables has won every wager for a month by stacking his pieces in towers nobody sees coming, and the judge is sure someone in the crowd is telling him the moves.
quests.goal: Catch the one who signals to him
steps: Watch the player's games from the gallery.
Catch the one who signals to him.
quests.next: A Game That Was Never Played

quests.name: Static in the Radio Room
quests.info: For three nights a convoy has called itself in short bursts on a band the watch keeps open, numbers and the names of colours.
quests.goal: Find the page of the arrivals book where it last appears
steps: Sit the night shift on the radio and copy the code.
Find the page of the arrivals book where it last appears.

quests.name: Stencils in the Register
quests.info: Before he decides anything, Sindri Ahl wants to know whose stencil that is. Corwin Strand keeps the harbour registers back past the year the ship struck, and he opens them for nobody without a reason he likes.
quests.goal: Trace the stencil from the wreck to the firm that shipped her cargo
steps: Give the harbourmaster a reason to open the old registers.
Trace the stencil from the wreck to the firm that shipped her cargo.
quests.next: The Firm's Man at the Gullwing

quests.name: Stone Through Stone
quests.info: A boy who came into the game alone, with no team and no teacher, has camped on the stone field for a week smashing rocks with his bare knuckles. His hands are wrapped in rags now. The keeper would rather have him alive than strong.
quests.goal: Walk him back to the waystation before the monsters come out at dusk
steps: Show him how to hold aura evenly through one stone and break another with it.
Walk him back to the waystation before the monsters come out at dusk.

quests.name: Stranded Below the Rim
quests.info: A player who heard tavern talk of treasure under the town went down the cliff on the old rope ladder, and a rung gave under him. He has clung to the ledge since dawn, and fog is rolling in off the western sea.
quests.goal: Bring him up to the rim alive
steps: Reach the ledge before the fog hides it.
Bring him up to the rim alive.

quests.name: Stranded on Zevil
quests.info: A commission boat went aground off Zevil Island, and its crew is sheltering in the shore caves while the tide rises.
quests.goal: Get the crew off the island
steps: Reach the caves before the tide.
Get the crew off the island.

quests.name: Strangers in the Back Room
quests.info: Two strangers in the inn's back room ask every newcomer which cards they started with, then offer a friendly game of dice. The newcomers come out with thinner binders and a horror of dice.
quests.goal: Win back what the newcomers lost
steps: Sit at their table and learn how the game is rigged.
Win back what the newcomers lost.

quests.name: Tabs Paid in Winnings
quests.info: Ever since the weather pinned the visiting crews to the outer mole, somebody has been staging bare-knuckle bouts after dark. One crewman settles his whole boat's tab every morning from a fat roll of wager money, and nobody has seen him lose. Rudd keeps an honest room; he wants to know if the fights are honest too.
quests.goal: Find out where tonight's bout is to be held
steps: Sit with Silas Ormond in the stove corner and read his book on the bouts.
Find out where tonight's bout is to be held.

quests.name: Talking Down the Airship
quests.info: Fog has come in off the sea, the airship's radio has failed on the way back from the far sites, and three examiners are aboard. The only way to bring it to the mast is by flare.
quests.goal: Bring the airship in to the mast
steps: Light flares along the mooring field.
Bring the airship in to the mast.

quests.name: Tea in the Waiting Ring
quests.info: The woman in the photograph keeps a spotless camper van at the caravan lot, and her barrel ran dry at noon. She will pour tea for anyone who brings her water, and she is ready to explain the suitcase to someone at last.
quests.goal: Hear what her books say about the family
steps: Bring water to the woman's van.
Hear what her books say about the family.

quests.name: Teeth in the Scrap
quests.info: The last load of iron from the mountain's scrap heap had a buckle in it with a name scratched on the back, and a blade bent into a shape that no forge made. the smith has stopped cutting and wants to know before he sells any more of it.
quests.goal: Put the question of the load to Ottokar at the gate
steps: Sort the load at the forge and read what is written on the metal.
Put the question of the load to Ottokar at the gate.
quests.line: The Boy at the First Door

quests.name: Ten Before Four
quests.info: A challenger must win ten matches on the 200th floor before losing four. The party has entered the count and the crowd has started to bet against it.
quests.goal: Reach ten wins before four losses
steps: Win the first five without a loss.
Reach ten wins before four losses.
Tell Heavens Arena 200th Floor Clerk the job is done.

quests.name: Teo on the Card
quests.info: Tonight there is an islander on the card: Teo Bramwell, whose father's trawler has sat on the yard's blocks since autumn for want of money. He has signed to fight the crewman nobody beats for a purse that would clear his bill. Rudd saw the last man who took that purse carried down the mole on a door.
quests.goal: Watch the champion closely enough to see how he really wins
steps: Get inside the boatyard shed before the first bout.
Watch the champion closely enough to see how he really wins.

quests.name: The Abandoned Rig
quests.info: The young driver made one call from the diner's payphone before he walked away from his rig, and the night waitress, Darlene Voss, remembers every number anyone ever asked for.
quests.goal: Learn whose telephone it rings
steps: Win Darlene Voss's trust enough to hear the number.
Learn whose telephone it rings.

quests.name: The Accident Book
quests.info: The burials are paid for by a man who gives no name, and the tower keeps a book of everything that goes wrong inside it.
quests.goal: Match its pages to the burial register
steps: See the tower's accident book.
Match its pages to the burial register.

quests.name: The Adviser's Chair
quests.info: The deputy military adviser plans for the whole Royal Army. The army needs a plan to hold the ship's lower tiers if order breaks down, and the princes' guards must not be able to say it was aimed at them.
quests.goal: Get it approved without a quarrel
steps: Draw up the plan.
Get it approved without a quarrel.
Tell Balsamilco Might the job is done.

quests.name: The Ape With a Face
quests.info: An ape with a human face is luring travellers out of the wetland fog by pretending to be someone they trust.
quests.goal: Drive it off the path for good
steps: Find the ape in the fog.
Drive it off the path for good.

quests.name: The Application
quests.info: Applications close on the last day of the year, and a young applicant at the harbour needs a guardian's signature he does not have.
quests.goal: See the application sent before the year ends
steps: Help the applicant get his signature.
See the application sent before the year ends.

quests.name: The Appraisal
quests.info: The treasure has to be valued before anyone can say what it is, and Kanzai wants it done at the best house in the world.
quests.goal: Learn what it really is and who owns it
steps: Bring the treasure to the appraisers.
Learn what it really is and who owns it.

quests.name: The Archive in Peijin
quests.info: Old papers in the capital's archive speak of a scroll taken from a foreign monk long ago, and the archive is guarded day and night.
quests.goal: Learn what became of the scroll
steps: Get into the archive.
Learn what became of the scroll.

quests.name: The Assay Book
quests.info: The silver camp's assay book sat in the ruined bank's safe for eighty years, and when she opened it last week, the pages for the camp's richest year had been cut out with a clean blade.
quests.goal: Learn which shaft the missing pages describe
steps: Search the camp for whoever took the pages.
Learn which shaft the missing pages describe.

quests.name: The Attaché's Bag
quests.info: An attaché carries what the nations will not put on a wire. The bag must cross a city where three newspapers are watching.
quests.goal: Hand it over unopened
steps: Get the bag across the city.
Hand it over unopened.
Tell Mizaistom Nana the job is done.

quests.name: The Auction's Books
quests.info: A Don's accountant keeps the money that the auction moves. The figures from last year do not match what the vaults hold.
quests.goal: Find where the difference went
steps: Read the auction's books against the vaults.
Find where the difference went.
Tell Zenji the job is done.

quests.name: The Back Row Fugitive
quests.info: A forger who skipped bail in the city has been sleeping in a borrowed car in the drive-in's back row, in among the black sedans whose drivers never look at the screen.
quests.goal: Walk him out before the film ends
steps: Pick out the fugitive's car without waking the wrong ones.
Walk him out before the film ends.

quests.name: The Back Surgery
quests.info: The doctor at the Mercy Street Free Clinic needs a student for his night shift, and on her first night two family soldiers carry in a third with a bullet in his thigh and their guns still out.
quests.goal: See the student through the shift
steps: Keep the soldiers calm while the doctor works.
See the student through the shift.
quests.next: The Night Coach to the Harbour

quests.name: The Barge Thieves
quests.info: Someone takes the best of every barge before the residents can sort it, and sells it in the market for food the city never sees.
quests.goal: Catch the thieves
steps: Watch the barges come in.
Catch the thieves.

quests.name: The Bloc Count
quests.info: A staff advisor counts heads before the meeting, not during it. The council splits into reformers, moderates and those who will not play politics, and a motion needs a majority by morning.
quests.goal: Bring the motion to a majority before the vote
steps: Learn where each advisor stands.
Bring the motion to a majority before the vote.
Tell Cheadle Yorkshire the job is done.

quests.name: The Boat in the Ring
quests.info: A fisherman's son walked into the pirates' tavern with drink in him and staked his father's boat on a shoving match inside the burning ring out back. He lost in a breath, and the pirates have daubed a skull across the boat's bow.
quests.goal: Win it back, in the ring or by a sharper bargain
steps: Find out what the pirates will take to give the boat up.
Win it back, in the ring or by a sharper bargain.

quests.name: The Boat with No Lights
quests.info: For a week a boat has lain off the far side of Zevil Island at night with every light doused. It is not the commission's launch; the keeper knows that boat's shape by heart.
quests.goal: Warn it off or bring word to the observers
steps: Row out and learn what the boat is after.
Warn it off or bring word to the observers.

quests.name: The Boathouse on the Flats
quests.info: With the family's protection gone, the robbers have gone to ground in a boathouse among the reeds, and the last envelope they took is still with them.
quests.goal: Bring the envelopes back to the prize office
steps: Find the boathouse.
Bring the envelopes back to the prize office.

quests.name: The Book That Does Not Match
quests.info: The stone sent back from the cutter's this morning sits in her tray with the right weight on its tag, yet under her loupe it has none of the flaws she wrote into her book the day she dug it out of the ground.
quests.goal: Learn which apprentice carried the parcel
steps: Compare the stone against the book with her.
Learn which apprentice carried the parcel.
quests.line: The Book That Does Not Match

quests.name: The Border Guard
quests.info: A border guard strips every visitor of anything made by machine. A party of strangers is at the gate carrying more than they declared.
quests.goal: Decide who may enter
steps: Search the strangers properly.
Decide who may enter.
Tell Haruna the job is done.

quests.name: The Border Officer
quests.info: A border officer decides who crosses between five countries. A truck with papers from the closed side of the Union wants through.
quests.goal: Decide whether it crosses
steps: Inspect the truck and its papers.
Decide whether it crosses.
Tell Knuckle Bine the job is done.

quests.name: The Border Post
quests.info: A family is trying to cross into West Gorteau with forged papers, and the guard on duty tonight is a man who shoots.
quests.goal: See them across
steps: Find the family before the guard does.
See them across.

quests.name: The Boy at the End of the Alley
quests.info: One of Ku Tal-bong's lookout boys was picked up in a sweep and is sitting in a police station in Mandai, eleven years old and frightened enough to say anything.
quests.goal: Get him out before he names the corner
steps: Find which station is holding the boy.
Get him out before he names the corner.

quests.name: The Boy at the First Door
quests.info: Wim Jansen has pushed at the gate every day this week with a vest the smith fitted for him, and yesterday he came back with blood under his fingernails. the smith is afraid the next thing the boy tries will be the small side door.
quests.goal: Talk him into training properly at the gatekeepers' cabin
steps: Watch the boy's morning at the gate.
Talk him into training properly at the gatekeepers' cabin.
quests.line: The Boy at the First Door

quests.name: The Boy on the Ridge
quests.info: A herder's youngest went up the lightning ridge after dark to see the fire cat for himself, and the storm is coming in early. His mother is at the foot of the hill with a lantern, and nobody else will go up.
quests.goal: Bring him down the hill alive
steps: Find the boy on the ridge before the storm breaks.
Bring him down the hill alive.
quests.line: A Horn for a Foreign Buyer

quests.name: The Bridge on the Highway
quests.info: A landslide has blocked the highway at the bridge, and the tour bus is stuck on the far side with forty tourists aboard.
quests.goal: Bring the bus back to town
steps: Clear the road.
Bring the bus back to town.
quests.next: The Man Who Wanted a Contract

quests.name: The Broker's Deal
quests.info: A broker sells what the family knows. A guard of another prince wants to buy information the family should not sell.
quests.goal: Sell or refuse, and keep the family's name
steps: Meet the guard in the dark of the theatre.
Sell or refuse, and keep the family's name.
Tell Morena Prudo the job is done.

quests.name: The Bubble Horse
quests.info: A horse made of something like bubbles runs on the meadow and vanishes when anyone comes near.
quests.goal: Catch it
steps: Learn how the horse can be approached.
Catch it.

quests.name: The Bull Market
quests.info: The trail leads to Yorknew's bull market, where anything can be bought if you know which stall to ask.
quests.goal: Learn who bought this one
steps: Find the stall that deals in licences.
Learn who bought this one.

quests.name: The Butterflies of the Woods
quests.info: An applicant left behind after the exam is hiding wounded in the woods of Zevil Island, and the crimson butterflies that smell blood from far off are gathering on him, drawing everything that hunts there.
quests.goal: Get him off the island
steps: Find the wounded applicant.
Get him off the island.

quests.name: The Buyer's Errand
quests.info: The buyer has taken the card into Meteor City, where a licence is worth more than a life and nobody is on paper.
quests.goal: Get the card back
steps: Find the buyer in the city.
Get the card back.

quests.name: The Buyer's Name
quests.info: The fence, the driver and the launch's crew are in the holding cells, a lawyer from Yorknew City is on the afternoon train to get them out, and not one of them will name who was waiting at the other end.
quests.goal: Get the buyer's name before the lawyer arrives
steps: Learn which prisoner is most afraid.
Get the buyer's name before the lawyer arrives.
quests.line: The Sword in the Back Room

quests.name: The Capo's Street
quests.info: A capo runs a street of his own. The party is given one in Yorknew and has a month to make it pay without starting a war.
quests.goal: Make it pay without a war
steps: Take over the street's business.
Make it pay without a war.
Tell Light Nostrade the job is done.

quests.name: The Car with Tinted Windows
quests.info: A black car has sat outside the cannery for two days. The owner says it is nothing; his foreman says the men inside came onto the quay at night and measured it with a tape.
quests.goal: Get the men off the quay without the quay rights
steps: Learn who holds the cannery's debt.
Get the men off the quay without the quay rights.

quests.name: The Caravan Market
quests.info: A caravan in the market at Setl City is selling animals that should not be for sale, caught somewhere across the border.
quests.goal: Free them and stop the trade
steps: Find where the animals came from.
Free them and stop the trade.

quests.name: The Carvings of the Clan
quests.info: The village of the Kurta is empty, and the carvings on its doorposts and shrine stones are in an old script that few living people can read.
quests.goal: Take nothing away but the words
steps: Read the carvings without disturbing them.
Take nothing away but the words.

quests.name: The Case in the Buffet
quests.info: The rival has caught up with Ysolde Marchetti in the junction buffet with two men lent him by a dealer who sells rare plants to the rich of Yorknew City.
quests.goal: See her onto her train with the cutting
steps: Keep the Hunter's case out of their hands in a crowded station.
See her onto her train with the cutting.

quests.name: The Catalogue Entry
quests.info: A pair of the eyes is listed in an auction catalogue under a collector's name.
quests.goal: Learn who means to buy them
steps: Learn who is selling them.
Learn who means to buy them.

quests.name: The Chair of the Union
quests.info: The chair speaks for five countries at once. A crisis on the Union's closed shores has the world asking questions, and the members will not agree on an answer.
quests.goal: Give the world one answer
steps: Bring the five members to one table.
Give the world one answer.
Tell Knuckle Bine the job is done.

quests.name: The Chalkboard Message
quests.info: Someone has been writing messages on the square's chalkboard in a code, and the last one names a meeting tonight.
quests.goal: Go to the meeting
steps: Break the code.
Go to the meeting.

quests.name: The Chapel of the Dead
quests.info: A church keeper tends the city's dead. A body has been brought back from abroad with no name and the scars of a hard death, and the city wants it buried right.
quests.goal: Give the body the city's rites
steps: Learn who the dead resident was.
Give the body the city's rites.
Tell Franklin Bordeau the job is done.

quests.name: The Clause on the Last Page
quests.info: A promoter in the lobby bar has the boy under contract, and the contract does not let him refuse a bout the promoter books.
quests.goal: Get the clause struck out
steps: Read the whole contract.
Get the clause struck out.

quests.name: The Clear
quests.info: The millionaire's chosen is the player who clears the game. One card remains between the party and the prize the millionaire has paid a fortune for.
quests.goal: Clear the game
steps: Find the last card.
Clear the game.
Tell Battera the job is done.

quests.name: The Climber on the Ledge
quests.info: An applicant who tried to climb down the outside of the tower instead of going through it is clinging to a ledge, and the birds that nest there are circling.
quests.goal: Bring the climber down alive
steps: Reach the ledge.
Bring the climber down alive.

quests.name: The Clinic Underground
quests.info: A clinic below a street in a closed country treats people who cannot go to the state's doctors, and it is running out of everything.
quests.goal: Keep the police from finding it
steps: Bring the clinic what it needs.
Keep the police from finding it.

quests.name: The Closed Shore
quests.info: The coast of NGL is closed to boats, but something large has been seen moving in the shallows.
quests.goal: Learn what moves in the shallows
steps: Watch the shore from the sea.
Learn what moves in the shallows.

quests.name: The Codename Book
quests.info: A clerk of the council keeps its papers in order. Twelve codenames, twelve tempers and a cabinet of sealed instructions: the party must sort a year of minutes so a vote can be checked against it.
quests.goal: Find the vote that does not match its record
steps: Sort the year's minutes by seat and session.
Find the vote that does not match its record.
Tell Cheadle Yorkshire the job is done.

quests.name: The Coin Game
quests.info: A senior butler can play the coin game blindfold. The head butler sets the party guessing which hand holds the coin while the hands move faster than an eye.
quests.goal: Win the game against the butlers
steps: Learn to follow the coin.
Win the game against the butlers.
Tell Canary the job is done.

quests.name: The Collector's Cut
quests.info: The Cha-R collector who takes his cut at the tea stall has begun taking a second one, from the young men he signs up to fight at night, and those who lose owe him their next month's wages.
quests.goal: Make the collector tear up the debts, or answer to his family
steps: Learn how many fighters owe the collector.
Make the collector tear up the debts, or answer to his family.
quests.next: Cadets with Their Pay in Their Boots

quests.name: The Collector's Score
quests.info: A page of old music has come up for sale, and the catalogue says it was found with a flute part nobody has dared to play.
quests.goal: Keep it from being played
steps: Learn where the page came from.
Keep it from being played.

quests.name: The Collector's Ship
quests.info: The last pairs belong to people who travel with armies of guards, and one of them is aboard a ship among the richest passengers in the world.
quests.goal: Find a way to them that does not start a war
steps: Learn which passenger holds the eyes.
Find a way to them that does not start a war.

quests.name: The Conditional Auction
quests.info: A stall in the bull market runs auctions with strange rules, and buyers keep leaving with less than they paid for.
quests.goal: Expose the trick
steps: Play the stall's game.
Expose the trick.

quests.name: The Contest in Antokiba
quests.info: Antokiba holds contests with specified cards as prizes, and this month's contest is one the party can win.
quests.goal: Win the specified card
steps: Enter the contest.
Win the specified card.

quests.name: The Convener's Word
quests.info: The convener speaks for the alliance when it breaks. The pirates have won, the alliance is walking away, and the party must decide whether anyone keeps after the card.
quests.goal: Decide who keeps after the card
steps: Hold the members together one more day.
Decide who keeps after the card.
Tell Goreinu the job is done.

quests.name: The Corporal's Squad
quests.info: A corporal leads a squad of his own. A squad on the fourth tier has lost its corporal and its discipline in the same week.
quests.goal: Bring it through an inspection
steps: Take the squad in hand.
Bring it through an inspection.
Tell Balsamilco Might the job is done.

quests.name: The Councillor's Figures
quests.info: A councillor knows the aid figures by heart. The aid sent to the closed members does not match what reached them.
quests.goal: Report where it went
steps: Follow the aid.
Report where it went.
Tell Knuckle Bine the job is done.

quests.name: The Countdown
quests.info: A senior member stands with the others when it matters. A member has a mark on his skin and a voice in his ear counting down, and he says it will kill him unless he gives up the alliance's cards.
quests.goal: Save the member without giving up the cards
steps: Learn what the mark is.
Save the member without giving up the cards.
Tell Nickes the job is done.

quests.name: The Courier's Steps
quests.info: The palace courier comes at dawn for the oldest scrolls, and the keeper has heard that someone means to meet the cart on the hill steps, where the incense smoke is thickest and the pilgrims crowd. He would rather lose his post than the scrolls.
quests.goal: Turn back whoever comes for it
steps: Walk beside the cart down the temple steps.
Turn back whoever comes for it.

quests.name: The Dare
quests.info: A boy from the pier rowed across to Zevil Island on a dare and went into the cave above the sea that every fisherman's child is told to stay out of. His friends rowed home without him.
quests.goal: Bring the boy out alive
steps: Reach the cave mouth.
Bring the boy out alive.

quests.name: The Dealer's Copy
quests.info: A dealer at the preview market in Yorknew swears he once handled a copy of the scroll and knows where it went.
quests.goal: Learn whether his copy was real
steps: Find the dealer.
Learn whether his copy was real.

quests.name: The Deck Boss
quests.info: A deck boss runs a deck for the family. The fifth tier's passengers are restless and the family wants them calm and paying.
quests.goal: Keep the deck calm and paying
steps: Learn what the passengers want.
Keep the deck calm and paying.
Tell Brocco Li the job is done.

quests.name: The Deed of Gift
quests.info: The men in suits are back with surveyors' stakes, but Anselm Duquesne, the old priest, remembers that the order which built his chapel was once given the land the camp stands on, and that the paper is somewhere in his records.
quests.goal: Put it in front of the men in suits and a city clerk together
steps: Find the deed in the chapel's records.
Put it in front of the men in suits and a city clerk together.

quests.name: The Depot Delay
quests.info: A convoy of medicine has been held at the Quen depot for a week because its papers have gone missing.
quests.goal: Get the convoy moving
steps: Find the papers.
Get the convoy moving.

quests.name: The Deputy's Desk
quests.info: The deputy secretary coordinates every agency at once. The agencies' people aboard are lent to the ship's investigators, and their reports are going missing.
quests.goal: Keep the agencies' work in one hand
steps: Find where the reports go.
Keep the agencies' work in one hand.
Tell Saccho Kobayakawa the job is done.

quests.name: The Digger With a Survey Map
quests.info: A foreigner with good boots and a folding shovel has been digging holes along the logging tracks below the temple, each one a little closer to it, with a hand-drawn map on a clipboard.
quests.goal: Learn whose map he is following
steps: Find the digger's camp in the pines.
Learn whose map he is following.
quests.next: A Map in a Grey Folder

quests.name: The Don's Messenger
quests.info: A messenger carries a Don's will word for word. The party must take an order to a boss who will not like it and make sure he understands it is not a request.
quests.goal: See that it is obeyed
steps: Deliver the order word for word.
See that it is obeyed.
Tell Zenji the job is done.

quests.name: The Drawing on the Beam
