quests.info: Someone pinned the stranger's drawing to the weighing beam. Half the market is whispering about the reward the stranger hinted at, the other half says the creed forbids selling a man to the outside, and Ebbert Kemp has already pulled two of them apart.
quests.goal: Find who tore the drawing down in the night
steps: Cool the market before it comes to blows.
Find who tore the drawing down in the night.

quests.name: The Driver's Card
quests.info: A young lorry driver handed over his savings for a Hunter License that turned out to be a printed card in a plastic sleeve, and the seller promised him a place at the next exam into the bargain.
quests.goal: Find what the seller left behind in the yard
steps: Hear from the driver how and where the card was sold.
Find what the seller left behind in the yard.

quests.name: The Dry Shelf
quests.info: The chart marks the dry shelf in the sea caves, and only one man on the island rows those cave mouths: Lazlo Fitch, retired by his own account, who has lately been drinking with a stranger off a mainland boat. Hobb is fairly sure the old smuggler has agreed to hold a cargo for them, and he would like very much to be wrong.
quests.goal: Reach the dry shelf at low water and see what is stowed there
steps: Get Lazlo Fitch to say what he promised the mainland man.
Reach the dry shelf at low water and see what is stowed there.

quests.name: The Eggs of the Chasm
quests.info: Spider eagles hang their eggs on threads over the chasm of Split Mountain, and the only way to them is to jump.
quests.goal: Come back up with an egg
steps: Jump into the chasm.
Come back up with an egg.

quests.name: The Eleventh Chair
quests.info: Ten chairs, ten territories, and nobody joins the table without the others agreeing. A territory has fallen vacant, and the party must win it the old way: by being too useful to refuse.
quests.goal: Take the vacant chair
steps: Win the backing of the other Dons.
Take the vacant chair.
Tell Zenji the job is done.

quests.name: The Empty Desk
quests.info: A boy from the camp who never missed a day of school has been gone two weeks, and Harriet Coyle, his teacher, has started asking questions in places where questions get people hurt.
quests.goal: Keep the teacher out of trouble while the party asks instead
steps: Hear what the boy's classmates know.
Keep the teacher out of trouble while the party asks instead.

quests.name: The Empty Village
quests.info: Kurapika wants to begin where it began: the village in the forest where his clan was killed.
quests.goal: Find what the killers left behind
steps: Walk the village with him.
Find what the killers left behind.

quests.name: The Endless Debate
quests.info: An assembly voice is heard among the elders. They have argued for nine days over whether a stranger's offer of help is a gift or a trap, and the city cannot wait for the tenth.
quests.goal: Bring the elders to a decision
steps: Learn what the stranger wants.
Bring the elders to a decision.
Tell Franklin Bordeau the job is done.

quests.name: The Entrance Exam
quests.info: The medical school's entrance exam is in a month, and Leorio has not slept properly in a week.
quests.goal: Get him to the exam on time and awake
steps: Help Leorio study.
Get him to the exam on time and awake.

quests.name: The Envoy's Errand
quests.info: An envoy knows which member of the Union is lying. Two members tell the council opposite stories about the same border shooting.
quests.goal: Find which one lies
steps: Hear both members.
Find which one lies.
Tell Knuckle Bine the job is done.

quests.name: The Envoy's Request
quests.info: An envoy asks the Hunters for what armies cannot do. The nations want a job done quietly and the Association wants to know why.
quests.goal: Win the Association's agreement
steps: Carry the nations' request to the Association.
Win the Association's agreement.
Tell Mizaistom Nana the job is done.

quests.name: The Escort Order
quests.info: An agency director sends escorts when a refusal fails. A voyage the agencies could not stop is about to leave, and someone must go with it.
quests.goal: Get them aboard with the right papers
steps: Choose the escorts.
Get them aboard with the right papers.
Tell Saccho Kobayakawa the job is done.

quests.name: The Exam Behind the Exam
quests.info: A licence makes a Hunter on paper only. The Bylaws ask that every Hunter know the art of aura, and the Association tests its rookies for it without ever saying so aloud.
quests.goal: Show the examiner what the body can do with its own aura
steps: Find a Hunter willing to show the way.
Show the examiner what the body can do with its own aura.
Tell Mamen Beans the job is done.

quests.name: The Face He Did Not Forget
quests.info: A man came through the restricted line this morning under a new name, and Tsui Wenjie knows the face: two years ago he was told to forget it. The man's permit is in order. His luggage went out on a cart that never reached the carousel.
quests.goal: Learn what the stranger's permit lets him reach
steps: Follow the cart from the airship masts to whoever collects it.
Learn what the stranger's permit lets him reach.
quests.line: The Face He Did Not Forget

quests.name: The False Navigator
quests.info: A man at the harbour sells applicants directions to the exam site, and every one he sends goes the wrong way into the mountains.
quests.goal: Bring back the applicants he misled
steps: Find the false navigator.
Bring back the applicants he misled.

quests.name: The Family's Head in All But Name
quests.info: An underboss runs the family while the boss holds the title. The boss can no longer lead, and the other families are circling.
quests.goal: Keep the other families off
steps: Hold the family's business together.
Keep the other families off.
Tell Linssen the job is done.

quests.name: The Far Harbour
quests.info: The last stretch of coast ends at Kakin's great seaport, where the harbour master wants the charts for himself.
quests.goal: Keep them out of the harbour master's hands
steps: Bring the charts into port.
Keep them out of the harbour master's hands.

quests.name: The Felling Ground
quests.info: Beasts out of the deep wood have driven the woodcutters off the felling ground for the third time this season, and the trunks they had already dropped are going soft where they lie.
quests.goal: Hold it for a full day while the men haul the cut trunks to the stacks
steps: Clear the felling ground of beasts.
Hold it for a full day while the men haul the cut trunks to the stacks.

quests.name: The Fifteenth
quests.info: On the fifteenth of every month the town holds its great contest. This month a crew of players means to win by keeping every strong rival in bed, and the roe seller saw one of them lingering at a sweet stall with something in his hand.
quests.goal: Get the contest run with every entrant on their feet
steps: Find which stall the crew has tampered with.
Get the contest run with every entrant on their feet.

quests.name: The Fiftieth Floor
quests.info: A senior disciple wins with the school's forms, not with brute strength. The master sends the party up the arena's lower floors with one rule: no technique the school did not teach.
quests.goal: Win one bout there without breaking the rule
steps: Climb to the fiftieth floor by the school's forms.
Win one bout there without breaking the rule.
Tell Wing the job is done.

quests.name: The Firm's Man at the Gullwing
quests.info: A man in a city coat has stepped off the mail boat and is asking around Gullwing Tavern who on the island dives; somebody has already said Sindri Ahl's name. He is pleasant, stands his rounds, and keeps his right hand in his coat pocket the whole evening.
quests.goal: Put him back on the mail boat believing the case still lies in the hold
steps: Learn what the firm's man knows and what he was sent to bring home.
Put him back on the mail boat believing the case still lies in the hold.

quests.name: The First Contract
quests.info: A trained killer has completed a contract alone. The target is a man in the town at the foot of the mountain who does not know the family has been paid.
quests.goal: Finish the contract and leave no trace
steps: Study the target unseen.
Finish the contract and leave no trace.
Tell Silva Zoldyck the job is done.

quests.name: The First Train Out
quests.info: The poisoner holds a ticket for the first train of the morning, and at that hour the concourse is packed with commuters, applicants and a man who has killed more people with a cup of tea than most soldiers have with rifles.
quests.goal: Put him in cuffs without a single bystander poisoned
steps: Pick the poisoner out of the crowd.
Put him in cuffs without a single bystander poisoned.

quests.name: The Fixed Bout
quests.info: A fighter on the fiftieth floors lost a match he should have won in a single blow, and the betting windows paid out a fortune on it.
quests.goal: Get the fixer barred from the tower
steps: Find who paid the fighter to lose.
Get the fixer barred from the tower.

quests.name: The Forest Survey
quests.info: Tyson has heard that a team surveying Kakin's forests has not been paid, and she wants to bring them their money herself.
quests.goal: Pay the team with Tyson's money
steps: Find the survey camp.
Pay the team with Tyson's money.

quests.name: The Fork in the Road
quests.info: Masked villagers have started setting their own quiz on the road and robbing whoever answers wrong.
quests.goal: End their quiz without hurting anyone
steps: Find the masked villagers.
End their quiz without hurting anyone.

quests.name: The Founder's Choice
quests.info: The founder decides what the alliance is for. Someone inside it has been killing players for their cards, and the alliance cannot go on unless the founder chooses what to do.
quests.goal: Decide the alliance's fate
steps: Find who inside the alliance is killing.
Decide the alliance's fate.
Tell Nickes the job is done.

quests.name: The Four Vows
quests.info: A disciple learns that the heart comes before the technique. The master will teach the true art only to someone who holds the vows of the flame without being told to.
quests.goal: Show the master Ten without being asked
steps: Hold the four vows through a week of training.
Show the master Ten without being asked.
Tell Wing the job is done.

quests.name: The Foxbear's Cubs
quests.info: A foxbear has had cubs in the hollow under the roots, and two men from the mainland have come with rifles to shoot her for her pelt.
quests.goal: Send them off the island without the pelt
steps: Find the men before they find the den.
Send them off the island without the pelt.

quests.name: The Friend Who Died
quests.info: Leorio tells the party about a friend who died of a sickness that could be cured, because nobody would treat him without money. He wants to see what a big hospital asks of a patient who cannot pay.
quests.goal: Learn what the hospital charges the poor
steps: Hear Leorio's story.
Learn what the hospital charges the poor.

quests.name: The Girl at the Barn Table
quests.info: A farm girl in the rice country has beaten every player in her county, and the county judges will not send her game sheets on to the capital because her family has nothing.
quests.goal: Carry her game sheets to the judge
steps: Watch her play at the collective barns.
Carry her game sheets to the judge.

quests.name: The Ground Floor
quests.info: Every fighter starts on the ground floor with a match that decides where they go next, and the line to register goes round the plaza.
quests.goal: Win the first match
steps: Register at the desk.
Win the first match.

quests.name: The Guaranteed Map
quests.info: Every winter a few young applicants come off the mail boat sure the ship from here is the best road to the Hunter Exam. This year half of them are waving the same printed map, which promises the exam's site and swears to it. Ilse Mardle has franked a stack of identical envelopes going the other way, every one to the same mainland box.
quests.goal: Get hold of one map and test what it claims
steps: Learn from Ilse Mardle who brings the envelopes to her counter.
Get hold of one map and test what it claims.

quests.name: The Guest in the Gallery
quests.info: A broad stranger in borrowed homespun has taken the best room in the guest gallery. He shows every carter a charcoal drawing of a man's face and says the licence that makes him a Hunter is sitting in a locker at the border.
quests.goal: Learn what the country's law lets him do here
steps: Hear what the stranger wants.
Learn what the country's law lets him do here.

quests.name: The Halfway Tank
quests.info: The seller's car boiled over in the Bilgai Desert, and the family at the rest house took him in, as they take in everyone the road breaks.
quests.goal: Learn which way the seller drove once the car was mended
steps: Speak with the host before anyone lays a hand on his guest.
Learn which way the seller drove once the car was mended.

quests.name: The Harbour Pilot
quests.info: Morel needs a pilot who knows the coast, and the best one at Dolle Harbor will not sail for a Hunter.
quests.goal: Win him over
steps: Learn why the pilot hates Hunters.
Win him over.

quests.name: The Haul Road at Night
quests.info: The old drift under the quarry meets the silver shafts, and every night lorries come down the haul road with their lights off and leave before dawn, lighter.
quests.goal: See what is stacked in the drift
steps: Follow a lorry down into the pit.
See what is stacked in the drift.

quests.name: The Have-Not Quarter
quests.info: Tyson wants to visit the quarter where the caste with no rights lives, and her guards say it is too dangerous.
quests.goal: Bring her through the quarter and back
steps: Prepare the visit.
Bring her through the quarter and back.

quests.name: The Head of the Family
quests.info: The family's head sits on the first tier with the princes. A meeting of the three heads has been called, and whoever leaves weaker may not leave at all.
quests.goal: Leave it stronger
steps: Prepare for the meeting.
Leave it stronger.
Tell Brocco Li the job is done.

quests.name: The Head's Orders
quests.info: A senior spider follows the head's orders even when the head is not there. The head has left a plan for a raid and gone, and the members argue over what he meant.
quests.goal: Carry out the raid as written
steps: Read the plan as the head meant it.
Carry out the raid as written.
Tell Machi Komacine the job is done.

quests.name: The Head's Word
quests.info: The head of the family gives the final word on a contract the family has never taken: a client who wants a child of the house dead. The family is waiting.
quests.goal: Give the head's word and stand by it
steps: Hear the client and the family out.
Give the head's word and stand by it.
Tell Silva Zoldyck the job is done.

quests.name: The Heartbeat in the Hall
quests.info: Melody hears a heartbeat in the hotel bar that is far too calm for what its owner is saying, and she wants to know why.
quests.goal: Learn what he is hiding
steps: Find the calm heart.
Learn what he is hiding.

quests.name: The Heavy Crate
quests.info: A crate with no manifest and the weight of a man is waiting on the dock, addressed to a private room on the 200th floor.
quests.goal: Learn who signs for it upstairs
steps: Learn what is in the crate.
Learn who signs for it upstairs.

quests.name: The Highway Gate
quests.info: Travellers are being turned back at the capital's highway gate without reason, and the general wants to know who gave the order.
quests.goal: Find who gave the order
steps: Watch the gate.
Find who gave the order.

quests.name: The Hiring Test
quests.info: A bodyguard is hired by a test, not a letter. The family has lost a piece of its collection to thieves, and the applicant who brings it back gets the job.
quests.goal: Bring the piece back to the mansion
steps: Find the thieves.
Bring the piece back to the mansion.
Tell Linssen the job is done.

quests.name: The Hotel Room in Mandai
quests.info: A foreign journalist is staying in a hotel room in Mandai City, and the secret police have orders to make her disappear.
quests.goal: Get her out of the country
steps: Reach the journalist first.
Get her out of the country.

quests.name: The House Always Wins
quests.info: The casino at Dorias pays out a card for a lucky streak, and a player who has lost every card he had is about to bet his life.
quests.goal: Win the casino's card a better way
steps: Stop the desperate player.
Win the casino's card a better way.

quests.name: The Hunter Gone Wrong
quests.info: The wanted man turns out to hold a Hunter's licence of his own, and the Association's rules say a Hunter may not hunt another unless the crimes are heinous.
quests.goal: Corner him in the market
steps: Prove the crimes.
Corner him in the market.

quests.name: The Hut in the Valley
quests.info: An old resident lives alone in a hut in the valley and has not come to the market for a month.
quests.goal: Bring the old one what they need
steps: Go to the hut.
Bring the old one what they need.

quests.name: The Initiate's Guard
quests.info: An assistant master protects those not yet ready. A newcomer with no aura has signed for the 200th floor, and the fighters there greet such people with a blow that cripples them.
quests.goal: Keep the newcomer whole
steps: Find the newcomer before the first match.
Keep the newcomer whole.
Tell Wing the job is done.

quests.name: The Investigator's Case
quests.info: An investigator brings a case the prosecutors can use. A passenger died in the central dining hall, and everyone saw it differently.
quests.goal: Build a case the bureau can use
steps: Gather the witnesses' accounts.
Build a case the bureau can use.
Tell Botobai Gigante the job is done.

quests.name: The Island Shoals
quests.info: The waters off Whale Island hide shoals that have sunk ships, and the charts are fifty years old.
quests.goal: Draw them on the chart
steps: Sound the shoals.
Draw them on the chart.

quests.name: The Junior's Star
quests.info: Two stars ask for an official post and a junior who has earned a star under the Hunter's guidance. The Association offers a post; the junior has to be found and taught.
quests.goal: Stand beside the junior when the board weighs their star
steps: Take on a junior and see them through their first real hunt.
Stand beside the junior when the board weighs their star.
Tell Mamen Beans the job is done.

quests.name: The Last Favour
quests.info: The supplier has come in person for his cases and his lorry, and he does not care to hear that the bank is paid and the works has no more use for his glass.
quests.goal: See the supplier off the works without a fire
steps: Stand in the furnace hall beside the owner when the supplier walks in.
See the supplier off the works without a fire.

quests.name: The Last Lesson
quests.info: The boy has reached the hollow trees, and the guards will not write a minor out of the country without a parent's mark in their book. Ottilie Brandt has ridden after him with a letter she has rewritten six times.
quests.goal: Carry his answer back to the school
steps: Let the boy choose with everything in front of him.
Carry his answer back to the school.

quests.name: The Last Lift of the Season
quests.info: Before the frost the quarry holds one last lift, and the prisoner has staked everything he has on a challenger from outside carrying the stone further than any quarryman ever has. Half the district is walking up the sledge track to watch.
quests.goal: See the book paid out fairly
steps: Carry the stone, or find the one who can.
See the book paid out fairly.
quests.line: The Lift at the Quarry Face

quests.name: The Last Phase
quests.info: The chief examiner decides the final phase and lives with every result. The party must interview the finalists, pair them in a tournament where losing is how one passes, and stop a fight before it kills someone.
quests.goal: Referee the tournament to its end
steps: Interview the finalists and pair them.
Referee the tournament to its end.
Tell Satotz the job is done.

quests.name: The Leader's Word
quests.info: The expedition's leader speaks from a cell under guard. He wants a message carried out, and the guards hear everything.
quests.goal: Carry it out past the guards
steps: Take the leader's message.
Carry it out past the guards.
Tell Muherr the job is done.

quests.name: The Ledge in the Drip Gallery
quests.info: The caving club saw a pale growth on a ledge of the drip gallery last winter, and their leader drew it on her survey beside a passage she named after a sponge cake.
quests.goal: Bring up a cutting without breaking the ledge
steps: Follow the club's survey down to the ledge.
Bring up a cutting without breaking the ledge.

quests.name: The Letter Up the Mountain
quests.info: The real errand: a sealed envelope that must reach the booth beside the Testing Gate and be read down the telephone to the mountain, word for word, by someone who is not a known face in the Mafia Community.
quests.goal: Read the request down the booth's telephone
steps: Carry the envelope up the road without breaking the seal.
Read the request down the booth's telephone.

quests.name: The Licence in Hand
quests.info: A new Hunter's licence opens almost every door in the world, and one new Hunter in five loses it within a year. Satotz takes the party to headquarters to hear how not to be that one.
quests.goal: Keep the licence safe through the first test of it
steps: Hear the new Hunters' briefing.
Keep the licence safe through the first test of it.

quests.name: The Lieutenant's Hunt
quests.info: A lieutenant hunts whoever crosses the family. Someone on the third tier has been killing the family's men one at a time.
quests.goal: End it
steps: Find the killer.
End it.
Tell Morena Prudo the job is done.

quests.name: The Lift at the Quarry Face
quests.info: Every rest day Brannick's men try to carry a cut millstone twenty paces, and the wagers have grown so heavy that men are staking their winter peat and their boots.
quests.goal: Learn who keeps the book
steps: Take a turn at the stone.
Learn who keeps the book.
quests.line: The Lift at the Quarry Face

quests.name: The Lift Girl's Envelope
quests.info: The men on the bench always seem to know which winner rode up unhurt and carrying the most, and only the lift attendants could tell them that.
quests.goal: Get her to stop, or to name who pays her
steps: Find which attendant is passing on the names.
Get her to stop, or to name who pays her.

quests.name: The Line in the Gravel
quests.info: A house butler holds a post without being told twice. A boy has been standing at the line for three days asking to see a son of the house, and he will not leave.
quests.goal: Decide what the house is told about him
steps: Keep him from crossing.
Decide what the house is told about him.
Tell Canary the job is done.

quests.name: The Log Toss
quests.info: Two teams want the same card from the yard's errand and have agreed to settle it by tossing logs on the town green. One side has a man who can make a log weigh whatever he pleases; the other side has no idea.
quests.goal: See the toss thrown fair, whoever wins it
steps: Learn how the one team means to cheat.
See the toss thrown fair, whoever wins it.

quests.name: The Lonely Guard
quests.info: One of the guards at the hotel has not smiled in a week, and Tyson has decided to find out why.
quests.goal: Set it right
steps: Learn what troubles the guard.
Set it right.

quests.name: The Long Count
quests.info: A survey hunter can keep a count true for a season. The crew needs a census of a herd that migrates through the survey area once a year.
quests.goal: Bring back a count the crew can trust
steps: Follow the herd through the forest.
Bring back a count the crew can trust.
Tell Spinner Clow the job is done.

quests.name: The Long Ward
quests.info: When the party comes asking about the bundle, Marta Quell shuts the ward door and admits she knows where it was going: to a carter's girl on her long ward, burning with a fever that a fortnight of willow bark and steam has not touched.
quests.goal: Decide whether the bottles reach the girl or the law
steps: Hear the girl's family out.
Decide whether the bottles reach the girl or the law.

quests.name: The Lorry in the Back Park
quests.info: A lorry has stood in the truck stop's back park for two days with its doors sealed and its driver gone, and the woman who runs the diner has been keeping his coffee warm.
quests.goal: Find the missing driver
steps: Open the lorry without breaking the seals.
Find the missing driver.
quests.line: The Sword in the Back Room

quests.name: The Lower Decks
quests.info: On a great ship the poorest passengers have one clinic between thousands, and Leorio has asked to work in it.
quests.goal: Keep it open through a week of trouble
steps: Open the clinic to everyone on the tier.
Keep it open through a week of trouble.

quests.name: The Magistrate's Gavel
quests.info: The supreme magistrate rules on what is lawful aboard. A prince has asked the court to approve something that would put the whole ship under one man's command.
quests.goal: Rule on it
steps: Hear the prince's claim.
Rule on it.
Tell Botobai Gigante the job is done.

quests.name: The Man by the Ropes
quests.info: The quiet man in the camel coat who watches the boxer spar has made his offer at last: a suit, a pistol and a month on a Don's door, at a wage that would buy the airship ticket twice over.
quests.goal: Stand beside the boxer while he gives his answer
steps: Learn what the family really wants him for.
Stand beside the boxer while he gives his answer.

quests.name: The Man Who Wanted a Contract
quests.info: A man in a cheap suit has been asking every taxi driver in Parasta how to hire the family on the mountain, and the drivers are frightened of him and of who might answer.
quests.goal: Learn who he wants dead
steps: Find the man.
Learn who he wants dead.

quests.name: The Map From the Market
quests.info: Kanzai bought a treasure map in a market stall and is certain it is real. He would like the party to check it before he tells anyone.
quests.goal: Learn whether the map is real
steps: Find the stall that sold the map.
Learn whether the map is real.

quests.name: The Maze of Spires
quests.info: A family's courier drove into the rock field to lose a tail and never drove out.
quests.goal: Bring back the courier or the cargo
steps: Find the courier in the spires.
Bring back the courier or the cargo.

quests.name: The Member's Mark
quests.info: A member of the family is marked by a job done in front of the others. A gambler owes the family and has hired guards of his own.
quests.goal: Collect the debt
steps: Get past the guards.
Collect the debt.
Tell Morena Prudo the job is done.

quests.name: The Men Behind the Desk
quests.info: The two men in suits who read every permit Tsui Wenjie stamps have written a report: the forged papers were his assistant's doing. The assistant is nineteen and has worked the desk for a month.
quests.goal: Keep the assistant at his desk
steps: Put what the party has learned in front of the ministry's inspector.
Keep the assistant at his desk.
quests.line: The Face He Did Not Forget

quests.name: The Mill Wheel
quests.info: The mill's wooden wheel has cracked, and the village has no machine and no smith who can mend it before the harvest.
quests.goal: Mend the wheel by hand
steps: Find the right wood in the forest.
Mend the wheel by hand.

quests.name: The Minister's Rally
quests.info: A minister stages the leader's rallies. Every citizen is to fill the assembly grounds for a speech, and the rally must look like joy.
quests.goal: Keep the rally looking like joy
steps: Fill the grounds.
Keep the rally looking like joy.
Tell Bizeff the job is done.

quests.name: The Missing Catalogue
quests.info: A copy of the auction house's catalogue has gone from its desk two days before the sale, with every lot's reserve price marked inside.
quests.goal: Get it back before the sale
steps: Find who took the catalogue.
Get it back before the sale.

quests.name: The Missing Herders
quests.info: A movement elder counts the people of the region. Herders have stopped coming down from the hills, and nobody will say what they saw there.
quests.goal: Bring the elders the truth
steps: Climb the trail and find the herders.
Bring the elders the truth.
Tell Haruna the job is done.

quests.name: The Missing Knife
quests.info: The old turnkey has counted the rack in the round stone room twice, and one knife is gone. The warden's search of the cells starts at dusk, and if an inmate is found with it, the whole tier loses visits for a year.
quests.goal: Get it back on the rack before the search
steps: Learn where the missing knife went.
Get it back on the rack before the search.

quests.name: The Mountain Pass
quests.info: The second map leads up into the Roto Mountains, where other hunters have heard of the treasure and want it.
quests.goal: Take the treasure out of the mountains
steps: Reach the pass first.
Take the treasure out of the mountains.

quests.name: The Movement's Voice
quests.info: The movement's leader speaks for every village in the region. Strangers have offered money for land deep in the forest, and the villages are split over whether to sell.
quests.goal: Speak for the region and settle the offer
steps: Learn who the buyers are.
Speak for the region and settle the offer.
Tell Haruna the job is done.

quests.name: The Musician of Aguilor
quests.info: A violinist in Aguilor played something no one recognised at a concert last year and has not spoken since.
quests.goal: Learn what he played
steps: Find the violinist.
Learn what he played.

quests.name: The Name on the Roster
quests.info: Somebody in the barracks tells the families when the patrol jeeps pass each gate, and the captain has narrowed it to the men on the night roster.
quests.goal: Bring the proof to the captain, not to downtown
steps: Learn which officer is selling the patrol times.
Bring the proof to the captain, not to downtown.

quests.name: The Navigator's Test
quests.info: A Navigator leads only the worthy to the exam. A family of shape-shifting beasts keeps that post at the lone pine, and the party must learn to test applicants the way they do.
quests.goal: Judge a band of applicants and lead only the right ones on
steps: Learn the Navigators' tricks at the cabin.
Judge a band of applicants and lead only the right ones on.
Tell Satotz the job is done.

quests.name: The Navigators
quests.info: The way to the exam site goes through the navigators, beasts who take human shape and test whoever asks them the way.
quests.goal: Pass the navigators' test
steps: Find the cabin by the lone pine.
Pass the navigators' test.

quests.name: The New Master
quests.info: Since the old master of the swamp was caught, a bigger fish has taken its place, and it has been dragging the fishermen's nets under and their rods after them.
quests.goal: Land the fish with a rod and line
steps: Learn the fish's habits from the fishing tree.
Land the fish with a rod and line.

quests.name: The Night Boat
quests.info: The crates were meant to go aboard a launch that leaves a slip at the shipyard after the welders have gone home, and the welders say it is not the first winter they have heard her engine.
quests.goal: Stop the launch before it clears the harbour
steps: Watch the slip through the night.
Stop the launch before it clears the harbour.
quests.line: The Sword in the Back Room

quests.name: The Night Coach to the Harbour
quests.info: Clara Whitcombe has her bag packed and a seat on the coach toward the harbours where applicants gather, and a smiling veteran of the exam has been sitting beside her in the waiting hall telling her she will be dead within a week.
quests.goal: Send the veteran on his way
steps: Get the student and her bag onto the coach.
Send the veteran on his way.

quests.name: The Night Delivery
quests.info: The next load goes up the goods lift tonight, and if it is caught on the way the parlour will lose its route and the foreman his excuse.
quests.goal: Put the route out of use without naming the foreman
steps: Catch the load between the dock and the 200th floor.
Put the route out of use without naming the foreman.

quests.name: The Night Shift Stays Up
quests.info: The night shift has refused to go underground since three of them came up from the deep gallery white as chalk, and the manager wants them back down or sacked by the end of the week.
quests.goal: Go down to the deep gallery and see for yourselves
steps: Hear the night shift out in the miners' bar.
Go down to the deep gallery and see for yourselves.

quests.name: The Nurse Is Not Paid
quests.info: The runner who carries Pail from the corner to the clinic never arrived, and the nurse has shut her door to everyone who cannot pay in hand.
quests.goal: Put the notes in the nurse's hand
steps: Follow the runner's road from the alley to the clinic.
Put the notes in the nurse's hand.
quests.next: The Boy at the End of the Alley

quests.name: The Old Roster
quests.info: A sworn paladin knows what the squad was. The only roster anyone has seen is locked in a records room that nobody has opened in decades.
quests.goal: Bring out what the roster says
steps: Get into the sealed records room.
Bring out what the roster says.
Tell Loupe Highland the job is done.

quests.name: The Open Number
quests.info: A leg of the spider carries a number, and numbers are not handed out. One has come free, and the members will watch the party try to show it deserves the tattoo.
quests.goal: Take the number and wear it
steps: Prove yourself in front of the members.
Take the number and wear it.
Tell Machi Komacine the job is done.

quests.name: The Padlocked Shack
quests.info: The boy's family's shack has a new brass padlock that no one in the camp could afford, and the neighbours say a car came for them at night with its lights off.
quests.goal: Find out what the family was offered, or told
steps: Learn who put the padlock on the door.
Find out what the family was offered, or told.

quests.name: The Pig in the Forest
quests.info: The forest's great stamp is the strongest pig in the world, with a skull that stops anything thrown at its face. Menchi wants one roasted.
quests.goal: Roast it well enough to please her
steps: Bring down a great stamp.
Roast it well enough to please her.

quests.name: The Poacher's Cage
quests.info: Poachers have been taking animals from the exam's island in the quiet months, and a cage full of them sits in the woods waiting for a boat.
quests.goal: Free the animals and catch the poachers
steps: Find the cage.
Free the animals and catch the poachers.

quests.name: The Poachers' Trail
quests.info: A senior amateur protects what the crew studies. Somebody is trapping the animals the survey has catalogued and selling them in the city.
quests.goal: Stop the trapping and free what can be freed
steps: Follow the trapped animals to the market.
Stop the trapping and free what can be freed.
Tell Spinner Clow the job is done.

quests.name: The Poison Diet
quests.info: A family assassin's body refuses most poisons. The training is a diet of them, one dose stronger every day, in the rooms under the mansion.
quests.goal: Walk out of the last dose on your own feet
steps: Take the doses for a month.
Walk out of the last dose on your own feet.
Tell Silva Zoldyck the job is done.

quests.name: The Prince's Aide
quests.info: A prince's aide speaks for the prince when the prince will not. A ceremony has been planned that will seat the prince below a younger brother.
quests.goal: Win the prince the right seat
steps: Learn who arranged the seating.
Win the prince the right seat.
Tell Nugui the job is done.

quests.name: The Prince's Favour
quests.info: The family's head is trusted by the prince who keeps it. The prince wants something from another prince's room, and he wants it by morning.
quests.goal: Bring it to him by morning
steps: Learn what the prince wants taken.
Bring it to him by morning.
Tell Morena Prudo the job is done.

quests.name: The Prisoner's Promise
quests.info: A convict who fought applicants in the tower says he was promised years off his sentence for it and never got them.
quests.goal: Learn whether the promise was kept
steps: Hear the prisoner's story.
Learn whether the promise was kept.

quests.name: The Prosecutor's Brief
quests.info: A prosecutor argues the case before the court. The accused is a prince's guard, and the prince wants the case dropped.
quests.goal: Argue it to a verdict
steps: Prepare the brief.
Argue it to a verdict.
Tell Botobai Gigante the job is done.

quests.name: The Queen's Retainer
quests.info: A queen's retainer keeps her household safe from the other households. Something in the queen's rooms has been moved in the night, and nobody admits to it.
quests.goal: Keep it from happening again
steps: Find who entered the rooms.
Keep it from happening again.
Tell Nugui the job is done.

quests.name: The Quiet Patient
quests.info: A fighter came down from the 200th floor on a stretcher with no mark on him and cannot move his arms, and the doctors have no name for what happened.
quests.goal: Find who did it to him
steps: Hear what the fighter remembers.
Find who did it to him.

quests.name: The Raider Who Stayed
quests.info: One man from the raid lived, and he now works for the family he came to rob. He has narrowed it to the two gatekeepers at the cabin and wants a word with the right one, out of earshot of the hound and the telephone.
quests.goal: Get him to speak of the raid without the butlers listening
steps: Work out which of the gatekeepers marched with the raid.
Get him to speak of the raid without the butlers listening.

quests.name: The Reel From the Tower
quests.info: A reel is gone from the box under his shelf: a night of bouts taped off foreign television at Heavens Arena, the one his friends have been betting on for a month.
quests.goal: Get the reel back before it reaches an office
steps: Learn who climbed the ladder and took it.
Get the reel back before it reaches an office.

quests.name: The Regional Office
quests.info: A regional officer keeps a city in line. Mandai has missed its quota, and the ministry will send someone harder if the party cannot fix it.
quests.goal: Bring the city to its quota
steps: Learn why the city missed the quota.
Bring the city to its quota.
Tell Bizeff the job is done.

quests.name: The Return
quests.info: The card is back, and the Association must decide whether a Hunter careless enough to lose it should have it back.
quests.goal: Speak for or against the careless Hunter
steps: Bring the card to headquarters.
Speak for or against the careless Hunter.

quests.name: The Ribs on the Sandbar
quests.info: At the lowest tide of the month the ribs of a small motor boat show on the sandbar off the beach, and Nell Corrie wants to know what else it carried before the longhouse hears there is an engine on its coast.
quests.goal: Bring back what the hold still holds
steps: Reach the wreck while the tide is out.
Bring back what the hold still holds.

quests.name: The Rider at the Inn
quests.info: Bram Tolliver says the rider in question sups at the crossroads every week, and lately settles his bill with a sewing needle so fine and bright no smith in the country could have drawn it.
quests.goal: See what he does in the carters' yard before he rides on
steps: Watch the rider through his supper.
See what he does in the carters' yard before he rides on.

quests.name: The Right Hand
quests.info: A Don's right hand carries out what the Don will not do in person. A family has sold seats at the auction to outsiders, and the Don wants them taught.
quests.goal: Teach the selling family its place
steps: Find the outsiders with bought seats.
Teach the selling family its place.
Tell Zenji the job is done.

quests.name: The Ring of Crushed Cars
quests.info: The number rings in the scrapyard's scale house, where on certain nights the cubes of crushed cars are stacked into a ring and men fight inside it with bare hands while the families bet.
quests.goal: Find out who holds the driver's debt
steps: Earn a place on the night's card.
Find out who holds the driver's debt.

quests.name: The Risk Report
quests.info: A risk analyst writes the report the ministers read. The party must judge how dangerous a region really is and put a number on it that nobody can argue with.
quests.goal: Write the report
steps: Gather what is known of the region.
Write the report.
Tell Saccho Kobayakawa the job is done.

quests.name: The Roadhouse Stranger
quests.info: A stranger at the roadhouse has been asking which way the families' cars go out of the city.
quests.goal: Send him back to them with a message
steps: Learn who the stranger works for.
Send him back to them with a message.

quests.name: The Robbery
quests.info: A new Hunter was robbed of his licence in Zaban City the week after the exam, and the Association cannot reissue it.
quests.goal: Find the thief's trail
steps: Hear the new Hunter.
Find the thief's trail.

quests.name: The Rope on the Bell
quests.info: A rope has been tied to the great bell again, and if it is rung the whole district will climb the stair to see why.
quests.goal: Learn who keeps tying the rope
steps: Keep watch in the bell court through the night.
Learn who keeps tying the rope.
quests.next: The Digger With a Survey Map

quests.name: The Runner's Proof
quests.info: A soldier of the family has been tested by a run under fire. A package must cross the fourth tier while the Heil-Ly watch every stair.
quests.goal: Lose the watchers
steps: Carry the package.
Lose the watchers.
Tell Onior Longbao the job is done.

quests.name: The Salt Pan Meeting
quests.info: Two families have agreed to meet on the salt pan where nobody can hide, and both have brought more men than they said they would.
quests.goal: Keep the meeting from turning into a fight
steps: Get both sides to the table.
Keep the meeting from turning into a fight.

quests.name: The Scholar's Request
quests.info: A university has asked once more to dig the valley mounds. Halvard Meen means to say no, as he always has, but he wants the trust to vote knowing whether it could protect what a dig would find.
quests.goal: Bring the trust a report it can vote on
steps: Walk the mounds with the survey map.
Bring the trust a report it can vote on.

quests.name: The Seal Numbers
quests.info: Pia Lorentz, the youngest officer in the hall, has brought the captain a notebook of seal numbers that went out of the bonded cage without ever crossing an inspection table, and she asked the question out loud in the canteen.
quests.goal: Keep the young officer in her post
steps: Trace three of the seals to where the crates went.
Keep the young officer in her post.

quests.name: The Seal Press
quests.info: The copied railway seals are struck on a press, and the brass they are cut from has been going out of the motor works' scrap bins by the sackful.
quests.goal: Bring a struck seal and its dies to the detective before the yard hears
steps: Search the works for the press once the night shift goes home.
Bring a struck seal and its dies to the detective before the yard hears.

quests.name: The Sealed Border
quests.info: The likeliest country is sealed to outsiders, and only a Hunter's licence might open its border post.
quests.goal: Get inside without starting an incident
steps: Talk the guards into honouring the licence.
Get inside without starting an incident.

quests.name: The Seaport Strike
quests.info: The dockers at the seaport have stopped work, and Tyson believes they only need to be loved properly.
quests.goal: End the strike fairly
steps: Learn what the dockers want.
End the strike fairly.

quests.name: The Second Ringed Date
quests.info: The second date on the tide table is tomorrow night, when the launch comes back for its cases. The men aboard carry guns and answer to a family of the Mafia Community; Hobb Marley has a helmet, a bicycle and one cell with a cot in it. He wants the stolen lots kept and the island forgotten by the family that sent them, and he knows he cannot manage both on his own.
quests.goal: Turn the launch away empty and see nobody killed doing it
steps: Set a watch on the caves that the launch's crew will not spot.
Turn the launch away empty and see nobody killed doing it.

quests.name: The Second Track
quests.info: The family's head is the one the prince trusts with the dirty work. Another family has gone after the head's people, and the head must answer without starting a war the prince did not order.
quests.goal: Answer without a war
steps: Find who struck the family.
Answer without a war.
Tell Onior Longbao the job is done.

quests.name: The Secretary's Shadow
quests.info: The secretary of state stands closest to the leader. A general is plotting to take that place, and the secretary wants him gone before he can.
quests.goal: Remove him without a scandal
steps: Uncover the general's plot.
Remove him without a scandal.
Tell Bizeff the job is done.

quests.name: The Selection
quests.info: A contract player is hired only after the selection. Hundreds of applicants stand in the castle hall, and the examiner wants to see what each can do with their aura, one at a time.
quests.goal: Show the examiner enough to be hired
steps: Wait your turn in the hall.
Show the examiner enough to be hired.
Tell Battera the job is done.

quests.name: The Shoulder, Not the Fist
quests.info: The man by the door was Dov Kalinsky, who once fought his way up the high floors of Heavens Arena and now crews a mainland trawler. Over one drink, and no second, he told Rudd Gallow that the champion is hitting with something besides his hands and that Teo Bramwell will be badly hurt. He will not go near the shed again.
quests.goal: Persuade him to give Teo Bramwell three mornings of training under the beacon
steps: Draw out of Dov Kalinsky what he saw and what ended his own fighting days.
Persuade him to give Teo Bramwell three mornings of training under the beacon.

quests.name: The Sick Village
quests.place: Village of the Bandits from the Mountains
quests.info: The village in the mountains is sick, and the men who rule it ask every passing player for their cards to pay for a cure.
quests.goal: Help them without being robbed
steps: Learn what the villagers truly need.
Help them without being robbed.

quests.name: The Signal Near the Wall
quests.info: A hiker's radio went silent in the woods along the boundary wall at dusk. The crew are allowed as far as the wall's foot and no further, and the last fix puts the signal very close to it.
quests.goal: Find the hiker or what is left of his kit
steps: Search the woods along the wall before the light goes.
Find the hiker or what is left of his kit.

quests.name: The Silent Set
quests.info: The barometer is falling fast with the applicants' ship two days out, and the radio on Corwin Strand's desk has heard nothing from her since morning. He cannot leave the set, the storm bell by the door needs ringing for the fleet, and within the hour the island will be at his window asking questions he cannot answer.
quests.goal: Keep the radio watch beside the harbourmaster until the ship answers
steps: Ring the storm bell and bring the fishing boats in ahead of the weather.
Keep the radio watch beside the harbourmaster until the ship answers.

quests.name: The Sinking Ground
quests.info: A part of the heaps is sinking, and three huts have gone down with it.
quests.goal: Find them somewhere to go
steps: Get the families out of the sinking ground.
Find them somewhere to go.

quests.name: The Sister in the Tenements
quests.info: The woman with the flowers lives on the fourth landing, works nights in the tower kitchens, and has told her family abroad that her brother is still fighting.
quests.goal: Learn the dead fighter's real name
steps: Speak with her without frightening her off.
Learn the dead fighter's real name.

quests.name: The Small Order
quests.info: The butlers' school has ordered a vest for a child of eleven, plated heavier than anything the smith would put on a grown man. He has made it, because he does not refuse that customer, but he wants it handed over by someone who will ask who it is for.
quests.goal: Learn which pupil will wear it
steps: Take the vest up to the booth by the gate.
Learn which pupil will wear it.
quests.line: The Boy at the First Door

quests.name: The Smashed Window
quests.info: The pawnshop's window was put in overnight. The owner swears nothing was taken and will not let the constable near the safe, which is how the constable knows something was.
quests.goal: Find the thief before the goods are sold on
steps: Learn what was taken from the safe.
Find the thief before the goods are sold on.
quests.next: A Man Who Knew My Name

quests.name: The Son at the Exchange
quests.info: The owner's son has taken the deeds to Ininge City to borrow against the works from a grain broker, meaning to pay off the bank and shut the supplier out, and his father knows nothing of it.
quests.goal: Bring father and son to the same table
steps: Find the son before he signs.
Bring father and son to the same table.

quests.name: The Specialist's Way
quests.info: A specialist killer has a method the clients ask for by name. A client wants a job done in a crowded hotel bar without a single witness knowing what they saw.
quests.goal: Do it unseen
steps: Plan the job around the crowd.
Do it unseen.
Tell Sengi Guild Agent the job is done.

quests.name: The Spider Lives
quests.info: The Troupe's oldest rule says the spider lives even if the head dies. The head has been taken, and the members look to whoever will put the spider before any one of its parts.
quests.goal: Keep the members together through it
steps: Decide what the spider must do now.
Keep the members together through it.
Tell Machi Komacine the job is done.

quests.name: The Square of Rubicuta
quests.info: The townspeople of Rubicuta will only trade with a player who solves the riddle painted in their square.
quests.goal: Solve it
steps: Read the riddle.
Solve it.

quests.name: The Stall by the Nets
quests.info: Two fishing families have quarrelled for a month over the best stall in the market, and now nobody will buy from either.
quests.goal: Settle the stall so the market trades again
steps: Hear both families out.
Settle the stall so the market trades again.

quests.name: The Stone Wall
quests.info: A mercenary of the old unit has never lost a man. The party must train with them for a week and come out of it without a scratch they did not expect.
quests.goal: Earn their nod
steps: Train a week with the mercenaries.
Earn their nod.
Tell Muherr the job is done.

quests.name: The Stowaway
quests.info: Somebody has been living in the exam airship's hold since the last exam, eating the examiners' food and hiding from the crew.
quests.goal: Decide what is to be done with them
steps: Find the stowaway.
Decide what is to be done with them.

quests.name: The Stranger at the Checkpoint
quests.info: A foreigner has been at the residents' checkpoint for three days asking for someone by a name nobody in the city uses any more.
quests.goal: Decide whether the city lets them in
steps: Learn what the foreigner wants.
Decide whether the city lets them in.

quests.name: The Strategist's Plan
quests.info: A strategist knows what the others will do before they do. The alliance needs a plan for the card the pirates hold that does not end in every member stealing it from the rest.
quests.goal: Get all fifteen to agree to it
steps: Draw up the plan.
Get all fifteen to agree to it.
Tell Goreinu the job is done.

quests.name: The Summit Table
quests.info: A head of state sits at the summit table with four others. The five must agree on one order, and each one wants the others to pay for it.
quests.goal: Bring the five to one order
steps: Learn what each nation wants.
Bring the five to one order.
Tell Mizaistom Nana the job is done.

quests.name: The Supplier's Order
quests.info: The man who sells the works its cheap glass has ordered a dozen display cases blown to his own drawing, every one with a false bottom, and wants them by the end of the month.
quests.goal: Learn what the cases are meant to carry, and for whom
steps: Meet the supplier's man in the packing yard.
Learn what the cases are meant to carry, and for whom.

quests.name: The Sword in the Back Room
quests.info: A pawnbroker in the city has taken in a sword whose owner was written off as drowned in the marshes, and the detective wants the seller's name before the blade leaves the city with everything else in that back room.
quests.goal: Find out where the back room's goods are sent
steps: Get the pawnbroker to say who brought in the sword.
Find out where the back room's goods are sent.
quests.line: The Sword in the Back Room
quests.next: The Lorry in the Back Park

quests.name: The Team
quests.info: A team captain keeps a team alive. The party must gather players into a team that can hold its cards against thieves and killers.
quests.goal: Keep the team's cards safe for a month
steps: Recruit a team.
Keep the team's cards safe for a month.
Tell Battera the job is done.

quests.name: The Temporary Licence
quests.info: A temp Hunter carries a licence the other Hunters mock. The team needs every one of its hires to pass muster before the ship sails.
quests.goal: Get them through the inspection
steps: Prepare the hires.
Get them through the inspection.
Tell Muherr the job is done.

quests.name: The Tier Boss
quests.info: A tier boss owns a tier's business. The fourth tier's trade is split between three families and the boss wants it whole.
quests.goal: Take the tier's business
steps: Win over the tier's traders.
Take the tier's business.
Tell Onior Longbao the job is done.

quests.name: The Tourists Who Stayed
quests.info: Two tourists slipped through the small side door while the bus waited, and they have not come out.
quests.goal: Bring back whatever can be brought back
steps: Learn what happened beyond the gate.
Bring back whatever can be brought back.

quests.name: The Trade Shops
quests.info: Cards can be turned into money and money into cards at the trade shops, and a player with a good eye can double what they have.
quests.goal: Make a trade that doubles the party's worth
steps: Learn the shop's prices.
Make a trade that doubles the party's worth.

quests.name: The Trail Hut
quests.info: The rest hut on the horse trail has been broken into, and the travellers' supplies are gone.
quests.goal: Bring back the supplies
steps: Follow the thieves' tracks.
Bring back the supplies.

quests.name: The Train to the Tower
quests.info: The boy has bought a train ticket to the coast and an airship berth on to Heavens Arena without a word to his trainer, and the train pulls out of the junction tonight.
quests.goal: Let him choose, and carry his choice back to the gym
steps: Catch him on the platform before the train.
Let him choose, and carry his choice back to the gym.

quests.name: The Translation
quests.info: With three scripts copied, Pyon wants the party to put them side by side and see what the old writers had in common.
quests.goal: Write the translation
steps: Lay the copies side by side.
Write the translation.

quests.name: The Treaty Watch
quests.info: A minister of state answers for the treaty that forbids voyages to the Dark Continent. A ship is about to sail that the treaty says may not.
quests.goal: Report what the nations must decide
steps: Learn who is aboard and why.
Report what the nations must decide.
Tell Mizaistom Nana the job is done.

quests.name: The Tree's Inscription
quests.info: Climbers say there are letters carved high on the trunk of the World Tree, above where the guides will take anyone.
quests.goal: Copy the inscription
steps: Climb past the guides' platform.
Copy the inscription.

quests.name: The Trophy Room
quests.info: A Mafia family keeps a room of trophies, and a servant swears one of them is a jar with two red eyes in it.
quests.goal: See whether the eyes are there
steps: Get into the trophy room.
See whether the eyes are there.

quests.name: The Two Hundredth
quests.info: The 200th floor is where the money stops and the fighting changes. A fighter who reaches it must register before the deadline or fall back to the first floor.
quests.goal: Register before the deadline
steps: Reach the 200th floor.
Register before the deadline.

quests.name: The Unanswered Letter
quests.info: The capital wants to know whether the warrants in his drawer are still current. With the guns, the camp and the list on his desk, he finally has something to tell them, and the whole town will hear about it.
quests.goal: See what goes in the letter and whether it is posted
steps: Lay the evidence in front of the sergeant.
See what goes in the letter and whether it is posted.
quests.line: Heavy Bags on the Morning Train

quests.name: The Underboss's Bargain
quests.info: An underboss makes the bargains the boss signs. The family wants a prince's protection, and the prince wants something in return.
quests.goal: Close the bargain
steps: Learn what the prince wants.
Close the bargain.
Tell Onior Longbao the job is done.

quests.name: The Underboss's Book
quests.info: An underboss keeps the family's money moving. The family's accounts at home have been frozen by someone who knows the voyage leaves soon.
quests.goal: Get the money moving again
steps: Find who froze the accounts.
Get the money moving again.
Tell Brocco Li the job is done.

quests.name: The Underboss's Errand
quests.info: The underboss's man carries business the boss must not be seen to do. A collector wants to trade with the family for something nobody should own.
quests.goal: Close or break the deal as the underboss wishes
steps: Meet the collector and learn the price.
Close or break the deal as the underboss wishes.
Tell Linssen the job is done.

quests.name: The Underboss's Peace
quests.info: An underboss keeps the families from killing each other. Two families have each lost a man and blame each other, and the auction is in a week.
quests.goal: Keep the peace until the auction
steps: Learn who really killed the two men.
Keep the peace until the auction.
Tell Light Nostrade the job is done.

quests.name: The Unknown Species
quests.info: A spotter earns the name by seeing first. The crew has heard a call in the forest that matches no animal in any book.
quests.goal: Record the animal without harming it
steps: Track the call to its source.
Record the animal without harming it.
Tell Spinner Clow the job is done.

quests.name: The Unlit Hull
quests.info: Petra blew the horn twice the night that barge came in, for a hull with no lights and no flag, and its crew stepped ashore. Her log has the hour and the tide.
quests.goal: Track the crew from the egg ledges
steps: Read Petra's log for the night of the dark barge.
Track the crew from the egg ledges.

quests.name: The Unopened Trailer
quests.info: The driver has been hiding at the tow yard behind the wreck rows, and the trailer of his rig, towed in with him, has never been opened since a cargo shed loaded it without paperwork.
quests.goal: Bring the driver out of hiding and see him safe
steps: Open the trailer at last.
Bring the driver out of hiding and see him safe.

quests.name: The Vacant Chair
quests.info: The vice chairman holds deputy power when the chair is empty. The council has called an emergency session, the chairman cannot be reached, and somebody has to run the Association until he can.
quests.goal: Hand the chair back with nothing broken
steps: Hold the session together.
Hand the chair back with nothing broken.
Tell Cheadle Yorkshire the job is done.

quests.name: The Wanted Poster
quests.info: A poster with a reward has the whole park hunting a man nobody has seen, and the crowd has started grabbing anyone who looks like him.
quests.goal: Keep the crowd from the wrong ones
steps: Find the man the poster is for.
Keep the crowd from the wrong ones.

quests.name: The Warehouse Test
quests.info: A soldier of the family proves himself in the stores. Something is stealing from the family's crates every night, and the guards see nothing.
quests.goal: Catch the thief
steps: Watch the stores through the night.
Catch the thief.
Tell Brocco Li the job is done.

quests.name: The Warrant
quests.info: The man has noticed he is watched and has booked a bout for tomorrow, after which he means to leave by air with his winnings.
quests.goal: Hand him over at the Skyfoot Police Station
steps: Take him when he steps outside the tower before the bout.
Hand him over at the Skyfoot Police Station.

quests.name: The Watcher Across the Road
quests.info: A masked child has sat on a heap across from the Hunter's car for two days without eating or blinking much, and she would like to know whose eyes those are before she goes anywhere near the elders.
quests.goal: Carry the Hunter's request for a hearing back the same way
steps: Coax the masked child into saying who sent him.
Carry the Hunter's request for a hearing back the same way.

quests.name: The Way of Nature
quests.info: A herder lives by the region's rule: nothing made by machine, nothing from a chemical. A family in the village has been hiding a radio, and the elders want the matter settled quietly.
quests.goal: Settle it without shaming them
steps: Learn why the family kept the radio.
Settle it without shaming them.
Tell Haruna the job is done.

quests.name: The Welcome Blow
quests.info: A contender has survived the 200th floor's welcome. Three fighters wait in the corridor to greet every newcomer the same way, with a blow nobody sees coming.
quests.goal: Survive the welcome on your feet
steps: Walk the 200th floor's corridor to the desk.
Survive the welcome on your feet.
Tell Heavens Arena 200th Floor Clerk the job is done.

quests.name: The Wheel Upstairs
quests.info: Three doors from her showroom, a loft over a jeweller runs its wheels all night, turning out glass and cheap stones dressed to pass at the September sales. Her own stone is somewhere on its benches.
quests.goal: Bring her stone out, and the fakes with it
steps: Get into the loft while the wheels are running.
Bring her stone out, and the fakes with it.
quests.line: The Book That Does Not Match

quests.name: The Whistle on the Mud
quests.info: A family of day trippers has walked far out past the stakes looking for the edge of the water, and the oyster farmer's whistle has split. The channel behind them is already filling.
quests.goal: Lead them back to the shore
steps: Reach the family before the channel fills.
Lead them back to the shore.

quests.name: The Wild Terraces
quests.info: The seed is a vine's, and the only vines in the Union old enough to throw it grow on the terraces the vintner's neighbours abandoned.
quests.goal: Find the parent vine before the rival does
steps: Climb the wild terraces with the vintner.
Find the parent vine before the rival does.

quests.name: The Withdrawn Warrant
quests.info: The patrol post will not pay for the forger: the desk sergeant says the warrant was withdrawn that morning by a telephone call from someone he will not name.
quests.goal: Get the bounty paid or the warrant restored
steps: Learn who had the warrant withdrawn.
Get the bounty paid or the warrant restored.

quests.name: The Wolf of Two Heads
quests.info: A two-headed wolf, one of a dying species kept alive by a breeding programme, has got loose and is killing sheep in the Miera Mountains, and the herders want it shot.
quests.goal: Bring it back to the programme alive
steps: Track the wolf.
Bring it back to the programme alive.

quests.name: The Word That Changed
quests.info: One word of her cry has been different since morning, and her slabs hold no Galgaida. She cannot say more than her cry allows, so she says it again, slower, looking straight at the party.
quests.goal: Be there when the next catch comes in
steps: Work out where the changed word points.
Be there when the next catch comes in.

quests.name: The Wreck in the Sand
quests.info: The wreck in the desert has been picked over again, and this time the looters found something the families had left there on purpose.
quests.goal: Get back what they took
steps: Find the looters.
Get back what they took.

quests.name: The Young Master's Shadow
quests.info: A personal attendant follows a child of the house without being seen. One of the children has gone into town alone, and the family wants to know everything without interfering.
quests.goal: Report everything and change nothing
steps: Follow the child through town unseen.
Report everything and change nothing.
Tell Canary the job is done.

quests.name: Thicker Than Blood
quests.info: An elder answers for the whole city. One of its people has been wronged in a foreign court, and the residents are ready to answer the old way unless someone finds a better one.
quests.goal: Win the city an answer that costs no residents
steps: Learn what the foreign court did.
Win the city an answer that costs no residents.
Tell Franklin Bordeau the job is done.

quests.name: Thirty Minutes
quests.info: Biscuit wants the party's aura held round the whole body, strong and steady, for half an hour while she throws stones at them.
quests.goal: Last the full thirty minutes
steps: Hold Ken through the stones.
Last the full thirty minutes.

quests.name: Three Letters From Congress
quests.info: A section chief sees the few applicants who get that far. One has three letters from his congress and will not take no.
quests.goal: Give him an answer he cannot appeal
steps: Hear the applicant.
Give him an answer he cannot appeal.
Tell Saccho Kobayakawa the job is done.

quests.name: Three Nights Gone
quests.info: Her grandson was picked for the shipyard crews four mornings ago and has not come back to sleep since. The foreman who chose him will not meet her eye, and his friends in the line say the foundry shifts have been running double.
quests.goal: Find where he sleeps now
steps: Learn which crew took him on.
Find where he sleeps now.

quests.name: Three Nights in a Neighbour's Shack
quests.info: Hollis has watched a small boy nobody can place sleep three nights in a neighbour's shack. He has not blown the whistle, which for him is a decision.
quests.goal: Bring him to the caretakers' door before the whistle goes
steps: Learn who the boy in the shack belongs to.
Bring him to the caretakers' door before the whistle goes.

quests.name: Three Rounds with the Kid
quests.info: The gym's best boy has nobody his weight to spar with, and he has begun dropping his right hand because nobody in the gym makes him pay for it.
quests.goal: Punish the dropped hand until he keeps it up
steps: Spar three rounds with the boy.
Punish the dropped hand until he keeps it up.

quests.name: Through the New Hole
quests.info: The winter swell has torn a fresh hole in the wreck's flank and opened the after hold, where a sealed steel case lies pinned under fallen crates. A salvage firm has hired a Hunter to dive the reef before spring. Sindri wants the case up first, and he cannot shift the crates and hold his breath at the same time.
quests.goal: Free the steel case from under the crates and bring it to the surface
steps: Go down with Sindri Ahl through the new hole, one breath at a time.
Free the steel case from under the crates and bring it to the surface.

quests.name: Torn Posters
quests.info: Somebody tears down every poster of a young fighter the night it goes up, and leaves notes under her door.
quests.goal: Stop whoever is doing it
steps: Watch the posters overnight.
Stop whoever is doing it.

quests.name: Tracks in the Beech Wood
quests.info: At dawn the volunteer found a shovel lying beside one of the protected mounds and fresh earth on its side. Whoever was digging knew exactly when the patrols pass.
quests.goal: Learn where he sells what he finds
steps: Find the night digger.
Learn where he sells what he finds.

quests.name: Tracks That Never Tire
quests.info: A man on a new wanted list walked out into the dunes three days ago, and his footprints go up and down the crests at the same even stride as if the sand were a pavement. The bounty hunter means to follow them alone.
quests.goal: Bring Vance Rourke home alive, whatever waits at the end
steps: Follow the tracks as far as they can be followed.
Bring Vance Rourke home alive, whatever waits at the end.

quests.name: Twelve Days Unopened
quests.info: A container with a family's seal on it has stood on siding four since the end of the month, and in the warm nights something inside has begun to smell and, once, to scratch.
quests.goal: Learn which firm consigned it
steps: Read the container's seal and waybill.
Learn which firm consigned it.

quests.name: Two Contracts Cross
quests.info: A senior assassin keeps the family's rule when two jobs collide. Another of the family has a contract that runs straight across the party's, and members may not kill each other.
quests.goal: Finish the job without breaking the family rule
steps: Find where the two contracts meet.
Finish the job without breaking the family rule.
Tell Silva Zoldyck the job is done.

quests.name: Two Men in New Boots
quests.info: Two strangers have spent three nights at the long bar asking after the beast behind the gate. Their boots have never touched a mountain, and the broker would like to know whose money is paying for the drinks before his own employers ask him.
quests.goal: Get a look at what they keep in the case under the table
steps: Drink with the strangers until one of them talks too much.
Get a look at what they keep in the case under the table.

quests.name: Two Men Who Tip Too Well
quests.info: Two men in new homespun who speak the village tongue badly have taken a room at the crossroads inn, asking every carter about wreckage on the coast and tipping like men who are used to being obeyed.
quests.goal: Keep them off the strand for a day
steps: Learn who sent them.
Keep them off the strand for a day.

quests.name: Two Nights Dark
quests.info: Greta Hollin has logged a ship standing off the north coast two nights running, showing no lights and answering no call, and the harbourmaster has not replied to her note. Hobb believes her log. He wants someone young enough to lie on the clifftop until the small hours and see what that ship does when it thinks the island is asleep.
quests.goal: Follow the ship's boat to the place it lands
steps: Keep the night watch with Greta Hollin from the coastwatch stone.
Follow the ship's boat to the place it lands.

quests.name: Two off the Mail Boat
quests.info: Two hard-faced men have stepped off the mail boat with rifles in cases, taken rooms at Harbour Rest Guesthouse and started asking after a stranger with a bad leg. One of them carries a Hunter licence and shows it to anyone who hesitates. Maud Ferrier has fed them, because she feeds everyone, and has sent word up to the kilns.
quests.goal: Keep them away from the denning hollows for a day
steps: Find out from the bounty hunters how much they know and how far they mean to go.
Keep them away from the denning hollows for a day.

quests.name: Two Reports
quests.info: The manager wants the report by morning, the blasting charges are already laid along the far wall of the gallery, and Konrad Ferle has both versions written and folded in his coat.
quests.goal: See the true report reach someone the company cannot silence
steps: Get the charges out of the gallery before the shift.
See the true report reach someone the company cannot silence.

quests.name: Two Rows Down
quests.info: A stall two rows down holds a crate of plain cards with a seal that looks right. Magda wants to know what she is being asked to sell before her name is in it.
quests.goal: Learn which barge brought it in
steps: Look the crate over without the stallholder knowing who sent you.
Learn which barge brought it in.

quests.name: Tyres on the Waste
quests.info: The hermit has counted the tyres crossing his ground: three vehicles, twice this week, both times on a moonless night. He says tonight is moonless too.
quests.goal: Stop the convoy before it reaches the road
steps: Lie up with the hermit where the tracks cross.
Stop the convoy before it reaches the road.

quests.name: Unclaimed
quests.info: The smaller parcels do not come by freight at all: they ride in the luggage of coach passengers who never collect it, and one bag has been asked after by a man who knew what it held.
quests.goal: Be there when the man comes back for it
steps: Find the bag in the unclaimed box.
Be there when the man comes back for it.

quests.name: Under the Catch
quests.info: The phones come ashore packed under ice in the fish boxes of one numbered boat, and the soldier who watches the weighing has started lifting the top layer of every box.
quests.goal: Get the crate ashore without the soldier opening it
steps: Meet the boat off the harbour mouth before it ties up.
Get the crate ashore without the soldier opening it.

quests.name: Under the Dunes
quests.info: The map points to a vault under the dunes of the Bilgai Desert, and the sand moves every night.
quests.goal: Open it without bringing the sand down
steps: Find the vault under the sand.
Open it without bringing the sand down.

quests.name: Ward of the Quarter
quests.info: A ward resident speaks for a street of the quarter. The street's water has been cut off, and the city says it is the quarter's fault.
quests.goal: Get the water back
steps: Find who cut the water.
Get the water back.
Tell Sarahell the job is done.

quests.name: Watched in the Cellar
quests.info: The priest has threaded the first tape and turned the screen to the wall. The tapes are birthdays and a kitchen and a garden, he says, and then they stop, and the children should decide whether they want to see where.
quests.goal: Let the two children choose what they see
steps: Watch the tapes with the priest first.
Let the two children choose what they see.

quests.name: What the Buoy Brought
quests.info: By first light the something in the surf has become a sealed canister lashed to an orange buoy, and Bess Tremayne has already carried it home to her cottage on the cliff path. Hobb needs to see inside it. He would much rather the party asked her for it than he did, because he has not set foot in that cottage for years and has his own reasons for staying out.
quests.goal: Open it somewhere dry and read what it holds
steps: Talk the canister out of Bess Tremayne without turning her house over.
Open it somewhere dry and read what it holds.

quests.name: What the Clearing Kept
quests.info: The raiders' tents rotted where they stood, and nobody came back for their kit. Somewhere under the canvas is a pack with his brother's initials burned into the strap, and the young Hunter cannot make himself be the one to lift the cloth.
quests.goal: Bring out whatever the brother left behind
steps: Search the tent lines before the rain turns the ground to soup.
Bring out whatever the brother left behind.

quests.name: What the Company Filed
quests.info: Konrad Ferle suspects this is not the first time the company has broken into something old and filed nothing, and the newspaper's clippings library keeps forty years of mining stories.
quests.goal: Find proof the company has buried a find before
steps: Search the newspaper's morgue for old accidents and closures.
Find proof the company has buried a find before.

quests.name: What the Family Packed
quests.info: Under the cartons of cigarettes and canned meat meant for trade, one crate is nailed shut with the family's own seal. His boss said not to open it. His boss also said nobody here would ever look at it.
quests.goal: Learn whose face is on the photograph inside
steps: Open the sealed crate so the seal can be set back.
Learn whose face is on the photograph inside.

quests.name: What the Ground Gives Up
quests.info: The digger has found the place without the map: under the bell court lie the bronze plates of the temple's scriptures, and he is lifting the stones.
quests.goal: Decide where the plates go
steps: Reach the bell court before the first plate comes up.
Decide where the plates go.

quests.name: What the Prisoners Know
quests.info: Some of the tower's convicts ran with the wanted man once, and Lippo will let the party question them.
quests.goal: Learn where the wanted man hides
steps: Question the convicts.
Learn where the wanted man hides.

quests.name: What the Regulars Know
quests.info: Ninety days are no use unless the boy learns what the floor's regulars do that no fighter downstairs can, and the coach has heard of someone who trains pupils at dawn in the park.
quests.goal: Bring the boy before that teacher
steps: Find a teacher who will take him.
Bring the boy before that teacher.

quests.name: What the Storm Brought
quests.info: The autumn storm left a sealed metal case in the wrack with a brass plate and a row of stamped numbers. The creed says it goes on the fire, and Nell Corrie has hidden it under the drying kelp instead.
quests.goal: Make sense of the numbers on the plate
steps: Open the case before anyone else finds it.
Make sense of the numbers on the plate.
quests.next: Two Men Who Tip Too Well

quests.name: When the Wings Lift
quests.info: The crimson butterflies have left the glade all at once, flying east. The naturalist who counts them knows what that means: somewhere in the woods, something is bleeding.
quests.goal: Tend whoever they found
steps: Follow the butterflies.
Tend whoever they found.

quests.name: Who Came off the Ferry
quests.info: A ferry crew sold Corvin Ashe a photograph of a poisoner who came ashore at Dolle Harbor this week under a name nobody yet knows; the coast guard writes down every passenger it lands.
quests.goal: Match the photograph to a name in it
steps: Get a look at the coast guard's landing log.
Match the photograph to a name in it.

quests.name: Who Will Not Be Missed
quests.info: Viktor Halasz pulls the party aside: the broker keeps a short list of carriers, ticked off as they go up and fail to come down, and the party's names are written on it in a neat hand.
quests.goal: Choose what becomes of the broker and his list
steps: Get the list out of the curtained booth.
Choose what becomes of the broker and his list.

quests.name: Without Peer
quests.info: A killer without peer turns work down. The agent brings the party a contract every other name has refused, with a fee to match the risk.
quests.goal: Take the job or turn it down, and live
steps: Learn why everyone refused.
Take the job or turn it down, and live.
Tell Sengi Guild Agent the job is done.

quests.name: Witness Protection
quests.info: The deputy chief prosecutor keeps the bureau's witnesses alive. A witness in the protection rooms says someone has been in her room while she slept.
quests.goal: Keep the witness safe until she testifies
steps: Find who entered the room.
Keep the witness safe until she testifies.
Tell Botobai Gigante the job is done.

quests.name: Work in Many Fields
quests.info: About ten Hunters in the Association hold three stars. The board will look at the party's record across every field it has touched and ask for one more feat in a field it has not.
quests.goal: Finish one feat in a field new to the party
steps: Bring the board a record of work in more than one field.
Finish one feat in a field new to the party.
Tell Mamen Beans the job is done.

quests.name: Wrapped and Hooded
