quests.info: A hooded resident is one the city trusts with its face. The market has a newcomer who takes more than he trades, and the residents want to see whether the party treats one of its own fairly.
quests.goal: Settle him into the city's ways
steps: Learn the newcomer's story.
Settle him into the city's ways.
Tell Franklin Bordeau the job is done.

quests.name: Wrapped in Plastic
quests.info: Lotte found a box under a slab that no child could lift, full of new tapes in plastic. The girl at the caretakers' house says her family's tapes went into the same kind of box on the day they were left.
quests.goal: Carry the box to the church unopened
steps: Lift the slab off Lotte's box.
Carry the box to the church unopened.

examples: I create my Hatsu: Mending Thread, a strand of aura that closes a wound

say.label: Imagery training (Conjurers)

words: [Ii]magery|[Ss]tudy (it|the shape)|[Hh]old it every day|[Dd]raw it over
examples: I study the shape and hold it every day

say.label: Swear a vow on your Nen

words: [Ii] (swear|vow)|I (SWEAR|VOW)|[Mm]ake a vow|MAKE A VOW|[Aa] limitation on|[Ii] bind (my|it)
examples: I make a vow: this thread only mends, never harms
I swear a limitation on my Hatsu

say.label: Everything for one fight

needs: someone carrying Vow: Everything for One Fight
examples: Everything I have, now

text.homeSay: The exact words that set off travel, Nen training, faction work and atonement.
text.homeMap: Every district on one map: find a place, show one district.
text.ledePeople: Everyone the known world introduces you to, with where to find them.
text.ledePlaces: Cities, islands, towers and wilds of the known world.
text.ledeCreatures: Beasts, magical creatures and the kinds of people the known world sends against you.
text.ledeLore: History, Nen, society and places of the known world.
text.ledeMechanics: How the world works, as the guide books every new character carries explain it.
text.ledeSkills: The skills of the known world.
text.ledeMusic: The soundtrack of the known world, by the mood of the scene.
text.ledeDistricts: The districts of the known world, all on the one map.
text.ledeSay: The lines that set off the world's systems.
text.ledeFactions: The associations, families, gangs and crews you can swear to, work for or cross.
text.ledeItems: Weapons, armour, remedies, tools, treasures and goods: what each gives, the slot it takes and how you get it.
text.guideSay: Most of the world's systems listen for plain lines.
text.plannerLede: Every pick the creator offers, in its order, with the same unlocks and exclusions. The totals add up what your picks give.
text.benchLede: Build the exact line to type, then run it through the world's own crafting triggers, the same code the game runs, to see what the narrator will be told.

patter: Ladies, gentlemen, and that examiner in the back:
patter.people: Everyone in the building, and a few who came in through the roof!
patter.places: Every stage in the house, front of house to the trapdoors!
patter.factions: Pick a side! Pick two! Dreamer once picked them all.
patter.creatures: Mind the beasts, folks. Most of them bite. Some of them clap.
patter.lore: Gather round for the long version, with all the voices!
patter.abilities: The tricks of the trade, and what each one costs!
patter.traits: Pick your costume! It changes everything!
patter.items: Props, every one! Handle with care, return by morning.
patter.starts: Curtain up! Where would you like the story to begin?
patter.quests: Odd jobs for brave volunteers! Dreamer has volunteered you.
patter.map: The whole tour on one page! Dreamer has been everywhere twice.
patter.skills: Practice makes the act! Here is what to practise.
patter.say: Say the magic words. No, really, these exact ones.
patter.planner: Build your act before the curtain goes up!
patter.districts: Every neighbourhood on the tour, each with its own crowd!
patter.guide: First time at the show? Dreamer will walk you in.
patter.search: Lost something? Dreamer finds things. Sometimes the right things.
